summary: XYZprinting presented the MfgPro220 xPF ultrafast 3D printer at Rapid + TCT 2018, highlighting its $19,950 price, 16-liter build volume, cognitive software, sensors, and LSPc technology that reduces printing cycles from hours to minutes. The passage also describes XYZprinting’s partnership with BEGO and Nexa3D to develop and market high-speed dental printers and other white-label products.

Sensient Technologies Corporation reported quarterly earnings of $0.80 per share, beating estimates by $0.02, and announced a $0.30 quarterly dividend payable March 1 to shareholders of record on February 7. The company had a net margin of 9.13%, return on equity of 16.73%, a market cap of $3.48 billion, and a 1.53% dividend yield. KeyCorp raised its price target to $84 and Zacks upgraded the stock to hold.

Collagen production decreases with age, prompting interest in supplements for skin, joint, bone, nail, and muscle support. The main supplement types are bovine, marine, porcine, and chicken collagen, with hydrolysed collagen described as the most effective and easiest to absorb. Research suggests possible benefits, but it is still ongoing, and a balanced diet with collagen-supporting nutrients is the most reliable way to maintain natural collagen levels.

The passage shows the contents of a technical report titled “Phase angle clusters in bioimpedance: An alternative to body mass index,” along with publication and license details for a medRxiv preprint posted on January 3, 2024.

The lecture introduces discrete stochastic processes, emphasizing that probability theory is about modeling real-world uncertainty and that finding good models is harder than solving well-posed problems. It outlines the course topics, discusses applications such as networks, queuing, risk management, and catastrophe prevention, and presents Kolmogorov’s axioms, random variables, independence, and basic consequences like the union bound.

IBM and The Weather Channel launched a 3.2MB Android app for emerging markets that uses IBM mesh networking to relay messages phone-to-phone over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, helping information spread during emergencies when mobile networks fail. The app works on slow 2G networks, adds no extra battery burden, and uses digital signatures for security.

The passage is a presidential veto message opposing a bill that would donate public lands or land scrip to states to establish colleges for agriculture and mechanic arts. The message argues that the bill is inexpedient and unconstitutional because it would reduce federal revenue, blur federal and state powers, harm new states and existing colleges, and exceed Congress’s constitutional authority to dispose of public lands.

Bell Academy received a grant in November 2016 that funded a new physical education building behind the school, built by parent volunteers and community members. The new indoor space has improved classes by allowing more activities and less noise, and a rock-climbing wall is being added before the building’s ribbon cutting.

Bethesda Softworks announced that Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus will release on Nintendo Switch on June 29, digitally and physically, though the physical version requires a download. The game originally launched on PS4, Xbox One, and PC in October last year.

The drive concept is a two-receiver pass concept featuring a 10-12 yard basic route and a 3-4 yard shallow cross, creating a triangle read for the quarterback and stressing linebackers. It is effective against man and Cover 4, but less effective against Cover 2 and Cover 3. The quarterback typically reads go, shallow cross, basic, then check-down, with variations using bunch formations or as a backside answer against blitz.

The council says it is working to reduce congestion and disruption around the north of the city by coordinating roadworks, working with utility companies, adjusting traffic signals and lane arrangements, and using night or off-peak work where possible. It also says planned roadworks are publicised in advance through its website, media, social media, roadside signs and warning boards.

The Department of Higher Education and Training is working to integrate NSFAS into college and university systems to improve free higher education funding, after delayed payments and protests over outstanding student allowances. Minister Naledi Pandor said the delays were unacceptable, blamed system integration problems, and announced additional funding and administrative support for NSFAS. The DA criticized the lack of clear answers and called for an urgent meeting with NSFAS.

ADT is described as undervalued versus Verisure, with strong revenue growth, improving profitability, and a high share of recurring revenue. The company is supported by Google and State Farm partnerships, debt reduction, and share buybacks, though churn and stagnant subscriber numbers remain challenges. Investments in AI, remote assistance, and smart home solutions are intended to improve retention, and a 12–14x P/E is cited as implying 33%+ upside.

Mr. Allen reported the assassinations and arrests of Kim Ok-kiun and Hong, their transfer to Korean authorities, and the mutilation of Kim’s body. Mr. Sill reported unrest in three southern Korean provinces, attacks on oppressive officials, the removal of missionaries for safety, and requested more frequent U.S. ship visits.

Joe Bryant’s Week 10 fantasy football email updates cheatsheets and previews passing and rushing matchups to avoid or exploit, highlighting favorable and unfavorable games for quarterbacks, receivers, and running backs.

The document describes the VCEK certificate and AMD KDS interface used to retrieve it for SEV-SNP systems. It covers the trust chain, certificate format and extensions, access methods for VCEK, certificate chain, and CRL retrieval, and notes that certificates are generated on request and can be pre-fetched for future TCB values.

Mauricio Pochettino named a 26-player U.S. men’s roster for October friendlies, with Christian Pulisic and Weston McKennie included. The squad is mostly full-strength after September experimentation, while several players were left out because of absences, injuries, or surprising exclusions.

UPMSP will declare the UP Board 10th and 12th results for 2018 on April 29 at 12:30 pm on upresults.nic.in and upmspresults.up.nic.in. The 10th exams were held from February 6 to 22, and the 12th exams from February 6 to March 12. Results can also be checked by website or SMS.

The speaker says the game has been tight and difficult, with Hasek active outside his net and making puck possession hard. He notes frustration with scoring and some defensive breakdowns, and says the team needs to refocus on stronger play from the defensive zone while accepting coaching changes and continuing to play.

The passage describes a vehicle sensing system using one or more radar sensors with two-dimensional arrays of transmitting and receiving antennas. A control applies 2D MIMO processing to create an enhanced virtual aperture, improving horizontal and vertical accuracy and resolution for detecting objects exterior to the vehicle. The system may support driver assistance functions, alerts, vehicle control, and optional fusion with camera data.

Jennifer Thompson was raped at knife-point and mistakenly identified Ronald Cotton as her attacker, leading to his conviction. Eleven years later, DNA testing showed Bobby Poole was the rapist, and Ronald had been wrongfully imprisoned. Jennifer says traumatic memory can fail, and she and Ronald later became close friends and joined Healing Justice.

Russia’s central bank cut its key rate to 9.25 percent from 9.75 percent for the second time this year and signaled more gradual cuts may follow as inflation continues to fall. It said annual consumer price growth should reach 4 percent before the end of 2017 and stay there in 2018-2019.

The Oct. 15 military pay date for 1.3 million active-duty service members may pressure lawmakers and the White House to end the shutdown. Analysts said it could trigger a compromise or a continuing resolution, though some expect the shutdown to last beyond mid-October or even into November.

The passage describes fabrication and cryogenic characterization of CMOS-compatible NbN coplanar waveguide resonators on n-doped Si/Si0.7Ge0.3 wafers, including deep etching of CPW gaps into the substrate. Two chips showed fundamental resonances near 5.04, 5.08, 5.57, and 5.60 GHz, with internal quality factors that were stable over four cooldowns spanning two years. Power and temperature measurements indicated TLS-related effects at low power and additional temperature-dependent loss, while the main losses were attributed to scattering centers and interface roughness.

Day 1 of the 2025 World Grand Prix of Darts featured an eight-game Monday night slate, with Luke Humphries, James Wade, Nathan Aspinall and Stephen Bunting among the players involved. Rob Cross won a three-set match against Nijman, Ratajski upset the top seed 2-0 with a 95.94 average, Menzies knocked out the #8 seed, and Cullen beat James Wade 2-0 in sets after a comeback.

Ghana’s gold mining companies, including Newmont, Gold Fields and AngloGold Ashanti, support new government tests to certify gold exports. The measures, which add to customs and company checks, are meant to tighten sector control and improve tax collection. The Chamber of Mines said it is working with the PMMC to implement the directive, while Ghana’s government also continues a clamp-down on illegal mining and unaccounted gold exports.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2016 reports total revenues of $1.15 billion and a net loss of $282.3 million. Cash and cash equivalents were $1.44 billion, total assets were $9.19 billion, and total liabilities were $8.18 billion. The company said Model S and Model X production continued, Model 3 had more than 325,000 reservations within one week of its introduction, and it was evaluating higher capital spending as it targeted 500,000 vehicle production in 2018.

The passage says a Minnesota school district will teach kindergarteners about “white privilege,” including a Melanin Project at Highlands Elementary School. It also says a Michigan State University professor claimed yoga by white people contributes to “white supremacy” and cultural appropriation.

In his farewell address, the president thanked aides and the American people, reflected on the presidency and the need for public involvement, and urged support for the new president. He warned about nuclear war, environmental decline, and the need to defend human rights, arguing that America must uphold its ideals at home and abroad.

The passage argues that diverse hiring is important in a global marketplace, but subconscious bias can affect decisions and cause employers to overlook qualified candidates. It cites studies showing bias in hiring and recommends using neutral job-posting language, removing names from resumes, and testing applicants’ skills to reduce bias.

The passage argues that high-dosage tutoring improves academic outcomes and can also cultivate belonging, build confidence, support teachers, and inspire future educators. It cites Teach For America’s Ignite Fellowship, which has trained more than 5,500 virtual tutors, produced strong student gains, and led many fellows into teaching, including 280 new teachers this year.

China’s foreign exchange regulator said capital outflow pressure eased in 2016 and that the yuan will have greater exchange-rate flexibility in 2017. SAFE said it will take measures to attract capital inflows, while China’s current account surplus is expected to remain within a reasonable range.

Amazon grew from an online bookstore to a major public company by prioritizing long-term growth over short-term profitability, expanding into many product categories, acquisitions, devices, and AWS. By its 20th IPO anniversary in 2017, it had a $458 billion market value and strong sales growth, but cumulative net income from 1997-2016 was only $4.9 billion.

The passage studies the “free option problem” created by Ethereum’s enshrined PBS (ePBS) with dual deadlines, where builders can withhold payloads or blobs to prevent unfavorable blocks from becoming canonical. It finds that option value and exercise probability rise with volatility, liquidity, and the share of CEX-DEX MEV, and that short windows or penalties reduce exercise but trade off against scalability or builder entry. Empirically, exercise is rare on average but spikes during high-volatility periods.

Microsoft’s 2020 Form 10-K says the company develops and sells software, cloud services, devices, and gaming products, operates through three segments, and was affected by COVID-19. It also outlines sustainability and digital-skills efforts, lists executive officers and employee counts, and describes major business risks including competition, cloud execution, acquisitions, cybersecurity, and data privacy.

Mary Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell and Shimon Sakaguchi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine for discovering regulatory T cells, which prevent the immune system from attacking the body and help avoid autoimmune disease. Sakaguchi identified T-regs in 1995, and Brunkow and Ramsdell later linked a mutation to a fatal autoimmune disease in mice and mutations in people.
An Enron email compiled media coverage about the company replacing CFO Andrew Fastow with Jeffrey McMahon amid SEC scrutiny of Fastow-related partnership dealings and a sharp stock decline.

Geary County authorities are investigating a road rage incident involving a white Dodge Ram 2500 near Fort Riley. Deputies said the passenger waved a gun at another vehicle after the truck cut off two Junction City residents and slowed in a construction zone. Isaac Torgerson of Fort Riley was arrested on suspicion of aggravated assault.

The Yankees made a surprise lineup change for ALDS Game 4 against the Blue Jays, starting Paul Goldschmidt at first base and benching Ben Rice. Goldschmidt will bat sixth, while Rice had started all three previous games and can still be used as a pinch-hitter or catching replacement.

The author ordered from Temu after it resumed direct shipping from China and worried about tariffs, but the package arrived with no extra fees. Some items were disappointing or broken, but one set worked well, and the author was later confirmed to be safe from tariffs.

Donnell Gibson, known as “Mr. D,” is a behavior intervention specialist and basketball coach at Como Park Senior High in St. Paul who mentors young men through school support, sports, and the Gibson Foundation. A former homeless youth, he was honored for running into a burning house three times in 2015 to save a family of 10.

An Enron media roundup from October 23, 2001 includes reports of a class-action lawsuit, SEC scrutiny of partnership transactions, falling stock prices, and criticism of the company’s accounting and financing. It also includes articles about Enron’s loan request from Citigroup, a Texas Monthly profile on Enron’s rise and decline, and related stories about trade, power, and India.

The passage describes a computational and experimental approach to studying microtubule dynamics in prostate cancer and using these patterns to anticipate drug resistance. It reports that ARv7-expressing M12 cells showed increased microtubule growth speeds, links quiescence and pVHL/GSK3β regulation to altered microtubule turnover, and discusses organoid, CTC, and image-analysis methods for matching tumors to tubulin inhibitors and other therapies.

The meeting was positive and focused on changes to the game plan. The team said it needs to improve its speed and skating, noted its goalie has been great in the playoffs, and said it has been close despite not playing its best. It also said the series is becoming more mental and that each player must prepare to bring their best game.

California’s energy crisis prompted proposed state purchases of utility transmission lines, long-term power contracts, and cuts in payments to small generators, while regulators, lawmakers, and the utilities disputed who would pay the growing power costs. Reported power alerts were lifted temporarily, but officials said the crisis and negotiations were far from resolved.

Hungary’s education system has evolved over 200 years, with compulsory general education, a structured teacher preparation system, and early special education history. Current special education policy gives students with disabilities rights to free schooling and supports, but Hungary still faces issues with diagnosis, accessibility, inclusion, teacher training, pay, and retention.

Donchian Channels, invented by Richard Donchian, use upper and lower bands based on the high and low of the last N bars. The passage says they work as a trend-following indicator for commodities and currencies, and as a mean-reversion indicator for stocks, while also noting they are similar in appearance to Bollinger Bands but can produce different backtest results.

Nvidia and Micron both rallied after last week’s earnings-related selling, but the passage says Nvidia bounced from its 50-day trendline and remains technically bullish, while Micron is still below its 50-day moving average, faces overhead resistance at $84, and is viewed as a likely short-lived rebound.

Trump suggested some furloughed federal workers may not receive back pay during the shutdown, despite prior administration guidance saying they would be paid retroactively. The White House memo and Trump’s remarks were seen as pressure on Senate Democrats, prompting criticism from the federal workers’ union.

BMO Capital Markets downgraded Canadian lumber producers after warning that U.S. duties, a stronger Canadian dollar and ongoing litigation would hurt the sector, with a near-term resolution to the lumber dispute seen as unlikely. West Fraser, Interfor and Canfor fell after the downgrade, while BMO said long-term prospects remain more positive.

In a speech at the University of Virginia, Reagan praised Thomas Jefferson’s influence on higher education, self-government, and American institutions, while arguing that democratic and free-market revolutions were expanding worldwide. He highlighted progress in U.S.-Soviet relations, arms reduction, regional conflicts, and human rights, urged caution and strong leadership in dealing with the Soviet Union, criticized congressional limits on foreign policy, and closed by invoking Jefferson’s legacy of self-government and unity.

Japan’s economy grew faster than expected in the April-to-June quarter, with GDP up 4% annualised and 1% from the previous quarter, driven by higher consumer spending and capital expenditure. Strong domestic demand offset a drop in exports, and the figures may support Shinzo Abe’s growth policies.

Select Security acquired Charlotte-based Intelligent Technology Inc. and Carolina Security Group, adding nearly 1,000 customers, staff, and a downtown Charlotte branch as it consolidates western North Carolina operations. The company, founded in 2003, serves nearly 30,000 customers across nine states and offers security, fire alarm, surveillance, access control, home security, life safety, and home automation systems.

Scientists at Newcastle University have 3D printed the first human corneas using a stem-cell bio-ink made from alginate and collagen. The corneas were printed in under 10 minutes, cells grew successfully, and patient-specific corneas matching eye scans were also demonstrated. Further testing is needed before transplant use.

Texas beaches are regularly tested for bacteria associated with feces, which can enter ocean water after heavy rain and stormwater runoff. A Galveston Beach advisory near 57th Street was issued Thursday and lifted Friday after water samples cleared. Officials say to avoid water under advisories, check conditions at TexasBeachWatch.com or GCHD.org, and note that warnings usually clear within 48 hours.

VentureWire’s May 16, 2001 issue reported Buzzsaw.com’s layoffs and planned $20 million round, UGO Networks’ acquisition of Bla-Bla.com, several new financings and product launches, multiple layoffs and shutdowns, acquisitions by Motient, XCare.net, Escalate, Qiva, BrainHeart, EMS Technologies, and Parthus, management changes at several companies, and VC fund news including Invesco’s $150 million EuroMedia Fund, PSINet Ventures winding down, and new funds from Schneider Electric, Axiomlab, CalPERS-backed SVCV, and Friends Ivory & Sime.

The passage lists key archival and published sources for studying Haig and Reagan, including papers at the Library of Congress, State Department files, the Reagan Library, and major newspapers. It also describes several Reagan campaign speeches and statements in 1980, with dates, locations, sources, and related press coverage.

Satellite radar over Colorado detected a 70-mile-wide swarm that scientists first thought were birds, but it was later identified as migrating Painted Lady butterflies. The species has recently descended in large numbers on the Denver area, and can glide hundreds of miles each day by following wind patterns.

The study developed a reproducible, data-driven method to prioritize AI-detected chest X-ray abnormalities for faster lung cancer reporting using two Greater Manchester cohorts. Three strategies were compared; the clinically reviewed strategy achieved 95.87% sensitivity and 79.11% specificity, with an NPV of 99.95%.

The NFP report, released by the US Department of Labor every first Friday at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time, shows monthly changes in US non-agricultural jobs and is a key indicator of economic health. It can cause major market volatility, affecting bonds, stocks, forex, and commodities; higher-than-expected figures are generally positive for the USD and stocks but negative for bonds, while lower-than-expected figures have the opposite effect. Backtests in the passage found a small positive open-to-close return for SPY and a small negative return for TLT, but concluded there is no clear edge in trading NFP numbers.

ICRC launched the nationwide “Pehlay Zindagi: Give Way to Ambulances— Give Way to Life” campaign to encourage motorists to respect and make way for ambulances. The initiative includes awareness activities, a website, a pledge application, media outreach, and support from over 30 partner organizations, and will run until December 2017.

The lecture discusses pseudorandom graphs, focusing on n,d,λ graphs and the expander mixing lemma, which shows that smaller λ gives more pseudorandomness. It gives Cayley graphs and Paley graphs as examples, computes their eigenvalues using Fourier-type sums, and shows Paley graphs have small nontrivial eigenvalues. It then states and proves that for Cayley graphs, a discrepancy condition is equivalent to a small-eigenvalue condition, using Grothendieck’s inequality. Finally, it presents the Alon-Boppana bound, showing that for fixed degree d, λ2 cannot be much smaller than 2√(d−1), with two proofs based on explicit vectors and the trace method.

Rain in Detroit delayed Mariners vs. Tigers ALDS Game 3, which was originally scheduled for 4:08 p.m. ET. The Tigers later said first pitch was expected at 7 p.m. ET, while MLB reportedly aimed for 7:30 p.m. ET, but no official confirmation was given. The game was moved to FS2, MLB Network, and the Fox One App.

The bank sued Hepner on a renewal promissory note for $1,400. Hepner claimed the original note was fraudulently induced by the Kil-Tone Company and that the bank knew of the fraud through its cashier, Hitchner, but the court excluded this evidence, held the cashier’s knowledge was not attributable to the bank, and discharged the rule for a new trial.

Apple Inc. filed its Q1 2023 Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 31, 2022, reporting net sales of $117.154 billion and net income of $29.998 billion, both lower than the prior-year quarter. The company cited foreign currency weakness as a major factor, repurchased $19.0 billion of stock, paid $3.8 billion in dividends, and said disclosure controls were effective with no material changes in internal control.

Lower global and U.S. interest rates may support a rebound in housing and related cyclical stocks over the next one to four years, with home improvement and homebuilding stocks historically outperforming during falling-rate periods. Tariffs on lumber and wooden goods may benefit domestic manufacturers, while lower current leverage than in 2007 is cited as reducing subprime-crisis risk.

Rite-Hite introduced the Uni-Dox Inflatable Shelter for loading docks serving varied truck and trailer configurations. It inflates after docking and deflates before departure, using a counterweight retraction system, conforming draft pads, and a single-phase blower; it is also suited for full rear trailer access and facilities with strong pressure, yard jockeys, truck levelers, or hydraulic rear tandems.

The defendant appealed a grand larceny conviction, arguing former jeopardy and trial error. The court held the jury’s earlier discharge was proper under the circumstances, but reversed the conviction because the alibi charge was fundamentally erroneous and granted a new trial.

The passage describes AGESA procedures, host call-outs, and build configuration options for processor, memory, graphics, ACPI, S3, and reset initialization. It also lists status codes, parameter structures, cache and memory allocation rules, and platform-specific customization settings for features such as VRM, PCIe, SATA, USB, and ACPI table generation.

The speaker says his favorite hockey player is Ron Hextall and praises hockey playoffs as exciting, especially Stanley Cup overtime. He says great players are helped by great teammates, and that winning multiple championships is especially difficult and impressive.

APP_CMD (CMD55) makes the next command an application-specific command; undefined ACMDs are treated as regular commands if legal, and reserved ACMD numbers include ACMD6, ACMD13, ACMD17-26, ACMD38-49, and ACMD51. CMD6 switches or queries card functions in six function groups, with mode 0 checking support and maximum power/current, and mode 1 setting functions; high-speed mode is optional and returns a 512-bit status block. CMD8 checks host supply voltage in Idle state and returns R7 if accepted. The passage also describes command/response formats, CRC protection, timeout rules, status fields, and Speed Class, UHS, and Video Speed Class performance requirements and recording procedures.

The bulletin lists multiple job openings for Haas alumni in locations including Berkeley, San Francisco, San Mateo, New York, San Jose, Los Angeles, Denver, and Menlo Park, with roles in business development, finance, consulting, product management, fundraising, compliance, and financial planning. It also includes detailed expanded postings with contact information, qualifications, and application instructions, plus notices about Haas Homecoming, alumni job subscription changes, and a disclaimer that the companies were not researched by the Haas School.

NVIDIA’s Q3 fiscal 2019 10-Q reported revenue of $3.181 billion, net income of $1.230 billion, and diluted EPS of $1.97, with revenue up 21% year over year. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $7.591 billion, and the company returned $1.13 billion to shareholders in the first nine months through repurchases and dividends.

The study found persistent excess mortality and years of potential life lost (YPLL) among Black people compared with White people in the U.S. from 1999 to 2020, totaling more than 80 million years of life lost. Improvements before 2012 stalled and were reversed in 2020, with heart disease, cancer, and infant mortality contributing importantly to the disparities.

One officer and two gunmen were killed, and eight officers were wounded, when Barrio 18 attacked police in San Salvador during a search for illegal weapons. One killed gunman was identified as a Barrio 18 leader in Panchimalco suspected in more than a dozen murders. The wounded officers had superficial injuries, and El Salvador is described as one of the world’s most dangerous countries.

Japan’s government raised its April assessment of business sentiment after the Bank of Japan’s tankan survey showed improving corporate mood, but kept its overall view that the economy is recovering gradually with some weaknesses. It said exports, factory output, employment and wages are improving, while consumer spending, capital expenditure and exports are recovering.

A 26-year-old Aroland man has been charged with assault with a weapon after a 30-year-old man died of injuries in a residence on Aroland First Nation. Ontario Provincial Police and Nishinawbe-Aski Police Service are investigating, and a postmortem examination is planned.

Comcast abandoned its bid for most of Twenty-First Century Fox’s assets, leaving Disney as the only remaining suitor in the $40 billion-plus deal. Comcast said it ended its review because it did not get the engagement needed to make a definitive offer. Disney’s talks with Fox continued, and a deal could be reached as early as that month.

The passage explains that simple moving average (SMA) strategies are used to identify trends, support and resistance, and buy or sell signals. Backtests suggest short-term SMAs work better for mean reversion, while long-term SMAs work better for trend following, with the 200-day moving average highlighted as effective. The SMA is described as lagging more than the EMA, and its usefulness depends on market context, period length, and whether it is combined with other indicators.

Colleges and universities are trying to reduce disruption around Oct. 7, when students and other groups plan demonstrations marking the second anniversary of the Hamas attacks on Israeli civilians. Columbia and the University of Maryland have tightened protest and campus access rules, and other schools are also facing planned events and protests.

Thirty-seven lawyers, including 10 partners, are joining Orrick from Cadwalader and will be based in Charlotte, London, Washington, D.C., and New York. The move comes amid reports of significant partner defections at Cadwalader this year, with the firm also adding leadership changes and other lawyers to strengthen core practices.

The passage describes a patent application about carrier aggregation and multicarrier communication systems, focusing on scheduling, timing advance groups, random access, multi-connectivity, tight interworking, gNB deployment, network slicing, licensed-assisted access, logical channel mapping, bandwidth parts, and control resource set configuration in LTE/5G networks.

Yahoo’s AOL is in advanced talks to be sold to Bending Spoons for about $1.4 billion. The passage also says Tesla delivered a record 497,100 vehicles in Q3, Caterpillar is benefiting from the AI boom, Berkshire Hathaway is buying Occidental Petroleum’s chemical business for $9.7 billion, and Wedbush identified several AI-related takeover targets.
Tesla Motors, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated April 3, 2015, stating that it published a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 and furnished the information under Items 2.02 and 7.01.

The speaker thanks a predecessor, cites religious and historical symbols, and says the inauguration marks a new beginning grounded in enduring principles. He calls for national unity, faith, justice, mercy, humility, competence, compassion, human rights, and individual sacrifice for the common good. He urges strength at home, respect for others abroad, support for freedom worldwide, limits on armaments, and progress toward lasting peace, including the elimination of nuclear weapons.

In the DAWN-Plasma randomized open-label phase 2 trial, 489 hospitalized COVID-19 patients were randomized 2:1 to standard care plus 4 units of convalescent plasma or standard care alone. The primary outcome, alive without mechanical ventilation on Day 15, did not differ between groups, and no significant differences were found for secondary outcomes or safety events. Transfusion-related side effects occurred in 19/320 patients, and the intervention did not change antibody-titer trends.

A prospective hospital-based study in three Dar es Salaam referral hospitals followed 229 adults with acute intestinal obstruction. Adhesions were the most common surgical diagnosis, with abdominal tumors, hernia, and volvulus also associated. Most patients were male, median age was 34 years, median hospital stay was 4 days, crude mortality was 5.3%, and 76% were discharged home.

Averaging down is buying more of a stock after its price falls to lower the average purchase price and reduce the breakeven point. It can help in some long-term or backtested strategies, but it can also increase losses if the price keeps falling. The passage says stocks are the best market for this approach because they are prone to mean reversion.

The Personalized Medicine Conference, hosted by San Francisco State University since 2008, has featured discussions on genomic health, precision medicine, and related scientific, business, regulatory, and ethical topics. Its 10th meeting on June 2, 2017, titled “Has It Changed Your Life?”, will review past themes, examine future directions, and include speakers from academia, industry, government, and medicine.

The work studies how to incorporate structural information into Bayesian optimization for antibody engineering, when it helps, and whether it improves over sequence-only approaches. It also proposes a protein language model “soft constraint” and notes that successful therapeutic antibodies must meet binding and developability criteria.

The fund is the consolidated result of several Aberdeen funds merged into Aberdeen Chile Fund, renamed Aberdeen Emerging Markets Equity Income Fund, Inc. and trading as AEF since April 30, 2018. It follows a multi-cap emerging markets equity income strategy and, as of May 25, 2018, its largest holding was Tencent Holdings Ltd, with cash and other smaller securities also included.

Joy Lane, Steve Stephens’ ex-girlfriend, texted CBS News after Stephens was suspected of killing Robert Godwin Sr. and broadcasting it on Facebook Live. She expressed sympathy for the victim’s family, described Stephens as kind and loving to her and her children, and asked for privacy. Police said Stephens randomly shot Godwin in Cleveland and are still investigating and searching for him.

The study compared chest x-ray-based biological age (CXR-Age) with epigenetic clocks in 2,097 Project Baseline Health Study participants. CXR-Age was moderately correlated with chronological age and was associated with worse coronary calcium, pulmonary function, frailty, disability, and some plasma proteins, while DNAm PhenoAge showed similar but not identical associations and Horvath age showed little association with these outcomes.

The study presents PhenoID, a transformer-based pipeline for extracting and normalizing dysmorphology findings to Human Phenotype Ontology terms from EHR text. Using 3,826 observations from 1,655 individuals, it achieved the best normalization performance among compared systems, with 0.717 F1, and 0.82 F1 when gold spans were provided.

SpaceX is set to launch Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s “Spaceborne Computer” to the International Space Station on a Falcon 9 rocket. The supercomputer is designed to process data in space, may perform one trillion calculations per second, and will be tested for a year to see if it can survive and function in orbit.

Valeant Pharmaceuticals Intl shares fell 0.3%, with analysts giving a 12-month consensus target of $16.75 based on 18 opinions, versus a recent close of $16.73. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 2.83 from 12 recommendations, with 3 Buy, 2 Outperform, 7 Hold, 6 Underperform, and 0 Sell ratings. Its ATR-14 is 0.7, weekly volatility is 3.31%, monthly volatility is 3.81%, RSI is 43.3, market cap is $5.85 billion, and shares outstanding are 349.76 million.

Researchers found that limiting a nutrient used by malaria parasites in mice exploited competition between drug-sensitive and drug-resistant strains, preventing resistance from emerging and allowing an existing drug to remain effective. The study suggests this ecological approach could help extend the life of drugs for infections such as malaria and tuberculosis.

StatsCan reported a slight rise in London-St. Thomas unemployment to 5.5 per cent in September, alongside a drop in the labour force and a lower participation rate. A new study found only about half of working adults have secure, full-time jobs with benefits, while the rest are in precarious work that is linked to stress, poor health, depression, anger, and family impacts.

The passage describes LIDAR-based methods for generating 3D point clouds and automatically classifying objects in real time or near real time. It uses surface normals, feature variables, spin images, covariance matrices, clustering, k-d tree nearest-neighbor search, and, when two classifiers disagree, iterative closest point fitting against model point clouds. It also describes heterodyne and homodyne chirped LIDAR hardware, experimental results, and general computer system components for implementation.

Apple’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended April 1, 2017 reported net income of $11.0 billion on net sales of $52.9 billion for the quarter, up from $10.5 billion and $50.6 billion a year earlier. Total assets were $334.5 billion, cash and cash equivalents were $15.2 billion, and long-term debt was $84.5 billion. The company also reported share repurchases, dividends, regional and product sales results, and notes on taxes, debt, derivatives, and contingencies.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Blackwell/GeForce RTX 50 Series features, including FP4 support for smaller AI models, new RT Core improvements for faster ray tracing and Mega Geometry, LSS for hair and strand rendering, SER 2.0, AMP scheduling, improved video encode/decode and DisplayPort 2.1b, power-efficiency upgrades, DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation and transformer models, and new neural shader technologies such as Neural Materials, Neural Texture Compression, Neural Radiance Cache, RTX Skin, and RTX Neural Faces.

Cell phone ownership among children varies widely by country: in the US it often begins earlier, while in Europe, Asia, Africa, and Australia ages and rates differ. The passage also notes that there is no “right” age for a child’s first phone, according to the American Academy of Pediatrics.

The passage describes the development of a new classical EAM potential for the W-H-He system to simulate radiation damage in tungsten. It is fitted to DFT defect energies, relaxation volumes, and gaseous properties, with particular emphasis on light-gas trapping in vacancies/voids and swelling-related relaxation volumes, and is compared with existing Li and Yang potentials.

Residents from Southeast Alaska villages are being trained as energy assessors to help lower high diesel-powered electricity bills by identifying affordable home improvements. The program, run with REAP and Southeast tribes, offers low-cost household assessments and could reduce bills by close to 10 percent.

The passage criticizes widespread misconduct by financial advisers and bank financial planning arms, including falsely witnessing superannuation documents, conflicted and shonky advice, and fees for no service. It says the royal commission exposed wrongdoing at banks and AMP, leading to public shock and apologies, and cites a case where Joe Hockey’s mother-in-law was badly misadvised and undercompensated by CBA.

Las Vegas city officials plan to introduce an ordinance to codify several trash fees Republic Services has been charging commercial property owners without prior approval. The passage says local ordinances require city councils or county commissioners to approve such fees, but officials appear largely unaware of past discussions. Republic says the fees were listed in annual supplemental services reports to municipalities, while some officials say the charges may violate the ordinance or do not need separate approval.

Using Mendelian randomization, the study found six gut microbiota taxa and 82 plasma metabolites associated with fibromyalgia. Enterobacteriaceae, Butyricicoccus, Coprococcus1, and Enterobacteriales were linked to lower risk, while Eggerthella and Ruminococcaceae UCG005 were linked to higher risk. Key metabolite pathways included caffeine metabolism and α-linolenic acid metabolism, and 2,3-dihydroxypyridine and palmitoylcholine partially mediated the association between Enterobacteriaceae/Enterobacteriales and fibromyalgia.

Guinness will partner with Thierry Henry for the first time as part of its Made of Black campaign, with Henry working in Nigeria and across Africa to highlight people who show the Made of Black spirit. Henry said he was excited to work with Guinness and visit Nigeria, while Guinness Nigeria’s marketing director called him an inspirational ambassador. The passage also notes that Guinness launched Made of Black in 2014 and will continue sponsoring EPL broadcasts through DStv.

The passage describes implantable medical devices, especially cochlear implants, that use a magnet and structural components such as plates within an elastomeric body to limit magnet rotation when exposed to external magnetic fields, including MRI fields. The rotation causes the structural components to move apart and increase resistance, and some embodiments include a slit for inserting or removing the magnet apparatus.

TCI Fund Management said Zodiac Aerospace shares were worth 7-10 euros each after the company posted a first-half loss, revising its earlier 10-euro valuation. The hedge fund, which is urging Safran to drop its bid, said any offer above 10 euros would destroy value.

Michael Dell said AI computing demand is “tremendous” and that there may eventually be too many AI data centers, but he sees no signs of that now. Dell Technologies raised its long-term revenue and profit growth targets, and its shares rose more than 3% Tuesday.

The agreement sets minimum purchase quantities for Congo products, allows additional purchases, and requires agreed pricing and usual payment methods. It also obliges the United Kingdom and United States to supply the Congo with industrial goods, and requires the Belgian Government to maintain controls in the Congo on transactions and exports aiding enemy powers. The Department comments on the draft agreement, including prices, payment for unshipped goods, shipping, and suggestions for options on output and development work in the Congo.

The article tests three bullish candlestick patterns on SPY from 1993 to October 2021 using a close-based exit rule: Bearish Engulfing Pattern, Three Outside Down, and Bullish Harami. All three produced decent backtest results, with the Bearish Engulfing Pattern and Three Outside Down showing the strongest performance.

Turkish authorities issued detention warrants or made detentions in multiple provinces targeting people alleged to have Gülen links, including 133 former public servants, teachers, military personnel, women, and others, often citing alleged use of ByLock. The passage says the post-coup crackdown has led to 50,510 arrests, 169,013 legal proceedings, and more than 150,000 suspensions or dismissals since July 15, 2016.

The passage lists recent posts on market timing, indicators, and trading strategies, including SuperTrend, PENTAD, Fabian, Coppock Curve, Yale Hirsch’s Best 6 Months, Sy Harding’s Seasonal Timing, and Bitcoin market timing. It also defines market regime indicators and notes that most investors should not time the market because most fail, while the site is run by traders sharing research and backtests.
The appeal from the Supreme Court, New York County orders entered on or about June 13, 2008 and July 25, 2008 was unanimously withdrawn in accordance with the parties’ January 11, 2010 stipulation.

Microsoft’s board amended its bylaws on September 20, 2016 to clarify proxy access rules, extend the recall period for loaned shares from three to five business days, clarify indemnification provisions, and lower the support needed to renominate a proxy access candidate from 25% to 15%. The company also announced its 2016 Annual Shareholders Meeting for November 30, 2016, with September 30, 2016 as the record date.

NVIDIA’s Titan V reportedly outperforms the Titan Xp and GTX 1080 Ti in leaked benchmarks, scoring 32,774 in Fire Strike and showing strong game performance at 1440p. It uses Nvidia’s Volta architecture, HBM2 memory, and targets AI, prosumer, and developer users, with a price around $3,000.

David Moyes urged Sunderland’s players to create more chances for Jermain Defoe, who has scored 14 of their 24 league goals, as the team fights relegation. Sunderland have won only once in their last 11 league games and are seven points from safety with 10 matches left.

The passage explains RSI, ADX, and IBS as “Big Three” indicators for short-term trading. RSI and IBS are used for mean reversion, while ADX measures trend strength without showing direction. It also reports backtesting results for separate and combined strategies, with the combined indicators performing best and requiring limited market exposure.

An Erie public school, Glenwood School, was converted into Erie Federal Credit Union’s new headquarters and 9th branch after 18 months of renovation. The full-service location includes teller services, loans, wealth management, safe deposit boxes, a drive-through, and a community room, and it returns the property to the tax rolls.

Beluga whales Qila and Aurora died at the Vancouver Aquarium in 2016 from an unidentified toxin, and researchers say DNA samples from them will help sequence the complete beluga genome and support conservation efforts for the species.

Citadel Securities hired Anthony Cronin to lead Treasuries trading in Europe, expanding its market-making across more trading hours and supporting its push to become a leading global dollar-rates dealer. The firm is also adding staff, growing its client base, and plans to introduce missing Treasury products before likely seeking primary dealer status.

The passage says Marine Le Pen’s chances in the French presidential election may be improving because François Fillon is hurt by a scandal and riots in immigrant-heavy French suburbs are strengthening her anti-immigrant, tough-on-crime message. It notes the unrest has led to nearly 250 arrests and could influence voters, though her victory is still considered unlikely.

The Chaikin Oscillator, developed by Marc Chaikin in the 1980s, measures accumulation/distribution and market momentum using the ADL and two EMAs. Quantified tests on several trading strategies found no significant profitable results, though it may still indicate buying or selling pressure and divergences.

The players said frustration had built up because they had chances but failed to score in recent playoff games, including lost home opportunities. They said the team had refocused, appreciated returning to road routines, and hoped better execution, sharper power play play, and more shots would help them tonight.

Dwyane Wade, Gabrielle Union, and Zion Wade visited the Phillip and Patricia Frost Museum of Science in Miami, where they saw a planetarium show, looked at fish, touched stingrays, and Zion enjoyed the food and sunglasses. The passage also mentions Wade responding sharply to a Twitter troll.

A University of Kansas researcher found that well ownership is linked to increased water use during droughts and that conservation behaviors differ by well type. In a survey of 864 Kansans, nearly half were private well owners; the study suggests well owners may use more water because they are more aware of and reliant on groundwater, especially for irrigation.

The passage describes an autonomous vehicle management system that uses sensor data, internal maps, and AI techniques to control autonomous operations safely. It can dynamically change sensor behavior, simulate what-if scenarios, use confidence scores to judge AI predictions, and provide user-facing explanations of planned actions and reasons.

Leon Cooperman said the bull market is in a late stage similar to what Warren Buffett warned about, citing excessive valuations, especially in AI stocks, and signs of market exuberance. He noted the S&P 500’s strong rally and said stocks are less risky than government bonds because of elevated inflation.

Several major school districts approved teacher contract raises but lacked funds to pay for them. Philadelphia borrowed up to $1.5 billion, Chicago used refinancing to cover a $734 million deficit, and Fairfax County and Baltimore County renegotiated contracts after budget shortfalls.

The disclosure describes methods and apparatus for ACK/NACK feedback in wireless networks with multiple TRPs, including configuring PDCCH monitoring occasions, whether cross-TRP bundling is allowed, bundling rules, and DAI definitions. It supports joint or separate ACK/NACK feedback in PUCCH and discusses joint versus independent DAI operation for multi-TRP transmissions.

Big Brothers Big Sisters of Mercer County gave seven children unassembled bicycles and paired them with local law enforcement, FBI agents, and other mentors in Hamilton for an evening of teamwork, mentoring, and fun. The event, funded by an I am Trenton Community Foundation grant, also included building second bicycles to be donated to other children.

C-BerryTrans is a C++ code under GPL 3.0 that computes Berry curvature, anomalous Hall conductivity, and anomalous Nernst conductivity directly from WIEN2k output using a Kubo-like formula and Brillouin-zone integration. It parallelizes k-point calculations with OpenMP, stores Berry curvature in binary form for post-processing over ranges of temperature and chemical potential, and includes a plotting module.

The SEC phase establishes the C environment by entering 32-bit mode and setting up a stack region using AMD_ENABLE_UEFI_STACK. The AMD initialization PEI driver is split into two PEIM modules: one initializes processor-related components, calls AGESA core entry points, and publishes AmdCpuEarlyInit PPI; another registers a callback for the Memory Init PPI.
Tippecanoe Middle School released second-grading-period honor students for 2017-18. The passage lists students named to the principal’s list and honor roll for sixth, seventh, and eighth grades.

VentureWire’s November 17, 2000 issue reported on govWorks cutting staff and seeking a buyer, Whitney & Co.’s plan to raise a $2.5 billion global fund, and PlanetOut’s merger with Gay.com parent Online Partners. It also covered numerous financings, closures, acquisitions, executive appointments, board additions, and venture fund developments across internet, software, wireless, and media companies.

Markets turned risk-off after weak jobs data, policy uncertainty, and tariff concerns, with major indexes breaking down and sectors weakening. The passage says earnings were still strong overall, but market internals and technical signals deteriorated, while bond prices rose as rate-cut expectations increased.

Swiss Economic Affairs Minister Johann Schneider-Ammann said his ministry will consider the arms industry’s request to soften weapons export rules, including longer licences and lifting the ban on exports to countries in internal conflict. The industry says current rules hurt competitiveness, reduce exports, and threaten jobs, while critics argue such changes would violate Switzerland’s neutrality.

World stocks and the dollar rose Monday as fears over a U.S.-North Korea standoff eased, with European and Asia-Pacific shares rebounding while Tokyo fell. Japanese growth data and comments about improving global growth lifted bond yields, though weak Chinese data pushed Brent crude lower.

The paper proposes a MoM-GSM hybrid method for multiscale electromagnetic problems, modeling the large surrounding structure with MoM and the antenna with a generalized scattering matrix. It aims to reduce unknowns, support modular reuse, and extend to GSM-PO and GSM + T-matrix variants for large reflectors and other structures.

The passage outlines defensive strategies against the Single/Double offense, emphasizing “show and recover,” pressure on the ballhandler, denial of post entries, and weakside help. It also describes disruption tactics such as wing traps, contact and snuggle switches, triangle help positions, and rotating defenders to trap shooters or post mismatches.

Reykjavik is enduring an unusually gray, wet summer, with May and June among the worst since 1914, while heat waves hit Britain and Scandinavia. The bad weather has hurt outdoor businesses and tourism, though some residents and visitors remain hopeful or unconcerned.

The passage is a credit card comparison page highlighting multiple cards with 0% intro APR offers, cash back or travel rewards, sign-up bonuses, no annual fees on some cards, and terms such as variable APRs and balance transfer fees.

The passage lists multiple financial and business headlines, including UBS reaffirming dividend increases and share buybacks despite capital buffer pressure, along with repeated mentions of AI, markets, banking, and policy-related news.

The passage concerns the seizure of the American bark Cape Horn Pigeon by Russian naval authorities near Vladivostok, the claim that the crew was left without food or shelter, and the U.S. request for an investigation and aid. Russian officials stated the vessel had been liberated, questioned Captain Scullen’s damage claims as exaggerated, and said the crew’s treatment would be investigated.

Trump told the UN that the future belongs to sovereign, independent nations and patriots, not globalists. He praised U.S. economic and military strength, criticized China, Iran, socialism, illegal immigration, and attacks on national sovereignty, and urged countries to defend their borders, values, and freedom.

Appeals in Herman A. Marten, conservator of the estate of Christ Guehler, v. Bert W. Meads et al., and W. C. Gilmore et al. v. William Guehler et al., were heard by Mr. Justice Wolfe, with the opinion filed April 7, 1932.

The lecture reviews uniform convergence, showing that power series converge uniformly on ցանկացած interval strictly inside their radius of convergence, so they can be differentiated and integrated term by term there. It then proves Weierstrass’s approximation theorem: every continuous function on the unit interval can be uniformly approximated by polynomials, using a sequence of polynomials built from kernels \(q_n(x)=c_n(1-x^2)^n\) that concentrate at 0.

Apple Inc.’s 2019 Form 10-K reports fiscal 2019 total net sales of $260.174 billion and net income of $55.256 billion, with iPhone sales down and Services, Wearables, Home and Accessories, Mac, and iPad sales up. It describes Apple’s products, services, markets, competition, supply chain, and numerous business risks, and notes that Apple had about 137,000 full-time equivalent employees as of September 28, 2019.

Louisville officials advise residents not to set off fireworks on Independence Day because the smoke is particle pollution that can harm air quality, worsen asthma and respiratory problems, and sometimes exceed federal limits. The advisory also notes that airborne and exploding fireworks are illegal in city limits, and the city last exceeded federal limits from fireworks smoke in 2015.
The court held Curtis & Cook patent No. 285,116 void for anticipation as to claims 1, 2, and 3, but valid and infringed as to claim 4.

At Kenyon College, the Whiteness Group aims to educate students about whiteness and anti-racist action, with rules that bar white members from asking questions of people of color. Founded by Juniper Cruz, the group says it seeks sustainable activism and discusses white privilege, allyship, and combating racism.

The Supreme Court appeared skeptical of Colorado’s ban on conversion therapy for minors, with several justices suggesting it may discriminate against counselor Kaley Chiles based on her speech. The case also raised questions about standing, whether the law regulates conduct or speech, and whether the issue should be sent back to lower courts.

The passage describes DDR2/DDR3 memory controller terminal functions, including data strobe signals for 32-bit data buses, their roles in reading and writing, and internal pullup/pulldown states during and after reset for DDR[0] and DDR[1] pins.

This study developed a cost-effective citizen science method to sample household tap water microbiomes across China. Among 50 samples from 19 provinces, 22 were PCR-positive for microbial DNA, and 16S rRNA metabarcoding detected diverse communities and pathogenic bacteria in all positive samples, including pathogens and toxin-producing cyanobacteria in samples from Zhengzhou and Changzhou after extreme weather events.

The speaker says it was disappointing to fall short after reaching the finals, but was happy to see a brother win. He describes playing together as fun and says spending time off the ice and with each other’s families has meant a lot. He says the key to their line’s success is trust and time together, and notes that strong goaltending from both teams has been important.

Dr. Pasvolsky said respect for international obligations, including treaties, was already inherent in the Dumbarton Oaks Proposals, though it might be worth explicitly stating it. The ambassadors of Honduras, Chile, and Venezuela discussed treaty respect and minute corrections, and the minutes were approved. Discussion then turned to Chapter VI on the Security Council, with Pasvolsky stressing efficiency, representativeness, permanent seats, and a majority of nonpermanent members. The Ambassador of Brazil argued that Latin America should be permanently represented and emphasized the Organization’s preventative purpose.

A Mexican man, injured in a crash near the California border and left in a vegetative state in a San Diego hospital, was called Pancho because he could not identify himself. Years later, his image spread online through groups helping find missing migrants, and someone thought he might be Gilberto.

Quarters coverage is a 4-deep, 3-underneath defense that uses safeties to help against the pass and run. It can be attacked with throws to the flats and deep middle, play-action against aggressive safeties, overload concepts, and route combinations that create 1-on-1 matchups. The passage also lists five specific quarters-beating plays from BYU, Kansas State, Ohio State, Georgia, and Wake Forest.

North Carolina has expanded child care academies in at least 11 counties to train educators quickly and at low or no cost, with two main models: classroom-ready and teaching credential. A state-funded pilot was proposed, and grants are available for more colleges and universities. The academies help graduates qualify for child care jobs or lead-teacher credentials, and local partnerships have funded and run programs with graduates moving into jobs or higher education.

The passage describes automated object sortation systems using programmable motion devices, perception units, and dynamic assignment of intermediate containers or bins to destinations. It emphasizes flexible buffering, robotic acquisition from mixed objects, and heuristics-based remapping of outputs to improve throughput, reduce space, and lower labor and divert costs. It also discloses shuttle-wing sortation embodiments that scale collection bins and throughput through multiple parallel wings, robots, and dynamically allocated bins.

Caffeine levels vary by coffee chain: McDonald’s has 9 mg per cup, Dunkin’ Donuts 12.7 mg, Peet’s 16.7 mg, Starbucks 20.6 mg, and Deathwish 54.2 mg per ounce. The passage says this means coffee’s energizing effect differs from place to place.

The post-election stock rally faces two main risks: very high valuations and uncertainty that the Trump administration will deliver promised policies such as tax cuts, infrastructure spending, and deregulation. The passage says market sentiment has outpaced hard economic data, the Federal Reserve may tighten faster, and future stock returns may be poor unless substantial policy changes occur, making the rally a risky bet.

The passage describes SEV-ES and SEV-SNP GHCB protocol operations, including GHCB GPA registration and unregistration, hypervisor feature support, guest termination requests, GHCB negotiation examples, and VMGEXIT handling. It also outlines supported non-automatic exit events such as MSR access, VMMCALL, MMIO, page state change, and SNP guest requests, along with required guest and hypervisor state handling and error reporting.

The passage covers a class on smart contracts, decentralized applications, platforms, and token sales, then a lecture by Larry Lessig on how contract law interacts with digital contracts. The professor defines smart contracts as digital promises and compares Ethereum with bitcoin, discussing technical differences, platforms, and ICOs. Lessig argues that contracts always involve the state, that code can conflict with law, and that smart contracts can lower transaction costs and expand markets, but can also reduce needed ambiguity and create legal challenges.

The court held that an action on the case for malicious prosecution may lie even if the prosecuting court lacked jurisdiction, so long as malice and falsehood are the main basis of the claim. Because the plaintiff’s evidence should have been admitted, the nonsuit was reversed and a new trial ordered.

The lower highs and lower lows pattern signals a short-term reversal and a downtrend. Backtests on SPY, GLD, and TLT found better results with longer holding periods, and a two- or three-day version slightly improved results in stocks, with the pattern working best as a short-term reversal in stocks.

Portsmouth are awaiting FA contact after Charlton fans used smoke bombs at Fratton Park, and the club could face a fine if its response is deemed unsatisfactory. Chief executive Mark Catlin said the club will explain its handling of the incidents and noted that flares and smoke bombs are not permitted in stadiums.

The court denied the plaintiffs’ motion to enforce a settlement agreement, finding that while the parties agreed to a $625,000 payment, they never reached a meeting of the minds on the plaintiffs’ re-enrollment in the retirement system.

Niantic will add 80 second-generation Pokémon to Pokémon Go later this week, along with new berries, avatar customization items, and battle reactions. The update raises the total second-generation Pokémon in the game to 88, leaving 12 absent, including six legendary Pokémon.

The speaker says the team has had time to regroup, is anxious to return, and needs to play better. They want more traffic and net presence to obstruct Roberto’s vision and make scoring harder for the goaltender, and say the next game is important for getting a split and feeling better.

Collagen production declines with age, and supplements are used for possible cosmetic and health benefits. The passage describes collagen types and supplement forms, notes that hydrolysed collagen may be most effective, and says supplements may support skin, nails, bones, joints, muscles, and possibly hair, though research is still ongoing. It also lists doses studied as safe and effective and says a balanced diet is the most reliable way to support natural collagen production.

Midline Option is an option run where the quarterback reads an interior defensive lineman to decide whether to hand off or keep the ball, with the play hitting the A-gap on the dive or the B-gap on the keep. Its main strength is that the offense avoids blocking one defender and can use motion as eye candy, but its main weakness is that it exposes the quarterback to hits. The passage also outlines blocking and quarterback responsibilities against 3-4 odd and 4-3 even fronts, and describes Flexbone Midline and Midline “Follow” as common variations.

The passage says backtests show a strong Santa Claus rally in DAX 40 and Euro Stoxx 50, with better performance during the Christmas season than random weeks. Using EWG and FEZ ETFs, the average gains per trade were 2.1% and 1.5%, both with an 81% win rate, though returns have weakened in recent years. Positions are typically held about 6–13 days depending on entry timing.

In a CHMI study of 19 semi-immune Gambian adults infected with NF54/3D7 P. falciparum, pre-existing immunity was associated with longer latency, lower parasitaemia, restricted var expression, and broader PfEMP1 antibody recognition, while sero-low individuals showed higher var diversity and greater antibody increases after infection. Var genes were the main differentially expressed genes, in vivo turnover rates were high, and in vitro cultures converged toward a high-entropy steady state, though sero-high isolates retained more of the initial expression pattern.

Tesla began handing over the first Model 3 cars to employee buyers, and Elon Musk said the vehicle had over half a million advance reservations. The $35,000 Model 3 marks Tesla’s move toward mass-market electric cars, but Musk warned production would be challenging and could involve at least six months of “manufacturing hell.”

IHRMP President Dr. Edward Kwapong urged HR practitioners to prefer professional certification over raw academic qualifications. At the institute’s ninth graduation in Accra, 136 Associate and nine certified members graduated, a 32% increase from the previous year. Speaker Irene Asare said artificial intelligence and robotics are already affecting workplaces and HR must adapt to remain relevant.

Researchers found 89 malicious Chrome Web Store extensions affecting over 423,000 users and forming the Droidclub botnet. The extensions injected ads, session-replay scripts, and earlier Coinhive mining code, while also making removal difficult; Google later removed them.

Soccer formations are the strategic placement of players to balance defense and attack, and are chosen based on player numbers, skills, and coach comfort. In full-sided games, formations for the 10 field players are named by defenders-midfielders-forwards, such as 4-3-3 or 4-4-2. U.S. Soccer recommends specific formations by age group, while younger-sided games use simpler or no formations at the coach’s discretion.

Billy Caldwell, 12, has been in London for epilepsy treatment and received a short-term Home Office licence for medicinal cannabis oil. His return home to Co Tyrone has been delayed because his mother says the Northern Ireland Department of Health must ratify the decision, while the department says it is working toward a timely resolution.
Hubble’s image of NGC 6000, a spiral galaxy 102 million light-years away in Scorpius, shows blue young stars, golden older stars, faint supernova remnants, and an asteroid streaking across the field.

Amazon.com, Inc. closed the sale of $18.437 billion of notes due from 2023 to 2061 on May 12, 2021, with estimated net proceeds of about $18.395 billion. The company said it intends to allocate the net proceeds from the sustainability notes to finance or refinance green or social Eligible Projects.

The passage explains that patterns, practices, and reusable components help developers learn from others, share a common vocabulary, and build reusable software. It then introduces single-node container patterns, especially the sidecar pattern, which augments an application container for tasks like HTTPS termination, configuration synchronization, monitoring, and Git-based deployment. It also describes the ambassador pattern for brokering access to sharded services, service discovery, and request splitting, and the adapter pattern for standardizing monitoring, logging, and health checks. The passage later shifts to multi-node architectures, covering replicated stateless services, caching layers, SSL termination, sharded services, and shard routing using sharding functions.

The speaker, assuming the presidency, outlines principles of limited government, individual rights, and checks on executive power. He pledges not to serve a second term, to restrict executive influence over the treasury, elections, the press, and legislation, to preserve union and state rights, and to maintain peaceful, just foreign relations while respecting religion and morals.

IDC says HPCaaS will increasingly matter for global cooperation amid skilled labor shortages and hybrid work, and that efficient use requires integrated, data-based process and product development with a single source of truth. It also notes that improving employee workstations is necessary but expensive.
William Riley’s petition for certiorari to review Riley v. State was abated by his death and dismissed by the Supreme Court of Alabama, with all justices concurring.

Thirteen-year-old Benje Choucroun, reporting for Time for Kids at the White House, asked press secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders what the administration has done and will do to prevent school shootings. Sanders said school safety is seriously taken and mentioned a presidential school safety commission meeting that week to discuss ways to protect children and help them feel safe. Time editor-in-chief Edward Felsenthal praised the question on Twitter.

Eric Thames homered for a fifth straight game as the Brewers beat the Cubs 6-3, their sixth win in seven games. Ryan Braun and Jeff Bandy also homered, Chase Anderson earned the win, and Chicago lost its fourth straight.

A webinar featuring Elliot Clark, Katy Theroux, and Cory Kruse will discuss turning candidate engagement into successful hires, tying HR strategy and productivity to business outcomes, using recruitment metrics to fill talent needs without sacrificing quality or retention, and the impact of candidate experience on hires and retention. It airs October 18, 2017, at 12:00 PM ET and does not count for CEU credit.

The speaker said the team held on well and did not collapse after the game was tied, but could not score a second goal. They noted that Sergei’s timely goal was the difference in a closely balanced game between two well-playing teams.

In this tax refund case, the court held that the Management Stockholder’s Agreement was ambiguous, admitted parol evidence, and concluded that the employees’ stock interests were subject to permanent restrictions so no taxable stock transfer or redemption occurred; judgment was entered for Riverton Investment Corporation.

Conformis Inc CS shares fell 6.47% in the most recent session. Analysts project a 12-month target of $5, with targets ranging from $4 to $6 based on 6 opinions, and the stock had an average brokerage recommendation of 2.43 from 7 recommendations. The latest closing price was $1.3, RSI was 18.89, ATR-14 was 0.16, weekly volatility was 7.15%, monthly volatility was 6.12%, and market capitalization was $56.95 million.

Six teachers from Haoreibi Makha Leikai LP Madrasa and Thoudam Wangmata Primary School were suspended by the Education (S) Department for negligence of duty after surprise school visits by Education Minister Th Radheshyam. Three madrasa teachers were suspended for running the institute in a private building without authorization and not holding normal classes, while three primary school teachers were suspended for absenting themselves without informing the authority.

The passage explains that design patterns improved object-oriented programming and argues that similar patterns can improve distributed systems by providing shared language, reusable components, and guidance based on prior experience. It introduces single-node patterns such as sidecar, ambassador, and adapter, showing how containers can augment applications, broker access to sharded services, and normalize interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks. It then discusses multi-node distributed patterns, including replicated load-balanced services, caching layers, SSL termination, and sharded services, emphasizing reliability, scalability, and modularity.

LeBron James said his contract year will not affect his play, is excited about the Lakers’ revamped roster, and is focused on getting his body ready for an 82-game season while considering his future based on motivation and health.

Facebook announced it has acquired the team behind London-based Bloomsbury AI in an acquihire, not the company itself. Bloomsbury AI, founded in 2015, specializes in natural language processing and built the document-reading AI “Cape.” Facebook said the team’s expertise will strengthen its natural language processing research, while reports said Facebook was interested in the software for fake news and other content issues.

Patrick Cullen, 33, was jailed for three years after pleading guilty to robbing a woman of her handbag on Wolfe Tone Street in Limerick on July 11. The woman was pushed from behind, fell and cut her finger, and the handbag was later recovered. The judge said the attack was frightening and opportunistic, and suspended the final 12 months of a four-year sentence.

A married woman’s property is not liable for family necessaries until an execution against the husband has been issued and returned unsatisfied. Because no judgment had been obtained against the husband, the levy on Ida C. Scott’s land was properly enjoined, and the district court’s judgment was affirmed.

The paper studies digitalization’s impact on higher education quality in Vietnam using SFAHP and expert interviews. It ranks pedagogical integration first, followed by student engagement, accessibility of digital resources, adaptability and innovation, and technological infrastructure.

Reuters reported Asian currency rates against the U.S. dollar at 0134 GMT on Feb. 2, including daily and year-to-date changes. The yen, Taiwan dollar, baht, rupiah, ringgit and yuan were stronger on the day, while the Singapore dollar, Korean won and peso weakened.

Mike Hoffman scored the deciding goal with a Forsberg-style move in a 4-3 shootout win for Ottawa over Philadelphia. Colin White got his first NHL point, Johnny Oduya earned a bonus, and coach Guy Boucher praised Sean Couturier.

Mets GM David Stearns criticized Kodai Senga’s inconsistency after two challenging seasons, noting injuries, a demotion to Triple-A, and that it would be “foolish” to assume he will make 30 starts next year. The Mets also missed the playoffs after a strong start and late-season struggles, with pitching issues contributing to the collapse.

SCDNR biologists tagged an 820-pound, 12-foot-2-inch female tiger shark named Harry-Etta in St. Helena Sound with a satellite transmitter and confirmed she is pregnant. The tag will help track her movements and may provide information on tiger shark lifespan, reproduction, and migration, while adding to research on the importance of South Carolina’s southern sounds as feeding and possible nursing areas.

Offensive linemen are selfless players who protect teammates, create running lanes, and block for the quarterback. The passage says the offensive line is central to offensive success, highlights common skills and body types, and names Jim Otto, John Hannah, and Anthony Munoz among the best ever.

A review of over 140 studies says bottled water drinkers may ingest about 90,000 more microplastic particles per year than tap water drinkers, and that these particles can enter the bloodstream, reach organs, and may cause inflammation, hormonal disruption, neurological damage, and other harms.

Martin Van Buren warned U.S. citizens against interfering in the Canadian civil war, saying unrest on the northern frontier was increasing and that arms, supplies, and a military force had been organized in the United States. He exhorted those involved to return home, and stated that anyone compromising U.S. neutrality would face arrest and punishment under U.S. laws.

A University of Pennsylvania study found that transcranial direct-current stimulation of the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex in 81 healthy adults reduced reported intentions to commit assault and rape and increased moral condemnation of violence, but experts said it is unknown whether actual violent behavior would change.

A Montana elk hunter’s fossil discovery led to identification of a new elasmosaur species that lived about 70 million years ago in an inland sea. The nearly complete fossil had an unusually short neck with about 40 vertebrae, and researchers said it provides evidence that elasmosaurs did not all evolve longer necks over time.

The lecture reviews groups, subgroups, cosets, quotient groups, fields, prime fields, and polynomials. It explains that finite cyclic groups are isomorphic to Zn, that subgroup cosets partition a group and lead to Lagrange’s theorem, and that quotient groups give Zn as Z mod nZ. It defines fields by additive and multiplicative abelian group structure plus distributivity, shows that Fp is a field for prime p, and states that every finite field has a prime characteristic and a prime subfield. It then introduces polynomials over a field, their addition and multiplication, degree rules, and notes that only nonzero constant polynomials are invertible.

The webinar on credit transfer and AI was seen as positive in direction but lacking concrete requirements. The author says accreditors are only urging colleges to “default to yes” on transfer credits, not mandating it, and that real change will be difficult without stronger pressure.

A security aide to Governor David Umahi was accused of slapping an FRSC officer at a checkpoint set up to block unauthorized access to the PDP convention at Eagle Square. Newsmen also observed security personnel extorting money from people without accreditation to gain entry to the venue, while the FRSC said it had not received an official report on the assault.

Coach Sutter said the team expects another game like tonight and stressed finishing chances, not giving up more than one goal, and that the series is very close. He noted the Kings had a strong first period but were hurt by a goal on a marginal call, said the pressure is on the home-team Devils, and added that first goals have been key in the series.

The 7th annual Julia’s Hope Cup and Carnival will be held Feb. 17 at Chippawa Park in Welland, raising money for The Hope Centre and honoring Paul Turner’s daughter Julia, who died of cancer in 2011. The event has grown into a winter carnival with food, kids’ games, a silent auction, and a mini-tournament for children ages 6 to 12.

Tesla’s 2021 Form 10-K says it designs, manufactures, sells and leases electric vehicles and energy generation/storage systems, operating two segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. It reported 99,290 full-time employees worldwide as of December 31, 2021 and stated that Gigafactory Texas would begin production in 2022. The filing also describes risks including COVID-19 impacts, production and supply chain delays, competition, regulation, product defects, and financing and leasing risks.

CBS’s drama Doubt premieres February 15 at 10/9c and follows Isaiah Roth and Associates, a New York defense firm handling a murder case involving pediatric surgeon Billy Brennan. Sadie Ellis is assigned to defend him while balancing her personal feelings and professional duty.
