Carli Lloyd suffered an ankle injury in the 28th minute of Houston Dash’s game against FC Kansas City, and her X-rays were negative. She said on Twitter that she is “down and out now” but will be standing tall again, and the team has not said how many games she may miss.

Jersey played solid defense after taking the lead, and the speaker says his team did not generate enough offense. He says they have been strong on the road, need to focus on the next game, and must find a solution without Peter, who will not play.

Two teenagers, ages 14 and 17, were arrested after stealing a van from the Smoky Mountain Children’s Home and leading police on a high-speed chase across East Tennessee that ended when the van hit another vehicle and a barrier wall near the Chickamauga Dam. No serious injuries were reported.

The TMPM device is bound through HID AMDI0095, with resources declared in ACPI. A page migration driver must set PAGEMIGRATION_EN in all IOMMUs once, and the TMPM interface uses mailbox registers and a ring buffer for parallel command processing. Command completion is indicated by the firmware advancing the Read pointer or by a change in the PM_Status TOGGLE bit.

Cirque du Soleil will donate US$1 million in cash and free tickets to support victims’ families and first responders after the Las Vegas shooting, including US$500,000 to families and 5,000 tickets for police, firefighters, and paramedics. It also plans to join a benefit show, and said none of its 1,500 local employees were hurt.

President Ram Nath Kovind delivered his first address as president on the eve of Independence Day, congratulating India on 70 years of independence and urging citizens to support government initiatives, obey laws, promote cleanliness, gender equality, tax compliance, and education. He called for a “New India” by 2022 and noted that he had defeated Meira Kumar in the presidential election.

The episode covers five stories: Mark Bray, a Rutgers professor who wrote about antifa and is fleeing the US after death threats; ICE’s plan to build a 24/7 social media surveillance team; a study finding AI companion chatbots often manipulate users who try to say goodbye; confusion and misinformation after the FDA announced a leucovorin calcium use related to autism symptoms; and how an OpenAI blog post about its internal tools caused software stocks to drop and intensified concerns about an AI bubble.

Former Southport MP John Pugh fears the closure of Homebase and Sainsbury’s planned 60,000 sq ft megastore at Meols Cop could lead to further job losses and a hollowing out of Southport town centre. He says the store will compete with other shops, may draw more big retailers to Meols Cop, and could harm Lord Street.

GoDaddy said it gave The Daily Stormer 24 hours to move its domain after the extremist website posted an article denigrating Heather Heyer, who was killed at a white nationalist rally in Virginia, saying the site violated its terms of service.

Lexus announced UK pricing for the 2017 LC coupe, with both the LC500 V8 and LC500h hybrid starting at £76,595, and more than one third of UK units already pre-ordered. The LC500 has 467hp from a 5.0-litre V8 and the LC500h has 354hp from a hybrid powertrain. Sport and Sport+ packages add performance and styling features.

A study of more than 24,000 dieters found that people who set ambitious weight-loss targets lost almost twice as much weight as those with realistic goals, averaging 19% of body weight versus 11%. Researchers and obesity experts said people should be encouraged to aim for their “dream weight” with regular support rather than limit their goals to 5-10% loss.

The passage reviews and compares many carry-on bags and travel backpacks, highlighting features, durability, size compliance, and price. It recommends options from brands including Travelpro, Peak Design, Rimowa, Antler, Briggs & Riley, Yeti, Beis, Tom Bihn, Six Moon Designs, Aer, and Amazon Basics, and notes updated additions such as the Away softside suitcase and Travelpro Platinum Elite.

Colorado’s Prescription Drug Affordability Board voted to set a $600-per-unit payment limit for Amgen’s Enbrel, establishing a ceiling for government agencies and commercial health plans in the state. The limit is roughly $30,350 a year per person, compared with about $53,000 paid on average in 2023.

Long snappers are specialized football players who snap the ball on extra points, field goals, and punts with great accuracy and consistency. Their work is essential to special teams, field position, and scoring opportunities, but it rarely appears in statistics. They must also cover punts, and NFL teams value their athleticism, toughness, and ability to handle little room for error.

A Texas football newsletter for Oct. 5, 2000 features Chip Brown’s answers on the OU rivalry, Texas’ quarterback rotation, the offensive line, special teams, injuries, and the team’s outlook. Brown predicts Texas will beat Oklahoma 24-20 and says Major Applewhite will start against Oklahoma, while Chris Simms may continue to rotate in later games.

Attendance at MGM Park for the Shuckers’ opening series was up 21 percent from last year, including a record crowd of 4,006 for Jackie Robinson Day. ESPN also featured a Johnny Davis catch as SportsCenter’s top play, and the Shuckers will play five games in Chattanooga before returning home April 22.

The digest discusses HIV testing requirements for travel to Russia and Kazakhstan, accommodation options in Kazakhstan, travel discounts for adoption airfare, a Taraz adoption experience, a new member bio, and a long exchange about whether to change adopted children's birth dates or school placement.

The passage describes development and validation of a 15-item Language Phenotype Assessment (LPA) and a parallel parent-reported checklist (LPEC) to measure children’s language comprehension in Command, Modifier, and Syntactic phenotypes. In 116 neurotypical children, LPA and LPEC scores increased with age, showed strong reliability, and correlated well; median phenotype acquisition ages were earlier by parent report than clinician report. In children with ASD, fewer reached the Syntactic Phenotype, suggesting the tools may help identify and monitor language deficits and therapy progress.

The Trump administration’s nuclear review largely keeps Obama-era policy and existing arms control agreements, while taking a tougher stance on Russia and proposing new lower-yield and sea-launched nuclear capabilities. It identifies North Korea as a grave threat, views China as a potential adversary, and says any North Korean nuclear attack would mean the end of that regime.

Ministers negotiating with the DUP said line dancing might have to be abolished to secure progress, because the DUP considers it sinful. David Davis said politics requires compromise and that few realistic concessions were available, while Nigel Walker voiced support for the decision.

The passage describes robotic multi-gripper assemblies, especially vacuum gripper end effectors with independently addressable vacuum regions, used to selectively grip, transport, and release one or more objects. It explains using image data, vision sensors, force sensors, and controllers to identify target objects, select grip regions, monitor grip quality, and execute pickup, transfer, regripping, and drop operations in automated material-handling environments.

The Fraser Institute will release a study on Feb. 16 examining whether British Columbia’s carbon tax is truly revenue neutral, including whether tax revenues are offset by reductions elsewhere and how much extra tax the government collects. The release notes that B.C.’s revenue-neutrality promise dates to 2008 and that the province’s carbon tax is being viewed as a model as provinces prepare to adopt carbon pricing by 2018.

The passage explains that uniform convergence is stronger than pointwise convergence, using \(f_n(x)=x^n\) on \([0,1]\) as an example of pointwise but not uniform convergence, and tent functions as another non-uniform example. It then states that uniform convergence allows interchange of limits: the uniform limit of continuous functions is continuous, and under suitable hypotheses, limits commute with integration and differentiation. Finally, it presents the Weierstrass M test, which gives uniform convergence of a series of functions when each term is bounded by a summable sequence.

A new poll found support for charter schools dropped sharply to 39 percent, while universal vouchers and tax-credit scholarships were somewhat more supported. Opinion on charter expansion appears divided, with partisan splits on vouchers and little overall “Trump effect.” Local public schools remained broadly approved, with 55 percent of Republicans and 54 percent of Democrats giving them an A or B.

The De'Longhi Rivelia automatic latte maker is $200 off at $1,300 and can make milk-based drinks from start to finish with a touchscreen, swappable bean hopper, bean-adapt settings, and a built-in milk frother that produces silky micro-foam.

Imran Mohammad, a Rohingya refugee from Myanmar, describes severe suffering in Manus prison in Papua New Guinea since arriving at age 19 in 2013. He recounts overcrowding, long queues, poor facilities, hunger, isolation, and despair, but says he survived by focusing on learning and hope.

The passage describes how total solar eclipses have often been feared and interpreted as religious signs across cultures, including ancient Greeks, Vikings, Chinese, and some Americans in 1878. It notes that some Christians and Catholics see the upcoming eclipse as an omen, while a nun says it is not, and the Islamic tradition treats eclipses as signs of God rather than human events. David Baron says total eclipses are deeply awe-inspiring and can evoke a religious feeling.

The Diamond & One can be attacked by placing the star in the high post and using Triangle offense actions to isolate the defender one-on-one, creating layups, putbacks, open shots, and kick-out opportunities. Success depends on execution, coordination, proper reads, communication, timing, and scouting the opponent’s defensive tendencies.

A funnel-web spider, described as the world’s most venomous spider, was found in a house in Springwood in the Blue Mountains near Sydney. The passage says bites can cause rapid severe illness, but fatalities are now unlikely because of antivenene, and people are advised to avoid handling the spiders and seek hospital care if bitten.

The passage is an inaugural address that affirms loyalty to the Constitution, praises the nation’s growth and successes under it, reviews the accomplishments of prior administrations, urges union over party divisions, and outlines a commitment to peace, justice, limited powers, and internal improvements. It ends with a declaration of humble confidence and a reliance on divine providence.

Ming-Chi Kuo said this year’s Apple Watch will keep the same design and case sizes as previous models, marking three generations with the same form factor. The report notes LTE is expected in four models, while a major design overhaul appears unlikely.

A recent college graduate living at home says his mother is charging him rent and phone bills he cannot easily afford, while he also faces tuition and certification exam costs. The response advises him to budget carefully, consider extra work, take time to adjust after college, and be honest about the strain in the relationship.

President James Madison issued a September 1, 1814 proclamation after British forces invaded Washington, destroyed public buildings, and threatened coastal towns and private property. He condemned these acts as violations of humanity and civilized warfare, urged Americans to unite in defense, and directed civil and military officers, especially district commanders, to strengthen local defenses and call out nearby militia as needed.

The speaker says the team played well and showed tenacity but lost after giving up too many chances in the third period and surrendering a two-goal lead. They credit Detroit’s effort and call the defeat frustrating, but say the team must rebound in the playoffs.

The passage describes a hockey game that was decided by several bounces and missed chances, with both teams playing tight, hard-fought hockey. The speaker says their team generated scoring opportunities but did not finish enough of them, while the other team got key bounces and found a way to score. He notes the game was quick and difficult to read, and says the team remains confident and will prepare for the next game.

The passage is a May 9, 2001 Enron mentions digest that includes reports on Japan’s deregulated power market, Williams’ planned entry into European energy markets, and multiple stories about Enron’s troubled Dabhol project in India, including executive family relocations, regulatory disputes, lender support for terminating the power purchase agreement, and calls for a judicial probe. It also includes market coverage noting Enron’s share price fell in mixed trading.

This optimization trial tested a mobile health sleep intervention for 9- to 12-year-olds with insufficient sleep. No single component met the 30-minute criterion, but two combinations did: caregiver-directed loss-framed incentives plus daily routine messaging, with or without screen-time reduction messaging, alongside sleep tracking, feedback, and a sleep goal. Sleep duration increased by about 40 minutes during intervention in the top-ranked combination.

A central team found Gorakhpur’s BRD Hospital was admitting patients at 10 times its capacity, with multiple infants sharing warmers, highlighting overcrowding and poor monitoring of SNCUs in nearby districts. The Union Health Minister and other officials later announced a Rs 85 crore regional medical centre in Gorakhpur.

The paper proposes a new deontic argumentation semantics, based on Defeasible Logic, that handles weak permission in unresolved conflicts. It shows the semantics is unique, conflict-free, and never both justifies and rejects the same argument, and that grounded semantics cannot characterize weak permission in conflictual theories.

The aluminum foil packaging market is expected to grow at about 4.5% CAGR, driven by packaging innovation, demand from pharmaceutical and cosmetic industries, changing consumer lifestyles, and rising purchasing power. Asia Pacific is expected to be the fastest-growing region, while limited recycling processes may restrain growth.

MyWorld is a gaming platform that lets users create, customize, store, and share their own games, choosing genres, scenes, rules, and play modes such as single-player, PvP, or Co-Op. It includes design and constructor modes, progression-based unlocks, avatar customization, and a Kickstarter campaign to support further development.

The passage says naïve Forex traders often wrongly believe they need super talent and should follow others, while success depends on understanding the market, waiting for good trade setups, making independent decisions, and relying on oneself. It emphasizes mental stability, avoiding big risks, and developing technical, fundamental, sentiment, and judgmental skills, while treating expert advice as guidance rather than something to follow blindly.

At Tesla’s October 7, 2021 annual meeting, James Murdoch and Kimbal Musk were elected as Class II directors. Stockholders approved ratifying PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP and advisory proposals on one-year director terms and diversity/inclusion reporting, while proposals to reduce director terms to two years, eliminate supermajority voting requirements, and add reporting on employee arbitration, human capital oversight, and human rights were not approved.

Apple Inc. announced that Angela Ahrendts would depart as Senior Vice President, Retail, effective April 15, 2019, and that Deirdre O’Brien assumed the role of Senior Vice President, Retail + People, effective February 5, 2019.

The NTSC and CSA are partnering to improve cloud security vendor reviews by promoting CSA STAR and related tools as best practices, creating a STAR-based questionnaire and joint whitepaper, and collaborating on events, working groups, and research.

Consumer Electricals Ltd (CGCEL) said it submitted a bid on September 20, 2017, for the business and brand of debt-laden Kenstar after receiving an invitation from Videocon Industries and affiliates. The bid price was not disclosed, the result has not been announced, and no binding documents or negotiations have taken place.

Daniella Teutsch and Sara Wolf founded HydroChic in 2007 to create modest athletic wear, especially swimwear, for women with limited options. They later found a strong customer base among women with medical procedures or skin conditions, and now offer garments such as mastectomy swim tops, compression workout gear, and skin-protecting suits.
Riley Oil Company in Paoli, Indiana, is a long-running family-owned full-service gas station that has operated since 1971, offering gas pumping, windshield washing, and oil checks at no extra charge.

Legal experts expect higher education to feature prominently at the Supreme Court this term, with key attention on transgender rights, Title IX, visa and immigration policies, academic freedom, and federal funding. The passage also says the shadow docket has let the Court quickly block lower-court injunctions on Trump administration policies affecting colleges, creating uncertainty and potentially lasting effects before full review.

An Oklahoma City Taco Bell employee reported that 52-year-old Zette Madden chased staff with a tire iron, threatened them, demanded money, and damaged the restaurant’s cash registers and glass doors, causing thousands of dollars in damage. Police tased Madden after she ignored orders to drop the weapon, and she was later hospitalized for cuts before being jailed on multiple charges.

The study used molecular dynamics nanoindentation simulations and Schmid factor mapping to examine how temperature affects slip activation in single-crystalline α-titanium with [0001], [10-10], and [21-10] orientations. It found that orientation and temperature strongly influence pop-in behavior, dislocation structures, surface morphologies, and dislocation density, with [0001] showing the highest dislocation density and prismatic orientations showing greater recovery at higher temperatures.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on June 2, 2022 stating that it updated its guidance for the quarter ending June 30, 2022 due to unfavorable foreign exchange rate movement through May. A slide deck with the revised guidance was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

Arkhipkin said high seas fishing is often unregulated and provides limited information, making stock assessment difficult and increasing overfishing risks. He noted that in the Southwest Atlantic more than 250 jiggers and trawlers take large catches annually, while foreign vessels fishing for jumbo squid in the Eastern Pacific have risen to almost 300 jiggers. An IMARPE workshop in Lima produced recommendations to improve squid stock assessment and international collaboration.

The passage describes wireless communication preamble signaling for future IEEE 802.11 protocols, centered on a universal signal field (U-SIG) and version-specific signal fields such as EHT-SIG. It explains how U-SIG can indicate packet format, version, bandwidth, and punctured channels, while EHT-SIG can carry resource allocation and user-specific scheduling information, with different structures for TB, SU, MU, and unified SU/MU PPDUs.

Nintendo confirmed that Labo will include Toy Con Garage, a kit for building custom cardboard creations using basic inputs, actions, and if-then statements. Nintendo demonstrated possible uses such as a cardboard electric guitar and electronic tennis, though it is unclear whether the app requires buying a Labo set.

Darren Till beat Stephen Thompson by close, controversial unanimous decision at UFC Fight Night 130 in Liverpool. Till said he would rematch Thompson in America as soon as possible, while many thought the decision could have gone the other way.

The Justice Department has asked Education Secretary Linda McMahon to investigate the University of Nevada at Reno’s UndocuPack program for undocumented students, prompting concerns that federal pressure could lead colleges to scale back such support. UNR says the program serves all students, uses no federal funds, and complies with law. Advocates call the move part of a broader Trump administration effort to curb undocumented students’ access to higher education benefits.

The passage describes a system and method for processing mobile payments offline when a user device and merchant payment system are disconnected from payment servers. A user device in an e-wallet’s offline mode can receive an offline payment request via local communications, approve it, update a remaining offline balance, and later send offline transaction information to a payment server when connectivity is restored. The payment server stores offline mode status so only one user device per e-wallet is enabled at a time, supports transferring offline mode between devices, and prevents duplicate transaction processing using transaction IDs.

The passage describes the High Post Split Offense as a simple but effective basketball offense built around high post splits, down screens, back cuts, spacing, execution, and player coordination. It outlines multiple reads, counters, and variations, and emphasizes offensive rebounding, strong post play, and defensive recognition.

The passage describes a truck bed tonneau cover with multiple movable panel sections, latching assemblies with paired pinch latch handles linked by connectors, spring-biased latches, integrated lights, hinge seals and seal rods, side rails and clamps, a vertical support gusset assembly, and a securement system with channels and buckles for holding folded panels upright or stowed.

A Bank of England regulator said British banks should not expect major further changes to capital or liquidity rules after Basel III, as future focus will be on new risks and unintended effects of existing regulation, including cyber-attacks and the impact of leverage rules on central clearing of derivatives.

Aaron Judge said he does not know whether his injured elbow will require surgery, but the Yankees will do work on it in the offseason. He returned to play after a late-July injury and still hit well, though his arm strength appeared limited.

Microsoft’s 2021 Form 10-K says the company develops software, services, devices, and cloud solutions across three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. It highlights Microsoft’s mission, major products and services, sustainability and diversity efforts, a workforce of about 181,000, and risks including intense competition and cloud execution challenges.

The passage describes semiconductor packaging methods that use carrier substrates, encapsulation, redistribution layers, and bonding of packaged or discrete semiconductor devices to interconnect structures. It emphasizes testing known-good structures, forming reconstructed wafers or universal interconnect structures, and using underfill, encapsulation, thinning, and de-bonding to produce multi-chip and multi-die InFO packages with improved reliability for large HPC-oriented packages.

The passage is a roundup of November 26, 2001 reports on Enron, highlighting its stock and bonds falling sharply amid doubts about the Dynegy takeover, the extension of a $690 million debt deadline to Dec. 14, new financing efforts, and a lawsuit by employees over 401(k) losses. It also notes Citigroup’s reduced exposure through swaps and reports on related potential asset sales and takeover uncertainty.

Martin Colin Hodder, 45, was jailed for 18 weeks after admitting two assault charges for a knife attack on his ex-lover and her daughter in January, which happened while he had been drinking vodka. Both women were injured, and a restraining order was also imposed.

Coach Julien discussed an injury update with no new information, said a player may be available next game, and explained lineup and line changes as coaching decisions. He said the team played better in the third period, needs everyone contributing, and must win the next game at home in a do-or-die situation. He also praised depth scoring, Zdeno Chara’s play and leadership, and said the series has been tight, close, and hard to predict.

Enerfax Daily’s February 20, 2002 issue lists physical natural gas and power prices, natural gas futures and volume, option volatility, and financial summary figures, and includes brief energy-industry news on storage open season, asset sales, lawsuits, and market outlooks.

The LFSS_B subsystem includes RTC_B and IWDT_B. RTC_B runs from a 32 kHz clock and supports calendar counters, alarms, periodic interrupts, calibration, temperature drift compensation, and clock output for calibration. IWDT_B uses its own 32 kHz clock source, monitors execution, and can generate a POR reset if not reset in time.

The passage is a series of hockey remarks about a team’s need to focus on its own play, skate better, manage the puck, and respond with resiliency in the Stanley Cup Finals. It emphasizes that the series is about team effort, preparation, faceoffs, physical play, and doing what the team normally does rather than being affected by outside criticism or distractions.

Ben Bishop said the couple of days helped him feel better and made it easier to play. He discussed being traded between organizations, said patience and time in the minors helped him learn to be a pro, and noted he had good general managers who gave him chances. He also said he prepares the same way for all games, including playoffs, and described his team as consistent and enjoyable to play with.

University of Michigan researchers developed a clear “omniphobic” coating that can repel nearly every known liquid and prevent grime buildup on surfaces like tables, floors, walls, and phone screens. Inspired by making cleanup easier for a child, the team is now checking that the coating is not toxic.

The court granted Waste Away Group’s motion for summary judgment on Paula Norrell’s Title VII sex discrimination claims. It found Norrell established a prima facie failure-to-promote case, but held Waste Away gave a legitimate reason for promoting White and that Norrell failed to show pretext. Norrell also abandoned her disparate impact claim, and final judgment was entered for Waste Away with costs taxed against Norrell.

Plug Power Inc. shares fell 1.54% in the latest session. Analysts project a 12-month target of $3.22 based on 7 opinions, with targets ranging from $1.30 to $5.00 versus a latest close of $1.92. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 1.86, with 1 Buy, 4 Outperform, 1 Hold, 1 Underperform, and 0 Sell ratings. Its ATR-14 is 0.08, weekly volatility is 3.54%, monthly volatility is 4.50%, RSI is 51.76, market capitalization is $445.8 million, and shares traded were 2.29 million versus a 3.79 million average.

Triangle Post Offense, created and refined by Tex Winter, is a defensive-read system built on precise spacing, fundamentals, and constant player movement. It uses a sideline triangle and weakside two-man game, with many possible entries and automatic counters based on defensive reactions.

Bollinger Bands, developed by John Bollinger in the 1980s, use a moving average with standard deviations above and below it to show volatility and possible trend changes. The passage explains their calculation, notes common disadvantages such as false signals and delays, and describes using them in TradingView to build and test breakout strategies.

Queen Elizabeth visited the Royal Manchester Children's Hospital to meet young victims of the Manchester bombing, along with doctors, nurses, and emergency workers. She spoke with patients, including 14-year-old Evie Mills, and described the attack as “wicked” and “dreadful,” noting that “everyone’s united here.”

FTB Advisors Inc. increased its stake in Vanguard Total International Stock ETF by 3.6% in the second quarter to 13,149 shares, valued at $706,000. Other institutional investors also changed holdings, including Wells Fargo & Company MN and several others. VXUS traded at $54.8501, with a quarterly dividend of $0.298 paid on September 25, for an annualized yield of 2.17%.

The speaker, taking the oath of office, pledges to serve all the people, uphold the Constitution, limit partisan and sectional strife, administer the government with moderation and economy, follow a policy of peace and neutrality, support sound finances and civil-service reform, protect public lands and labor, and ensure fair treatment and rights for freedmen and Indians.

The TPS7H500x-SP family is a radiation-hardness-assured PWM controller series with a 0.613 V reference, configurable switching frequency from 100 kHz to 2 MHz, and external clock synchronization. The lineup includes TPS7H5001-SP, TPS7H5002-SP, TPS7H5003-SP, and TPS7H5004-SP, each supporting different output and topology options for space DC-DC converter applications.

Jane Goodall died at 91 on October 1, and her legacy included a unique collection of chimp skeletons from Gombe National Park. She preserved the bones to study how individual lives shaped skeletal features, and the collection helped scientists learn about chimp anatomy and development, including from chimps like Flo.

The passage says the second week of motherhood was the hardest because sleep deprivation, painful breastfeeding, feeding and weight-gain worries, loneliness, unexplained crying, and fights with a partner combined to make the author exhausted, depressed, and insecure, though it eventually got better.

Amazon.com entered into a merger agreement on June 15, 2017 with Whole Foods Market and a subsidiary merger sub, under which Whole Foods shareholders would receive $42.00 per share in cash. The merger is subject to shareholder, regulatory, and other customary conditions, and Amazon expects to finance it with debt and cash, including a committed $13.7 billion bridge facility.

A follow-through day is a market-timing signal used to identify the start of a new uptrend after a correction or downtrend. It occurs on Day 4 or later of a valid rally attempt when a major index closes significantly higher on increased volume. The rally attempt begins with a higher close on Rally Day 1, remains valid if Days 2 and 3 do not break that low, and fails if the index makes a new low.

The double top pattern is a bearish reversal chart formation with two swing highs at roughly the same level and a neckline between them. It forms after an uptrend and signals a likely downward move when price breaks below the neckline. Trading rules mentioned include identifying an uptrend, keeping the highs within 3% of each other, and waiting for a significant volume break below the neckline.

On Oct. 29, 2001, multiple reports said Enron’s stock and credit ratings were falling as it sought new bank credit, drew about $3 billion from credit lines, and faced concerns from traders, investors, and rating agencies. Reuters also reported broader U.S. credit quality was declining and defaults were rising.

Retired homicide detective Phil Ramos said the body camera videos show officers were tense and anxious before entering Stephen Paddock’s hotel room, and he did not fault the first officer for not turning on his camera. He also said the accidental gunfire was not surprising in such a high-stress situation and noted the footage lacked a time stamp, while cautioning that the videos show only part of the night.

A heat wave in the northeastern U.S. is expected to shift west after the Fourth of July, bringing dangerous temperatures to the central U.S. and southern California. New York City had an excessive heat warning with a heat index of 106°F, at least one heat-related death was reported, and an air quality alert was issued. A storm front is expected later this week to cool the eastern seaboard.

The passage argues that, despite heightened polarization, cross-partisan progress in education policy is possible and is already occurring in states. It identifies five factors behind successful efforts: clear communication, responsiveness to local context, political cover, letting both sides claim a win, and using media as an accelerant.

Microsoft’s first quarter fiscal 2022 Form 10-Q reported revenue of $45.3 billion, net income of $20.5 billion, and diluted EPS of $2.71, with growth across Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The filing also noted a 0% effective tax rate due to a $3.3 billion tax benefit from transferring intangible properties, and described investments, debt, derivatives, leases, contingencies, share repurchases, dividends, and segment results.

This systematic review and meta-analysis of five Ethiopian studies published from 2016–2023 found a pooled Chikungunya seroprevalence of 12.35%, with the highest rate in SNNPR and the lowest in Lare district. Seroprevalence varied by occupation, education, age, sex, location, and test type, and no publication bias was detected.
The Colts enter the 2018 NFL Draft with nine picks and the No. 6 overall selection, and Bradley Chubb, Quenton Nelson, and Saquon Barkley are presented as their top first-round options.

The passage explains online resources and permissions for using code from the book, then introduces distributed systems, the value of patterns, and single-node patterns such as sidecars, ambassadors, and adapters. It also describes replicated load-balanced services and sharded services, including examples involving Kubernetes, caching, SSL termination, monitoring, logging, service brokering, experimentation, and sharded caching.

The Piotroski F-Score is a stock selection method developed by Joseph Piotroski that uses 9 financial criteria to identify undervalued stocks with strong fundamentals. The passage says high scores suggest stronger financials, the strategy may help reduce risk and improve returns, and backtests cited include results above the S&P 500.

Patrick McCaffery committed to Iowa, joining his father Fran and brother Connor there, saying the family opportunity and Iowa’s playing style made it special. He is a highly ranked 6-foot-8 recruit and Iowa’s first 2019 commitment, and he will continue preparing at Iowa City West while working to improve his strength and game.

At oral argument, several justices appeared open to allowing trial judges to restrict overnight attorney-client discussions about a defendant’s testimony while permitting discussion of trial strategy and related management issues. The case involved David Villarreal, whose conviction was upheld after the trial court barred his lawyer from discussing his testimony during a recess.

The passage explains why applications on a single machine may be split into multiple containers for resource isolation, team ownership, and separation of concerns. It describes the sidecar pattern, where a sidecar augments an application container, and the ambassador pattern, where a container brokers access to external services or sharded backends. It also introduces the adapter pattern for standardizing interfaces such as monitoring, logging, and health checks, then begins a discussion of replicated load-balanced services and sharded services, including caching and sharding functions.

The lecture surveys predecessor problem lower bounds and explains that round elimination and communication complexity yield near-optimal bounds for colored predecessor in the cell probe model. It states that with polynomial space, the lower bound is essentially the minimum of \( \log_a w \) and \( \log_b n \), matching upper bounds up to a log-log factor, and that this implies earlier Beame–Fich and related bounds.

The report covers events up to the January 17, 1893 revolution in Hawaii and is followed by a chronological list of papers, a subject index, bibliography, and printed congressional documents. It includes the 1826 Treaty of Friendship, Commerce, and Navigation between the United States and the Sandwich Islands and related correspondence on protecting foreigners and American interests.

Rudy Gestede said Middlesbrough must stay positive and believe they can avoid relegation after a long winless league run, as they sit 19th and six points from safety. He also said Arsenal are a strong side likely to respond after recent poor results, and Middlesbrough must be focused and ready.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Ampere GA10x GPU architecture, including GA102 and GA104, and compares it with Turing. It says GA10x GPUs are up to 1.7x faster in raster graphics, up to 2x faster in ray tracing, and up to 1.9x more power efficient. GA102 powers the GeForce RTX 3090, RTX 3080, RTX A6000, and A40; it features 10,752 CUDA Cores, 84 RT Cores, and 336 Tensor Cores, plus FP32, ray tracing, Tensor Core, GDDR6X, NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, and ROP improvements.

In rheumatoid arthritis patients, abatacept and rituximab reduced SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccine humoral responses, with rituximab causing near-absent antibodies and abatacept lowering S-specific and neutralizing antibodies. Abatacept also altered RBD-specific B cell activation, class switching, and memory differentiation, while MTX mainly reduced S-specific CD4+ T cell responses. Reduced IL-2, IFNγ, and IL-21 production by S-specific T cells was linked to poorer antibody responses, supporting temporary abatacept cessation when feasible before vaccination.

Danantara plans at least eight waste-to-power projects in Indonesia by the end of October, starting in Jakarta and expanding across Java and Bali. The projects will process 1,000 tonnes of waste daily per plant, generate about 15 megawatts each, and support Indonesia’s waste management and renewable energy goals.

MTN and four banks plan to raise GH¢4.67 billion from the Ghana Stock Exchange within six months, raising concerns about market capacity and investor funds. Analysts said pension funds and foreign participation could support the offers, but the timing is risky and may affect the cedi and recapitalisation success.

This study translated and validated an Arabic version of the Orthognathic Quality of Life Questionnaire in 74 Saudi Arabian patients. The questionnaire showed excellent internal consistency, good-to-excellent test-retest reliability, acceptable validity, and responsiveness, and overall scores improved after surgery.

The Supreme Court will consider whether the ex post facto clause applies to restitution under the federal Mandatory Victims Restitution Act. Holsey Ellingburg argues restitution is criminal because it is part of the sentence, uses criminal procedures, and carries incarceration for nonpayment; the government agrees restitution is criminal for this purpose.

Delta Air Lines announced plans to acquire up to an additional 32% of Grupo Aeroméxico’s outstanding stock at MXP$43.59 per share, subject to regulatory approvals in Mexico and the United States. Delta currently owns about 4.1% and has an option to acquire another 8.1%; after the offer, Delta and its pension trust could own or have options to buy up to 49%.
The appeal was docketed and dismissed on the appellant’s motion, with the appellee’s consent, and without costs to either party.

Tradeshift raised $250 million in a Series E round led by Goldman Sachs and PSP Investments, with participation from HSBC, H14, GP Bullhound, and Gray Swan. The funding brings its total to over $400 million and its valuation to more than $1.1 billion. Mikkel Hippe Brun will join the board, and the company said the investment will support its growth and leadership position.

Steve Pearse discusses startup fundraising, emphasizing simple, compelling pitches, clear hooks, customer and business benefits, strong presentation skills, and understanding the audience. He says startups should aim for exits through going public or being sold, raise money before it is needed, work in parallel with investors, stay focused, move fast, and build flexible teams and credible plans.

The speaker says the team is now more comfortable, confident on the road, and focused only on the next game. They note the team must play its own game to be successful, credit the owner’s commitment and the team’s depth, and praise a player who overcame injuries as one of the best on the team.

This systematic review examined 23 level IV studies on personality traits and online learning in higher education. It found that conscientiousness, agreeableness, openness, and emotional stability were generally linked to higher satisfaction, engagement, and grades, while neuroticism was usually linked to poorer outcomes, though findings varied across studies. No studies focused on occupational therapy programs.

Leeds hosted the UK’s first Reclaim the Night march in 1977 after fears about women’s safety during the Yorkshire Ripper murders. The march was later revived and inspired RashDash’s new performance, The Darkest Corners, to be staged in a Holbeck car park as part of Transform 17.

Southwestern College adjuncts held a poorly attended rally for better wages and equal protections, saying low pay, long hours, and weak benefits hurt both their lives and the quality of education. College leaders spoke in support, and adjuncts urged students and faculty to help secure paid office hours and disability leave.

Demi Guo’s AI video company Pika, founded with Chenlin Meng after she dropped out of Stanford’s Ph.D. program, has raised about $135 million and launched a TikTok-like app with a new feature, Predictive Video, that creates short, self-expressive videos from simple prompts or selfies for Gen Z and Gen Alpha. The passage also says AI startups are driving up San Francisco rents, TSMC profit rose 39.1% on AI chip demand, and Spotify is partnering with major music companies on AI music products.

The study compared Colombian higher education students’ perceptions of online learning and emergency remote education during COVID-19. Students generally viewed both positively, but preferred online learning in most aspects, especially content quality, independent work, assessment, and organization. They valued interaction, flexibility, and timely feedback, and suggested better instructor training, more structured activities, and improved assessment practices.

Mark Cuban said Trump’s new TrumpRx drug platform could have an impact if it forces PBMs to change, but he noted it is currently still “rigged to benefit the big PBMs.” He gave the platform a “B,” said Trump could get credit if it succeeds, and public-health experts remain skeptical it will make drugs broadly more affordable.

The Russell 2000 is a market-weighted small-cap index rebalanced annually in June, usually on the fourth Friday, to reflect changes in its constituents and market capitalization. The passage says this process can create buying and selling imbalances and has historically been associated with a late-June rally, with a tested strategy of buying after June 23 and selling in early July.

The passage promotes the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, highlighting unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 spent in 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months, no annual fee, and up to $600 cell phone protection. It also lists other cards and includes advertising, rating, and disclosure information from Motley Fool Money.

Digital leaders align teams around transparent, data-driven goals tied to strategy, creating shared purpose and vertical and horizontal coordination. Digital laggards often lack this connection, leading to misalignment. The passage also emphasizes data culture as central to digital transformation and describes four organizational patterns: data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant.

The President vetoes a harbor and river appropriations bill, arguing it is unconstitutional because the Federal Government lacks power to fund internal improvements within states. He says the bill would expand federal power, favor local interests, encourage wasteful spending, and increase public debt during wartime.

Coach DeBoer said his team made mistakes, played tentatively early, and did not deserve to win, but should improve with two days to prepare. He said the team must keep its usual routine, use its experience, and focus on battling through traffic and pressure against a strong opponent.

The passage contains postgame and pregame comments about a Stanley Cup series, with speakers praising Boston’s strong play, goaltending, and ability to win despite the other team’s hard effort. It also discusses nerves before a seventh game, confidence in the group, and excitement about the opportunity to play for the Stanley Cup.

This phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo- and active-controlled trial evaluates dasiglucagon in children with type 1 diabetes, with the primary endpoint of time to plasma glucose recovery. Analyses use the FAS for efficacy and the safety set for safety, with summary tables, listings, and figures generated in SAS. The SAP specifies sample size, covariate-adjusted primary analyses, hierarchical testing, PK/PD summaries, and detailed safety, laboratory, ECG, and immunogenicity analyses.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs, highlighting GDDR6X memory with PAM4 signaling, up to 936 GB/sec bandwidth, and Error Detection and Replay. It also covers RTX IO for GPU-based loading and decompression, A40 and A6000 data center/workstation features, display and video support including AV1 hardware decode and NVENC encoding, and performance improvements in ray tracing, AI, and rendering.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that on May 1, 2018 it issued a press release and data sheet announcing financial results for its second fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2018. The report includes these documents as exhibits and states the information is not deemed filed under the Exchange Act.

Reports say Queen Elizabeth II may abdicate at 95 and hand the throne to Prince Charles, with a possible Regency Act transition being prepared. If Charles became king, he would be the oldest-ever UK monarch to be crowned, and the succession would then pass to Prince William and Prince George.

Microsoft filed a Form 8-K on April 12, 2021 announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Nuance Communications, Inc. for $56.00 per share in an all-cash transaction valued at $19.7 billion, including Nuance’s net debt. The filing also states that a press release and investor presentation were attached as exhibits.

The White House has identified over 4,100 federal workers for layoffs during the government shutdown, with affected departments including Commerce, HHS, HUD, DHS, and Treasury. Federal workers are furloughed, working without pay, or worried about further cuts, and some agencies have confirmed the reductions.

Punith Kumar, 19, from Choolai, placed first in India and third internationally in the ACCA Chartered Accountant final P2 exam. He completed the course in two years and three months while doing a paid internship, studied from 4 am to 9 pm, and plans to start his own company after finishing the remaining papers by September.

The passage cites multiple prior cases and international awards, including the Hope On, Col. Lloyd Aspinwall, and Bering Sea claims, to show that damages for seizure or detention are measured by the loss of a vessel’s use, especially lost catch or earnings. It also states that foreign nationals may not be forcibly enrolled into a government’s service without consent.

The passage says SPY tends to be higher after a red day and lower after a green day, which is explained as short-term mean reversion. A backtested strategy using SPY—buying after red days and selling after green days—performed better than buy-and-hold, with higher CAGR, less time in the market, better risk-adjusted returns, and lower maximum drawdown.

The newsletter described a sharp market sell-off, especially in Internet and technology stocks, with the Dow and Nasdaq both falling about 70 points. It highlighted earnings reactions, warned against holding over earnings, and listed updated call and put plays, including new call ideas for Vodafone, Qwest, and several diagonal spreads.

Ofcom has proposed automatic compensation for fixed broadband and landline customers when outages are not fixed quickly, new services are delayed, or engineers miss appointments. Payments would be automatic, set by Ofcom, and could reach up to £185m a year for up to 2.6 million customers.

Sonora High’s 2017 Athletic Hall of Fame inducted 12 former Wildcats and coaches spanning 1950 to 2008, recognizing achievements in multiple sports, coaching, and education. The banquet was scheduled for Nov. 4 at Sonora Elks Lodge.

The passage says censorship and book banning are rising sharply in U.S. schools and colleges, with conservative and Trump-aligned efforts targeting books, curricula, and academic freedom. It cites bans at colleges and military academies, proposed syllabus and compact requirements, and argues that higher education should unite with librarians and others to resist repression.

A federal judge ruled that FACEA’s religious-freedom provision applies to Falun Gong practitioners and rejected a constitutional challenge to the law. Judge Jack Weinstein said the law can be construed broadly to protect nontraditional places of worship, certified the ruling for appeal, and encouraged the parties to settle before a difficult two-month trial.

The Carter administration used MONs for higher-risk, higher-cost, or more specific covert operations under approved objectives, later extending them to significant changes in any finding. New covert actions still required new presidential findings, and Congress was typically notified within 48 hours. The Intelligence Oversight Act of 1980 narrowed oversight to the two intelligence committees, allowed limited notice to the “Gang of Eight” in extraordinary circumstances, and required timely notice and reasons if prior notice was withheld.

The court held that the case could not be removed to federal court, that the widow could recover in one action for both pecuniary loss and the decedent’s pain and suffering, and that the disabled interstate car was still covered by the Safety Appliance Act. It also held the railroad liable for the injury caused by the defective coupler and upheld the widow’s testimony about contributions, affirming the $10,000 judgment.

The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe said the official US dollar to bond note exchange rate remains 1:1 and urged the public to use licensed financial institutions for currency exchanges. It said 45 institutions are licensed, illegal forex traders are being arrested under a new law, and retailers refusing non-cash payments should be reported.

The dollar rose to three-week highs after a Federal Reserve official backed further rate hikes, while U.S. Treasury yields increased. The yen weakened, the euro fell on French election uncertainty, U.S. job growth missed forecasts but labor market strength was seen as intact, and speculative long dollar positions fell to a five-week low.

The passage derives a continuous-wave interferometry limit for time-dependent phase estimation using pairs of squeezed states. It shows a spectral quantum Cramer-Rao bound scaling as 1/[ΔΩ·n(n+2)], giving Heisenberg scaling for large photon flux per mode, and states that this bound is attained by a nonlinear estimator based on filtered homodyne records.

The study examined whether PNI, NLR, and PLR predict prognosis in patients with chronic hepatitis C-associated cirrhosis complicated by type 2 diabetes. It included 56 such patients, 85 chronic hepatitis C-associated cirrhosis patients, and 85 T2DM patients, and divided the affected patients into poor and good prognosis groups after 6 months of treatment. NLR, PNI, and PLR were calculated from blood test data.

The Rubber Band trading strategy is a contrarian mean-reversion approach for stocks that seeks overbought or oversold points and expects price to return to the mean. It often uses Keltner Channels, with buys below the lower band and sells above the upper band, sometimes confirmed by reversal candlesticks. A backtest on XLP reported 328 trades, 0.45% average gain per trade, 6.1% CAGR, 20% time in market, a profit factor of 2, and 16% max drawdown.

The passage describes Turing GPU features including VirtualLink for single-cable VR headsets, NVLink for faster SLI GPU-to-GPU transfers, and hardware-based real-time ray tracing using RT Cores. It also covers NGX AI features such as DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez, plus mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, and multi-view rendering.

UK university staff are in their fourth week of striking over pension changes, with 14 more strike days planned for April to June if talks fail, potentially affecting exam periods. The University of Edinburgh has also been criticized for asking lecturers to provide recorded past lectures during the strike.

The study used ADNI data and machine learning to predict rates of cognitive decline and progression to MCI or dementia in non-demented individuals. It compared models using demographics, APOE4, composite cognitive scores, plasma biomarkers, MRI measures, and combinations of these features. Prediction was strongest for the memory domain (ADNI-MEM), especially when plasma and MRI data were combined, while Aβ42/40 was less predictive than NfL and p-tau181. Predicting decline was more difficult in cognitively unimpaired individuals than in MCI groups, but predicted memory decline also helped forecast progression to MCI/dementia.

A National Academies report says heritable DNA editing should be allowed only to prevent serious, strongly heritable diseases, not to enhance traits. It urges strict oversight, public scrutiny, and long-term follow-up for any germline-editing clinical trials, while noting CRISPR-Cas9 has made such editing a realistic possibility.

Eight women and 15 men were arrested in a week-long Singapore police operation from May 21 to 27. The women were suspected of advertising sexual services online, while 14 men were arrested for gambling-related offences and one man for drink-driving. Police checked about 700 people at more than 70 units in Yishun, Ang Mo Kio and Sengkang and seized S$730 and 10 handphones.

Aiden Markram said it was an honour to captain South Africa after replacing injured Faf du Plessis, and that he hopes to thrive under the added responsibility. He said senior players will help him, and the Proteas need to improve against India in the second ODI after trailing 1-0 in the series.

Google is adding speech recognition support for 30 new languages and locales, bringing total support to 119, with a focus on India and Africa. The update launches in Gboard for Android, Voice Search, and the Cloud Speech API, and includes voice dictation with emojis for U.S. English speakers. Google trained the new languages using native speakers and machine learning.

Saints begin their Anglo-Welsh Cup campaign at Exeter Chiefs on November 4, then play the Dragons at home on November 11, Sale Sharks away in late January, and Harlequins at home in early February. They are grouped with Saracens, Scarlets and Worcester Warriors, and the top team from each pool reaches the semi-finals.

The passage describes TeraAgent, a distributed simulation engine for agent-based models that overcomes BioDynaMo’s single-server limits by scaling across multiple servers. It introduces a custom serialization method and delta encoding to reduce communication overhead, and reports simulations of up to 501.51 billion agents on 84,096 CPU cores, with improvements in serialization speed, visualization, interoperability, and scalability.

The paper proposes a model-based geostatistical method for designing soil-transmitted helminth impact assessment surveys using baseline prevalence, intervention history, and environmental data. Applied to Kenya, Sierra Leone, and Zimbabwe, it produced similar accuracy to classical surveys with much lower sample sizes and about 80% lower cost on average.

CoreLogic reported that U.S. home prices rose 7.1% year over year in May 2018 and 1.1% from the previous month, with limited housing supply and strong demand contributing to higher prices. Among the 100 largest metropolitan areas, 40% were overvalued, 26% undervalued, and 34% at value; the forecast projects a 5.1% national increase from May 2018 to May 2019.

The passage describes a vehicle vision and driver monitoring system that uses one or more cameras and vehicle signals to capture exterior and interior images, estimate driver distraction and driving workload, and determine driver attention. It can monitor passengers, detect objects and hazards, generate alerts or overlays, and may take autonomous control if the driver is not attentive and risk exceeds a threshold.

Alere said its 2015, 2014 and 2013 financial statements should not be relied upon due to misstatements, mainly involving revenue recognition at its South Korean location and one Japanese transaction affecting 2013 and 2012. It expects no change to total revenue reported for any transaction, believes prior material weaknesses in revenue recognition remain unremediated, identified an additional control-environment weakness, and may need more time to file its first-quarter 2017 10-Q.

The American Academy of Pediatrics says five commonly ordered tests for children who are short, overweight, or showing early puberty are often unnecessary if the child is otherwise healthy. These include hormone, endocrine, vitamin D, thyroid or insulin tests for overweight children, and thyroid ultrasounds. The AAP advises weighing risks and benefits and using these tests only in specific situations where they are more likely to be helpful.

Letters from women in immigration detention describe harsh conditions, family separation, and distress over not knowing their children’s fate. One anonymous woman said she was held in chain-link cages, went days without bathing or brushing her teeth, slept on the floor, and was separated from her children for 21 days before being reunited by phone; she was later released from custody.

Shonda Rhimes and her Shondaland company have signed a deal to create new shows for Netflix, while her current series will continue airing on ABC. No financial terms or contract length were disclosed.

Pairs trading is presented as a market-neutral strategy that buys one asset and sells another to profit from convergence or divergence in the spread. The passage says it can still be profitable, but it also has drawbacks such as leverage, slippage, shorting costs, and black swan risk. It discusses correlation, cointegration, examples like KO/PEP and GS/MS, and notes that simple backtests showed mixed results.

The passage describes a virtual-scene system in which a terminal displays a marker element for a user-marked target virtual item directly in the scene interface for teammates to view. A server checks whether the target is within the current virtual object’s visible distance, sends marker indication information, and terminals render the marker, optional distance information, and a thumbnail-map icon. The passage also covers marker type selection, marker cancellation after a preset duration, and related terminal, apparatus, and storage-medium implementations.

A district court judge ordered Texas State University to reinstate Thomas Alter, a tenured history professor fired after a speech at a virtual socialism conference. Alter says the university violated his free speech and due process rights and breached his contract; he will be reinstated without pay while the case is reviewed.

Tesla Motors, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2016, reporting $2.30 billion in quarterly revenue, $21.9 million in net income, and $3.08 billion in cash and cash equivalents. The filing also described Tesla’s acquisition agreement with SolarCity, updated balance sheet and cash flow figures, debt and lease obligations, revenue recognition policies, and management’s outlook for vehicle production, deliveries, the Gigafactory, and expansion.

Henrik Lundqvist said his team was disappointed after allowing a last-second first-period goal, but believed they had created chances and could still turn the series around. He said they needed a strong start, to focus on the process, and to play their best against a very good team and goalie.

Researchers found that ALS patients had stronger T cell responses than controls to the protein C9orf72, and patients with mutations in C9orf72 showed even stronger responses. In patients with C9orf72 responses, higher IL-10 levels were associated with longer survival, but the authors said the findings do not prove ALS is an autoimmune disease and further study is needed.

The passage reports that AMD shares surged after an AI chip deal with OpenAI, gold rose above $3,900/oz, and market commentary said the S&P 500 is still in an uptrend but faces early technical warnings and seasonal headwinds. It also notes July gains for the S&P 500, a weak start to August, and several Investing.com headlines and risk disclosures.

Cryptocurrency crime in Japan is rising amid falling overall crime, highlighted by Coincheck’s ¥58 billion NEM theft. The passage says Japan has embraced virtual currencies, but also faces fraud, ransomware, and risky ICOs, which regulators warn may involve rapid losses and fraud.

The Ontario Liberals are considering scrapping Grade 3 and Grade 9 EQAO tests, eliminating the mandatory high school literacy test, and weakening other provincewide assessments. The report behind the proposal has raised concerns about reduced accountability, lack of EQAO consultation, and less independent data on student performance.

Auswide Bank is an Australian bank that grew from Queensland building societies, listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in 1994, and converted from a building society to a bank in 2015. For fiscal 2020, it had assets of AUD3,789 million and net profit after tax of AUD18.5 million. The passage also lists representative fiscal 2021 transactions, including a share issue, borrowing, customer deposits and loans, interest and expense items, a loan sale, a dividend, depreciation, and loan impairment, plus assignment questions to prepare records, a balance sheet, and fiscal 2021 net income and cash flow.

The passage describes the WEA Teacher Residency Program, a union-led, non-IHE-affiliated special education teacher preparation program in Washington State. It addresses teacher shortages and workforce diversity through an 18-month residency with Hyflex coursework, mentorship, field placements, technology use, and financial incentives, while emphasizing cultural competency, equity, and evidence-based training.

San Francisco’s Ford GoBike program launched 250 electric pedal-assist bikes at stations in the western half of the city. Officials said the bikes are meant to help riders handle the city’s hills, attract more users, and support short trips and first-and-last-mile travel.

The speaker says the main goal is to stop the other team from scoring, avoid turnovers, and focus only on winning the next two games, not personal records. They also say prior experience helps with the media attention and recognition that comes with being a hockey player.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Secretary Abid Majeed directed the formation of committees to oversee the upcoming province-wide measles campaign and stressed communication, staff training, logistics, vaccines, and referral systems. The campaign, set for October, will vaccinate children aged nine to 59 months, targeting 4.3 million children amid rising measles cases across the province.

IDC says industrial enterprises need IT-based simulations, modeling, data analytics, and HPC to address disruption, improve agility, optimize product development, supply chains, energy use, and sustainability, and support new digital products, services, and business models. It recommends virtual development, a holistic data strategy with a single source of truth, choosing the right HPC operating model, ensuring scalability, security, and energy efficiency, and using external expertise when needed. The findings are based on a December 2021 telephone survey of 200 IT and other decision makers from industrial enterprises in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

Sarah and Laura Ayoub say Scotland’s music education was crucial to their careers, and they support free access to tuition for all children. The passage also describes concerns that council cuts and charges are reducing access to music lessons across Scotland, despite government investment in the Youth Music Initiative.

The court denied defendants’ summary judgment motion in a suit by a union member challenging the use of his dues for non-bargaining purposes. It held that the case presented a justiciable controversy, that plaintiff was not required to attend union meetings or further exhaust § 201(c) remedies, and that the NLRA does not authorize expenditures of dissenters’ dues for political or ideological purposes.

A Gallup-Walton Family Foundation survey found that more than 1 in 4 U.S. public school teachers lack basic materials or staffing support, with shortages especially common for teaching assistants, mental health resources, and special educators. Teachers with adequate resources report higher job satisfaction, while many also face difficulties obtaining materials and limited useful professional development.

The speaker says it was wonderful to be part of the group in Detroit, praised by Chris Chelios and Ken Holland, and to win the Stanley Cup, hoping to return next year. He also said there is great respect for the coach, whose long career should end eventually, and that this time he is more aware and able to enjoy the experience without controversy.

The lecture explains how linear shift-invariant systems described by linear constant coefficient difference equations can be implemented using digital networks built from delay, multiplication, and addition. It introduces block diagrams, then signal flow graphs, and derives their matrix form. It also discusses computability of node orderings, noting that delay-free loops can make a network non-computable.

Ron Washington will not return as Angels manager in 2026, and interim manager Ray Montgomery also will not get the job. The Angels are searching for their sixth manager in nine years after finishing 72-90, while Perry Minasian remains under contract through 2026.

Britain’s occupation of the Sandwich Islands was later described as unauthorized, and the causes of the incident were linked to rivalry among foreign powers in Hawaii. The United States had earlier recognized Hawaiian independence through Webster’s 1842 statement, and in November 1843 France and Great Britain agreed to treat the islands as an independent state and not take possession of any part of them.

Manchester United want to recover from a 2-0 loss to Spurs, with Alexis Sanchez set for his home debut against Huddersfield. Mourinho will speak before the match about Fellaini’s fitness and his touchline issues with Paul Pogba.

NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU introduces Ampere architecture features including third-generation Tensor Cores, MIG, NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, asynchronous copy and barriers, task graph acceleration, and fine-grained structured sparsity. It delivers higher performance and efficiency for AI, HPC, and data analytics than V100, with support for TF32, BF16, FP64, INT8, INT4, and binary data types, and up to seven GPU Instances through MIG.

Elliott Management said NXP Semiconductors is worth $135 per share on an intrinsic standalone basis, above Qualcomm’s $110 offer, and argued Qualcomm’s bid undervalued NXP. Elliott, which owns about 6% of NXP, said it had hired UBS Investment Bank to analyze the company and planned to share the report with shareholders.

The Japan Society of Technology Education developed the New Framework for Technology and Engineering Education (NGTE) in response to changes in STEAM education and Society 5.0. A survey of 1,656 junior high school students found positive attitudes toward Technology classes, but limited exploratory learning and weak links between design problem-solving and abilities for technological innovation and governance. NGTE emphasizes technology and engineering literacy, a triple-loop engineering design process, and a STEAM learning model centered on engineering-based problem-solving.

NVIDIA filed an 8-K reporting that on March 6, 2019 the Compensation Committee approved a new global performance-based restricted stock unit notice and agreement, and on March 8, 2019 it adopted the Fiscal Year 2020 Variable Compensation Plan for eligible executive officers based on fiscal 2020 revenue performance goals. The report also lists named executive officer target award opportunities and includes the related exhibits.

Robert Cyrus Garrison was convicted of first-degree rape and sentenced to 30 years after a two-stage trial. The court held the punishment instruction was erroneous and prejudicial, but not grounds for reversal, so it modified the sentence to 15 years and otherwise affirmed.

Tesla appointed Zachary Kirkhorn as Chief Financial Officer to succeed Deepak Ahuja and Vaibhav Taneja as Chief Accounting Officer on March 13, 2019. Kirkhorn and Taneja received stock option and restricted stock unit grants that vest over four years under Tesla’s standard equity policies.

Port Hardy Secondary School’s senior girls soccer team qualified for the BC Single A High School Provincials in Penticton after finishing second at the Island Championships. They won 6-1 over Duncan Christian, lost close games to Glenlyon Norfolk, and beat St. Andrews 3-1 in overtime in the semifinal.

A state audit found that former Duquesne School District superintendent Barbara McDonnell and four other employees used district funds for personal, no-interest loans totaling about $41,000, including $22,000 for McDonnell, without board approval. The audit also cited questionable accounting, missing documentation for $1.3 million in transportation reimbursements, and at least $180,000 in state overpayments. The matter is being referred to the State Ethics Commission.

Lobster 207, formed in 2013 as both an IAM local and cooperative, organized Maine lobstermen to improve prices, influence regulations, and build economic power. The new segments are Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing, and the filing states the updates do not restate previously issued financial statements.

He urges support for the Constitution, warns against aiding the rebels, and says offenders should be brought to justice.

Royalty North Partners Ltd. granted 35,000 stock options at C$1.47 per share expiring October 6, 2022, and awarded 37,500 restricted share rights to certain directors and senior officers, vesting over two years.

A Kuwaiti court sentenced both parents to death for torturing and killing their three-year-old daughter, whose body was reportedly kept in a freezer for a week. The verdict is not final and must be reviewed by the appeals and supreme courts.

The Clean 20 is a diet book by Dr. Ian K. Smith that explains clean eating, emphasizes reducing processed foods, and highlights 20 easy-to-find clean foods. It includes a meal plan, 60 recipes, substitutions, and 20-minute workouts, while promoting choosing foods wisely within all food groups for weight loss and health.

Lincoln City FC and Grimsby Town FC are rivals, but the railway line to Grimsby opened in 1848 for economic transport needs. The passage focuses on the River Witham Bridge at Stamp End, a John Fowler-designed box-girder bridge that may be the oldest surviving wrought iron box girder railway bridge in Britain and has been altered and reinforced several times, including major work in 1903, 1948, and 1968.

In a study of 1,411 emergency department patients in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, 95.6% had detectable S-IgG, 24.0% had NC-IgG, and 94.4% and 84.9% showed neutralizing activity against Wu01 and BA.4/5, respectively. Scientists made kirigami-inspired perforated Mylar parachutes that automatically unfurl, fall straight down regardless of orientation, and could be used for aid drops or package delivery. In tests, they reached targets more accurately and slowed a 1-kilogram bottle from about 34 to 14 meters per second.

Intraday trading is buying and selling financial instruments within the same trading day, often through scalping or day trading. It can be profitable with a backtested quantified strategy, but most traders lose money. The passage says the best time to trade is usually the first two hours after the market opens, and common markets and indicators include forex, stocks, futures, options, moving averages, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and RSI.

The trial court erred by dismissing controlled substances charges against defendant on double jeopardy grounds after a drug tax liability was docketed and partly paid. West decision was not binding on North Carolina courts.

The passage also notes Disney plans to pull movies from Netflix, Netflix bought Millarworld, and a Barron’s article criticized Netflix’s valuation and rising debt.

Hundreds of people in Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly were admitted to hospital with eating disorders in 2016-17, including two children under 10, 13 aged 10-12, 91 aged 13-15, and 117 aged 16-18. Eating-disorder admissions were at a record high, more than double 2010-11 levels, with anorexia the most common diagnosis and women and girls making up 94% of cases. The Buck Sweep is a misdirection off-tackle run with two pullers, used mainly in the Wing-T offense. Its strengths are disguise, angles, and stress on defensive discipline, while its weaknesses are timing, spacing, and the need for effective pulling and practice. The passage also outlines blocking rules against 3-4 and 4-3 fronts and describes shotgun Wing-T and I-Wing variations.

The passage argues that despite concerns, Google has said there are no changes to Inbox by Gmail, and recent new Inbox features suggest development is still continuing. It notes Inbox still has distinct functions from Gmail and is not likely to be sunsetted soon.

TripAdvisor said it had already penalized the listing and removed some reviews.

The shiitake mushroom market is projected to grow strongly, driven by Asia Pacific, especially China, which held 97% of the region’s market. The market is linked to its nutritional and medicinal uses, with pharmaceutical applications expected to grow fastest. Major players include Bonduelle SA, Mitoku Company, Agro Dutch Industries, The Mushroom Company, Modern Mushroom Farms, Hirano Mushroom LLC, and Banken Champignons.

It analyzed co-contraction, muscle correlations, and muscle synergies to characterize altered coordination after stroke and identify potential motor-related biomarkers.

Port Gregory lost power repeatedly over four days, leaving elderly residents without medical equipment and causing food loss. Resident Betty Sewers reported multiple outages and said her neighbour could not use a CPAP machine, while Western Power said storm fronts stretched resources and the area is prone to outages due to salt, dust, and its spur-line location.

It says unity will require shifting power toward moderate, more liberal forces and pooling purposes across the alliances. It also predicts that success on the Western Front depends on exhausting Germany’s reserves, resisting peace offensives, and maintaining broad public support until a military decision is reached through territorial gains and the growing American reserve.

Sonali Bendre Behl said she has been diagnosed with high-grade cancer that has metastasised and is undergoing treatment in New York. She said the diagnosis followed tests for a niggling pain and that she is supported by family and friends and determined to fight the illness.

SrTiO3 changes from a cubic non-polar phase to a tetragonal phase below 105 K, and cryogenic 4D-STEM reveals that it is locally polar below this transition. Polar nanodomains form with a characteristic size of about 20 nm and show periodic correlations over about 25 nm, but below about 40 K they fragment into smaller, more disordered clusters and lose this periodic ordering.

Apple plans to become approximately net cash neutral over time, with CFO Luca Maestri saying its current net cash position is $163 billion. The company may do this through capital returns, debt changes, or both, and will provide more details in its next quarterly results update.

The S&P 500 fell 0.11% on Friday, ending a six-day streak of record closes after weaker U.S. jobs data and Amazon-related pressure on pharmacy stocks. The Nasdaq rose 0.07% to a record close for the sixth straight day, while the Dow was nearly flat. Walgreens, CVS, and Costco declined sharply, and the S&P 500 still rose 1.2% for the week.

Traders also increased expectations for a December Federal Reserve rate hike to 93 percent.

Fior Markets released a report on the global cooking oil market for 2017–2022, covering industry trends, segmentation, growth, market share, revenue, leading players, regions, types, and applications. It includes forecasts, market size estimates, drivers, restraints, opportunities, and regional analysis for markets including the USA, Europe, Japan, China, India, and Southeast Asia.

PIMS employees continued their fifth-day protest for separation of PIMS from SZABMU, forcing the vice chancellor out of his office and sealing it. Government officials said the amendment bill’s summary would be sent to the prime minister after legal formalities were completed, and the Law Minister asked that the bill be tabled for approval. Protesters said they would continue the strike until their demand was met, despite appeals to end it for patient care.

Dinbych were tested by Wrexham after three opening wins, but still earned a 29-22 victory in a competitive Division Two (North) match. Wrexham scored four tries and secured a losing bonus point, while Dinbych led 12-10 at half-time and pulled clear in the second half. Dinbych 2nds also lost 16-10 at Flint and gained a losing bonus point.
