A mapping review of U.S. occupational therapy fieldwork literature from 1989–2020 found 67 eligible articles, with most focused on OT Level II fieldwork. The literature disproportionately addressed instructional methods and learner characteristics and competencies, while OTA fieldwork, Level I fieldwork, theory building, signature pedagogies, socialization to the profession, faculty development and resources, and diversity, inclusion, and equity were largely absent.

Peruvian police are considering expelling U.S. citizen John Dougherty and Canadian citizen Jennifer Moore for allegedly inciting rural communities to protest against Hudbay Minerals’ Constancia copper mine in Peru. The interior ministry said they entered as tourists in April but were found to be engaging in anti-mining activities that disturbed public order.

Archaeologists in Egypt announced the discovery of a 4,400-year-old tomb near the pyramids outside Cairo, likely belonging to the 5th Dynasty official Hetpet, with wall paintings showing hunting and fishing scenes.

The lecture summarizes Thomson scattering spectra in plasmas, showing how the spectral density depends on electron and ion distribution functions, susceptibilities, and the parameter alpha. The study argues that Turkey’s centralized, bureaucratic education administration should be replaced by a local education boards model based on participation, transparency, accountability, and democracy. Using mixed methods, it compared 16 OECD countries and surveyed 421 teachers and administrators, most of whom preferred local, elected boards and broader stakeholder participation. It proposes a model with central and local boards/commissions for education governance.

A federal judge denied the U.S. government's request to pause an order allowing transgender individuals to enlist in the military starting January 1, 2018. The Pentagon said it was preparing to comply, while the White House said the Justice Department was reviewing legal options.

Texas educators, parents and experts worry a new law replacing STAAR with three yearly tests may not reduce stress or testing time, especially if accountability ratings still depend heavily on the end-of-year exam. The law bans practice tests, requires quicker score release, and allows educator review, but critics want more teacher input and fewer restrictions on test day.

Spotify, Comcast, and Oracle recently announced co-CEO structures, reflecting a broader but still uncommon model that can improve shareholder returns yet also create role confusion, power struggles, and governance challenges. Experts said it works best when responsibilities and authority are clearly defined, while companies like Chipotle have later returned to a single CEO.

NVIDIA reported third-quarter fiscal 2016 revenue of $1.305 billion and net income of $246 million, with nine-month revenue of $3.609 billion and net income of $406 million. Revenue rose in the GPU business and declined in the Tegra Processor business. The company also reported restructuring charges from winding down Icera modem operations, an $8 million third-quarter charge and $97 million for the first nine months, along with ongoing litigation, share repurchases, and dividends.

H. White, and Kate and Anna, and includes a memorandum presenting the claims to an arbitrator at The Hague.

The planarization layer can support touch sensors or other patterns, reducing dead space and parasitic capacitance while maintaining moisture protection.

It found that grain interior resistivity depends on heat treatment rather than composition, Si and Mg2Si precipitates contribute equally to resistivity, and bulk resistivity increases linearly with solute content and precipitate volume fraction.

Y-Cross is a common drop-back passing concept used in many offenses to create deep and intermediate throws with a post, crosser, and running back flat route. It works well against man coverage and Cover 4, is weaker against Cover 3, and can be adjusted with different personnel and backside route tags. The quarterback’s base progression is post, deep crosser, then RB check-down or backside dig.

Bitcoin rose to a six-week high after positive headlines about possible entry by major financial institutions, lifting the broader cryptocurrency market. It gained 4.4% to $9,340.88, helped push total digital-currency market value to $427 billion, and saw $28 billion in 24-hour trading volume, while regulatory concerns remained.

DWI arrests in Wichita Falls have declined, with 25 arrests from January 1 to March 19 this year compared with 39 in 2016 and 38 in 2017, and only 5 arrests over St. Patrick’s Day weekend. Sgt. Harold McClure said people may be making smarter choices, ridesharing may be helping, and police presence at events may also encourage sober driving.

The Trump administration wants employers to pay a $100,000 fee for new H-1B visas, which could affect thousands of college jobs. U.S. colleges and universities employed more than 16,000 H-1B workers as of June 30, and universities say the visas help hire researchers, academic staff, and medical personnel.

No candidate for governor or U.S. Senate reached the 60 percent threshold, while several other targeted districts also fell short of endorsement requirements.

European research institutions are proposing International Coccolithophore Day on October 10 to raise awareness of their role in carbon regulation, marine ecosystems, and climate science, amid concerns that climate change is threatening their survival.

A Tennessee mother’s video of her son Keaton describing bullying at middle school drew widespread support from athletes and entertainers. The video, which showed Keaton saying classmates insulted and mistreated him, had more than 18 million views, and a fundraising page for his education raised over $29,000.

NVIDIA reported that on June 28, 2021 it completed a corporate structure simplification by domestically repatriating certain non-U.S. intellectual property, and updated its second-quarter fiscal 2022 tax outlook to 13% plus or minus 1%, with an expected Domestication tax benefit of about $250 million to $300 million.

Memory problems were more associated with Alzheimer’s disease, tremor with Parkinson’s disease, and hallucinations, confusion, constipation, falls, and depression with dementia with Lewy bodies. Revenues increased year over year, but operating losses widened due to higher research, development, and selling, general and administrative expenses. The power play needs to score more, and the team needs to battle hard throughout.

Published in Nature Communications, it may improve fusion control, reduce hardware needs and costs, support ELM suppression research, and help make future fusion reactors more compact, reliable, and affordable.

The Supreme Court declined to hear Ghislaine Maxwell’s appeal of her conviction and 20-year sentence. Maxwell argued that a 2007 non-prosecution agreement for Jeffrey Epstein barred some charges against her nationwide, but the Solicitor General said the clause was unusual and did not warrant review.

It has been adapted for short selling, but short results are less profitable than longs.

The study found that the Sal6830™ SARS-CoV-2 saliva test could be used accurately and easily by non-laboratory trained healthcare workers at point of care. In blinded sample testing, results matched expectations, and in the clinical comparison the overall percent agreement with the Cepheid Xpert Xpress CoV-2/Flu/RSV test was 93.3%. Usability questionnaires showed users found the system easy, well integrated, and requiring no technical support.

It trains tiny neural networks on live game data to reduce GPU ray-tracing work, improve indirect lighting quality, and adapt to different in-game scenarios.
The State of Washington appealed a Spokane County superior court judgment in favor of Douglas John Nelson. The appellate court reversed and remanded the case in an unpublished opinion.

DryShips raised $14.5 million by issuing 7.9 million shares at an average price of $1.79, falling short of its $30 million target and leaving $173.4 million remaining under the offering. The stock had 54.92 million shares outstanding at April 17, and the issuance caused 16.8% dilution, reflecting weak market demand and continued difficulty completing the equity offering.

Hurricane Maria struck Puerto Rico on September 20, 2017, causing major flooding, infrastructure damage, power loss for 3.4 million people, and over US$82 billion in damages. The passage proposes a semiparametric Poisson regression model to estimate excess deaths by cause and post-emergency period, while accounting for population displacement and temporal variation.

Dylan Drysdale, Tim Loughran and Garry Cullum won class titles at the 2017 Molecule ProKart Series final round at Agrisea Raceway. Drysdale took the Wifiplus KZ2 title, Loughran won Aarque Group KZ2 Masters, and Cullum claimed his fourth KZ2 Restricted series title after winning every race session.

NASA has proposed the HAMMER spacecraft as a response to a possible Bennu impact; it could use an impactor on smaller asteroids, but would need a nuclear device to destroy Bennu. Bennu is a potentially hazardous asteroid, monitored since 1999, with a 1 in 2,700 chance of hitting Earth on September 21, 2135.

When a player is injured and play continues, players may stop play by kicking the ball out of bounds as a form of soccer etiquette. After play resumes with a throw-in or dropped ball, the team receiving the ball should return it to the opposing team, usually backward, and neither side should take advantage of the courtesy.

It found high participant engagement, improved confidence and attitudes, and strong interest in further practice-based, domain-specific accessibility training.

The passage argues that the Supreme Court is likely to uphold President Trump’s firing of FTC Commissioner Rebecca Kelly Slaughter, but this would not require overturning Humphrey’s Executor. It says the Court may instead use a narrower, agency-specific analysis that could still preserve the Federal Reserve’s independence, with a likely “mend it, don’t end it” approach to Humphrey’s Executor.

In a 2017 SONA debate speech, DA leader Mmusi Maimane accused the ANC and President Zuma of corruption, elite enrichment, and abusing power, citing the Esidimeni deaths and parliamentary violence. He said the DA would pursue a Rescue Plan focused on youth, education, jobs, honest government, and economic growth through private sector involvement, anti-corruption measures, and reforms to state and labor policy.

The study used WLI and AFM to examine defects introduced by electropolishing on bulk Nb samples. It found intergranular sloped steps with heights up to 70 nm and slope angles up to about 50°, and showed that these defects can suppress the superheating field, enhance magnetic fields, and reduce impurity uniformity near grain boundaries.

Alexa can help make cleaning easier by creating schedules with the Cleaning Buddy skill, ordering cleaning supplies through Amazon, controlling robot vacuums like Roomba and Neato with voice commands, and assisting with laundry through Laundrapp or stain-removal skills.

MIT researchers developed a refined prime editing system that makes far fewer DNA errors, reducing mistakes to about 1/60 of the original rate in mouse and human cells. The approach could make gene therapy safer and more precise for treating many genetic diseases.

British police declared a major incident after a man and woman in their 40s were left critically ill from an unknown substance in Amesbury, near Salisbury, and counterterrorism officers are working with local detectives while police say it is not yet clear if a crime was committed.

The court denied the plaintiff’s complaint to deny discharge, finding no sufficient proof under §§ 727(a)(2), (a)(3), (a)(4), or (a)(5), and entered final judgment and discharge in favor of the debtor, Ambrozy Jerry Fasolak.

The passage traces polo’s origins from Persia to India and then England and the U.S., and describes the Milwaukee Polo Club in Hartland as an accessible “blue collar” club that welcomes the public, emphasizes safety and horse care, and holds matches of about two hours during fair weather.

The speaker emphasizes preparation, focus, execution, and team depth over momentum or individual play, saying opportunities to win are rare in a cap world. He praises contributions from multiple players, values doing it for teammates, and says the team must keep playing hard, avoid turnovers, and get ready for the next game.

Austin ISD sent a memo telling principals and staff not to share unvetted resources or discuss political or controversial topics, citing increased scrutiny after recent ICE detentions in the Austin-San Antonio area. The memo drew criticism from board Vice President Paul Saldana and Education Austin, which has been distributing immigration rights information and will urge clearer communication at a news conference and board meeting.

A 13-year-old girl was shot in the thigh while sitting with others in an open garage in Guildford, Sydney, about 9.45pm Tuesday and was taken to the Children's Hospital at Westmead in a serious but stable condition. Police believe the shooting was not random and are waiting to speak with her.

Penny stocks are described as highly risky, illiquid, lightly regulated, and often tied to unproven or failing businesses, with many ending worthless. The passage warns they are exposed to scams such as pump-and-dump schemes and “guru” frauds, and advises avoiding them altogether.

Mark Warner said Republicans are making an unprecedented effort to undermine Robert Mueller’s investigation and the FBI, criticized the release of the Nunes memo, and said being blocked from viewing it showed its partisan nature. He also said the ongoing Senate Russia investigation is important for countering future cyber threats and that the president’s failure to acknowledge the threat makes the country less safe.

The paper studies many-to-one two-sided matching and introduces team-justified EF1, a relaxation of team fairness that accounts for participants’ preferences. It presents a polynomial-time algorithm that guarantees team-justified SD-EF1, participant-justified EF, balancedness, Pareto optimality, and group-strategyproofness for participants, and extends these results to settings with quotas and unassigned parties.

Digital leaders emphasize learning, transparent data access, clear metrics, and aligned goals to support collaboration, innovation, and accountability. Digital laggards tend to be risk-averse, data-hoarding, and focused on short-term, qualitative, or process-based efforts, which can hinder alignment and innovation.

The passage reflects on a century of U.S. constitutional growth, praising the Union’s survival through civil war, the abolition of slavery, and the expansion of citizenship and self-government. It urges equal suffrage, universal education, national unity, and obedience to law, while outlining policies on finance, agriculture, commerce, religious freedom, civil service reform, and federal authority.

ATR Trailing Stop is a technical indicator introduced by J. Welles Wilder that uses average true range to set dynamic stop-loss levels based on price volatility. It can help determine exit points, signal potential trend reversals and entry signals, and be applied to stocks and other instruments. The passage notes that it uses a multiplier of typically 3.5, offers benefits such as protecting profits and minimizing losses, and has risks, including not fully accounting for past performance and price movements.

Harvard President Drew Faust announced she will step down at the end of the 2017-18 school year, ending her nearly 11-year tenure. She plans to take a sabbatical and return to scholarship, and Harvard will form a search committee to find her replacement.

Texas A&M’s streak of at least one first-round NFL draft pick every year since 2011 may depend on Christian Kirk, who is projected as a fringe first-rounder. Armani Watts is seen as a mid-round pick, Damion Ratley as a late-round possibility, and Zaycoven Henderson’s draft stock has fallen because of his arrest.

Michigan State Superintendent Michael Rice is retiring after a long education career and says schools should not reduce instructional time by counting professional development days. He cited pandemic-related setbacks, persistent literacy and achievement problems, some progress on funding, preschool, graduation rates, and teacher shortages, and argued Michigan should follow Mississippi’s example on reading instruction.

Alphabet will pay $24.5 million to settle Donald Trump’s lawsuit over YouTube’s post-January 6 ban, with $22 million going to Trump and $2.5 million to co-plaintiffs. Trump has directed part of the money to the Trust for the National Mall and White House ballroom construction.

Peter Lynch, a retired Fidelity Magellan money manager, produced strong returns from 1977 to 1990 and promoted “invest in what you know” and “ten baggers.” His strategy focused on clear, undervalued companies with strong fundamentals, grouped into categories such as slow-growing, moderately growing, fast-growing, cyclical, crisis recovery, and undervalued assets.

The Ghana Football Association’s vice president, George Afriyie, was relieved of his duties after an Executive Committee meeting, amid a reported rift with Kwesi Nyantakyi. The sacking has intensified speculation about Afriyie’s challenge for the GFA top job and Nyantakyi’s possible 2019 re-election bid.

The passage is a news digest on the Dabhol Power project, reporting lender discussions about possibly suspending or closing phase II, hiring Stone & Webster to assess costs, Enron’s willingness to cut its rate of return, efforts to resolve disputes with MSEB, and DPC’s court challenge to the MERC order.

Scientists say a comprehensive assessment of cheetah populations in southern Africa shows the species is in dire condition and should be listed as Endangered; they note cheetahs have disappeared from 91 percent of their historic range.

The study analyzes Aedes mosquito egg counts and climate data in the Basque Country, a non-endemic region where imported mosquito-borne cases and Aedes populations have increased. Temperature showed the strongest relationship with egg abundance, while precipitation had less influence. Random Forest performed best on training data, but GLM performed best on test data, with SARIMAX also performing well; ongoing localized surveillance was highlighted as important for forecasting and control.

The speaker says the series has been closely contested, with home ice giving his team more comfort in the playoffs, and stresses that they must stay focused on execution rather than the prize. He praises his team’s effort and attitude through injuries, values the opportunity to play for the Stanley Cup, and highlights the special significance of the Red Wings, Detroit fans, and hockey history.
The author reflects on college years after graduation, saying they loved college but now see missed opportunities and things they did wrong, and introduces a list of those mistakes.

HPBOSE declared the Himachal Pradesh Class 12 result 2018 on April 24 at 14:07 pm on hpbose.org. The Class 12 examinations were held from March 6 to March 29, and students could also check results on examresults.net and indiaresults.com or via SMS using HP12ROLLNUMBER to 56263.

Seven more candidates qualified for the race to replace U.S. Rep. Tom Price in Georgia’s 6th Congressional District, bringing the total to 15 with one day of qualifying left. The special election is set for April 18, with a likely runoff on June 20.

Liverpool begin their 2017/18 Premier League season away to Watford on August 12. Key fixtures include the Merseyside derby against Everton on December 9 and April 7, Manchester United visits to Anfield on October 14 and Old Trafford on March 10, and a final home match against Brighton and Hove Albion on May 13.

A British study in Thorax found that CT lung cancer screening may help motivated high-risk smokers quit. Among screened participants, 10% quit at two weeks and 15% at two years, compared with 5% in those not invited to screening, and the researchers concluded screening can be a teachable moment for smoking cessation.

The Geminid meteor shower peaks Wednesday night and may be one of the year’s best, with up to 50 meteors visible and the best viewing between midnight and 4 a.m. Thursday. Viewing should be better in dark rural areas, no telescope is needed, and the smaller crescent moon this December should help visibility. The meteors appear in the direction of Gemini and are caused by Earth passing through debris from asteroid Phaethon.

Northwestern is nearing its first NCAA bid after upsetting Wisconsin, but coach Chris Collins and players said the team must handle growing media attention and stay focused. The Wildcats face Maryland next and will again be without Scottie Lindsey, who is missing his fourth straight game with mono.

Valmet Oyj’s Board of Directors approved a new long-term share-based incentive plan for key employees for 2018–2020 to align employee and shareholder interests. The plan targets about 120 participants, has a maximum reward of about 586,000 shares, and the 2018 reward will be based on Comparable EBITA margin and stable business orders received growth, with payment partly in shares and partly in cash in 2019.

The U.S. Geological Survey awarded $4.9 million to Caltech and six other institutions to develop the West Coast earthquake-warning ShakeAlert system and bought about $1 million in sensor equipment. The system aims to provide several seconds of advance warning, and funding concerns earlier this year were eased by $10.2 million secured for the program’s development.

A U.S. study of 202 daycare staff in Illinois found that sun safety was a low teaching priority compared with nutrition, exercise, and brushing teeth. About half of programs provided sunscreen, but most did not let children apply it themselves; spray sunscreens were sometimes used instead, though often incorrectly. The study suggests more education is needed about sun protection in early childhood programs.

A federal jury in Denver found radio host David Mueller liable for groping Taylor Swift during a 2013 preconcert photo session, awarding Swift $1 in her countersuit for assault and battery. The jury also found that Swift’s mother and manager did not interfere with Mueller’s contract, and Swift said she would donate to organizations that help sexual assault victims.

American Airlines emailed Theresa Staab a Net SAAver fares offer valid for travel the following weekend, with domestic fares for November 30–December 4, 2001 and international fares for November 29–December 4, 2001, and tickets due by November 23, 2001. The message listed domestic and international weekend getaway fares, explained how to book on AA.com, included AAdvantage award mileage options, other vacation package offers, restrictions, and unsubscribe instructions.

The author argues that touching pregnant women without consent in workplaces and courtrooms is assault, not affection, and says consent does not end with conception. Drawing on her experience as a pregnant lawyer, she calls for explicit policies, training, and cultural change to stop such conduct.

The speaker says the team has played better, managed the puck better, and is more confident after two straight wins, while focusing only on Thursday’s game. They praise their goaltender’s playoff performance, note both teams are comfortable with matchups and strong defensively, and say scoring first would help but neither team is likely to fold.
Pete Hegseth summoned hundreds of generals and admirals from around the world and argued that the military needed major changes because it had become soft and “woke.”

The passage describes SD card operations for pre-erased multiple block writes, erase, discard, FULE, write protection, password lock/unlock, Card Ownership Protection, CMD42 behavior, ACMD usage, CMD6 switch functions, CMD8, card capacity differences, CRC, timeouts, commands, responses, and state transitions.

Chris Hadfield celebrated Christmas in 2012 aboard the International Space Station by hiding family messages for his crewmates, sharing fruitcake, turkey, and other holiday items, and using decorations like a small artificial tree and stockings to maintain traditions. The passage says holidays in space, like on Earth, help people reset and focus on well-being, relationships, and psychological health.

The NVIDIA A100 GPU has a larger and faster L1 cache/shared memory unit than V100, 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, and a 40 MB L2 cache with 2.3x the L2 read bandwidth of V100. It also adds L2 residency controls and Compute Data Compression to improve bandwidth and capacity utilization.

Polling began for 69 of Uttarakhand’s 70 assembly seats amid tight security, with about 30,000 security personnel and 60,000 polling officials deployed across 10,685 booths. Over 74 lakh voters are deciding the fate of 628 candidates, while polling for the Karnaprayag seat was postponed to March 9 after the death of a BSP candidate.

The court held that evidence supported a finding of negligence by the bowling alley proprietor for the condition of the sliding floor and did not require a finding of contributory negligence by the plaintiff. Judgment was ordered for the plaintiff on the jury’s $750 verdict.

Samsung announced cheaper, water-resistant Galaxy A3, A5, and A7 smartphones, its first unveiling since the Galaxy Note 7 launch. The new phones will launch in Russia later this month, feature a 16-megapixel camera, and have less power and storage than Galaxy S models.

Camp Mystic parents, grieving children lost in the July 4 Kerr County floods, pushed Texas lawmakers to pass new camp safety bills requiring cabins out of floodplains, weather radios and alert systems, and staff emergency training, but they said the laws could not bring their daughters back.

The passage describes memory map regions, the DDR DMM TILER extended addressing map, and package pin assignments. It also explains terminal functions tables, pin multiplexing, and reset-sampled boot configuration for several GPMC-related pins.

The passage gives passport rules: only the Secretary of State may issue passports in the United States, and applicants must owe allegiance to the United States. It outlines where to apply, the affidavit and supporting evidence required, and special requirements for native citizens, naturalized citizens, women, children of naturalized citizens, and residents of insular possessions.

China launched its first talent visa to attract foreign young professionals and science and technology graduates from top universities, making it easier for them to study and do business in the country, as the US imposed a $100,000 H-1B fee.

The passage says AI and especially LLMs may change social science by improving access to large-scale data, supporting data analysis, and enabling synthesized data and novel theory generation, while also raising challenges about bias, validity, ethics, and the need for human-AI collaboration.

An international COVID-PCD study of 747 people with primary ciliary dyskinesia found wide country differences in diagnostic testing and recall. Most reported testing, but only 36% of participants older than 5 reported all three tests; more recent diagnosis was linked to more testing, while situs abnormalities were linked to fewer tests.

The Third Circuit vacated the district court’s denial of Prava Chatterjee’s petition to set aside a settlement and release of a seaman’s death claim and remanded for further proceedings. It held that Indian law governs the validity of the special power of attorney, federal maritime law governs the release, and Garrett’s careful-scrutiny standard applies to the seaman’s surviving family. The court found no error in excluding earlier Calcutta Commission testimony, but held that denying a new commission in India deprived Chatterjee of a fair trial and due process.

A federal judge upheld the Biden administration’s gainful-employment rule, rejecting a lawsuit by cosmetology schools and siding with the Education Department. The rule requires for-profit and nondegree programs to show graduates can afford loan payments and earn more than a high school graduate, with possible loss of federal aid for repeated failures, and adds new reporting requirements.

Halliburton reported first-quarter net income of $46 million, or 5 cents per share, compared with a loss a year earlier. Adjusted earnings were 41 cents per share, matching Wall Street expectations, while revenue of $5.74 billion fell slightly short of forecasts.

The passage argues that NAFTA has been highly beneficial to Canada, but the ongoing renegotiations reveal the need for Canada to strengthen its business environment and global manufacturing competitiveness. It says new trade agreements alone will not ensure prosperity, and calls for a broader plan focused on tax and regulatory reform, stronger protections against non-tariff barriers, choosing trade partners with natural ties, leveraging existing supply chains, and better support for small and medium-sized exporters.

A court deferred to July 6 the hearing on the ED chargesheet against Karti Chidambaram and two companies in the Aircel-Maxis money laundering case. The ED alleged Karti’s role in securing FIPB clearance, said the FDI was actually Rs 3,565.91 crore, and noted related payments to the companies.

Roosevelt reported on the Crimea Conference and said the Allies had made major progress toward defeating Germany and building lasting world peace. He described agreements on Germany, liberated areas, Poland, France, Yugoslavia, and a future international organization, and urged congressional and public support for these plans.

The speaker says they do not know whether the player will play tomorrow and will not reveal his status. They also say fatigue has not been a factor, the team is proud of its players, home and road games have not had a huge impact, and distractions at home may have affected some top players in the first period of last night’s game.

Pokémon GO’s Solstice Event offers 3 times the XP for catching Pokémon and for nice, great, excellent, curveball, and first throws, which can be combined with Lucky Egg for 6 times XP on catch-related actions. The passage says this makes catching Pokémon feel satisfying and efficient, while evolving gives no bonus XP, and notes the event may help casual and midcore players prepare for upcoming gameplay changes.

Theresa May faces mounting pressure ahead of a Chequers meeting, with Conservative MPs warning that failing to deliver Brexit would be catastrophic for the party. Andrea Jenkyns and Jacob Rees-Mogg urged her to keep promises to leave the single market and customs union, while Michael Gove said he expected the cabinet to agree a united position and said May had a clear plan.

The passage argues that despite a long bull market and strong earnings forecasts, changing conditions suggest higher volatility and a possible market top. It highlights rising interest rates, reduced Federal Reserve support, and sharply increased stock market volatility in 2018 as signs of growing risk.

The passage explains the Bogleheads 3 Fund Portfolio and 4 Fund Portfolio, their fund compositions, suggested allocations, and benefits such as diversification and low costs. It also notes that market conditions affect both stocks and bonds, and reports backtest results of 7.6% annual return with 28% max drawdown for the 3-fund portfolio and 7.8% annual return with 31% max drawdown for a 4-fund version.

U.S. arrivals data show 19 percent fewer international students in August 2025 than in August 2024, with especially sharp declines from Africa, Asia, the Middle East, and India. Experts say visa delays likely reduced enrollment, though September SEVIS data showed a disputed 0.8 percent increase; fuller fall data are expected in mid-November.

Guyana will host the CWWA’s 26th Annual Conference and Exhibition from October 16 to 20 at the Guyana Marriott Hotel, focusing on water, wastewater and waste management. The event is expected to draw over 250 delegates and more than 40 exhibitors, and will include ministerial discussions on regional water governance and waste management plans.

The broadcast calls for a nationwide voluntary effort to raise funds and organize relief for unemployed and needy families during the coming winter, combining local community action with federal public works and other government measures. It emphasizes mutual responsibility, generosity, and making Thanksgiving a day when America ensures no one suffers hunger or cold.

LG introduced the V35 ThinQ, a premium smartphone with a Snapdragon 845, 6GB RAM, 6-inch OLED display, dual 16MP rear cameras, 8MP front camera, IP68 rating, headphone jack, and AI features. It also includes a 3,300 mAh battery, fast charging, Hi-Fi Quad DAC, face recognition, fingerprint support, and 64GB or 128GB storage with microSD expansion. Pricing and release date were not announced.

The study found that open access and controlled access publications contribute roughly equally to the knowledge graph for drug repurposing, and their citation rates are similar. About half of all relations are supported by only one reference and are evenly distributed between the two access types. The authors conclude that additional confidence scores are needed for knowledge graph relations.

The lecture reviewed control charts as running hypothesis tests, explaining false alarms, missed alarms, average run length, and how sample size affects beta and detection of shifts. It also distinguished control limits from spec limits, introduced process capability (CP, CPK) and quality loss functions, and previewed moving average, EWMA, and cumulative sum charts for detecting smaller shifts faster.

Lawmakers are using Trump’s first State of the Union to highlight #MeToo, immigration, and other issues through guest invitations, black clothing, and boycotts. Guests include sexual assault survivor Chessy Prout, young immigrants and a border wall contractor, while some Democrats will not attend. Bill Nye will attend as Jim Bridenstine’s guest, and Rep. Joe Kennedy will deliver the Democratic response.

Managed by Q, founded by Dan Teran and Saman Rahmanian, provided on-demand office cleaning, maintenance, and supplies with a focus on transparency and high-quality service. By July 2015 it had raised $17.4 million, operated in New York, Chicago, and San Francisco, and was deciding whether to expand into more cities or grow by serving existing customers with additional services.

Iraq has begun aerial bombardment of Islamic State-held Tal Afar west of Mosul, and a ground assault is expected after the air campaign ends. Iraqi authorities had said Tal Afar would be the next target in the fight against Islamic State.

Sarahah is a free anonymous messaging app for Android and iOS that lets anyone leave messages on a user’s profile, with options to flag, delete, reply to, or favourite messages. It has become popular but polarizing, with mixed reviews and concerns about hateful comments and bullying, though it includes privacy controls such as blocking senders and limiting who can comment.

A chronological list of telegrams and dated diplomatic records from Washington, Helsinki, Kuibyshev (Moscow), Stockholm, Ankara, and London, spanning January to September 1942, with file references and receipt times.

The study examined tungsten oxidation in dry air from 400–1050°C and WO3 sublimation in synthetic air. Tungsten showed parabolic-to-linear oxidation kinetics, with edge oxidation becoming significant at higher perimeter-to-area ratios. Raman and XRD revealed an oxide scale of inner WO2, middle WO2.72, and outer WO2.9/WO3, while cracking, voids, and spalling were observed above 600°C. The WO3 sublimation rate increased with temperature, and the presence of WO2 was suggested as a possible factor in low detritiation efficiency.

The PGA848 is a high-voltage, high-bandwidth programmable gain instrumentation amplifier with eight binary gain settings from 0.5V/V to 100V/V, intended for applications such as factory automation, data acquisition, test, and semiconductor test. It can operate within 3V of either supply rail, uses ±15V input-stage supplies and a separate output supply in the example circuit, and requires careful layout, filtering, and bypassing for performance and stability.

A Missouri detective was exposed to fentanyl mixed with heroin while trying to revive an overdose victim, then developed a headache, lightheadedness, and tingling. Both the detective and the patient were taken to the hospital and are okay.

A Barrie court heard emotional reactions from the parents of 16-year-old Joey Tanner after Joseph Nicholson’s murder conviction was reduced to second-degree murder, making him eligible for parole earlier than the original 25 years. Crown attorney Ray Williams seeks a 16-year parole period, while Tanner’s family condemned the decision. Sentence will be imposed Aug. 11.

Katie Albert, a Southern Illinois University Edwardsville student studying in Florence, describes a busy semester of Italian classes, painting and drawing, cultural activities, and trips to Italian cities and several European countries. She also recounts a personal visit to Becherbach, Germany, her ancestor’s hometown, and ends by noting the approach of final exams and her mixed feelings about leaving Florence.

Australia’s childcare subsidies will change on July 2, with families needing to update Centrelink details through myGov or risk missing out. The new means- and activity-tested system replaces existing payments, with subsidy rates based on income and hours of work, study, volunteering or job seeking.

Jeffing is a run-walk-run fitness method created by Jeff Galloway in the 1970s, using planned walking breaks to make exercise easier and more manageable. It may improve aerobic endurance, reduce fatigue and injury risk, support consistency, and help beginners and experienced runners train with less stress, though poor progression or mechanics can still cause injury.

The passage surveys matroids, multinets, Orlik–Solomon and holonomy Lie algebras, resonance varieties, and hyperplane arrangements, emphasizing how these invariants reflect matroid combinatorics and topology. It also introduces key definitions, examples, and open questions about realizability, multinets, and algebraic structure.

The last trading day of the month is described as a weak stock market day with negative seasonality and poor intraday performance, especially from open to close. In SPY since 1993, buying at the second last close and selling at the last close produced an average loss of 0.06% per trade and a negative 0.8% CAGR, while the open-to-close return on that day averaged -0.11% with a 42% win ratio. There is said to be no end-of-month effect on this day.

The suicide of Sharon Haliwell led to a review of mental health assessment procedures after concerns about poor communication within North West Boroughs NHS Foundation Trust. She had reported suicidal tendencies to two services, but due to an error was not referred for counselling, and the coroner issued a prevention of death notice while noting some improvements had been made.

The speaker says that in a Stanley Cup race to four, fatigue is not a factor because adrenaline takes over, and notes the team’s experience and ability to rebound. He praises the chemistry of the Sykora-Elias-Arnott line, says physical play can help shut them down, and adds that Joe is playing well despite not scoring, with strong offensive-zone play and valuable contribution beyond goals.

Anna Ryder Richardson is leaving Manor House Wildlife Park in Wales, ending her 16-year relationship with Colin MacDougall and moving to a farmhouse in France with their daughters. She says the zoo’s stresses, costs, and public attention damaged the marriage, though she still loves the animals and plans to rebuild her life and career.

Tiffany Gholston, who was born with a heart murmur and received her first pacemaker at 20, supports the American Heart Association’s Go Red For Women campaign by staying active, eating well, meditating, and raising awareness and money for heart health research.

Hackers released more unaired HBO episodes, including “Curb Your Enthusiasm,” “Insecure,” “Ballers” and “The Deuce,” but not “Game of Thrones.” HBO said it was not communicating with the hacker and would not comment on each leak, noting the cyber incident had been widely reported and that stolen materials were being leaked in an attempt to gain media attention.
The passage is a list of article and headline titles from The 74, covering education news, student and teacher profiles, school integration, COVID and school issues, and related commentary.

The passage promotes several credit cards, led by the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, highlighting unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 spent in 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months, no annual fee, and cell phone protection. It also lists offers for the Capital One Quicksilver Cash Rewards Card and Citi card, along with disclosure statements about compensation and editorial independence.

Albert Einstein College of Medicine researchers found that exercise-induced warming suppresses appetite in mice by activating TRPV1-like receptors in proopiomelanocortin neurons in the arcuate nucleus of the hypothalamus. Capsaicin or heat activated these neurons, and blocking or removing the receptors prevented reduced food intake after treadmill exercise.

The Texas Supreme Court denied Anna Black’s writ of error in a Health Spa Act enforcement suit, while noting it was not approving the court of appeals’ distinction between witness and document identification or relieving a party of the duty to show good cause in the record under Rule 215.5.

Researchers propose using a global network of citizen scientists’ mobile phones and small radio receivers to detect fast radio bursts in the Milky Way. Phones would monitor frequencies, upload data for correlation, and help identify and locate a simultaneous radio signal that could indicate a local FRB.

McLaren says the reliability problems from pre-season testing have been fixed and it heads to the Australian season-opener confident of improvement, while noting its true pace is still uncertain and the midfield order is hard to judge.

The passage describes systems and methods for adaptive radiotherapy that update or evaluate treatment plans using real-time imaging data and extracted biological, physiological, and anatomical information. It includes use of PET, MRI, CT, SPECT, and other modalities, plan quality index and dose-volume histogram comparisons, clinician notifications, and treatment plan changes such as dose, geometry, fractionation, and session duration adjustments.

The speaker celebrates winning the Stanley Cup after eight years in the league, thanking teammates, coaches, and family for their support. He says the victory is a long-awaited dream, feels healthy and motivated to keep playing, and suggests bringing the Cup to Moscow could help Russian hockey and attract investors.

Early forecasts say viewing next Monday’s partial solar eclipse in the Philadelphia area is uncertain because of possible unsettled weather moving north; rain and clouds are expected in Virginia and south. Meteorologist Lance Frank said it is too early for a certain prediction, though forecasts from Friday should be more reliable. Philadelphia is not in the path of totality, which will occur in South Carolina.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated October 26, 2017, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2017. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and is not deemed filed under the Exchange Act.
Huddersfield began the season with a 28-16 win at Widnes after a 12-0 pre-season victory at Warrington, and coach Rick Stone wants them to build on that form ahead of their home game against Salford.

The compilation bridges the Dumbarton Oaks Proposals and the Charter of the United Nations, focusing on the United States role in shaping the UN’s legal framework and tracing policy development, negotiation, debate, and drafting from early 1945 to the Charter’s signing on June 26. It uses unpublished minutes, official records, correspondence, and other documents from several U.S. government and archive sources to show how American positions and informal agreements among major powers were developed.

NVIDIA entered into an accelerated share repurchase agreement with Barclays on March 22, 2016, as part of its plan to return $1 billion to shareholders. NVIDIA will pay Barclays $500 million and receive 12,108,715 shares, with final settlement based on NVIDIA’s stock price during the agreement term.

The coach discussed shortening third-period shifts to keep players fresh, making lineup decisions based on injuries and matchups, and protecting injury details from the media. He emphasized managing players like Hull through compromise, limiting opponents’ control of the game, and increasing physical and mental sacrifice, especially after feeling the team had not done enough in the Colorado series.

Intel shares rose 7% after a report said Intel is in early talks with AMD to manufacture chips in Intel’s foundry business. The possible deal would be a major win for Intel Foundry, but the amount of manufacturing is unclear; Intel and AMD declined to comment.

Saudi Arabia selected Exxon Mobil, Royal Dutch/Shell, BP, Phillips, TotalFinaElf, Conoco, Occidental Petroleum and Enron for three gas projects totaling about $25 billion, reopening its natural-gas sector to foreign investment. Exxon will lead Core Venture 2, while leaders for Core Ventures 1 and 3 were not yet announced.

Steven Kean said Enron’s role in the Ex-Im fight was smaller than a Wall Street Journal article suggested and aligned with its interest level; John Hardy said Enron was not leading the battle but should support agencies like Ex-Im and OPIC, with Enron negotiating on projects and needing their support.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated July 18, 2019, announcing a press release with its financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2019. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and is not deemed filed under the Exchange Act.

The Stack Offense compacts players into two stack alignments near the free throw line, keeping the ball with three handlers while two posts act as screeners. It uses continuity actions such as penetrate-and-pop, basket rolls, dribble penetration, and back cuts, with players resetting into stack alignment after each action.

This NYC secret-shopper study found that only 40% of pharmacists were aware of EPT and 30% were willing to dispense nameless EPT prescriptions, with only 46% of dispensed prescriptions following New York State guidelines. National chain pharmacies were more likely to report EPT awareness, while neighborhood socioeconomic vulnerability was associated with higher awareness but not willingness to dispense.

Keaton Jones’ viral bullying video drew widespread support and prompted Horace Maynard Middle School to plan an assembly and an anti-bullying talk. Principal Greg Clay said he was unaware of repeated bullying, the incident had already been resolved, and action was taken with the other children involved.

The passage describes hardware-aware AI/ML model searching and an ML model scaling system that selects and swaps subnets from a supernet based on real-time system, hardware, environmental, and network context. It aims to reduce resource use and data-transfer cost by choosing replacement models with the most shared pretrained parameters while maintaining performance under changing constraints.

The passage argues that globalization has created a more interconnected world and that English education should include global issues to prepare university students for international communication, cooperation, and global citizenship. It presents a Taiwan-based study of 372 adult learners who discussed topics such as global warming, health, war, culture, and technology, and largely supported integrating globalization into English curricula.

Skinimalism is a simplified skincare routine that uses a few high-quality, well-chosen products to meet the skin’s needs while protecting the skin barrier. It may reduce irritation, sensitivity, waste, and cost, but it is not suitable for everyone; people with acne, pigmentation, rosacea, or menopause-related skin changes may still need targeted active ingredients, used thoughtfully.

A single case study found that smartphone touchscreen interaction patterns changed with anti-seizure medication tapering and a focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizure. During tapering, next-interval dynamics accelerated, then reversed after medication restart; on the convulsion day, interactions slowed compared with the previous three days.

The passage describes Market Basket’s history, business model, and 2014 family and board conflict that led to Arthur T. Demoulas’s firing, a six-week employee, customer, and vendor protest, and his reinstatement with full authority. It details the company’s low-price, high-service, employee-centered operations, its family ownership disputes, the walkout’s disruption, and the eventual agreement for Arthur T. and his family to buy control of the company for $1.6 billion.

Microsoft reported quarterly results for the period ended September 30, 2018, with revenue of $29.1 billion and net income of $8.8 billion, both higher than the prior year. Revenue and operating income increased across all three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The company also reported a 14% effective tax rate, adopted new accounting guidance, and disclosed details on investments, debt, leases, contingencies, and the planned acquisition of GitHub.

Wide receivers are increasingly important in pass-heavy offenses because they create one-on-one matchup problems, run routes, catch passes, and also contribute as run blockers. Their name comes from lining up wide and receiving passes, and examples of elite receivers mentioned are Jerry Rice, Randy Moss, and Steve Largent.

The passage introduces PerovSegNet, a lightweight YOLOv8-seg-based framework for SEM image segmentation of perovskite and lead iodide films. It uses ASDCB and SAD modules to improve multi-scale feature extraction and preserve fine details, was trained on the PerovData dataset of 10,994 annotated images, and outperformed several baseline models while also enabling automated quantification of grain area and count linked to photovoltaic performance.

A University of Connecticut study found that vaping nicotine-based e-cigarettes may cause DNA damage roughly equivalent to unfiltered cigarettes, with damage increasing as puff count rises. The researchers used a low-cost 3D-printed screening device, and said they are planning further research.

The passage explains how to backtest a monthly momentum strategy in Python using sector SPDR ETFs and yfinance. Momentum is defined as the past 9-month performance, the top 3 ETFs are equally weighted each month, and the strategy’s returns are compared with SPY. It reports a 9.89% CAGR for the strategy versus 9.46% for SPY, with similar overall performance.

The Evening Star is a bearish reversal candlestick pattern made of three candles: a tall bullish candle, a small candle that gaps above it, and a bearish candle closing below the first candle’s midpoint. Traders use it to spot potential downside reversals, often confirming it with indicators, trendlines, or support and resistance levels, and they may manage trades with stop-losses and profit targets. The passage also notes that backtesting, timeframe choice, market conditions, and risk management are important, and lists risks such as false signals and market volatility.

A 92-year-old Arizona woman, Anna Mae Blessing, was charged with first degree murder, aggravated assault, and kidnapping after allegedly shooting her 72-year-old son to death in their Fountain Hills home. Authorities said the shooting followed a dispute over plans to place her in assisted living, and her son’s girlfriend disarmed her before deputies arrested her.

The passage argues that U.S. education has long borrowed business and medical models, but these have not improved student outcomes and have increased testing, stigma, segregation, and teacher insecurity. It proposes replacing these approaches with a problem-solving model centered on metacognition, student-teacher collaboration, and self-directed learning at all levels of the education system.

Leitrim is expected to get new autism units this school term, with 12 units planned across Sligo/Leitrim and Donegal, including five primary and seven post-primary classes. Since 2011, special ASD classes in Co. Leitrim have increased from two to five. Minister Richard Bruton also said special education supports have grown since 2011, and noted that school places may require a fair, non-discriminatory selection process when applications exceed available places.

The passage argues that INF deployment should proceed because abandoning it would undermine NATO and embolden anti-deployment forces in Europe. It recommends holding to the zero-zero option, deploying as scheduled if the Soviets do not change their position, and considering arms control only if the Soviets restructure their INF stance. It also reports that Shultz and Dobrynin agreed to meet regularly on U.S.-Soviet issues and that Dobrynin favored Foreign Ministers resolving major arms control problems.

The passage states that damages for unjustifiable detention or collision-related repairs should include loss of a vessel’s use, including lost profits or catch when relevant, to provide full indemnity. It cites U.S. and admiralty cases supporting compensation for detention while repairs are made and for the value of the vessel’s earning capacity.

Selenium addition to CZTS crystals hardens the crystal structure and lowers bromine-methanol etching rates compared with CZT. Experiments on crystals with y = 0, 0.02, 0.06, and 0.1 showed average etching rates of 24, 18, 15, and 13 μm/min, with the largest drop at low selenium content. The results were consistent with a proposed thermodynamic law and are relevant for processing detector elements.

Vanuatu’s regulator may investigate AFIC’s savings and loan scheme amid questions over its claims of 25,000 fully vested depositors and 30,000 partially vested, with no deposits in commercial banks. Ambae’s volcanic alert has been lowered to level 3 as activity remains confined to Lake Voui, while relief supplies are being collected for evacuees. New teacher salary scales will begin in 2018, and 21 retired teachers were awarded medals for 35 years of service.

Crystal Palace host Newcastle United at Selhurst Park, with both managers reportedly unsatisfied by the transfer window. Crystal Palace are missing several injured players, including Bakary Sako, while Newcastle may be boosted by Islam Slimani’s possible involvement. Crystal Palace have Form LDWWLD and lead scorer Milivojevic with 5 goals; Newcastle have Form LDWDLD and leading scorer Joselu with 4.

Massey University launched the second edition of The New Zealand Land and Food Annual at National Field Days, featuring 31 contributors on how New Zealand can address sustainability and lead in the green revolution. The book, edited by Professor Claire Massey, says land and food production has environmental impacts and must become more nutrition-driven and operate within planetary boundaries.

The passage reviews small-body reservoirs and exocomet sources in the Solar System and other planetary systems, emphasizing how star formation, disc chemistry, thermal conditions, host-star mass, and planetesimal formation processes shape these reservoirs. It describes dust growth, pebble collapse, debris discs, and the Oort cloud, and concludes that small-body reservoirs are likely common around main-sequence stars but evolve with planetary architecture and environment.

The SAP specifies summaries and listings for plasma concentration, plasma glucose, pharmacodynamic, safety, laboratory, ECG, and immunogenicity data by treatment group, with descriptive statistics, change from baseline, and selected figures and tables; safety analyses are based on the safety set, and TEAEs, local tolerability, rescue glucose infusion, and ADA are included.

The passage contains three State Department circulars: one says passports may be granted without a statement of intent to return within two years, though they should not be issued to persons with no intention to return; one explains that in a mission’s absence the actual first secretary normally acts as chargé d’affaires ad interim, with the Department to be consulted in emergencies; and one transmits an executive order barring diplomatic and consular officers from publicly charging or criticizing other officers except confidentially to the Department of State.

Seminary graduation exercises were held May 20 in Huber Heights for 16 Miami Valley seniors, who received certificates for studying the Book of Mormon. Mark Skouson addressed the students, and several seniors spoke about their seminary experiences.

The passage describes design selections and guidelines for a TPS7H500x-SP push-pull converter, including a 49.9 kΩ leading-edge blanking resistor, 33 nF soft-start capacitor, 2.5 transformer turns ratio, 40 μH primary inductance, 170 V primary GaN FETs, 80 V synchronous rectifier FETs, 0.47 μH output inductor, at least 1.3 mF output capacitance, 7.5 Ω current-sense resistor, 3.3 nF hiccup capacitor, 40.2 kΩ/15 nF/47 pF compensation values, and a 102 kΩ slope compensation resistor. It also gives layout and supply recommendations and notes documentation updates and revision history.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed its 2019 Form 10-K, reporting net sales of $280.5 billion, operating income of $14.5 billion, and net income of $11.6 billion. The company operates in North America, International, and AWS, and says its business is affected by intense competition, global expansion, seasonality, foreign exchange, regulation, and other risks.

Anthology Inc. lost nearly $80 million over two years and now has more than $1 billion in debt. It is restructuring with investor support, selling most of its businesses and focusing on Blackboard, after its acquisition-driven expansion and market changes made its debt unmanageable.

Janet Yellen questioned President Trump’s economic policies and opposed efforts to roll back Dodd-Frank, saying bank lending was growing, banks were well-capitalized and strong, and US banks were more resilient and profitable than before. She acknowledged burdens on community banks and suggested exempting them from the Volcker Rule, while also saying fiscal policy should support sustainable US accounts and that interest rates should rise sooner than expected.

The DAWN-plasma study is a randomized, open-label, phase 2 multicenter trial in hospitalized adults with COVID-19, comparing standard of care with standard of care plus convalescent plasma. It uses outcomes based on WHO trial templates and a 2:1 allocation, with details on rationale, amendments, and study personnel included in the protocol appendices.

Germany’s education system has been shaped by its history, is largely state-run, and includes a three-tier secondary structure. Special education developed through separate schools for students with disabilities, while inclusion has increased but remains limited, with challenges related to funding, teacher attitudes, and school structure.

The Department of Education said its employees will be affected by federal mass layoffs, but did not say how many or which offices. Sources said Office of Federal Student Aid staff would not be laid off, while cuts may affect elementary and secondary education and communications and outreach.

Angela Merkel and Mateusz Morawiecki met in Warsaw to discuss EU future, security, bilateral ties, and Poland’s rule-of-law dispute with the EU. Merkel said she hoped the talks would help resolve the standoff, while both leaders emphasized European unity and discussed a strong EU response to the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal, which Merkel said points to Russia’s responsibility.

The passage describes a patent application for FinFET and transistor structures with reduced resistivity metal gates, contact plugs, and vias. It focuses on using cobalt and/or metal silicide layers over a metal nitride barrier layer to improve adhesion, lower resistivity, and reduce corrosion compared with tungsten-based structures.

OpenAI’s Sora app, powered by Sora 2, lets users create and scroll AI-generated videos of themselves and others through a TikTok-like feed. It is iOS-only, invite-based, includes audio, and offers likeness controls and safety guardrails, though testing showed it can generate convincing deepfakes, some blocked content, and public-figure/copyright restrictions.

The passage describes the device’s Spinlock and Mailbox modules, memory maps, TILER extended addressing, and extensive pin multiplexing and terminal functions. It also outlines boot configuration via BTMODE pins, PINCNTL registers for pin control, and notes that supply pins must be connected correctly while unused input pins should be pulled to valid logic levels.

A study in the Journal of Consumer Psychology found that parents tend to favor children of the same sex: mothers more often chose daughters, and fathers more often chose sons. The results were consistent across experiments in the US and India, while most participants still said they did not prefer one child over another.

The passage describes an off-road utility vehicle with a frame, cargo box, seating area, doors, ROPS, steering, braking, front and rear suspensions, driveline, CVT cover assembly, steering column and gear selector, floorboard, and removable seat bases and foldable seat backs. It also states that, in some embodiments, the rear suspension includes a left A-arm whose pivot axis is on the right-hand side of the vehicle longitudinal centerline.

Top universities, including MIT, are using MicroMasters online programs to make some master’s degrees more affordable and to help schools identify strong applicants. Students can gain skills at lower cost, though a full degree still requires further on-campus study.

The passage discusses the urgency of a game tomorrow, strong fan support in Colorado, and memories of joining the NHL with limited English. It also reflects on playing together with Ray, the value of his trade to the Avalanche, and his leadership, work ethic, and team-first example in the dressing room.

The speaker says the team has not lost because of goaltending, believes last night’s game was one of their best in the series, and expects the team to respond. Kris Letang will not return for the series, Archie was inserted for energy and speed, and Carter Rowney has played well. The team has been adjusting lines to create better balance and secondary scoring, and believes several goals were preventable while also noting they created quality chances but did not score.

NVIDIA RTX Blackwell builds on prior NVIDIA AI technologies to improve gaming, creative, and engineering applications with greater realism, interactivity, and design capabilities. It uses neural rendering, DLSS, and ray reconstruction to boost performance and image quality at lower computational cost, and adds AI-based neural rendering and shading for generative AI workflows in games and professional 3D design. The Blackwell architecture family is named after David H. Blackwell.

The Boston zone offense, developed by Tom Davis, uses fixed player positions, a strong low-post attack, and dribble entry. It emphasizes sharp ball movement, ball reversal, skip passes, post feeds, baseline cuts, and counters to overplay and zone pressure, with specific reads for attacking 2-3, 1-2-2, and 1-3-1 zones.

Hawaiʻi is expanding preschool through charter schools, with Waikīkī Community Preschool becoming the first private program to convert to a tuition-free charter. Supporters say charter funding can help recruit and retain early educators, but current funding levels are often too low to cover staffing and facility costs.
STAT reports that enGene hired Hussein Sweiti as chief medical officer, and that he previously worked at Johnson & Johnson as global medical head, oncology clinical development.

Amazon.com, Inc. reported its May 30, 2018 Annual Meeting results: all nine director nominees were elected, Ernst & Young LLP was ratified as independent auditors for fiscal 2018, executive compensation was approved in an advisory vote, and two shareholder proposals were not approved.

The passage says day trading can be profitable, but it is difficult, requires patience, preparation, and strict discipline, and many traders fail. The author shares personal trading results from 2002 to May 2012, notes that 1% of the best days made 11% of total profits, and says market changes and algo trading made recent trading harder. It also cites poor profitability at Tuco Trading and recommends starting with swing trading.

FPIs showed strong interest in Monday’s auction for corporate bond investment limits, bidding Rs 5,898 crore against a notified Rs 3,360 crore. The cut-off bid was 15.25 basis points, compared with 1.20 basis points for G-secs, and this was the second such corporate bond auction in the fiscal year.

The Turnaround Tuesday effect is a market reversal pattern from Monday’s close to Tuesday’s close. Backtests on SPY suggest buying on weak Mondays can be profitable for about 30 years, while buying on strong Mondays is not. Adding a filter can improve the strategy.

The reciprocity treaty between Hawaii and the United States was signed in 1875 and became effective in 1876. It later led to disputes with Great Britain and Germany over treaty privileges, but these were settled diplomatically. The period also saw a domestic Hawaiian scandal, requests for U.S. help in suppressing liquor traffic in the Ralik Islands, and U.S. involvement in a Hawaii-Japan treaty.

The study used FemNoC to measure ultrafast spin fluctuations in Sm0.7Er0.3FeO3 across its spin reorientation transition. It found that qF magnon noise is enhanced when the free energy potential softens near the transition and is suppressed, while its frequency increases, under applied c-axis magnetic fields. Atomistic spin and Monte Carlo simulations reproduced these trends.

The passage describes a camera module, molded circuit board assembly, molded photosensitive assembly, molding mold, and manufacturing methods that use molding technology to mass-produce camera modules. The molded base forms a light window with sloped or stepped surfaces to reduce demolding damage and stray light, while maintaining structural strength and mounting areas for lenses, filters, and actuators.

The lecture describes manufacturing processes as geometry changes driven by directed energy exchange, using examples such as machining, molding, turning, laser processing, coating, rolling, and 3D printing. It distinguishes serial and parallel processes, noting their implications for control, flexibility, rate, cost, and quality, and introduces the framework of equipment and material states and properties as key sources of variation.

The speaker says the group is special for winning back to back despite the difficulty, and values sharing the experience with teammates, family, and friends. He credits the team’s competitiveness, willingness to do whatever it takes, strong fill-ins, veteran additions, key goaltending, and players who handled big moments, and says passing the trophy to a long-time teammate was especially meaningful.

The passage explains that neutral atoms attract through quantum effects, not classical Coulomb forces. It presents van der Waals interactions as arising from zero-point fluctuations of atomic dipoles, giving a short-range \(1/R^6\) potential, and the longer-range Casimir-Polder force as a retarded \(1/R^7\) potential due to vacuum electromagnetic field fluctuations and virtual photon exchange.

The study surveyed 63 College of Education staff at Kuwait University and found medium acceptance of AI in education, with high concern about challenges such as lack of materials, expertise, and subject complexity. Most participants had no prior teaching experience with AI, and there were no significant differences by gender, degree, or department except a gender difference in challenges and difficulties.

Sears borrowed $100 million from CEO Eddie Lampert’s hedge fund ESL Investments, which also agreed to lend up to $100 million more. Lampert and his hedge fund have loaned Sears nearly $2 billion over two years as the retailer struggles with declining sales, store closures, and competition from e-commerce.

The passage is a repeated list of financial and business headlines, followed by promotional text about PIM Capital and Pan Finance. It highlights PIM Capital’s focus on flexible fund structuring and administration for emerging markets, alternative investments, and cross-border opportunities, and notes Pan Finance’s global financial intelligence readership and media presence.

CSUSB veteran students described military tuition benefits, including active-duty tuition assistance of up to $4,500 a year, the Post-9/11 GI Bill, and the Montgomery GI Bill. The Post-9/11 GI Bill can provide up to four years of education benefits, may cover public school tuition in full, and can be used within 10-15 years after service, while the Montgomery GI Bill has tuition and expense requirements and pays based on credit load.

Pasvolsky met again with the Soviet Ambassador on January 13, 1945, to discuss Dumbarton Oaks documents, voting formulas, the Court, and dependent areas. The Ambassador reviewed open issues before leaving for Moscow, and the conversation focused especially on trusteeship and colonial questions.

R. L. Wells’s embezzlement conviction and two-year sentence were appealed, but the appeal bond was approved by a judge other than the trial judge, as required by article 904, making the bond insufficient and causing the appeal to be dismissed.

The court held that an indictment for conspiring to bribe a township trustee to employ a teacher was sufficient under the statute, even without alleging a vacant school. It also held that continuance affidavits and evidentiary objections were not reviewable because the bill of exceptions was not properly in the record, that objection to discharging a codefendant as a witness was waived, and that the appointment and action of the special judge were presumed valid. The judgment was affirmed.

The lecture introduces risk preferences using the expected utility model, discusses risk aversion, and notes that many real-life choices involve risk and insurance. It defines expected utility, risk neutrality, risk aversion, and risk lovingness, explains how economists measure risk aversion with absolute and relative risk aversion, and shows that small-scale gamble choices can imply implausibly high risk aversion for large-scale choices. It then begins describing how insurance choices can be used to estimate risk aversion.

Democrats are refusing to support a GOP spending bill unless it extends enhanced Obamacare tax credits, while Republicans say that issue can be addressed after a funding resolution. Hakeem Jeffries reiterated opposition ahead of a meeting with Trump and congressional leaders, and the government faces a shutdown at 12:01 a.m. Wednesday unless a deal is reached.

H&M said March local-currency sales rose 6%, below an earlier preliminary estimate, adding to concerns it may miss its 10-15% full-year growth target. The company has faced weaker sales, rising competition, and falling profits, while continuing to open stores and invest in a more flexible supply chain.

Microsoft’s FY 2022 10-K says it is a technology company offering software, services, devices, and solutions across Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing, with major products including Office, Azure, Windows, LinkedIn, Dynamics, Surface, Xbox, and search and advertising. The filing also describes Microsoft’s sustainability, diversity and inclusion, digital skills, human capital, operations, research and development, distribution, licensing, and executive officers, and notes that competition and cloud-based services present risks.

Amazon reported Q1 2016 net sales of $29.1 billion, up 28% from $22.7 billion, and net income of $513 million versus a $57 million loss in Q1 2015. Operating income rose to $1.1 billion, with growth in North America, International, and AWS sales. Cash and cash equivalents were $12.5 billion at March 31, 2016, down from $15.9 billion at year-end 2015, and total assets were $61.1 billion.

The U.S. has given Cambodia more than $55,000 to preserve 3,000 to 5,000 personal items from prisoners at the Khmer Rouge’s Tuol Sleng prison and torture center. The project aims to conserve the deteriorating clothing and accessories, some of which still show blood and sweat stains, and some items will be displayed at the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum.

Connor McDavid signed a two-year, $25 million extension with the Oilers, who also extended Jake Walman and coach Knoblauch. The passage also notes several NHL-related headlines and details McDavid’s career achievements and Edmonton’s recent Cup Final losses.

NVIDIA’s quarter ended April 29, 2018 showed revenue of $3.207 billion and net income of $1.244 billion, up from $1.937 billion and $507 million a year earlier. GPU revenue rose 77% and Tegra revenue 33%, while gross margin increased to 64.5%. Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $7.30 billion, and the company repurchased 3 million shares and paid $91 million in dividends.

The passage describes U.S. plans for dependent territories, including international collaboration, self-government, eventual independence on a fixed schedule, and non-discriminatory treatment, while noting British objections and later revisions before submission for approval. It also records agreement with Britain on Security Council voting and a Stimson memorandum urging great-power agreement first and warning against raising territorial or trusteeship questions during the war.

The passage describes Turing GPU features, including RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, NGX and Tensor Cores for AI-based graphics enhancements such as DLSS, and rendering technologies like mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, and multi-view rendering. It explains that these features improve performance, visual quality, and VR support, and compares Turing ray tracing performance favorably to Pascal.

The message reports Georgia surveyors entering Creek Indian territory secured by treaty, urges protection of Creek rights, and cites federal law forbidding such surveys. The President ordered civil prosecutions and warned that continued state encroachment could require federal enforcement, while asking Congress to consider further legislation.

The passage explains the ambassador pattern as a single-node pattern in which an ambassador container brokers communication for an application container, with uses including sharded backends, service brokering, and request splitting. It also introduces the adapter pattern for modifying application interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks, then moves on to replicated load-balanced services, sharded services, scatter/gather, and FaaS, describing their benefits, trade-offs, and examples.

Apple reported first-quarter fiscal 2016 net sales of $75.9 billion and net income of $18.4 billion, up from $74.6 billion and $18.0 billion a year earlier. iPhone sales were essentially flat, iPad sales declined, and Services and Other Products increased. Gross margin was 40.1%, operating income was $24.2 billion, and the company ended the quarter with $215.7 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities.

The appeal for reappraisement concerned glassware, furniture, and smoker’s articles exported from France. Based on the parties’ stipulation, the court held that foreign value under section 402(c) of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the proper basis of value, using invoice unit values plus 12.44% and packing for the invoiced merchandise, and 337 French francs each plus 12.44% and packing for the 40 excess boxes of item 21008. Judgment was to be entered accordingly.

AT&T said it will turn on LTE-M nationwide by the end of June to connect Internet of Things devices. The technology uses low power and small data amounts for items such as soda fountains, pallets and smart water meters, and AT&T is still deciding how to price access.

The speaker discusses the Detroit Red Wings’ weaknesses, the importance of power plays and every scoring chance, and says the team is prepared. He praises a player’s offense, defense, confidence, and maturity, and describes recovering from an injury while the team was losing. He says changes helped the club improve and notes the series is highly competitive, especially against the same team that beat them last year.

Tesla debuted lower-priced Model Y and Model 3 versions, with the Model Y standard priced just under $40,000 and the Model 3 standard around $37,000. The Model Y standard omits some premium features, offers 321 miles of estimated range, and costs about $5,000 less than the previous entry-level version. Tesla also released a new version of its driver assistance system, while investors remain focused on the company’s broader competition and future products.

Rock Springs City Council will hold a May 1 public hearing on ordinance amendments that would allow downtown restaurants to offer seasonal outdoor dining decks. The proposal, already approved by the Planning & Zoning Commission, includes rules on sidewalk clearance, storage, parking space rental, fire access, alcohol service, maintenance, and inspections.

A.J. Hinch said Tarik Skubal will not pitch in Game 4 of the ALDS against the Mariners, even though the Tigers face elimination. Skubal had pitched seven innings in Game 2, and is being held for a potential Game 5 on normal rest.

Lego DC Super Villains was officially announced with a trailer. The game lets players create their own super villain and work with DC villains in a parallel universe, and it will release on October 16, 2018, for PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch, with special editions available.

The passage discusses several hockey players and coaching thoughts, praising some as underrated, veteran, or leading by example, and saying team leadership and playing for the team are more important than individual pressure. It also notes that ice conditions, rest, and officiating have not changed the team’s approach, and describes one official as a respected throwback.

Pakistan has stopped work on three CPEC road projects after China halted funding, and the projects will resume only if Chinese money is received.
