A Pakistani parliamentary committee said the projects were not abandoned, while the passage notes broader concerns over Pakistan’s debt and China’s role in CPEC.

The passage advocates a graduated national inheritance tax on gifts and bequests, with heavier rates on larger fortunes and more distant kin, and supports gradual progress toward this goal. It cites earlier U.S. inheritance taxes and Supreme Court rulings upholding their constitutionality. It also discusses income tax law as more difficult constitutionally, noting past rulings, and says a constitutional amendment should be used only if legislation cannot achieve the desired result.

This retrospective study of 290 CABG patients found that older age, progressive angina, and post-myocardial infarction myocardial sclerosis were associated with more postoperative complications and longer ICU/total hospitalization. Hydrothorax was the most frequent complication and was linked to low BMI, longer CPB and aortic cross-clamp times. The number of shunts or internal thoracic arteries used was not significantly associated with complication number.

Coach Sutter said the team values complete, tenacious two-way players, preparation, leadership, and trust over individual star power. He praised several players for consistency, competitiveness, and strong play, noted the team has matured but is still young, and said they are in the Stanley Cup Final and may need to play again tomorrow.

The passage discusses a team’s playoff success, home confidence, and ability to handle adversity, with praise for John as a key defensive leader after Bobby Holik left and others had to step up. It also mentions injuries, travel, roster changes, winning the Stanley Cup, and uncertainty about calling the team a dynasty while expressing hope for continued success.

A creditor’s accounting action against assignees for creditors was held not to be an “action for money received” in a fiduciary capacity under section 179 of the Code, so the assignee could not be arrested. The court affirmed judgment for false imprisonment because the execution against the plaintiff’s person was unauthorized.

America Saves Week, coordinated by America Saves and the American Savings Education Council, is an annual campaign since 2007 that promotes good savings behavior and helps people assess their savings. America Saves Week 2017 will run from February 27 to March 4 and include daily themes, engagement activities, and resources for participants.

JonnyPops began in 2011 when St. Olaf student Erik Brust, honoring his cousin Jonathan Jeffrey, developed a frozen treat made with fruit, real cream, cane sugar, and salt. After early sales in Minnesota, the company expanded through manufacturing, food service distribution, and grocery retail, reaching 10,000 distribution points nationwide. Brust and Connor Wray later took the company full-time, launched a new Delights line of flavors, and supported a social mission called Better Pop for a Better World, including messages on sticks and fundraising for addiction treatment organizations.

Jensen Huang said Nvidia will continue sponsoring H-1B visa employees despite Trump’s new $100,000 fee, which could cost the company an estimated $147.3 million for 2025 approvals. Huang said legal immigration remains essential and praised immigrant workers.

Several analysts changed price targets on Friday, October 6th, including increases for AdvanSix, Deckers Outdoor, New Oriental Education, Netflix, Plug Power, Constellation Brands, 2U, and Yum China, and decreases for Ascena Retail Group and Rite Aid. BNP Paribas issued new targets for Covestro, Basf, Evonik, Linde, Lanxess, and Wacker Chemie, while other new targets were set for Costco, Inovio, Eli Lilly, and Mallinckrodt.

The speaker thanks citizens for reelection, reviews the nation’s postwar defense, foreign relations, finances, and westward growth, and states plans to continue peace, neutrality, revenue measures, fortifications, naval strength, and policies toward Indian tribes.

This review aims to assess the relationship between serial PCR Ct values or other viral burden measures and infectious SARS-CoV-2 in transplant recipients, using studies with viral culture from respiratory samples. It will search multiple databases through December 31, 2021, include primary studies on solid organ or hematopoietic stem cell transplant patients, exclude studies without viral culture or using only post-mortem or non-respiratory samples, and present findings narratively rather than pooling data.

The passage mourns the death of the President and notes that his constitutional successor is peacefully installed, showing the strength of popular government. It says the new President will carry forward the late President’s aims, while the country remains prosperous, at peace, and without need for an unusual congressional session.

Lincolnshire County Council approved a new care leavers strategy and says it will continue supporting vulnerable young care leavers with legal and practical help beyond age 18, including council tax discounts, university costs and driving licences. The leaving care services budget is about £1.2 million, with more than 600 people in care and 300 in leaving care services.

A fossil from southwestern China shows Dinocephalosaurus, a 245-million-year-old marine reptile, with an embryo inside, indicating it gave birth to live young. The find suggests this archosauromorph was fully marine and provides new evidence about vertebrate reproduction.

The Farmers State Bank of Craig sued Samuel J. Lydick on a $3,000 promissory note. Lydick claimed fraud and lack of consideration in connection with prior notes and stock purchases involving the Missouri Valley Cattle Loan Company and Everett J. Martin. The trial court withdrew one cross-petition issue, submitted others to the jury, and the jury found for the bank and for Martin. The court held the evidence and instructions proper and affirmed the judgment, including that the bank could be a holder in due course.

James Schenck, PenFed Credit Union president and CEO, was named Large Business Philanthropist of the Year by Volunteer Alexandria. The passage highlights PenFed’s charitable support for veterans, military families, and community programs, its role in the Alexandria Business Philanthropy Summit, and Schenck’s volunteer and leadership record.

Prime Day 2 starts October 7 and 8, with early deals already available; the passage highlights discounted WIRED-approved gear including an Apple iPad, Apple MacBook Air, Arlo Pro 5S security camera, Kindle Scribe, and several power banks, headphones, keyboards, and accessories.

China has modernised the People’s Liberation Army for two decades to build hard power, support regional and global interests, protect economic routes and projects, and counter US influence. The PLA has become a modern fighting force, contributing to a more assertive China, though the long-term outcome remains unclear.

North Korea’s defaulted debt, once viewed as a speculative frontier-market opportunity, has become harder to trade after new U.N. sanctions and rising tensions with the United States. The debt, repackaged in 1997 as NK Debt Corporation securities, has not been traded in years, and investors now expect little progress on restructuring or repayment.

Latin American stocks rebounded on Monday as tensions eased between the United States and North Korea, with Mexico’s IPC up 1.1% and Brazil’s Bovespa reaching its highest level since May. Currency moves were modest, with the Mexican peso firmer and the Brazilian real mixed ahead of a fiscal goal revision.

The passage describes a modular, AI-driven framework for synchronous XRD and XAFS experiments at NSLS-II, using human-in-the-loop adjudicators, Bluesky infrastructure, and Bayesian optimization agents. It was demonstrated on Al-Ni-Pt combinatorial thin films and a digital twin, where AI-driven mapping outperformed conventional grid sampling in resolving phase boundaries and localized features.

Let’s Grow Kids was created in 2015 to spend 10 years building Vermont’s child care infrastructure and then sunset in 2025. Leaders say the deadline helped it raise over $70 million, attract staff and partners, support Act 76, and leave implementation to permanent organizations and an action network.

Court documents say a Facebook argument between Jennifer Bartell’s daughter and Albany Pierce escalated into a planned meeting, then a fight outside Bartell’s home, where Joshua Bowen allegedly shot Bartell on March 14. Bowen, Pierce, her mother Shaunicka Cooley, and Shyrayno Jackson were arrested, with Pierce, Cooley, and Jackson charged as accessories after the fact. Neighbors said they were shocked, and investigators said the shooting was tied to an ongoing dispute rather than a random attack.

A federal judge ruled that Nirvana’s 1991 album cover showing a naked baby underwater is not pornography and dismissed Spencer Elden’s 2021 lawsuit over the image, saying it was not lascivious and was most like a family photo of a nude child bathing.

A Florida Museum study found that lice parasitizing primates and humans have continuously hosted bacterial symbionts for at least 20 to 25 million years. The bacteria provide essential vitamins, have tiny remodeled genomes, and the coevolution of lice and symbionts may help illuminate primate and human evolutionary history.

A new study using deep learning on more than 50,000 satellite images found that Martian dust devils and winds can reach up to 44 m/s, or about 160 km/h, much faster than previously assumed and important for lifting dust into Mars’s atmosphere and informing future missions.

In 54 adults newly diagnosed with ADHD, resting-state nucleus accumbens connectivity at diagnosis and after about three years was associated with symptom severity and symptom change. Lower connectivity with the right paracingulate gyrus correlated with higher baseline symptoms, and lower connectivity with the right insular cortex predicted better long-term improvement. Connectivity patterns differed by stimulant treatment status at follow-up.

A state audit found Utah’s alcohol department overcharged businesses $1,161 on seven incorrectly marked-up products and lost $186 on nine sales, and it plans to refund the overpayments. The audit also found the department failed to transfer $4.6 million in required revenue to school lunch and public safety programs in November 2017, but corrected the error after it was discovered.

The passage describes the 1793 yellow fever epidemic in Philadelphia, its mosquito transmission, and the later discovery that mosquitoes spread the disease. It also says Brazil has had a major yellow fever outbreak since December 2016, that an effective vaccine exists, and that Penn researchers are developing Zika vaccines using DNA and mRNA technology.

Rachael Caplan has severe CRPS, leaving her bedridden and unable to leave the top floor of her parents’ home. After a delayed diagnosis, she has tried many treatments with limited success and now uses her story and social media efforts to raise awareness of the disease and hope for better treatment or remission.

Gulf Island Fabrication trades at a large discount to book value after a sharp share-price decline, driven by weak offshore markets and operational problems. The company has no major debt, is selling non-core Texas facilities near book value, and has shipbuilding and other potential contract opportunities that could support future growth.

The passage describes QoCGM, an open-source MATLAB tool for preprocessing CGM data and deriving metrics including descriptive statistics, TIR, glycemic risk, variability, control, and entropy/complexity measures, with options for night/day analysis and missing-data handling. A case study in 324 insulin-treated T2DM participants found substantial overlap among many metrics, while some, including day-to-day TIR variation, Mobility, and DTpM, showed low R² with others and may capture unique information.

Dunkin' Donuts will launch fall-inspired menu items on Aug. 28, including pumpkin, maple pecan, and maple sugar bacon products. The company says seasonal flavors help drive customer interest and sales, and its limited-time offerings have recently boosted performance.

Sarasota County sought review of a declaratory statement on whether a proposed crude oil splitter in Manatee County was a development of regional impact under Chapter 380. The court denied certiorari, holding the County lacked standing and was not among the entities authorized to initiate the DRI process. A special concurrence said the County had other possible avenues for relief, while a dissent would have granted review and remanded for reconsideration of the declaratory statement.

The speaker said a player was just given a day off, noted the team needs to improve second periods after games in Boston, and stressed making every shift count. He said two players are playing better than their point totals show, praised their goaltender and defense, and said the team will focus on one game at a time and execute its plan. He also said the group is ready for the challenge of winning the trophy.

The passage argues that after the war, European statesmen will focus on securing materials and conditions needed for recovery, since demobilization may cause unrest or economic crisis. It says Germany’s ability to dominate the Near East and eastern Europe depends on access to supplies from the outer world, which the blockade limits. It also describes two German imperialist approaches: one favoring accommodation to secure supplies, and the other favoring military control, with Belgium as the central issue.

ICICI Bank said its mortgage loan portfolio has crossed Rs 1.5 trillion, making it the largest private player in the segment, and it aims to reach Rs 2 trillion by FY20. The bank said growth is coming mainly from tier II and III towns and is also expanding digitisation and loan processing centres.

The study fit a mechanistic model to England vaccine effectiveness data for AZD1222, BNT162b2, and mRNA-1273 against Delta and Omicron BA.1/BA.2, estimating immune waning, boosting, and a 6.5-fold Omicron reduction in immune level. It found higher protection against severe outcomes than mild disease, waning over time, and that bivalent boosters may provide more durable protection than original vaccines.

A survey of 2,000 British adults found the average Brit wakes three times a night, and one in 10 wakes 7 to 10 times. Common reasons include needing the toilet, discomfort, snoring, being pushed to the edge of the bed, tossing and turning, bedroom noise, phone light, TV or reading, bad dreams, and anxiety. A psychologist said sleep hygiene and sleep cycles affect sleep quality, and factors like snoring, noise, and discomfort can prevent returning to sleep smoothly.

The passage says Larry Connors’ R3 is a mean-reversion strategy from *High Probability ETF Trading* with rules based on the close being above the 200-day moving average, a three-day decline in the 2-day RSI, entry when the 2-day RSI is below 10, and exit when it is above 70. Backtests on ETFs showed positive results, including 992 trades, a 75% win rate, a 0.68% average gain per trade, a 2.08 profit factor, 6.47% CAGR, and a maximum drawdown of -16% in August 2011.

Afrinvest said N62.4 billion in 91-day and 182-day Treasury bills and N168.1 billion in OMO maturity will hit the market this week, while last week liquidity remained tight, rates rose sharply, and Treasury bill, bond, and forex market performance was mixed. The CBN continued FX interventions, the naira was mostly stable, and the Bankers’ Committee said the I&E window attracted $4 billion since April.

Six Texas public university systems have ordered reviews of curriculum, syllabi, and course descriptions after conservative criticism over teaching gender identity. Texas A&M, North Texas, Texas, Houston, and Texas Woman’s University are among those reviewing courses, while public syllabi accessed through Simple Syllabus have also exposed faculty to targeting.
The Eighth Circuit denied Earl Ringo’s petition for rehearing en banc and the panel rehearing petition; Judge Bye would have granted en banc rehearing, and Judge Benton did not participate.

The study reports that COVID-19 mRNA booster vaccination increased insulin resistance and worsened glucose control in pre-diabetic and diabetic subjects, while immune responses remained similar across groups. In mice, repeated vaccination impaired glucose tolerance and insulin signaling, and metformin alleviated these effects without reducing vaccine-related immune protection.

Love in the Time of Chasmosaurs is a dinosaur-focused website featuring scientific reports, paleoart, book and media reviews, and museum visit reports. Active since 2009, it posts regularly and is noted for its educational, humorous, and often snarky tone.

Olivia Munn said a two-minute lifetime risk assessment led to her stage 1 breast cancer diagnosis at 43, despite a clear mammogram and no symptoms. She said the assessment should be standard care, and it also led to her mother’s stage 1 breast cancer diagnosis.

Hugh Jackman said he is undergoing another treatment for basal cell carcinoma, posting a photo with a bandage over his nose and noting that frequent body checks and doctors have kept him well. He has been treated for the skin cancer at least four times before, first in November 2013, and his recent diagnosis has not slowed his film projects.

Doug Ford launched his Progressive Conservative election campaign at the Toronto Congress Centre amid enthusiastic support from party members and candidates. He promised to unite the party, take on Premier Kathleen Wynne and the Liberals, and bring prosperity to Ontario, while attendees acknowledged the campaign would be difficult.

Stan Lee was hospitalized after experiencing shortness of breath and an irregular heartbeat, but his representative said he is now out of the hospital, doing well, and feeling good. His condition remained stable, and the visit was described as a precaution.

Valeant Pharmaceuticals said it, J. Michael Pearson, Pershing Square Capital Management and William Ackman entered a litigation management agreement covering the pending California class action and related Allergan litigation, with a Nov. 1, 2017 termination date if no settlement stipulation is executed; it also includes fee-sharing, a forbearance commitment by Pershing Square, and a mutual release of claims.

The passage discusses playoff and Stanley Cup Final preparation, emphasizing routine, teamwork, and focus rather than changing habits for the bigger stage. It describes the emotional significance of winning, the sacrifices behind the achievement, injuries and pain some players managed or played through, and appreciation for teammates, families, coaches, and fans, especially after finally finishing the series.

The study compared 101 cardiomyopathy patients with 101 healthy controls and found significantly higher CRP, TNF-α, MDA, GPX, and NT-proBNP levels in patients, with several significant correlations between inflammatory and oxidative stress markers. It concludes that inflammatory and oxidative stress indicators are correlated in cardiomyopathy patients but not in normal controls.

Severe storms with tornadoes damaged homes and trees across the Southeast, with at least three confirmed tornadoes in northern Alabama and no reported injuries in Limestone County. Forecasters warned of possible strong tornadoes, damaging winds and large hail, prompting school closures, campus suspensions and safety alerts in Alabama and nearby states.

Premier Li Keqiang said China will further open its economy, allow foreign and domestic firms to compete equally, increase access in services and manufacturing, lower import tariffs, and better protect intellectual property, amid global trade war concerns and looming US tariffs.

BNP Paribas Investment Partners S.A. corrected a major holding notification for Amadeus FiRe AG, stating that on 09 Feb 2017 its voting rights fell to 4.99% (259,295 shares) from 5.003%, with no instruments held.

At Huntington University Hospital, Dr. Frank Young led a blood conservation project to cut cardiac surgery transfusions by two-thirds in one year, lowering costs and improving outcomes. He faced resistance because cardiac surgery teams were loosely aligned, surgeons had little formal control over staff, and many veterans saw no need to change existing transfusion practices.

Ajman’s ruler issued a decree reducing the tourism tax on hotels and tourism companies from 10% to 7% to promote tourism and improve the investment environment. The reduction takes effect immediately and lasts until December 31.

The SAP defines sample sizes of 20 dasiglucagon, 10 placebo, and 10 GlucaGen patients, with primary efficacy based on the FAS and safety on the safety set. The primary endpoint is time to plasma glucose recovery, analyzed with Kaplan-Meier methods and stratified log-rank testing; secondary endpoints include recovery rates and glucose changes at 10, 15, 20, and 30 minutes. It also specifies detailed statistical, PK/PD, safety, and QC analysis procedures, including handling of missing data and adverse events.

Meb Faber’s Three-Way Model allocates equally among stocks, bonds, and gold, holding an asset when its monthly 3-bar moving average is above its 10-bar moving average. The passage says the strategy is still working, returned 13% annually from 1971 to 2015, and in a backtest from 2006 to the present reached 422,000 from 100,000 with an 8.9% CAGR and 18% max drawdown.

The passage defines soccer passing directions terminology, describing common pass paths relative to the player and field, including forward, back, angled, diagonal, lateral, square, wide, long, short, and terms such as center, switch fields, reverse field, near post, far post, and outlet.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 31, 2017, announcing a press release and data sheet on its first fiscal quarter 2016 financial results, ended December 31, 2016.

Mark Haedicke asked to be removed from the e-mail list, and the message also contained the State Bar of Michigan e-Journal for October 25, 2000, including case summaries, classifieds, news, and event listings.

Samsung Galaxy J5 Prime, unveiled in India at Rs 14,900, has started receiving an Android 7.0 Nougat OTA update in the UAE. The update is over 1GB and adds features including improved multi-window usability, notifications, quick settings, dual messenger, stricter app permissions, new emoji, better battery optimisation, bug fixes, stability improvements, and speed optimizations. The phone has a 5-inch HD TFT display, 13MP rear camera, 5MP front camera, quad-core 1.4GHz processor, 3GB RAM, 32GB storage, 4G support, and a 2400 mAh battery.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPU architecture, including ROPs moved into the GPC, an SM redesign with doubled FP32 throughput, third-generation Tensor Cores, second-generation RT Cores, larger L1/shared memory, GDDR6X memory, RTX IO, and improved video encode/decode. It also highlights performance gains in ray tracing, AI, motion blur, power efficiency, and data center and workstation GPUs such as the A40 and RTX A6000.

Peloton launched five AI-powered fitness products, including updated bikes, treadmills, and a new rowing machine, with Peloton IQ coaching features and other upgrades. The company also raised equipment prices and monthly membership fees as part of a comeback effort under CEO Peter Stern, while its stock remained down sharply overall.

U.S. stocks fell sharply Friday, with the Dow dropping more than 650 points and slipping below 26,000. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined, and the Dow had its worst week in two years. Investors sold off on fears that a stronger-than-expected jobs report and accelerating wage growth would lead the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates more than expected.

RaySearch and Eckert & Ziegler BEBIG signed a partnership to integrate RayStation and RayCare with Eckert & Ziegler BEBIG brachytherapy systems, enabling a complete brachytherapy solution. The companies said the cooperation supports better integration of brachytherapy into modern radiation therapy workflows.

The 48-inch LG C4 OLED is at its lowest-ever Amazon price of $800 for Prime Day. The TV offers strong picture quality, gaming features like VRR up to 144 Hz on four HDMI inputs, webOS, and a slim design with a center-mount pedestal stand.

The passage studies radiation damage in phlogopite using the XTANT-3 code. It finds that hydrogen migration starts at about 0.17 eV/atom, Mg becomes liquid-like near 0.4 eV/atom, full disorder occurs above 0.5 eV/atom, the bandgap collapses around 0.9 eV/atom, and higher doses cause strong nonthermal acceleration, especially of K and O.

The passage compares Winthrop Center and 425 Park Avenue as risky sustainable building projects, focusing on developer decisions, market acceptance, tenant strategy, and cost premiums. Winthrop Center faced weak green premium recognition, lost a tenant, suffered COVID-related financing disruption, and later gained support from regulation and education. 425 Park Avenue pursued a healthy-building strategy with WELL-related features, significant uncertainty over costs and rent premium, and ultimately achieved a record lease but later faced financial distress and delay.

The lecture reviewed utility from beliefs, overoptimism, and anticipatory utility, showing that people may prefer rosy beliefs because they feel better now, but such beliefs can distort decisions and cause disappointment. It then discussed evidence of overconfidence and motivated beliefs in self-assessments and choices, including lab experiments and real-world behavior. The second half covered Bayesian learning and common errors in probabilistic judgment, especially the gambler’s fallacy, hot-hand fallacy, and base-rate neglect, followed by an introduction to heuristics such as representativeness and availability.

The coach said the team was not good enough in its last game, citing weak offense, physical play, speed, defense, and specialty teams, and said they must play better tomorrow. He expressed confidence in Michael and expected strong games from Mike Richards and Jeff, praised a player’s professionalism, and said he focuses on what his team can control rather than the opponent’s lineup.

The speaker praised Oskar’s smartness, timing, and work ethic, and said the line has good chemistry and communication. They said the team has improved through each series, wants to keep its foot on the gas in the best-of-three, and needs to keep improving, with some help from big saves by Binner.

The passage explains that topological insulator lasers use protected edge states to let light travel with minimal scattering from defects, making the laser more efficient and stable. Experiments showed that lasers in the protected state kept working even when rings were removed and did not develop extra colors at higher power, unlike unprotected lasers.

Law enforcement has spent two years planning security for Super Bowl LII in Minneapolis, with the Minneapolis Police Department leading and multiple federal, state, local agencies and more than 400 National Guard members assisting. Plans include extensive screening, indoor prescreening at locations like Mall of America, a heavy police and tactical presence, and counterterrorism and credential checks for over 30,000 people.

The passage calls for reorganizing Alaska’s government and supports the Alaska Yukon Pacific Exposition as a means to develop Alaska and Pacific trade. It argues that nations should act with fairness and ethical standards, and that immigrants lawfully in the country should be treated with justice and good will. It also condemns hostility toward Japanese people in the United States, praising Japan’s achievements and urging equal and courteous treatment.

The study reported a few temporary drops in lymphocyte counts after Dose 1 in Phase 1, which returned to normal by 6 to 8 days and did not occur after Dose 2. Injection site reactions and systemic events within 7 days were usually mild or moderate and resolved quickly. Most medical problems within 1 month after Dose 2 or booster doses were mild or moderate, with no single problem occurring in more than 2 participants in Phase 1; some serious medical problems occurred in later phases, but researchers generally did not believe they were related to the study vaccine. No deaths occurred in Phase 1, and deaths in Phase 2/3 were not believed to be caused by BNT162b2.

Waterstone Financial’s news coverage was rated positive by Accern, with a sentiment score of 0.26 and an impact score of 45.63, suggesting limited near-term stock impact. Recent brokerage actions included a downgrade by BidaskClub and an upgrade by Sandler O’Neill, which also lowered its price target to $20. The stock fell 0.26% to $19.45, and the company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.12 per share.

The lecture discusses neutral particle diagnostics for measuring ion distributions in plasma cores, where direct methods fail. It explains neutral production by charge exchange with edge neutrals or neutral beam injection, neutral transport losses from ionization and charge exchange, and why low-density plasmas are needed for neutrals to escape. It also covers passive and beam-based diagnostics, charge exchange recombination spectroscopy, beam emission spectroscopy, and the motional Stark effect for magnetic field reconstruction.

Toyota and ChassisCo faced major quality, sourcing, logistics, and problem-solving failures in the Athens plant for the 2003 Suprima rear suspension cradle launch. Toyota had expanded ChassisCo’s responsibility, but ChassisCo lacked adequate project management, supplier tracking, staffing, and technical capability, while Toyota’s support and oversight were insufficient for the complexity. By late 2004, the plant had low output, high defects, frequent overtime, and significant risk to the vehicle program.

Researchers at McGill University developed DOLPHIN, an AI tool that detects previously hidden disease markers inside single cells. In pancreatic cancer data, it found more than 800 markers missed by conventional tools and distinguished aggressive from less severe cases.

The passage says the S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and 7.8% year to date, but slipped 1.6% on the first day of August. It notes that market momentum remains intact overall, while short-term technical conditions are weakening and volatility and credit spreads are turning up seasonally.

The passage describes radiotheranostics, PBPK modeling, and the need for verification, validation, and uncertainty quantification (VVUQ) in radiopharmaceutical therapies. It explains PBPK model components, development approaches, and methods for internal and external validation, sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty assessment. It also discusses challenges in extending PBPK models to dynamic theranostic digital twins and notes that regulatory frameworks for PBPK models in radiopharmaceuticals are still lacking.

The speaker says the two teams are similar, both good hockey teams, and stresses consistency, rebounding, and sticking to a simple team game plan. He notes the opponent has dangerous scorers and speed, but says they are not just a one-line team. He also says Larry’s coaching advice is convincing and important, and emphasizes staying patient and not altering the game plan during the playoffs.

The coach said he believes in his players despite ups and downs, praised their focus on the present, and stressed that the team must bring its best against San Jose. He credited the group’s trust, defense, and closeness, and highlighted Phil as a consistent two-way contributor whose game improved in the second half of the season.

Alibaba Group Holding Limited is downgraded from Buy to Hold as its shares near fair value after a strong rally. AI and cloud computing are driving recent growth, while e-commerce and international segments show solid revenue growth. However, profitability remains pressured by heavy reinvestment, making the current valuation more cautious despite a discount to U.S. peers.

The passage introduces a framework for evaluating and improving LLMs’ persuasive capabilities using Bayesian persuasion. It defines persuasion as strategic information disclosure, proposes measures such as persuasion gains and conditional mutual information, constructs opinion-change benchmarks from human persuasion datasets, and reports that stronger models and reinforcement learning can increase persuasion gains and transfer across receiver architectures.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2015 announcing its first quarter 2015 financial results and reporting a change to three operating segments effective Q1 2015: North America, International, and AWS.

The speakers say their playoff success depends on team play, patience, strong defense, and minimizing mistakes, not individual blame. They emphasize good communication, sacrifice, and confidence, and note that Claude’s dirty work and Jason’s leadership are valuable to the team.

The Clock is a simple, easy-to-teach zone offense using a 1-3-1 free lance passing attack with basic rotation rules. It features corner pass, ball reversal, dribble clear, and continuity actions, and aims to create open outside shots, basket cuts, and post rolls. The passage also gives options against 1-3-1 and 1-2-2 zones, a 2-1-2 “Cat” counter for double teams, and “Crunch Time” specials called Vegas and Back.

The passage criticizes unnecessary government printing costs, notes progress in expanding the merit system and urges extending it to the District of Columbia and consular appointments, and says the White House has been restored to its original design. It also includes State Department circulars on passport rules, directing officials to assess intent to return and to deny protection only to those who have effectively abandoned U.S. citizenship or residence.

The passage describes design figures for an exercise apparatus, including perspective, front, rear, top, bottom, and side views. It notes that opposite sides are mirror images and that broken or break lines indicate portions not included in the claimed design.

Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies have fallen sharply, and several related stocks have also declined. Long Blockchain, formerly Long Island Iced Tea, abandoned a planned bitcoin mining equipment purchase and will focus on a merger with Stater Blockchain after its stock dropped nearly 55% from an initial surge. Riot Blockchain, LongFin, and Nodechain have also seen significant share declines this year.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing TU102 GPU as the highest-performing Turing GPU, detailing its architecture, memory system, NVLink interconnect, and SM design. It also explains Turing features such as RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, Tensor Cores for AI and inference, enhanced video and display engines, Mesh Shading, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, and support for VR and NGX technologies.

The passage is an October 15, 2001 Baker & McKenzie Global Employment Law Alert summarizing employment-law developments worldwide, including privacy, pensions, discrimination, unions, labor disputes, layoffs, minimum wage changes, immigration, and workplace safety across multiple regions and countries.

On August 31, 2016, Tesla subsidiaries entered into a Loan and Security Agreement with Deutsche Bank AG that allows borrowing up to $300 million to support Tesla Finance’s direct vehicle leasing program. The facility ends for new draws on August 31, 2017, matures on September 20, 2018, and was unused as of August 31, 2016. The obligations are secured by lease contracts and related leased vehicles, bear interest based on LIBOR or other reference rates, and include customary defaults, covenants, reserve, and fee requirements. Tesla is not a guarantor, and the agreement is expected to reduce Tesla’s cash needs, public fundraising, and stockholder dilution.

The passage describes NVIDIA Blackwell features including DLSS 4 Multi Frame Generation, which can generate up to three additional frames per rendered frame, and transformer-based DLSS models that improve image quality, stability, and motion detail. It also outlines neural shaders and RTX Neural Materials, Texture Compression, Radiance Cache, Skin, and Neural Faces, and lists Blackwell GPU specifications for GB202, GB203, and GB205, including GeForce RTX 5090, 5080, 5070 Ti, and 5070.

The passage defines equality and equality of opportunity, explains education and equality of opportunity in education, and identifies economic, geographical, political, individual, and social factors affecting it. It also outlines Turkey’s education policy context and recommends improving access, quality, teacher preparation, and early childhood education to support equal opportunity.

Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl LX halftime show has sparked backlash from right-wing figures over his Spanish-language music, criticism of Trump, and anti-ICE stance. The passage says the controversy reflects culture-war politics, while the NFL views the choice as a business move to reach younger and more global audiences.

A variable multiplexer for vehicle communication bus compatibility is described. The external device detects connection to a vehicle bus, determines the vehicle’s pinout using a VIN sent to a remote system or by listening to bus data and checking known configurations or checksum values, then configures the multiplexer to match the pinout so a single cable can work with different vehicles.

The passage explains that patterns help identify reusable components and improve software quality. It then introduces single-node container patterns: sidecars augment applications, ambassadors broker access to external services such as sharded backends or experiments, and adapters normalize interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks. It also begins the discussion of distributed systems, including replicated load-balanced services, caches, SSL termination, and sharded services, emphasizing scalability, reliability, and choosing appropriate shard keys.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture and RTX 50 Series features, including higher INT operation throughput, more texture units, GDDR7 memory with built-in ECC, new Tensor Core FP4/FP6 support, improved RT Cores, Mega Geometry, Linear Swept Spheres, SER 2.0, AMP scheduling, enhanced video/display capabilities, power efficiency improvements, DLSS 4, and several neural rendering technologies.

The passage says the team must fight through a hard-working opponent, play with full effort, and rely on everyone doing their job rather than trying to be individuals. It also says the opponent’s speed, defensive activation, and hunger have been key differences, while a skilled player is described as gifted and difficult to predict.

NVIDIA GPUs have evolved into a leading parallel processing engine for gaming, content creation, HPC, datacenter, and AI applications. Turing introduces a new architecture that improves efficiency and performance, combining rasterization, ray tracing, AI, and simulation, with enhanced shader execution and GDDR6 memory support. Tensor Cores enable new deep learning-based Neural Services for graphics effects.

Reverse Action Offense, introduced by Pete Newell in the late 1950s, is a guard-around continuity offense built on precise execution, off-ball post screens, and multiple counters to defensive overplays. It can begin from many entries and includes guard-around actions, sideline triangle play, post isolation, back cuts, and quick-hit special options.

The passage explains how soccer defensive walls are built, when they are used, and the relevant Laws of the Game. It says the goalkeeper usually decides the wall size and positioning based on ball location, with defenders forming shoulder-to-shoulder to block part of the goal on free kicks. It also describes referee procedures, player responsibilities, traditional and non-traditional wall-setting methods, special cases such as kicks from less than 10 yards, and several coaching tips.

Tesla reported that CFO Deepak Ahuja intended to retire after seven years, would remain until transition and help select a successor. At the June 9, 2015 annual meeting, stockholders elected Antonio J. Gracias and Kimbal Musk as Class II directors, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor, and rejected two stockholder proposals by Mark Peters and Elizabeth Farrell Peters.

Indian financial institutions fixed Dabhol Power Company's reserve price at $700 million and discussed a package involving tariff cuts, lender and equity-holder concessions, MAT exemption, mega power status, and separation of the LNG facility. Tata Power and BSES began due diligence and sought distribution rights as part of the proposed sale. MSEB declined to attend the Houston board meeting, while court orders restrained DPC from issuing a final termination notice and barred encashment of customs guarantees.

The reverse play is a football trick play designed to deceive the defense by sending the ball one way before a player carries or tosses it back in the opposite direction. The passage describes traditional reverses, fake reverses, reverse screens, and reverse pass plays, using examples from the Panthers, Cardinals, Purdue, and a reverse pass touchdown, and notes that offensive linemen help by sealing off defenders.

Packers coach Mike McCarthy said Damarious Randall has had an outstanding offseason and stood out at nickel/star during OTAs and minicamp. Randall is trying to rebound from a difficult second season and could play a key slot role, with McCarthy saying his game is already speaking for itself.

The passage discusses industrial technology trends, emphasizing data visualization, digital twins, and high-performance computing (HPC). It says cloud-based engineering workstations and AR/VR can improve collaboration, while digital twins can support monitoring, simulation, and new business models such as Product as a Service. It also argues that HPC is becoming essential for complex simulation and data analysis, with external, cloud, and HPCaaS models offering scalability, flexibility, cost optimization, and support for future innovation.

The Kansas Supreme Court affirmed summary judgment for Farmway Credit Union, holding that it could exhaust its security interest in the decedent’s collateral after his death without filing a probate claim or foreclosing in district court. The court also rejected the administrator’s argument that summary judgment was premature.

Counter is a football run play that shows Power in one direction before redirecting the runner the opposite way. Its strengths are creating confusion against aggressive defenses and bringing extra blockers to the point of attack, while its weaknesses are slower development and vulnerability to penetration or spill techniques. The passage also outlines blocking responsibilities for Counter Trey against 3-4 and 4-3 fronts and describes GT Counter and Gun Split GT Counter Triple Option variations.

China criticized a U.S. nuclear strategy report that portrayed it as a potential adversary, saying its nuclear arsenal is only the minimum needed for security and that it will never use nuclear weapons first. It urged the United States to reduce its much larger arsenal and work with China to promote regional stability.

Arch Manning had mixed performances in Texas’ first four games, with strong outings against San Jose State and Sam Houston State and weaker ones against Ohio State and UTEP. He finished those games with a 61.3% completion rate, 888 passing yards, nine touchdowns, and three interceptions.

Virgin America’s brand will disappear after its final two revenue flights Tuesday night, with all remaining Virgin-branded counters, signs, kiosks, and gate areas at 29 U.S. and Mexico airports switching to Alaska Airlines on Wednesday. Alaska will use one flight network, website, app, call center, and airport check-in system, though some Virgin America aircraft interiors may remain until the end of 2019.

Enron said it could repay about $3.3 billion in notes from investment vehicles through asset sales, but might issue stock if needed. The company’s stock fell sharply amid SEC inquiries into transactions involving CFO Andrew Fastow and investor concerns about liquidity and disclosure.

The passage says digital twins can improve efficiency and sustainability by reducing development time, material use, and CO2 emissions, while HPC is seen by industrial enterprises as a game changer that improves simulation speed, quality, agility, and innovation. It also notes that many firms prefer external, cloud-based or hybrid HPC models because of cost, flexibility, scalability, security, and energy concerns.

Paradox Interactive said its regional price hikes were a mistake and that it is trying to improve future pricing and communication. The company is also expanding on console and mobile, while remaining focused on PC and deep, complex games.

Fisher Chiropractic in Sacramento offers massage and chirotherapies for pain and back concerns, emphasizing personalized care, affordable prices, and certified experts. Its website includes service descriptions, reviews, email contact, and a Google Maps address.

The paper develops a crystallographic framework for cubic-to-tetragonal coexistence in ferroelectrics using high-resolution X-ray diffraction, deriving orientation relationships and Bragg peak splittings for 24 mismatch-free adaptive-state variants. It applies the model to PMN-35PT near the cubic-tetragonal transition and finds experimental Bragg peak separations consistent with an AS-like state without domain miniaturization.

The passage mainly contains Investing.com headlines, market commentary, and risk disclosures. It says Asia stocks were muted after mixed Chinese PMIs, the S&P 500 closed higher ahead of jobs data, and gold topped $3,800/oz amid shutdown risks and rate-cut bets. It also discusses seasonal market weakness, yields, the dollar, and technical views on TLT, commodities, and equities.

Microsoft entered into an underwriting agreement on February 9, 2015 to issue and sell $10.75 billion of senior unsecured notes due 2020, 2022, 2025, 2035, 2045, and 2055. The notes pay interest semi-annually, may be redeemed in certain circumstances, and rank equally with Microsoft’s other unsecured and unsubordinated debt.

The probiotics chewables market is expected to grow significantly, driven by rising applications and demand for probiotic dietary supplements. Chewable probiotics support digestive and immune health and are segmented by product type, end user, and region. Europe holds the largest market share, with North America and Asia Pacific following.

BA.2.86 (Pirola) and its descendant JN.1 carry many spike mutations and strongly evade neutralization by polyclonal sera from double-boosted individuals, but the XBB.1.5-adapted vaccine substantially improves neutralization against both. Reverse mutational scanning identified ins16MPLF, Δ144Y, K356T, N460K, V483Δ, A484K, F486P, and P621S as contributors to immune escape.

Apple Inc. reported that at its February 23, 2021 annual shareholder meeting, all listed directors were elected, Ernst & Young LLP was ratified as independent auditor, executive compensation was approved, and two shareholder proposals were not approved.

The design combines the ADS8681W 16-bit SAR ADC with the eight-channel MUX36D08 differential multiplexer for fast channel-to-channel operation. The ADS8681W settles to 1% in under 5 µs, supports input amplitudes up to ±12.288 V on a single analog supply, includes safety features, and interfaces with a controller through enhanced SPI. The MUX36D08 supports up to eight differential inputs and uses three digital control lines.

The court affirmed a local improvement assessment in South Bend, holding that a preliminary cost estimate is only for deciding whether to begin the improvement, and an assessment is valid if it reflects the actual bona fide cost even when that cost greatly exceeds the estimate. It also held the ordinance was not void for indefiniteness and found the proceedings regular.

Pius Suter scored three goals and Jonas Hiller made 25 saves as Switzerland beat host South Korea 8-0 in Olympic men’s hockey. Switzerland bounced back from a loss to Canada, while South Korea lost its second straight game.

Reagan campaigned in several states in 1975–76, lost the Republican nomination to Ford at the 1976 convention, then exchanged conciliatory remarks with Ford and addressed delegates, urging party unity and warning against domestic decline and nuclear destruction. The passage also notes that in 1979 Jeane Kirkpatrick criticized Carter’s foreign policy in an article titled “Dictatorships & Double Standards.”

XO Training Ltd has proposed converting Unit 2 Pipers Court in Thatcham into a members-only ice training centre for sports including ice hockey, figure skating, speed skating and sledge hockey. The facility would use real, synthetic and Dryland ice, employ 20 staff, and is expected to be decided by West Berkshire Council by August 2.

The study surveyed 90 elementary mathematics teachers in the UAE about distance education. Teachers reported generally positive perceptions of online mathematics teaching and confidence using digital tools, but also noted increased workload, stress, and concerns about student learning and communication. Most preferred face-to-face teaching in the future, although they valued school support and training.

This document defines the GHCB for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests, standardizing guest-hypervisor communication, supported non-automatic exits, and required guest state exposure. It adds hypervisor feature advertisement, GHCB version 2 support, SEV-SNP-specific protocols, and revision changes such as APIC ID list retrieval, multiple VMPL support, page state change notification, and SEV-SNP confidential computing blob EFI protocol support.

The lecture introduced Langmuir probes, explained that a probe in plasma forms a sheath, and described how probe current varies with bias voltage through floating potential, plasma potential, electron saturation, and ion saturation regions. It gave sheath-based results for current, density, and temperature estimates, then outlined single, double, and triple probe methods, noting their advantages, limitations, and complications from magnetic fields and collisions.

Mayank Jaggi earned INR 38.68 lakh by finishing 6th in the $1,100 No-Limit Hold’em event at the 2018 Wynn Summer Classic in Las Vegas. The tournament drew 2,197 entries, and Athanasios Polychronopoulos won the title.

Apple Inc.’s Q2 2022 Form 10-Q reported six-month net sales of $221.2 billion and net income of $59.6 billion, up from $201.0 billion and $52.4 billion a year earlier. Revenue rose across iPhone, Mac, Wearables/Home/Accessories, and Services, while iPad declined. Total assets were $350.7 billion and total liabilities $283.3 billion as of March 26, 2022. The company repurchased $43.3 billion of common stock in the first six months and announced on April 28, 2022 a $90 billion increase to its share repurchase authorization and a dividend increase to $0.23 per share.

The speaker says their team has had chances but needs to score more, create better chances, get closer to the net, and capitalize on rebounds. They describe the opponent as a well-rounded, hard-working team with strong puck possession, big bodies, and good faceoff play.

The Denver Broncos ended a 37-game streak without a 100-yard rusher when J.K. Dobbins ran for 101 yards in a 28-3 win over the Bengals. The victory moved Denver to 2-2 and marked their largest yardage advantage in the game, outgaining Cincinnati by 353 yards.

The passage reports that the Dow hit a record high despite a likely government shutdown, while market commentary says momentum remains intact but technical charts show early warnings. It notes the S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and 7.8% year to date, but August started weak, with investors shifting heavier into tech stocks and volatility and credit spreads turning more seasonal.

A Gallup-Walton Family Foundation survey found that more than 1 in 4 U.S. public school teachers lack basic materials or staffing support, with shortages especially common for teaching assistants, mental health resources, and special educators. Teachers with adequate resources were more satisfied at work, and many reported difficulty obtaining materials and inadequate professional development.

This study developed a Patient Report Template (PRT) to support nursing handoffs and streamline EHR documentation, then surveyed 106 University of Iowa Health Care nurses about its usefulness and their views on AI. Nurses generally rated most PRT sections as useful, especially Patient Profile, Safety, and Actions, while reporting low comfort and trust in AI but moderate expected utility.

The passage describes the turn-of-the-month trading strategy, where traders go long on the fifth last trading day of the month and exit on the third trading day of the next month. It says the strategy has performed well in the S&P 500 for over 60 years and is tested across many markets, sectors, and assets, including stocks, Bitcoin, commodities, gold, and Treasuries. It also distinguishes the strategy from the end-of-month effect and notes that the last calendar day of the month can differ from the last trading day.

The passage promotes multiple credit cards with 0% intro APR offers, cash back, points, and travel rewards, and explains that low-interest cards can help save money. It also notes that the site reviews over 100 cards from more than 50 issuers and says compensation does not affect ratings or reviews.

The speaker describes a hockey player as physically strong, smart with the puck, strong in the corners, and having played a solid game. The team felt its first and third periods were better than the second, said it needed to stay aggressive and create scoring chances, and noted that players should not get distracted by physical play or retaliate.

The speaker says a goal came from throwing pucks on net and staying positive through a dry spell, noting that getting chances matters and the goal came at the right time. The speaker also says players go through this kind of stretch, should stay confident and stick with it, and credits their dad for major support.

Systems log data in varied formats and levels, often creating problems in containerized environments where logs are expected on stdout. The adapter pattern can redirect logs to stdout and transform differing log formats into a single structured representation for aggregation. Using a separate adapter container is often preferable to modifying a reused application container because it is easier to maintain and can be shared.

The passage says oil majors have improved revenue, production, margins, and cash flow as oil prices recovered from 2016 lows, with aggregate oil production and gas growth rising and capital spending falling. It argues the oil market is gradually rebalancing, inventories are being drawn down, and majors can remain profitable at about $50/bbl if spending is disciplined.

The passage discusses hockey teams’ similar disciplined, physical styles, the importance of goaltending, penalty killing, and specialty teams, and says the series should be close and exciting. It also emphasizes leadership, team improvement, discipline, learning from mistakes, and contributions from veterans and rookies in pursuit of winning the Stanley Cup.

The patent includes at least one color drawing or photograph. The figures show a display screen with an animated graphical user interface in three images, and the appearance sequentially transitions between them. Broken lines indicate the display screen and are not part of the claimed design, and the transition process is excluded from the design.

Germany, through the United States, Spain, and Switzerland, said the Allies rejected its December 12 peace proposal and accused them of bad faith. It defended the Central Powers’ war aims, rejected responsibility for the war, claimed the Allies had violated international law and humanitarian norms, and argued that further bloodshed was indefensible.

The paper introduces PATCH, a network growth model combining preferential attachment, triadic closure, and homophily to study segregation, degree inequality, and inequity in networks with minority and majority groups. Simulations show that homophily drives segregation and inequity, preferential attachment mainly drives degree inequality, and triadic closure can moderate segregation and inequity depending on whether its target selection is biased. Applied to scientific collaboration and citation networks in Physics and Computer Science, the best-fitting model has both global and local links biased by preferential attachment and gender homophily, suggesting that reducing network inequalities would require simultaneously lowering homophily, triadic closure, and preferential attachment.

Fifteen Sacred Heart Academy students and five chaperones traveled to Alajuelita, Costa Rica, during spring break for a mission trip combining Spanish use with community service. They spent time with children and seniors, shared meals, played games, sang songs, and completed ministry work and a hike, saying the trip improved their Spanish and taught them about helping others.

The Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly passed the Rs 95,666.97 crore budget for 2018-19, a 20% increase, with the appropriation bill linked to expenditure reforms. Finance minister Haseeb Drabu said funds would be released quickly through BEAMS, procurement timelines capped at 60 days, and no fresh casual or need-based workers would be engaged.

SD card reads use a synchronous DAT bus with start and end bits, and block-oriented transfers have a maximum size of 512 bytes with CRC protection. CMD17 reads a single block, CMD18 reads consecutive blocks until CMD12 stops transmission, and reads may be interrupted by power loss without data destruction except during write or erase operations.

Researchers found that a horseshoe-shaped microstructure where dandelion seeds attach helps explain directional seed release: seeds detach more easily when pulled toward the open side, while the taller barrier helps them stay attached when pushed the opposite way. This structure may help dandelions catch upward gusts and avoid downward flights.

This review examined MAFLD prevalence and its association with HbA1c in adults with T2D in Africa. It included 10 studies with 1,667 participants from six countries and found that MAFLD diagnosis was mostly by ultrasound; most participants were overweight or obese and had poor glycemic control.

The passage describes SD card CMD6 switch functionality, including support requirements by spec version, mode 0 checking and mode 1 setting, function groups, busy status, power limits, and returned 512-bit status data. It also covers CMD8, command classes and responses, bus timing and CRC rules, timeout conditions, SD status fields, and speed class, UHS speed grade, and video speed class definitions and measurement conditions.

The Supreme Court announced that Collegium recommendations on judicial appointments, transfers, and elevations will be made public online, along with the reasons for those decisions. The move, already started, follows criticism of the Collegium’s lack of transparency, and some earlier recommendations had already been posted on the court’s website.

The study examined whether objective cognitive-behavioral measures of drug bias could better predict 4-month treatment adherence in inpatient opioid use disorder than demographics and subjective measures. It compared 59 inpatients with opioid use disorder and 29 healthy controls, and used follow-up visit attendance as the clinical endpoint.

On March 14, David Rabin of Greenwich United Way received a $5,000 Rotary Club of Greenwich grant at a luncheon at the Riverside Yacht Club. The donation will support the Reading Champions program with tutor supplies, books, and year-end awards.

Using 7T MRS in controls, biological relatives, and people with psychotic psychopathology, the study found lower occipital NAA in PwPP and relatives, lower prefrontal NAAG in PwPP, and higher glucose in PwPP, especially in PFC. Repeat scans showed generally stable metabolite measures, and clustering linked higher glucose with worse psychiatric and visual task measures.

The TLV321x and TLV322x are 5V single, dual, and quad high-speed comparators with 40ns propagation delay, rail-to-rail inputs, 1.8V to 5V supply operation, and 40μA per channel. TLV321x parts use push-pull outputs, while TLV322x parts use open-drain outputs that can be pulled up to 5.5V. The family includes power-on reset, internal hysteresis, and is specified for –40°C to 125°C operation.

Reuters listed the top agricultural exports by volume for five Atlantic coast port regions that could be affected by Hurricane Irma. Norfolk, Savannah, Port Everglades, Jacksonville, and Miami each had different leading exports, with poultry, grocery items, and soybeans among the major goods; nearly half of U.S. poultry exports transit through these five ports.

Several boxers transitioned to mixed martial arts with mixed results: Holly Holm and Heather Hardy found success, Ray Mercer and Mia St. John won one MMA fight each, while James Toney, Art Jimmerson, and Ricardo Mayorga had limited or poor results.

The passage introduces the Z-transform as a generalization of the discrete-time Fourier transform to address convergence problems. It explains that the Fourier transform converges when the sequence is absolutely summable, gives examples of sequences with and without convergent Fourier transforms, and defines the Z-transform as \(X(z)=\sum x[n]z^{-n}\). The region of convergence is emphasized as essential, along with poles and zeros, and its relation to right-sided, left-sided, two-sided, stable, and causal sequences is described. It also notes that convolution in time becomes multiplication in the Z-domain.

The passage contains a Microsoft WM-DRM notice and a SanDisk end user license agreement for software bundled with the product. It grants a limited personal-use license, restricts modification, reverse engineering, redistribution, and other uses, disclaims warranties, limits liability, allows termination for violation, and includes governing-law, export, and disposal instructions.

The MSPM0Cxx MCUs include low-power, zero-wait-state SRAM retained in RUN, SLEEP, STOP, and STANDBY modes, with 1KB-resolution write protection. The devices also provide GPIO, IOMUX, ADC, temperature sensing, LFSS, VREF, comparator, security features, CRC, UART, I2C, SPI, watchdog timers, RTC_B, timers, SWD/debug support, and factory constants.

Source Energy Services Inc. is seeking about C$250 million in an IPO and a valuation of about C$1 billion, with Bank of Nova Scotia, Morgan Stanley and Bank of Montreal leading the sale. The Calgary-based fracking sand distributor plans to use the proceeds for a Wisconsin facility, debt reduction and other capital expenditures, as oilfield services demand improves.

The Tenth Circuit affirmed the INS’s reinstatement of Alejandro Mendez Suarez’s 1996 exclusion order, holding that the district court properly transferred his habeas filing, the reinstatement was not improper despite his criminal bond issues, § 1231(a)(5) was not applied retroactively, he was ineligible for adjustment of status, and he showed no prejudicial due process violation.

Ashby Fields Primary School is consulting parents on closing at 1.15pm on Friday afternoons to help staff workload and work-life balance, while some parents say it would make childcare difficult and reduce teaching time. The school says the change could improve teaching and learning, and feedback will be reviewed before any formal proposal.

This study systematically reviewed and meta-analyzed studies on mental health disorders in women with PCOS and estimated their direct healthcare costs in the U.S. PCOS was associated with higher prevalence of anxiety, depression, and eating disorders, but not significant postpartum depression, with corresponding 2021 excess costs of about $1.94 billion, $1.68 billion, and $0.64 billion. The authors concluded that PCOS-related direct healthcare costs exceed $15 billion annually in 2021 USD, with mental health disorders accounting for nearly one-third.

The passage promotes several credit cards with 0% intro APR offers, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses, and explains that low-interest or interest-free cards can save money and are evaluated through a data-driven ranking system.

A class action lawsuit was announced against Enron over alleged misrepresentations that inflated its stock, while reports said the SEC sought information on Enron transactions with limited partnerships managed by a senior officer. Enron’s shares fell sharply, and several news items focused on investor concern, credit access, and broader problems at the company.

Apple Inc. reported first-quarter fiscal 2024 net sales of $119.6 billion, net income of $33.9 billion, and diluted EPS of $2.18, up from $117.2 billion, $30.0 billion, and $1.88 a year earlier. iPhone and Services sales increased, while iPad and Wearables, Home and Accessories declined. Cash and cash equivalents were $40.8 billion, total assets were $353.5 billion, and shareholders’ equity was $74.1 billion. The company repurchased $20.5 billion of common stock, paid $3.8 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents, and noted no material changes in controls, market risk, or critical accounting estimates.

The passage argues that sex education is often misunderstood and opposed by some Christians and others, but says it helps children feel unashamed about sexuality, recognize their bodies, and report abuse. It claims the opposition is driven more by fear and culture than by faith, and says schools should support parents in educating children about sex.

A Chinese maths question for 11-year-olds asked how old a ship’s captain was if a ship had 26 sheep and 10 goats onboard, and it was declared unsolvable because there was no answer. Students and adults tried to solve it, but the education department confirmed the question was intended to have no answer.

President Theodore Roosevelt proclaimed Thursday, September 19, 1901, a national day of mourning and prayer for President McKinley, urging people to gather in worship to honor his life and mourn his death.

The passage lists Enron-related news items and includes articles on the Bush energy task force, Texaco’s LNG plans, Enron’s suit against NGX, South American energy policy, Japanese electricity reform, Saudi gas projects, and Dabhol power project developments in India. It also reports that Cheney met privately with executives from Conoco, Enron, and Exxon Mobil while many environmental and consumer groups said they were excluded from the energy task force process.

Resource Generation is a 20-year-old nonprofit that helps wealthy young adults examine their “money stories,” understand how wealth connects to inequality, and direct money toward social justice and structural change. Members, including Emily Bookstein, Adam Roberts, Hanna Mahon, and Elizabeth Baldwin, report giving much more after joining.

The passage examines how separating Druze education from Arab education in Israel affected matriculation and higher education outcomes. It reports that Druze schools have seen rising achievement and high matriculation eligibility, with principals attributing success mainly to leadership, teachers, social change, and Druze identity, while many do not view separation as the main cause. It also notes a gap between high school achievement and readiness for academia, and calls for better preparation for higher education.

NVIDIA’s Compensation Committee adopted the Fiscal Year 2019 Variable Compensation Plan on March 7, 2018, allowing eligible executive officers to earn cash payments based on fiscal 2019 corporate performance goals tied to revenue. The plan requires employees to remain employed through the payment date unless otherwise determined, and it lists target award opportunities for named executive officers.

CongressDailyAM reports House appropriators’ FY02 spending allocations, expected to mostly follow Bush’s requests but with higher amounts for Labor-HHS, VA-HUD, and Energy and Water, and covers debate over the FY01 defense supplemental. It also notes House Republicans see little change in House partisanship after the Senate switch, Steve Largent’s planned House resignation, several policy issues including liability reform, ergonomics, drug reimportation, generic drug law, steel trade tensions with the EU, Senate organizing talks, and Bush’s planned nomination of Jo Anne Barnhart to head the Social Security Administration.

Alex Caruso, the Lakers’ first two-way player, has played 25 games for the team while nearing the 45-day limit of his NBA time this season. Coach Luke Walton said the two-way system has improved continuity and player familiarity, and the Lakers believe Caruso could become part of their regular rotation. Caruso has averaged 19 points and 7.4 assists for South Bay, and he said the deal provides more opportunity and hope than a G-League contract.

Williams Jones & Associates LLC cut its Star Bulk Carriers Corp. stake by 52.6% in the second quarter to 31,600 shares worth $311,000. Other institutional investors also adjusted holdings, and 75.03% of the stock is owned by institutions and hedge funds. Star Bulk Carriers opened at $10.28, had a $651.91 million market cap, and analysts gave it a consensus “Buy” rating with a $12.80 target price.

The government said it is controlling the bird flu outbreak in Pampanga through restrictions, poultry culling, quarantine measures, and public information. Health officials said the virus mainly affects birds, human infection is difficult, and properly cooked chicken is safe.

A multi-country survey and model study in France, Belgium, and Italy found high declared adherence to testing and isolation but lower willingness to get a fall 2022 booster in France. The predicted testing and isolation protocols would reduce transmission by about 17–18% in France and Belgium and 24% in Italy, but none would reduce the effective reproductive number below 1; cost barriers to testing would substantially reduce effectiveness.

The passage says Alcoa’s shares have risen sharply and one contributor views it as a buy because of expected growth in bauxite production and new supply contracts, while another says the stock is hard to value because of asset write-downs, ongoing restructuring, and risks from raw material prices and trade policy.

The passage compiles multiple energy-crisis articles about California, including power-plant pollution rule changes, FERC refund orders for possible overcharges, rising utility debt and bankruptcy threats, blackout-zone changes, and state efforts to buy electricity and manage shortages. It also includes commentary criticizing parochial attacks on out-of-state generators.

Vienna was ranked the world’s best city for quality of life for the ninth year in a row, while Baghdad remained last in Mercer’s annual survey of 231 cities. Europe dominated the top 10, with Zurich second and Auckland and Munich tied for third; London fell to 41st.

The passage says playoffs and the Olympics differ because playoffs allow teams to recover from deficits, while Olympic teams can be eliminated after the quarterfinals, making the Olympics more draining and less relaxing. It also says the speaker’s coach is relaxed when players are doing their job, but sharp at keeping them attentive when they drift, with a mutual understanding developed over the years.

The passage is a collection of November 11, 2001 news items focused heavily on Enron’s collapse, its SEC investigation, Dynegy’s planned acquisition, and commentary on the company’s accounting practices, market impact, and effects on Houston.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2017 reported total revenues of $2.70 billion and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $330.3 million. Total assets were $25.1 billion, total liabilities $18.9 billion, and cash and cash equivalents $4.0 billion. The filing also described the Grohmann acquisition, SolarCity-related operations, debt, stock issuance, legal proceedings, and segment results for automotive and energy generation and storage.

The professor discussed Porter’s CSR framework, arguing that moral, license-to-operate, reputation, and vague sustainability arguments are incomplete drivers. Instead, companies should focus on strategic CSR by prioritizing issues tied to their value chain, competitive context, and core business, using measurement, targets, and supply-chain engagement to embed sustainability into company “DNA.”

The lecture introduces a class on the mathematics and algorithms of folding, covering applications in robotics, graphics, mechanics, manufacturing, medicine, biology, sculpture, and architecture. It outlines three main topics—linkages, paper, and polyhedra—plus hinged dissections, and distinguishes foldability, design, universality, decision, and hardness results.

Tamil Nadu’s sugar output is expected to drop by more than a third to 600,000 tonnes in 2017/18 because of the worst drought in over a century. The drought has also hurt other southern Indian farmers, while India’s overall sugar output for 2016/17 is forecast at 20.3 million tonnes.

A Yale-led team created a historical urban population dataset by digitizing and standardizing past research, extending city population records back to 3700 B.C. The data, though incomplete and uneven, helps analyze long-term urban growth beyond earlier U.N. records.

The passage introduces a bound-preserving coupling of cell-centered finite volume and discontinuous Galerkin methods for steady convection-diffusion problems, aiming to reduce DG overshoots and undershoots by switching troubled regions to FV so that standard conservative slope limiters can be applied. It also defines the model PDE, FV/DG mesh partitioning, and TPFA admissibility assumptions for the FV region.

The lecture introduces computer security as achieving policy goals despite adversaries, using a threat model and mechanism, and gives examples of failures in policies, threat models, and mechanisms. It discusses password recovery, certificate authorities, human behavior, changing assumptions, and buffer overflow attacks, then notes that reducing the trusted computing base can improve security.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2018 reports total revenues of $4.0 billion and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $717.5 million for the quarter, with total assets of $27.9 billion and total liabilities of $22.6 billion. It also describes the adoption of ASC 606 on January 1, 2018, which changed revenue recognition for certain vehicle sales with resale value guarantees and affected balances such as deferred revenue, resale value guarantees, and operating lease vehicles.

Wyong Race Club is seeking to settle a compensation dispute with Gary Leafe after his horse Eyes To Heaven was attacked by dogs at the track, leaving the filly badly wounded. Leafe is asking for $8300 for training and feed bills, while the club says it wants to know how the amount was calculated.

The passage criticizes Keith E. Whittington’s view that professors should self-censor to protect academic freedom, arguing that academic freedom is a fundamental right that should not depend on avoiding offense. It also says the 1940 AAUP statement used by Whittington was meant as moral guidance, not a basis for punishment, and that controversy is central to free academic inquiry.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2016 reported revenue of $20.531 billion and net income of $3.756 billion for the quarter, with total assets of $181.869 billion and total liabilities of $107.063 billion. The company adopted new stock-based compensation accounting guidance early, announced upcoming changes in revenue recognition and lease accounting standards, and reported segment results for Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

Microsoft Corporation held its 2018 Annual Shareholders Meeting on November 28, 2018, where shareholders voted to re-elect all fourteen director nominees, approve executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratify Deloitte & Touche LLP as independent auditor for fiscal year 2019.

Britain’s Financial Ombudsman Service said consumer credit complaints rose to 7,281 in the second quarter from 5,846 a year earlier, and criticised lenders for inadequate affordability checks. Payday loans accounted for nearly half of the complaints, while PPI remained the most complained-about part of the market, with 42,401 new cases opened in the quarter.

The study uses molecular dynamics and effective Hamiltonians to show that Zr-substituted BaTiO₃ supports stable ferroelectric topological textures. In a 12.5% ordered superlattice, chemical doubling along [111] produces alternating −2 antiskyrmions and +4 skyrmions, while random Zr substitution yields distorted but still nontrivial textures. The textures remain stable up to nearly 100 K depending on composition, and in the ordered superlattice a local field can induce Q=+4 textures near 293 K, though stability is volatile without the field.

The study uses QSGW and QSGW+W calculations to examine WSe2/CrI3 heterostructures and finds that proximity effects generate robust interlayer excitons between the WSe2 A and B excitons, alongside preserved WSe2 excitons and CrI3 excitons. The calculations predict type-I band alignment at the higher levels of theory, magnetic splitting of the WSe2 excitons, and enhanced brightness of the interlayer excitons, with the splittings strongly dependent on band alignment and stacking configuration.

The passage is a news digest and articles about the Enron-Dabhol dispute, focusing on Madhav Godbole’s resignation and later withdrawal, the Maharashtra government’s support for him, Pawar’s comments, and Centre and lender responses. It also includes commentary on flaws in the Dabhol project and the need for renegotiation, regulatory review, and possible power trading arrangements.

Asia-Pacific stocks rose after U.S. officials downplayed North Korea conflict risks. Japan’s economy grew 4.0% annualized in April-June, while U.S. stocks had their biggest weekly loss in months amid weak earnings and North Korea tensions. U.S. inflation stayed subdued in July, and Fed’s Kaplan said rates are appropriate for now.

Michael Liersch of JPMorgan says most investors can succeed by making a budget and plan, reframing investing as a long-term benefit, staying patient through market swings, seeking a second opinion, and starting with small automatic steps.

The passage argues that the reproduction number is a biased measure of viral spread when testing varies over time because it ignores diagnostics, and presents the acceleration index as a test-adjusted, unit-free alternative that measures cases relative to tests.
