It derives a formal link between the two, shows they are equal only under specific testing conditions, and reports that in France and several other countries the reproduction number often underestimates or overestimates spread compared with the acceleration index, with important implications for public health policy.

Pershing Square’s US long portfolio rose slightly to $6.01B in Q2 2017 with 7 positions and remained highly concentrated, with Restaurant Brands International, Chipotle Mexican Grill, and Mondelēz International making up about 71% of value. New stakes were added in Automatic Data Processing, Air Products was fully sold, Howard Hughes increased through warrant conversion, Mondelēz was reduced, and Restaurant Brands and Chipotle were kept steady.

The Poland Local Board of Education dissolved the contract of Poland Seminary High School teacher Cassandra Kibler after her teaching license was revoked following an investigation into an alleged inappropriate relationship with a student. The board also heard two facility options from Strollo Architects to reduce district costs, but took no action and will review them later.

Ann Schmidt circulated a list of Enron-related news stories on California power market profits, Enron’s possible U.K. plant purchases, Scottish Power’s restructuring, Dabhol Power disputes in India, Northern Border’s Midwestern Gas acquisition, a Tampa LNG terminal proposal, and a ruling allowing Enron to source university power from California utilities.

Microsoft’s 2017 Form 10-K says the company’s mission is to empower every person and organization on the planet to achieve more, and it operates worldwide in three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. It describes products and services including Office, LinkedIn, Dynamics, Azure, Windows, Surface, Xbox, and search advertising, and notes risks from competition, cybersecurity, regulation, intellectual property, acquisitions, supply issues, and product quality.

Simone Askew, a 20-year-old West Point cadet from Fairfax, Va., became the first black woman to lead the Corps of Cadets as first captain, the highest cadet leadership position. She said the role is humbling and exciting, and she encourages other young women to seek mentorship.

Syrian rebels in southern Daraa faced a Russian deadline to accept surrender terms or face renewed military action, as talks continued amid a regime offensive that had retaken about 60 percent of the province and displaced up to 330,000 people. Russia rejected rebel ceasefire and withdrawal demands, while Jordan and Israel kept their borders closed to fleeing Syrians and the UN Security Council planned an emergency meeting.

He was estimated to receive about $60,000 a year, but may not access pension payments until age 57 and eight months. Officials say the faster process helps them monitor problem areas and spray if needed; no human cases have been reported in Macon County this year.

The Cape Horn Pigeon sailed on a whaling voyage in 1891, was in the Okhotsk Sea in September 1892, and had twice visited Vladivostok to seek permission to fish in certain bays. On September 10, 1892, it was seized on the open sea by an Imperial Russian naval officer, taken by force to Vladivostok, and detained until October 1, 1892; the captain protested, the crew was pressed into service, and the United States was later notified that the vessel had been released.

Iraqi forces were fighting Islamic State around Mosul, where the group also cut strategic roads and attacked military positions, killing and wounding soldiers and pro-government fighters.

He launched Bevel for men, later Form for women, and also founded Code2040 to increase access and opportunities for young people of color in tech.

Predictions were generally highly similar, especially when averaging RCC and RMLO views and combining multiple models. Performance differences were linked to higher density and smaller breast area, but not to age or dose ratio.

It reports that most store offerings are ultra-processed, Whole Foods has more minimally processed items, higher processing is generally associated with cheaper calories, and ingredient-level analysis with IgFPro identifies ingredients and oils that contribute most to ultra-processing.

Tecomaria capensis, or Cape honeysuckle, is a deciduous scrambling shrub or small tree up to 6 m tall with orange-red, trumpet-shaped flowers. It grows in southern, eastern, and tropical Africa, is classified as Least Concern, and is used in traditional medicine and for cultural necklets called isixhoxho. It is also a popular garden and hedging plant and is visited by sunbirds, butterflies, and honey-bees.

It held that admission of David Fones’s hearsay would not violate the Confrontation Clause, that the Double Jeopardy Clause did not bar retrial because the convictions were vacated for legal error rather than insufficient evidence, and that the government’s conduct was not so outrageous as to bar further prosecution under due process.

A year after Hurricane Helene, four western North Carolina school districts reported varied recovery: Atkinson Elementary returned to its building after floor repairs and community support; Old Fort Elementary reopened after extensive renovations and temporary placement with Parkway Elementary; Valle Crucis School remained split among multiple community sites while a new building’s opening was delayed; and Yancey County Schools closed Micaville Elementary permanently, expanded other schools, and shifted to improved communication and facility plans.

Since Aug. 1, it has been widely used, cutting average wait time from 83 to 15 minutes, and nearly 95 percent of transactions can be done online.

The game often had missing assets, lower-than-expected resolution, uncapped and uneven frame rates, and little sign of optimization for the One X.

It stresses patience, offensive rebounding, and second efforts, with several variations such as pop, high post rub, shuffle cut, and dribble clear.

It offers connections through 23 partners and partial circuits from 50Mbps to 10Gbps, with general availability expected in the coming weeks. Google said the service reduces reliance on the public internet and latency, but data is not encrypted by default.

Myxofibrosarcoma had the highest survival and spindle cell sarcoma the lowest. An all-cause mortality nomogram was developed to predict overall survival.

Australia’s business investment rose 0.4 per cent in the first quarter, below expectations, with buildings and structures down 1.3 per cent and new factories falling 16 per cent. Equipment, plant and machinery investment rose 2.5 per cent, while next year’s capex estimate was revised to $87.7 billion but remained below forecasts.

Police are trying to match it to a theft report, and Herbert is asking the rightful owner to come forward with a description or photo to claim it.

Trading saw heavy website traffic, bitcoin rose about 8% to above $15,700 and later above $16,000, while next-month futures traded above $18,000.

Holden provisional governor of North Carolina to help loyal citizens organize a state government and restore the state’s constitutional relations with the federal government. The court held Meeker could not represent his minor daughters pro se, that the claims were barred by res judicata or otherwise failed, and that a guardian ad litem is not a state actor under § 1983.

Euge’s malicious prosecution suit, holding that his prior conviction created probable cause as a matter of law even though it was later reversed. The court rejected claims that the indictment was improperly obtained and ruled that the facts underlying the prosecution did not create a jury question on probable cause.

Total assets were $32.795 billion as of September 30, 2019, and the company adopted ASC 842 in 2019, completed the Maxwell Technologies acquisition, and recorded higher sales return reserves and long-term debt.

The passage is a speech at the signing of a Middle East peace agreement, honoring leaders such as Rabin, Arafat, Peres, Carter, and Bush, and welcoming Israel and the PLO’s declaration of principles on interim Palestinian self-government. It emphasizes the history of conflict, the promise of reconciliation and security for Israelis and Palestinians, U.S. support for implementation, and hopes for a peaceful future for the region’s children.

A 14-year-old girl was arrested in Kingston after damaging her grandmother’s home during an outburst over a nonworking phone, including slamming doors, hitting walls, smashing dishes, and breaking a rear window with a baseball bat. She was charged with mischief, then released to her mother with conditions and a future court date.

Oil prices fell below US$56 a barrel after an API report showed U.S. crude inventories rose by 9.9 million barrels, raising concerns that OPEC’s cuts have not tightened supply. Brent fell to US$55.62 and U.S. crude to US$52.84, while rising U.S. stocks, higher U.S. output, and a stronger dollar also pressured prices. OPEC and other producers are cutting output by almost 1.8 million barrels per day, with January compliance above 90 per cent, though adherence has been mixed among members.

Restoration Affiliates was founded in 2011 by four restoration companies to help smaller regional firms compete with national players by offering national coverage and a collaborative referral network. By 2013, it had 21 members and $300 million in revenue, but leaders were still debating governance, standards, communication, referral fees, and territory overlap.

The paper presents a general method for obtaining codensity presentations of monads by combining density and duality. Its main theorem states that in any “codensity setting,” the monad induced by a dual adjunction is the codensity monad of a related functor. The authors apply this framework to derive known and new codensity presentations for ultrafilter, filter, Vietoris, sobrification, and probability monads, including the expectation, Giry, Radon, Kantorovich, and finite semiring-valued measure monads.

The passage is an extended eulogy for Henry Clay, describing his death, public career, and influence on American politics. It recounts his birth in Virginia, his rise to law and national office, his role in the War of 1812, the Missouri Compromise, Nullification, and later compromise efforts, and praises his eloquence, devotion to the Union, opposition to slavery, and support for colonization and foreign struggles for liberty.
The passage presents a series of quotes criticizing taxation, banking, corporations, patriotism, and education, with themes of debt, exploitation, and control.

Microsoft Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that on January 30, 2017 it entered into an underwriting agreement to issue and sell $17 billion of senior unsecured notes due in 2020, 2022, 2024, 2027, 2037, 2047, and 2057. The notes will be issued under the May 18, 2009 indenture as supplemented by a twelfth supplemental indenture dated February 6, 2017, with interest payable semiannually starting August 6, 2017.

Harvard Law School visiting professor Carlos Portugal Gouvêa was arrested Oct. 1 after police said he fired a pellet gun near a Jewish temple during a Yom Kippur service. He was placed on administrative leave and charged with illegally discharging a pellet gun, disturbing the peace, disorderly conduct, and damage to personal property. Police said he admitted he was hunting rats and did not file bias-based charges.

A Cambridge pet owner, Jacob Hackin, was prosecuted for leaving dog mess in Midsummer Common after failing to pay a fixed penalty notice, and was fined £75 plus £125 costs and a £30 surcharge. He was the first person in Cambridge prosecuted for this offence, and the council said the case should warn dog owners to clear up after their pets.

Former CIA case officer Kevin Mallory is on trial in Virginia, where prosecutors say he gave a Chinese agent secret information, including details about human assets, for $25,000. Defense lawyers say he was trying to expose the Chinese operation by feeding false documents and had alerted the CIA. Evidence includes undeclared cash found at O’Hare, text messages with a recruiter, and secret documents recovered from his home. Mallory faces up to life in prison.

Kelly Keefe will become ERC’s president on Jan. 1, becoming the first woman to lead the Highland Heights-based organization in its 97-year history. She will succeed Pat Perry, who is stepping down after nearly 20 years as president but will remain chairman during the transition.

The passage describes a messaging system that uses a virtual object machine learning system to generate synthetic training data from 3D models, poses, textures, and environments so machine learning models can better classify dynamic subjects such as hands and dogs. It also details messaging, annotation, collection, and ephemeral timer systems, database structures, message components, and example client/server software and machine architectures.

Upgrade is a near-future sci-fi horror action film about Grey Trace, a mechanic left paralyzed after a savage attack, who is upgraded by a processor called STEM and seeks revenge. It features violent but purposeful action, explores artificial intelligence and technology, and is praised for its execution, though the mystery is considered somewhat predictable.

The passage reports on Hawaiian and Chinese affairs. It says the United States should respect Hawaiian independence while appointing a consular representative, and it recommends sending a paid commissioner to China to protect American commercial interests after new British treaty openings there.

Sen. John McCain criticized President Trump for approving the release of the GOP-Nunes memo, saying it undermines the rule of law and serves Putin’s interests. He called the memo partisan attacks on the FBI and DOJ, urged officials to stop politicizing the Mueller investigation, and noted Democrats responded by calling for the release of their own memo.

A real estate broker sued the purchaser for a commission after failing to consummate the sale; the court held there was no proof of any special contract making the purchaser liable and that the plaintiff did not bring about the sale, so the judgment for plaintiff was reversed and a new trial ordered.

Thabane Sigadla, 24, from KwaDabeka was sentenced by the Pinetown Regional Court to an effective 38 years in prison for carjacking, possession of an unlicensed firearm and ammunition, after being linked to hijackings in KwaDabeka in 2016 and New Germany in 2017.

Azerbaijani Health Ministry spokesperson Safaya Ahmadova said the US State Department’s warning to citizens about surgery and medicine in Azerbaijan was unrelated to the country’s healthcare, calling it a routine recommendation. She said Azerbaijan’s medical institutions are accepted by foreign states, hundreds of foreigners receive treatment there, and the ministry rejected the US report on tuberculosis as untrue, saying figures have declined year by year.

The paper introduces AI-Noether, a system that uses abductive reasoning to reconcile polynomial hypotheses with background theory by finding missing or modified axioms. It encodes axioms and hypotheses as ideals and varieties, then uses primary decomposition and Gröbner basis elimination to identify candidate missing polynomial axioms. Experiments on scientific laws such as Kepler’s Third Law show the method can recover missing axioms, including in some multi-axiom cases.

Nanyang Polytechnic scientists have developed a method to turn coffee waste into biodegradable plastic using bacteria to produce PHA. The team improved yield and purity by switching to eco-friendly solvents and genetically modifying the bacteria, and they hope to commercialise the process in three to five years.

The passage lists biotech and health news headlines, including a government shutdown expected to furlough more than 32,000 at HHS and hamper CDC and CMS communication, a U.K. antitrust probe request over drugmakers’ investment halts, and several biotech and pharmaceutical stories such as Trump backing off threatened pharma tariffs and a Pfizer drug pricing deal.

The Iowa Supreme Court held that Gary G. Kehde did not have to apply for rehearing before seeking judicial review, but the Department properly disqualified him from unemployment benefits for misconduct based on his possession of a lit marijuana cigarette on company premises. The court reversed the district court and remanded.

A regulation American football field is 120 yards long and 53.3 yards wide, with a 100-yard playing area and two 10-yard end zones. The passage explains key field markings, including goal lines, yard lines, hash marks, numbers, and sidelines, and notes that their measurements and placement can differ by level of play.

The passage describes Merck’s “Lean Design” approach to rebuilding clinical trial schedules of assessment from “Ground Zero” to reduce unnecessary data collection. Using Faro’s Smart Design Tool and workshops on six protocols, the teams identified fewer assessments, reduced timing/frequency, and smaller subsets for some measurements, which could save participant and staff time, costs, and complexity.

The IMF said Ghana’s “Ghana beyond Aid” vision and early economic performance under President Akufo-Addo are an inspiration to Africa. Finance Minister Ken Ofori-Atta outlined the agenda at the IMF/World Bank Spring Meetings, describing revenue measures to boost domestic resource mobilisation and support growth, jobs, and incomes.

A 2018 test of 124 VPN and proxy providers found 20 leaking users’ IPs via WebRTC and 101 hiding them. The passage lists leaking providers, suggests testing for leaks and disabling WebRTC if needed, and names several VPN services presented as better for privacy, including ExpressVPN, NordVPN, StrongVPN, and Private Internet Access.

MoviePass said its ticket purchases made up significant shares of opening-weekend box office for several films and increased in later weeks for others. It also signed a marketing and performance-based revenue deal with an undisclosed independent distribution company, and said it will begin using active marketing and ads to target users.

The passage describes a non-occluding intravascular blood pump designed to reduce hemolysis by minimizing shear stress through features such as a cylindrical shroud, centrally aligned impeller and motor, supporting pillars, a trumpeted inlet, extended inlet length, raked-back blade edges, a long bare hub, matched stator and pillar angles, and controlled clearances. It reports iterative prototype testing and CFD analysis showing reduced hotspots, lower predicted and measured hemolysis, improved flow guidance, and maintained hydraulic output, with prototype P_31 performing better than the reference design.

MRC Vaudreuil-Soulanges council members said recyclable materials collected in the region remain valued despite global recycling concerns tied to China’s stricter acceptance rules. Tricentris, which handles a large share of Quebec recyclables, said it is doing well and urged citizens to keep recycling and improve material quality; the MRC also launched an online sorting tool and promotes Tricentris recycling news.

The case concerned the dutiable value of Christmas tree ornaments imported from Germany. Based on stipulated facts and the Woolworth case record, the court held that the proper foreign and export values were the per se unit invoice prices plus 3% social assessments and applicable packing and container costs. The appeal was dismissed for all other merchandise.

Asteroid 2025 TF, about 1 to 3 meters wide, passed over Antarctica on October 1 at a distance of 428 ± 7 km from Earth. It was detected by the Catalina Sky Survey hours after the flyby, posed no danger, and was later tracked by ESA astronomers with high precision.

Molecular dynamics simulations of pure niobium at 300 K and 1–75 keV compared EAM, FS-1, FS-2, and SNAP potentials. All captured cascade formation, but they differed in defect production, clustering, and morphology: EAM gave a balanced mix of loop- and ring-like clusters, FS-2 favored 1/2⟨111⟩ loops, FS-1 produced more ⟨110⟩/crowdion-like and small C15-ring structures, and SNAP formed compact cascades with many C15-like rings that may evolve into loops.

The speaker says being up gives confidence and forces the other team to make adjustments, which is an advantage. He says a few days between games were helpful to enjoy a win in San Jose and move on, and that a key player remains day to day but is important on faceoffs and penalty kills. He also says the upcoming matchup will be tough, but the key is for his team to play to its potential.

Live Nation is marking National Concert Week with $20 all-in tickets to over 2,000 summer live events from April 30 to May 8 on its website, offering over 1.5 million tickets across multiple genres and featuring artists such as Alan Jackson, Bon Jovi, Kevin Hart, Keith Urban, and Shakira.

Horsell Lodge near Woking, Surrey, offers specialised residential and dementia care, from short-term respite to long-term care. Staff work with residents and their families to provide bespoke care, support, and activities, and encourage residents to bring personal possessions to make their rooms their own.

The passage compares the Pixel Watch 4 and Apple Watch Ultra 3 as outdoor watches under $500, noting that the Pixel Watch 4 costs $399, has improved battery life, satellite emergency services, better sleep tracking, and more usable Google Maps integration, while the Watch Ultra 3 is more rugged, supports regular satellite texts in more countries, and is the better adventure watch overall.

The passage argues that conventional machine-learning-assisted GWAS can produce false-positive associations when imputing missing phenotypes. It introduces POP-GWAS, a summary-statistics-based framework that uses GWAS of observed and imputed phenotypes in labeled data plus GWAS of imputed phenotypes in unlabeled data to provide unbiased, valid, and more powerful inference. Simulations and a T2D benchmark support its validity, and its application to UK Biobank DXA-BMD data identified 188 loci, including 89 novel loci.

A Federal High Court in Katsina ordered former Governor Ibrahim Shema remanded in EFCC custody until April 27 over alleged money laundering and misappropriation of N5.7 billion SURE-P funds. Shema, facing 26 fraud-related charges, pleaded not guilty, while the court deferred hearing his bail application.

The passage introduces semiring-based semantics for propositional, first-order, and existential second-order logic, and defines a semiring analogue of nondeterministic polynomial time via BSS machines. It proves that ESO=
K equals NPK for positive, commutative semirings, extending versions of Fagin’s and Cook’s theorems and relating these results to semiring interpretations and logical characterizations of computation.

The passage presents a method for designing dilute PIB-PB Boger fluids with target viscoelastic properties by relating polymer concentration, molecular weight, and solvent viscosity to shear modulus, relaxation time, and first normal stress difference. It reports measured scaling laws, shows that a Zimm model with a correction factor describes the fluids, and demonstrates experimental fabrication of fluids with independently controlled G0, τ, and ψ1.

Jason Day is set for a group-stage rematch with Louis Oosthuizen at the World Golf Championships-Match Play in Texas, alongside Jason Dufner and James Hahn. Marc Leishman will play Branden Grace, Bubba Watson and Julian Suri, while Cameron Smith faces Hideki Matsuyama, Patrick Cantlay and Yusaku Miyazato and needs a strong finish for a Masters invitation.

Week 7 Idaho high school football rankings largely stayed intact, with Bishop Kelly and Eagle surviving close wins to remain undefeated. Minico and Ririe entered the rankings, while Middleton and Capital fell out. Several top teams posted dominant victories, including Rocky Mountain, Coeur d'Alene, and Lakeland.

The passage traces Enron’s rise from a pipeline company to a dominant energy trader under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling, then its rapid decline amid criticism of its accounting, failed ventures, falling stock, and internal culture of extreme competition.

Euro zone stocks rose to their highest level in more than a year after stronger-than-expected manufacturing data, with Italy’s market leading gains. The euro fell below US$1.05 as the dollar strengthened, while euro zone bond yields declined. Istanbul and Baghdad attacks had limited market impact, though the Turkish lira weakened. China’s manufacturing growth slowed, and bitcoin topped US$1,000 for the first time since 2013.
The passage lists the NBA’s full national TV schedule for the 2017-18 season, including games from October through April on TNT, ESPN, ABC, and NBA TV.

The Supreme Court is returning from summer recess and will hold its “long conference” to address accumulated cert petitions. The passage highlights Justice Clarence Thomas questioning stare decisis, former Justice Anthony Kennedy criticizing increasing partisanship, and several Trump-related emergency actions, including birthright citizenship, Venezuelan protected status, and foreign-aid funding.

Apple Inc. filed its 2015 Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 26, 2015, reporting that it designs, manufactures, and markets devices, software, services, and accessories, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, iOS, OS X, watchOS, iCloud, Apple Pay, and Internet Services. The company said it manages operations by geographic segment, had about 110,000 full-time equivalent employees, and faced significant competition, supply-chain risks, legal proceedings, and other risks affecting its business and financial results.

The passage explains Bengali typing symbols and rules, including digit mappings, special symbol behaviors, how English punctuation translates, and how ZWJ and ZWNJ affect ligatures and vowel combinations.

The passage argues that the retail apparel industry is under pressure from e-commerce, store overexpansion, and trade-policy uncertainty, but that Francesca’s Holdings Corp. is financially strong with no debt, significant cash, and free cash flow. It reports recent sales and earnings results, FY18 guidance, mixed valuation metrics, and concludes that FRAN is profitable, can sustain itself, and may see its share price rise over the next several years.

Oil prices fell and markets were calm after Israel and Hamas agreed to a rare truce in Gaza. U.S. stocks were little changed near record highs, with the S&P 500 up 0.1%, while gold stayed near record levels and Treasury yields rose slightly. Delta and PepsiCo reported earnings, and Novo Nordisk announced a $4.7 billion acquisition. In other markets, U.S. crude and Brent fell, European shares were mixed, and most Asian stocks rose.

Callinex Mines filed an independent technical report for a preliminary economic assessment of its Nash Creek and Superjack projects in New Brunswick. The maiden 2018 PEA outlines a 10-year open-pit operation with pre-tax IRR of 34.1%, pre-tax NPV of C$230 million, and pre-production capital costs of C$168 million. The company also plans a drill program to look for satellite deposits near Nash Creek.

The study used multi-ancestry transcriptome-wide analysis in GENOA AA and EA samples with GWAS summary statistics for general cognitive function, white matter hyperintensity, and Alzheimer’s disease. It identified 602, 45, 231, and 9 significant genes for these outcomes, respectively, and fine-mapping prioritized genes including ICA1L for both WMH and AD and TOMM40 for AD in AA and EA. The findings suggest roles for innate immunity, vascular dysfunction, and neuroinflammation, and the authors conclude this is the first TWAS using expression mapping studies in multiple ancestries for cognitive function and neurocognitive disorders.

A Chronicle of Higher Education survey found private college president pay continued to rise in 2015, with average compensation up 9% to $570,000 and 58 presidents earning more than $1 million, compared with 39 in 2014. The highest-paid Ohio president was Daniel Curran of the University of Dayton at more than $2.4 million, followed by Barbara Snyder of Case Western Reserve University at $1,152,836.

The African Union Commission’s Department of Trade and Industry held the First African Union Start Up Fest to exchange ideas on youth entrepreneurship and start-up development, assess start-up and tech-hub needs, and support creation of an African Association of Start-ups. Speakers highlighted the importance of SMEs, youth entrepreneurship, inclusion, access to education, technology, capital, infrastructure, and training. A follow-up side event on an African Association of Community Innovation Hub was planned for the 2018 Transform Africa Summit in Kigali.

The passage says offsites can be used for alignment, coordination, or celebration, but when seeking breakthroughs they should disrupt routine, foster connections, center on a shared purpose, and drive practical action. It describes HATCH experiences as using unfamiliar environments, communal living, diverse people, and carefully designed programs to support creativity, cross-pollination, and a world-changing mission.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2022 reported total revenues of $18.756 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $3.318 billion, compared with $10.389 billion and $438 million a year earlier. Cash and cash equivalents were $17.505 billion, total assets were $66.038 billion, and total liabilities were $30.632 billion. The filing also described debt repayments and settlements, stock-based compensation, legal proceedings, and Tesla’s automotive and energy generation and storage segments.

The passage is a June 7, 2001 Enron mentions digest covering several articles. It reports Enron and Exelon’s agreement to supply power to Chicago, ongoing lender talks over Enron’s Dabhol Power project in India, Enron Broadband’s investment in AP Engines, Enron’s challenge to a Maharashtra regulator’s order, and other energy-related news and commentary.

The study found that hybrid immunity from vaccination and natural infection produced higher antibody levels, stronger neutralization, and better variant cross-neutralization than vaccination alone, and that longer intervals between exposures, up to at least 400 days, further improved these responses.

Chris Jones said he did not pursue Trevor Lawrence on the Jaguars’ game-winning touchdown because he thought the play was over, called it a teaching point, and said it would not happen again. He also said his social media accounts had been deactivated before the game, not after the loss.

DPI (UK), an aluminium frames and lightboxes maker based in Castle Donington, received a £12,200 grant from the Collaborate scheme to buy an automated saw. The investment will help the company cut larger panels, produce bigger structures in the UK, reduce contract times, and support future job creation.

Andrew W. Lo introduces 15.401 Finance Theory for first-year MBA students, argues that finance is central to business, and outlines the course focus on valuation, asset management, time, risk, and six basic finance principles. He demonstrates price discovery with an auction of a boxed iPod, uses corporate and household cash-flow frameworks, and explains course requirements, grading, and study advice.

President Trump called the House-passed health care bill “mean,” upsetting some conservatives who supported it and slowing Senate efforts to revise the measure. Senate Republicans remained divided over major issues, and some leaders said passage could slip until the end of July.

The passage describes a system for answering private database queries with differentially private outputs. A client submits a query and privacy parameters, the system accesses the database, modifies the query or its result using differential privacy methods, and returns a privacy-preserving response. It includes modules for count, median, mean, variance, IQR, gradient descent, random forest, histogram, model testing, synthetic database generation, and validation of differential privacy.

ARDD reported that Jordan’s legal response to the Syrian refugee crisis has been rapid and effective, with government agencies and UNHCR providing free protection services, legal awareness, and documentation support in refugee camps and urban settings. The report praised internationally recognised camp legal sections but noted ongoing challenges, including access to the formal labour market, limited financial resources, and the need for better evaluation of legal aid services.

Moody’s said India may still meet its 3.3% fiscal deficit target for year ending March 2019, but risks remain from lower revenue, higher spending, and rising crude oil prices. Most survey respondents in Singapore and Mumbai expected fiscal slippage, and Moody’s said the government may cut capital spending to offset it.
High-tech sensors show greater noctule bats attacking and snatching songbirds from the sky at night.

The passage warns that the integrated circuit can be damaged by ESD and should be handled with proper precautions. It also includes revision history and extensive mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for MSPM0C1105/MSPM0C1106, along with TI disclaimers and legal notices.

TyreWatch, launched in Oxfordshire, is a predictive tyre management system that monitors tyre pressure and temperature in real time and sends data to a secure server for analysis. It uses cellular and satellite communications, provides alerts through a dashboard warning light and notifications, and can recommend corrective action to reduce breakdowns, downtime, fuel use, and tyre wear. In testing, it prevented 95% of tyre-related breakdowns and was developed by a consortium funded with £1.2 million through Innovate UK.

The passage explains how a “horns” double mid screen alignment can help isolate a star ballhandler against a Box & One defense, with options to drive, pass to rollers or corner shooters, use screen-and-pop actions, or flow into single/double continuity. It also stresses execution, coordination, scouting, defensive recognition, and using varied alignments to attack weak defenders.

Japanese government bonds firmed after a strong two-year auction, with the 10-year yield steady at 0.015 percent and futures up 0.04 point. The auction drew bids 5.51 times the amount offered, and the BOJ was due to release May purchase details later that day.

The message praises national blessings, reviews foreign relations and commercial disputes with Britain and France, notes treaties with Austria and others, reports favorable treasury and debt reductions, defends the tariff and protection of native industry, discusses Indian affairs, and summarizes progress in fortifications, roads, canals, the Navy, the Post Office, public buildings, land sales, and plans for the next census.

Jammu and Kashmir Deputy Chief Minister Nirmal Singh said the government is considering skill development courses and an optional skill development paper in educational institutions to give students technical vocational knowledge. He praised students at GCW Gandhi Nagar and GDC Nawakadal for activities including mushroom cultivation, florist work, chocolates, and paper mache items, and said colleges should improve technical skills and product quality to encourage entrepreneurship.

A fired Washington State Walmart employee returned days later to retrieve a safe he had tried to steal, but store employees found heroin and Xanax inside. He admitted the safe, container, and drugs were his and was booked into Pierce County Jail for unlawful possession of a controlled substance.

The study of 30 adrenalectomy specimens found that normal adrenal veins had asymmetrical longitudinal smooth muscle bundles similar to fibromuscular dysplasia, while adrenal cortical adenomas and pheochromocytomas often showed segmental arterial mediolysis-like changes and vascular complications such as hemorrhage and thrombosis. The authors suggest these findings may link adrenal hormones or receptors to the pathogenesis of FMD and SAM.

Donna Adelson was sentenced to life in prison plus 30 years for her role in the 2014 murder of Dan Markel. She maintained her innocence and said she would have stopped the plan if she had known about it, while Judge Stephen Everett said he could consider her “utter lack of remorse.”

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on October 26, 2021 reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2021. The report included the press release as Exhibit 99.1 and listed Exhibit 104 as the cover page interactive data file.

The passage says cloud-based HPC has expanded HPC architectures, with public cloud expected to become the most important option for manufacturing enterprises, followed by hybrid cloud HPC. IDC recommends deciding between building in-house HPC or buying HPC services, noting that public cloud HPC can offer technical and financial advantages, greater scalability, flexibility, security, resilience, and support for innovation, collaboration, and new business models.

Two pieces of ammunition were found in a bathroom at Litchfield High School on Wednesday morning, prompting a lockdown and a soft lockdown at the high school and middle school. Students were later dismissed to their parents, and multiple police officers responded to the school.

The passage argues that the Yankees and baseball have increasingly de-emphasized starting pitchers in favor of bullpens and closers, citing short outings, rising bullpen use, and concerns about slower games. It questions whether expensive starting pitchers are worth it and says MLB may need to address the trend sooner rather than later.

A new study found that airplane passengers in window seats who stay seated may have lower risk of exposure to germs, and estimated that on a 150-passenger flight only about one person would be infected on average if a hypothetical infectious passenger were in an aisle seat. The study, funded by Boeing, also found that aisle-seat passengers moved around more often, and that the 11 people closest to a sick passenger face the highest risk.

SuperTrend is a trend-following indicator created by Oliver Seban that uses ATR and a multiplier to form bands and signals trend changes when price crosses the prior value. The passage says it can work in intraday, daily, weekly, and ranging markets, adjusts to volatility, and is often used with RSI, moving averages, or Bollinger Bands. A weekly backtest on the S&P 500 using 10 and 3 reported about 65.79% win rate and around 67% accuracy, with a 24.6% max drawdown.

Encode’s Nathan Calvin accused OpenAI of using subpoenas and intimidation tactics to target critics and weaken California’s SB 53 AI safety law, while OpenAI said its actions were standard litigation and raised legitimate questions about Encode’s funding and ties. Calvin said Encode is not funded by Musk and that OpenAI’s conduct felt inconsistent with its nonprofit mission.

The message reports that the country is at peace, public health is high, and relief efforts are underway during hardship, while the economy remains in severe depression. It urges continued spending cuts, budget balancing, banking reform, and cooperation with other nations, and outlines further recommendations on taxes, government reorganization, veterans, and other legislation.

The court denied plaintiffs’ request to enjoin NASD Regulation’s Rule 8210 interviews and found no credible proof that the demands were issued as an agent of the government or that grand jury materials were improperly disclosed. It held that the DOE’s investigation was independent of the criminal investigation, though it noted the arrangements between CPAG and DOE warranted careful attention.

The passage criticizes We Energies and the PSC for allowing high electric rates and high executive pay, arguing that the utility has overbuilt power plants and delivered large shareholder returns. It says rates were once among the lowest but rose sharply after PSC became more compliant, and notes that CUB and ICE are pushing for lower electric prices, with some calling for a rate rollback instead of a freeze.

A Case Western Reserve University study estimates childhood exposure to domestic violence costs the U.S. federal government about $55 billion annually and nearly $50,000 per affected person over a lifetime, due to higher health-care costs, crime, and lower productivity.

Canadian Blood Services will open Canada’s largest blood donation clinic at Eau Claire Market on July 10, replacing the current 18-bed clinic. The new clinic will have 20 donation beds and underground parking. The organization is urging donations to help address a national blood shortage, especially low O negative supplies, and is aiming for 150,000 donations by July 1, though it is 50,000 short.

F2 Logistics aims for a fourth straight win and the No. 2 seed against Generika-Ayala in the PSL Grand Prix, while Sta. Lucia faces winless Smart in the opener. Generika-Ayala is coming off its first win after four losses, and several teams are still competing for positions from Nos. 3 to 7.

The passage describes the SD Memory Card physical layer specification, including licensing conditions, terminology, document structure, card types, capacities, speed classes, bus protocols, registers, initialization, data transfer, command handling, error conditions, electrical interface, SPI mode, and mechanical addenda. It also notes UHS-I and UHS-II modes, content protection, write protection, and additional features such as cache, self maintenance, command queue, and application performance classes.

The passage says Prince’s music becoming available on Spotify upset some fans because he had opposed it in life, and it lists other artists who have also refused or criticized Spotify, including Taylor Swift, Garth Brooks, Thom Yorke, Beyoncé, and Joanna Newsom.

Market Research Future’s report says the global blowout preventer market is expected to grow by 2021, driven by rising oil and gas demand, offshore exploration, and safety standards. The Middle East is expected to dominate, Asia-Pacific is also growing, and key players include Aker Solutions, Weatherford, FMC Technologies, Cameron, National Oil Well Verco, Proserve, and Uztel.

Prime Minister Justin Trudeau and Public Safety Minister Ralph Goodale expressed sorrow after a Toronto van attack, saying there was no apparent link to terrorism or national security concerns. Trudeau called it a senseless tragedy and praised first responders, while Goodale said the incident was a large homicide investigation. Toronto police arrested 25-year-old Alek Minassian, who was due in court later that day.
Lake Lugano, about an hour from Lake Como, is a quieter, lesser-known destination in Ticino with waterfront scenery, mild climate, villages, hiking, art, local cuisine, and fewer tourists.

European stock markets rose slightly at the start of trading on Tuesday, led by the energy sector after rising oil prices pushed Brent crude to a more than two-year high following the shutdown of the Forties pipeline. Investors were also focused on central bank interest rate decisions in the US, Britain and the eurozone later in the week.

Janet Yellen said Wall Street gains were not a bubble, though asset valuations were elevated and investors should diversify cautiously. She described the U.S. economy as strong, cited job growth and rising wages, and said she was disappointed not to get a second Fed term before Jerome Powell replaces her.

The passage is a repeated list of financial and business headlines, followed by promotional text for Dunas Capital, which says it is a Spanish asset manager founded in 2016, manages over €4.5 billion, focuses on capital preservation and risk management, and offers four mutual funds plus alternative investment products.

The majority held that the will’s reference to “grandchildren” included all grandchildren, including those of afterborn children, and dismissed the exceptions. A dissent argued the term should be limited to the grandchildren of the four named children because that was testator’s apparent intent.

AMD’s SEV-ES Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block specification defines a legal agreement, GHCB protocol, and related requirements for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests and hypervisors. It standardizes the 4 KB decrypted GHCB memory area, non-automatic exits, feature advertisement, GHCB MSR protocol, guest requests, page state change, AP booting, NMI handling, debug register support, and SNP restricted injection features, while stating that SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

The tax department is likely to use the net asset value method to calculate the fair market value of unlisted shares for capital gains tax, rather than the more subjective discounted cash flow method. The budget proposal says capital gains will be computed using the higher of the selling price or FMV, and this has raised concern among unlisted companies, especially start-ups.

Dogs of the Dow is a strategy that selects the 10 highest dividend-yielding stocks from the Dow Jones Industrial Average and rebalances annually. It became popular in 1991 through Michael B. O’Higgins’ book, but backtests in the passage show it has underperformed the S&P 500 over the last couple of decades.

Former Katsina State Governor Ibrahim Shehu Shema was remanded in EFCC custody over alleged N5.7 billion money laundering and fraud charges. He pleaded not guilty to 26 counts, and the court set 27 April 2018 to hear his bail application.

California officials and power generators began federally ordered settlement talks over electricity refunds, with California seeking nearly $9 billion while suppliers disputed any overcharges and sought payment for bills owed to them. Governor Gray Davis also met with new FERC commissioners, discussed natural gas, refunds, and allegations against Duke Energy, and officials urged compromise on broader energy issues.

The passage describes COVIDFast, an RNA extraction-free RT-qPCR assay for rapid, high-throughput SARS-CoV-2 detection using either anterior nares swabs (SwabFAST) or saliva (SalivaFAST). It reports buffer optimization, buffer stability, analytical and clinical validation, and real-world use of 409,883 tests with an overall positive rate of 8.10%.

The S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller indices showed continued U.S. home price growth in February 2018, with the National Index up 6.3% year over year, the 10-City Composite up 6.5%, and the 20-City Composite up 6.8%. Seattle, Las Vegas, and San Francisco had the largest annual gains among the 20 cities, and all 20 cities rose month over month.

Coach Quenneville said the team has experience in big games, must stay focused and not get ahead of itself, and is relying on preparation, consistency, depth, and top players rising to the challenge. He described the playoffs and series as a difficult process, noted the team’s resilience and improved play against Anaheim, and emphasized that the team must keep getting better shift by shift.

In this accident insurance case, the court held that the insurer’s denial of liability excused proof of death, but did not waive the policy’s time limit for suing on the death benefit. The judgment for the plaintiff was reversed, and a new trial was granted only on the weekly disability indemnity claim.

Austria’s Financial Market Authority raised its expected proceeds from selling Heta Asset Resolution assets to 8.6 billion euros, up from 6.0 billion. The increase reflects better-than-expected sales and would benefit the Austrian state and help fund about 4 billion euros in initial payments to Heta creditors, mainly Carinthia.

The preliminary inquiry into the murders of Phyllis Caesar and Constance Fraser continued before Magistrate Judy Latchman, with three more police ranks and former corporal Derwin Eastman testifying. Three men are charged in connection with the 2017 robbery killings, and the inquiry continues on Monday.

The passage describes SD memory card commands and behaviors, including CMD19 tuning, data read/write and erase operations, lock/unlock and Card Ownership Protection using CMD42, application commands via CMD55, switch functions and high-speed mode via CMD6, CMD8 interface checks, bus timing, CRC rules, and timeout conditions.

The paper proposes a DNN-Transformer-AE framework for corporate tax risk supervision that combines static enterprise features, temporal financial data, and autoencoder-based anomaly detection to output risk scores and high/medium/low risk levels. On a real dataset of about 12,000 enterprises, it outperforms baseline models with 0.91 accuracy and 0.88 macro F1.

The passage argues that magnon-phonon coupling can transfer orbital degrees of freedom between magnons and phonons through symmetry breaking and quantum geometry. In a honeycomb antiferromagnet model, this coupling gives phonons finite orbital angular moment and enhances electric polarization and transverse voltage, which are proposed as experimental probes of magnon-polaron orbital dynamics.

The IMF urged Saudi Arabia to pace its economic reforms and price hikes to avoid harming growth, while noting progress on Vision 2030 and tax reforms. Saudi Arabia faces large budget deficits and near-zero GDP growth, with further austerity measures and a VAT planned for next year.

Value area trading uses the volume profile to find the price range where 70% of trading volume occurred in a period, helping identify support and resistance, buy and sell zones, breakouts, and reversals. It is used across timeframes and markets, but it can produce false signals and requires risk management such as stop-losses and position sizing.

The study uses first-principles calculations and an embedded cluster expansion model to compute equilibrium vacancy concentrations in a nine-component refractory alloy. It finds that group 4 elements greatly increase vacancy concentrations, short-range order strongly affects vacancy behavior, and binary bonding/ordering energetics correlate with vacancy concentrations. The work also shows that rigorous finite-temperature sampling differs from single-SQS approximations and can better predict vacancy thermodynamics.

Astronomers and citizen scientists will observe next week’s U.S. solar eclipse, using ground-based equipment, satellites, planes, balloons, and public participation to study the sun, Earth’s weather, space weather, and animal and plant behavior. The eclipse is expected to provide major science, especially about the sun’s corona, and has historical significance for discoveries such as helium and evidence for Einstein’s relativity.
The superintendent of Iowa’s largest school district was arrested by Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

The court held that a levy by extent is construed like a deed, so the debtor’s buildings passed with the land even though they stood on blocks. Parol evidence was inadmissible to show the buildings were orally excepted or reserved, and judgment was entered for the plaintiff.

A Danish study found that children born to mothers with rheumatoid arthritis had higher risks of developing rheumatoid arthritis, thyroid disease, and epilepsy than children of mothers without the disease. The researchers said the findings should increase doctors’ awareness and prompt special attention to child development.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020 reports revenue of $35.0 billion and net income of $10.8 billion for the quarter, versus $30.6 billion and $8.8 billion a year earlier. The company’s main segments were Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing, and it noted that COVID-19 had minimal net impact on revenue in the quarter.

The passage describes video coding techniques, especially intra prediction and non-separable transforms. It says coding information for a block can signal a directional mode using a nominal mode and angular offset, and a non-separable transform can be selected from a transform set based on the nominal mode and an optional transform index. It also discusses non-directional modes such as DC, PAETH, SMOOTH, SMOOTH_V, SMOOTH_H, recursive filtering, and CfL, and notes that non-separable secondary transforms may not apply to PAETH or recursive filtering modes.

A University of Maryland study of 1,099 college students found that energy drink consumption between ages 21 and 24 was associated with a greater risk of later cocaine or non-medical prescription stimulant use, especially among those with persistent energy drink use. The researchers said the link should be investigated further.

The study examines Hungarian higher education lecturers, focusing on development after 1990, employment rules, staff structure, earnings, and doctoral students. It finds that higher education expanded until the 2000s, then became more restrictive under later government policies, while lecturer numbers did not fall in line with student numbers. Hungarian lecturers are relatively old, the share of women has risen but remains low internationally, university professor numbers have declined sharply, and doctoral graduates in academia face lower lifetime earnings than those in business, with Hungary also performing poorly in doctoral student comparisons.

The Scottish Accountancy & Finance Awards recognise accountants’ work in private and public sector organisations. The 2018 event, hosted by Sarah Heaney, includes dinner, entertainment by DNA, and awards in categories such as large and small accountancy firm, finance director, young accountant, tax team, and corporate finance team.

The speaker says Detroit was his first team and that he has fond memories of the city and playing for the Red Wings. He recalls enjoying his time there, being shocked by his trade, and says he later believed in Washington’s players despite the trade not working out at first.

Azerbaijan plans to increase exports of organic honey and beekeeping products, as global demand is expected to rise sharply. Agriculture Minister Heydar Asadov said Azerbaijan sold 6 tonnes of honey last year and will seek more state support for beekeeping and access to premium markets.

Legal experts and public education advocates criticize Texas for investigating teachers’ social media posts about Charlie Kirk’s killing, saying it threatens educators’ First Amendment rights. The Texas Education Agency is reviewing complaints and could discipline teachers, including possible license revocation, while supporters argue the posts were reprehensible and inappropriate.

Marc Ó Sé said an injury-free James O'Donoghue could be a huge boost for Kerry, praising his nine-point return against Clare and saying more games should build his confidence and strengthen Kerry’s attack.

Bond trading strategies are systematic approaches to buying or selling bonds, often used for diversification and uncorrelated returns. The passage describes Treasury bond strategies, notes that interest rates strongly affect bond prices, says bond trading can be automated, and mentions day trading bonds and beginner strategies such as dollar-cost averaging.

An Enron mentions roundup reported that Enron was in advanced talks to sell Portland General Electric to Northwest Natural Gas for about $1.8 billion to $2.8 billion, with Northwest expected to assume about $1 billion in debt. It also noted Enron plans to cut 500 jobs in Europe and reported problems with its India asset sales, including the BG Group deal and possible sale of the Dabhol stake, while Tata Power was said to be preparing a bid.

Microsoft announced that Frank H. Brod will retire as Chief Accounting Officer, stepping down July 31, 2020 and staying through September 30, 2020 for transition support. Alice L. Jolla will become Corporate Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer effective July 31, 2020 and will receive a $1.5 million stock award under the 2017 Stock Plan.

FULE is a full user area logical erase that completely erases the card’s user area. It uses CMD32 with argument 0, CMD33 with the end of user area, then CMD38 with argument 00000002h. The host must check the FULE_SUPPORT bit; if unsupported, the card performs ERASE instead. Out-of-sequence commands cause ERASE_SEQ_ERROR or ERASE_RESET, and FULE is supported only for SDHC and SDXC cards, not SPI.

Bitcoin fell below US$8,000 before recovering some losses, after dropping more than half from its December record high amid regulatory threats, a Japanese exchange hack, price-manipulation fears, and Facebook’s ad ban. Rival cryptocurrencies also fell sharply as concerns about the industry grew.

After the Roseanne reboot was canceled over Roseanne Barr’s racist tweet about Valerie Jarrett, President Trump criticized ABC for not apologizing to him for negative statements aired about him. Jarrett said ABC CEO Bob Iger apologized to her and called the tweet racist and bigoted.

Best Hope Services says it will launch Nigeria’s first online trade exhibition in May to promote local innovations, allowing exhibitors and visitors to participate remotely. The e-fair, created by Prof. Joseph Mba, is expected to support national development and will cover four areas, with registration open ahead of the May 1 expo.

Microsoft is reportedly developing Polaris, a modular Windows 10 version based on Windows Core OS that uses CShell, supports desktop, laptop, and 2-in-1 devices, and runs only UWP apps from the Microsoft Store. It would strip out legacy desktop features, may improve speed, security, and battery life, and could use remote virtualization to run older desktop applications.

Researchers found that polypropylene’s mechanical properties depend on molecular regularity and thermal treatment. Higher isotacticity and crystallinity produce stronger, harder materials, and the findings can help synthesize polypropylene with predetermined properties such as elasticity or hardness.

The passage says U.S.-China relations should remain important and strategic, with expanded trade and cooperation on peace and stability in the Western Pacific, while also opposing aggression. It stresses that U.S. policy toward Taiwan must follow the Taiwan Relations Act, maintain defensive support for Taiwan, and uphold commitments and congressional oversight.

The JACL Kakehashi Program, run by the Japanese American Citizens League and JICE with funding from Japan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, will select up to 200 participants to build Japan-U.S. relations. It offers a nine-day trip to Japan with visits to historical and educational sites, cultural activities, and a homestay. Eligible applicants are Japanese American or Asian American students or young professionals ages 18–25; Japanese nationals and passport holders may not apply.

Wal-Mart’s reported bid for Bonobos is part of its effort to expand in online fashion, attract younger customers, and compete with Amazon. It would be its fourth acquisition of a small online clothing brand since early 2017, as it continues e-commerce investments under Marc Lore despite lagging behind Amazon online.

The passage introduces molecular augmented dynamics (MAD), an O(N) modified MD method designed to find low-energy, ab-initio accurate atomistic structures that match experimental data. It develops analytic, linearly scaling experimental forces for XRD, ND, PDF, and XPS, including thermal broadening, and defines MAD as a Hamiltonian combining kinetic, interatomic, and experimental potential terms.

Intel has released Coffee Lake 14nm desktop processors and Z370 chipsets, with Z370 motherboards already on sale. More Coffee Lake processors and H310/B360 chipsets are planned for early 2018, enterprise vPro parts and Q370/Q360 for the second quarter, Gemini Lake Pentium Silver and Celeron processors in November 2017, Coffee Lake notebook processors in 2018, and 10nm Cannon Lake and Ice Lake later in 2018 and 2019.

The passage shares weekly making tips, including magnets on alligator clips for difficult hookups, an old motor used as a video turntable, a hobby knife added to a compass, marking untrue stock edges with a squiggly line, turning a drill press into a drum sander, and recommending a $10 Ikea flexi-neck LED lamp for workbench lighting.

In 1976, Kent Howerton won the AMA 500cc National Motocross opener at Moto-Masters, followed by Bob Hannah and Tony DiStefano, with six different brands in the top six. In 1982, Ricky Johnson won the High Point 250 National, Darrell Shultz won the 500 Class, and Yamaha riders said the Trans-USA Championship was not worth the money; Yamaha also ended its use of coach Gary Bailey. In 1987, Ross Pederson won the Montreal Supercross.

The “Drive & Kick” offense is a three-player weave from a 3-2 spread that uses dribble penetration, with the ball handler attacking the basket and passing back বাইরে if the drive is cut off. The action continues through repeated drive-and-kick exchanges, can be used to run time off the clock, and includes corner kick-outs and back-cut options against baseline help.

The passage describes the NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU and its Ampere architecture, highlighting major performance improvements over V100 for AI, HPC, and data analytics. Key features include third-generation Tensor Cores with TF32, BF16, FP64, and sparsity support, 40 GB HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, asynchronous copy/barriers, CUDA Task Graph acceleration, and Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitioning for up to seven GPU Instances. It also describes DGX A100 as a 5 PFLOPS system built around eight A100 GPUs.

The Housing Authority of the City of Santa Barbara won a Gold Nugget Award for Bradley Studios, a 54-unit affordable housing development for low and extremely low-income residents with special needs. Built in 2012, the project includes community spaces and social service offices and was praised for its design and community focus.

Spatial transcriptomics and single-cell imaging of cutaneous leishmaniasis lesions showed that IDO1 and PD-L1 are concentrated in myeloid cell-rich niches, especially mature dendritic cells and CCL18+ macrophages, and are associated with nearby CD8+ memory T cells and Tregs. IL-32, produced mainly by CD8+ T cells and Tregs, was a common correlate of these niches across Sri Lankan CL, Brazilian CL, and Indian PKDL, and high abundance of IL-32+ CD8+ T cells was linked to slower cure after treatment in Sri Lankan patients.

CDC acting director Jim O’Neill called for the MMR vaccine to be split into three separate shots, a move unsupported by evidence that it would improve safety or effectiveness. The passage says experts warn this could reduce vaccination rates and increase disease, and that monovalent versions are no longer available in the U.S.

The MSPM0C1105/6 are ultra-low-power 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ microcontrollers running up to 32 MHz, with up to 64 KB flash, 8 KB SRAM, integrated analog and digital peripherals, and support for 1.62 V to 3.6 V operation over -40°C to 125°C. They include multiple timers, UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, DMA, RTC, watchdogs, GPIO, security features, debug support, and configurable power modes from RUN to SHUTDOWN.

The study examined empathy among 206 Education faculty teachers at a university in Spain using the Interpersonal Reactivity Index. Teachers showed high overall empathy, with optimal scores in perspective taking, fantasy, and empathic concern, and moderate personal distress. Female teachers scored higher on all empathy dimensions, while contract status, teaching experience, degree taught, and campus location showed no significant relationship with empathy.

The Department opposes dividing the General Assembly into four regional sections or decentralizing the international organization before it is firmly established. It also outlines the Mexico City Conference and U.S. discussions with Latin American ambassadors on the Dumbarton Oaks proposals, and recommends an immediate meeting of jurists to prepare a statute for the proposed international court of justice.

UNC Chapel Hill placed Professor Dwayne Dixon on leave while investigating alleged advocacy of politically motivated violence. The action followed right-wing accusations linking him to extremist activism and campus flyers, though Dixon said he left Silver Valley Redneck Revolt in 2018.

At Great Lakes Dragaway in Wisconsin, three Illinois men were shot dead at close range during a large auto racing event. Authorities said the victims were gang members and suspected the killings were gang-related, but the shooter remained at large.

The passage is a hockey discussion about coaching, team balance, playoff progress, player development, and confidence in the group’s consistency. It mentions Corey Crawford’s strong season, Bryan Bickell’s growth, respect for opponents’ strengths, and the team’s goal to sustain success through continuity, internal improvement, and strong goaltending.

The Bearish Engulfing candlestick pattern appears in an uptrend, with a bearish candle fully engulfing a bullish candle, and suggests a potential reversal to a downtrend. Traders may use it with other indicators, risk management, and confirmation of market momentum or context. The passage says its success rate and win rate in the stock market are between 55% and 65%, and its accuracy can be improved with added filters like RSI.

The 50 EMA strategy is a technical analysis method that uses the 50-day exponential moving average to identify trend direction and generate buy and sell signals, usually for medium-term trends. Traders often combine it with indicators like RSI or MACD, use medium-term timeframes, and backtest it on different assets; the passage says results vary, with improved performance when the 50 EMA is used as a filter with a second indicator.

AMD Secure RNG Library provides APIs that wrap the RDRAND and RDSEED x86 instructions to return single values, arrays, or byte streams of 16-, 32-, or 64-bit random data, with retry handling and hardware support checks via CPUID. It is intended to simplify access to AMD hardware random number generation for applications such as cryptography, HPC, and seeding PRNGs, while abstracting low-level MMIO and instruction handling.

A federal appeals court allowed the Education Department to fire half of the 550 employees in its Office for Civil Rights, after earlier injunctions and a Supreme Court ruling in a related case. The court said it could not conclude the OCR case differed enough from the Supreme Court’s order in McMahon.

Liberal nonprofits are preparing for possible Trump administration investigations and funding attacks by considering emergency funds, mergers, legal challenges, relocating abroad, or giving up 501(c)(3) status. The passage says Republicans and administration figures have accused nonprofit networks of supporting the “radical left,” while nonprofit leaders warn the effort could damage civil society, force self-censorship, and reshape how money is spent.

Carolina Herrera hired Lisa Arnold as vice president of retail and Thea Terenik as vice president of global merchandising. Both are based in New York and report to Emilie Rubinfeld. Arnold previously worked at Chanel, Roger Vivier, Dior and Ralph Lauren, while Terenik came from Calvin Klein and earlier worked at Alexander Wang and Barneys New York.

British shares fell on Thursday as Fed minutes signaled possible balance sheet shrinkage later this year, with the FTSE 100 down about 0.5%. Banks led declines, Pearson dropped after an Exane downgrade and trading ex-dividend, while real estate and some miners rose. Allied Minds hit a record low below its IPO price, while Tullow Oil and BTG gained.

U.S. manufacturing faces a shortage of qualified workers for automation and advanced technology, with nearly 390,000 jobs open and more expected. Many available jobs now require education, technical know-how, or specialized skills, leaving workers like Herbie Mays unable to qualify.

The study examined orthopaedic and trauma referrals to Kenyatta National Hospital before and after enforcement of Kenya’s 2014 referral guidelines in July 2021. It found reduced referrals from lower-tier facilities, fewer direct referrals from some private facilities, and increased referrals from higher tiers, with human resource capacity, infrastructure, equipment, patient preference, and financial considerations influencing referrals.

The 1-2-2 zone is a strong defense against outside shooting teams and fast breaks, and can help protect a late lead. The passage describes player alignments, defensive shifts, point and wing responsibilities, corner trap and wing corner options, switching to a 2-1-2 on the first pass, and extending the zone into a half- or full-court press.

New research suggests probiotics, especially Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG (LGG), may help protect the liver from drug- and alcohol-related damage. In mice, an LGG-rich diet improved the liver’s antioxidant response and reduced oxidative damage from acetaminophen, with Nrf2 playing a key role. Further studies are needed to see whether this applies to humans.

The passage lists multiple March 28, 2001 news items about Enron, including Jeff Skilling saying Enron’s stock fell because of multiple compression, Enron executives receiving large 2000 bonuses, a failed Blockbuster video venture, EnronOnline’s trading expansion, a Nigerian power-market overhaul, and Enron unit Encom presenting a thermal power plant plan in Japan.

The passage argues that education worldwide remained deficient by 2020 in terms of access, quality, and equality, and that COVID-19 worsened these problems through school closures and distance learning. It presents the Sustainable Development Goals and the Incheon Declaration as humanity’s 2030 vision for education, with Goal 4 as central. It also says Comparative and International Education should study the pandemic’s effects, the role of technology, and its own shortcomings to help build better education systems.

The court affirmed judgment for defendants, holding that because the contractor’s bond and contract required the contractor to furnish materials and complete the building “according to the contract,” the guarantor was liable for unpaid material liens. The court also held the signer was a guarantor, not a surety, notice of acceptance was unnecessary, and the burden was on the guarantor to plead and prove lack of notice of default and resulting damage.

The passage describes new shading advancements including mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture-space shading, and multi-view rendering. Mesh shading moves geometry processing to highly parallel GPU programs, enabling more objects per scene and new geometry algorithms. VRS dynamically varies shading rate to improve efficiency and frame rate. Texture-space shading caches results for reuse, and MVR renders multiple views in one pass.

Texas Tech briefly posted FAQ guidance on new anti-trans policies, saying the rules apply only to instructional activities and not research, but advising faculty not to include LGBTQ allyship statements or pronouns on syllabi. The FAQ was removed after three days, and faculty on other campuses reported conflicting verbal instructions and concern about limits on teaching transgender-related content.

The passage promotes the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, highlighting unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 spend in 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months, no annual fee, and cell phone protection up to $600. It also lists other credit card offers, including Capital One Quicksilver and Citi cards, along with disclosure and advertising information.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated January 28, 2019, stating that it issued a press release and shareholder letter updating guidance for the quarter ended January 27, 2019. The filing lists the press release and shareholder letter as exhibits.

VentureWire’s June 7, 2001 newsletter highlighted FreeMarkets and Adexa ending a $340 million acquisition deal, inVentures merging with Redwood Partners, and several new financing rounds, including ChipData’s $23 million second round, Corus Pharma’s $18.5 million Series A, and ThruPoint’s $31 million round. It also reported layoffs, shutdowns, acquisitions, board appointments, a new nCoTec fund closing, and Whitney & Co. losing another managing director.

The passage describes route planning systems and methods for vehicles, especially AGVs, that use map node information and motion status information of other vehicles to modify a topological map before planning a route. It outlines determining start and destination nodes, calculating node costs, and generating routes to reduce collisions and improve route accuracy.

The passage outlines a U.S. approach to the Soviet Union in 1983: maintain firm arms control standards, use regional and human rights issues to pressure Moscow, manage economic ties carefully, and pursue limited reciprocal bilateral steps. It also proposes building a structured dialogue at multiple levels, potentially leading to a summit, while keeping responsibility for tensions on the USSR if it does not meet U.S. criteria.

A bankrupt who has been discharged has no standing to challenge a refusal to stay execution on property conveyed to his wife before bankruptcy, because the order does not affect his rights. Any issues about the creditor’s right to proceed or the validity of a sheriff’s sale of the wife’s interest must be raised by the wife, not the bankrupt.

Delta Insurance says the South Island technology sector is growing, especially in Christchurch, Dunedin, Nelson and Queenstown, and highlights its technology, cyber liability, and other liability insurance offerings. It has joined Canterbury Tech, is New Zealand’s only risk management-led cyber insurance provider, and says its local presence helps it better serve South Island businesses and brokers.

A new study says traditional yogurt in Bulgaria and Turkey can be made by adding four live ants to warmed cow’s milk, because bacteria on the ants and the ants themselves acidify and thicken the milk. Microbes from frozen or dehydrated ants are less effective.

MacKenzie Scott donated $42 million, including major unrestricted gifts to scholarship providers serving students of color and underrepresented communities, such as 10,000 Degrees, Native Forward, and UNCF. The passage says her giving remains focused on diversity, equity, inclusion, education equity, and trust-based grants, with continued support for HBCUs and other equity-centered organizations.

The passage describes Lisa Baird’s first year as NWSL commissioner, including the league’s pandemic response, the Challenge Cup and Fall Series, rising media exposure and sponsorships, expansion, and ongoing challenges around fan growth, governance, compensation, and social justice.

The study reports ultra-fast spray pyrolysis synthesis of NiO and 7 wt% Cu-doped NiO thin films on ITO-coated glass in 1.5 minutes. Cu doping slightly increased lattice parameters, reduced crystallite size from 21 to 20 nm, narrowed the bandgap from 3.70 to 3.65 eV, and lowered photoluminescence intensity. Electrical testing showed higher LPG sensitivity for NiO:Cu than pure NiO, with sensitivity at 5 V increasing from 1.3 to 1.8.

Apple Inc. reported that on November 13, 2017 it issued and sold $7 billion in senior unsecured notes maturing from 2019 to 2047, with semi-annual interest payments, under an underwriting agreement and indenture.

The passage describes AMD AGESA PPI, HOB, PEIM, DXE driver, build, and host-environment interfaces across boot stages, including early/post initialization, reset coordination, memory initialization, late table generation, suspend/resume, and required call-outs such as memory allocation, reset, SPD reads, and AP task execution.

Best Buy is discounting the Lenovo Legion 7i Gen 10 gaming laptop by $220 to $1,650. It features a color-accurate HDR-ready OLED display, an RTX 5060 GPU, strong keyboard and trackpad, but battery life is under five hours.

The Jerusalem Post says traditional business models are no longer sustainable, and although it has not put up a paywall, it asks readers to support it with a $5 monthly membership that provides ad-light access, Premium Section and magazine content, an ePaper, and Hebrew-learning content.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on February 1, 2018 it announced its fourth quarter 2017 and full-year 2017 financial results, with the related press release and non-GAAP information included as exhibits.

Alek Minassian, 25, is charged with 10 counts of first-degree murder after a rental van was driven into pedestrians in Toronto, killing 10 and injuring 15. He made his first court appearance as Canadians mourned the attack, while officials said it did not change the national threat level.
U.S. airlines had record-low cancellation, baggage mishandling, and passenger bumping rates in 2016, while on-time arrivals improved to 81.4 percent and traveler complaints fell 11.3 percent.

The passage argues that improving farmers’ condition requires broad education, farmer organization, and cooperation between farmers and government. It highlights agricultural education, farmers’ associations, irrigation and forest preservation, a proposed memorial amphitheater at Arlington, and calls for Congress to control marriage, divorce, and polygamy.

Researchers at Oregon Health & Science University reported that their attempt to create functional human eggs in the lab has mostly failed so far, though they made some progress with a chromosome-reduction process called “mitomeiosis.” The technique had previously produced healthy mouse pups from lab-created eggs, but remains far from clinical testing.

A small study of 19 mothers and their babies found that mothers showed more dopamine activity when watching their own babies, and higher dopamine was linked to more sensitive, optimal caregiving. The researchers suggested dopamine may help motivate mother-child bonding, though the study was small and did not prove cause and effect.

The passage explains how trauma and adverse childhood experiences can affect postsecondary students’ behavior, learning, attendance, and academic success, including in occupational therapy programs. It outlines trauma-informed care principles, implementation domains, and educational strategies for higher education, and reports that trauma-informed training and simulation models can improve OT students’ knowledge and self-efficacy.

CongressDailyAM reported House appropriations allocations for FY02 that mostly tracked Bush’s budget but added money for Labor-HHS, VA-HUD, and Energy and Water. It also covered House Republicans’ view that the Senate Democratic takeover would have limited effect on House partisanship, Steve Largent’s planned resignation to run for Oklahoma governor, Hutchinson’s departure and its impact on liability reform, ergonomics forums announced by Labor Secretary Chao, FDA warnings about mailed prescription drugs, debate over generic drug patent reform, EU concerns over Bush’s steel probe, Senate negotiations on nominee procedures, and Bush’s planned nomination of Jo Anne Barnhart to head SSA.
