AMC Entertainment is proposing to double authorized shares to 1.1 billion, which could dilute shareholders. Despite debt refinancings, net debt remains above $3 billion, Q3 box office revenue was weak, and the stock trades at a steep discount because of ongoing losses, negative equity, and cash burn.

The passage argues that Robert Stuart’s work suggests the BBC Panorama documentary “Saving Syria’s Children” may have involved fabricated or misleading footage about an alleged 2013 attack in Syria, citing disputed injuries, inconsistent victim counts, and conflicting timelines, and it raises broader concerns about the BBC and related medical personnel.

The study models the global risk of pfhrp2/3 deletions, finding malaria prevalence as the main driver and estimating strong linkage between pfhrp2 and pfhrp3 deletions. It predicts many regions, especially in Africa, are at risk of increased false-negative HRP2-based RDT results and says the maps can guide surveillance and alternative RDT deployment.

Researchers created functional human egg cells from skin cells by combining cloning techniques, fertilization, and chemical coaxing, causing chromosomes to be halved and early embryos to form. The method is still inefficient and produced no viable embryos, but it is a proof of concept that could one day help treat infertility.

The passage discusses protein folding as a problem of understanding what 3D shape a protein chain folds into and how to synthesize a protein to achieve a desired shape. It models protein backbones as fixed-angle linkages, then reviews results and open problems on span, flattening, flat state connectivity, and locked chains, including NP-hardness results for some planar cases and open questions in 3D. It also presents a theorem for producible protein chains: under a cone model inspired by the ribosome, producible configurations can be canonicalized, are connected, and all flat states are connected by algorithmic motions.

An email newsletter titled “IEP News 7/31” circulated multiple news items about California’s energy crisis, including reports on Gray Davis’ energy contracts, SEC scrutiny of his advisers, stock holdings of his spokesman, Southern California Edison bailout efforts, San Francisco public power ballot measures, and federal refund rulings that reduced expected California electricity refunds.

Gas colic is a common but least serious form of colic, caused by gas buildup in the large colon when digestion, motility, forage intake, stress, feed changes, dehydration, or exercise are poor. Prevention focuses on steady access to forage, pasture turnout, gradual feed changes, slow feeders, and reducing stress and confinement.

Newark police released names and photos of nine suspects in seven unsolved shootings and robberies dating back to June 2016 and asked the public for help locating them. The cases include an armed grocery-store robbery, a taxi-driver robbery, another armed robbery, and a shooting that injured three people. Tips can be submitted anonymously by phone, online, or through the department’s app.

Asus has launched the Zenfone 5Z in India in Meteor Silver and Midnight Blue, with prices starting at Rs. 29,999 and sales on Flipkart from July 15. It has a 6.2-inch notch display, Snapdragon 845, Android Oreo, dual rear cameras, a 3300mAh battery, and launch offers including discounts, EMI, and Jio cashback.

The Michigan Supreme Court held that sexual delinquency is an alternate sentencing provision, not a penalty enhancement, and that a separate jury is required unless waived. Helzer’s gross indecency convictions were affirmed, but the case was remanded for a separate sexual delinquency hearing, with 20 peremptory challenges for that jury and no reference to the sexual delinquency charge during the principal trial. Chief Justice Kavanagh dissented, calling the statute void for vagueness.

Tesla reported that underwriters fully exercised their option to buy an additional $127.5 million of its 2.375% Convertible Senior Notes due 2022, issued on March 30, 2017. Tesla also entered into additional note hedge transactions and additional warrant transactions related to the option notes, paying about $26.6 million for the hedges and receiving about $6.9 million from the warrant sale.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture, including GDDR6 memory, improved compression and caching, NVLink, and support for higher-resolution displays, HDR, and faster video encoding/decoding. It also covers new hardware and software features such as RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, Tensor Cores for NGX and DLSS AI functions, and graphics techniques like mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, and multi-view rendering.

The American Cancer Society updated its guideline to recommend colorectal cancer screening begin at age 45 for average-risk adults, with regular screening through age 75 and individualized decisions at ages 76 to 85. It recommends several screening test options without preference, and says positive non-colonoscopy tests should be followed by colonoscopy.

Higher wind supply and easing demand pushed European prompt power prices lower on Tuesday, while forwards fell with coal prices. Traders said the market outlook remains bearish as French nuclear supply improved and demand is expected to drop next week. German and French power prices fell sharply, and Germany’s 2019 contract edged lower near its record high.

The University of Manchester’s Students’ Union launched Earth Week with a panel featuring Asad Rehman and Martin Empson. Rehman linked climate change, displacement, and the #NoBanNoWall campaign, arguing that poorer countries suffer most and need legal protection. Empson called for public involvement through protests, petitions, MPs, donations, and cooperation between environmental and migration movements.

American Girl will release its first male doll, Logan Everett, on Thursday as part of a new contemporary series. Logan plays drums for Tenney Grant, and the company also plans to reintroduce Felicity Merriman and release two new dolls later in 2017: Z Yang in spring and Nanea in the fall.

Canada’s Privacy Commissioner is opening a formal investigation into Uber’s 2016 data breach, which affected tens of millions of users. The breach has also triggered investigations in other countries and a class-action lawsuit in Alberta. Uber says it has no evidence the stolen data was misused, but has not said how many Canadian users were affected.

The passage introduces tensor-network methods for modelling radical-pair spin dynamics, aiming to address ensemble averaging, exponential scaling, and long-time propagation challenges. It presents the radical-pair Hamiltonian, spin-state observables, and three approaches: stochastic MPS, vectorised MPDO, and locally purified tensor networks.

An expert described the Thailand cave rescue of 12 boys and their coach as one of the toughest he has seen, noting that flooding rescues usually depend on waiting for water to subside. He said the group was found alive but may face weeks underground because monsoon rains could keep the cave flooded, they have had no food for nine days, and the main options are risky diving, drilling, finding another entrance, or waiting.

Terry Rozier scored a career-high 31 points and Jayson Tatum added 27 as the short-handed Celtics beat the Hawks 119-110. Boston overcame a halftime deficit with a 41-20 third quarter, while Taurean Prince led Atlanta with a career-high 31 points.

Trump criticized CNN’s book cover photo of himself as the “worst” photo, prompting many Twitter reactions and awkward photo responses. The passage also notes that other Trump photos and tweets have recently attracted attention, including a retweet of Ivanka Trump’s New Year’s photo montage and a briefly followed “Emergency Kittens” account.

Sources said the Bank of Japan is unlikely to end ultra-loose policy soon because it wants to avoid a sharp yen rise and inflation remains low. Although the economy has strengthened, any policy adjustment is expected to be modest and cautious, with officials still worried about the effects of normalization, political pressure, and limited room to respond to future downturns.

The Arizona Supreme Court held that A.R.S. § 13-4033(B) bars direct appeal of a contested post-judgment restitution order when the order is entered pursuant to a plea agreement that capped restitution. The court affirmed dismissal of Hoffman’s appeal and said review must be sought through Rule 32 post-conviction relief.

The passage describes a blood-based, non-invasive test that detects circulating glial cells using GFAP and OLIG2 immunocytochemistry to identify glial malignancy and distinguish it from benign brain tumors and brain metastases. In analytical and clinical validation studies, the test showed high sensitivity, specificity, and concordance with tissue diagnosis, and was proposed as an aid to diagnosis when biopsy is difficult or risky.

Apple Inc.’s Q1 2022 Form 10-Q reported quarterly net sales of $123.9 billion and net income of $34.6 billion, both higher than the prior year. Revenue increased in iPhone, Mac, Wearables, and Services, while iPad declined. The company also reported $37.1 billion in cash and cash equivalents, $381.2 billion in total assets, $309.3 billion in total liabilities, and $71.9 billion in shareholders’ equity. During the quarter, Apple repurchased $20.4 billion of common stock, paid $3.7 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents, and continued to face COVID-19-related operational impacts.

U.S. stock futures edged higher ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision and Janet Yellen’s statement, with economists expecting a rate hike. Options volume was average Tuesday, and Apple, Tesla, and Micron saw notable trading activity. Apple CEO Tim Cook confirmed the company is working on autonomous systems, which boosted AAPL trading and options sentiment.

Carleton University is creating a five-year renewable chair in conjuring arts to study the history of magic, perception, and deception, funded by a $2 million matching grant and drawing about 80 applicants. The passage also describes a University of London experiment suggesting people can become stuck on initial explanations of a magic trick, making them less able to find the correct solution.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated July 31, 2018, stating that it issued a press release and data sheet on its third fiscal quarter results for the quarter ended June 30, 2018, and attached them as exhibits.

Adam Henrique and Travis Zajac said the Kings were a big, fast, deep team with strong defense and goaltending, and that their team did not play its best in the first game, showing nerves, poor execution, and too many turnovers. They said the game improved as it went on, noted Henrique’s return added depth, and said they need to start better, execute more, and use their forecheck and cycles more effectively in the next game.

The speaker says his dad, Patrick Kane, supported him throughout the years, and credits coaches and Buffalo’s hockey environment for his development. He says he can play wing or center and likes both setting up and finishing plays, naming several coaches and a supportive fan he stays in touch with. He also says he would like to bring a Cup to Buffalo, but having his rights there would already be special.

The passage reviews four “Trump trades” since the election and inauguration: hospital stocks fell then recovered slightly, infrastructure stocks rose then leveled off, bank stocks gained strongly then partially retreated, and small-cap stocks rose further on expectations of tax cuts. It says early market optimism over Trump’s agenda has cooled because of legislative setbacks and uncertainty about his ability to enact his proposals.

Mark Begich’s entry into Alaska’s governor race has raised fears among some Democrats and independents that he could split the vote with Gov. Bill Walker and help Republicans. The race is expected to be a three-way contest among Begich, Walker and the Republican nominee, with Mike Dunleavy seen as an early GOP favorite.

Dr. Howard W. Ellzey, a Memphis physician, was convicted of conspiracy and multiple counts of illegally distributing controlled substances for issuing large numbers of amphetamine prescriptions outside ordinary medical practice. The Sixth Circuit affirmed, finding sufficient evidence and no reversible error in the admission of evidence, jury instructions, indictment language, or voir dire.

Energy Central Direct’s November 23, 2001 edition highlights electric power news, with top stories on utility rate decisions, E.ON acquisitions, hydro relicensing, and Los Angeles keeping a Nevada power-plant share. It also summarizes major sections on California market issues, Enron’s crisis, mergers and acquisitions, regulation, rates, power projects, renewables, and financial results.

This week’s iOS and Android deals include A Good Snowman is Hard to Build, Ace Attorney, Assassin’s Creed Identity, Kensho, Royal Trouble, Runic Rampage, Spite & Malic HD, and Warhammer 40,000, with several titles discounted or free on iOS and/or Android.

Ebberston, Mulgrave and Ganton won the Premier, Division One and Division Two finals respectively at the first triple-header T20 Cayley Cup Finals Day at North Marine Road. Ganton beat Kirkbymoorside by nine wickets, Mulgrave beat Sherburn by 28 runs, and Ebberston beat Filey by six wickets.

The passage describes panic disorder and distinguishes panic attacks from “anxiety attacks,” noting that panic attacks can occur without a clear trigger and usually last under 30 minutes. It lists common symptoms and recommends strategies such as keeping factual reminders and mantras, visualizing panic as a wave, using smartphone distractions, and practicing slow deep breathing daily.

Using 2019 NSECE data on recent child care and early education searches for children under age 6, the study used latent class analysis to identify five search types based on up to two information sources. The types were characterized by combinations of CCR&R/local organizations, internet search, social media, known providers, and friends/family. Search type varied by whether families sought information on type of care, whether the child had a condition affecting care, and region, but showed few differences by other family and child characteristics.

The A100 GPU has 40 GB HBM2 memory with SECDED ECC protection, 40 MB L2 cache, and higher memory and cache bandwidth than Tesla V100. It adds third-generation Tensor Cores, MIG for partitioning one GPU into up to seven isolated GPU Instances, third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4 with SR-IOV, and several features such as NVJPG, optical flow, improved atomics, NVDEC, CUDA async copy, asynchronous barriers, L2 residency controls, and compute data compression to improve performance and efficiency.

The lecture covered web security vulnerabilities and defenses, including Shellshock, cross-site scripting, SQL injection, cookie misuse, protocol parsing bugs, GIFAR attacks, and covert channels. It discussed browser filters, HTTP-only cookies, privilege separation, content sanitization, Markdown, Content Security Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, stateless cookies with MACs, DOM storage, client-side certificates, and attacks based on visited-link colors, caching, DNS, and rendering behavior.

A.J. Brown said he wants the ball when the Eagles are struggling and in key moments, but said his comments are about helping the offense, not just increasing targets or numbers. The passage notes Brown has had limited production this season, DeVonta Smith has also struggled, and the Eagles are 4-0 despite disappointing numbers from their top receivers.

A study found that bumblebee queens fed thiamethoxam, a neonicotinoid pesticide, were 26 percent less likely to lay eggs, raising concerns about declines in wild bumblebee populations and adding to debates over restrictions on neonicotinoid use.

The passage argues that Swarthmore students should ease their constant seriousness, accept mistakes, laugh at themselves, and give others the benefit of the doubt, since the campus is intense but not life or death.

The passage discusses Hadamard transform realizations of Reed-Muller codes, showing how recursive binary graphs can realize the 8,4,4 code with simple constraints but cycles, and how agglomeration can produce a cycle-free trellis-like realization. It then introduces the sum-product algorithm for a posteriori probability decoding, emphasizing its exact operation on cycle-free graphs and its approximate iterative use on graphs with cycles.

San Diego County’s HHSA confirmed the first West Nile virus case in the county this year in a Spring Valley woman who developed rash and headache after traveling outside the country. The county warned residents about symptoms and prevention, noting California has reported 231 illnesses and 12 deaths this year, and San Diego County has also found positive dead birds, mosquito batches, and one horse.

Asian equities were mostly cautious after the US Federal Reserve raised rates by 25 basis points and outlined more detail on balance sheet unwinding. Japan and South Korea fell, Australia dropped sharply, and China was mixed. Markets viewed the move as dovish, while oil prices, the dollar index, and the kiwi fell; the Australian dollar rose after strong jobs data. Tolkien, Toshiba shares remained under pressure, and Wall Street closed mixed.

In a multicentre study of patients with multiple sclerosis, deep learning models based on MRI were used to estimate age, disease duration, and multiple sclerosis-specific brain ageing. The disease duration gap was weakly correlated with brain-age gap, was associated with EDSS, and added to brain-age measures in explaining disability and its worsening over time, whereas the multiple sclerosis-age gap did not add significant value.

The passage introduces the Situation Calculus, its Markovian and non-Markovian forms, and a door-opening example. It then explains a deontic fluent for obligations and states that the paper uses non-Markovian Situation Calculus to formalize a taxonomy of obligations, with later sections covering formalization, properties, violation, compensation, and related work.

The discovery of Richard III’s remains in a Leicester car park changed the lives of several people connected to the search. Dominic Smee, who has scoliosis like Richard, took part in research and filming; Michael Ibsen’s DNA helped confirm the remains; car park attendant Mike Mistry became linked to the find; and musician Ian Churchward was inspired to create Richard III-themed music.

The TPS7H500x-SP controllers support configurable duty cycle limits via the DCL pin, use CS_ILIM for peak current sensing and current-limit configuration, enter hiccup mode when CS_ILIM exceeds 1.05 V, and support external fault protection, slope compensation, thermal shutdown, and fixed-frequency peak current mode control. The passage also gives application and layout guidance, including component selection examples for a push-pull converter.

The passage argues that weakening parties and ending partisan primaries may increase, not reduce, political partisanship and fragmentation. It also summarizes current political news, including a new poll showing Ted Cruz leading Beto O’Rourke in Texas, Trump-related stories about donations and Russia claims, and several other campaign and media items.

Junior County, a top-five shooting guard in the 2026 class, committed to UConn after visiting last weekend. He chose the Huskies over other finalists and said Dan Hurley’s intensity and the program’s development appealed to him. County is a 6-foot-4 combo guard from Wasatch Academy and is UConn’s first commitment in the 2026 class.

VentureWire’s November 14, 2000 issue reported major funding and deal news, including Apax’s plan to merge its European and Israeli units and invest $600 million in Israeli companies, Cisco’s $295 million acquisition of Radiata, and numerous venture financings across technology, wireless, software, and Internet companies. It also noted layoffs and shutdowns at New Edge Networks, Buzz MSP, eSociety, and iExplore, plus several product name changes, acquisitions, board appointments, executive changes, and venture capital personnel updates.

Beijing ordered 15 online real estate portals to remove misleading information, false advertising, feng shui advice, and financing-related content as part of efforts to cool its housing market. The sites were also told not to promise rising returns, spread rumors, or help with hukou permits or school enrolment. The measures follow earlier rules raising down payments, limiting mortgage terms, and banning third-property purchases.

Researchers used fossils and rare horizontal gene transfers to date fungi’s evolution, finding that living fungi likely share a common ancestor 1.4–0.9 billion years ago, long before land plants. The study suggests ancient fungi interacted with algae, recycled nutrients, broke down rock, and helped form primitive soils, making Earth’s continents more habitable.

The passage argues that Soviet aggression was met effectively only when the U.S. was strong, and criticizes the Carter administration for weakness, inconsistency, and defense cuts. It calls for restoring a “margin of safety” through stronger defense, firmness against terrorism, support for allies, and adherence to American principles, claiming peace depends on strength.

The passage is an Enron mentions digest dated October 19, 2001, highlighting reports on Andrew Fastow’s LJM2 partnership profits and Enron’s losses, a New Power Company amendment to its netting agreement with Enron subsidiaries, lobbying firm rankings that include Enron as a client, Houston business honors, metals market concerns, and a legal hearing involving Enron-promoted Dhabol Power Company.

United Airlines used its earnings call to promote premium features like uncrowded lounges and seatback entertainment, appearing to criticize Delta’s crowded Sky Clubs and American’s lack of seatback screens on most domestic flights. United said its premium cabin revenue rose about 6% year over year in the third quarter.

China warned Hong Kong not to let anyone use the city to threaten mainland stability, as concerns grew over a pro-independence movement and Beijing’s tighter control. Zhang Xiaoming said no activity harming national sovereignty, security, or the central government would be permitted. The passage also notes fears that Hong Kong’s freedoms, autonomy, and identity are being eroded, alongside political developments including Leung Chun-ying not seeking re-election and Regina Ip running for the post.

MusConv is an online software that helps users transfer playlists from Spotify to Amazon Music and other music platforms. It offers Basic, Professional, and Ultimate subscriptions with features including unlimited songs and playlists, CSV export, batch importing, Apple Music support, priority support, free updates, and duplicate track deletion.

The speaker describes preparing with headphones and a hoodie to focus, learning from past experiences, and emphasizing that the team played well, blocked shots, and did whatever it took to win. The speaker says the goal is to focus on the next game, win the Stanley Cup, and stay motivated by teammates, family, and friends.

The Competition and Markets Authority said some care home fees billed to vulnerable elderly people and their families may be illegal, citing practices such as charging after a resident has died, charging before entry, threatening eviction, and failing to advertise prices. It said these abuses mainly affect self-funding residents, who often struggle to complain and may face bills over £600 a week, and it is considering new legislation and a test case to clarify legal protections.

Caring Health Center in Springfield is celebrating National Health Center Week with more than 50 Massachusetts health centers and over 1,200 nationwide. The center serves more than 20,000 people, and Monday’s Elected Officials Day included local and state representatives, community leaders, and healthcare honors.

Education regulators are reviewing a whistleblower’s claim that Ohio’s now-closed Electronic Classroom of Tomorrow inflated attendance figures to increase state funding using ActivTrak software. A former employee said school officials ordered staff to manipulate student data, while the school and state officials disputed the allegations and said the claims were being considered in audits and attendance reviews.

In his farewell Oval Office address, the President thanked Americans for eight years of service, described economic, social, and environmental gains, and said America was in a strong position. He urged fiscal responsibility, continued U.S. global leadership, and greater national unity and fairness, while wishing the next President well and expressing hope for America’s future.

The passage reviews blockchain education in 533 AACSB-accredited US universities, finding 151 schools offer at least one blockchain course, with more offerings in larger universities and in public and private institutions. Most courses are at the undergraduate level, concentrated in computer science, information systems, and finance, and are mainly about blockchain fundamentals, digital assets, and technical development. It also notes blockchain courses often address other technologies such as AI and IoT, and include social, methodological, and personal competences.

Seven-year-old Joseph Nyberg, grieving his grandfather’s death from heart disease, collected pennies and dollars through “Heart Cents” to help St. Joseph’s heart patients, raising $672.14 after matching and an anonymous donation.

The device supports legacy SPI-compatible read protocols with single or dual SDO-x, and an SRC protocol. After power-up or asynchronous reset, SPI-00-S is the default; other SPI protocols are selected by programming SDI_MODE[1:0] and setting SDO_MODE[1:0] to 00b. In dual SDO mode, SDO1_CONFIG[1:0] = 11b enables two-bit transfers on SDO-0 and SDO-1, with the same timing as single SDO mode but requiring fewer SCLK cycles.

The disclosure describes noninvasive physiological monitors and methods that combine raw or minimally processed optical sensor data from multiple measurement sites, or from multiple photodetectors in one sensor, to generate a single measurement of a physiological parameter such as oxygen saturation, pulse rate, or related blood constituent values. It also describes spatially distributed photodetectors conforming to patient anatomy to improve measurement robustness and sensor-position validation.

The passage describes a surgical robotic wrist and arm with articulated joints and torque sensors that measure forces on a surgical instrument or end effector. The design uses a universal-joint-like wrist arrangement to improve mobility, reduce singularities, and provide force feedback while keeping the arm slim and suitable for surgical use.
Katalin Karikó thought the call was a joke when she became one of the few women to win a Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine in 2023.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that on July 23, 2015 it announced its second quarter 2015 financial results and included exhibits with the press release and information on non-GAAP financial measures.

Los Angeles County, the Inland Empire, and Orange County saw strong annual house price gains in May, with Los Angeles up 8.3 percent, Riverside and San Bernardino up 8.2 percent, and Orange County up 6.2 percent. CoreLogic said low housing supply is pushing prices higher and reducing days on market, while many homeowners are keeping low-rate mortgages instead of selling.

The passage explains that distributed systems aim for reliability, agility, and scale, and that the book seeks to identify patterns for them. It motivates splitting single-node applications into multiple containers for resource isolation, team ownership, reuse, and separation of concerns, and notes that the patterns assume tightly coupled containers that can be co-scheduled on one machine and may share resources.

Kesha tweeted support for Taylor Swift after David Mueller sued Swift over allegations he groped her in 2014, saying she admired Swift’s strength and fearlessness and that truth is always the answer. Swift’s countersuit against Mueller still stands, and Swift had previously donated $250,000 to Kesha during her legal battle with Dr. Luke.

The Combo defense uses aggressive outside pass denial with inside zone support to stop spread offenses and dribble penetration. X1 protects the middle, X2 and X3 deny passes, and X4 and X5 provide backside and baseline help. On dribble penetration or a picked-up dribble, defenders rotate or trap to force difficult passes, with a possible shift to a quarter-court 1-3-1 trap if X4 and X5 are strong ball handlers and shooters.

Mikel Obi said the Super Eagles will give their best in the June 2, 2018 friendly against England at Wembley, ahead of the World Cup. Nigeria will also play the Czech Republic before the tournament, and will face Croatia, Iceland and Argentina in Group D.

The passage describes many AGESA host and entry procedures for x86-64 and some AArch64 APUs, including stack creation/removal, processor initialization across BSP and AP cores, memory initialization and resume flows, buffer allocation/deallocation, SPD reading, AP task execution, ACPI/DMI table generation, S3 suspend/resume support, and numerous platform configuration and call-out interfaces.

The Louisiana Supreme Court affirmed dismissal of United Distributors’ claim against Alfred R. Willis, holding that his guarantee became ineffective because his expected stock ownership and association with Air-eo Appliance & Hardware, Inc. never materialized and plaintiff was informed he would not be connected with the corporation.

Johnson & Johnson’s first-quarter update was mixed: sales were slightly below estimates, adjusted EPS met consensus, and it raised full-year 2017 sales and earnings guidance after including Actelion. Remicade sales fell 6%, some consumer segments declined, and the author concludes the stock is not attractive enough and would seek value elsewhere.

ConocoPhillips announced another asset sale after a larger Canadian sale earlier in the month. The San Juan Basin deal brings $2.7 billion upfront and up to $300 million more over six years, while reducing natural gas exposure, reserves, production, and operating cash flow. The passage says management’s choice appears reasonable, but the value depends on how the cash is ultimately used.

The passage outlines Inquiry’s planned contributions to the Peace Conference, including estimates of doubtful states, economic arrangements, and minority protections for various regions. It also lists tasks the Inquiry could not further and notes a confidential proposed Pan American Treaty aimed at guaranteeing territorial integrity, political independence, and peaceful settlement of disputes.

The figures show a claimed graphical user interface design in four embodiments and its application to an electronic device display screen; broken lines indicate the screen or device and are not part of the claimed design.

VIX futures, introduced in 2004, are financial derivatives based on the VIX Index and trade on the Cboe Futures Exchange. Their prices are mainly affected by stock market cycles and contango/backwardation, and they can be used for hedging, diversification, and speculation. The full contract equals VIX multiplied by $1,000, the mini contract by $100, the tick size is $50, minimum price fluctuation is 0.05, and settlement is financial via SOQ.

The study developed simultaneous ADF-EDS-EELS tomography to map structure, chemical composition, and valence states in 3D for NCM111 battery cathodes across cycling. It found uniform compositional changes throughout particles but surface-localized, depth-dependent valence-state changes and transition-metal inhomogeneity, with degradation progressing from layered to spinel-like and then rock-salt structures, especially after 100–200 cycles.

Brayan Rocchio hit an unlikely eighth-inning home run and the Guardians scored five runs to beat the Tigers 5-1, forcing a decisive Game 3 in the AL Wild Card Series. The Tigers stranded a playoff-record 15 baserunners, and both teams will face an elimination game Thursday.

The court affirmed that Mumma Brothers Drilling Co. was subject to sales or use tax on drilling equipment purchases because it qualified as a contractor under Ind. Code 6-2-1-38(k) and did not prove an exemption under Ind. Code 6-2-1-39(b)(6). The exemption was found inapplicable because the water extracted was used by the ultimate purchasers for personal use, not resale.

The Elliott Wave theory, developed by Ralph Nelson Elliott from 75 years of stock data, says asset prices move in recognizable wave patterns. It divides waves into impulse waves, which move with the trend, and corrective waves, which move against it. Impulse waves have five sub-waves and corrective waves have three. The theory is used by technical traders to identify possible future price movement, but it is highly subjective, difficult to backtest, and lacks clear entry and exit rules.

The justices heard arguments on whether the Mandatory Victims Restitution Act can be applied to Holsey Ellingburg without violating the Constitution’s ex post facto clause. The government agreed with Ellingburg that it cannot be used to increase his punishment, while some justices questioned whether restitution is more civil than criminal and others emphasized its penal character. The passage predicts the Court will likely reject applying the new statute to Ellingburg.

The passage describes how microtubule dynamics are linked to androgen receptor signaling, taxane resistance, and prostate cancer progression, and presents computational EB1-comet tracking methods to measure these dynamics in cells and patient-derived organoids. It reports that ARv7 is associated with increased microtubule growth and taxane resistance, while pVHL and GSK3β regulate microtubule turnover, quiescence, and cilia maintenance. It also discusses ex vivo approaches to predict drug response, including organoids, circulating tumor cells, and tubulin-bundling assays.

Traders bought Verizon Communications on weakness, with net inflow of $56.85 million as the stock fell to $48.81. Analysts’ average rating was Hold with a $52.86 target, and the company reported quarterly EPS of $0.96 on revenue of $30.55 billion. Verizon declared a quarterly dividend of $0.59 and saw notable insider and institutional ownership activity.

The passage describes NVIDIA RTX IO, a GPU-based I/O and decompression system that uses DirectStorage to reduce CPU bottlenecks, improve loading and streaming performance, and reduce game install sizes. It also outlines NVIDIA A40 and GA10x Ampere GPU features and performance claims, including support for high-resolution displays, hardware video decode and encode, ray tracing, AI acceleration, memory improvements, and workstation/data center applications.

The Eleventh Circuit affirmed Alexis Perez’s 51-month sentence for conspiracy to commit mail fraud, holding that the district court properly denied both a three-level reduction for an incomplete conspiracy and a minor-role reduction.

A day trading price action strategy uses patterns in price movements, chart patterns, and candlestick patterns to decide entries and exits without relying mainly on indicators. The passage says traders should backtest and out-of-sample test such strategies, since performance depends on the market and many price action ideas may not work consistently.

The passage offers advice for paying off debt by reducing credit card use, creating a spending plan and emergency fund, paying as much as possible each month, cutting spending, focusing on high-interest debts first, and using freed-up funds to increase payments on the next debt.

Spanish police dismantled a prostitution network that lured transsexuals from fake “Miss Trans” competitions in Venezuela, freed over 20 victims, and arrested 14 suspects. The victims were held in overcrowded apartments in Barcelona and Palma de Mallorca, had their documents confiscated, and were forced into prostitution and drug dealing to repay debts.

Google honored physicist Max Born with a colorful Doodle for what would have been his 135th birthday. Born, born in 1882 in Breslau, Germany, made major contributions to quantum mechanics, developed the Born Rule, won the 1954 Nobel Prize, and was forced to emigrate to England in 1933. He died in 1970 at age 87.

The bill creates a Regulatory Sandbox in Education allowing district and charter schools to propose innovation plans and seek waivers of State Board rules, and it lets LEAs use certain restricted funds and accept private support for innovative programs. It also requires reporting on approved plans and waivers, and recommends the State Board raise awareness of the program through website information, application forms, and existing communication channels.

UK employment rose strongly to a record high in the three months to April, but pay growth weakened to 1.7% while inflation reached 2.9%, leaving real wages falling. The passage says this is squeezing households, threatening consumer spending and the economic outlook, while business confidence may have been hurt by post-election uncertainty. It also notes input cost inflation has moderated, and the Bank of England is likely to keep interest rates unchanged.

The passage describes the AGESA host BIOS interface, including bridge and call-out mechanisms between host BIOS code and AGESA software, requirements for stack setup and standard headers, and the dispatcher/router flow for function calls. It also outlines UEFI build stages and tools, host environment responsibilities, initialization entry points across SEC, PEI, DXE, and runtime phases, configuration options, memory and graphics-related tables, suspend/resume support, and host-provided call-outs such as memory buffer allocation.

Schoenfeld reported meeting Foreign Minister Witting, reading him a note clarifying U.S. views on Finland, and discussing Finnish security, strategic aims, and Witting’s belief that small nations face similar pressures from Germany and Britain. Schoenfeld said Witting seemed to realize Finland was increasingly subject to forces beyond its control. The Secretary of State later told Finnish Minister Procopé that inquiries about American citizenship applied to Finnish Legation and Consulate personnel, and that Finnish consular staff in the United States must seek such permission when leaving their city limits.

Apple’s Board of Directors adopted amended bylaws on December 21, 2015 to implement proxy access. The new Section 5.15 allows eligible shareholders, or groups of up to twenty shareholders, owning at least 3% of outstanding common stock for at least three years to nominate directors for up to 20% of the Board in proxy materials, with related changes to advance notice provisions and other conforming revisions.

NEMA’s South East office has warned of imminent flooding in parts of Enugu, Anambra and Ebonyi states, citing NIHSA and NiMET forecasts and climate change. It identified specific high-probability and probable flood-risk areas and urged residents to prepare early and adjust energy use.

DBS says Indian government bonds remain under pressure, but much of the sell-off may be over and future yield rises should be more modest. It remains neutral-to-negative on longer-term bonds, expects the rupee to stay vulnerable, and sees it depreciating toward 67 this year.

Al-Qaida-linked militants in Syria shot down a Russian Su-25 fighter jet in Idlib and killed the pilot after he ejected and resisted capture, while Russian and Syrian forces continued heavy fighting there. The passage also reports Turkish casualties in fighting around Afrin in Turkey’s operation against the YPG.

Mentoring relationships with adults and peers, in programs and naturally in schools and communities, are linked to improved academic outcomes such as attendance, grades, test scores, school connectedness, and graduation. The passage says mentoring is effective but unevenly available, with youth of color, low-income youth, and youth whose parents have limited education reporting less access, and calls for public and private investment to expand mentoring.

Xiaomi’s Redmi 5 goes on sale in India today at 12 pm on Amazon India, Mi.com and Mi Home stores, with prices starting at Rs 7,999 and topping at Rs 10,999. It comes in three variants, has a 5.7-inch 18:9 HD+ display, Snapdragon 450 processor, 3300 mAh battery, 12MP rear camera, 5MP front camera with selfie flash, and four colour options.

The President explains that he will not ask the Senate to ratify the 1853 U.S.-Mexican convention on a Tehuantepec transit route because it would require the United States to guarantee a private company’s contract and security for years, despite possible regulatory conflicts, and would conflict with the 1850 convention with Great Britain concerning interoceanic communication through Tehuantepec.

In 11 nursing home residents with SARS-CoV-2 infection, anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibodies were detected throughout follow-up, with Pan-Ig, IgG, and IgA often rising after infection and increasing further after Pfizer-BioNTech vaccination. No culturable virus was found after antibody detection, and the authors conclude that residents mounted a robust humoral response post-infection and post-vaccination.

The Colts blew another lead and lost 13-7 in overtime after a late touchdown pass was negated by a flag and Adam Vinatieri tied the game in blizzard conditions. The loss left Indianapolis on a four-game losing streak, eliminated from playoff contention, and facing questions about recovery, Pagano’s future, and several injured players.

Oclaro reported 47% revenue growth, 11-point margin expansion to 39%, and EPS of $0.79, while trading at about 11 times fiscal 2017 earnings. The passage says 100G products now make up 81% of revenue, China demand is weaker and expected to decline further in the near term, but the company is well positioned in newer high-growth products, including 400G. It also notes no debt, $258 million in cash and investments, and Q1 2018 guidance for $151 million to $159 million in revenue.

The court affirmed dismissal of Lever Brothers’ opposition to Thrift-D-Lux Cleaners’ service mark registration, holding that “Thrift-D-Lux” was not confusingly similar to “Lux” and that the common term “de luxe” could not be monopolized.

An outside day is a two-bar price pattern where the current bar has a higher high and lower low than the previous bar, and outside reversal patterns occur when the bars move in opposite directions. The passage says outside days can act as continuation or reversal signals depending on context, but backtests on SPY found little useful edge for day trading and mostly random or negative results.

In his inaugural address, George H. W. Bush thanked Ronald Reagan, honored Washington, and called for unity, prayer, service, and a renewed use of power to help people. He said freedom, free markets, free speech, and free elections would guide a prosperous future, and urged national engagement on poverty, crime, drugs, deficit reduction, and bipartisan cooperation at home and abroad.

The Pennsylvania Supreme Court held that a bona fide assignment of a judgment in Pennsylvania was valid everywhere and left the assignor with no attachable interest. A later New York foreign attachment against the judgment debtors did not bind the assignees, who were not parties or privies and had no jurisdictional notice. The court affirmed judgment for the assignees on demurrer.

Aziz Ansari says he uses a flip phone, does not have email, and prefers low-tech communication. He says this gives him more space to think and helps him keep a clear head for writing. He is skeptical of ChatGPT, saying it outsources critical thinking, makes opinions more similar, and can reduce humanity.

The court affirmed dismissal of a plastic surgeon’s complaint alleging disability discrimination after his medical license was revoked, holding that the action was वास्तवतः a challenge to the Administrative Review Board’s revocation decision and had to be brought in a CPLR article 78 proceeding, which was time barred.

Northern Ireland’s health service is the only one in the UK without ministerial नेतृत्व and faces long waiting lists, staffing shortages, rising drug costs, and increasing care needs. By March, 83,392 people had waited over a year for a first hospital appointment, and an extra £30m was allocated to reduce pressure. The passage also notes crises involving neurology patients, Dunmurry Manor care home, and stalled reforms following the collapse of Stormont in January 2017.

Nassau County jurors acquitted 18-year-old Jasmine Copeland of manslaughter and other charges in the 2014 stabbing death of 17-year-old Abbigale Thomas after about three hours of deliberation. Prosecutors said Copeland stabbed Thomas during a brawl that followed social media taunts, but the defense said she was innocent and had no contact with Thomas.

The lecture reviews stochastic methods for multidimensional integrals, emphasizing Bayesian weighting factors, Metropolis Monte Carlo step-size choice and sampling errors, Kinetic Monte Carlo for very large state spaces, and molecular dynamics with thermostats for time-dependent simulations. It stresses choosing the right method for the problem and checking results for reasonableness.

Zeta Global is acquiring Marigold’s enterprise software business for $325 million, its largest deal ever, adding loyalty, email, and marketing automation products. Zeta said the acquisition will expand its customer base, strengthen its presence in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and support its strategy of getting clients to use multiple services.

Players said they need better starts after three straight overtime games, with hope to get the first goal and come out strong at the Garden. They stressed traffic in front of the goalie, home-ice momentum, and confidence in their team and leaders, while noting the Rangers’ home building, history, and energy.

The passage describes technology for detecting gastric neoplasia using DNA methylation markers identified from case-control studies. It reports optimal marker panels for stomach cancer and plasma samples, and provides related methods, kits, compositions, and systems for measuring marker methylation and screening for neoplasms.

NVIDIA’s 2015 Form 10-K reports fiscal year ended January 25, 2015 revenue of $4.68 billion and net income of $630.6 million. The company describes its business as visual computing, with GPU and Tegra processor segments serving gaming, enterprise, HPC & cloud, and automotive markets, and notes significant risks from competition, dependence on third-party manufacturing, customer concentration, and international operations.

A study identified 50 high-risk objects in low-Earth orbit, mostly old rocket bodies, and said removing all 50 would cut debris-generating potential by 50 percent and removing the top 10 by 30 percent. Russia and the Soviet Union lead the list, while China has added 21 of 26 new hazardous rocket bodies in the last 21 months, raising concerns as its megaconstellations expand.

The Court denied the writ, holding that the juror’s physical and mental condition and competency were questions of fact that it could not review on writ of error. It found no sufficient federal question and upheld the state court’s judgment.

East Dunbartonshire Council warned that refuse collections and other services will be affected by strike action and ongoing action short of strike by GMB, Unison and Unite in mid-July. The council said it is disappointed and will continue discussions with unions, while unions said further action may follow if the dispute is not resolved.

Cerebras said it is withdrawing its IPO plans, more than a year after filing its prospectus, and after raising $1.1 billion at an $8.1 billion valuation. The company said it does not intend to proceed “at this time” and still hopes to go public later.

A UN World Water Development Report praised nature-based solutions to global water challenges, citing India’s community-led water restoration, China’s rainwater recycling, and Ukraine’s artificial wetlands. It highlighted Tarun Bharat Sangh’s work in Rajasthan, which increased forest cover, groundwater levels, and cropland productivity, and warned that water scarcity could affect up to 5 billion people by 2050.

The passage is a WIRED guide comparing Google Pixel phones, recommending the Pixel 9a for most buyers, the Pixel 10 for added features like Qi2 charging and 5X zoom, the Pixel 10 Pro/Pro XL for the best overall experience, and the Pixel 10 Pro Fold for folding-phone buyers. It also covers older Pixel models, software support, Pixel-exclusive software features, case and accessory recommendations, and notes on battery, charging, and repair plans.

Ryan, a six-year-old featured on the YouTube channel “Ryan ToysReview,” became one of the highest-paid YouTube stars, earning $11 million in a year and attracting over 8 billion views with toy-opening and surprise videos that many children and parents watch avidly.

The passage describes AGESA interface rules, returned status codes, error logging, and host/BIOS interaction through dispatcher, bridge, and call-out router functions. It also outlines UEFI build phases, stack and cache setup requirements, and the roles of major initialization routines for reset, early, post, memory, late, suspend, and resume stages, along with related configuration options and generated tables.

Michael Cohen removed “personal attorney to President Donald J. Trump” from his Twitter bio after an ABC News interview about his legal situation, though it remained on LinkedIn. The passage says his ties to Trump became more significant after the FBI raided him and prosecutors disclosed a criminal investigation, and it notes Cohen’s comments that his family and country come before loyalty to Trump and that he respects the FBI.

The court granted class certification only for Class I, a Pennsylvania medical monitoring class of Baycol users who have not been diagnosed with rhabdomyolysis or congestive heart disease, and appointed Arthur Conner, Milton Angert, and Lisa Frost as representatives. Certification was denied for all other classes.

The speaker says Peter’s aggressive, high-pressure system took time to learn but has been effective and has improved the team’s shape. He describes an opponent as highly competitive, hard-working, versatile, and a player the team must focus on. He says the finals should be exciting, expects a long, close series, and stresses consistency, strong defense, shooting often, and scoring gritty goals rather than making pretty plays.

The passage describes methods and apparatuses for downlink assignments for downlink control channels in wireless communications. It covers monitoring associated PDCCH candidates and search spaces across different CORESETs, receiving downlink assignments, determining PDSCH allocations and DMRS symbol locations, decoding downlink data, and handling repeated PDCCH/PDSCH transmissions, HARQ-ACK resources, and TCI field indications.

The speaker says the series is not over, the team is playing better and creating chances, and they are not frustrated. They trust Marc as a goalie and believe he will do well. They also say both players are emotionally invested, and being at home with different matchups and lineup may help create momentum.

The passage describes how the Air Force and the Maryland Air National Guard’s 175th Cyberspace Operations Group are adapting to rapid change in cyber warfare through innovation, cross-training, and diverse civilian experience. Adm. Michael Rogers and ANG leaders say flexibility, transparency, and new ideas help build more effective cyber forces, while members like Tech. Sgt. Kyle Hanslovan and Col. Jori Robinson emphasize that civilian cyber skills and varied backgrounds strengthen both offensive and defensive missions.

The passage describes a study of Pennsylvania city LEAs to examine whether COVID-19 affected special education due process hearings, including hearing frequency, ruling outcomes, and remedies owed. It uses published ODR decisions from March 16, 2018 to March 15, 2022 and compares pre- and post-pandemic hearings.

Apple is reportedly set to debut a “blush gold” iPhone 8 at its September keynote. The phone is also described as “copper gold” and may come in 64GB and 128GB storage sizes, with earlier rumors of an edge-to-edge screen, no home button, and wireless charging.

The report covers the global pyridine market, including value and growth from 2012 to 2022, regional analysis for the United States, China, Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia, and India, and competition among major manufacturers such as BASF, Bayer, Dow Chemical, DuPont, and others. It also examines pyridine by type, including chemical synthesized and coal tar extracted pyridine, and by application, including agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, and chemical synthesis.

The lecture compared model-free policy gradient and value-function methods, noting policy gradients’ scalability and guaranteed convergence versus value methods’ efficiency but weaker stability. It then introduced actor-critic methods, which combine both by using a value estimate to reduce variance in policy updates. A case study described a robot that learned to walk quickly with this approach, improving stability and adaptation without requiring a detailed model.

Delhi has extremely high PM 2.5 levels, and a WHO-based map of urban air quality ranks Pakistan as the most polluted country, followed by Qatar and Afghanistan, while Australia is the least polluted among the 92 countries listed.

The Court of Appeals affirmed the trial court’s order modifying custody and child support, holding that Clark’s pro se brief was inadequate and no transcript was included, so the court presumed the proceedings were regular. The dissent argued the custody order should be vacated and remanded because it did not expressly address the children’s best interests.

The passage explains that, under a recent trade deal, China may export cooked poultry meat to the United States despite U.S. concerns about avian influenza, food safety, antibiotic residues, and heavy metals. It says U.S. inspectors require foreign plants to meet USDA-equivalent standards, but consumers may not know if cooked poultry is from China because labeling rules do not apply to processed foods or restaurants.

The passage describes NVIDIA Blackwell RTX architecture features, including faster ray tracing, Mega Geometry, Linear Swept Spheres, Shader Execution Reordering 2.0, AI Management Processor, improved video encode/decode and DisplayPort support, power-efficiency improvements, DLSS 4, and neural shaders. It also lists GPU specifications for GB202, GB203, and GB205-based GeForce RTX 50 series products, and notes FLUX.dev VRAM and performance differences between FP16 and FP4.

The passage says a bear market is when the market is below its 200-day moving average. It argues that traders can make money by sticking to a backtested plan, trading both long and short, and continuing to trade through bear markets. It also says long-term investors should keep investing, since bear markets can offer lower prices and stocks have historically had positive real returns.

The passage describes design considerations for the UC1825B-SP, including diode and MOSFET voltage stress, output capacitance and filter choices to reduce ripple, compensation selection, sense resistor function, operating input range, and PCB layout guidelines such as keeping traces short, using ground planes, and placing components close together. It also includes test figure captions, documentation notices, and packaging and legal information.

The passage explains how to prevent strength-training injuries by warming up and cooling down, using correct technique, working within your limits, increasing intensity gradually, and resting when pain occurs. It also describes common injuries such as rotator cuff injuries, hamstring injuries, herniated discs, tendonitis, and tennis elbow, including their symptoms, causes, and possible treatments.

The passage says several celebrities refused to perform at Donald Trump’s inauguration, calling them disrespectful and unpatriotic, while noting that other performers and supporters will still attend. It highlights Bristol Palin’s criticism of these celebrities and claims Americans will not forget their actions.

Human Rights Watch said Syrians fleeing violence in northwest Syria were shot at, beaten, detained, and denied medical assistance at the Turkish border, with some children among those shot and a woman and newborn reportedly sent back without care. The passage also says violence intensified in Idlib, Hama, Aleppo, and Eastern Ghouta, with civilians killed in airstrikes and shelling amid worsening shortages in besieged eastern Ghouta.

Tesla filed a Form 8-K on May 13, 2019 announcing the final offer consideration for its exchange offer for all outstanding shares of Maxwell Technologies, Inc. common stock for Tesla common stock. The filing also included tax opinions from Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati and DLA Piper LLP (US) and a related Tesla press release.

A study published in Value in Health found that testing 7 cancer-associated genes instead of 2, followed by risk-reduction management, could cost-effectively improve life expectancy for women at risk of hereditary breast cancer. In the model, the 7-gene strategy had ICERs of $42,067 and $23,734 per life-year gained, or $69,920 and $48,328 per quality-adjusted life-year gained, and was considered cost effective by WHO guidelines.

Eric Robinson, 46, was arrested and charged with murdering his roommate at a Plantation duplex and trying to hide the body in a dumpster. Neighbors described the victim as kind and said the home had a history of domestic disputes involving Robinson and a woman. Police said the victim’s name is being withheld until family is notified.

SOS switching is an integral part of the SOS Pressure Defense system, using automatic “Screen-Over-Switch” actions to reduce hesitation and fouls. It emphasizes contact switching on off-ball and on-ball screens, with a Hi-Lo rule for baseline screens and aggressive switching or trapping depending on screen location.

A defensive switch occurs when the first defender is beaten and the second defender calls for the switch, takes the ball carrier, and the first defender covers the second defender’s mark. The second defender must stay goalside, maintain proper support position and distance, communicate clearly, and adjust with the play. The passage also outlines coaching instructions, switch-back communication, and scenarios such as switches down the sideline, inside, and in midfield.

The device uses SmartReflex modules for power reduction through DVFS and AVS, supports independent OPPs per Core Logic Voltage Domain, and includes SRAM shutdown, dual-voltage I/Os, standby mode, supply sequencing, and multiple reset types. It also describes clock sources and PLLs, interrupts, and peripherals including EMAC, MDIO, GPIO, GPMC/ELM, EDMA, JTAG, DCAN, and HDMI with their timing and interface requirements.

The passage describes storage systems and clusters with controllers, storage nodes, authorities, NVRAM, flash memory, erasure coding, redundancy, failover, and cloud connectivity, and says the embodiments focus on methods and apparatus for ensuring reproducibility in an artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Shop & Save Market signed a letter of intent to open a grocery store in the former Dominick’s at Jeffery Plaza in South Shore, with city tax increment financing expected to help fund the development. The store could open in 18 to 24 months, though details are still being finalized and the deal is not complete.

Whitworth University will cut its annual tuition from $54,000 to $26,900 next fall and make merit-based discounts GPA-based and publicly available. Officials say the change is meant to improve clarity and transparency for families, not to address enrollment decline.

A study by University of Guelph researcher Nigel Raine found that thiamethoxam, a neonicotinoid pesticide, made bumblebee queens 26% less likely to start colonies, suggesting increased extinction risk for bumblebee populations. The study found little effect from a parasite and noted that other wild factors may further affect bee health.

Mediclinic’s share price rose after a better outlook for its Middle East operations. CEO Danie Meintjes said Switzerland, southern Africa and Dubai performed as expected, while Abu Dhabi faced regulatory and other challenges. The company expected to resolve Abu Dhabi issues and see improved regional performance next year, though Middle East revenue fell 8%.

A court heard that Tyler Denton was stabbed to death by housemate Redvers Bickley after he became angry at a birthday gathering, then attacked her sisters and father when they intervened. Bickley admits killing Tyler but denies murder and attempting to murder the others; the trial continues.

Five English clubs—Manchester City, Manchester United, Liverpool, Tottenham and Chelsea—reached the Champions League last 16, the first time one country has had five teams in the knockout stage. Chelsea can only draw Paris St Germain, Barcelona or Besiktas, while the other English clubs may face teams including Bayern Munich, Juventus and Real Madrid. Arsenal, the only English team left in the Europa League, could be drawn against Celtic in the last 32.

TCGX closed a $1.3 billion fund amid investor interest. The passage also mentions European pharmaceutical policy overhaul efforts, FDA-related biotech updates, and several biotech and medicine headlines.

Tony Robinson has become patron of the John Cracknell Youth Enterprise Bank, which gives grants of up to £1,000 to young people in Hull, the East Riding, and nearby towns to help turn ideas into reality. More than 400 young people have already benefited from the fund.

The passage describes Enron’s rise from a pipeline company to a dominant energy trader under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling, driven by aggressive hiring, trading, and accounting practices, and its subsequent decline amid criticism, failed ventures, falling stock, and Skilling’s abrupt resignation.

DeBoer said his team improved its coverage and awareness, noting many games have been close and that the group believes in itself. He said they are confident on the road, expect a hard game in the current environment, and believe it will be difficult for the opponent to close them out.

Ankit, an engineering graduate from Dhakoli village, allegedly killed Sheelu and her cousin Shivani in Bahpur village after Sheelu rejected his marriage proposal, then burned their bodies. Police said he later admitted to the killings and solved the case within 24 hours.

TOPIC is a topology-constrained crystal structure prediction algorithm for oxide solid-state electrolytes with corner-sharing frameworks. Using MLIPs and DFT, the study reproduced known structures and found 92 candidate materials, with 15 further validated as promising conductors; the Li ratio was identified as a key descriptor for framework stability and ionic conductivity.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 Tensor Core GPU, highlighting higher Tensor Core, FP64, and memory performance than Tesla V100, support for TF32, BF16, FP16, INT8, and sparsity, and features such as MIG, NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, NVJPG, NVDEC, CUDA enhancements, and improved caching and bandwidth. It also explains A100’s use in HPC, AI training and inference, DGX A100 systems, and structured sparsity for accelerating workloads.

The David Swensen Portfolio, or Yale Model, is a diversified strategy developed by David Swensen that emphasizes alternative investments, low-cost index funds, passive investing, and risk management. The Yale endowment reportedly returned 12.5% annually from 1985 to 2020 versus 9.7% for the S&P 500, though a cited ETF backtest showed 6.23% annual returns and underperformance versus the S&P 500 with lower drawdowns.

In 157 patients hospitalized with ADHF, BIS measured fluid overload at admission and discharge but did not predict MACE or HHF during 10.7 months of follow-up. CKD patients had higher baseline OH and OH/ECW, and HFrEF patients showed greater OH/ECW reduction, but these changes were not associated with clinical outcomes.

The lecture explains that wireless channels differ from wired ones because fading arises from Doppler effects and multiple propagation paths. It derives time-varying channel models using attenuation, propagation delay, ray tracing, and baseband conversion, and says the key factor is Doppler spread rather than a single Doppler shift.

NVIDIA’s 2017 second-quarter Form 10-Q reported revenue of $2.23 billion and net income of $583 million for the quarter, up from $1.43 billion and $261 million a year earlier. GPU revenue grew 59% to $1.90 billion and Tegra Processor revenue rose 101% to $333 million, while cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $5.88 billion.

The passage describes the Six Nations of the Grand River’s deer harvest at Short Hills Provincial Park, made possible by a 2013 treaty recognition, and the protests it has drawn. It says the hunt supports food needs, health, culture, and the passing on of traditions, while officials and biologists assist the hunters and note the deer population is far above carrying capacity.

BrainWorking Recursive Therapy, now available in Dunstable, is presented as a treatment for anxiety and related conditions that aims to retrain the brain and stop trigger reactions. Practitioner Keith Tunstall offers free initial consultations and confidential appointments, including by Skype or FaceTime.

Amazon reported Q1 2020 net sales of $75.5 billion, up from $59.7 billion in Q1 2019, with net income of $2.5 billion versus $3.6 billion. Operating income fell to $4.0 billion from $4.4 billion, while AWS sales rose to $10.2 billion and North America sales to $46.1 billion. The company said COVID-19 affected results, and noted it changed server useful lives from three to four years, reducing Q1 2020 depreciation and amortization expense by $786 million.

Sterling Bank Plc reported stronger 2017 performance, with gross earnings of N133.5 billion, profit before tax of N8.606 billion, profit after tax of N8.521 billion, and loans and advances rising 27% to N598.1 billion. Deposits grew 17.1% to N684.8 billion, shareholders’ funds rose 20.2% to N102.9 billion, and non-performing loans fell to 6.2%. The bank said it would focus on agility, digitisation, and specialisation in sectors such as health, education, agriculture, renewable energy, and transport.

The speaker said the game was more defensive and realistic than the last one, and that two quick goals were frustrating. They noted the team played well at home, had a strong third period, but still lost and must return home to win. They also mentioned learning from an early pro hockey goalie coach.

Amazon.com, Inc. closed the sale of $8.25 billion of senior notes due 2024, 2025, 2027, 2029, and 2032, with estimated net proceeds of about $8.235 billion. The notes were sold under an underwriting agreement and issued under an existing indenture, with related exhibits filed with the report.

Neo Performance Materials looked attractive due to a cheap valuation and growth tied to rare earth demand from permanent magnet motors, especially through its Magnequench segment. However, the author says patent expirations covering most Magnequench products created a major risk of increased competition starting in 2018, so no position was taken.

European spot electricity prices for Monday delivery rose in France and Germany as forecasts of weaker wind speeds were expected to reduce renewable output, while demand stayed broadly flat. The German and French Monday baseload prices both reached 36 euros/MWh, and Czech day-ahead prices also rose to 36 euros. Forward prices were mixed, with France’s year-ahead contract higher and Germany’s unchanged.

NASA told employees working on Artemis missions with SpaceX and Blue Origin to keep working during the government shutdown, though their work will be unpaid until the shutdown ends. NASA said it will support Artemis operations, the International Space Station, and some satellite missions, while furloughing about 15,000 people and requiring around 3,000 to keep working.

Budgens owner Food Retail Operations Ltd has gone into administration, putting almost 900 staff nationwide, including around 27 at the Prestwick store, in uncertainty. Administrators are continuing to trade all 34 stores while seeking buyers, and Co-op may step in if no buyer is found.

Microsoft reported lower revenue, gross margin, operating income, and diluted EPS for the three and six months ended December 31, 2015 versus 2014. Revenue declined primarily due to Windows 10 revenue deferrals and unfavorable foreign currency impacts, while Intelligent Cloud revenue increased; the company also reported a new segment structure beginning in fiscal 2016.

Consumer gasoline demand hit a record March high at 9.6 million b/d, while gasoline inventories fell and the national average gas price rose to $2.55, two cents higher on the week. Prices were highest in Hawaii and California, and several states in the South and Southeast saw weekly increases, though the region still had some of the nation’s cheapest gas.

The passage praises a player’s skating, size, strength, skill, work ethic, and leadership, noting that he has been scoring more goals this year and is a difficult opponent who must be closely defended.

The passage criticizes campus and workplace political correctness, arguing that demands for safe zones, trigger warnings, and identity politics undermine free academic discourse and lead to unjust harassment investigations. It describes Lindsay Shepherd’s treatment at Wilfrid Laurier University as an example and contends that not every complaint or difficult interaction legally constitutes harassment.

The speaker says the team ran out of energy and lost to a great team after injuries, including Donovan’s sprained MCL and Robyn’s ankle injury. They praise the officiating and congratulate the Tampa organization and Jay, while expressing pride in their players for lasting through the series.

The lecture discusses gluing polygons into convex polyhedra using gluing trees, combinatorial types, and algorithms. It gives exponential upper and lower bounds for general and edge-to-edge gluings, polynomial bounds for bounded-sharpness polygons, and dynamic programming algorithms for edge-to-edge and general enumeration/decision problems. It also describes examples such as the cube cross, star polygons, and counts of gluings and resulting polyhedra for specific cases like the cross and triangle.

The speaker said the team played defensively unlike earlier in the playoffs, was beaten in many areas, and must rectify and build on them. They noted the opponent capitalized on power plays and that although the first period was not bad, the team failed to score on third-period chances and later allowed goals. The goalie was praised for being sharp, making good early saves, and battling hard despite not being at fault for some goals.

Kashmiri students in Haryana’s Mahendergarh were assaulted by a group of 15–20 people after leaving a mosque, according to Aftab. Police arrived later, the students got checked at a hospital and filed a complaint with the university. Haryana Police registered an FIR, and Mehbooba Mufti urged strict action and a probe.

The Nigerian Immigration Service told a Federal High Court in Abuja that suspended Supreme Court Justice Sylvester Ngwuta used two similar standard international passports interchangeably. The witness said a new passport was issued after Ngwuta reported the first one missing, but he later failed to return the recovered passport. The service found four diplomatic and two standard passports in his possession, with no evidence of forgery, and the trial was adjourned to October 20.

The Tri State Psychology Conference, founded by Marshall University students and faculty in 1993, will mark its 25th anniversary with a conference on April 20 at West Liberty University. Started as a local student event, it has grown into a regional conference with speakers from higher education, research, policy, and health care, and is funded by Psi Chi grants with no registration fee.

The passage describes interrupt shadow handling for HLT, requiring guests to execute HLT with interrupts disabled and resume by checking interrupt state as if after #HV. It then details #HV doorbell page setup via VMGEXIT, and host/guest rules for presenting interrupts, non-maskable events, acknowledgments, and EOI handling through PendingEvent and NoEoiRequired fields.

The passage describes a six-month onshore Performance Specialist contract in Aberdeen with NES Global Talent, responsible for PSCM functional performance management and risk and assurance. The role requires strong finance, accounting, procurement, analytical, communication, and organizational skills, with expertise in MS Excel and desired experience in SAP and Backbone, plus an accounting degree or relevant qualification.
Vernon and Penticton each took 2-0 series leads, Victoria fell behind 0-2 to Powell River, Surrey tied its series with Prince George 1-1, and Jackson Ross committed to Colorado College.

The Rangers are focusing their manager search on Skip Schumaker, a special adviser under contract through October, as Bruce Bochy’s replacement. Chris Young said the team has a lead internal candidate and has not yet focused on external candidates.

The passage says Martin Braithwaite left Middlesbrough in January to improve his chances of making Denmark’s World Cup squad, but the move is portrayed as disappointing and possibly taking the easy way out. It argues that staying could have helped him and Middlesbrough, while his decision now depends on whether he succeeds with Denmark and whether Boro still achieve promotion.
Russia said U.S. missile defense deployments in Romania and planned in Poland violate the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Force Treaty. It called the plans a gross violation of the treaty’s obligations.

The passage says LLMs may help social science by generating hypotheses or theories, but their originality and validity are questioned, so human-AI collaboration is needed. It also argues that AI governance should be human-centered, safe, secure, and trustworthy, with cooperation among industry, academia, policymakers, and users, using both top-down and bottom-up approaches to address evolving risks and regulations.

ASTROCO is a conformer-style encoder for astronomical time series that combines self-attention, depthwise convolutions, and gating to improve reconstruction and label-efficient embeddings over Astromer baselines. It uses masked reconstruction pretraining on irregular light curves, soft feature mixing across layers, and reports better reconstruction error and macro-F1 on MACHO R-band, with the smaller model outperforming prior work using fewer resources.

The speaker says his team played poorly against Anaheim, with turnovers, weak puck movement, and problems in its own end, but believes the series remains winnable if they improve. He discusses the physical play, line matchups, officiating, and says players like Jason, Getzlaf, Perry, and Kunitz have improved or were valued draft picks.

Las Vegas Valley residents filing last-minute tax returns must have them postmarked by 10 p.m. Tuesday at Postal Service headquarters, which will close earlier than last year. The IRS considers returns filed on time if postmarked by April 18, 2017, or October 16, 2017 with an extension, and the Postal Service advises using sufficient postage, clear addresses, a sealed envelope, and saving mailing receipts.

The Carlsberg UK Northamptonshire Food and Drink Awards 2017/18 celebrated county food and drink businesses at Northampton’s Royal & Derngate, with awards including The Hopping Hare as Booker Food Pub of the Year, Workbridge Coffee Shop as Independent Café/Tea Room of the Year, and The Folly as Restaurant of the Year and Great Service Award winner. Antonio Carluccio OBE was remembered after his death a week before the event.

The team said it played a solid game and had chances, but brief lapses led to quick goals and a loss. They noted the opponent is one of the league’s best defensive teams, so goals require getting the puck deep, grinding, and getting it to the net.

The passage outlines defensive strategies against the triangle offense, including basic NBA show-and-recover coverage and more aggressive SOS disruptions. It describes multiple phases of defense, such as denying cuts, collapsing help, trapping the first pass, and rotating to cover post feeds, screens, reversals, and corner passes.

Girlfriends’ Kenna McNeil said the shop has been preparing prom flowers and accessories since about March 1, with close to 100 orders so far and 20 to 30 tux and corsage orders taken in the past few days. She said students are encouraged to order early so the shop can get the right flowers and materials in time.

The passage describes NFDI4DS shared tasks that support FAIR, transparent, and reproducible research data infrastructure. It presents 12 tasks in total: seven completed, one ongoing, and four under development, covering topics such as software mention detection, scientific visual QA, fact-checking, field-of-research classification, subject tagging, ontology learning, scholarly QA, scientific web discourse, and future tasks on model/dataset mention detection, README-to-knowledge-graph conversion, clinical uncertainty, and algorithm generalisation.

Scores of fishermen in central Vietnam clashed with police while trying to file lawsuits for compensation over mass fish deaths caused by a Taiwanese firm’s toxic waste dump. Witnesses said some were beaten, hospitalized, and briefly detained, while the fishermen said they have not received compensation from Formosa despite the company paying $500 million to the government.

Hollywood’s summer movie season is led by potential blockbuster sequels such as “Avengers: Infinity War” and “Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom,” as studios try to offset weak box office trends and low ticket sales. Alongside franchises, studios are also promoting more diverse, female-led, indie, documentary, and original films amid growing competition for audience attention.

Digital leaders use detailed, measurable data to set goals and track progress, with evaluations based on data-driven metrics and 360-degree reviews. This measurement culture is said to support flexibility, autonomy, innovation, experimentation, and risk-taking rather than rigid control.

The Colchester-Milton Rotary Club and other volunteers planted saplings along the Winooski River at Pine Island Farm as part of an Intervale Center restoration project to replace failed plantings from 2014. The effort supported Rotary International president Ian H.S.
