Riseley’s challenge to plant a tree for every Rotary member and was described by local leaders as an ongoing commitment to environmental projects.

The passage promotes the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card and other credit card offers, highlighting unlimited cash rewards, welcome bonuses, intro APR periods, $0 annual fees on some cards, and benefits such as cell phone protection and travel perks. It also includes disclosures about compensation, editorial independence, credit score requirements, and issuer partnerships.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting that on July 19, 2016 it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2016, and furnished the press release as Exhibit 99.1.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s A100 Tensor Core GPU architecture, highlighting accelerated FP64 and mixed-precision Tensor Core performance for HPC, fine-grained structured sparsity, a larger L2 cache and HBM2 bandwidth, MIG partitioning for isolated multi-tenant use, NVLink and PCIe Gen 4 improvements, and CUDA features such as task graphs, async copy, barriers, and L2 residency controls.

The study examined THE World University Rankings from 2015 to 2025 for top HEIs in ten Asian countries. China, Japan, and Russia showed the strongest and most stable rankings, while India improved overall. HEIs in Indonesia, Pakistan, Thailand, the Philippines, Bangladesh, and Vietnam generally lagged behind, with many showing neutral, fluctuating, or declining trends.

U.S. stocks gave up early gains as rising bond yields and tech declines weighed on markets ahead of major earnings. The S&P 500 was on track for its first weekly decline in five, while the Fed held rates steady and cited inflation concerns. Banks rose, eBay jumped after earnings, PayPal and UPS fell, and after-hours trading saw Amazon rise while Alphabet and Apple declined.

Odell Beckham Jr. accepted a six-game NFL suspension for violating the league’s performance-enhancing drugs policy after a failed test last season with the Dolphins. He said he did not knowingly take banned substances and wants to return this season, but he will not be eligible to play until Week 12.

The lecture discusses renormalization and Sudakov double logarithms in SCET, including cusp anomalous dimensions, Wilson coefficients, and running to resum logs. It explains when momentum labels in operators are fixed by external kinematics and when they lead to convolution-type renormalization, using DIS as the main example. The passage then sets up DIS factorization in the Breit frame and shows how the relevant quark operator relates to the parton distribution function.

Open source communities helped show software development is a community effort, and the book uses that perspective to explain patterns for distributed systems. It defines patterns as general blueprints rather than technology-specific instructions, and argues they help developers learn from others, share a common vocabulary, and build reusable components. The passage then introduces single-node patterns such as sidecar, ambassador, and adapter, showing how containers can add functionality, broker access to external services, and normalize interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks. It also outlines multi-node distributed patterns, including replicated load-balanced services and sharded services, with examples involving caches, SSL termination, and service routing.

The study found that increasing physical education hours with cognitively engaging activities improved short-term attention in middle school students, especially in Class 6 with 4 hours per week; control groups showed no significant changes. Sustained attention improved only in Class 6, and the authors noted that further research is needed on long-term effects and specific activity types.

The UK’s Competition and Markets Authority has designated Google Search with Strategic Market Status after a 10-month investigation, giving it power to impose measures such as rival search choice screens, fair ranking principles, greater data portability, and possible limits on AI Overviews. The rules will affect Google Search, News tab, Top Stories, and Discover, but not Google News or Gemini, and Google says the changes could harm innovation and growth.

The passage describes methods and hardware for configuring a deep neural network activation module using programmable lookup tables. It determines input ranges from calibration data, generates lookup data for those ranges, supports interpolation, clamping, offsetting, and switching between multiple activation functions, and includes related data processing system, integrated circuit, and manufacturing system embodiments.

Rockwood School District keeps students together for whole-class, grade-level reading instruction and uses flexible small groups for support or enrichment. The district says this approach produced higher kindergarten, first-grade, and second-grade reading results than national averages, while building confidence, stamina, and joy.

A study found that 75% of 198 honey samples from nearly 200 sites worldwide contained at least one neonicotinoid pesticide, with 45% containing two or more compounds and 10% containing four or five. North America had the highest proportion of contaminated samples at 86%, followed by Asia and Europe.

China has announced it will shut down its domestic ivory market by the end of 2017. Conservationists say the move could significantly reduce ivory demand, help curb elephant poaching, and may influence other countries to end ivory trade as well.

The passage reviews numerous higher education studies on online teaching quality, e-learning, leadership, resistance to change, quality assurance, rankings, internationalization, curriculum reform, and institutional support. It concludes that higher education publications are increasingly shaped by innovative models and technologies, with growing emphasis on inclusivity, accessibility, collaboration, and adaptability in scholarly communication.

Platinum futures are legally binding, exchange-traded contracts settled by physical delivery, used for speculation, diversification, and hedging. The passage describes trading rules, seasonality, contract specifications, risks, price drivers, and backtests showing mixed but sometimes solid performance.

The passage argues that high-dosage tutoring improves student learning and confidence, supports teachers, and can help recruit future educators. It cites Teach For America’s Ignite Fellowship, which has trained over 5,500 virtual tutors, produced strong test score gains, and led many fellows to enter teaching, including 280 new teachers this year.

The passage is a presidential veto message returning House bill No. 7864, which would amend U.S. immigration laws by excluding many immigrants who are physically capable and over 16 but cannot read and write, with limited family exceptions. The message argues this would be a radical and harmful departure from national immigration policy, criticizes the educational test as an unreliable measure of desirable citizenship, and objects to the bill’s harsh, indefinite, and oppressive provisions on alien labor and employment.

The study introduces GeoSQL-Eval, the first end-to-end automated framework for evaluating LLMs on PostGIS GeoSQL generation, and GeoSQL-Bench, a benchmark of 14,178 tasks covering conceptual understanding, SQL generation, and schema retrieval. It evaluates 24 models across five capability levels, finding that reasoning-enhanced and large SQL models generally perform best, but errors are dominated by PostGIS function misuse and SQL syntax mistakes, with table schema retrieval the main bottleneck.

The passage discusses informal U.S., British, and Chinese consideration at Dumbarton Oaks of how to liquidate the League of Nations and transfer functions to the United Nations, with no papers exchanged and no U.S. initiative taken. It also describes the League Supervisory Committee’s December 1944 action to form a committee to select a Conciliation Committee, and notes a January 31, 1945 meeting in Washington on the Dumbarton Oaks Proposals, including a request by the Chilean Ambassador to correct the minutes regarding international treaties.

Kyle Busch, after his third straight 2018 NASCAR Cup Series win at Richmond, said he hopes he is not peaking too early and noted that Talladega’s restrictor-plate race is unpredictable. He said his strong start has been special, short tracks suit him, and running lower-tier teams may give him an edge.

New patches to biosecurity screening software can better detect AI-altered harmful proteins. In computer simulations, original harmful proteins were usually flagged, but many AI-adjusted versions bypassed filters; patches reduced this problem and missed about 3 percent of variants. The study was done entirely on computers.

New Orleans and Louisiana are adapting to worsening flooding, land loss and sea-level rise after Hurricane Katrina, through raised homes, evacuation centers, rain gardens, urban water planning, and a $50 billion coastal master plan. The passage also describes ongoing challenges in the Lower Ninth Ward, where many residents have struggled to return amid damage, gentrification and abandoned homes.

The cup and handle pattern is a bullish continuation formation that resembles a cup with a handle, with a rounded cup forming after a rally and a handle forming on the right side before a breakout. It is used as a long signal, often with higher volume on breakout, stop-losses below the handle or cup bottom, and confirmation from other indicators. The passage also says market volatility, volume, and market psychology affect its formation and reliability, and that backtests and examples give mixed results.
On May 10, 2018, NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting that it issued a press release on its results for the quarter ended April 29, 2018, and attached CFO commentary for the same quarter.

The induced graph removal lemma differs from the usual removal lemma by counting induced copies and allowing edge additions as well as deletions. Its proof uses a strong regularity lemma that produces a partition and a refinement with very regular parts and controlled energy increase, avoiding irregular pairs through a selected subset of each part. This yields the induced removal lemma, an infinite removal lemma, and the conclusion that hereditary graph properties are testable by an oblivious one-sided error algorithm.

Higher-order Feynman diagrams can produce divergent loop integrals, giving infinite results unless a cutoff and renormalization are introduced. Physical masses and couplings are then redefined at a specific scale, and these couplings “run” with energy; new particles can change this running and may affect whether the electromagnetic, weak, and strong couplings unify at high energy.

Boston has long been the world’s leading life sciences hub, with more lab space than anywhere else and major federal and venture funding, but federal funding cuts and threats to higher education are now challenging its biotech advantage.

Roma are reportedly interested in signing Manchester United winger Adnan Januzaj, who is out of favour at Old Trafford and expected to be sold. Januzaj has returned after a poor loan spell at Sunderland, and Roma could view him as a cheaper replacement for Mohamed Salah.
This passage is a copyright and publication notice for a book by Brendan Burns, published by O’Reilly Media in 2018, and includes sales, trademark, and liability disclaimer information.

The passage explains dollar-cost averaging and lump sum investing, then describes a backtest of a lump sum buy-and-hold strategy using a diversified portfolio of five equal-weighted asset classes. It concludes that lump sum investing is historically the higher-probability choice, especially over long-term horizons of at least ten years, and that earlier investing produced higher total profit in the backtest.

The passage is a roundup of June 4–5, 2001 coverage on California’s energy crisis, focusing on allegations of price manipulation, new FERC price controls, and California Senate subpoenas to power companies including Enron. It also reports on Enron’s troubles in India’s Dabhol project, its exit from a Saudi gas venture, and media coverage of a PBS “Frontline” documentary on the crisis.

NeoWorld is a deep learning framework that generates an open-ended interactive world from a single image by progressively unfolding lightweight 2D object-centric representations into 3D. It combines object-centric scene reconstruction, image-to-3D conversion, and user-prompt-driven interaction to support 3D-consistent exploration, object manipulation, and physics-based animation while balancing realism and computational efficiency.

Senator Sherwin Gatchalian urged the Department of Education to address delays in releasing performance-based bonuses for public school teachers, calling the long delay unacceptable and asking for streamlined clearance processing. Teachers have yet to receive bonuses for school year 2016-2017, with DepEd citing failed biddings and delayed clearances.

Former president Robert Mugabe returned home after a bomb blast in Bulawayo intensified allegations against him and his allies, with Mnangagwa’s government accusing the former first family and G40 of being behind the attack. Mugabe’s family rejected the claims, while G40 figures warned that Mnangagwa was using the blast to target perceived enemies.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS ADC with input clamp protection up to ±18V, a PGA, wide common-mode rejection up to ±12V, selectable data formats, clock synchronization, an internal reference, configurable 2-lane or 4-lane SDR/DDR interfaces, data randomization, averaging, test patterns, speed-boost mode, and SPI register access including daisy-chain support.

Apple Inc. reported that on February 2, 2015, it entered into an underwriting agreement for the issuance and sale of $6.5 billion in senior unsecured notes due in 2020, 2022, 2025, and 2045, with interest and maturity terms specified for each series.

The passage describes a whole-body PBPK model for rifampicin, ethambutol, isoniazid, and pyrazinamide that adds pleura and lymph nodes to study extrapulmonary TB. The model was calibrated and validated using plasma and lung concentration data, then used to predict drug concentrations at extrapulmonary sites; it found rifampicin and isoniazid often exceeded critical concentrations, ethambutol was low in several sites, and pyrazinamide did not reach its critical concentration in any compartment.

Microsoft filed a Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2017. It reported revenue of $24.538 billion and net income of $6.576 billion, with total assets of $249.097 billion and total liabilities of $159.450 billion.

The U.S. Federal Reserve raised the federal funds rate by 0.25 points to a target range of 1 to 1.25 percent after a two-day policy meeting. It was the second increase in half a year and the third hike since Janet Yellen ended the near-zero rate policy after the financial crisis.

Dr. Maria Pane became a neonatologist during medical school and now cares for sick newborns at GBMC, often involving parents in rounds. She says this helps her understand families’ perspectives, and she values the teamwork at the neonatal intensive care unit.

Amazon.com reported Q2 2022 net sales of $121.2 billion, up 7% year over year, but posted a net loss of $2.0 billion and operating income of $3.3 billion. The company ended June 30, 2022 with $37.7 billion in cash and cash equivalents, $419.7 billion in total assets, and $58.1 billion in long-term debt.

The lecture introduced probabilistically checkable proofs (PCPs), defining them as proofs that can be verified by querying only a few randomly chosen locations. It explained the PCP complexity parameters, nonadaptive verification, and stated a construction for NP with polylogarithmic randomness and query complexity using the GKR protocol. The lecture also outlined efficiency and soundness considerations, noted that low-degree testing is needed, and prepared to connect this framework to cryptography.

A Stephens County jury convicted Robert Pearl Bryson of aggravated sodomy, child molestation, and failure to register as a sex offender. On appeal, the court found the evidence sufficient, upheld the denial of his motions to quash, motion to withdraw, and motion to sever, found no error in admitting the no contest plea, and held that he waived his ineffective assistance claim.

The passage presents FFDP, a distributed framework for image registration that uses fused kernels and boundary-synchronized sharding to reduce memory use and scale to ultra-high-resolution multimodal problems. It reports faster, more memory-efficient registration, including a 250µm-to-100µm brain MRI alignment with over 11.8B parameters completed in about one minute on 8 GPUs.

The paper examines how digital transformation, Big Data, Advanced Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence relate to enterprise digital business. It develops a multidimensional data-driven AI innovation taxonomy, an AI/BD/AA micro-level value chain, and a five-level AI maturity framework to help evaluate human-machine relationships and enterprise transformation across platforms and business models.

The passage lists multiple CS5535 device issues, including unreliable SSMI signaling when an IRQ occurs simultaneously, UDMA failures if bus mastering is enabled before a PIO command, several wake, RTC, USB, IDE, SMBus, GPIO, and sleep-state behavior problems, and recommended workarounds such as using normal UDMA procedure, PWRBTN#, interrupts, DWORD-aligned PRDs, and specific register programming changes.

The Mississippi Supreme Court affirmed Ulysses S. Gandy’s second manslaughter conviction and ten-year sentence, holding that the evidence was sufficient to support the jury’s findings of intoxication, wrong-lane driving, and culpable negligence, and rejecting his claims regarding a refused instruction, admission of three sketch exhibits, and the lack of a food recess during deliberations.

The study developed a region-specific SIR metapopulation model linking Google Community Mobility Reports, temperature, and virus variants to SARS-CoV-2 transmission in Norway, Sweden, and two German regions. It found that GCMR settings explained substantial infection shares, with Transit stations and Workplaces most important in Norway and Sweden, while Retail & recreation was most important in the German regions. Seasonality reduced transmissibility, and Alpha and Delta increased it.

Ronald Reagan’s acceptance speech thanked Texas and Dallas, accepted the Republican nomination, and contrasted his party’s vision of hope, growth, and individual freedom with his opponents’ pessimism and government expansion. He defended his administration’s record on inflation, taxes, jobs, defense, and foreign policy, criticized past Democratic policies, called for lower taxes, fiscal restraint, stronger alliances, and reduced nuclear arms, and ended by praising America’s promise and unity.

This study compared mydriatic and non-mydriatic portable retinal images for diabetic retinopathy screening in 327 patients. Mydriasis produced more gradable images (82.1% vs 55.6%) and slightly better AI performance, with higher accuracy, F1 score, and AUC, and fewer false positives. Older age, systemic hypertension, longer diabetes duration, male gender, and Indigenous race were associated with lower image gradability in non-mydriatic images.

The study harmonized Korean and Taiwanese stroke registries into a 9,941-patient EVT dataset. Taiwanese patients were older and had more vascular risk factors and more severe strokes, with lower functional recovery. Age, especially 75–85 years, was strongly associated with worse EVT outcomes, but symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage did not differ by age.

EUR/USD is rising for a fourth straight session, supported near 1.1810 and trading around 1.1826, close to daily highs near 1.1840. The move follows a weaker greenback after US inflation data, while markets await ECB and FOMC minutes.

Texas Instruments warns that the integrated circuit can be damaged by ESD and should be handled with proper precautions. The document also notes a revision update changing ADS8685W and ADS8689W from Advance Information to Production Data, and provides mechanical, packaging, and orderable information subject to change.

A July 10, 2001 message listed multiple news items on California electricity prices, Enron, and the Dabhol project, including reports on Duke Energy, refund talks, and Neil McGregor’s resignation from Enron’s Indian unit.

Grief is a highly personal emotional reaction to loss, including death, illness, or major life changes. It can involve shock, denial, yearning, guilt, anger, sadness, disturbed sleep, and loss of confidence, and may begin before an expected loss. There is no fixed stage process or set timeframe, but most people eventually have more good days than bad days and may need support.

The ADS9803 supports simple and moving average modes for SNR improvement, with simple averaging reducing output data rate by 2 and moving average leaving it unchanged. It also provides test patterns for two channel groups, power-down and initialization sequences, speed-boost mode for a selected channel pair, SPI register access across three banks, and daisy-chain SPI support for multiple devices.

The Patriots had one of their worst offensive games of the Tom Brady era against the Dolphins, going 0-for-11 on third down and gaining just two yards in the first quarter, but they still had a chance in the final minute. Stephen Gostkowski’s onside kick attempt was described as bizarre and half-hearted, and the Dolphins recovered to win the game.

Researchers led by Joshua Caldwell reported that isotopically purified hexagonal boron nitride greatly improves hyperlensing by reducing optical losses and increasing polariton lifetime, enabling theoretical imaging of objects as small as 30 nanometers. The advance could allow low-energy imaging of living cells in natural environments and has potential applications in biology, medicine, communications, and nanoscale optical components.

Beating the offside trap requires attackers to recognize the trap, stay onside, and adjust their play to use the space behind defenders. The passage describes several tactics, including dribble through, through passes, lateral runs, checking runs, short passes, deep-lying runs, bending runs, back passes, delayed runs, and a designated non-runner, especially on free kicks.

Scientists found that periwinkles can adapt to more acidic ocean conditions by changing shell production, making less-dense inner shells and less-soluble shells, though their metabolism declined. The findings suggest some calcifying organisms may be more resistant to ocean acidification than previously thought.

The appeal from the District Court of Humacao was decided on the grounds of People v. Soldán. The case was almost identical to case No. 2037, and for the same reasons the judgment was reversed and the defendant acquitted.

The passage lists multiple financial and business headlines, including EU scrutiny of Italy’s bank merger rules, China’s blacklisting of TechInsights over Huawei chip analysis, Google’s launch of Gemini Enterprise, Turkey’s €974 million highway loan, and market updates such as rising gold prices and Wall Street gains.

The passage argues that fears about Netflix’s competition, pricing power, and accounting are overblown, noting its subscriber growth, ability to raise prices, and market dominance. It concludes that betting against Netflix is dangerous, despite Barron’s warning that the stock could fall sharply.

A study in Pediatrics found nearly 17,000 children under 6 were treated in emergency rooms for window-blind injuries from 1990 to 2015, with entanglement in blind cords causing most hospitalizations and deaths. The authors called for mandatory blinds with inaccessible cords, and safety groups urged consumers to choose cordless or inaccessible-cord window coverings.

Ryan Kerr, 26, was remanded in custody after admitting several assaults, including punching a woman and attacking a man who was left unconscious in a pub toilet. The court heard he showed no remorse and had previous convictions for battery and assault. The judge will decide his sentence on October 13.

Peterborough City Council says it has brought 179 empty homes back into use in the past year and 663 over five years, while also outlining budget proposals, warning of reduced government funding, reporting early success of two PSPOs, and launching CHUMS to support children and young people’s mental health.

Shannon Bard announced that Zapoteca in Portland has closed permanently, saying family priorities have changed as her children reach their later school years. The Bards opened the restaurant six years ago and still own Toroso, Salud, a cooking school, and a catering company.

The study evaluated whether best supportive care plus high-volume, high-titer convalescent plasma reduced the need for mechanical ventilation in hospitalized COVID-19 patients, and assessed safety and other clinical outcomes versus best supportive care or standard of care. It was approved by ethics committees, conducted under Helsinki and ICH-GCP guidelines, and required signed informed consent before enrollment.

The NAAIM Exposure Index is a weekly measure compiled by the National Association of Active Investment Managers from members’ reported equity exposure, using a two-week moving average. It is used to gauge investor sentiment and may serve as a contrarian indicator, but the passage says backtests found it performed poorly and was less useful than other indicators.

Lubrizol Corp. is investing US$80 million to expand TPU production capacity in North America, Europe, and Asia due to increased demand. The expansion includes new capabilities in North America, new compounding and extrusion lines in Songjiang, China, and added production for elastomers, aliphatics, and adhesives in Europe, with further investments planned for 2019.

Jeff Horn will defend his WBO welterweight title against Gary Corcoran, with a win potentially leading to major fights, including a bout with Terence Crawford. Horn aims to quiet criticism over his controversial win against Manny Pacquiao, while Corcoran enters as the underdog in his first world title fight outside Britain and Ireland.

Trump announced a deal with Pfizer to lower drug prices for Medicaid and direct-purchase patients, with new medicines to be launched at prices matching other countries. Pfizer may avoid certain U.S. drug tariffs if it keeps investing in U.S. manufacturing, but experts said the deal’s effect on affordability and Medicaid costs is unclear. Sanofi also confirmed it is under European Commission investigation for possible anticompetitive activity.

Manchester City host Burnley at the Etihad Stadium on Jan. 2, with City expected to attack and aim for an early goal. Pep Guardiola needs his team to stay fit and unbeaten, while Burnley are fighting to avoid relegation. Sergio Aguero returns for City, and Burnley’s main threats are Andre Gray and Sam Vokes.

This EEG study compared 19 adults with Tourette syndrome and matched healthy controls during median nerve stimulation. The Tourette group showed increased trial-by-trial variability and flatter high-beta/gamma 1/f PSD slopes, while early and mid-latency SEP timing, topography, and most amplitudes were similar between groups. The P2 (P100) SEP amplitude and beta-band coherence were increased in Tourette syndrome, and variability decreased after stimulation in both groups.

Facebook published a longer, more detailed version of its community standards, covering topics such as drug use, sex work, bullying, hate speech and violence, and said users can now appeal individual content removals. The company said the rules are being made more transparent and will be updated frequently, while local-law takedown requests are handled separately and can lead to country-specific blocking.

Apple Inc. reported that on June 20, 2017 it completed the issuance and sale of $1.0 billion of 3.000% Notes due 2027. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, with interest payable semi-annually starting December 20, 2017 and maturity on June 20, 2027.

A federal jury found retired Little Rock police lieutenant David Hudson did not use excessive force when he punched Jon Erwin outside a restaurant in 2011. The jury decided Hudson’s actions were reasonable after hearing testimony about the confrontation and the Little Rock Police Department’s use-of-force policy.

The Finnish press largely ignored U.S. war statements, while Finnish irritation with Germany grew because German troops were seen as unhelpful, even as Finland depended on Germany for supplies and food. German influence on the press remained strong, and war weariness and social unrest increased, including a trade union petition over worsening conditions and food shortages. U.S. officials also discussed Finnish press attacks and Finnish censorship, and a Finnish representative acknowledged that Finland could not criticize Germany because of its dependence on German foodstuffs.

An article about Enron’s rise and fall was circulated, prompting discussion of how Jeff Skilling and Ken Lay built the company into a trading giant, then faced criticism as its stock fell, its accounting was questioned, and Skilling later resigned as CEO.

The passage is a long hockey interview about playoff games, penalties, power plays, matchups, coaching adjustments, and team structure. The speaker says the series has been hard to read because of many calls, that quick puck movement and defensive positioning are key, and that the team’s defense improved after personnel changes. He also describes his coaching style as adaptive, emphasizes delegation, and says he enjoys hockey and coaching despite the pressure.

Amazon.com, Inc. reported first-quarter 2018 net sales of $51.0 billion, up from $35.7 billion a year earlier, and net income of $1.629 billion versus $724 million. Operating income rose to $1.927 billion. Cash and cash equivalents plus restricted cash were $17.6 billion at March 31, 2018, and total assets were $126.4 billion. The company adopted new revenue, financial instruments, income tax, and restricted cash accounting guidance in Q1 2018 and disclosed ongoing legal, tax, and acquisition matters, including the April 12, 2018 acquisition of Ring Inc. for about $900 million.

The paper surveys ontologies and ontology design patterns for process modeling in Materials Science and Engineering, identifies requirements for process structure, data/resources, and project roles, and extracts reusable patterns from ontologies including P-PLAN, Metadata4Ing, WILD, GPO, OPMW, and PMDcore. It also presents a semantic-similarity-based baseline method for automatic ODP extraction and reports that P-PLAN performed best for process and resource patterns, while PMDcore covered all three pattern types.

Florida State linebacker Ethan Pritchard was released from the hospital and moved to Brooks Rehabilitation in Jacksonville nearly six weeks after being shot in the back of the head. The school said he is alert, responsive, and able to communicate, and four people have been arrested in connection with the shooting.

Old Forge High School students organized a Math-a-thon for St. Jude’s Research Hospital and raised $3,864. Rosemarie Corigliano was installed as president of the Wayne Memorial Hospital Auxiliary, which has planned two fundraisers and previously presented over $250,000 to the hospital. Hannah Perry Burgess gave a honey bee program at a Scranton City Chapter of the DAR meeting focused on conservationism.

GoDaddy gave The Daily Stormer 24 hours to move its domain after an article mocking Heather Heyer, saying it could incite violence and violate terms of service. The site later claimed it had been hacked, but a contributor said that was a prank, and the publisher said he was trying to regain control of the site.

A July 2021 salmonella outbreak in Cardiff was linked to an Eid al-Adha barbecue, with 22 symptomatic cases identified. Epidemiological and microbiological evidence indicated traditional raw liver dish “marrara” as the main vehicle of infection, while contaminated sheep meat also matched human isolates by whole genome sequencing.

A federal appeals court ruled the government cannot stop interstate trade of Burmese pythons and other giant exotic snakes within the continental U.S., saying the Lacey Act does not authorize such restrictions. The ruling does not change import bans or state laws, and the Fish and Wildlife Service is reviewing next steps.

The speaker says the team gained confidence after Holik’s chance in the second period, when the pace slowed and they began to hang on to the puck and make plays. They say their team had been at a disadvantage in the series, but in Game 4 they finally started to fight back, with better effort, emotion, and faceoffs. They also say they stayed overnight to keep a normal schedule and believe they must play better than New Jersey to win Game 5.

The passage argues that weakening family life and wilful sterility harm the nation, and then urges Congress to support American shipping and reform currency laws. It says current currency laws are defective, especially during crop seasons, causing severe fluctuations in call money, high commercial rates, and business strain.

Fad diets, juice cleanses, and cutting out carbohydrates may lead to temporary weight loss, but the passage says sustainable weight loss comes from avoiding strict dieting, reconnecting with food, and building a healthy relationship with the body. It emphasizes moderation and promoting healthy habits rather than feeling deprived.

Gold Coast signed veteran Michael Gordon to a two-year NRL deal after he was released by the Sydney Roosters, and he is expected to fill the Titans’ fullback vacancy and likely take over goal kicking duties.

Morgan McSweeney, also known as Dr. Noc, describes his social media work as “edutainment” that makes public health and science topics engaging and digestible. He says nuance and occasional personal details help build trust, and that he now focuses on reaching confused middle audiences rather than people who strongly disagree. He also says his biotech day job and social media work are mostly kept separate, and that comments or accusations no longer bother him much.

The Coppock Curve is a long-term smoothed momentum indicator, originally devised by E.S.C. Coppock, using a 10-month WMA of 11- and 14-month ROC values. It signals long entries when crossing above zero and exits when crossing below zero. The passage says a monthly backtest on the S&P 500 produced few trades, reduced drawdown, and risk-adjusted returns above buy and hold.

The passage discusses Nick Foles’ unexpected rise as the Eagles’ Super Bowl starter after Carson Wentz’s injury, noting that Foles could lead Philadelphia to its first Super Bowl win. It says Wentz is expected to return as the starter in 2018, which could leave Foles’ future uncertain despite his success. Possible outcomes include the Eagles keeping Foles as a backup, or exploring a trade or other move after the season.

The speech congratulates the 100th Congress during the Constitution’s 200th anniversary, praises economic progress, and urges Congress to support defense, foreign policy, budget reform, welfare reform, competitiveness, education, and anti-drug efforts. It accepts responsibility for the failed Iran action, warns against Soviet and Nicaraguan threats, supports SDI and arms reduction, and closes by celebrating the Constitution and America’s future under “We the people.”

The passage describes memory map references, the DDR DMM TILER extended addressing map, and package pin assignments. It explains terminal function tables, including pin multiplexing, reset boot mode sampling, and how various pins default to GPMC functions after reset.

The passage says the team was outworked and lacked full effort, with players noting they did not have everybody going. It says they could accept losing if they played hard, but not the way they performed. It also mentions mixed play in recent games, defensive focus against Pittsburgh, and that they need to support each other and get more shots on net.

UND campus senate chair Dana Harsell said the executive committee will review the draft NDUS proclamation and gauge support for it. The NDSU Faculty Senate proposal cites a “crisis of confidence” in the university system over budget cuts and consolidation efforts, calls for stronger advocacy and collaboration, and urges a higher education summit with campus, state, and gubernatorial leaders.

The author wrote the book to share repeatable patterns and reusable components for distributed systems, reducing the need to reimplement similar systems and making reliable distributed system development more efficient.

Energy Central’s Research Report Watch newsletter lists recently published and new reports on the power industry, including utility profiles, marketing, deregulation, e-commerce, and white papers, with prices, publishers, and ordering information.

The lecture explains how sustainable real estate fits into sustainable finance, linking tenants’ preferences and regulatory effects to higher rents, lower risk, and higher asset values. It covers portfolio theory, green versus brown buildings, mortgage pricing and default risk, green mortgages and renovation financing, and private equity’s use of ESG in investment decisions.

A wind advisory is in effect until 7 AM CDT Monday across the South Plains area, with windy conditions, areas of blowing dust, and mostly clear to mostly sunny skies through Monday. Lows tonight are mainly in the 30s to 50s, Monday highs are mostly in the upper 50s to upper 60s, and conditions turn colder Monday night before warming steadily midweek into Thursday and Friday, when highs reach the upper 70s to lower 90s.

Patrick Kane discusses lineup changes, playing against tough opponents, the team’s depth and defensive focus, his growth as a more well-rounded player, and the importance of wanting the puck and making plays without worrying about points.

Treasury bears recovered some losses as Italian political turmoil triggered a safe-haven rally into U.S. government debt, causing a sharp drop in Treasury futures open interest. The 10-year yield rose to 2.855 percent on Wednesday after falling to 2.759 percent on Tuesday, while analysts said bond positions remained vulnerable to further political developments in Europe.

Havant Borough Council has banned bouncy castles and other inflatables on its land after a three-year-old girl died in Norfolk when an inflatable trampoline exploded. The ban will stay in place until the inquiry into the cause of the accident is complete and the risk can be assessed.

He credits Jeff Reese with changing his style, says he feels anxious to start the series, and notes the team had time to rest and recover. He emphasizes focusing on shutting down the other team’s top players and says they will attack their goalie as they did other strong goalies. He also mentions shouldering injuries and surgery last summer, and expects the games to become heated and physical quickly.

Wikipedia in Italy and Spain blocked articles to protest proposed EU copyright law changes, especially Articles 11 and 13. Critics warned the directive could harm online freedom, require filtering systems, and risk making Wikipedia harder to use or even forcing it to close down.

Twin Rivers Council is asking families to enroll girls in Cub Scouts now through March 31, aiming for up to 125 girls in kindergarten through third grade so they can attend summer camp programs. The Boy Scouts of America opened Cub Scouting to girls starting in fall 2018, and interested parents can use the “Be a Scout” website or call the council office.

Audi’s forthcoming Q8 will be the brand’s new flagship SUV, with styling closely based on the 2017 Q8 Concept and featuring a prominent hexagonal grille, large air intakes, and scowling headlamps. It is expected to debut in Shanghai in early June, ride on Volkswagen Group’s MLB platform, and its production powertrain has not been confirmed.

It says environmental groups exploit fear for money and suggests Earth Day should be used for outdoor enjoyment after litter cleanup.

It also mentions rising volatility and credit spreads, heavier investor exposure to tech stocks, and a breakout in US electricity demand.

SpaceX launched an unmanned Falcon 9 rocket from Kennedy Space Center carrying 6,400 pounds of cargo to the International Space Station, mostly experiments including 20 mice. The Dragon capsule also carried ice cream and ice cream candy bars for the station’s six-member crew, including Peggy Whitson. SpaceX planned to try to land the booster back at Cape Canaveral.

The Health Ministry requested $8 million to offset rising indigent and seafarers health costs, and the funding was approved after legislators discussed the need to manage costs and consider national health insurance.

A blitz in football is a defensive play that sends five or more players into the offensive backfield to pressure the quarterback or disrupt the run. Blitzes carry risk because they leave fewer defenders in coverage, but they can confuse offenses, create sacks or turnovers, and are used in several forms, including zone, safety, cornerback, zero, and run blitzes. Offenses can counter with quick passes, mobile quarterbacks, or max protection blocking schemes.

The passage lists five Indian film romantic scenes enhanced by VFX: Baahubali, Befikre, Shivaay, Sanam Re, and Prem Ratan Dhan Payo, highlighting how visual effects created dreamlike locations, snow, ocean views, and other romantic visuals.

NVIDIA’s quarterly report for the period ended October 30, 2016 showed revenue of $2.004 billion and net income of $542 million for the quarter, with nine-month revenue of $4.737 billion and net income of $1.012 billion. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $6.67 billion, and the company issued $2.0 billion in new long-term notes during the quarter. Revenue increased year over year in both the GPU and Tegra Processor segments, and the company early adopted a stock-based compensation accounting standard.

The passage explains market sentiment as the aggregate mood of investors and traders, measured by sentiment indicators such as the AAII index. AAII surveys members weekly on the stock market’s six-month outlook. Backtests suggest very bearish readings are followed by higher four-week returns than very bullish readings, though the passage says other indicators may be better for short-term trading.
Antarctic krill eject more leftover food when it is contaminated with plastic, but the effects of plastic on their role in the carbon cycle are unclear.

Coach Sutter said offense and top-end players are especially valuable in the playoffs if they are ready, and he emphasized that lineup changes depend on game situation. He said the team has handled emotional and scheduling challenges well, relies on veterans and young players, and focuses on nutrition, hydration, and routine. He also noted the team’s confidence is not a concern, that the finals have been very close, praised Brodeur’s performance, and said Jonathan needs to play that well next.

The passage argues that rapid social and technological change makes lifelong learning essential for librarians in Romania. It describes LIS training routes, alternative and non-formal learning methods, limited institutional funding, and the 2012 Occupational Standard for higher-education librarians, which defines required competences and activities.

Residents of Greensboro’s Cottage Grove neighborhood say housing conditions at Avalon Trace Apartments have declined, with trash, boarded windows, sewage leaks, inadequate heating, roaches and mold. Community groups and local partners received $250,000 in grant funding, matched by Cone Health, to identify asthma hot spots and create a map to guide services for residents.

China’s power generation in July rose 8.6% year on year to 604.7 billion kWh, a monthly record since May 2014, driven by thermal power, which was up 10.5% to 433.4 billion kWh. Total output for January-July increased 6.8% to 3.57 trillion kWh, with nuclear, wind and solar up and hydro down 3.4% year on year.

The Miami Hurricane editorial argues that student newspapers need funding and editorial independence to let student journalists practice independent reporting, learn professional skills, and serve campus communities. It says threats to student newsrooms undermine students’ understanding of a free press and calls for support of #SaveStudentNewsrooms.

It shows framing-only optimization is NP-hard and sensitive to belief-oracle errors, while joint framing and recommendation is more tractable, with a continuous objective and a QPTAS. The authors also present LLM-based experiments and human studies supporting the approach.

It blamed Belgium and the powers influencing it for the war’s effects there, and said the Allied powers would continue the struggle until a peace ensuring honor and development was achieved. It also includes the Persian Minister’s welcome of President Wilson’s peace note and request that the United States help preserve Persia’s integrity, and an account from the ambassador in Turkey about possible Greek deportations, German efforts to discourage them, and fears of massacres.

Jaguars edge rusher Travon Walker had left wrist surgery after getting injured in Sunday’s win over San Francisco, and coach Liam Coen said he is day-to-day and could play against Kansas City. Walker is second on the team with two sacks.

Players said they missed good chances, outshot the opponent, and must score more goals after a tough loss in the Stanley Cup Finals. They said both goalies were very good, the team was not outplayed, and the series is now best of three.

At a Department of Education negotiated rule-making meeting in Washington, officials said they would keep their proposed fixed list of 10 “professional” degrees, which could leave many health-care graduate programs subject to lower student loan caps. Committee members objected and drafted an alternative definition for further discussion, while the department said it remained open to future rule making.

ESA’s JUICE mission to Jupiter has received NASA approval and is set to launch in 2022. The probe will study Jupiter and its moons Ganymede, Callisto, and Europa, with a focus on Europa’s habitability, and is expected to reach Jupiter by 2030 for a three-year exploration.

Drake University’s Painted Street is organized by SAB co-chairs Karoline Sandusky and Meghan Mulligan, who select designs based on creativity and how well they fit the annual Relays theme. Organizations submit designs after Blitz Day, and small groups often pay for their own paint supplies.

A Bloomberg Law analysis of campaign contributions found that BigLaw and larger plaintiffs-side firms gave 92.45% of contributions to Democrats in 2023 and 2024, up from a 6-1 Democratic-to-Republican ratio in 2017-2020. The study covered the nation’s 100 top-grossing firms and 50 larger plaintiffs-side firms, with about $52 million given to Democratic-affiliated groups and about $4 million to Republican-affiliated groups. The firms with the highest Democratic contribution shares were Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton, Fried, Frank, Harris, Shriver & Jacobson, and Mintz, Levin, Cohn, Ferris, Glovsky and Popeo; the lowest were Nelson Mullins Riley & Scarborough, Lewis Brisbois Bisgaard & Smith, and Ogletree, Deakins, Nash, Smoak & Stewart.

Olusola Simeon, 25, was arraigned and convicted by a Magistrate court in Osogbo for assaulting and injuring his girlfriend, Fadunsi Alaba. He admitted guilt, and the court remanded him in Ilesha prison custody before adjourning the case for sentencing on August 3.

A 29-year-old Grande Prairie man, Wally Adams, was arrested in Calgary and charged with possession of child pornography and making it available after a RCMP investigation and search warrant in Grande Prairie. He has been released and is due in provincial court on Sept. 27.

San Juan High School’s baseball team says someone is posing as part of the team to solicit fake sponsorships from local businesses, costing at least one business about $1,400. The team filed a police report, posted a warning on social media, and is urging businesses to verify requests directly with the school or program before donating.

It mentions George McPhee’s qualities, the decision to leave the team without a captain and rely on a leadership group, the team’s road wins and confidence, and the community’s response after an emotional opening night ceremony. It also says the expansion draft rules and salary cap created opportunities to acquire players and draft picks, and that the team aimed to be competitive and enjoyable rather than set a win total.

The TSX was slightly higher as gains in Canadian National Railway, Restaurant Brands International, and materials stocks offset declines elsewhere. Gold steadied, helping precious metals miners, while Mitel Networks was the biggest gainer and Prairiesky Royal the biggest decliner.

High-energy 1 MeV electron-beam irradiation was used to controllably engineer defects in monolayer MoS2 by varying exposure time. Irradiation increased defect-bound PL emission, induced Mo-O bonding and p-type behavior, and reduced valley polarization. XPS, KPFM, Raman, temperature- and power-dependent PL, and first-principles calculations showed that oxygen at sulfur vacancies creates acceptor-like defect states responsible for the observed optical changes.

Gold prices are driven by supply and demand, the US Dollar, investors, central banks, and jewelry demand. From 1955 to 2022, gold reached 80 monthly all-time highs, but it also had long periods without new highs. The article backtests a gold new high trading strategy using monthly closing prices and finds a decent equity curve, lower return, reduced market exposure, and a smaller maximum drawdown.

Japanese and Chinese forces were both increasing in Korea, with Japanese troops occupying Seoul and strategic points while China continued to send troops. Japan refused to withdraw until China gave guarantees not to interfere in Korean affairs, and foreign representatives tried unsuccessfully to secure a simultaneous withdrawal, as conflict seemed imminent.

Tencent added Batman to Arena of Valor, along with a new Death Match mode, Valor TV, and UI and menu improvements. Batman joins other DC characters in the game and is built for stealthy Assassin-style play.

The Wing-T is a football offense built on misdirection, unusual formations, and a varied run game to confuse aggressive defenses. Developed by Harold “Tubby” Raymond at Delaware, it requires at least two capable running backs, an athletic quarterback, and often smaller, quicker linemen. Its strengths are deception, adaptability, and an uncommon style; its main weakness is a limited traditional dropback passing game. Common formations include Wing, Wing-Slot, and unbalanced sets, with plays such as Buck Sweep, Down, Trap, Waggle, option routes, and play-action vertical passes. It is still common in high school football and has influenced spread offenses such as Gus Malzahn’s.

The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 3.75, with 1 Buy, 3 Hold, 1 Underperform, and 1 Sell rating. Corning, a science-based materials company founded in 1851, repeatedly reinvented itself through innovations in glass, optical fiber, and other technologies. After a severe telecom crash in 2002, it recovered by 2008, with revenue and stock rebounding and innovation centrally managed by the Growth and Strategy Council, which allocated resources across business segments and innovation projects.

Backtesting from 2016 onward found the strategy profitable on paper, with EMA filtering improving results and EMA200 chosen as a common setting. The strategy beat buy and hold with less volatility, but the small number of trades means out-of-sample testing and caution are recommended before live trading.

A Tennessee judge sentenced Christopher Drone Bassett to life plus 35 years for first-degree murder in the 2015 death of 15-year-old Zaevion Dobson, who shielded friends from gunfire. Co-defendants Richard Gregory Williams III and Kipling Deshawn Colbert received 143-year and 109-year sentences, respectively, for facilitating the murder, with some time also tied to unrelated charges.

The devices achieve state-of-the-art finesse and quality factors, with measured values up to F = 0.89 × 10^6 and Q = 2.3 × 10^9, and can be assembled into compact cavity systems for quantum and classical optical applications.

Amazon is developing a top-secret home robot project called Vesta, overseen by Gregg Zehr, with plans to seed robots in employees’ homes and possibly sell to consumers later. The robots may act as mobile Alexa devices, use advanced cameras and computer vision to navigate homes, and are part of a market expected to grow significantly by 2023.

San Miguel Pure Foods Company is delaying its planned P100-150 billion follow-on offering to the third or fourth quarter, citing market volatility and the need to let investors absorb recent stock rights offerings. The share sale is intended to raise public ownership to meet the 15% minimum after mergers that will leave the new entity with a 4.3% public float.

It enables users to run simulations with a selected version or a hybrid of versions, bypass selected components or input overriding values, and output simulation results through a reporting engine.

Nigeria is seeing more shopping malls, especially in Lagos, driven by demand for convenience, one-stop shopping, and changing lifestyles. The new and expanding malls are described as signs of investor confidence and are said to create jobs and increase tax revenue.

Paul Tisdale said Exeter City could be proud of their performance in a 1-0 defeat to Luton Town, despite missing six defenders and losing to Harry Cornick’s deflected strike. He praised his players’ effort, defended Liam McAlinden’s disallowed late equaliser, and said Exeter can still face Wycombe Wanderers with confidence.

Apple Inc. reported the results of its March 10, 2015 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. Shareholders elected seven directors, ratified Ernst & Young LLP as independent auditor for 2015, approved executive compensation, and approved an amendment to increase shares under the Employee Stock Purchase Plan by 50,000,000. Two shareholder proposals, “Risk Report” and “Proxy Access for Shareholders,” were not approved.

Environment and Climate Change Canada said none of more than a dozen phthalates studied posed a risk to human health, and only one needs further environmental study. Environmental Defence criticized the decision, saying Canada missed a chance to protect people from harmful chemicals and should modernize its laws to require proof that products are safe before use.

The passage argues that standardized testing narrows curriculum and teaching, including in school choice programs, and says testing choice would let schools use assessments that fit their educational approach. It criticizes SAT and ACT standards as degraded and recommends states offer multiple assessment options and accept them for public college admissions and scholarships.

The Supreme Court will hear a challenge to Colorado’s ban on conversion therapy for minors, with therapist Kaley Chiles arguing it violates free speech and Colorado arguing it regulates unsafe and ineffective treatment. The dispute centers on whether the law regulates speech or conduct and whether strict scrutiny or rational basis review applies.

A Canadian Society of Palliative Care Physicians report says expanding palliative and hospice care across Canada would improve care and reduce costs, with evidence of savings from hospital, outpatient, home, and residential hospice services. It recommends a mix of programs and urges governments to improve, monitor, and evaluate access and quality of palliative care.

AMP chairman David Murray said ASX corporate governance principles had contributed to weaker financial sector governance by discouraging new models, creating a trust deficit, and becoming overly detailed and prescriptive, leading institutions to conform rather than use the opt-out option.

The court affirmed judgment for the defendants in an automobile negligence case arising from a street intersection collision. It held there was no reversible error in the jury charge regarding alleged negligence, right of way, speed reduction, or comparative negligence, and the evidence supported the defense verdict.

At the Johnston Press South Business Awards in Brighton, Guardian Angel Carers of Chichester won Large Business of the Year and Overall Business of the Year. Other winners included Olive and Vine, Talks at Six, and Southsea Bathing Hut, with awards given across categories such as startup, innovation, community contribution, and retailer of the year.

Gardaí have appealed for information about the murder of 18-year-old Cameron Reilly in Dunleer, saying his missing iPhone may hold key evidence. In a separate operation in west Dublin, gardaí seized a shotgun, drugs worth about €1m and cash, and arrested a man and a woman.

The Central Bank of Nigeria has introduced FORM X for SMEs to improve foreign exchange access and reduce documentation requirements. The form requires a supporting application letter, beneficiary invoice, and bank wire transfer, and applies to forex needs of $10,000 or less for genuine transactions.

It also describes adaptive bitrate selection, jump points, proxy servers that generate indexes or proxy streams, and a system of streaming client, video player, performance monitor, and trick-play optimizer to improve fast-forward and rewind experience.

It lists warning signs such as swelling, dimpling, redness, rashes, nipple discharge or inversion, and advises regular self-examination and medical review of any unusual changes. It also describes risk factors, screening, treatment benefits of early diagnosis, and notes that men can also get breast cancer.

NVIDIA Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that on June 16, 2019 its Board appointed Donald F. Robertson Jr. as Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer and Principal Accounting Officer, effective June 17, 2019. Robertson will report to CFO Colette Kress, replace Michael Byron in those roles, and receive a $650,000 salary, a $600,000 sign-on bonus, 15,000 RSUs, and other benefits.

Travis Haydon, 20, was jailed for 18 months after stabbing Liam Brown in the stomach with a flick knife during a pub row over a spilt drink in Plymouth. He admitted assault, possessing a knife in public, cannabis possession, and breaching a suspended sentence, and the judge said the offence could have been much more serious.

SPYR, Inc. said it will give shareholders of record on May 19, 2017, a 1-for-1 dividend of shares in a new publicly traded spin-off company created to separate its restaurant division. The spin-off will focus on licensing or franchising the Eat at Joe’s name and concept and on branded foods.

Scientists identified Breugnathair elgolensis, a 167-million-year-old Jurassic lizard from Scotland’s Isle of Skye, with snake-like jaws and hook-like teeth plus lizard-like body and limbs. The fossil belongs to a newly defined group of extinct squamates, Parviraptoridae, and suggests snake ancestors may have been different than expected or that snake-like traits evolved independently.

The A100 GPU has 40 MB of shared L2 cache, 6.7x larger than Tesla V100’s, improving performance and bandwidth for many HPC and AI workloads. It is split into two partitions and 40 slices, with 5120 Bytes/clk read bandwidth, hardware cache coherence, residency controls, and Compute Data Compression that can improve bandwidth up to 4x.

Chicago is preparing heavy security for three major sports events amid fears heightened by the Las Vegas shooting. Officials plan increased police, undercover officers, and layered checks for the marathon, Cubs game, and Bears game, while urging public vigilance and coordination with nearby high-rise buildings.
AI models Evo 1 and Evo 2 generated bacteriophage genomes from scratch, and some of the AI-designed viruses outperformed a well-studied strain in lab dishes.

Saudi Aramco plans to change its Asia crude pricing formula from October, switching to a 50:50 average of DME Oman futures and Platts-assessed Dubai cash prices instead of Platts-assessed Oman and Dubai prices. The move, the first OSP benchmark change since the mid-1980s, is expected to boost DME Oman trading liquidity and may influence other Middle East producers.

DoorDash unveiled Dot, a nearly five-foot-tall autonomous delivery robot, as part of a hybrid delivery model that also includes humans, drones, and autonomous vehicles. The discussion said delivery robots face major technical and regulatory challenges, especially on sidewalks and bike lanes, but companies like Coco and Starship are still advancing the technology in limited settings such as suburbs and university campuses.

He also says past land sales to the English were paid, encourages them to farm and adopt industry, clarifies that earlier goods were gifts, and arranges further discussions and safe travel home.

The court reversed the denial of unemployment benefits to Genel Altimeaux, finding the referee’s conclusion that he voluntarily quit was not supported by competent, substantial evidence because it rested on uncross-examined testimony from a prior hearing.

Parents are questioning Township High School District 113’s process for hiring a new Highland Park High School principal, especially why only two parents are on the 18-member stakeholder interview committee and how parents were selected. Superintendent Christopher Dignam said the process is the same used at Deerfield High School and that a principal should be selected by April 25.

Pin and Pull is a perimeter run that creates favorable down-block angles and gets blockers in space as lead blockers. Its strengths are getting extra blockers to the point of attack and offering versatility, while its weaknesses are the need for specific personnel, especially two guards who can pull and a speed back. The passage also explains differences from Buck Sweep, gives blocking assignments against 3-4 and 4-3 fronts, and describes two toss variations.

Researchers used biologgers and microphones to track greater noctule bats hunting songbirds in flight, showing they ascend to high altitudes, dive on prey, and eat the birds midair. Most recorded hunts involved insects, but two cases captured a successful attack and a 23-minute in-flight meal.

The passage argues that gold’s recent rally is less important than weak performance by silver and mining stocks, which it says confirms bearish implications. It also says the U.S. Dollar Index is verifying a bullish pattern and that stocks appear to be taking a breather before potentially declining further.

Verizon and AST SpaceMobile announced a commercial agreement for space-based cellular broadband across the continental US, which is intended to boost Verizon’s network coverage. The passage says Verizon’s long-term outlook is strong and rates it a strong buy, while AST SpaceMobile is described as highly speculative and rated a sell.

Former Nepali prime minister K.P. Oli appeared set to return to power after winning his parliamentary seat, with his Communist UML party and Maoist allies on course for a majority. Counting was still under way after Thursday’s election, and Oli said he would seek a full five-year government focused on infrastructure and jobs.

Brock University researchers found that rosemary extract reduced the growth and survival of lung cancer cells in the lab, blocked the Akt signaling pathway, and increased cell death. The study suggests rosemary may have anti-tumour and chemoprevention properties, but more research is needed to identify the active compounds and its effects in people.

Plans for England’s longest smart motorway, a 32-mile stretch of the M4 between London and Theale, will be displayed before work begins in September. The road will be widened to four lanes in both directions, 11 bridges will be demolished and rebuilt, and four others widened, at a cost of up to £862.4m. Completion is expected by March 2022, and Highways England said the route is congested and will have places of relative safety every 1.12 miles on average.
