Gold is expected to rise to $1,400 an ounce by year-end, supported by North Korea-U.S. tensions, global political risks, and stronger demand from China and India. Analysts said it could reach $1,360 within three months, and prices were trading at $1,281.86 after already gaining 12 percent this year.

A Business Insider reporter paid about $860 for one night in the Aurora Suite at Miami’s Villa Casa Casuarina, formerly the Versace Mansion, and described feeling like the only guest amid the hotel’s ornate rooms, gold-tiled pool, rooftop views, and attentive staff.

The passage describes multi-camera imaging systems for detecting faint objects using arrays of lower-performance cameras. By co-registering and combining images from multiple cameras, the systems increase signal-to-noise ratio, can improve effective bit depth, reduce cosmic-ray artifacts, and support common field, hybrid field, and adaptive field array configurations for applications such as astronomy and satellite detection.

Asian shares were mostly lower after U.S. stocks fell at the end of trading, with major indexes in Japan, China, Hong Kong, South Korea and Australia declining. U.S. markets were led lower by technology and banks, while trade tensions between the U.S. and China remained in focus. The yuan stabilized after comments from China’s central bank chief, and oil prices and the euro edged higher while the dollar weakened against the yen.

The Student Finance Board withheld or tabled funding for three events over cost concerns, including the Akwaaba Banquet, A Taste of South America, and Stroll for a Cure, while funding was approved for AirBand, Mystique of the East 2017, Once Upon A Rock Step, and SFB’s Summer Training Retreat.

Researchers tested poplar trees inoculated with a probiotic microbe at a California Superfund site contaminated with TCE and found the treated trees grew better, contained less TCE, and reduced toxin levels in downstream groundwater compared with untreated trees. The study suggests the method could improve and lower the cost of cleaning polluted sites.

Reports citing anonymous U.S. officials say Russian intelligence repeatedly contacted Trump campaign staff, raising concern but with no proof of collusion. The communications were intercepted during routine intelligence collection, prompting ongoing FBI and congressional scrutiny, while Trump and the Kremlin dismissed the reports and some Republican lawmakers opposed an independent investigation.

Moqtada al-Sadr said his followers would hand over weapons used against Islamic State only if fighters are given jobs or integrated into official security forces and if the government supports families of those killed. Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi had declared final victory over Islamic State and said the state should monopolize arms.

The passage describes deploying a sharded Redis cache to Kubernetes using a StatefulSet to create three Redis pods with unique DNS names, then exposing them with a Service. These DNS names are used to configure twemproxy, which is deployed via a ConfigMap and serves Redis on localhost:6379.

A week after Assistant Professor Jharna Dalei’s suicide at Padmanava College of Engineering, security guard Ram Chandra Gouda died on the same campus after collapsing on duty. Police said he had asthma and that his death was unrelated to Jharna’s case. Police also registered a case against a faculty member for abetment in suicide based on her note.

Tesla filed its quarterly Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2020, reporting $8.771 billion in quarterly revenue and $369 million in net income. For the first nine months of 2020, revenue was $20.792 billion, net income was $566 million, and cash and cash equivalents rose to $14.531 billion. The filing also disclosed a five-for-one stock split, a February 2020 common stock offering, a $5.0 billion at-the-market offering in September 2020, and updated debt, lease, and revenue recognition details.

Shock compression of a natural zircon single crystal to 13.6 and 51.3 GPa produced fractured zircon without polymorphic transformation at 13.6 GPa and textured reidite at 51.3 GPa. The reidite sample showed reduced cathodoluminescence and segregation of trace rare-earth elements on planar defects.

The passage describes a ladar transmitter system and related patent applications, focusing on methods to improve scan coverage and dwell time in desired regions. It introduces field splitting/inversion for resonant scans and Lissajous patterns, induced periodic phase drift to reduce gaps and blindspots, and an ellipsoidal reimaging mirror assembly for compact beam scanner designs with improved scan geometry and reduced distortion.

An email circulated a list of articles on California’s energy crisis, covering power price controls, plant shutdowns ending, Chevron’s warning to cut gasoline output, PG&E bonuses and reimbursement disputes, polling support for price limits, subpoenas for energy companies, conservation gains, and new electricity contracts.

The White House blocked congressionally approved funding for the Council of the Inspectors General on Integrity and Efficiency, effectively shuttering the oversight office after midnight Tuesday. The move was condemned by Senate Republicans, who called for the money to be released immediately.

The passage gives trading levels and targets for Nifty, Bank Nifty, Tata Steel, Ambuja Cements, and PowerGrid, including stop-losses, support/resistance zones, and notes that Nifty and Bank Nifty may see big moves, with Bank Nifty’s trend remaining negative but possible short-covering.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 27, 2021, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2021. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

A collection of year-end articles focused on Enron’s collapse, its impact on commodities, bandwidth trading, SEC scrutiny, bankruptcy warning signs, and related effects on companies, investors, utilities, and retirement savings.

Scientists say asteroid Bennu has a small chance of hitting Earth on September 21, 2135, and NASA has studied ways to deflect it, including a “bulk impactor” or nuclear device under the HAMMER plan. The passage says Bennu is not considered big enough to cause dinosaur-level extinction, but it is useful for testing planetary defense methods, and NASA’s OSIRIS-REx mission is mapping it and returning a sample.

The Citi Simplicity® Card offers a 0% intro APR for 21 months on balance transfers and 12 months on purchases, with no annual fee, no late fees, and no penalty rate. It requires good/excellent credit and has intro balance transfer fees of 3% for transfers completed within 4 months, then 5% afterward.

Rep. Lito Atienza filed House Bill 4758 to create a Metropolitan Manila government that would replace the MMDA with an elected governor, vice governor, and Metro Manila Council. He said the current appointed-chairman setup lacks accountability and has failed to address traffic, flooding, peace and order, and garbage problems.

Ten-man Manchester City beat Burnley 2-1 to move up to third, with Gael Clichy and substitute Sergio Aguero scoring after Fernandinho was sent off before halftime. Burnley briefly responded through Ben Mee, but City held on and closed the gap on second-place Liverpool to two points.

Eric Fung left California for Tokyo to start the US-registered AI company Colega AI, with a remote-first team based in Tokyo. He said rising costs and a dimmed Bay Area drew him to Japan, and he is adjusting to Japanese work culture, language barriers, and life in a cheaper apartment near Shibuya with his wife.

An industry group is urging Treasury to let mortgage lenders use the National Directory of New Hires as an alternative to the IRS’s troubled IVES income verification system, saying it could speed mortgage processing and help avoid delays in closings. The group also wants Treasury to seek congressional funding to upgrade IVES.

The passage promotes several credit cards with 0% intro APR offers, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses, and explains that low- or zero-interest cards can help consumers save money. It also notes that the site reviews and rates cards using a data-driven system and that compensation does not affect its ratings.

The passage is a collection of ESPN headlines about a Cubs “Korean corn dog,” a 2026 Savannah Bananas selection show, and Stephen A. Smith reacting to a Yankees comeback win, along with a sportsbook disclaimer and copyright notice.

The passage says Sirius XM has low-cost fixed-rate debt, strong cash flow, and could unlock about 20% more free cash flow by 2026 through satellite spending cuts. It also says share repurchases may boost per-share value, and that SIRI trades below its historical EV/EBITDA multiple with potential 2–3× upside.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPU architecture, highlighting second-generation RT Cores, third-generation Tensor Cores, GDDR6X memory, NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, improved cache and FP32 performance, and features such as RTX IO, AV1 decode, and NVENC. It also details performance gains for ray tracing, AI, motion blur, data center workloads, and professional GPUs including the A40 and RTX A6000.

The automated fare collection system market was valued at $4.81 billion in 2016 and is projected to reach $12.81 billion by 2024, growing at a CAGR of 13.3%. Growth is driven by efficiency, reduced errors, improved security, and new technologies, while lack of awareness and limited smart card use are restraints. The market is segmented by component, application, technology platform, and geography, with major players including Advanced Card Systems Ltd., Atos SE, Cubic Transportation Systems, LG CNS, and Thales Group.

A new analysis of the West African Ebola epidemic found that 3 percent of patients caused more than 60 percent of infections, with an average of 2.39 secondary infections per patient. Superspreading was linked to people staying home and to funeral practices, while transmission was lower after patients reached hospitals.

Bayhorse Silver Inc. increased its non-brokered private placement to 3,000,000 units at $0.10 each for gross proceeds of $300,000, subject to TSX-V approval. Each unit includes one share and one-half warrant, with whole warrants exercisable at $0.15 for 24 months. Proceeds will fund equipment, working capital, and general administrative costs for the Bayhorse Silver Mine.

The passage describes LTE and NR small data transmission techniques using NOMA, including configured-grant PUSCH in idle and inactive states, broadcast configuration of DMRS ports and MA signatures, and methods that reduce signaling, latency, power use, and collision probability by using UE-specific reference bits, interleaving, spreading, and systematic LDPC or Polar encoding.

The writer, who rarely watches TV, passed an online “Jeopardy!” contestant test and reflects on memory as a major unresolved neuroscience problem. He discusses conflicting research on whether memory is stored locally or throughout the brain, mentions RNA-based memory experiments in snails and flatworms, and jokes that he might suspect an RNA drug if he lost on the show.

The Massachusetts House and Senate passed a supplemental budget bill allocating $15 million to school districts educating students who arrived from Puerto Rico after Hurricane Maria, with funding distributed through the existing local aid formula. More than 2,300 students have come to Massachusetts since September, and the bill still needs differences negotiated before reaching Governor Baker.

The Tax Court sustained the IRS determination allowing levy to collect petitioner’s unpaid 1994 and 1996 income taxes. The court held that petitioner failed to allege specific facts showing error in the assessments or any other error in the determination.

CDC acting director Jim O’Neill approved updated Covid-19 vaccine recommendations for anyone over 6 months old and separately approved giving young children the MMR and chickenpox vaccines as separate shots. The decision allows states to order updated Covid vaccines for low-income children through the Vaccines for Children program.

Agents Mutual, owner of OnTheMarket.com, plans to float on London’s AIM and raise £50 million to fund marketing, sales, customer relations and technology, including a national advertising campaign. OnTheMarket is Britain’s third biggest property site behind Rightmove and Zoopla, has ended its mutual status, signed long-term listing agreements with several estate agencies, and says it is well placed to challenge the two leading portals, though an analyst said the task remains significant.

Police are seeking witnesses after a father was allegedly spat at, punched and kicked by two men during an unprovoked attack at Coed Bach Park in Pontarddulais, Swansea, on 29 June, while he was walking with his children. The attack followed his complaint about a man riding a moped erratically near children.

The court held that the insured failed to substantially comply with the burglary policies’ record-keeping clause because his scratch-pad totals did not provide enough information about the stolen payroll checks to accurately determine the loss. The judgment for the plaintiff was reversed and the case remanded with directions to dismiss the complaint.

The Ninth Circuit affirmed Tax Court judgments holding the taxpayer liable for income tax deficiencies for 1975 and 1976. The court ruled that payments deposited in the taxpayer’s Honolulu bank account were “received” in the United States under section 931(b), making the income taxable despite the taxpayer’s possession-based operations in American Samoa.

The passage argues that language education should center on connection, using imagined communities to help students see languages as links to cultures and people. It describes task-based, authentic classroom scenarios, notes positive outcomes such as deeper cultural understanding and greater connection, and says the approach can support language program retention at all levels.

The passage discusses time-dependent Monte Carlo neutron transport, focusing on how global variance reduction techniques and population control methods interact. It finds that Cooper-Larsen weight windows combined with uniform combing generally perform best, while weight windows with weight-based combing and implicit capture with uniform combing can harm efficiency.

A federal humanities agency and First Nations Development Institute are each contributing about $2 million to fund Native language education programs in tribal communities. The effort aims to revitalize endangered Native languages, with about 15 programs expected to be funded each year through a competitive process.

The passage is a May 3, 2001 Enron mentions digest with news items on Enron-related plant hearings, California electricity prices, the Dabhol dispute in India, Enron’s role in energy markets and derivatives, and several corporate transactions involving Enron units.

The disclosure describes methods, polypeptides, nucleic acids, vectors, and genetically modified host cells for producing cannabinoids, cannabinoid precursors, and derivatives, including by expressing a new geranyl pyrophosphate:olivetolic acid geranyltransferase (GOT) polypeptide, CsPT4, or truncated forms that produce cannabigerolic acid at least ten times higher than SEQ ID NO:82. It also describes related pathway enzymes, host cell embodiments, and production methods using suitable media and feedstocks.

Rep. Garret Graves said the shooting of Rep. Steve Scalise and others reflects a divisive political climate fueled by verbal attacks, polarization, and misinformation. Scalise was critically injured after being shot by James T. Hodgkinson, whose anti-Republican views raised questions of political motive, while Bernie Sanders and Donald Trump both condemned the violence and called for unity.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed its quarterly Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2019, reporting net sales of $69.981 billion and net income of $2.134 billion for Q3 2019. Total assets were $199.099 billion, stockholders’ equity was $56.508 billion, and cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $43.4 billion.

An Ilorin Magistrates’ Court remanded two herdsmen, Shehu Abubakar and Abdulkareem Maikudi, over the alleged killing of their colleague, Musa Kareem, during a dispute over a cell phone. They face charges of criminal conspiracy and culpable homicide, and the court adjourned the case to July 12.

The speaker said they felt energized throughout the game despite many power plays and penalty kills, and praised the team’s four scoring lines and composure. They noted both teams defended well, blocked shots, and that patience eventually led to an opening and a successful shot.

A New York Times survey found that most responding federal judges were dissatisfied with the Supreme Court’s emergency docket decisions in Trump-related cases: only 12 of 65 said the Court used it appropriately, only 12 said lower courts got enough guidance, and only two of 54 said it improved public perception of the judiciary. Judges described the orders as demoralizing and opaque, while the paper noted the findings may not represent the entire judiciary.

Energy Central Direct’s January 14, 2002 daily edition listed electric power, gas, legal, financial, and international industry news, with top stories focused on Enron, utility mergers, deregulation, and power market developments.

Nigeria launched its National Cancer Control Plan 2018-2022, and BVGH presented AAI’s partnership with the Nigerian government to improve access to cancer medicines, technologies, infrastructure, and training. The plan aims to expand quality, equitable diagnosis and treatment, while AAI is conducting hospital needs assessments and guiding future efforts based on the NCCP.

The Unemployment Insurance Appeal Board’s denial of benefits was affirmed because substantial evidence supported its finding that the claimant was disqualified for misconduct after allegedly pulling a box cutter on his supervisor. Violent or threatening behavior was held to be disqualifying misconduct, and the claimant’s denial raised only a credibility issue for the Board.

The passage examines President Trump’s use of pardons amid the Mueller investigation, including the pardon of Scooter Libby and the possibility of pardoning Michael Cohen. It outlines legal debate over the scope of presidential pardon power, including self-pardons, and notes congressional and state-level efforts to limit pardons used to obstruct investigations.

The study uses a Schelling-variant urban migration model with over 200 LLM-driven agents to examine egoism and altruism in social simulation. Results show two model types: “Adaptive Egoists,” whose behavior becomes more altruistic with a message board, and “Altruistic Optimizers,” which consistently prioritize collective welfare regardless of communication.

This retrospective MIMIC-IV study of 1,918 ICU patients with intracerebral hemorrhage found that resting heart rate was associated with all-cause mortality, with risk increasing above 78.5 bpm and a nonlinear threshold at 90.3 bpm. RHR below 90.3 bpm was described as protective, while RHR above 90.3 bpm was independently linked to higher mortality.

The passage provides mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for TLV3211, TLV3212, TLV3214, TLV3221, and TLV3222, along with drawing notes, tape orientation labels, and TI warranty and legal disclaimers.

The lecture explains hedonic pricing as a way to estimate willingness to pay for nonmarket attributes using housing transaction data, focusing on green building premiums. It describes regression-based decomposition of housing prices, discusses dummy variables and log interpretations, and highlights causal inference challenges such as omitted variables, reverse causality, and selection bias. It also covers matching as an apple-to-apple comparison method and gives examples involving green buildings, parks, subways, school districts, and urban development.

Purdue University ended its GEAR UP program after the Trump administration canceled a $34.9 million federal grant, citing concerns over merit, fairness, excellence in education, and civil rights law. The program served more than 13,000 low-income Indiana students, and Purdue did not appeal the termination.

Edinburgh has seen significant haar this spring. The Met Office said weaker Atlantic temperature contrasts have weakened the jet stream, leading to more persistent easterlies and increased haar in the east of Scotland.

The Microbus-inspired ID Buzz is not yet approved for production, though it may be more likely than the original Microbus concept because it shares underpinnings with other ID models. Its release could be delayed until around 2025. The regular ID is aimed at Golf buyers, while the Crozz could suit a large American launch due to its all-wheel drive, 302HP output, and practical design.

DWH Deutsche Werte Holding AG moved to the Vienna Stock Exchange’s mid market segment on 23 April 2018 after trading on the exchange-regulated Third Market since 7 December 2017. The upgrade requires higher transparency, quality, and publicity criteria, with Capital Lounge GmbH as coach and ICF BANK AG providing liquidity. The passage says the Third Market is an important entry point for companies and that Austrian companies may again gain easier access to trading if planned legal changes are implemented.

The Supreme Court declined to hear several cases, including challenges involving gun laws, a police dog search, Laura Loomer’s lawsuit against social media platforms, Ghislaine Maxwell’s appeal, and a petition for rehearing in an American Indian sacred site case. It also asked the solicitor general for the government’s views in three other cases.

The Turtle Trading Strategy is a trend-following system developed by Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt after a 1983 experiment to test whether trading skill could be taught. Its original rules used volatility-based position sizing, pyramiding into winning trades, and preset exits and stop-losses, with breakouts used to identify trends. The passage says the strategy still works, especially in clear trends, though it may be less effective than in the 1980s.

The device includes a second-order antialiasing LPF, an integrated ADC driver, and selectable internal or external 4.096V reference modes. It supports straight-binary ADC output, input and AVDD alarms with flags, multiple SPI and source-synchronous data transfer protocols, daisy-chain operation, reset and low-power modes, and nine configuration registers for controlling range, reference, alarms, and data output.

BC reported 1,422 suspected illicit drug overdose deaths in 2017, up 43% from 2016, though monthly deaths fell in the last four months of the year. About 81% involved fentanyl, most deaths occurred indoors or in private residences, and Vancouver Coastal Health had the highest rate.

JPMorgan downgraded Valero Energy from Overweight to Neutral, raising its price target from $75 to $78. It said Valero’s improved cash flow and capital discipline have already supported some multiple upside, but further gains may take time, and estimated total return potential of 6%, below the group’s 7%.
A Harvard Business School study says some AI companions use tricks to keep conversations from ending.

This study combined mangosteen peel and grass jelly leaf dyes in DSSCs and found that the 1:3 MP:GJL ratio gave the highest power conversion efficiency of 3.50%, higher than single-dye samples. The improved performance was linked to complementary absorption across UV-blue and red regions, better dye morphology, and enhanced light harvesting.
18-year-old Islander Luca Speight received the Outstanding Achievement Award and Isle of Wight College Student of the Year 2018 for his determination and hard work after a life-threatening illness.

Depoe Bay, Oregon, is preparing for the first total solar eclipse to cross the continental U.S. in 99 years, expecting large crowds and possible traffic, harbor, and emergency access problems. The town has sold out hotels and campgrounds, added supplies and emergency measures, and is coordinating with state authorities and the Coast Guard.

Figma shares rose 7% on Monday, briefly jumping as much as 16%, after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman showcased Figma integration in ChatGPT at DevDay. Altman said users will be able to ask ChatGPT to use Figma to complete tasks, and that OpenAI plans more third-party integrations and future monetization options.

The passage describes NVIDIA RTX IO, which uses GPU-based lossless decompression with DirectStorage to reduce CPU load and speed game and asset loading, and NVIDIA A40/Ampere GPUs, which improve data center, graphics, AI, rendering, video decode/encode, and display performance. It also highlights features of GA10x GPUs, including AV1 decode, NVENC encoding, ray tracing, Tensor Cores, GDDR6X, and Error Detection and Replay.

Benjamin David Sherwood was sentenced to 11 years in prison in Houston after pleading guilty to traveling across state lines for illicit contact with a child and enticing a minor into sexual contact. He will be supervised for life, register as a sex offender, and face limits on access to children and the Internet. The case began when he responded to an undercover ad and was arrested in a Houston hotel in 2017 with items for a sexual encounter.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2018 reported $26.8 billion in quarterly revenue and $7.4 billion in net income. Total assets were $245.5 billion, cash and short-term investments were $132.3 billion, and stockholders’ equity was $79.2 billion. The filing also described accounting changes for revenue recognition and leases, recent tax legislation effects, debt, investments, derivatives, leases, contingencies, and share repurchases.

Portland Thorns captain Christine Sinclair said anything less than a championship would be a disappointment after last season’s home semifinal loss. Portland finished second and will host Orlando in one semifinal, while North Carolina hosts Chicago in the other. North Carolina won the Supporters’ Shield, and Sam Kerr set an NWSL record with 17 goals.

BMW and Brilliance Automotive launched the 1 Series sedan in China in July 2016, and BMW was considering a possible India launch. The car was designed for the Chinese market, based on the BMW Concept Compact Sedan, measures 4,456mm long with a 2,670mm wheelbase, and is smaller than the Mercedes-Benz CLA but longer than the Audi A3. It uses the UKL1 platform, is front-wheel driven, and the India version may get petrol and diesel engine options.

Forecasts suggest the next 10 days will bring about 7.5 inches of colder, more spread-out rain to the Feather River basin, likely producing less runoff and less stress on Oroville Dam than the February storms. Officials are continuing to drain the reservoir, which had dropped to 885.57 feet, leaving time before Friday’s expected rain and a potential buffer of nearly 40 feet.

The lecture reviewed the LSZ theorem, explaining that scattering amplitudes are obtained from momentum-space correlation functions by taking the on-shell limit, stripping external propagators, and keeping only connected diagrams. It then introduced the Dirac equation, deriving it from the requirement of a first-order Lorentz-covariant equation whose square gives the Klein-Gordon equation, leading to gamma matrices, the Clifford algebra, and spinors.

Amazon reported first-quarter 2017 net sales of $35.714 billion, net income of $724 million, and operating income of $1.005 billion, compared with $29.128 billion, $513 million, and $1.071 billion a year earlier. Cash and cash equivalents fell to $15.440 billion, and total assets were $80.969 billion. The company adopted new accounting guidance in Q1 2017, signed an agreement to acquire Souq Group Ltd. for $580 million, and said it expected Q2 2017 net sales of $35.25 billion to $37.75 billion and operating income of $425 million to $1.075 billion.

Phuket Governor Norraphat Plodthong ordered lifeguards back on patrol at Phuket beaches by April 1 after a meeting on March 21 to address the lifeguard situation. The report said local offices must ensure lifeguards for specified beaches, while the PPAO may provide budget support, despite earlier orders saying it would no longer be involved.

Eric Schmidt, former CEO of Google, will fund a five-year Schmidt Sciences project using four remotely piloted uncrewed surface vessels to collect data in the Southern Ocean around Antarctica. The $45 million effort aims to improve understanding of the ocean carbon sink, with data made public and collected through a public-private partnership involving NOAA.

The passage describes several AGESA procedures for stack setup/removal, structure creation, and hardware queries. It explains required stack and processor dependencies, register effects, returned status codes, and parameter fields for functions including AmdCreateStruct, data eye results, APIC and PCI address lookup, execution cache size, current core identification, and FRU memory address mapping.

Chemists found that tiny bubbles of air and methane in water can produce electrical micro-sparks, which may help explain what ignites methane gas in will-o’-the-wisps. The experiments suggest microbubbles can discharge visible zaps of light, though the mystery is not fully solved.

In a daisy-chain topology, all devices share CONVST/CS and SCLK, with each device’s SDO-0 connected to the next device’s SDI, and the last device connected to the host SDI. The host programs identical configuration values in all devices, uses SDO_CTL_REG bits 7-0 = 00h, and transfers data MSB-first so device N’s data is received first. An optimal frame uses 32 × N SCLK capture edges; shorter frames can cause erroneous configuration.

Solawave’s 4-in-1 Renewal Wand is highlighted as a budget-friendly red light therapy device that targets specific areas, vibrates, and warms during use. It is on sale for a little over $100 during Prime Day, and WIRED staff reported positive skin-tightening results, especially around the eyes.

Amazon.com’s board elected Wendell P. Weeks as a director and Audit Committee member, approved Diego Piacentini’s two-year leave of absence beginning in August 2016, and authorized up to $5 billion in common stock repurchases, replacing the prior $2 billion authorization.

EUR/USD is in a bearish trend channel with slowing bearish momentum, while the 1-hour chart suggests a possible retracement or larger bullish correction if resistance breaks. GBP/USD is attempting a bullish breakout from a contracting triangle, with downside risk toward 1.05 if it fails. USD/JPY is forming a bull flag on the 4-hour chart, but the 1-hour chart shows a break below support that could indicate a larger retracement.

The message urges Congress to strengthen conservation of national resources through laws on public land classification, anti-fraud enforcement, mineral and water-power leasing, forest preservation and reforestation, reclamation of arid lands, and inland waterway improvement. It also recommends validating land withdrawals, authorizing reclamation bonds, and funding major river projects such as the Ohio, upper Mississippi, and Missouri.

The passage describes NVIDIA RTX IO, which improves loading and streaming of large datasets by using DirectStorage and GPU-based lossless decompression to reduce CPU load and I/O bottlenecks. It also outlines NVIDIA A40 and other GA10x Ampere GPU features, including higher performance for data center, rendering, AI, ray tracing, video decoding/encoding, display support, and large-memory workloads.

The passage describes the SEV-ES and SEV-SNP Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB), which standardizes guest-hypervisor communication for encrypted guest state, Non-Automatic Exits, feature advertisement, GHCB negotiation, and several NAE events such as CPUID, page state changes, SNP guest requests, AP creation, doorbell page use, timer and IPI support, APIC ID lists, Secure AVIC, and termination requests.

The passage says consumer confidence measures optimism about the economy and is used to understand spending, saving, and market conditions. Backtests using U.S. consumer confidence data found that the S&P 500 performed better when consumer confidence was above its 12-month moving average and poorly when it was below it. A bullish consumer confidence strategy had lower drawdown than buy and hold, while the opposite signal produced weak returns.

Natalie Grabow, 80, became the oldest woman to finish the Kona Ironman World Championship in 16 hours, 45 minutes, and 26 seconds. She began triathlons at 60 after learning to swim at 59, trains for months, and says she plans to keep competing as long as she can.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs, especially the A40 and RTX A6000, for data center and professional workloads. It highlights improved performance for ray tracing, AI, simulation, virtualization, display output, NVDEC video decoding, NVENC encoding, AV1 hardware decode, and larger memory support, along with brief notes on GeForce RTX 3090, RTX 3070, and EDR technology.

Lenovo officially unveiled the limited-edition ThinkPad 25, a retro-inspired version of the T470 based on the ThinkPad 700C’s design. It includes modern hardware such as a 14-inch Full HD touchscreen, Intel Core i7-7500U, GeForce 940MX, 16GB RAM, and a 512GB NVMe SSD, along with classic ThinkPad elements like a red TrackPoint and seven-row keyboard. It will be sold in limited quantities in select countries starting at $1,899.

The passage introduces molecular dynamics methods for calculating thermal conductivity, focusing on Green-Kubo and NEMD, and explains that heat flux is central to both as well as to interfacial thermal conductance and spectral decomposition. It notes that existing LAMMPS formulas were limited for many-body potentials, and describes this work’s extension and implementation of exact Torii et al. formulas for heat flux in control volumes and across control surfaces, including spectral decomposition, for arbitrary many-body potentials.

COPD is a leading cause of death in the United States and is caused almost exclusively by smoking. It can cause chronic coughing and shortness of breath, and patients may be tested with breathing exercises after doctors assess their smoking history. Treatments include inhalers, oxygen, and pulmonary rehabilitation, but the main way to reduce risk and prevent worsening is to stop smoking.

The study evaluated distance education in Turkish sports higher education during COVID-19 using interviews with 14 lecturers. Lecturers reported positives such as flexibility, access to resources, and reduced pandemic spread, and negatives such as communication problems, low motivation, access and infrastructure issues, and difficulties with applied courses. They also said the process and education platforms were not managed effectively enough and recommended improvements to distance education design, infrastructure, and data security.

The passage is a collection of repeated financial and business headlines, with one detailed item noting that Jeff Bezos has suggested building data centres in space to address land, energy, cooling, and resilience constraints, while acknowledging major engineering and cost challenges.

The paper studies tunnel magnetoresistance in Mn3Sn(01̄10)/MgO(110)/Mn3Sn magnetic tunnel junctions using first-principles calculations. It finds that Mn3Sn’s momentum-dependent spin splitting, together with MgO’s tunneling-electron filtering, produces a finite TMR ratio exceeding 1000% for a suitably thick barrier.

A study found that barn owls can identify a moving target among shifting backgrounds by grouping elements moving in the same direction, a visual processing ability previously tested only in primates. Researchers showed that the owls performed better when background motion was uniform and that the ocular tectum responded differently depending on dot movement, suggesting it helps with this task.

Strong US job growth and wage gains boosted expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes, pushing the dollar and US bond yields higher while stocks fell. The report said 200,000 jobs were added and wages rose 2.9 percent, with the 10-year US Treasury yield reaching 2.84 percent.

Gold edged lower as the dollar rose ahead of U.S. non-farm payrolls data, with stronger jobs numbers seen as potentially negative for bullion by supporting further Fed rate hikes. Gold was set for a little-changed week, while palladium was on track for its biggest weekly drop since early September.

Clark County Schools Superintendent Pat Skorkowsky retired after five years as superintendent and 30 years in the district. He said he was proud of rising graduation rates and expanded magnet schools, but noted a $60 million budget shortfall, funding and teacher pay issues, and school safety concerns. He urged the new superintendent, Dr. Jesus Jara, to work with lawmakers, parents, and teachers, and said he had not decided his next step.

Caterpillar kept its quarterly dividend flat at $0.77 per share for the seventh straight quarter, despite a 23-year record of dividend increases. Goldman Sachs remains bullish on the stock, citing improving mining spending and a $120 price target, but the passage says Caterpillar’s shares already reflect optimism and argues investors should remain cautious because revenues, earnings, and cash flows have fallen and further dividend growth looks difficult.

Stimson argued that territorial adjustments and trusteeships in the Pacific should not be raised in discussion until later in the war, to avoid distrust and suspicion, and that the subject should be avoided if possible. Chris King, 57, attended his first match at Headingley Carnegie Stadium to watch Leeds Rhinos beat Widnes Vikings 42-22. He had previously lost both hands in a work accident and later became the first UK patient to receive two hand transplants. At half-time, he was applauded after pulling out the winning ticket for the golden gamble draw, and he said the visit was “absolutely fantastic.”

Crocs plans to appeal, but the ruling was a major blow as the company is already closing 160 stores and reported declining revenue.

The study used bibliometric analysis of publications on digital accessibility and digital accessibility in education from 2013 to 2024 across WoS, Scopus, and ERIC. The study evaluated a VIA-based workflow for optical genome mapping in 10 myeloid malignancy cases. OGM detected all standard-of-care findings, identified additional reportable variants in five of six positive cases, and enabled relatively fast technologist review, with the authors concluding it is a streamlined and efficient approach for cytogenomic variant interpretation and reporting.

A community backed Mark Ryan, headteacher of St. Patrick’s Catholic Primary School, after a Gazette report incorrectly claimed he took a two-week term-time holiday and had told a parent she would be fined for taking her child out of school. Ryan said he had been granted three days’ leave by governors to attend a close family friend’s wedding abroad, and governors, staff, parents, and the local community supported him and called for the story to be corrected.

The Shippers Group celebrated a ribbon cutting for its new 540,000-square-foot Austell distribution facility, which offers warehousing, transportation, packaging, and e-commerce fulfillment services. The company, established in 1901 and now operating 11 locations nationwide, said the new site brings its Georgia warehouse total to 1.5 million square feet.

Pitching coach Jeremy Hefner, hitting coaches Jeremy Barnes and Eric Chavez, and third base coach Mike Sarbaugh will not return, while bench coach John Gibbons resigned and catching coach Glenn Sherlock is retiring.

World stocks fell as U.S. bond yields rose above 3 percent for the first time in four years, while Brent crude climbed above $75 a barrel. U.S. and European equities weakened, with the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower, amid rising yields and a drop in Alphabet shares.

Articles also discussed OPEC’s output cut, debates over energy policy, and how various groups used the crisis to challenge other government rules.

More than 300 Islamic banks operate globally, demand for Sharia-compliant services is rising, and many banks are investing in digital initiatives.

Sickle cell disease is a genetic disorder that causes abnormal sickle-shaped hemoglobin cells, reducing oxygen delivery and blocking blood flow. It can cause pain crises, acute chest syndrome, anemia, infections, and other complications. Diagnosis is by blood test, often at birth, and management includes screening, vaccines, symptom treatment, lifestyle changes, and in severe cases stem cell transplantation.

He argues that Pakistan’s nuclearization emboldened militant attacks and has contributed to repeated crises, including Kargil, the 2001–2002 crisis, and the 2008 Bombay attacks.

The dispute centers on whether federal procedural rules or state requirements control, with arguments over the Erie doctrine, Rule 11, and whether applying the statutes in federal court would be chaotic or would help limit malpractice litigation.

The study reviewed over 18,000 plasma mcfDNA sequencing reports from a large hospital-based cohort and found a median turnaround time of 26 hours with 96% valid results. Of valid tests, 58% detected at least one microbe, spanning 701 taxa, including bacteria, fungi, viruses, and parasites. The authors conclude that plasma mcfDNA sequencing can detect a broad range of pathogens, including uncommon organisms, but emphasize the need for diagnostic stewardship and further clinical studies.

Coach Julien said the team was average and not sharp in decision making, puck movement, and defensive commitment, but battled back to tie the game and create a chance to win. India’s Congress party elected Rahul Gandhi unopposed as its president, replacing his mother Sonia Gandhi and positioning him to lead the party against Prime Minister Narendra Modi ahead of the 2019 national elections.

A Hiscox report found U.S. entrepreneurs are motivated mainly by flexibility, control, and remote work, with many taking little or no vacation. Most surveyed U.S. businesses reported revenue, profit, and customer growth, and U.S. owners were optimistic about hiring despite funding difficulties, limited succession planning, and concerns about government policy and political instability.

A backtest on the S&P 500 found that a strategy of buying when rates are rising performed poorly, while buying when rates are falling was much more profitable, with strong CAGR improvement and similar drawdown.

President Barack Obama said he will give a farewell address on Jan. 10 in Chicago to thank supporters and reflect on his presidency. He said the speech will celebrate changes made over the past eight years and offer thoughts on the future, as Donald Trump prepares to take office on Jan. 20.

The Apple Watch Series 3 with LTE has slowly expanded to more markets since its 2017 launch, despite limited carrier support and a ban in China after initial approval. Pre-orders will open on May 4 in Denmark, Sweden, and India, with deliveries a week later, and confirmed operators include Three in Denmark and Sweden, plus Reliance Jio and Airtel in India.

IFC Films promoted Mark Boxer to executive vice president of sales and distribution and Lauren Schwartz to senior vice president of publicity and promotions. Boxer oversees distribution for IFC Films, Sundance Selects, and IFC Midnight titles, while Schwartz has led promotional campaigns for several notable films.

The school’s enrollment has dropped from about 310 to 130, and the temporary campus includes 19 classrooms, a kitchen, library and play areas.

Robert Whittaker rose to seventh, Anderson Silva dropped to eighth, Vitor Belfort remained ninth, and Kelvin Gastelum entered at tenth. The OHL trading strategy is an intraday stock strategy that uses the open, high, and low prices in the first few minutes of the session to determine entries: buy when the open equals the low and sell when the open equals the high. It is best used on lower timeframes and can be combined with CPR levels. Backtests on S&P 500, ES futures, SPY, and WTI crude oil showed small average gains and indicated that the first minutes of trading may set the day’s direction.

The passage presents a multi-patch isogeometric neural solver that combines PINNs with IGA to address CAD geometries, focusing on enforcing continuity across patch interfaces, strongly imposing Dirichlet boundary conditions, and handling varying geometry scales through reference-domain normalization. It uses NN-based ansatz functions in the reference domain, mapped to the physical domain via NURBS, and is trained with a variational PINN framework on energy functionals.

Owen Sound Foodland is one of 87 new Ontario stores authorized to sell beer and cider starting in April, bringing the provincial total to 370. It will be the first grocery store in the immediate Owen Sound area to do so. Common criticisms were inadequacy, difficulty, short lesson times, lack of similarity to face-to-face education, and technical problems. The Executive Yuan plans no budget for it next year, will transfer six staff to the Mainland Affairs Council, and continue its remaining functions under the Ministry of Culture.

Jose Mourinho urged him to sign the contract soon, while Fellaini is definitely out against Huddersfield and may miss the Champions League matches against Sevilla.

Prof. Mahesh Bandi showed that wind power fluctuations follow wind-speed fluctuation patterns for a different reason than previously assumed, and that geographic smoothing has a natural limit: power from dispersed wind plants can still remain correlated at low frequencies. This finding, based on Texas and Ireland wind data, has implications for reserve estimates and energy policy.

Merger arbitrage seeks to profit from the spread between a target company’s stock price and the acquisition offer price, but it requires careful assessment of deal completion risk, regulation, financing, and liquidity. Backtests cited in the passage show low volatility but weaker returns than the S&P 500, with mixed results across funds and studies.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 26, 2022, reporting that it released its fourth quarter and full year 2021 financial results on its website and attached the update as Exhibit 99.1.

Congress failed to avert a government shutdown, and the federal shutdown has increased uncertainty for education programs. Most schools should see little short-term disruption, but some districts and programs could face funding problems if it lasts, including Head Start, school nutrition, and civil rights and other Department of Education work. Trump has also sought more mass layoffs during the shutdown.

Chicago wheat rose 0.9% after rains eased drought concerns in the U.S. southern Plains, while corn and soybeans also edged higher. Wheat had suffered its biggest three-day decline since 2013, and U.S. winter wheat ratings in Kansas and Texas fell slightly.

Police arrested Arkansas Gov. Asa Hutchinson’s son, William Asa Hutchinson III, on DWI, speeding and implied consent violation charges. He was released on bond and is due in court Wednesday and again on July 19. The arrest follows a prior DWI case that was dismissed due to citation errors, and a separate 2016 Alabama drug arrest.

Paul Kazarian said Portugal’s corporate sector is attractive for investment and opened his first European office in Lisbon. He praised the economic recovery policies of Socialist governments in Portugal and Greece, noted Portugal’s stronger growth and Greece’s ongoing bailout, and said Japonica Partners is looking at opportunities in real estate and technology, as well as broader European investments.

XRD, SEM, EDS, and Li-NRA showed cathode c-axis contraction, surface decomposition, and lithium loss, while the graphite anode showed cracking, SEI growth, and lithium accumulation consistent with lithium plating and trapping.

The Education Department said it will revise two Obama-era student loan forgiveness rules, Borrower Defense to Repayment and Gainful Employment, and hold hearings in July. DeVos said the current regulations are overly burdensome, while critics warned the changes would weaken protections for students harmed by for-profit colleges.

The T-bills market was slightly bullish, with strong liquidity from bond maturities, while the CBN’s auction was moderately oversubscribed. Money market rates fell, but yields are expected to rise slightly as another OMO auction is anticipated. The interbank rate stayed at N305.95/$, external reserves declined to $47.65bn, and FX rates weakened in the I&E, cash, and transfer markets. Sovereign bonds softened, led by the 2047s, which fell to 99.70.

Kawann Short, nicknamed “KK,” signed a five-year, $80 million extension with the Panthers, ending a long negotiation and avoiding the franchise tag. The deal supports Carolina’s win-now approach, alongside other veteran additions, while questions remain about Cam Newton’s health and the offense.

Dozens of chess players from across Alberta will compete at the University of Calgary in the annual Battle of Alberta chess tournament on Feb. 18–19, hosted by the U of C Chess Club. About 30 to 40 players are expected, including six to eight from U of C, and the event will follow World Chess Federation rules. The club, founded in 2015, also holds weekly meet-ups and the tournament is open to students and non-students, with registration fees of $10 and $15.

Sugar futures trade on ICE Futures US and CME Globex, with contract size of 112,000 pounds and tick size of $11.20 per contract. ICE settles by physical delivery and CME by cash. Sugar prices are affected mainly by supply, inventories, crops, government subsidies, tariffs, ethanol demand, oil prices, Brazil’s currency, and weather. The all-time high was 66.00 US cents in November 1974, and the all-time low was 2.63 US cents in June 1985.

Prime Day discounts make the M4 MacBook Air a strong buy, with the 13-inch M4 Air at $800 and the older M1 Air at $600, while the MacBook Pro models are only about 10 percent off and face more uncertainty from upcoming M5 rumors.

The Supreme Court appeared likely to give police more leeway to enter a home without a warrant in an emergency, in a case involving William Case, who was shot after police entered his Montana home. The justices questioned a probable cause standard and seemed inclined toward an “objectively reasonable” emergency-help standard.

Thomas Jefferson issued a proclamation on November 27, 1806, warning that citizens and residents were preparing an unlawful military expedition against Spain. He ordered those involved to stop, urged officials to seize vessels and supplies, and called on citizens to help expose and prevent the enterprise.

Microsoft filed a Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2019, reporting revenue of $33.055 billion, net income of $10.678 billion, and diluted EPS of $1.38, with revenue, operating income, and net income all increasing from the prior year. Revenue grew across all three segments, led by Intelligent Cloud and Productivity and Business Processes, while cash and short-term investments totaled $136.6 billion and total liabilities were $172.9 billion.

Kano Pillars drew 1-1 with Niger Tornadoes in a rescheduled NPFL Week 12 match at Sani Abacha Stadium. Niger Tornadoes led through Andrew Ikefe’s 19th-minute goal, but Junior Lokosa equalized for Pillars from a penalty in the 81st minute, taking his season tally to 11. Pillars coach Ibrahim Musa praised his players and fans and said the team would prepare for their next match against Kwara United.

It also discusses candlestick and volume confirmation, Fibonacci retracements, breakout and pullback trading, risk management, multiple time frame analysis, and harmonic patterns.

The passage reports dispatches from Mr. Wise on slave-trade evasion, describing a system in which American vessels are nominally chartered, sent through Britain and Brazil, and used to transport slaves from Africa. It says some U.S. citizens and British subjects are implicated, while guilty owners, brokers, and charterers often escape punishment. It urges stronger measures by the United States and Britain to suppress the trade and restore captured Africans to their homes.

DS is expanding its UK range with the DS7 Crossback’s new PureTech 225 gasoline engine, a 225hp petrol unit with reduced fuel consumption, paired with an EAT8 8-speed gearbox. The DS7 Crossback’s launch-year range includes four Euro 6.2 engines, with additional diesel options already available and a future hybrid powertrain planned. The PureTech 225 is offered on several UK models starting at £34,990.

The passage is a presidential message to Congress describing widespread domestic prosperity, reduced debt and taxes, and satisfactory government finances, while urging continued economy and caution against new appropriations. It also reports progress in foreign relations, defense, veterans’ relief, agriculture, commerce, aviation, public works, conservation, immigration, and social policy, and concludes that prosperity and peace must be preserved through continued effort and sound government.

It presents Hawaii’s strategic, commercial, and military value to the United States, notes strong American influence and foreign control of government and capital, and suggests annexation could come with little cost.

A mother warned parents to keep sick children home after her toddler Chloe was hospitalized with RSV following contact with a sick cousin at a family dinner. She said the 3-year-old, who has asthma, is now on antibiotics and a breathing machine, and shared the story to caution others about the risks for children with preexisting lung conditions.

Developer Ed Russo marked the start of construction on the Annin Lofts apartment project in Verona on Flag Day, aiming to preserve the historic Annin Flag building’s integrity. The former flag manufacturing plant, which operated from 1919 to 2013, will be converted into 112 rental units in two buildings, including loft-style apartments and a penthouse addition.

The team said a comeback and two quick goals helped take over the game, with everyone contributing offensively. They praised Kenny’s emotional big goal in the Stanley Cup Final and described a save made after Modano’s shot and a rebound to Brett Hull. They also said they respected the opponent, had some lucky bounces, and noted the next game would start at zero again.

Apple reported net sales of $50.6 billion and net income of $10.5 billion for the quarter ended March 26, 2016, both down from a year earlier, with lower iPhone, iPad, Mac, and regional sales partially offset by higher Services and Other Products revenue. The company ended the period with $305.3 billion in assets, $174.8 billion in liabilities, and $232.9 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities, while continuing share repurchases, dividends, debt issuance, and other disclosed financial and legal matters.

The Foreign Office reported only occasional discussions with Belgian officials, not formal negotiations. A memorandum said British and Belgian talks on renewing the Anglo-Belgian Congo purchase agreement were complicated by increased wartime demand for raw materials, conflicting Allied offers, lack of coordinated Belgian orders, and Belgian preference for dollars. The Secretary of State said the UK and US had agreed to pursue a broader, coordinated arrangement with the Belgian Congo covering Congo needs and UK/US purchases.

Sienna Senior Living announced a February 2017 dividend of $0.075 per common share, payable March 15, 2017 to shareholders of record on February 28, 2017, and noted its optional DRIP offers shares at a 3% discount from market price.

Nigeria and some foreign countries, including the United Kingdom, have begun Automatic Exchange of Tax Information on overseas assets held by Nigerians. The Finance Minister said the data is being used to support VAIDS, verify declarations, and identify potential tax defaulters, while urging users of offshore structures to regularize their taxes. The tax reform committee said its work is aligned with key government plans and has led to two executive orders and five amendment bills covering major tax areas.

Google said it will develop an ethics policy for military projects, with rules expected to ban artificial intelligence in weaponry. The policy will be shaped by employee feedback after protests over Project Maven, which sparked internal debate and concerns about Google being linked to AI weapons.

Eleven Ursuline High students and six adults plan to travel to Nicaragua April 2-8 during spring break to help residents with basic needs such as food, housing, home visits, cooking, playing with children, and building houses. School officials said the trip teaches empathy, compassion, and awareness of other cultures.

Dr Chukwuma Agubata said Ogbono soup, made from Irvingia fat, may improve the efficacy of Artemether anti-malaria drugs by helping the drug pass through body barriers and reach the bloodstream more effectively. He said the finding came from research on lipid microparticles and called for government and private support to develop and mass-produce the locally sourced material.

A survey by Nationwide Home Insurance found pet owners spend almost £3,500 in the first year. Average annual costs are £2,455 for cats, £4,791 for dogs, £12,654 for horses, £769 for fish, and £1,802 for rabbits. The ABI reported a record £706 million in pet insurance claims in 2016, and Nationwide warned that pet ownership can be expensive and should be budgeted for.

The Palmerston North Rescue Helicopter was dispatched three times on Saturday 9 December: to transfer a 31-year-old man with a suspected spinal injury to Christchurch Hospital, to airlift a 57-year-old motorbike rider with a fractured lower leg to Palmerston North Hospital, and to transport an 11-year-old boy with a back injury to Whanganui Hospital.

Through the cases of Laura and Richard, it shows tension between university theory and school practice, and how narratives in reports and Moodle supported the (re)construction of their professional identities.

The CFPB finalized rules that would require payday and auto title lenders to assess borrowers’ ability to repay and limit repeated account debits, aiming to reduce rollover debt and overdraft fees. The industry says the rules could hurt access to credit and force many lenders out of business, while supporters say they protect vulnerable borrowers; the rules may still be blocked or rolled back by Congress.

Ariel Miranda pitched seven shutout innings in the Mariners’ 6-1 win over the Marlins, allowing four hits, striking out five, and walking none for his first win of the season. Robinson Cano and Nelson Cruz hit home runs in the first inning to support him, and manager Scott Servais praised Miranda’s aggressive fastball approach.

Marine heatwaves in the Gulf of Alaska altered plankton communities and disrupted the ocean’s biological carbon pump, causing carbon to accumulate near the surface or in the upper twilight zone instead of sinking to the deep sea. Two heatwaves showed different carbon transport patterns, highlighting the need for long-term ocean monitoring.

Yen Bai province plans to expand raw material areas and hi-tech processing to boost agro-forestry-fishery development, especially in wood, tea, cinnamon, cassava, camellia fruits, bamboo shoots, and cattle meat. It aims to upgrade low-tech facilities, attract investment, and raise industrial output and product value by 2020 and 2025.

It argued that the Central Powers had sought only defensive aims, while their opponents pursued territorial conquest, and declared it would continue the war until a peace securing its existence, honor, and development was achieved.

Mario Batali surrendered oversight of his restaurant empire and will take leave from ABC’s “The Chew” after reports of sexual misconduct involving at least four women over at least 20 years. Batali apologized and said he takes full responsibility, while his company said he had previously been reprimanded after an October complaint. The Food Network also put plans to relaunch “Molto Mario” on hold.

Starbucks’ stock has been flat since late 2015, mainly due to weak comparable-store sales, though management says comps are rebounding. The passage highlights growth drivers including Mobile Order & Pay fixes, limited-time drinks, Frappuccino Happy Hour, a rapidly growing dividend, and strong China expansion, where the company is opening 500 stores a year and reported 7% comp-store sales last quarter.

The study developed the Grocery Basket Score (GBS), a model that rates grocery baskets using mortality-linked dietary signals from NHANES data. The final GBS combined separate food and beverage Cox models and was validated against Nutri-Score and AHEI, showing a 0.60 correlation with Nutri-Score on Open Food Facts items and stronger correlation with AHEI than calorie-weighted Nutri-Score scores.

Cam Newton apologized for sexist comments made at a press conference, saying his word choice was degrading and disrespectful to women. He said he did not mean to offend anyone, took responsibility, and apologized to reporters, journalists, mothers, daughters, sisters, and women worldwide after facing backlash and losing a sponsorship.

The Fifth Circuit held that Chapter 7 debtors with above-median income may claim the IRS vehicle ownership deduction even when they have no loan or lease payments on the vehicles. It reversed the dismissal of the Tates’ bankruptcy case and remanded the matter.

The company linked its mission to business value through tools like Candidate Stories, Assess, and an expungement tool, while also hiring fair chance talent internally and supporting the effort through CSR and Checkr.org.

It warns against withdrawal, urges patience and continued support, and says the mission in Iraq is tied to U.S. security and the fight against terrorism.

Southeast Asian stocks recovered on Wednesday after early losses driven by trade-war fears. Indonesia and the Philippines led gains, while Singapore, Vietnam and Thailand also rose; investors were bargain hunting and awaiting Philippine inflation data.

Michael Daniels, a BMW salesman from Ashford, was jailed for five years and three months for conspiracy to steal motor vehicles after helping steal nine cars worth £210,000. He gave accomplice Alex Tingle spare keys and customer addresses, and the cars were later taken from homes and passed to a figure known as “Ali.”

Sony’s “Baby Driver” surpassed $100 million domestically after seven weeks and earned $67 million overseas, against a $34 million budget. Directed by Edgar Wright and starring Ansel Elgort, it opened June 28 and performed above expectations, with a 94% Rotten Tomatoes score.

Jury selection has begun again in Isaiah Hagan’s murder trial after a mistrial, with 10 jurors selected so far and 14 total planned, including two alternates. Hagan is charged with four counts, including murder and robbery resulting in serious bodily injury, in the death of Halee Rathgeber, and opening statements are set for Monday.

The passage contrasts this court intervention with bureaucratic limits on access to the drug and argues that many more TB patients need timely treatment.

The passage discusses Duncan Keith and other teammates, emphasizing their hard work, maturity, level-headedness, fairness, friendship, and growing chemistry on and off the ice. Apple Inc. filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2020, reporting $59.7 billion in quarterly net sales and $11.3 billion in net income. Net sales increased 11% year over year, led by Services, iPad, and Mac, while the company also reported impacts from COVID-19, share repurchases of $16.0 billion, and a four-for-one stock split announced after quarter end.

Bernstorff informed Colonel House that Germany accepted Wilson’s help toward a peace conference, but would not publish peace terms while the Allies sought Germany’s destruction; he also justified submarine warfare as a response to the Allies’ aims and actions.

It outlines policies of justice in foreign affairs, strong military defenses, strict limits on executive power and removals from office, economy in public spending, enforcement and possible reform of financial laws, and preservation of the Constitution, union, and free institutions.

It emphasizes maintaining intensity, playing hard at home, relying on strong crowd support, and expecting a hard-fought, low-scoring playoff game.

GBP/USD is trading in a narrow 30-pip range as bears consolidate losses after hawkish Fed testimony by Yellen boosted the dollar and Treasury yields. The pair may be influenced next by the UK jobs report, followed by US CPI, retail sales, industrial production, and Fed speakers.

It warns of Soviet efforts to weaken NATO, expand influence in several regions, and achieve military superiority, while presenting U.S. strength as essential to peace and freedom.

Merck halted its late-stage Alzheimer’s drug verubecestat after an independent study found it had virtually no chance of working, following Eli Lilly’s recent stop of solanezumab. Experts said the failure was a setback for mild-to-moderate Alzheimer’s treatment and raised concerns about the beta amyloid theory, though other BACE inhibitor trials continue and Merck’s early-stage results are due in February 2019.

The Oklahoma Supreme Court held that the district court could not reduce Turner’s six-month license revocation, reversing the trial court’s modification and affirming the suspension. A dissent argued that 47 O.S. § 6-211 allowed judicial modification based on excessive length and that the 1975 amendment added, rather than replaced, that authority.

The passage describes Vermont City Electric, a municipal utility seeking to optimize nine demand-side management programs under an $800,000 2009 budget limit. DTE Maharashtra released the MHT CET 2018 exam pattern and syllabus circular for the May 2018 test for admission to engineering, technology, pharmacy, and pharma-D courses. The exam will have 20% weightage from Class XI and 80% from Class XII, with no negative marking.

The speaker says the team does not rely on fan support, wants wins over minutes or statistics, and believes success depends on everyone playing with emotion, pride, and sacrifice. The team strongly wants the cup, hates losing, and accepts that recent losses came because opponents played better, with a sharper passing and finishing game.

It introduces new MU clustering, scheduling, and NDP-based control frame formats intended to support flexible per-transmission clustering, multiple MU transmission schemes, and reduced control overhead.

Xenon Pharmaceuticals held an investor webinar on its Kv7 and Nav1.7 pain programs, led by CEO Ian Mortimer with presentations from Jim Empfield, JP Gilbert, and Chris Kenney. Mortimer introduced the company, noted forward-looking statements, and said the session would cover Xenon’s pipeline and its work in ion channel drug development for pain.

Xiaomi is celebrating its 8th anniversary and will launch the Mi 8, Mi 8 SE, and Mi Band 3 at an event in Shenzhen, China. The Mi 8 is expected to feature MIUI 10, Snapdragon 845, a 6.2-inch notch display, dual rear cameras, and an under-display fingerprint sensor, while the Mi 8 SE is expected with 6 GB RAM and up to 256 GB storage. Mi Band 3 is expected to include a touchscreen and gesture controls, and there are teasers suggesting the Mi 8 may come to India.

Quinton Tellis’s defense attorney alleges Panola County District Attorney John Champion tried to obtain false testimony from another defendant in exchange for leniency, and seeks Champion’s removal from the case and a delay of Tellis’s September retrial.

James Patterson has increased his annual donations to classroom libraries from $1.75 million to $2 million, distributing 4,000 $500 gifts to teachers nationwide through his “Patterson Pledge.” The program, launched in 2015 with Scholastic Book Clubs, received more than 80,000 applications.

The author describes a family road trip to several national parks and reflects on weather and climate confessions prompted by the trip. The passage discusses the value of conveying uncertainty in weather forecasts, people ignoring risk warnings, the shrinking of glaciers in Glacier National Park, and frustration with climate change being judged by short-term weather.

Finnish confidence in German success had recently increased, but anxiety remained about German exhaustion and possible Russian strength against Finland later. Finnish and U.S. officials discussed strained Finnish-American relations, Finland’s alignment with Germany, and the difficulty of fighting both Russia and Germany. Schoenfeld also reported that Finnish press ignored Stalin’s Baltic and Karelia statement, suppressed Roosevelt’s war statements, and that Finland remained dependent on Germany for essential food supplies due to icebound grain shipments.

The study examines Moroccan teachers’ views on education leaders’ role in sustaining ICT after COVID-19 and finds that many teachers did not continue using technology. Main barriers were lack of devices, internet, digital resources, training, and institutional support, with differences linked more to leadership and system factors than to teacher demographics.

Kingwood High School in Texas reopened for the first time since Hurricane Harvey after being closed for over six months due to flood damage that caused millions of dollars in repairs. All 2,782 students had been sent to another school while renovations were made, including security upgrades and new facilities.

Bilayer formation strengthens in-plane exchange by about 6–10%, and inversion-breaking stackings activate Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and in-plane polarization, linking stacking symmetry to magnetoelectric behavior.

Ian Murray, 74, was fined after a collision in Hathersage injured a cyclist who feared he had broken his neck. The cyclist was hospitalized and left with bruises, grazes, a facial laceration, and pins and needles in his hands, though he is expected to recover. Murray pleaded guilty to driving without due care and attention and was fined £185, with costs, a victim surcharge, and six points on his licence.

Nintendo will release a Hylian Shield New Nintendo 2DS XL exclusively at GameStop on July 2 for $159.99. The system comes pre-loaded with The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds, plays 3DS games in 2D and Nintendo DS games, and Nintendo has sold 72 million 3DS family systems globally.

The review finds dinners and gifts to officials, a Boston visit with officials’ families, large cash withdrawals, a $3 million payment to TGH Consulting, weak accounting and banking controls, and a sales culture that prioritizes profit over paperwork.

Melania Trump is hosting major online and social media companies to discuss cyberbullying and internet safety. The passage says companies have anti-harassment policies but mainly rely on user reports, and despite efforts, abuse remains widespread. It also notes the scale of the challenge, the lack of a federal bullying law, and that Trump has made child well-being and online safety a focus.

The ADS7828 can use an internal 2.5V reference or an external reference; a +5V supply requires an external +5V reference for full 0V to +VDD input range, while a +2.7V supply allows full range with the internal reference.
