The Health Ministry estimates there are 44,586 sex workers aged 15 to 49 in Zimbabwe, including about 6,800 in Bulawayo, and their average HIV prevalence is 55 percent compared with the national average of 13 percent. The report also says 25,900 people died of AIDS-related causes in 2016, or 71 per day, and notes that key populations remain more vulnerable to HIV infection.

Gas prices rose in Montgomery and nationwide, with Montgomery averaging $2.18 a gallon and the U.S. average reaching $2.40, its highest since 2015. Analysts cited lower oil inventories, geopolitical tensions, summer demand, and possible OPEC production cuts as reasons prices may keep rising.

GoSun introduced the Fusion, a 10-pound solar-electric oven that can steam, bake, or roast indoors or outdoors, day or night, without fuel. It uses a 150-watt electric heater, cooks in minutes at 350°F, feeds five people, and is designed to be portable, durable, and usable through clouds and freezing cold.

The lecture introduces least squares function approximation as a way to replace discrete Markov chain representations in temporal difference learning. It covers neural networks, linear basis functions such as radial basis, barycentric, Fourier, and polynomial approximators, and shows how linear function approximation enables explicit least-squares solutions. The lecture also explains system identification as a linear-in-parameters problem and extends TD learning to linear function approximators using eligibility traces, leading to least squares temporal difference learning (LSTD), which is more data-efficient and does not require a learning rate.

The court granted AAA Nevada Insurance Company’s motion for summary judgment, holding that the policy limits for the claim were $100,000 and that AAA’s failure to settle within the two-week deadline did not constitute bad faith under Nevada law. The court denied the interveners’ request for a Rule 56(f) continuance and rejected their jurisdiction arguments.

The passage outlines a treaty guaranteeing territorial integrity and political independence, requiring peaceful settlement of disputes through negotiation, investigation, and arbitration, and restricting hostile military expeditions and war supplies. It also sets ratification, deposit, duration, and denunciation procedures. The passage then includes two brief letters: one about drafting general principles for confidential consideration, and another expressing support for making Germany livable after the war.

The passage promotes a “write essay for me” service, saying essays can be organized with brainstorming, topic selection, editing, and formal tone, and that expert writers can produce error-free, customized papers and help students get better grades.

Most Southeast Asian stock markets fell as investors awaited the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting, with Thailand and Singapore among the biggest decliners. The Philippines recovered from early losses to close slightly lower, Malaysia edged up, and Vietnam rose for a sixth straight session to its highest close since March 2007.

Trap is a quick-hitting downhill run scheme that kicks out an interior defensive lineman, effective against aggressive pass rushers. Its strengths are speed, deception, and flexibility for different offensive line personnel, while its weakness is difficulty against defenses that squeeze interior gaps. The passage also explains trap play blocking and backfield responsibilities against 3-4 odd and 4-3 even fronts, plus shotgun RPO and Wing-T variations.

The speech reviews U.S. foreign policy, calls for unity with Congress, and focuses heavily on Vietnam and Cambodia, requesting emergency military and humanitarian aid for South Vietnam and evacuation protections. It also addresses relations with allies and adversaries, including Japan, Europe, Turkey, Greece, the Soviet Union, China, the Middle East, and developing nations, while urging continued strength, diplomacy, and national resolve.

Hillview Middle School will host an all-ages outdoor family movie night on April 27 at 7:30 pm showing Sing. Adults must supervise children at a 1:8 ratio, refreshments and a Mexican food truck will be available, and proceeds benefit LLS and JDRF.

The passage describes AGESA binary module and UEFI host interface mechanisms, including dispatcher, bridge, router, call-out handling, stack requirements, and event logging. It outlines initialization phases such as early, post, late, boot, and resume, along with related PPIs, HOBs, ACPI/DMI table generation, build options, and host environment responsibilities.

Gary Kleck’s study and later CDC surveys both found about 2.5 million defensive gun uses per year in the United States, but the CDC never published its results. The passage argues this undermines anti-gun claims and supports education and private gun ownership.

A review of a new study says the environmental value of biodegradable plastic bags is uncertain, with research findings inconsistent and poorly defined, making them of little use for policy or regulation.

Kinder Morgan rose after the Canadian government agreed to buy a pipeline project for $3.4 billion. Bank of America fell as banks skidded on lower interest rates, Petrobras dropped after Brazil said it would subsidize diesel price cuts, and other stocks moved on earnings, a share purchase deal, rising home prices, and lower bond yields.

Mitsui & Co Ltd said its April-December profit rose 64 percent to a record 376.8 billion yen and raised its full-year net profit forecast to 440 billion yen, citing stronger metal and energy assets and higher iron ore and coking coal prices. Itochu Corp also reported record April-December profit but kept its full-year forecast unchanged, while Sojitz Corp raised its profit forecast due to higher coal prices.

The passage criticizes long hospital emergency wait times and says doctors and nurses should not be blamed, but higher-ups should give doctors authority to call in extra help. It also argues that long-term care seniors should not pay for medications and questions the timing of funding announcements before an election.

The passage describes systems and methods for dynamically providing video overlays by identifying a set-top box and video content using fingerprinting or template matching, then selecting and presenting replacement video content in the same, cropped, blended, or masked regions. It also describes generating and using templates and data structures to support picture-in-picture, menu overlays, and playback-speed changes.

Peter DeBoer said the team felt energized by returning veteran players, needed a win to build momentum, and believed the series could turn after Saturday night. He praised a rookie’s clutch performance, credited the group’s resilience and composure, and said the team must start scoring and end their streak or the season will end.

The passage criticizes KDKA-TV and WPXI-TV for falsely reporting that Antwon Rose II was seen firing a gun and had gunshot residue on his hands. KDKA later retracted the report, while WPXI initially defended it before apologizing on June 28. The passage says the stations failed and questions their sources and reporting practices.

Costa’s rapid growth has helped drive Britain’s coffee boom, with more than 2,000 UK shops and rising sales. Its new Basildon roastery quadruples roasting capacity, uses sustainable design, and supports strict quality control, barista training, and global shipping.

The passage discusses multi-stakeholder engagement in palm oil supply chains, using Greenpeace, RSPO, and GAR as examples. It outlines many stakeholders involved, debates between higher sustainability standards and lower, more competitive ones, and challenges such as transparency, certification costs, small farmer burdens, and communication strategies. It also describes types of collaborations between companies and NGOs or industry groups, including one-on-one partnerships and broader industry associations.

YouTube announced four new Original series for YouTube Red aimed at family audiences and created with the YouTube Kids app in mind. The series, debuting in spring, feature DanTDM, TheAtlanticCraft’s Joe and Cody, L2M, and Fruit Ninja. YouTube also said additional shows are in development for 2017, and that YouTube Kids will soon be available on LG and Samsung Smart TVs.

The Kiss of Death is a sell signal for the S&P 500 that occurs after a drop from an all-time high, a fall below the monthly 21-EMA, a bounce back above it, and then a drop below the recent low. It triggered in 1969, 1973, 1978, 2001, and 2008, each time before major bear markets, though September 2022 was a false signal. A backtest from 1967 found that selling on the signal and re-entering above the 10-month EMA improved buy-and-hold performance and reduced maximum drawdown.

Fair Isaac unveiled a new pricing model that lets mortgage lenders bypass credit bureaus and license FICO scores directly to resellers, sending its shares up more than 20%. Shares of Experian, TransUnion, and Equifax fell after the announcement.

MSPM0C1105/6 are ultra-low-power 32-bit MSPM0 MCUs based on an Arm Cortex-M0+ core, running up to 32MHz with 1.62V to 3.6V supply and -40°C to 125°C operation. They offer up to 64KB flash, 8KB SRAM, an internal oscillator, DMA, CRC-16, analog peripherals including a 12-bit ADC and comparator, timers, watchdog, and UART, SPI, and I2C communication peripherals with multiple protocol supports.

Pekkala said most Finns supported the democracies and increasingly favored a separate peace with the Soviet Union, with this view shared by Mannerheim, much of the army, and several political parties, though not the Agrarian Party. Schoenfeld reported that Foreign Minister Witting stressed Finland’s dependence on Germany for imports and showed little willingness to resist German influence. Johnson warned that Finland’s military situation was worsening and that a Russian offensive could trigger political crisis in Sweden, while Kollontay privately said only a cessation of fighting could lead to peace.

Tesla Motors filed an 8-K stating that an immaterial error in its 2015 Form 10-K overstated the cost and net book value of the Supercharger network; the correct net book value as of December 31, 2015 was $166.6 million, and the error did not affect the consolidated financial statements or related notes.

Scientists have developed a molecular sensor that detects influenza by releasing thymol, a thyme-like flavor, in gum or lozenges. In lab tests, it released thymol in flu-positive saliva within 30 minutes and did not affect human or mouse cells; human trials are planned in about two years.

Four Baltimore County executive candidates told a real estate forum they support smart growth, a smoother development approval process, and more predictable rezoning tied to the county master plan. None backed impact fees, and Brochin again promised to end “pay-to-play politics.”

The Harrogate Advertiser Business Awards are open for nominations, with entries due by noon on Monday, March 13. The 12th ceremony will be held as a black-tie dinner at the Royal Hall in Harrogate on Thursday, April 27, with 10 award categories and sponsorship from Verity Frearson.

The passage argues that academic freedom is a false ideal used to justify ideological bias in academia, citing Robert Oscar Lopez’s view that tenure and academic freedom do not protect dissenting views. It claims higher education is corrupt and politically driven, suggests cutting funding and favoring trade schools and apprenticeships, and says teaching should be governed by truth rather than academic freedom.

The passage says the S&P 500 tends to perform significantly better on the first trading day of each month, with an average gain of 0.24% from the prior month’s close to the first day’s close. It defines this as the first trading day, not the first calendar day, and says the effect is not tradeable without additional filters or criteria.

The paper studies profit maximization in repeated bilateral trade from an online learning perspective, seeking low regret against the best DSIC and IR mechanism in hindsight. It shows ˜O(√T) regret in the stochastic i.i.d. setting with a matching Ω(√T) lower bound, while proving that in the adversarial setting no learning algorithm can achieve sublinear regret for a 2/3+ε fraction of optimal profit. It also applies the approach to reduce regret for the joint ads problem to ˜O(√T).
The figures show a new cooling fan design from multiple views, including an alternative perspective position. Broken lines indicate portions not part of the claimed design.

The passage introduces mediation analysis in psychological research and presents RAPSEM, a rank-preserving structural equation model that extends RPMs to latent variable settings. It aims to estimate controlled direct and mediation effects while handling measurement error and omitted mediator-outcome confounding under a no-effect-modifier assumption.

The speaker says the team felt comfortable, played well, and expected to capitalize on chances. He praises the goalies, Ryan Smyth’s work ethic and ability to score big goals, and says the team’s power play, coaching, and game plan have been important to playoff success. He also notes the team has grown together, is aware of the organization’s tradition, and feels they have another chance to even the series.

The passage says the team has been successful because it has been working hard while still having fun, and describes a fearless player who blocks many shots, stays on the ice regularly, and inspires teammates. It also notes that the break from hockey initially felt exciting but the buildup around the games changed the feeling, and praises a smooth, non-flashy player who is nominated for top defenseman and has had a great career.

A cross-sectional study in Denan district, southeastern Ethiopia, found 9.63% DAT sero-positivity for visceral leishmaniasis among 187 participants. Higher risk was associated with age 19–36, damp floors, outdoor sleeping, and sleeping near animal shelters. Knowledge and attitudes about VL were generally poor, and 823 sand flies from 12 species were collected, with P. orientalis the dominant Phlebotomus species.

The paper studies whether transformers can learn transitive reasoning by training on graph connectivity examples. It finds that transformers learn connectivity well on low-dimensional grid graphs, while performance is weaker on disconnected chain graphs; scaling model size helps more for grid graphs, whereas increasing graph size helps more for higher-dimensional grids and graphs with more chains.

Plymouth gift and gadget shop Hawkin's Bazaar will close its New George Street store on February 4 after four years there, following six years in the West End. A closing-down sale offers at least 50% off, with some items reduced by up to 75%.

Cincinnati handed No. 14 Iowa State its first loss, winning after a 17-point first quarter and recovering an onside kick late to preserve the lead. The Bearcats improved to 4-1, while Iowa State fell to 5-1 after trailing 31-7 before a late rally.

The North Carolina Supreme Court ordered a new trial, holding that after the defendant withdrew his guilty plea and requested time to obtain witnesses, forcing trial the next day denied him a reasonable time to prepare his defense.

MADSEN Cycles manufactures customized bucket bikes that can carry up to four kids plus cargo and offers accessories designed for comfort, security, style, and functionality. These include rain covers, front racks, and a middle bucket seat accessory for transporting pets, changing diapers, or holding drinks.

Jerome “Jay” Powell will become US Federal Reserve chair on Monday, succeeding Janet Yellen after a period of economic recovery and low unemployment. He is expected to face debate over how quickly to raise interest rates amid solid growth, low inflation, and the effects of fiscal stimulus and tax cuts. Yellen left the Fed with a more normalized policy environment after gradual rate hikes and reducing bond holdings.

The Supreme Court will hear Barrett’s case on whether Section 924(j) creates a separate crime from Section 924(c) and may be punished separately for the same conduct. The case raises double jeopardy questions about federal firearm offenses, with arguments that Congress did or did not authorize cumulative convictions and sentences.

Vocational assessment is complex and should combine formative feedback, self- and peer-assessment, academic and technical skills measures, and workplace evaluations. Competence-based and authentic assessment are emphasized as better suited to vocational education than standardized tests because they connect learning to workplace performance and can improve student motivation and engagement.

The Second Circuit affirmed summary judgment for Reisdorf Brothers on the plaintiffs’ Clean Water Act and RCRA claims, held that the district court properly declined supplemental jurisdiction over the state law claim, and upheld the denial of attorney’s fees to Reisdorf.

Using PREVEND cohort data and multi-state modeling, the study estimated age- and sex-specific transitions between KDIGO kidney risk stages and their association with new-onset heart failure. Kidney disease progression increased with age and was generally faster in men, while women had higher backward transition rates from intermediate to low risk. More advanced KDIGO stages were linked to higher heart failure risk, with relative risk decreasing but absolute risk increasing with age. The model also identified notable misclassification between kidney risk stages and showed good calibration.

Phil Kessel and Evgeni Malkin led the Penguins with two goals each in a 7-4 win over the Capitals. Pittsburgh won its fourth straight and seventh consecutive home game, while Alex Ovechkin scored twice for Washington. Sidney Crosby extended his scoring streak to 11 games.

The passage explains ways to access Australian financial markets, including ETFs, ADRs, direct stock trading, and CFDs, and notes that the ASX trades Monday to Friday from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm Australian Eastern Daylight Time. It says the Australian dollar can be traded against major currencies and highlights the currency ETF FXA. It also reports that seasonal strategies, especially the Santa Claus effect, performed well on Australian stocks, while some classical mean reversion strategies did not.

The study developed a 36-item scale to measure prospective teachers’ attitudes toward values education through distance education. Based on data from 341 education students, exploratory factor analysis identified two factors, “Necessity and Usefulness” and “Feasibility,” with reliable internal consistency. The scale showed valid and reliable measurements, though it does not support a total score because it is not additive.

The Dabhol Power Company board in London authorized Enron India managing director Wade Cline and CEO Neil McGregor to issue a preliminary termination notice to the Maharashtra State Electricity Board, but lenders and Indian officials pushed for renegotiation. Maharashtra paid Rs 134 crore under protest, and the state government said it would form a committee to renegotiate the power purchase agreement.

A law enforcement official said Stephen Paddock had tracer rounds, which can improve accuracy in the dark, as part of an arsenal that also included 23 guns, modified weapons, cameras, and large amounts of ammunition. Investigators said he may have been planning additional attacks and were still trying to determine his motive.

Tall post players can be difficult to defend and require team-based adjustments, including active pressure on the passer, backside help, traps, and specific post-defense tactics such as denying the block, face-guarding, influencing the ball to a weaker side, pressing full court, and using adjusted 2-3 zone or Diamond & One defenses.

Amazon reported higher net sales in Q2 and the first half of 2017, but lower operating income and net income than in the same periods of 2016. The company ended June 30, 2017 with $13.2 billion in cash and cash equivalents, and noted acquisitions, lease obligations, tax matters, and commitments including the planned Whole Foods acquisition.

Justice Babatunde Quadri admitted EFCC evidence against Chinese national Li Ya Ping, who is charged with concealing $300,000 while trying to fly from Abuja to Dubai. An EFCC witness said Customs arrested her at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport and later handed her, the money, and related documents to the EFCC.
Aledo leads Ryan 2-0 in Denton, Texas, after a safety in the first scoring play. Aledo is ranked No. 22 in The Sporting News High School Football Top 25, while Ryan is not ranked.

The passage describes key archival sources for documenting U.S. policy toward the Soviet Union from January 1983 to March 1985, including Reagan Library, State Department, and NSC records, and notes that many documents are also available on the Internet. It also explains the organizational context and changing procedures for U.S. covert actions, beginning with NSC 4-A in 1947 and NSC 10/2 in 1948, which expanded CIA responsibility for covert operations.

Children of obese parents, especially mothers at conception, have a higher risk of obesity, possibly due to changes in eggs and sperm such as non-coding RNAs and mitochondria. The passage says diet, exercise, and other pre-conception interventions may improve egg and sperm quality and reduce obesity risk in offspring.

VentureWire’s October 19, 2000 issue reports on top venture capital and private company news, including St. Paul Venture Capital’s $1.3 billion sixth fund, idealab!’s postponed IPO, Constellation Ventures’ $350 million fund, and New Edge Networks’ $139.9 million round. It also lists numerous financings, product launches, a NetObjects acquisition of MyComputer.com, board appointments, personnel changes, and several VC fund updates.

The passage says some songs may not play because the rights to play them on an additional device were not purchased. It also states to update the firmware to the latest version, copy CDs by ripping them first, convert unsupported files to supported formats, and use ID3 tags to fix unknown artist or album names.

The speaker said Ozzie played well and made great saves, but the other team had more scoring chances than expected. After taking the lead, they did not play as well, and the other team gained momentum in the second period. The first game of a series was described as a feeling-out process, especially against teams from other conferences.
The passage says the U.K. is reportedly considering raising drug spending and that Novo Nordisk said it will buy Akero Therapeutics, a developer of a MASH treatment, for up to $5.2 billion.

Cornerbacks are defensive backs whose main job is to cover opposing wide receivers, usually through man or zone coverage, and protect the outside parts of the field. They must be fast, agile, strong in backpedal and recovery, and also help stop outside runs. Great cornerbacks can shut down top receivers, making the position crucial to a defense.

Defending goal kicks focuses on pressuring the kick, winning possession, and denying an easy build-up or long kick. The passage explains goal-kick rules, including that the ball is live once kicked and moves, opponents may enter the penalty area then, and retakes occur if opponents in the area interfere before play resumes. It also outlines defensive positioning and tactics, plus youth and adult variations such as build-out lines, target receivers, and goalkeeper or strong-kicker responsibilities.

CeeDee Lamb, out for the past two games with a high ankle sprain, was seen doing rehab work on a side field Wednesday for the first time since Week 3. Cowboys vice president Stephen Jones said Lamb could return within the next two weeks, though his status for Week 6 remains uncertain and he is expected to be limited if he practices.
David Jones has not renewed Jesinta Franklin’s contract after two years, saying it is “taking another direction,” and has named Victoria Lee as its new ambassador.

Pharmacist Zameer Ghumra, 38, was jailed for six years after being convicted at Nottingham Crown Court of disseminating terrorist propaganda and trying to radicalise primary school-age children, including showing a child a beheading video and posting pro-ISIS content. The judge said he made a determined effort to turn children into terrorists, noted his lack of remorse, and said the crimes caused serious harm; one boy was diagnosed with PTSD and another had trouble sleeping and feared snipers.

Larry Connors’ 3-day high/low ETF strategy, outlined in High Probability ETF Trading, buys when an ETF makes lower highs and lower lows for three consecutive days and meets additional criteria such as being above the 200-day moving average and below the 5-day moving average. The passage says the strategy still works, though performance has deteriorated somewhat, and notes Connors focused on ETFs, testable rules, and high win-ratios.

NewMarket’s Singapore expansion and emerging-market exposure may improve growth, but the passage says its overall top-line outlook remains weak and the shares do not appear undervalued. The company has strong margins and cash flow, but growth is limited, with valuation already reflecting substantial FCF expectations.

Nippon Express said an employee falsified inspection stamps on government-stockpiled rice it stored for Mitsubishi, affecting 251 bags in total. Some rice was shipped as livestock feed and no health damage was reported, while the rest will be incinerated and none was sent for human consumption. The farm ministry had already issued Mitsubishi a business improvement order over the misconduct.

The passage sets out voyage contract terms for seamen: expenses from misconduct are charged to the responsible person; the master may replace an incompetent officer or seaman and adjust shares; sick or deceased crew members’ representatives receive a prorated share; entrusted vessel goods must be accounted for; and crew members are paid by fixed rates for whale oil, sperm oil, and whalebone upon return to San Francisco if they complete the voyage properly. It also requires crew signatures, bans distilled spirits except for medical use, and states that violating this pledge forfeits the violator’s share.

Seeking Alpha’s transcripts team says it publishes thousands of quarterly earnings calls and continues expanding coverage, and notes that EON Resources Inc. published the slide deck for the event. The chart shows time values from 2025-09-25 to 2025-09-30 and data values from 0.4121 to 0.5074.

The Bifrost subsea cable, a 20,000-kilometre system linking Singapore and the U.S. West Coast, is set to begin commercial operations. The $760 million project, led by Keppel with Meta and Telin Indonesia, is designed to boost capacity, resilience, and regional digital connectivity.

The study surveyed 147 second-year Hungarian engineering and technical management students about Education 4.0 skills. Problem solving was rated most important, but engineering students favored specialization, technical-mathematical knowledge, and ICT skills, while technical management students favored decision-making and analytical skills. Abroad study was mainly valued for improving language skills; career success was seen as depending mostly on individual talents, professional devotion, and networks.

Irrfan Khan revealed he has a Neuro-Endocrine tumor and has been receiving treatment in London. He shared an inspirational poem on Instagram, while the film fraternity asked for privacy and wished him a speedy recovery.

Thirty-seven lawyers, including 10 partners, have joined Orrick from Cadwalader, Wickersham & Taft and will work in Charlotte, London, Washington, D.C., and New York. The move comes amid reports of significant partner departures from Cadwalader, which has lost nearly a fifth of its partnership this year.

Plymouth Argyle beat Gillingham 2-1 to move level on points with them and climb off the bottom of League One on goal difference. Goals from Joel Grant and Toumani Diagouraga sealed the win, while Ryan Taylor’s return, the DJM takeover, and the improved league position were positives. Concerns remained over the goalkeeper crisis and Graham Carey’s form.

Petronas is seeking partners or bidders for up to a 49% stake in its SK316 offshore gas block in Malaysia, with a deal potentially worth about $1 billion. The company has approached several major oil firms and Asian companies, and the sale could help fund development of the Kasawari field amid low oil prices.

The passage argues that while white-black income disparities are significant, racial wealth disparities are far worse, largely tied to homeownership. It criticizes costly housing policies that create little equity and favors approaches that help residents repair, own, and preserve existing homes to build wealth and reduce racial wealth gaps.

A Year 7 student used a Nazi salute in sustained anti-Semitic bullying at Sydney Secondary College in Balmain, leading to two suspensions and discipline for three students over racist আচaviour. The school contacted parents of 18 students and offered counselling and support to those targeted.

AMD states the document is for informational purposes only, may contain errors, can change without notice, and provides no warranties, liability, or intellectual property license; product terms are governed by signed agreements or AMD’s standard terms.

The speaker says the team came out slow, tentative, and turned over pucks, which led to a seven-goal loss. They were disappointed by the lack of physical presence and success, said the opponent capitalized on nearly every chance, and noted the team must play better and can try to recover at home in the next game.

The passage says adult illiteracy is still a serious but overlooked problem, and Idris Elba is working with Project Literacy to raise awareness. He discussed diversity in Hollywood, shared a story about helping bring a former illiterate mother’s children’s stories to life, and said illiteracy is widespread, hard to admit, and important to address, especially for young people and people in jail.

A roundup of Indian newsclips focused on the Dabhol/Enron dispute reported that MSEB stopped buying power from DPC, MERC restrained DPC from activating its escrow account and pursuing arbitration, and the Centre submitted proposals but said it would not buy power from Dabhol. Negotiations continued, with discussion of tariff reduction and lender responses.

The Newfoundland and Labrador English School District voted to keep four rural schools open and close only H.L. Strong Academy, despite recommendations to close five schools to save $1.7 million annually. Trustees cited concerns including student safety, and board chair Goronwy Price said school reviews will restart.

The passage argues that pedagogy, slavery, and surveillance are historically interconnected, and uses Foucault’s panopticism to explain how surveillance has shaped teaching, learning, and social control from Ancient Greece and racial chattel slavery to digital education. It introduces “surveillance pedagogy” to describe how advanced technology, data extraction, and textualization now extend these extractive practices through schools, platforms, and surveillance capitalism.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on August 2, 2017 reporting that it released its second quarter 2017 financial results by posting its shareholder letter for the quarter ended June 30, 2017 on its website, with the letter attached as Exhibit 99.1.
The order appealed from was reversed, with ten dollars costs and disbursements to the appellant, to be paid by the respondents as committee out of the estate in their hands. Opinion by Smith, J.

A cross-sectional study of 302 heroin users on methadone at Muhimbili National Hospital in Tanzania found lung function decline in 28.5% of participants, with restrictive disease most common. Underweight, HIV infection, and a history of pulmonary tuberculosis were independently associated with lung function decline, while other substance-use factors were not significant.

The paper analyzes “personal attention” ASMR YouTube videos, using Olivia Kissper as a case study, to examine mediated intimacy and sexuality. It argues that ASMR consumption can be understood as a sexual practice and the ASMRtist-viewer-technology relationship as a sexual relation.

The Superior Court of Pennsylvania affirmed Clay Williams’s life sentence for first-degree murder and related convictions, denied his remand petition, found several claims waived, and dismissed his ineffective-assistance claims without prejudice for collateral review.

The passage introduces BALLAST, a Bayesian active learning method for placing Lagrangian observers to study time-dependent ocean currents. It models the currents with a spatio-temporal vector-output Gaussian process and uses an information-theoretic utility to sequentially choose observer locations. The authors claim BALLAST accounts for Lagrangian trajectories through surrogate-simulated paths and present a new GP posterior sampling method using standard regression and the SPDE approach.

An analysis says Ontario’s school fundraising deepens funding inequities: needy schools receive about $179 per student in grants, while fundraising averages $280 per student and brings in nearly $200 million more than the government provides to lower-income communities. The report says special education, ESL, and school maintenance have been underfunded for two decades, and unions are calling for more funding and regular reviews of the system.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting shareholder approval of a 20-for-1 common stock split and related increase in authorized shares, effective May 27, 2022, with trading expected on a split-adjusted basis June 6, 2022. The report also gave voting results from the May 25, 2022 annual meeting, including election of directors, ratification of Ernst & Young LLP, approval of executive compensation, and rejection of multiple shareholder proposals.

The Citi Simplicity® Card offers 0% intro APR for 21 months on balance transfers and 12 months on purchases, has no annual fee, no late fees, and no penalty rate. It requires good/excellent credit and charges a balance transfer fee of 3% for transfers completed within 4 months, then 5% afterward.

The Fifth Circuit affirmed Joe Ezeokeke’s 138-month sentence for possession of cocaine with intent to distribute, upholding the obstruction-of-justice enhancement based on false trial testimony and rejecting his claim that the sentence was substantively unreasonable.

The study of 1,284 Kailuan cohort participants found that higher long-term visit-to-visit blood pressure variability was associated with greater cerebral small vessel disease burden, especially for lacunae and visible perivascular spaces. High systolic variability was linked to moderate burden and PVS, diastolic variability to LA, and pulse pressure variability to moderate/severe burden, LA, and PVS. These associations were stronger in participants with hypertension, and in adults under 60, high pulse pressure variability showed the strongest associations.

The passage is a class discussion on Bitcoin’s 10th anniversary, payment-system pain points, and whether blockchain can address them. It highlights issues such as cost, delayed settlement, intermediaries, chargebacks, privacy, fraud, interoperability, scalability, governance, and regulatory concerns, while noting possible benefits like lower verification costs, faster settlement, cross-border payments, financial inclusion, and smart contracts. It also discusses blockchain and crypto payment companies, stablecoins, bridge currencies, and the view that existing payment systems may also improve without blockchain.

The passage describes a password protection feature that locks a card using a stored password in non-volatile PWD and PWD_LEN registers, with optional FEP and FEP_LEN registers if COP is supported. Locked cards still accept basic commands, ACMD41, CMD16, and lock card commands, but not data access. The lock/unlock command works only in transfer state, requires the card to be selected, and uses a data block containing the command information.

The passage warns that the integrated circuit can be damaged by ESD and should be handled with proper precautions. It also lists extensive revision history updates to device features, specifications, tables, and mechanical/orderable information for the MSPM0G3519, MSPM0G3518, MSPM0G1519, and MSPM0G1518 datasheet.

Sheree Coffman spoke to the Northmont Rotary about the Northmont High School Student Assistance Program, which identifies and helps troubled students and supports early intervention through universal, targeted, and indicated programs. The passage highlights services such as Alternative to Expulsion, Peer Facilitation, SADD, small support groups, and U.N.I.T.Y. Day, which has involved over 400 students in recent years.

The passage explains Bollinger Bands, a technical indicator with a middle moving average and upper and lower bands based on standard deviations. Victor Wembanyama spent a transformative offseason after a right shoulder condition, training in unusual ways including soccer, a Shaolin temple retreat, meditation, Kung Fu, chess, NASA, and workouts with Hakeem Olajuwon. Chief Justice Del Toro dissented, stating the evidence supported the trial court’s finding of the defendant’s negligence and would affirm.

The passage reviews a Netflix documentary about a Michigan teen who receives abusive texts, the FBI investigation that follows, and the eventual reveal of the sender. It also discusses cellphone forensics, Oklahoma’s new school cellphone ban, and the broader risks of cellphone use among students.

SOS Defensive “Do’s” emphasize pressuring the ball to sideline, corner, or baseline checkpoints, denying middle drives, using contact pass denial and fronting post ups, rotating on traps, switching on off-ball screens, and boxing out on all shots. The passage also outlines sideline, wing, helpside, and triangle “I” alignments and rotations for sideline and baseline traps.

Apple Inc. reported that it consummated the issuance and sale of $1.377 billion of 4.15% Notes due 2046 on June 22, 2016. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, with interest payable semi-annually beginning December 22, 2016 and maturing June 22, 2046.

The paper studies molecule generation with LLMs and finds that LLMs perform worse with SELFIES than SMILES and are inefficient at correcting invalid SMILES. It proposes SmiSelf, which converts invalid SMILES to SELFIES and back, achieving 100% validity while preserving molecular characteristics and maintaining or improving other metrics.

Mike Peca is described as consistently deserving recognition for winning the Selke Trophy and being nominated again. The speaker also says the North Stars and Dallas Stars have always aimed to win the Stanley Cup and reach the finals, and that unrestricted free agency has been used as one way to improve the team, with past additions generally benefiting both players and the club.

The passage reports field-free superconducting diode effect in stressed NbSe2, observed only in strained regions and not in stress-free areas. It finds two magnetic-field symmetries: B-even behavior with zero-field SDE in some devices and B-odd behavior in others, explained by two orthogonal mechanisms activated by stress or magnetic field.

Fitch affirmed Marsh & McLennan Companies’ Long-Term IDR at A- and short-term ratings at F2, and revised the outlook to Positive from Stable, citing several years of improved operating performance, strong credit metrics, liquidity, and financial flexibility. Fitch said the company’s risks from litigation and regulation are manageable and listed upgrade and downgrade triggers tied to margins, leverage, coverage, and potential charges or impairments.

Melita Honey Farm owners in Tasmania face auction of their home in three weeks after not paying council rates since 2010, because they say the land belongs to God. Meander Valley council says the family has not contacted them, and it plans to auction the property on September 1 unless the debt is paid.

OpenAI and Stripe have introduced Instant Checkout in ChatGPT using the open-source Agentic Commerce Protocol, which could let users shop inside AI chats. The feature starts with U.S. sellers and will expand to more than a million merchants, while the protocol could also be adopted by other AI assistants.

Scientists studied brown recluse spiders and found they sew their thin, flat silk into looped structures that greatly increase strength and toughness. The research suggests this spider-inspired material could improve synthetic fibers for space protection, parachutes, bungee cords, and other lightweight high-strength applications, and a patent application has been submitted.

Rock art at Jebel Misma, Jebel Arnaan, and Jebel Mleiha in the Nefud dates to more than 12,000 years ago and was likely made by early nomadic people after a dry period ended. The engravings, including camels and human figures, suggest a once-wetter, more habitable Arabian Desert and reveal a new monumental rock-art tradition.

The 2016 ISL season finale drew 54,000 stadium attendees and 41 million TV viewers, with total season viewership rising to 216 million, up 41% from 2015. Rural, metro, and digital engagement all increased, and fan attendance averaged over 84% across club cities.

Japanese Finance Minister Taro Aso said North Korea-related tensions could make the yen extremely unstable, declined to comment on exchange rates, and urged the remaining TPP countries to proceed without the U.S. He said Washington may eventually find it better to rejoin TPP.

Industrial enterprises use simulation, modeling, analysis, and 3D tools to improve innovation, quality, speed, cost, and decision making, but data silos and limited computing capacity often constrain results. Many firms plan greater deployment and investment, while HPC and cloud-based HPCaaS are seen as key to faster, more accurate calculations, scalability, and new digital products, services, and business models.

Oil prices rose about 1.5% after OPEC+ approved a smaller-than-expected output increase of 137,000 bpd starting in November. Brent crude reached about $65.44 and WTI about $61.77, while analysts said the gains may be short-lived amid weak demand and oversupply risks.

The lecture explains that regularity of Euclidean black hole and Rindler spacetimes requires periodic imaginary time, implying a temperature for observers using that time. It distinguishes vacuum choices in curved spacetime, including Hartle-Hawking, Schwarzschild/Boulware, and Rindler vacua, and argues that the regular Hartle-Hawking vacuum is more physical because the other vacua are singular at horizons. Using the Rindler wedge, it shows that the Minkowski vacuum can be written as an entangled state of left and right Rindler modes, so tracing out the left side yields a thermal density matrix for the right side with temperature \(1/2\pi\) in Rindler time.

This phase III, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled study in India evaluated CORBEVAX™ as a heterologous booster in adults previously primed with COVAXIN or COVISHIELD™. The booster was safe and well tolerated, caused no serious adverse events, and produced significantly higher neutralizing, anti-RBD IgG, Omicron, and cellular immune responses than placebo at 28 days.

The study examined Scopus-indexed articles by Ukrainian scholars from 2020–2023 to assess how Russia’s full-scale war affected foreign co-funding, authorship patterns, and citation impact for MESU-, NASU-, and NRFU-funded papers. It found that funded articles increased, foreign co-funding and international co-authorship remained common and were concentrated among countries such as Poland, Germany, the USA, China, and the EU, while foreign-only funding generally had the highest citation impact. Articles with foreign co-affiliations or co-authorship usually outperformed those authored only by Ukrainian-affiliated scholars, and the results suggest a need to reform Ukraine’s research funding system and create a centralized national funding database.

UK median disposable household income rose to £27,300 in 2017, £1,600 above pre-2008 levels, with the biggest gains for poorer households and a small fall in inequality. Richest households have only just returned to pre-crisis income levels, and retired households remain behind non-retired households, with the gap widening again.

Research commissioned by the Association of British Insurers found British fire-safety testing for building materials is inadequate, using only wood in test fires despite plastic being common in real fires. It said cladding tests and conditions do not reflect real building use, and called for urgent reform, non-combustible materials, and mandatory sprinklers in some new buildings.

The passage explains that filing taxes late can lead to IRS fees, loss of refunds after three years, and possible collection actions if taxes are owed. It notes that many people may still be eligible for refunds or credits even if they are not required to file, and says communicating with the IRS and filing on time can help avoid serious consequences.

The passage describes a proximity sensor module that uses optical resin lenses over a light-emitting diode and light sensor, then encapsulates them in molding compound to block optical cross-talk and simplify manufacturing. It also describes alternative embodiments with added glass lenses, baffles or metal caps, separate leads, and a sensor stick containing multiple sensors such as environmental, light, proximity, motion, and wireless connectivity sensors.

Automation Anywhere’s Bot Store saw 100% growth in bots two months after launch, with AI as the top category, speech-to-text leading downloads, finance and accounting the most common process, and SAP the most listed application. The addition of IQ Bot lets partners and developers offer cognitive capabilities for automating document-centric processes such as bills, bank statements, and tax forms.

California is seeking guidance from Colorado on implementing a regulated recreational cannabis system. Governor John Hickenlooper will testify before California lawmakers about Colorado’s experience with cannabis taxes, regulations, and track-and-trace implementation, as California officials face a tight deadline to set up its own system under Proposition 64.

Arsenal visit Tottenham for the 50th derby of Arsene Wenger’s reign, with Arsenal hoping to hurt Spurs’ title hopes. Fan views suggest a tight match: Spurs expect midfield to decide it and predict a 2-1 win, while Arsenal fans say recent wins and an FA Cup boost have improved confidence, though many still think a draw is likely.
A billionaire-backed life sciences VC firm has launched, led by a former Flagship associate and backed by private equity billionaire Tony James.

Astronomer Rory Barnes concluded that many future exoplanets, including potentially habitable ones detected by TESS, will likely be tidally locked, challenging the idea that only planets around small, dim stars can be synchronized. He said tidal locking may be a major factor in the evolution of habitable exoplanets and important to know when searching for life.

The passage says children’s belief in Santa is a normal part of development, often fades by about age eight, and is not harmful. Parents can either support the belief, let children question it themselves, or provide evidence to end it, and children usually handle discovering the truth better than parents expect.

Jacques Dubochet, Joachim Frank, and Richard Henderson won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing cryo-electron microscopy, a technique that lets scientists create detailed images of molecules and see biological molecules in their natural environment, including down to individual atoms.

Stephen Hawking and Thomas Hertog submitted a paper on March 4, 2018, shortly before Hawking’s death, proposing an alternate model of multiverse theory and suggesting the universe will eventually die out as stars lose energy. The paper, “A Smooth Exit from Eternal Inflation?”, may be considered by a leading journal.

The passage describes the GHCB specification for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP, including guest-hypervisor communication, protocol versioning, feature advertisement, NAE event handling, page state changes, guest requests, AP boot methods, NMI handling, debug register virtualization, and #HV doorbell page behavior.

The passage describes a continuation patent application for a linear surgical stapler and multiple pin trap mechanisms that releasably couple stapler halves at their proximal ends. It explains embodiments using slides, hooks, C-clips, springs, camming surfaces, dual slides, and a rotatable locking member to keep the stapler in an open or clamped state and to allow controlled separation.

The passage lists many commodity and gold-related trading strategy articles, including backtests, rules, performance, and examples. It also explains that commodity trading strategies use methods such as trend following, mean reversion, spread trading, fundamental analysis, arbitrage, and options trading, and says traders may benefit from diversifying into gold strategies.

The passage describes a Python trading strategy that combines a 14-day RSI and a 5-day SMA to generate signals. It buys when RSI is below 30 and price is above the SMA, and sells when RSI is above 70 and price is below the SMA. It also explains calculating the indicators, building buy/sell signals, and measuring performance with metrics such as annual return, win ratio, maximum drawdown, and risk-adjusted return, using Walmart data and noting it can also be applied to SPY and QQQ.

The speaker says the team has grown more comfortable and relaxed through playoff experience, having faced many pressure situations in recent years. He believes the team is physically strong, not overly outsized, and prepared for tough play. He also says speed is fairly even between the teams and that reaching the finals is less thrilling than winning them, with beating Colorado being the real triumph.

Sebastian Vettel won the 2018 Bahrain Grand Prix for Ferrari after fending off Mercedes’s Valtteri Bottas by 0.699 seconds in a final-laps battle. Ferrari and Mercedes used different tyre strategies, while Red Bull’s Daniel Ricciardo and Max Verstappen retired early. Hamilton finished third, with Pierre Gasly fourth, Kevin Magnussen fifth, and points also scored by Alonso, Ericsson and Ocon.

The Stochastic Indicator Strategy uses the Stochastic Oscillator to measure price relative to its recent range, with %K and %D lines signaling overbought, oversold, crossovers, and divergence. It can be adjusted for sensitivity, used across markets and timeframes, and is often combined with other indicators and risk management.

KeyBanc downgraded Fortinet from Overweight to Sector Weight, saying its valuation looks full after strong share gains and that slower margin expansion could increase volatility and downside risk, despite continued strength in network security and cloud opportunities.

Saudi Aramco cut Asian official selling prices for lighter crude grades in May, while leaving heavier grades unchanged, as it appears to be defending market share against rising light-oil supplies from U.S. shale and other producers. Middle Eastern producers’ share of Asia’s crude imports fell in March, while Western suppliers’ share rose.

Broader indices traded higher, with Nifty up 26 points and Sensex up 88, led by gains in Bank Nifty, oil & gas, and metal stocks. HDFC Bank, Reliance Communications, Coal India, Bharti Airtel, and ONGC were among the top gainers, while several stocks hit fresh 52-week highs and 38 stocks hit new 52-week lows. Market breadth favored advances on both NSE and BSE.

Thousands of schools were closed on Monday because of snow, and several schools in and around Warwick District and Rugby Borough will remain closed today due to icy weather. A list of affected schools was provided and may be updated with more closures.

In a TriNetX retrospective study of 12,410 cancer patients who developed CTRCD, 1,223 GLP-1 RA users matched to 1,223 nonusers had lower 1-year risks of the composite outcome, mortality, heart failure, and all-cause hospitalization, while atrial fibrillation/flutter, ventricular tachycardia, and gastroenteritis were not significantly different.

U.S. officials warned Finland that active assistance to Germany and any major offensive against the Soviet Union could endanger relations, while urging Sweden to press Finland toward peace or a ceasefire with the Soviet Union. The passage also reports a new German-Finnish trade agreement and a related goods-exchange agreement with Norway.

A Tennessee mother’s video of her bullied son Keaton went viral, drawing support from athletes and entertainers. Keaton described being teased, isolated, and mistreated at school, and a fundraising page for his education raised over $29,000.
Perforated Mylar disk parachutes use kirigami cuts to unfurl as they fall and could be useful for humanitarian aid drops or package delivery.

The passage is a collection of news reports and headlines about Enron replacing CFO Andrew Fastow with Jeffrey McMahon amid an SEC inquiry into Fastow-related partnerships, investor concern, and a sharp drop in Enron’s stock. It also mentions analyst downgrades, lawsuits, disclosure concerns, and related market reactions.

A Future Oncology article reported that in patients with metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma treated with avelumab, lack of disease progression correlated with improvements in health-related quality of life, based on data from the JAVELIN Merkel 200 Phase II trial.

The passage discusses the Stanley Cup Finals between the Washington Capitals and the Detroit Red Wings, emphasizing Detroit’s strength, coach Scotty Bowman’s adaptability, and the Capitals’ different system and lineup. It highlights player experience, leadership, family support, humor in the locker room, and respect rather than intimidation, while noting both goaltenders are in strong form and that the series will be difficult.

The passage describes a respiratory assistance system with a humidification chamber, heaters, sensors, and a controller that determines the gas source type and adjusts temperature set points to deliver heated, humidified gases. The controller can identify room-air entraining versus non-entraining sources using component detection, flow, temperature, humidity, and rebreathing patterns, and may generate user alerts or automatically confirm the system configuration.

CeeDee Lamb is recovering from a high-ankle sprain and has missed the last two games. He has resumed doing some work at practice, including resistance bands, which suggests progress in rehab. ESPN’s Todd Archer believes Lamb is more likely to return in Week 7 than Week 6.

This cross-sectional study in Nigeria found that HIV-positive participants, especially those occupationally exposed to chemical mixtures, had lower p53 and bcl2 levels, higher MDA, and lower CD4 counts than HIV-negative participants. HIV status and SOD were significantly associated with p53 and bcl2, and the authors concluded that immune deficiency, oxidative stress, antioxidant deficits, and dysregulated apoptosis may increase genomic instability and cancer risk in HIV-infected workers exposed to hazardous chemicals.

Solomon Dalung said Buhari’s 2015 victory showed elections can be won without money and reflected a political revolution against “god-fatherism.” He supported the “Not too Young to Run” campaign, criticized political manipulation, and said Nigeria was making progress while calling for unity.

Jane Goodall says conservation is now more urgent than ever, with poaching, deforestation, and especially climate change threatening wildlife. She remains cautiously optimistic that there is still time to act, and hopes a new documentary about her early chimpanzee work will inspire greater understanding and action.

The device includes a linear temperature sensor with factory calibration, an LFSS with RTC and IWDT, a configurable VREF, comparator, CRC, UART, I2C, SPI, WWDT, RTC_B, and TIMx peripherals, plus SWD/DEBUGSS support, factory constants, and security features such as firewalls and CRC-16.

The passage is a repeated list of financial and business headlines, with one detailed article about Germany’s Federal Cartel Office investigating whether Temu’s pricing practices violate competition rules.

Scientists proposed refreezing the Arctic by deploying about 10 million wind-powered pumps to spray seawater over the ice, potentially adding 1 meter of ice in a winter and slowing summer sea-ice loss. The plan is estimated to cost about US$500 billion and would require massive amounts of steel.
The Third Circuit found no error in the record and affirmed the district court’s judgment.

The study analyzed SARS-CoV-2 genomic surveillance data from Connecticut from January 2022 to January 2023 and found that successive Omicron lineages replaced one another through different combinations of intrinsic transmissibility and immune escape. BA.1 and BA.2 showed strong growth and transmissibility, BA.4/BA.5 had lower intrinsic transmissibility but expanded amid increasing population immunity, and XBB later outcompeted BA.5 with both immune escape and transmissibility advantages.

Tesla announced cheaper Model Y and Model 3 Standard versions priced at $39,990 and $36,990, but they remain short of replacing the canceled $7,500 tax credit. The models remove some features to lower costs, and Tesla’s sales are down 6 percent globally, while Musk says the company’s future depends on autonomous cars and humanoid robots.

The passage reviews Japan’s high life expectancy, the meaning and determinants of subjective survival probabilities (SSP), and the limited research on how work and employment relate to SSP among people aged 50+ in Japan. It describes Japanese pension and retirement reforms, employment categories in late career, and job satisfaction and working time as related factors. The study uses JSTAR panel data from 2007–2013, covering 7,082 respondents in ten cities, and measures SSP with repeated questions on the probability of living to specific ages.

The lecture discusses how allowing firms to enter changes market structure, profits, and welfare under different models. In homogeneous-good models, entry is usually excessive because firms do not internalize business stealing, though fixed costs can limit entry; in differentiated-goods models, entry can be too high or too low depending on business stealing and consumer surplus from better product matches. It also presents Jovanovic’s model of firm dynamics, where firms learn their own productivity over time, and a later paper on rating intermediaries showing that limiting information about highly rated firms can encourage more entry and better consumer outcomes.

The lecture introduces psychology and economics as the study of how psychological and economic factors jointly shape behavior, and argues that behavioral economics seeks to improve standard economic models by accounting for deviations such as limited self-control, biased beliefs, imperfect attention, social influences, and demand for commitment. It also outlines the course topics, including preferences, beliefs, attention, mental health, discrimination, policy, paternalism, and poverty.

GAO found that CSI schools served more low-income and Black students, had lower proficiency rates, and slightly higher student-teacher ratios than other public schools. In a sample of CSI plans, 42 percent appeared to address all three reviewed ESEA elements, and Education could strengthen monitoring by independently selecting plans for review; Education agreed and said it would do so starting in spring 2024.

In patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy and healthy controls, 23Na MRI showed higher total sodium concentration in structural hub regions than non-hub regions, but sodium signal fraction did not differ by hub status. Epilepsy was associated with increased total sodium concentration and an increased sodium signal fraction in the epileptogenic zone, while non-epileptogenic regions showed lower signal fraction. The findings suggest hub-related total sodium changes reflect microstructural abnormalities rather than epilepsy-specific effects.

The passage describes the impact of a catastrophic injury that forced the team to rely on young players, helped the speaker learn the organization’s depth, and influenced later acquisitions. It also discusses leadership, special teams, travel, and says the group has strong leadership, resilience, and no drama, with a particular praise of one player as a great leader.

Telltale Games confirmed it is working on an original new IP, though details and timing have not been announced. The studio also plans to expand its games to new platforms and streaming services, with more information due this summer.

Periyar University has released UG and PG examination results for 2017 on its official website, with results also available through students’ colleges. Students can check the result by entering their registration number and date of birth, and can apply for re-totalling or revaluation within 10 days, with specified fees.

The passage contains anti-Japanese and anti-foreign proclamations by Tong-Hâk men, warning of anarchy and urging Koreans to unite and expel Japanese and foreigners. It also includes a Japanese consul’s notice advising Japanese residents in Seoul to prepare to evacuate women and children because Tong Hâk forces were approaching the city.

IDT Corporation held its fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2025 earnings call on September 29, 2025, covering results for the three- and twelve-month periods ended July 31, 2025. The company noted that its remarks may include forward-looking statements and non-GAAP measures, with reconciliations provided in the earnings release.

Britain’s first carbon neutral new-build church was the Roman Catholic Church of the Annunciation in Walsingham, built in 2006 with solar panels, a bore heat exchange system, and a round tower using stones from an older church. A planned PassivHaus church in Sheffield, Christ Church Central, received planning permission in 2013 but was not built because funding fell short, though similar projects exist in the United States and Canada.

Canon’s EOS 77D, positioned awkwardly between the T7i and 80D, adds a 24.2-megapixel Dual Pixel CMOS sensor, 45-point autofocus, 80D metering, Bluetooth, and an optional beginner-focused interface, while lacking weather sealing. Canon also introduced a smaller but slightly heavier EF-S 18-55mm f4-5.6 IS STM kit lens, priced at $250, and the 77D is scheduled for April 2017 at $900 body-only.

Via Browser is presented as a lightweight, fast, customizable Android browser with strong stability, useful privacy features, intuitive usage, and easy tab management. It supports search engine changes, pull-to-refresh, Incognito Mode, Do Not Track, and ad blocking, and is recommended as a good default mobile browser alternative to Chrome.

High Prairie Elementary School students are using the new Overdrive App for ebooks, and several classes are working on projects including elections, planting, biographies, science, sequencing, Christmas concert practice, postcard exchanges, and a Kids Sense Book Sale. Grade 5 students also helped with school events and kindness and holiday campaigns.

The DD’s automatic Local bus clock gating can prevent an edge-configured PIC input from returning to Idle if its interrupt source stays high after servicing, causing later edges to be missed and potentially hanging the system.

The Supreme Court denied Google’s request to pause parts of a lower-court order in its antitrust dispute with Epic Games, requiring Google to let app developers use their own payment systems for in-app purchases. The broader changes to Android and competing app stores may still be affected by Google’s pending appeal.

The passage describes Russian traditional remedies for sunburn, including sour cream, yogurt, kefir, egg whites, nettle decoction, watermelon juice, sea buckthorn oil, vegetables, sauerkraut, soda water, oatmeal, and a lemon-sour cream mask, along with claims that these help reduce redness, pain, peeling, itching, and swelling.

Despite efforts to reduce academic code violations, they remain high, with more than half occurring in computer science. In 2015-16, 49 undergraduates and seven graduate students were charged; sanctions ranged from no violation to dismissal. The University uses tutorials, syllabi, and plagiarism detection tools to prevent violations and is considering expanding the committee, adding integrity initiatives, and possibly an honor code.

NVIDIA’s FY2019 10-K reports that the company, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, focuses on GPU- and AI-based platforms across Gaming, Professional Visualization, Datacenter, and Automotive markets. It describes its business strategy, manufacturing model, competition, employees, properties, stock repurchases, and extensive risk factors, and notes 13,277 employees, $7.42 billion in cash and securities, and substantial international revenue.

NVIDIA reported that Mellanox and NVIDIA Holdings received Chinese antitrust approval for NVIDIA’s proposed acquisition of Mellanox, bringing approvals from the European Commission, Mexico, and China. The deal was expected to close on or about April 27, 2020, subject to remaining customary closing conditions.

The passage describes the secession crisis, the attack on Fort Sumter, and the call to use federal force to preserve the Union. It argues that secession is unlawful, asks Congress for 400,000 men and $400,000,000, defends limited habeas corpus suspension, and calls the conflict a people’s struggle to maintain constitutional government.

Rancho Bernardo Kiwanis Club marked 50 years of service, noting its 1967 founding and long history of youth programs, fundraising, and community donations. The club sponsors school and Scout groups, supports charities such as Rady Children’s Hospital and Ronald McDonald House, and says it has helped over 800,000 children.

In 15 patients with excessive LV trabeculation, CMR analysis showed that intertrabecular recesses had a higher ejection fraction than the central cavity. Contouring trabeculations changed LV volume and EF estimates, often increasing EF and reclassifying some patients out of severely reduced EF categories.

Lois Riess, accused of killing her husband in Minnesota and a woman in Florida, is in custody in Texas awaiting extradition to either state. Florida charges include second-degree murder and other offenses, while Minnesota charges her with felony theft and may add murder charges. Prosecutors could seek the death penalty in Florida if the charge is elevated to first-degree murder.

Arlo is a smartphone-controlled home security system with motion detection, night vision, free week-long online video storage, and Alexa compatibility. The three-camera system is discounted from £409.99 to £249.99 today in Amazon’s Early Easter Sales, with waterproof, battery-powered cameras and expandable support for different camera types.

The president said the U.S. has made major progress against COVID-19 but is facing a tough stretch driven by the Delta variant and nearly 80 million unvaccinated Americans. He announced a six-part plan requiring more vaccinations, expanding testing and masking, protecting schools and children, supporting economic recovery, and improving treatment and global vaccine efforts.

The passage introduces blockchain as a distributed ledger technology valued for immutability and trustless transactions, then presents an exploratory multiple-case study of five Chinese blockchain companies to examine how they create and capture value through digital business models. It identifies five models: platformer, disintermediator, mediator, transformer, and co-innovator, and notes key challenges for each.

The Trump administration fired most members of the National Council on the Humanities, leaving four members, all Trump appointees. The 26-member council advises the National Endowment for the Humanities on grant-making, policy, and funding decisions, and was expected to review proposals for the National Garden of American Heroes program. Karen Stout said she was disappointed by the firings.

Harvey Ulfers, 64, was sentenced in federal court to 2 years and 9 months for wire fraud and money laundering for a scrap metal fraud scheme involving John Deere Foundry. He must pay a $111,602 fine and $259,132 restitution. Prosecutors said he defrauded Deere & Company of at least $250,000 from about 2004 to January 2013. Patrick Williams also pleaded guilty, was sentenced to 27 months, and was ordered to pay $259,132.97 restitution.

The study extended follow-up of BNT162b2 and ChAdOx1 vaccine effectiveness to 50 weeks after second dose. In older and clinically vulnerable groups, high third-dose uptake made later two-dose estimates difficult to interpret because remaining two-dose recipients appeared selected for poorer health or recent infection. In the 18–39 group, waning against COVID-19 hospitalisation and positive SARS-CoV-2 test was approximately log-linear, with negligible effectiveness by weeks 35–38 and 15–18 respectively, and no clear effect of omicron.

Halimat Oniru, founder of Haleem Group, is described as a private but influential Nigerian entrepreneur whose company operates in several states and creates many jobs. The passage says Haleem Group is a leading dredging and road construction brand in West Africa, and portrays Halimat as a symbol of courage, beauty, humility, and humanitarian work for younger women.

Amazon.com, Inc.’s Q2 2021 Form 10-Q reported net sales of $113.1 billion and net income of $7.8 billion, with operating income of $7.7 billion. Cash and cash equivalents plus marketable securities were $89.9 billion at June 30, 2021, and long-term debt was $50.3 billion. The filing also disclosed the $8.5 billion MGM acquisition agreement and a €746 million Luxembourg data protection fine.

The passage describes a weather forecasting system that collects and normalizes high-frequency sensor and microwave-link data, processes it through multiple servers, and uses cadence-based tile layers to generate and update near real-time precipitation, fog, water vapor, and RVR forecasts. It emphasizes asynchronous processing, partial recalculation, and propagation of only changed data to improve speed and accuracy.
Two Oceans Restaurant at Cape Point has stopped selling West Coast Rock Lobster after SASSI red-listed the species as unsustainable, and TMNP supports the conservation initiative.

The passage describes watchdog timers, timers, analog and I/O connections, debug and bootloader interfaces, factory constants, application layout recommendations, support resources, and revision history for MSPM0G3519/MSPM0G3518/MSPM0G1519/MSPM0G1518 devices.

Linda Ronstadt discussed living with Parkinson’s disease, saying it has ended her singing career but that she remains selective about her activities and exercises daily. She described day-to-day difficulties such as brushing her teeth, talking, and traveling, and noted her upcoming “A Conversation With Linda” events in California. The passage also recalls her 2013 diagnosis, 2014 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction, and details about the success of her album Simple Dreams.

The passage describes blockchain-based digital certificate management methods and systems in which a blockchain performs consensus verification on certificates, revocation lists, or revocation records before they are written to the chain. The blockchain then accepts or rejects CA requests based on the consensus result, and nodes can use local ledgers containing revocation lists to verify transaction permissions without remotely querying the CA.

Kyle Busch won the Overton’s 400 after improving his car through multiple pit-stop adjustments, taking the lead on lap 210 and holding off Kyle Larson on the final lap. He finished with his fifth win of the season, 48th career Cup victory, and second win at Chicago.

The study validated the 17-item C19-YRSm in 1,314 Long Covid patients and found it to be valid, reliable, responsive, and easy to administer. It showed good convergent and known-groups validity, moderate-to-strong stability over time, and reasonable two-factor structure, with initial minimally important difference estimates for use in clinical and research settings.

Trump said the New York explosion showed Congress must reform immigration, end chain migration, and increase security. Police said Akayed Ullah, a Bangladeshi-born permanent resident, detonated the crude device. Trump also called for more ICE officers, stronger detention powers, and tougher action against fraud and abuse.

The transformer design selects a 2.5 turns ratio and 40 μH primary inductance, with 6% magnetizing current initially targeted; the main FETs are rated at 170 V, the synchronous rectifier FETs at 80 V, the output inductor is 0.47 μH, output capacitance is at least 1.3 mF with about 2.3 mF used, RCS is 7.5 Ω, the hiccup capacitor is 3.3 nF, compensation values are 40.2 kΩ, 15 nF, and 47 pF, and the slope compensation resistor is 102 kΩ. Layout guidelines emphasize minimizing noise coupling, keeping power loops short, separating grounds, and placing bypass, compensation, and sensing components close to the controller.

The Department of Transport says some commercial State companies считают official salary rates for top executives too low, with discontent over the ban on performance-related bonuses and threats of legal action; one case has gone to the High Court. It notes that lower CEO salary rates and removal of benefits were introduced in 2011, and gives examples of current starting salaries for several transport companies.

Edmonton police seized $3.2 million worth of carfentanil from a basement suite after a fire call led firefighters to discover suspicious powder in a southwest Edmonton residence. Police said it was their largest seizure of the drug, found alongside suspected caffeine, with no arrests made and the building condemned.

The San Diego County Fair’s “Where the West is Fun” exhibit features Kumeyaay Nation members sharing their culture, singing in their native language every Wednesday at 12:30 p.m., and offering craft projects on Kids’ Day. The exhibit also includes maps, photos, and information about the Kumeyaay, along with displays meant to dispel myths about the Wild West.

Ruth Negga said she resented how teachers spoke to her at school and was eager for school to end. She also said her acting career involves luck, and she has received her first Oscar nomination for her role in Loving.

VentureWire People’s May 30, 2001 issue lists executive changes across multiple tech companies, including new chairmen, CEOs, presidents, CFOs, and vice presidents, along with executive search openings and a brief note on Proteus seeking its first vice president of sales and marketing.

Cancer cells transfer mitochondria to neighboring fibroblasts through nanotube-like structures, causing the fibroblasts to grow faster, activate cancer-linked genes, and support tumor growth. MIRO2 is identified as a key protein needed for this mitochondrial transfer.

The speaker says there is little carryover or added rivalry this season, and that a potential return by the other player would not change their focus. They are more concerned with their own play, believe both teams have had chances to win, and remain confident they can win at least one game on the road.

The passage is a presidential inaugural address that emphasizes a mutual covenant between the President and the people to support the Constitution, obey the laws, and uphold equal rights. It reviews the nation’s growth, calls for uniform law enforcement, civil-service reform, cautious immigration and diplomacy, support for industry, pensions, education, honest elections, and patriotism grounded in justice, mercy, and public honor.

The White Building has been under renovation since summer 2016 and is expected to be completed by the end of March, with more improvements continuing through the semester. Updates include a renovated lobby, two new registration desks, a new stairwell and elevator, and changes to the entrance and pathway to create one entrance and exit. The renovations aim to improve traffic flow, safety, policy compliance, and usage tracking, while the fitness center is not scheduled for renovation anytime soon.

The visceral pain market is projected to reach USD 14.22 billion by 2024, led by rising geriatric population, increasing prevalence and awareness, with North America dominant in 2016 and Asia Pacific the fastest-growing region. Analgesics led therapeutics, Crohn’s disease was the largest indication, and key players include Pfizer, Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, Takeda, Allergan, and AstraZeneca.

The passage says upcoming superannuation tax changes will begin in July and are expected to increase self-managed super funds. It lists several planned changes, including caps on transfers and contributions, changes to spouse offsets, and other tax rule adjustments. It also says more Australians, including younger people and women, are setting up SMSFs, while the total number of SMSFs is declining.

The passage argues that regulated financial institutions are a rich source of AI training data and that AI use in finance has grown rapidly, but incidents are underreported and existing public databases miss many financial AI events. It proposes a regulator-reported global AI incident database, modeled on finance reporting and lessons from aviation and healthcare, with confidentiality protections such as omitted timestamps and percentage-based metrics. The paper presents synthetic data and use cases for systemic risk monitoring and market manipulation detection.

The Ministry of Finance amended Rule 80 on advances to the families of government servants who die in service, retaining the existing provisions and setting the maximum advance at Rs. 25,000. The order takes effect immediately and does not reopen cases already sanctioned.

The speakers discuss injuries, the grind of a long hockey season, and staying confident despite outside noise. They say the team remains competitive, wants to avoid back-to-back bad games, and views the next game as a must-win, with a focus on rebounding and giving full effort.

Version 2 adds SEV-ES enhancements, initial SEV-SNP support, and hypervisor feature advertisement, along with changes such as XSS MSR reporting, GHCB shared-area requirements, restricted APIC emulation, and new support for APIC ID lists, multi-VMPL, page state change, GHCB GPA registration, SEV-TIO, Secure AVIC, and SNP guest requests.
