Sweden’s unemployment rate was 7.3 percent in July 2017, unchanged from a year earlier, but unemployment remained much higher among people born abroad than among those born in Sweden. A record 76,561 foreigners were registered in Arbetsförmedlingen’s Introduction Programme, and long-term unemployment rose slightly. The agency also said it needs more government funding for 2018 and 2019.

Derivatives trading involves buying and selling contracts whose value depends on an underlying asset. Common derivatives include futures, options, forwards, swaps, and CFDs. Options give the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell at a strike price before expiration. Trading can be used for hedging or speculation, but it is risky and should be done with a backtested plan and a clear understanding of the market.

The study compares pretrained LLMs and small proprietary Transformer models for financial transaction understanding, aiming to map messy POS transaction text to merchant IDs. It finds that proprietary models can match or exceed LLM performance with fewer parameters, faster inference, and lower cost, and deploys a proprietary Decoder-Only model to process previously unmanaged transactions, increasing coverage from 80% to 94% and saving about $13.2 million annually.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated July 21, 2015, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2015, and furnished the press release as Exhibit 99.1.

IHE editors discuss White House and congressional developments affecting higher education, including funding cuts for minority-serving institutions, new restrictions on international students, student borrowing rulemaking, and the “Compact for Academic Excellence,” while also previewing the federal policy agenda.

David Moyes named his Sunderland team to face Liverpool amid injuries and suspensions, with Donald Love, John O’Shea, Papy Djilobodji, and Jack Rodwell included. Sunderland’s bench featured several unfamiliar young players, and the squad has limited Premier League experience.

GOG’s 2017 Piñata Madness event sold $3 piñatas that gave a random game worth $6–$45, with games generated at purchase and piñatas opening automatically by August 28. The pool included titles like Heroes of Might and Magic V, Pillars of Eternity, and Shadow Warrior 2, and if all games were already owned, a copy to give away was provided.

The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate for the third time in six months and said it would begin gradually reducing its bond holdings later this year. It cited solid employment and a durable economy, while noting low inflation, possible slower rate increases, and uncertainty over future Fed board appointments.

The passage describes chess as an ancient strategy game from India that is associated with intelligence, planning, concentration, and problem-solving. It argues that chess can benefit education by improving cognitive, mathematical, reading, social, and personal skills, while also noting that some studies question whether these effects come from chess itself or from related factors such as instruction and motivation.

The Horns offense uses two high post screeners to create dribble-penetration options to either side, open outside shots, and help against pressure defenses. It relies on coordinated execution, includes multiple reads and counters against common defenses, and has several variations such as Loop, Base Split, Picket Fence, Twin Sides, High Post Rub, and Hand Back Lob.

A California law allows police or family members to seek temporary gun violence restraining orders; in 2016-17, 190 were issued, mostly by law enforcement, and only 17 were extended to one year. The law’s author, Nancy Skinner, said it may have prevented deaths and that family members can be important in identifying threats.

Taco Cabana is offering a limited-time “Random Acts of Tacos” promotion with Favor today from 9–11 a.m., letting Dallas-area users in Favor’s delivery zone request two free breakfast tacos through the app on a first-come, first-served basis. If they miss it, Friday in-store customers can get a limited coupon for a breakfast taco on a future visit.

AMD’s Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) provides non-persistent runtime firmware updates without BIOS reflashes or system resets, aiming to improve stability and reduce maintenance downtime. It applies only to selected AMD firmware components, uses cryptographically signed update packages with optional customer co-signing, and requires updates to be reapplied after reboot.

Pharmaceutical dosage form testing systems assess tablet quality, stability, and drug properties through tests such as weight variation, hardness, friability, disintegration, and dissolution. The market is expected to grow due to regulations, advanced technology, and demand for quality products, but high costs and a lack of skilled personnel may restrain growth. North America is expected to lead, while APECJ and China are emerging markets; major players include SOTAX AG, ABC Laboratories, Almac, Dalton Pharma Services, GEA Process Engineering, Micromeritics Instrument Corporation, Quality Chemical Laboratories, and SCYNEXIS, Inc.

FMI reports the global surface protection films market is projected to grow at a 5.7% CAGR from US$1,196.2 Mn in 2017 to US$2,081.6 Mn by 2027. The 50–100 microns thickness segment, PE base material, and construction & interior end use are expected to lead, while Western Europe holds the largest regional share in 2017.

The message asks Senate approval for U.S. representation at the Panama Congress of American nations, noting the invitation from Colombia, Mexico, and Central America. It says the U.S. would not join belligerent deliberations or hostile alliances, but would promote liberal trade, maritime neutrality, opposition to future European colonies, and religious liberty, while showing respect and friendship to the southern republics. It nominates Richard C. Anderson and John Sergeant as envoys, and William B. Rochester as secretary.

Hollywood Bowl Group’s full-year results were well received, with shares up almost 8% after revenue rose nearly 9%, like-for-like sales grew 3.5%, net cash from operations increased over 16%, and adjusted underlying earnings after tax rose 30%. The company also announced a first-time full-year dividend and a special dividend, while the passage contrasts this stable, cash-generative business with UK Oil & Gas Investments’ higher-risk exploration outlook and volatile share price.

The passage describes Blackwell GPU power-saving features, DLSS 4 Multi Frame Generation, transformer-based image quality improvements, and new neural shader technologies such as RTX Neural Materials, Neural Texture Compression, Neural Radiance Cache, RTX Skin, and RTX Neural Faces. It also lists Blackwell GPU families GB202, GB203, and GB205 with their specifications and associated GeForce RTX 50 series products.

The passage introduces the Voice Reasoning Gap (VRG), a consistent drop in reasoning performance for voice systems compared with text models, especially on multi-step tasks. It presents VERA, a benchmark for evaluating real-time voice reasoning, and reports that voice models perform much worse than text models, with distinct failure patterns across architectures.

Reuters reported that Rohingya insurgents from ARSA attacked Myanmar police posts in August 2017 using mostly homemade and improvised weapons, with many fighters saying they had little training and were recruited through village meetings and WhatsApp. The fighting was followed by a Myanmar counteroffensive that sent more than half a million Rohingya into Bangladesh, where views of the insurgency were mixed but some fighters and refugees said they still supported continuing the struggle.

Seattle rallied from an early 11-point deficit to beat San Francisco 25-23, with Russell Wilson throwing for 258 yards and a touchdown before being pulled in the fourth quarter. The Seahawks finished 10-5-1, earned the NFC West title and the third seed, and will host Detroit next week, while the 49ers fell to 2-14 and fired coach Chip Kelly and general manager Trent Baalke after the game.
Enron ousted CFO Andrew Fastow and named Jeffrey McMahon as his replacement after SEC scrutiny of Fastow-related partnership transactions and a sharp fall in Enron’s stock.

Ronny Jackson’s confirmation hearing for Veterans Affairs secretary was put on hold amid allegations of misconduct, including a hostile work environment and improper dispensing of medication, with additional unproven claims of being drunk on duty. Trump said he would stand behind Jackson, who said he wanted to reschedule the hearing, and the White House said he would not withdraw his nomination.

Delta College president Gavin will resign in January to lead a national coalition defending equity in higher education. He informed the board last week, and trustees will begin selecting a successor in the coming weeks.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Ampere GA102 and GA10x GPU architecture, highlighting improved performance, efficiency, and features over Turing. It covers GA102’s use in products like the GeForce RTX 3090, RTX 3080, RTX A6000, and A40, along with FP32, RT, and Tensor Core gains, GDDR6X memory, NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, ray tracing, AI, RTX IO, video decode/encode support, and data center capabilities.

The passage describes President Trump’s visit to the opening of the Mississippi Civil Rights Museum, the controversy over his attendance, and Mayor Chokwe Antar Lumumba’s criticism of Trump and support for Jackson’s people’s assemblies and Black self-determination.

The Southern Poverty Law Center released a campus guide to help students counter alt-right and white nationalist speakers by avoiding direct confrontation, denying them a spectacle, and using peaceful protest and outreach. The guide, sent to over 2,000 schools, explains the movement and offers tactics such as speaking to classmates, making videos or pamphlets, and enlisting faculty and leadership.

The TLV32xx input range is 200 mV below V− to 200 mV above V+, with no phase inversion within that range; unused inputs should not be tied together. The family has 1.8 mV internal hysteresis, push-pull or open-drain outputs, ESD protection to the supply rails, and a power-on reset that holds the output low for up to 32 µs after VPOR is crossed.

A distraught father, Randall Margraves, tried to attack Larry Nassar in a Michigan courtroom after being denied time alone with him, then apologized and said he had lost control. The incident occurred during Nassar’s sentencing hearing, where survivors and their families described abuse and the judge said violence was not acceptable.

The Supreme Court heard arguments in Michael Bowe’s challenge to his firearm conviction and whether it can review the denial of his request to file a successive Section 2255 motion. The dispute centers on whether Section 2244(b)(3)(E) bars Supreme Court jurisdiction and whether Section 2244(b)(1), which refers to Section 2254, applies to federal inmates.

The passage explains memory hierarchy data structures, focusing on the external memory model and the cache-oblivious model. It describes block transfers with block size B and cache size M, giving results for scanning, B-tree search, sorting, permuting, and buffer trees. It then introduces cache-oblivious B-trees, showing a static van Emde Boas layout with O(log_B N) searches, followed by dynamic updates using ordered file maintenance and indirection.

Python is an open-source, high-level programming language used for algorithmic trading, data analysis, backtesting, and executing trading strategies. The passage says it is popular for its readability, library support, and ease of use, and lists common backtesting frameworks such as PyAlgoTrade, Bt, Backtrader, Fastquant, Zipline, and LEAN/QuantConnect. Backtesting uses historical price data to evaluate a strategy, but it does not guarantee future performance and does not usually include trading fees.

The speaker said the team was pleased with its series start after a close win and that the next game is crucial. He described a player as upbeat, intense, physically strong, and a natural scorer who would fit the team. He said the team has benefited from scoring by many different players, staying composed under pressure, and gaining playoff experience. He also said the team must start well, avoid carelessness, and improve penalty killing against Philadelphia.

The Kentucky Supreme Court held that, in subsequent injury workers’ compensation cases, the correct test is the degree of occupational disability immediately before the later injury, not whether the employee was working. It affirmed the Board’s apportionment, reversed the Court of Appeals, and held the employee’s preexisting 55% disability was not compensable by the Special Fund.

Electronic Arts will go private in a $55 billion all-cash deal backed by Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners, with Andrew Wilson staying on as CEO. The move removes Wall Street pressure on Wilson, but analysts say he may still face demands from the company’s new owners.

Colorado Boy Scout Troop 1532 is made up almost entirely of refugee youth from places including Burma, Rwanda and Nepal, and was formed in 2014 to help them adjust to American culture while providing a safe refuge. The troop faces challenges such as transportation, working parents, and maintaining membership, but leaders say it also teaches skills, discipline and belonging.

The SNB and ECB are assessing a link between their instant payment systems through 2026 to enable faster cross-border transfers and improve interoperability, while addressing technical, legal, liquidity, cybersecurity, and regulatory challenges.

This message is a Commissioner.COM Fantasy Football E-Report containing promotional offers, team rosters and injuries for Luccis Losers, and extensive NFL player news and fantasy start/sit updates for Week 10 of the 2001 season.

The speaker says the team is confident, well-led, and capable of playing better in the next games in Boston. He emphasizes the need for stronger execution, more offense, and adjustments against Boston’s goaltender, while expressing respect for the Bruins and trust in the team’s top players and power play.

The passage says ChatGPT can help traders analyze market data, brainstorm ideas, and generate Python backtests, but it is not a trading platform and does not provide financial advice. It describes backtesting a Bollinger Band mean reversion strategy on SPY since inception, with a reported CAGR of 3.20%, 326 trades, and 45.63% time in the market.

Leeds United lost 1-0 at home to Wolves after a poor first half, dropping out of the play-off places to seventh. Wolves scored through Nouha Dicko in the 39th minute, and Leeds failed to equalise despite improving after the break.

The speaker says the team needs to focus on rebounds and shooting more against the opponent, then move on and prepare to win in St. Louis. They believe the team played well despite not getting the bounces, should put the past game behind them, and maintain confidence in their chemistry despite line changes.

The passage lists financial and business headlines, including warnings about an AI bubble, record-high valuations, gold rising above $4,000 on Fed easing expectations, Google’s Gemini Enterprise launch, and several corporate, infrastructure, and regulatory developments.

The Supreme Court will hear Michael Bowe’s habeas challenge to his 24-year sentence for a 2008 armored-car robbery attempt in which he shot two people. Bowe argues that later rulings mean neither of his robbery convictions qualifies as a crime of violence for his Section 924(c) firearm conviction, and he is also challenging limits on successive habeas petitions and a lower court ruling that barred his claim.

Shedeur Sanders said he is thankful for whatever role he has with the Browns and feels he is in a “great mental space” as Kevin Stefanski considers the team’s backup quarterback. Sanders has been the inactive emergency quarterback for five games, says he is prepared to play, and Browns offensive coordinator Tommy Rees said Sanders has shown improvement in preparation and understanding of the offense.

The Four Corner offense is a spread offense associated with Coach Dean Smith and North Carolina that uses players in each corner to create isolation and reduce turnovers and opponent possessions. Its basic continuity features O1 attacking one-on-one, with kick-out and return-pass options, baseline cuts, and left-side variations including exchanges and dribble penetration when return passes are denied.

The passage describes a near-eye waveguide display for VR, AR, or MR that uses a light source such as MicroLEDs, an optics system, and one or more waveguides to deliver scanned image light to a user’s eyes. It explains embodiments with a source waveguide and output waveguide, controller-driven scanning, coupling and decoupling elements such as diffraction gratings, and various 1D, 2D sparse, curved, and stacked source array layouts with optical isolators to reduce interference.

Air Canada apologized and offered compensation after a Canadian family’s 10-year-old son was bumped from an oversold flight, leaving them to reroute and experience further travel disruptions. The family’s case gained attention amid backlash over United Airlines’ high-profile overbooking incident.

The passage praises U.S. work in the Philippine Islands and urges stronger military preparedness, including better training, maneuvers, a general staff, militia reform, and improved Navy gunnery, shipbuilding, and manning. It argues that a first-class navy is necessary to support U.S. foreign policy and the Monroe Doctrine.

The passage explains how youth soccer coaches should evaluate players’ abilities and temperaments before assigning positions, choose a formation, and avoid typecasting by exposing players to all positions. It also emphasizes functional training, equal playing time, and player development, noting that less-skilled players may be placed in less demanding roles and that late bloomers may emerge later.

Rush Bowls, a Colorado chain that opened in St. Louis’s Central West End, serves smoothie-like fruit bowls, smoothies, and toppings such as acai, granola, peanut butter, and jelly. The shop is loud, offers counter service, and is aimed at post-workout customers.

EUR/USD fell on Tuesday as weaker-than-expected Eurozone data and a more hawkish-than-expected Janet Yellen testimony boosted the dollar. The pair moved closer to 1.0500, with further downside targets near 1.0350 if the decline continues.

The passage examines digital transformation in Ethiopian higher education, describing supportive national and institutional policies and initiatives such as EthERNet, NADRE, and NADLE, but also major barriers including poor internet and ICT infrastructure, lack of skilled human resources, and resistance to change. It concludes that policies alone are insufficient and that effective digitalization requires reliable internet, stronger infrastructure, capacity building, and better leadership and governance.

WTI crude futures fell 46 cents to $52.72 a barrel after recent weekly gains, as traders focused on rising US shale output and a higher US rig count. US production reached 9.24 million bpd, offsetting support from stronger China data and hopes for an extension of Opec and non-Opec output cuts.

The passage lists multiple Bergdorf Goodman-related stories, including Dita Von Teese unveiling her fragrance Scandalwood, a scalp-focused salon, holiday windows, Neiman Marcus sales gains, lender concerns, Linda Fargo, and other fashion and retail items.

WisdomTree Investments (NASDAQ:WETF) rose 2.43%, with analysts projecting a 12-month target of $10.75 based on 9 opinions versus a latest close of $9.68. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 2.55 from 11 recommendations, with ratings including 3 Buy, 2 Outperform, 5 Hold, 2 Underperform, and 1 Sell. Its ATR-14 is 0.34, weekly volatility is 3.42%, monthly volatility is 3.62%, RSI is 57.35, market capitalization is $1.36 billion, and shares traded recently were 2.16 million versus an average of 1.6 million.

A jury is considering whether Tomas Gajowniczek, who denies attempting to murder Alicja Kalinowska, should be found not guilty by reason of insanity. The prosecution says he was intoxicated on cannabis and intended to kill her, while the defence says he suffered from a mental disorder and was unable to control his actions.

MCW Pro Wrestling “Spring Fever” is scheduled for April 22 at MCW Arena in Joppa, MD, featuring Rey Mysterio, a meet and greet at 4 pm, and live action at 7:30 pm. The card includes title and contender matches for the vacant tag titles, the MCW championship, and the Rage TV championship, along with several other singles and tag bouts.

The passage recounts 19th-century British, French, and U.S. involvement in Hawaii, including threats, temporary occupations, and cession proposals, while noting that annexation efforts failed and reciprocity remained under consideration. It also states that U.S. sugar interests obstructed a favorable reciprocity treaty, and quotes Secretary Fish in 1873 turning from reciprocity to annexation.
High short interest generally predicts worse future stock returns, while low short interest tends to outperform. Short squeezes can create large gains, but they are rare and hard to predict.

The passage argues that standard MARL is limited by single scalar rewards and introduces a framework for multi-objective multi-agent learning. It defines Multi-Objective Markov Games and Pareto-Nash Equilibrium, proves PNE exists in finite MOMGs, links PNEs to Nash equilibria of linearly scalarized games, and develops online learning methods for weaker solution concepts such as WPNE and PCE.

The speaker says playoffs and winning the Stanley Cup are the goal, notes a tough win over Ottawa, and describes being disappointed to be out of the lineup but accepting the coach’s decision as best for the team. They focus on playing solid defense, staying concentrated in practice and games, and say the upcoming opponent is a disciplined, smart, hard-working team. They add that reaching the Stanley Cup has made things less frustrating and that everyone on the team has played well so far.

The team said the ice made passing difficult, but they stayed aggressive and needed their best hockey to beat a very strong opponent. They noted they did not adapt well to the opponent’s aggressive style, which differed from Colorado’s counterattack approach.

Indian shares rose, ending a five-day losing streak, as weak U.S. inflation data and a recovery in global markets improved sentiment. The NSE and BSE indexes gained about 0.8 percent, led by banks and HDFC shares, while DLF surged on talks over its rental unit arm. Sun Pharma and BPCL fell after disappointing quarterly results.

The passage argues that despite concerns about Cleveland’s late-season decline, poor defense, and LeBron James’ heavy workload, the Cavaliers should not be counted out because LeBron has repeatedly carried teams to the Finals. It suggests any true challenge to Cleveland would likely come in June, possibly against the Warriors.

Tesla’s stock has risen sharply, and the company is growing sales, cash, and revenue, with strong Model 3 demand and future expansion plans. However, its valuation is high versus automakers like Ford, GM, and BMW, it remains unprofitable, carries significant debt, and is considered a risky but cautiously promising investment.

German CPI rose 2.2% year over year in May, above expectations, driven mainly by energy prices. Food prices rose 3.5%, energy 5.2%, and services 1.9%, while core inflation likely stayed subdued. The article says inflation is at its highest since February 2017 and notes political uncertainty in Italy may influence the ECB and the extension of asset purchases until year-end.

The speaker expresses gratitude and humility upon assuming the presidency, pledging to follow the Constitution strictly, limit federal power, protect states’ rights, preserve the Union, maintain just laws, enforce economy and revenue for support rather than protection, support Texas annexation and Oregon claims, conduct foreign policy cautiously, and serve all the people impartially.

Star Bulk Carriers is heavily exposed to the Capesize dry bulk segment, which recently weakened but then rebounded sharply. The report says its acquisition of 16 vessels was accretive, increased fleet size and cargo capacity, reduced average fleet age, and supports a fair value target of $15 per share, about 24% upside.

The lecture defines batch arguments (BARGs) as succinct proof systems for proving that many NP statements are true at once, with completeness and soundness, and explains why they matter for building SNARGs. It sketches a construction starting from a Kilian-style protocol with PCPs, then replaces interaction using correlation-intractable hashes and a special statistically binding hash from FHE, whose extraction property lets the soundness proof focus on a single false statement in the batch.

The S&P 500 and Dow were flat in early trading after an explosion at New York’s Port Authority, with one suspect in custody. Tech stocks led gains, financials lagged, and cryptocurrency-related stocks rose sharply. Investors were focused on expected Federal Reserve rate hikes and several stocks, including Bluebird Bio and Celgene, rose on drug trial results.

Carbon-related spin defects in hBN were created by 13C ion implantation and thermal annealing, revealing isolated single-defect emitters. The defect is treated as a strongly coupled electron–13C nuclear spin two-qubit system with selective MW and RF control, extended electron coherence via CPMG to 38 ± 10 µs, and demonstrated preparation of all four Bell states.

The passage mainly lists health care headlines, including a Cigna reimbursement policy, a court ruling affecting Medicare Advantage audits, a whistleblower suit involving UnitedHealth, Trump’s proposed tariffs on prescription drugs, and other health and biotech stories.

Momo Inc. rose more than 15% after strong Q1 earnings and upbeat Q2 revenue guidance, and its stock was up nearly 85% in 2018. The passage argues the uptrend remains constructive and recommends a modified fence options strategy, specifically buying the July $45/$50 call spread and selling the July $40/$35 put spread, to limit risk while positioning for further gains.

The Santa Barbara Public Library System is offering free Spelling and Word Basics workshops starting in July, with daytime classes on Tuesdays for seventh grade and up and evening classes on Wednesdays for adults only. The sessions run through the end of August at the Townley Room, and preregistration is encouraged but walk-ins are welcome.

Quinstreet Inc. shares rose 38.91% in the latest session. Analysts have a 52-week average target of $9.88 based on 3 opinions, with targets ranging from $8.5 to $12.5, versus a latest closing price of $12.96. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 1 from 2 recommendations, ATR-14 of 0.67, weekly volatility of 9.10%, monthly volatility of 6.30%, RSI of 83.22, market capitalization of $575.55 million, and 44.41 million outstanding shares.

AAPL is Apple Inc.’s stock ticker on Nasdaq. It began trading on December 12, 1980, typically trades from 9:30 am to 4:00 pm ET, has an all-time high of $233.47, pays an annual dividend of $0.82 per share, and has an average five-year return of about 16.1%.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated July 2, 2022, stating that it published a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. The report covers Items 2.02 and 7.01 and lists the exhibit and signature by Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn dated July 5, 2022.

The passage describes a “Stay Rich Portfolio” for wealth preservation after achieving FIRE, arguing that preserving wealth requires different methods than building it. It compares asset classes using long-term return versus max drawdown, concludes that U.S. and foreign stocks have the best reward/risk ratios, and notes that T-bills rank worst. It then proposes a moderately conservative, globally diversified ETF portfolio including foreign stocks, TIPS, and corporate bonds to reduce drawdowns and protect against inflation, followed by backtesting and performance statistics.

The passage argues that revolutionary Communist regimes produce massive numbers of refugees and cites Vietnam, Cuba, and several African countries as examples. It says violent Marxist insurgencies are unlikely to lead to democracy, that history suggests gradual liberalization is more likely in some traditional autocracies than in radical totalitarian regimes, and that U.S. policy should favor realistic, gradual reform while treating leaders who denounce the United States as enemies rather than democrats.

Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels will start Sunday against the Chargers after missing two games with a sprained left knee. He practiced all week, will wear a black brace, and said it does not restrict his movement.

The lecture reviews covariant and Lie derivatives, Killing vectors, and tensor densities, showing how the metric determinant converts tensor densities into tensors and simplifies calculations such as volume elements and certain Christoffel symbols. It then derives the geodesic equation for a freely falling test body, explains affine parametrization and proper time, and notes that geodesics can also be obtained by extremizing proper time.

After being sacked as White House communications director, Anthony Scaramucci said some elements inside Washington, including the White House, were trying to undermine President Trump. He also criticized the political establishment for not supporting Trump and said he believed his consequences followed a recorded phone call he thought was off the record.

The passage highlights several health news items: NIH is funding autism research focused on environmental factors, the agency is also pushing non-animal research methods, FDA approval of a generic mifepristone drew criticism, the Trump administration delayed a drug price negotiation policy, and an op-ed argues the administration’s autism rhetoric echoes eugenic thinking.

Larry Connors’ Double Seven is a simple mean-reversion strategy from *Short Term Trading Strategies That Work* that buys when the close is at a seven-day low and the price is above the 200-day moving average, then sells when the close reaches a seven-day high, with no stop loss. Backtests showed it still works on major stock indices, especially SPY, but other Connors strategies perform better; a combined ETF portfolio had modest results, SPY and QQQ together did not work well, and the short version performed badly.

The passage describes SD memory card data transfer, erase, protection, and command behavior. It explains card selection with CMD7, read/write and erase command sequences, busy signaling on DAT0, timeout limits, CMD42 lock/unlock and Card Ownership Protection, ACMD6 bus-width changes, APP_CMD handling, and CMD6 switch-function and power-limit settings.

A client seeks a Dutch-speaking Mechanical Engineer for a 12-month mission in Genk, starting in 1–4 weeks. Required experience includes modelling with Matlab, Modelica or Demola, a thermal background, and mechanical experience; chemical processing is a secondary preferred background.

Biogetica and Research Needs have partnered for upcoming clinical trials and research projects focused on evidence-based natural medicine. Planned 2018 studies include HPV, herpes, trigeminal neuralgia, vertigo, tinnitus, and cataract, with the goal of validating multidisciplinary plant-based and nutraceutical protocols.

The BIG Initiative analyzed 13,152 genomes from a diverse Tennessee cohort and found substantial ancestry diversity, including many non-European and admixed individuals. It reported ancestry-specific novel variants, higher obesity and asthma odds in minority groups, and mismatches between self-reported race and genetic ancestry, supporting BIG as a model for inclusive genomics.

SpaceX’s Falcon Heavy was set for a target launch on Tuesday, February 6 at 1:30 p.m. ET, with a backup date of February 7. The company planned to attempt landing all three first stages, while CEO Elon Musk was reportedly managing expectations, aware the rocket might not reach orbit.

This systematic review examines empirical studies of LLMs in education, focusing on applications, evaluation methods, risks, and mitigation strategies. It identifies three application areas—operational effectiveness, personalized applications, and interactive learning tools—and reports risks across technical, pedagogical, and societal domains, including superficial understanding, bias, hallucinations, privacy violations, over-reliance, memory erosion, and inequity.

CTA trading advisors and funds use quantitative, often systematic, derivative-based strategies such as trend following and momentum to trade futures, options, swaps, currencies, commodities, stocks, and other markets. They emphasize risk management and, more than raw profit, low correlation among strategies to produce steadier risk-adjusted returns.

The passage argues that Andropov may have personal, military, economic, and political incentives to pursue an arms control agreement, especially on INF, and recommends opening a private channel with a short, serious letter expressing interest in reducing nuclear arms while avoiding a full proposal at first.

The paper proposes a Fourier Neural Operator-based meta-learning approach to approximate the inverse Hessian in 4D-Var data assimilation. On a linear advection test problem, the FNO-CG method uses the FNO as an initializer for conjugate gradient, reducing average relative error by 62% and iteration count by 17% compared with standard CG, with the largest gains in ill-conditioned cases.

The passage compiles multiple October 25, 2001 reports on Enron, noting a negative S&P outlook, Fitch and Moody’s credit concerns, stock declines, and little change in trading partners’ dealings. It also describes Enron’s losses, questions over partnerships tied to Andrew Fastow, Kenneth Lay’s resignation from i2’s board, and media coverage debating whether the company could restore credibility.

The passage urges soccer coaches to use contingency planning by asking “what if” questions, documenting responses, and sharing plans with coaches, players, and parents. It covers communication, practices, pre-game, in-game, post-game, and extended absence scenarios, emphasizing checklists, delegation, preparation, and back-up support.

Darren McGregor said Hibs’ 3-2 comeback win over Rangers at Ibrox was “character-building” after they fell behind early in a very intense atmosphere. He praised the team’s heart, credited Ryan Jack’s red card as a turning point, and singled out Simon Murray for his strong form, noting his ten goals in seven competitive matches.

Professors and support staff at Nova Scotia Community College approved new six-year collective agreements after a vote on management’s final offer. Faculty voted 55% in favor and professional support staff 64% in favor. The agreements run from Sept. 1, 2014 to Aug. 31, 2020 and include a 7% wage increase, with service award options under the agreements.

VentureWire’s September 14, 2000 issue highlighted Inktomi’s planned $1.3 billion acquisition of FastForward, Bertelsmann’s launch of a $1 billion venture fund, Algorithmics’ $60 million round and Sentry acquisition, Artisan Entertainment’s $50 million venture unit, and Privista’s $17 million first round. It also listed numerous financing, product, M&A, management, and VC fund announcements across Internet, software, telecom, healthcare, and other sectors.

The ADS9803 supports 2- and 4-lane SDR/DDR source-synchronous data interfaces, outputs 20-bit results in 24-bit packets, and includes data randomization, data averaging, test patterns, speed-boost mode, SPI register access, and daisy-chain SPI configuration. It also describes reset, power-down, initialization, register banks, and key register settings for interface, averaging, test patterns, and channel configuration.

Low volatility investing focuses on stocks with relatively stable prices, low beta, and less fluctuation than the overall market, often aiming for steadier returns and lower risk. The passage says these stocks can be found in sectors like utilities, consumer staples, and healthcare, and portfolios can be built or implemented through ETFs, mutual funds, historical data analysis, diversification, and periodic rebalancing. It also states that low volatility stocks have often outperformed high volatility stocks over the long run, but they can underperform for long periods and carry risks.

Several speakers praise a retiring Swedish hockey player as an iconic, highly professional role model who is respected by young players in Sweden and has had a remarkable two-decade career. He is described as having won four Stanley Cups and seven Norris Trophies, being a mainstay and backbone of his team, and being one of the best Swedish players ever.

A TeamLease survey found that Delhi has the highest job loss risk among nine Tier I cities, followed by Bengaluru and Hyderabad, while Pune has the lowest. Industrial manufacturing and allied sectors face the highest risk, while healthcare and telecom are the lowest-risk sectors.

A Thame headteacher, David Wybron of Lord Williams’s School, is urging the Government to reform GCSEs, ease teacher visa rules, and address school funding shortfalls. He argues that state school students face greater exam pressure than independent school peers, that recruitment is suffering amid immigration controls, and that current funding arrangements leave his school significantly underfunded.

The Triple RSI trading strategy is a modified RSI-based mean reversion strategy using four key variables, including RSI readings and the 200-day moving average. A backtest on SPY since 1993 showed 83 trades, an average gain of 1.4% per trade, a 90% win rate, and a profit factor of 5. It can also be used to complement a long-term buy-and-hold portfolio with cautious leverage.

Naughty Dog highlighted Uncharted: The Lost Legacy at Sony’s E3 2017 conference, with Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross featured in an adventure through ancient structures. The team began working on the project weeks after Uncharted 4: A Thief’s End was completed.

The passage is an AMD Geode CS5535 specification update listing multiple silicon revision A3 issues and workarounds, including LPC transaction aborts, SMB controller NEGACK behavior, GPIO register write problems after suspend, missing LOWBAT_FLAG, and Sleep_X not deasserting when delays exceed PM_SED.

Defensive tackles line up inside the defensive line and are important for stopping the run, taking on double teams, and pressuring the quarterback. They are typically strong, tough, compact players who can also be called nose tackles or nose guards, and their work helps free up other defenders and shape the defense’s overall success.

The passage introduces PRDNet, a multimodal crystal representation framework that combines graph embeddings with learned diffraction-based pseudo-particle information. It argues that existing real-space encoders can map distinct crystal structures to the same representation and that reciprocal-space encoding can better capture long-term interactions. PRDNet is reported to be invariant to crystallographic symmetries and to achieve state-of-the-art results on Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, and MatBench.

The passage describes NVIDIA Ampere and GA10x GPU features, including DLSS for higher-performance ray-traced gaming, GDDR6X memory with over 900 GB/sec bandwidth, RTX IO for GPU-based loading and decompression, advanced display support for 4K120 and 8K60, NVDEC and NVENC video acceleration, and performance gains in the A40, RTX 3090, RTX 3070, and RTX A6000.

The passage describes SD memory card commands and status rules, especially CMD6 switch function behavior, CMD8 interface condition checking, command legality, response formats, busy status, and timeout requirements. It also explains speed class, speed grade, and video speed class specifications, including allocation units, recording units, power limits, and CMD20 support for recording control.

China’s manufacturing PMI rose to 51.9 in May, the fastest pace in eight months and above forecasts, while services and composite PMIs also edged higher. Despite the strong readings, economists warned the gains may be temporary amid trade tensions, debt tightening, funding pressures on small firms, and signs of broader economic slowing.
Intel shares rose 3% Thursday and are up over 50% in the last month, lifting the U.S. government’s stake to about $16 billion after its August 10% investment.

President Truman bids farewell as he prepares to leave office for General Eisenhower’s inauguration, praises the peaceful transfer of power, and reviews his nearly eight years as President. He recounts major events and decisions, including Roosevelt’s death, the end of World War II, the start of the Cold War, U.S. actions in Iran, Greece, Turkey, Europe, and Korea, and urges support for Eisenhower and continued defense of freedom, peace, and prosperity.

The passage proposes Truthful Text Summarization (TTS), which scores retrieved sources using leave-one-out atomic claims and peer-prediction-style agreement, then filters low-scoring sources before summarization. It argues this makes truthful reporting the best strategy, provides theoretical incentive guarantees, and reports improved factual accuracy and robustness against adversarial and uninformative sources in experiments.

Lilly Nguyen and Phil De Carlos married at Texas Children’s Hospital so their son Lucas, born at 24 weeks and now growing in the NICU, could be part of the ceremony. De Carlos proposed in Lucas’s NICU room, and the couple said they wanted him included in their special day.

A study of The Opportunity Project’s early learning centers in Wichita and Derby found that TOP students outperformed similar low-income peers through eighth grade in academics, social skills and attendance, including higher reading proficiency. The centers serve about 600 children, use scholarships and family support services, and Parent Cafe workshops helped William Eckels become more involved in his son’s education and consider returning to school.

MIT and the Carnegie Institution for Science released a public dataset of nearby stars, collected over 20 years by the W.M. Keck Observatory, to help search for exoplanets. The release includes nearly 61,000 measurements of more than 1,600 stars, open-source software, and a tutorial, and researchers have already found more than 100 potential exoplanets.

The passage describes NVIDIA Turing GPU features, including improved NVENC/NVDEC video encoding and decoding, VirtualLink USB-C support for VR headsets, NVLink-based SLI with higher bandwidth, and major graphics advances such as RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, Tensor Cores for AI features like DLSS and NGX, variable rate shading, texture space shading, multi-view rendering, and mesh shading. It also compares Turing ray tracing and encoding performance with Pascal and software approaches, and outlines TU102, TU104, and TU106 chip configurations and product examples.

The Trump administration began laying off federal workers during the 10th day of the government shutdown, with officials saying the cuts are substantial and will affect multiple agencies. Unions and Democratic leaders denounced the layoffs and said they would fight them in court, while Republicans blamed Democrats for the shutdown.

Amazon.com, Inc. reported Q2 2018 net sales of $52.9 billion and net income of $2.5 billion, compared with $38.0 billion and $197 million in Q2 2017. For the six months ended June 30, 2018, net sales were $103.9 billion and net income was $4.2 billion. Cash and cash equivalents plus restricted cash were $20.5 billion at June 30, 2018, and total assets were $134.1 billion. The company acquired Ring in April 2018, adopted new revenue and tax accounting guidance in 2018, and reported principal segments of North America, International, and AWS.

Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was born in Montreal and later moved to the Dominican Republic with his mother. His family includes Hall of Famer father Vladimir Guerrero Sr., mother Riquelma Ramos, wife Nathalie Guerrero, two daughters, brothers Pablo and Vladi Miguel, uncles Wilton and Julio, and godfather Pedro Martinez. The passage also notes several relatives with baseball connections.

Smith Tower is being converted from manually operated elevators to automatic operation after 103 years, though at least one elevator operator will remain. Unico Properties says the modernization began in June to improve safety, reliability, accessibility, and service while preserving the building’s historic appearance.

A depositor placed money in savings banks “in trust for” Catharine Heilmann, kept the pass books, and drew the interest during his life; part of the fund was later paid to her. The court held this created a valid trust, not a gift or testamentary disposition, and affirmed judgment for Heilmann.

A fake Michael Flynn Twitter account fooled House Democrats Nancy Pelosi and Elijah Cummings, who cited its tweets while criticizing Republicans over Flynn’s resignation. Both later acknowledged the mistake, and the New York Times also corrected a story that had cited the unverified account.

The 123 reversal pattern is a three-swing chart formation that signals a potential trend reversal when price fails to make a higher high in an uptrend or a lower low in a downtrend. Trading rules described include entering on a breakout of point 2, placing stop loss beyond point 3 or even point 1, and estimating profit target by measuring the pattern. The passage says a backtest on GLD was somewhat promising for the bullish version, while the bearish version performed weaker.

The passage describes cooperative monitoring networks that combine multiple monitoring systems to share alerts, sensor data, cameras, and control actions across nearby properties or users. A monitoring application server or central alarm station can activate, expand, modify, or disband these networks based on detected events, rules, user preferences, proximity, and consent, including for intrusion tracking, medical emergencies, mobile user distress, and system malfunctions.

Security researchers say Hajime is a Mirai-like IoT malware that has infected about 100,000 devices, uses a peer-to-peer network instead of command-and-control servers, and is more resilient and harder to stop. Its purpose is unknown, it has not been seen launching DDoS attacks, and it continues to spread while competing with Mirai by infecting some of the same vulnerable devices.

The passage lists multiple global financial and business headlines, then focuses on OpenAI reaching a $500 billion valuation after a secondary share sale of about $6.6 billion, with major investors participating. It notes that this reflects strong investor confidence in AI and rising competition in the sector.

The passage describes the UCLA high post rub offense, a flexible basketball system built on spacing, inside-out play, high post screens, ball reversals, and down screens. It outlines multiple defensive reads and counters, teaching methods, game strategies, and post-up options for exploiting switches, overplays, fronting, and double teams.

The passage discusses market commentary arguing that gold’s rally, weak mining stocks, a rising USD Index, and declining stocks suggest bearish conditions and resemble 2008, while also noting Trump’s planned 100% tariff on China starting November 1 and the resulting tumble in US stock indexes.

The lecture reviews payback period, profitability index, and IRR as alternatives to NPV, explaining that NPV remains the preferred capital budgeting rule because it accounts for scale and avoids the limitations of the other methods. It also notes that APV is used for adjustments such as taxes and project interactions. The lecture then introduces efficient markets and uses the Challenger stock-price reaction to illustrate rapid price discovery.

The passage discusses efforts to help Indians become self-supporting through varied work, English instruction, and support for native industries; calls for high standards and punishment for misconduct among government officials; highlights scientific aid to farmers and new crops; recommends Smithsonian and National Museum preservation work; and urges Washington, D.C. to serve as a model for sanitary, charitable, labor, and railway safety legislation.

The speaker says the team must stay consistent with the little things, including getting the puck in deep, finishing checks, and playing well in the neutral zone. They note Dallas is strong in transition, that road play has been a plus, and that after big wins the team sometimes reverts before correcting mistakes and returning to its game.

The speaker says he assumes the presidency under extraordinary circumstances and asks Americans for prayer rather than ballots. He promises to be the President of all the people, to seek peace, candor, and truth, and says the country’s “long national nightmare is over.” He calls for healing after Watergate, prays for Richard Nixon and his family, and reaffirms his pledge to uphold the Constitution and do his best for America.

The study used VDAART mother-child pairs to examine whether gut microbiome data from mothers, infants, and children predicted neurodevelopment scores (ASQ) from years one to three. The maternal gut microbiome was most relevant to year-one neurodevelopment, the predictive power declined by year two, and neither maternal nor child microbiomes predicted year-three outcomes.

A long chain of forwarded emails repeated a message titled “cancer: don’t u dare delete,” which claims a 7-year-old named Amy Bruce has severe lung cancer and a brain tumor, asks recipients to forward the message, and says the Make A Wish Foundation will donate 7 cents for every name on the list.

Troll Cakes is a New York City bakery/detective agency that makes cakes decorated with internet insults and can anonymously send them to trolls. The cakes cost $35 to make and ship, with an extra $25 to track down an address, and a Trump tweet can also be sent to the White House for $30.

The speaker describes Florida’s goalie as quick, low-playing, and active handling pucks, and says the team needs more traffic and shots to test him. Travis Zajac says the team did not get a bounce last night, believes they can play well, and says they should focus on winning tomorrow to gain confidence.

The speaker says entering the Stanley Cup Final with five minutes left was a learning process, that confidence can build after a few saves, and that he did not feel helpless. He and Jussi prepared for the situation as an opportunity, and he admitted holding the puck too long and making a mistake, while saying he can still help the team by staying prepared and working hard.

Scientists observed 14 of Centaurus A’s 16 dwarf satellites orbiting in the same plane, contrary to lambda cold dark matter expectations of random motions. The finding has prompted debate over whether current dark matter models are incomplete or whether the result is a statistical fluke, and researchers say more study of distant galaxies is needed.

The passage describes several offensive corner kick types—far post, near post, medium, top-of-the-arc, short, skip header, direct score, and floated-ball—and explains their intended target areas, services, and tactical purposes. It also states that coaches should choose corner kick plays and personnel based on player abilities, teach and practice the options progressively, and account for factors such as wind, goalkeeper strength, timing, and possible clearances or rebounds.

The study developed and validated a fluorescent immuno-lectin assay to measure lubricin glycoforms in synovial fluid and plasma. Synovial fluid lubricin was much more abundant and differently glycosylated than plasma lubricin. In plasma, OA was associated with decreased SNA-binding glycoforms, while BMI correlated positively with several glycoforms and age correlated negatively with sialylation.

A longitudinal study of 121 community-dwelling adults aged 60+ found pneumococcal carriage in 22.3% of individuals and 4.8% of samples, with some households showing both members colonized but no clear evidence of adult-adult transmission. Carriage was higher among participants with recent contact with children, especially frequent contact with young children, and acquisition risk increased with contact with children under 10 years.

Tesla Motors, Inc. and Tesla Motors Netherlands B.V. entered into a $500 million senior secured asset-based revolving credit agreement on June 10, 2015, with potential increases to $750 million, plus letter of credit and swingline subfacilities. The facility matures on June 10, 2020, is for working capital and general corporate purposes, and is secured by specified assets and guaranties; no amounts were outstanding at closing.

The passage says recent hurricanes and wildfires will make more voters accept climate change and shift votes away from Republicans toward Democrats, especially as people relocate and formerly safe seats become competitive. It argues that as warming and extreme weather continue, climate denial will be punished and Republicans will eventually be voted out unless they change.

Europe will launch Sentinel-3B to monitor oceans and other environmental conditions as part of the Copernicus satellite constellation. The satellite will provide near-real-time data on sea level, temperature, pollution, sea ice, coastal vegetation, rivers, lakes, and wildfires. Copernicus is a free EU and ESA environmental-monitoring programme, though Britain’s future role in it is uncertain after Brexit.

Workers removed a Confederate statue in Gainesville, Florida, while a Confederate memorial park in Tampa was vandalized with red paint and derogatory comments. The Florida actions came amid broader controversy over Confederate monuments following violent protests in Charlottesville, Virginia.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated April 24, 2019, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2019. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and is not deemed filed for Exchange Act purposes.

The Triangle & Two defense uses three players in a zone and two aggressive chasers who deny passes and rebounds. The passage explains that Double Stack offense can free shooters with screens, curls, fades, back cuts, post-ups, and other entries, and emphasizes execution, communication, scouting, and adapting alignments to attack the defense.

The passage describes GHCB/VMGEXIT behavior for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests, including exception handling, supported non-automatic exits, page state changes, guest requests, AP creation, #HV doorbell/timer events, and interrupt notification rules. It also outlines guest and hypervisor responsibilities for shared pages, valid bitmap fields, CPUID-based SEV-ES detection, and notes that SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

The AEGEAN study randomized 1162 subjects and found high apixaban adherence and persistence through 24 and 48 weeks, with no significant benefit from the additional educational program. Safety outcomes were similar across groups, and no clinically concerning hepatic or renal signals were identified.

A phase 2 trial found that adding abatacept to standard prevention nearly eliminated severe acute GvHD after mismatched unrelated donor stem cell transplants, reducing grade III-IV cases from 32% to 3% and improving overall and disease-free survival. The study reported intact immune reconstitution, no major uncontrolled infection, no increase in relapse, and a second cohort’s data are pending.

Geoff Cameron said Stoke City must beat Hull City to end a five-game winless run and avoid being dragged into the relegation battle. Stoke are 13th, eight points above the drop zone, while Hull are 17th and have not won an away league match since August.

Amazon.com, Inc.’s Q3 2015 10-Q reported net sales of $25.4 billion and net income of $79 million, compared with a net loss of $437 million in Q3 2014. For the nine months ended September 30, 2015, net sales were $71.3 billion and net income was $114 million. Cash and cash equivalents were $10.7 billion at September 30, 2015, and total liabilities and stockholders’ equity were $56.2 billion. The filing also described segment results for North America, International, and AWS, several legal proceedings, acquisitions, debt obligations, and recent accounting pronouncements.

The passage is a speech on Syria arguing that Assad’s chemical weapons attack killed over 1,000 people and violated international law, and that the United States should respond with a limited military strike to deter further use. It also says the president asked Congress to postpone a vote while pursuing a diplomatic effort with Russia to have Syria give up its chemical weapons.

The speaker praised military leaders and argued for restoring the Department of War name, emphasizing “peace through strength,” merit, border security, and stronger domestic and foreign military actions. He said recruitment has surged, defense spending will rise, new weapons and missile defenses are being developed, and the U.S. has helped settle multiple wars while seeking to end the Ukraine and Gaza conflicts.

A woman on Milwaukee’s east side said suspects tried to break into her home on New Year’s Eve by kicking in her front door, but her alarm scared them away. She called 911, and police said similar calls had come from her street. The door was damaged and boarded up, and she plans to change her home security.

Biogen fell after its CFO announced he is leaving for Alexion, H&R Block rose on a stronger-than-expected fourth quarter, and Southern and other high-dividend stocks gained as bond yields fell. GameStop, Citizens Financial, Synchronoss, and Anadarko declined on weak retail sales, lower yields, a revenue restatement, and falling oil prices, while Brookdale rose on reports of possible sale talks.

The passage reports that Childs Farm Baby Moisturiser, sold for £3.99, has been praised online by parents and sufferers for helping eczema and psoriasis. Several people, including Laura Gray, Paige Sweeney, and Joanne with her daughter Kelisha, said it quickly improved or cleared their skin conditions after other treatments had failed.

This study of over 8 million patients found that the 2021 CKD-EPI equation identified CKD earlier for 24% of Black patients but only 0.7% of non-Black patients, with significant discordance in CKD staging between the 2009 and 2021 equations. Black patients were much more likely to have a higher CKD stage under the 2021 equation, while the included social determinants of health were not significantly associated with increased CKD stage.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2021, announcing a press release on its second fiscal quarter results ended March 27, 2021, and attaching the press release as Exhibit 99.1.

The passage discusses the buildup to a final deciding game, with emphasis on mental toughness, focusing on the next game rather than past results, and the draining emotional nature of the series. It also describes rising frustration, penalties, and growing hatred between the teams as the series continues.

Legal experts criticized the proposed Communications (Retention of Data) Bill 2017 for omitting key Murray Report recommendations, including stronger protections for journalists’ sources and an independent oversight body. The bill would require district court judge authorization for requests and retain retrospective High Court reviews, which were also criticized as insufficient.

New clinical trials show that oral GLP-1 drugs orforglipron and another drug help people with obesity lose weight, offering more options than injected GLP-1 treatments that require refrigeration and needles.

A St. Louis woman with chronic back pain after nearly 40 years and five spinal fusion surgeries got major relief from a spinal cord stimulator implant at Washington University Pain Management Center. The device blocked pain signals, helped her stop using a walker, and gave her what she described as a “whole new lease on life.”

Rory McKelvie, 19, from Biggar, Lanarkshire, was found dead in his sleep after posting about his mental health struggles and saying he had been “fobbed off” by his doctor. He had urged others to talk to friends or family, and his family and girlfriend paid tribute after his death, which is not being treated as suspicious.

Trump faced widespread criticism for a misspelled tweet defending his writing abilities. His ghostwriter Tony Schwartz said Trump cannot read or write well and had little to do with writing The Art of the Deal. Trump also drew criticism over his treatment of the press and his decision on lowering flags after a newsroom shooting, later declaring that flags should be lowered.

Enron-related reports on November 30, 2001 covered its suspension from energy trading markets in Australia and Europe, the expected bankruptcy filing, scrutiny of its accounting and overseas assets, pressure on Dynegy after its failed takeover bid, and potential financial losses for insurers, banks, and other counterparties.

Arsene Wenger said he wants to fit Arsenal’s attacking players, including Aubameyang, Mkhitaryan, Ozil and Lacazette, into the team while also improving the defence. He called Ozil’s new contract a cheaper option than replacing him, said Arsenal must stay within what they can afford, and stated that players must compete for places, with Aubameyang’s fitness still to be assessed.

Edmonton blogger Barry Kent Winters was charged with wilfully promoting hatred, a rare Criminal Code offence, after years of complaints and a 13-month police investigation into his racist and hateful blogs. The passage describes the blogs as attacking many groups and public figures, and argues both for denunciation of the content and concern about free speech and giving him notoriety.

The Strategic National Stockpile stores medicines and supplies for bioterrorism, nuclear attacks, disease outbreaks, and other emergencies, and has expanded to include natural disasters. The Trump administration plans to shift oversight from CDC to ASPR, but officials and lawmakers are divided over whether the change will improve efficiency or disrupt distribution, politicize decisions, and weaken public health coordination.

The Missouri Court of Appeals reversed summary judgment on the Larisons’ negligence claim alleging a water district employee created a dangerous condition, but affirmed summary judgment on their claim that the district knew or should have known of the condition and on their res ipsa loquitur claim.

Clinton County’s Wilmington micropolitan was ranked 64th on Site Selection magazine’s Top 100 Micropolitans list. Clinton County submitted four projects totaling $70 million in investment, 150 new jobs, and 400 retained jobs, and Ohio led all states with 16 micropolitans on the list.

This study analyzed Australian vaccine safety reports and general practice data from January 2021 to March 2023 and found increased vertigo after mRNA vaccines, increased tinnitus after both mRNA and adenovirus vector vaccines, and no increased hearing loss after any COVID-19 vaccine.

The lecture explains how spontaneous symmetry breaking in a complex scalar field generates mass for gauge bosons and leaves one real massive scalar, while the Goldstone boson is absorbed. It then applies this to the Standard Model Higgs field, showing that the W and Z bosons gain mass from the Higgs vacuum expectation value and couplings, the photon remains massless, and the Higgs boson was discovered in 2012.

Gold held just below $1,250 an ounce on Monday after its biggest weekly fall in over six months, as markets awaited an expected U.S. Federal Reserve rate hike this week. Hedge funds and money managers also sharply cut net long positions in gold and silver, while silver, platinum and palladium were slightly lower.

BCom (Hons) third-semester students in Indore were given a Corporate Accounts paper instead of Corporate Law, delaying the exam by about 30 minutes; DAVV said the mistake was corrected and denied a leak. The university also said BCom (Hons) will continue under the annual exam system.

Education groups in China were formed to reduce disparities in basic education by linking prestigious core schools with ordinary schools, sharing resources, improving teachers’ competence, supporting student development, and easing school-choice pressure. However, they also face problems such as cultural homogenization, difficulty applying core-school methods in ordinary schools, and weak incentives for core-school management, leading to recommendations for more equal governance, stronger team building, and greater government support.

Fire departments across the state are holding October education sessions for Fire Prevention month, using the theme “Every Second counts – know two ways out.” Officials urge families to identify more than one exit, avoid blocking doors or windows, review what to do when alarms sound, stay outside after evacuating, and rehearse a home fire drill.

The passage describes GHCB negotiation and VMGEXIT handling for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests, including how guests obtain the GHCB GPA, determine the page table encryption bit, and exchange state with the hypervisor. It also outlines several NAE events such as page state change, SNP guest requests, AP creation, doorbell page setup, timers, APIC ID lists, and secure AVIC behavior, plus rules for #HV doorbell notification, interrupt acknowledgment, and EOI handling.

John Whitfield’s application for a writ of error coram nobis, claiming ineffective assistance of appellate counsel and seeking to vacate a prior affirmance, was denied because he failed to establish that he was denied effective appellate counsel.

Adidas and Refinery 29 created limited-edition UltraBOOST X shoes for all 50 states in the “Boost the Nation” series, with one pair per state designed by female artists and auctioned for charity. Georgia’s shoe, designed by Lizzie Darden, is peach-themed, and its bid was $350 at publication.

Amazon Prime Big Deal Days features discounts on nearly all Kindle models, including the Colorsoft, Kindle Scribe, Paperwhite, base Kindle, and Kids versions. The passage recommends the Paperwhite as the best all-around Kindle, the base Kindle for budget buyers, and says the Colorsoft and Scribe are worth considering on sale.

The judgment convicting Vu Ngo of three counts of first-degree robbery was unanimously affirmed. The court held that the Batson claim was unpreserved, and rejected the suppression challenge, finding no unlawful detention at the hospital and reasonable suspicion to justify continued detention for identification and questioning.

An Enron email forwarded a confidential note and attached legislative materials about California electricity proposals, including DWR credit-risk fixes, distributed generation, demand reduction, a competitive retail market, utility solvency, and an attachment that appears to be proposed legislation and CPUC talking points.

In 467 people with epilepsy and 473 controls, basal ganglia perivascular space volume fraction was higher in all epilepsy subtypes, while white matter measures did not differ after age and sex correction. Temporal lobe epilepsy with hippocampal sclerosis showed some contralateral asymmetry, but no PVS measure was associated with illness duration.

NVIDIA reported that Executive Vice President, Chief Administrative Officer and Secretary David M. Shannon will retire at the end of 2016. After his retirement, Brian E. Cabrera will lead the legal team, and NVIDIA will seek a leader for human resources.

The passage presents a Rocq-verified, correct-by-construction voter unit for synchronous N-modular redundant measurement systems in avionics control. It defines fault models, soundness and completeness requirements, permanent fault isolation, output generation, and validity/output-age rules, then synthesizes and verifies code implementing them.

Dr. Thomas Wilson Ikubese, a 2019 presidential aspirant and convener of the YesWeFit Revolution, joined the Alliance for New Nigeria (ANN) after consultations and following ANN’s adoption by the Nigerian Intervention Movement. He had recently left the National Conscience Party over alleged over-taxation, described ANN as a “Third Force,” and urged his supporters and other young aspirants to join the party.

The document describes AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which supports page migration for tiered memory systems, concurrent DMA, and SNP guest pages. It outlines command formats, ring buffer and driver initialization, status and error handling, performance guidance, firmware reload procedures, address encoding requirements, and migration rules for PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO and PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST commands.

Doctors said most eye cancer cases in the country are detected very late, and urged greater awareness of its types and symptoms for prevention and early treatment. An expert noted eye cancer can cause blindness or death, specialized treatment facilities and trained ocular oncologists are scarce, and retinoblastoma is the most common form in children under five.

The passage explains how digitalization and the internet have expanded online informal education, especially in design education, through synchronous and asynchronous workshops and courses. It compares online informal programs with formal education, highlights personalization, collaboration, and accessibility as advantages, and notes limitations such as unequal access, lack of certificates in transcripts, and exclusion from formal curricula.

The study developed and evaluated an integrated environmental education model based on multiple intelligences for extended opportunity schools in Nakhon Pathom. It found community pollution problems linked to agriculture, wastewater, air pollution, garbage, and technology-related cultural issues, while students showed lower environmental learning levels than teachers. The model met the 80/80 efficiency criterion, improved posttest achievement, and received high student satisfaction.

The Supreme Court held that re-promulgation of ordinances is a fraud on the Constitution and that the President’s and Governor’s satisfaction under Articles 123 and 213 is subject to judicial review. It ruled that ordinances must be laid before the legislature, that failure to do so is a serious constitutional infraction, and that salaries already paid to the teachers should not be recovered.

Solar energy has become the cheapest source of power worldwide, with costs low enough to undercut coal, gas and wind in some countries. Falling battery prices and new solar materials are improving reliability, but grid integration remains a major challenge, making smart grids and long-term policy support important.

The passage contains denunciations of foreign religions and “strange doctrines,” accusing their followers of falsehood, hypocrisy, and social disorder, and urging them to depart. Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated January 26, 2015, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2014, and furnished the press release as Exhibit 99.1.

The passage describes a bull market signal strategy that sells the S&P 500 after a 20% drop from its all-time high and buys after 18 consecutive closes above the 200-day SMA in a bear market. Backtested from 1927 to the present, it generated 12 signals, with a CAGR of 7.24%, standard deviation of 15.26, Sharpe ratio of 0.24, maximum drawdown of 60%, and 87.38% time in the market. It outperformed the Golden Cross in some respects, generated fewer false signals, and the S&P 500 was up 21.84% one year after the signal on average.

St. George welcomed an 11-member delegation from its sister city Ibigawa, Japan, including four runners competing in the St. George Marathon. The visitors were hosted by local families, received official recognition and an international luncheon, and will also visit several local sites before returning to Japan. St. George plans to send a delegation to Ibigawa next month for the Ibigawa Marathon.

Delhi-NCR commuters may face taxi shortages as Ola and Uber drivers threaten a one-day strike over low fares, while the Delhi High Court has restrained two taxi-driver unions from blocking services. The Sarvodaya Drivers' Association demands higher fares and removal of the 25% commission, and says it may launch an indefinite strike if its demands are ignored.

A study found that birds and mammals adapt to temperature changes 2–3 times faster than reptiles and amphibians, based on 270 million years of data. The researchers said it is unclear whether this will help them face rapid climate change, given other threats such as pollution, hunting, habitat loss, and invasive species.

The passage describes SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guest-hypervisor mechanisms including VMPL changes, SNP TIO guest requests, Secure AVIC backing pages, termination requests, AP boot and creation methods, NMI handling, debug register virtualization, and #HV doorbell page interrupt delivery and EOI behavior.

Kuwait said it will finish cleaning up a crude oil spill in its southern Gulf waters this week, with no new oil patches found and cleanup focused near the shore. Authorities had not given the spill’s size or cause, while Saudi-Kuwaiti joint operations said its facilities were safe and unaffected.

Investors, after a year of ignoring geopolitical and economic risks, have become wary as stocks fell, Treasury yields rose, and the dollar slumped. The jobs report raised concerns that rising wages could lead to higher inflation and faster central bank tightening, threatening the cheap money that helped fuel the stock boom.

It says corrections have occurred about yearly since 1900, typically last less than two months, and markets often recover and rise over time despite temporary declines and crises.

It also urges revision of tax laws, including local taxes where appropriate and a graduated inheritance tax and, if possible, a graduated income tax, with burdens distributed more equitably between rich and poor.

Apple Inc. reported net sales of $61.1 billion and net income of $13.8 billion for the quarter ended March 31, 2018, both higher than the prior year. Sales increased across all geographic segments, led by iPhone, Services, and Other Products, while gross margin was 38.3%. The company ended the period with $45.1 billion in cash and cash equivalents, $367.5 billion in total assets, and $101.4 billion in long-term debt. It also reported a lower effective tax rate due to the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and continued share repurchases and dividend payments.

Two teens were arrested and a third person remains at large after a police pursuit in Frankston early this morning. A black Subaru with stolen numberplates was later dumped in Bayswater after fleeing road works, and police arrested a 17-year-old girl and an 18-year-old man, both from Mill Park; the man was taken to hospital after being bitten by a police dog.

The passage compiles news on California power contracts, options trading, and Saudi Arabia’s selection of international oil companies for three major gas projects. It reports that Exxon Mobil, Shell, BP, Phillips, Conoco, Occidental, and Enron won roles in Saudi gas ventures worth about $25 billion, while Shell and Enron were also active in market reports.
