Sam Bankman-Fried was charged with fraud and related offenses, pleaded not guilty, and former executives Gary Wang, Caroline Ellison, and Nishad Singh later pleaded guilty to criminal charges tied to the scheme.

Penn State will no longer allow the Outing Club and two other outdoor recreation clubs to organize student-led trips, saying the activities are too risky because they occur in remote areas with limited emergency access. Students said the decision came from a review done without consulting club leaders, while the university says it is focused on student safety and will offer a more expensive university-run outdoors program instead.

Android 8.0 Oreo adds Picture-in-Picture mode, which enables a small floating video window while using other apps. The passage explains supported apps, how to use it with YouTube in Google Chrome, and how to enable the feature in app settings if needed.

The court held that the 1839 instrument from Mastín Latham to William F. Henderson was an absolute, unconditional deed, not an executory contract. It rejected the stale demand and limitations defenses, found the plaintiff’s title sufficient, and reversed the judgment, remanding the case.

Gifts to the Annual Fund support the rule of law, independent courts, fairness, access to justice, and efforts to eliminate bias and improve legal representation. Donors receive a sticker and magnet set as a thank you.

The passage is a presidential address to Congress reporting that efforts to get Britain and France to revoke their edicts against U.S. commerce failed, so the embargo remained in force. It says the embargo and other defensive measures helped protect mariners and property, and it reviews foreign relations, the Chesapeake affair, peace with Indian and Barbary powers, seaport defenses, gunboats, militia, arms production, internal manufacturing, finances, debt reduction, and proposes future use of surplus revenue for national improvements.

Ukraine has partnered with Bitfury to put all of its government electronic data on a blockchain platform in what Bitfury says is the largest government blockchain deal. The pilot project will begin with areas including state registers, public services, social security, public health, and energy, with expansion planned afterward.

Investors will focus on key central bank meetings, including the Bank of England’s “Super Thursday,” while watching Australian, New Zealand and emerging market rate decisions, China data, U.S. trade and retail figures, possible shutdown risks, and company earnings in Europe and the U.S.

The Seventh Circuit affirmed summary judgment for the Village of Orland Park and the individual defendants, holding that Joseph McGreal provided no admissible evidence that his firing was retaliatory or that the defendants knew of his protected speech. It also held that he failed to support his intentional-infliction-of-emotional-distress claim with evidence of extreme and outrageous conduct or severe emotional distress.

The passage describes HoopTactics out-of-bounds plays, saying they are proven to create high-percentage shots with two to three options and flow into predetermined continuity if no shot is available. It also discusses baseline, sideline, and full-court situations, emphasizing preparation, simple execution under pressure, and using the best inbounders and shooters, especially at the end of games.

Kyle Freeland pitched 5 1/3 innings, doubled in Colorado’s three-run fourth, and helped the Rockies beat the Giants 11-4. Every Rockies starter had at least one hit, while Evan Longoria hit two solo homers and Buster Posey added another for San Francisco. Giants starter Jeff Samardzija left after one inning with shoulder tightness, and rookie Dereck Rodriguez made his major league debut after replacing him.

High school senior Maddie Sabourin found out she is a perfect kidney match for her grandfather, Sam Senseney, who has been on the transplant list for six years and is on dialysis. After raising awareness and funds for organ donation, she convinced doctors to let her donate, and they will meet next week to set a surgery date, expected within a month.

Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope observed the rogue planet SIMP-0136 and found strong auroras, storms, temperature changes under 5 °C, and constant silicate cloud cover. The study provided some of the most precise atmospheric measurements of an extrasolar object and revealed directly measured changes in atmospheric properties.

The court affirmed judgment for the defendants, holding that the plaintiff failed to prove Louis Helbing executed the unrecorded gift deed to his wife with intent to defraud creditors. The deed’s delayed recordation was suspicious but not enough by itself to show fraud, and the excluded testimony about later events was not grounds for reversal.

Tropical Storm Nate, the 15th Atlantic system of the season, is moving toward Mexico and may hit the U.S. Gulf Coast as a hurricane. Louisiana declared a state of emergency, ordered evacuations in coastal areas, and mobilized National Guard troops. Nate has already caused deaths and flooding in Latin America, including at least 15 deaths in Nicaragua and seven in Costa Rica.

This retrospective study of 390 patients in a subacute CDU during March 2020–February 2021 found that delayed discharge was mainly linked to complications from primary diagnoses or multimorbidity and to patient-centred needs. Median LOS was 19.4 days, and prolonged LOS was more common in patients aged 65–75 years, women, and those with more than four comorbidities. HCAI, frailty/falls, and community services were not significant contributors to prolonged LOS.

Bank of England research says a central bank digital currency could strengthen monetary policy transmission, speed interest-rate pass-through, and improve quantitative easing by allowing direct payments to non-banks. The Bank is not currently planning to issue a CBDC.

The passage says the portfolio has generally performed positively over long horizons, with results varying by bond maturity.

The Golden Cross is a trading strategy using the 50-day and 200-day moving averages, buying when the shorter average crosses above the longer and selling when it crosses below. In an S&P 500 backtest since 1960, it produced 33 trades, a 79% win rate, 6.8% annual return, 9.6% risk-adjusted return, and a 33% drawdown versus 56% for buy-and-hold.

The study at Kibungo Referral Hospital in Rwanda found a 13% ART non-adherence rate among 424 HIV patients. Significant factors associated with non-adherence were younger age, lower education, stigma, perceived ART ineffectiveness, and failure to integrate ART into daily routines; setting an alarm was not significant.

Officials said winter rains could worsen the danger, and trails in Oneonta Gorge remain closed, with some areas possibly closed until September 2018.

Ronald Reagan criticized Carter’s foreign policy as weak and contradictory, linking it to the Iran hostage crisis and Soviet actions in Afghanistan. He argued that America must be strong, predictable, and build military strength, including stronger deterrent forces, naval superiority, and the ability to defend U.S. interests abroad.

Cars.com’s 2018 American-Made Index ranks the Jeep Cherokee first, followed by several Honda, Ford, Chevrolet, and Acura models. The list is based on U.S. parts, engine and transmission origins, and assembly location, and Honda has four vehicles in the top 10 while Jeep and Ford also place multiple models.

PCR detected 15 agents in 28/29 samples, while mNGS detected 44 microorganisms, including 29 not found by PCR. The mNGS approach showed high concordance with PCR for shared targets and additionally identified organisms classified into phenotypic groups reflecting pathogenic potential.

Florida transportation officials are proposing a new connector between the Sawgrass Expressway and I-95 in Deerfield Beach, with two possible routes along Southwest 10th Street. The plan, still at least three years away, has drawn local concern over congestion, property values, and opposition from residents and officials.

Nigeria faces a severe doctor shortage as many doctors migrate to the UK, US and other countries. NOIPolls says 88 percent of doctors plan to leave, worsening the ratio to 1:5,000 from 1:4,000, far below WHO’s 1:600 recommendation. The country has about 72,000 registered doctors, with only 35,000 practicing, and needs 303,000 doctors plus 10,605 new doctors annually.
