It explains TMPM support for migrating pages between system physical addresses, including pages under DMA and SNP guest pages, up to 128 pages per command, and notes that all system physical addresses must be 4KB aligned.

Amazon.com, Inc. reported third-quarter 2016 net sales of $32.7 billion, up 29% from the prior year, with net income of $252 million versus $79 million in Q3 2015. For the nine months ended September 30, 2016, net sales were $92.2 billion and net income was $1.6 billion. Operating income rose to $575 million in Q3 2016 and $2.9 billion for the nine-month period. Cash and cash equivalents were $13.7 billion at September 30, 2016, and total assets were $70.9 billion.

The 49ers ruled out Brock Purdy, Ricky Pearsall and Jauan Jennings for Thursday night’s game against the Rams, with Mac Jones set to start at quarterback. The team also ruled out defensive end Yetur Gross-Matos and will be short-handed on offense.

The passage describes a knowledge exchange project in England that supported Citizenship student teachers to develop trans-inclusive classroom practices, use storytelling and human rights legislation, and create rights-respecting environments for transgender youth. It also discusses draft UK guidance, legal protections under the Equality Act 2010, international human rights frameworks, and the importance of training, visibility, and whole-school approaches to trans inclusion.

King Salman and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan held talks in Riyadh on bilateral relations, expanded cooperation, regional and international developments, peace and security, and combating terrorism. Erdogan received an official reception, inspected the guard of honor, and Crown Prince Muhammad Bin Naif also met separately with him.

The passage urges Congress to grant substantial tariff reductions on Cuban imports, arguing that Cuba deserves special reciprocal treatment for moral, political, and economic reasons. It says this would support Cuba’s welfare, protect American interests, and continue the policy of close U.S.-Cuba relations established during and after the Spanish-American War.

In Phase 1, 2 participants had serious medical problems between Dose 1 and 6 months after Dose 2: 1 of 24 in the BNT162b2 20-µg group had inflamed appendix, and 1 of 24 in the BNT162b2 30-µg group had inflamed nerves.

Health authorities in Taiwan are urging people to avoid raw or undercooked eggs and to cook eggs and poultry thoroughly, at least to 70°C, to reduce avian flu risk. They also advise washing hands after handling eggshells, maintaining hygiene, wearing surgical masks, and seeking medical care if fever develops.

Malaysia’s central bank will let all resident entities short-sell government securities from May 2 to improve bond market liquidity and risk management. It will also expand foreign exchange hedging options, consider short selling of MGII bonds, and introduce a new financial markets code of conduct.

The court reversed the judgment and ordered a new trial because improper evidence was admitted. The evidence about Kingsbury and McKechnie speculating in hops and McKechnie’s refusal to sell the hops was deemed irrelevant to the indemnity claim, prejudicial, and likely to excite sympathy and prejudice the jury.

Kinlochleven has received three new defibrillators through local fundraising, presented by Lucky 2B Here and Marcus and Martine Spence. Residents have also completed emergency life support training, and the defibrillators are planned for placement outside the Co-op and GP’s surgery. The group has raised £2,900 of its £3,500 target and is still accepting donations.

Magda Enriquez secretly joined the Sandinistas in 1976, later became a founder of their women’s association and a member of Nicaragua’s Council of State. She describes leaving her husband, working for the revolution, and raising her children amid the conflict, while saying the revolution has given women opportunities to solve their problems and challenge outside myths about Nicaragua.

Harry Kane scored for England in a 4-3 penalty shootout win over Colombia after a 1-1 draw, sending England into the World Cup quarter-finals against Sweden. Kane said the team was focused on Saturday’s match, while Kieran Trippier praised the team spirit. Radamel Falcao and Diego Maradona criticized the referee after the defeat.

Hinsdale South High School seniors were named Illinois State Scholars, an honor for students in the top 10 percent of the state’s graduating seniors based on ACT or SAT scores, unweighted GPA, and class size. The passage lists the named students.

Between weeks 24 and 48, adverse events, serious adverse events, discontinuations, and bleeding events were reported across the study groups, with fatal bleeding in 2 subjects. Overall, 24 deaths occurred, no pregnancies were reported, and laboratory data showed no clinically concerning hepatic or renal signal. The study concluded that adherence and persistence remained high through 48 weeks, but the educational program provided no additional benefit.

The passage says retirees and FIRE individuals are vulnerable to going broke because of sequence risk, high withdrawal rates, poor diversification, and lack of a margin of safety. It uses an example of an unlucky FIRE couple who eventually ran out of money, and argues that conservative withdrawals, diversification, and frugality are key to reducing this risk.

Andrea and Luke Benrud of Appleton are sharing how CPR saved Andrea’s life after she collapsed from a rare, undetected heart defect. Luke kept her alive for seven minutes until help arrived, and the couple hopes their story encourages others to learn CPR.

Body camera footage showed Grand Rapids Officer Kevin Penn pressing his AR-15 muzzle to a suspect’s head during an August 19 arrest. Kent County Prosecutor Chris Becker said the conduct was not condoned but that Penn would not face charges, and Penn later resigned.

The European Central Bank is expected to keep rates at historic lows and maintain its 30-billion-euro monthly bond-buying programme while warning of risks to growth and low inflation. Economic indicators remain positive but less strong, and analysts expect Mario Draghi to stress downside risks without changing policy quickly.

Jonathan Erick Miles, 33, was charged after police found two marijuana plants, controlled substances and illegal smoking devices in his Lancaster Township home during a search warrant. He was also charged with endangering the welfare of children for allegedly being under the influence while caring for his daughter and was released on unsecured bail.

The passage says companies use exhibitions and events to improve brand image and gather feedback, but need experienced hosts and other temporary staff to succeed. It promotes Professionate as an online event staffing agency that connects companies, recruitment agencies, and job seekers through profiles, ratings, reviews, and vacancies, and also advertises event hosting services in Dubai.

The study compared self-reported PCL-5 and clinician-administered CAPS-5 PTSD scores in 100 adults and found strong overall correlation, but stronger alignment in females than males. CAPS-5 scores did not differ by sex or trauma type, while males showed greater deviation from the ideal PCL-5/CAPS-5 relationship and more PTSD misclassification. Civilian trauma was associated with stronger PCL-5/CAPS-5 correlation than military trauma.

The U.N. warned that two years of war in Yemen could deprive a generation of children of education, leaving up to 4.5 million children unable to finish the school year because months of unpaid salaries have affected 73 percent of teachers. It said children out of school face higher risks of recruitment as child soldiers or early marriage.

A Channel 4 documentary follows five women who say they experience “super orgasms,” or up to 100 orgasms in one encounter, but experts say the film is not scientific and the term is misleading. Researchers observed the women’s arousal, brain activity, and blood flow, concluding they were easily aroused and multi-orgasmic, but noted the small sample and lack of controls. Experts said orgasms vary widely, “super orgasms” are uncommon, and most women should not see them as a goal.
FDA approved a second generic version of the abortion pill mifepristone.

Cover 3 is a common zone defense with 3 deep defenders and 4 underneath defenders. It helps defend deep passes while adding support against the run, but it is vulnerable in the flats, on seams, and against perimeter runs. Variations include fire zone, Buzz, and pattern-reading coverages like Rip/Liz.

The President transmitted documents and correspondence on the Guadalupe Hidalgo peace treaty and defended his earlier refusal to publish the commissioners’ instructions, though he provided them because the House had requested them. He explained that the commissioners were limited to securing Mexican ratification of the Senate-amended treaty, that Mexico ratified it without further change, and that the later protocol did not modify the treaty but merely explained the Senate’s amendments.

The court held that John Jacob Beechwood was not a farmer within the meaning of the Bankruptcy Act because, on the relevant dates, he was primarily a lawyer and business employee whose income came mainly from employment, not from personally engaged farming. Accordingly, his defense against involuntary bankruptcy failed and an order adjudicating him a bankrupt was to be entered.

The Times reported that Paul Manafort was one of the Trump advisers whose calls with Russian intelligence officials were intercepted, though the officials would not name others. Manafort denied any involvement with Russian intelligence or the Russian government. The passage also says U.S. intelligence suspected Russia of cyberattacks on Democratic institutions and of trying to help Trump win, while Rep. Elijah Cummings called the report alarming. Michael Flynn had resigned the day before over calls with Russia’s ambassador, and Sean Spicer said nothing had changed regarding Trump campaign contacts with Russians during that period.

The memorandum outlines topics for the Inquiry, including peace conference technique, data on war-breeding areas, national aspirations, international arrangements, war laws, reparations, trade routes, and diplomatic history. It also lists practical conference tasks and regions where the Inquiry may help with boundaries, governments, economic arrangements, minority protection, and other issues, including Russia, Poland, Austria-Hungary, the Balkans, and Turkey.

Amazon is reportedly planning layoffs of up to 15% of its human resources staff, with more cuts likely in other divisions. The cuts may affect PXT and parts of the core consumer business, as Amazon continues reducing costs while investing heavily in AI and infrastructure.

The passage claims a study in the Journal of Hematology & Thromboembolic Diseases found Bt toxins in GM crops may cause blood abnormalities, anemia, and leukemia-like changes in mice, and says further research is needed before considering these toxins safe for mammals.

The passage proves that continuity at a point can be characterized by limits and by sequences, shows that functions like sine, cosine, polynomials, and certain combinations of continuous functions are continuous, and gives an example of a function that is discontinuous at every real number.

December manufacturer incentives include leases as low as $159/month and discounts up to $18,100 on fuel-efficient vehicles. Notable deals include the 2017 Kia Soul EV, 2017 Kia Optima Hybrid and Plug-In Hybrid, 2017 Chevrolet Volt and Bolt EV, 2018 Chevrolet Equinox Diesel, and 2017 Toyota Yaris iA, with offers varying by region, model, and applicable tax credits or rebates.

H H Martyn & Co, founded in Cheltenham in 1888, became a major crafts and engineering firm known for work on buildings, ships, aircraft, cars, and decorative art. It employed over 1,000 people by 1910, helped spawn the Gloster Aircraft Company, and closed in 1971 after its assets were sold.

The passage describes early U.S., French, and British naval involvement in Hawaii from 1826 to 1843. It notes Capt. Thomas ap Catesby Jones’s 1826 friendly mission and treaty with the Hawaiian King, later visits and interventions by U.S. ships, a French ultimatum and treaty in 1839, and British pressure culminating in Lord George Paulet’s seizure of the islands in 1843, followed by restoration of the Hawaiian flag after Rear-Admiral Thomas’s agreement.

The report analyzes the global Meat Starter Culture market, covering historical, current, and projected revenues, growth rates, trends, risks, opportunities, competition, and regional data for 2018–2025. It segments the market by product type and application, lists key companies, and includes SWOT, feasibility, and return analyses.

Amazon.com, Inc. announced that on September 9, 2020, its Board elected General (Ret.) Keith B. Alexander as a director and appointed him to the Audit Committee. He received a restricted stock unit award for 288 shares, vesting in three annual installments beginning November 15, 2021, and entered into the company’s standard indemnification agreement.

Progress Software held its third fiscal quarter 2025 earnings conference call on September 29, 2025, with Investor Relations, CEO Yogesh Gupta, and CFO Anthony Folger. The call included safe harbor statements about forward-looking guidance and noted that referenced financial figures were non-GAAP unless otherwise indicated.

The passage introduces a recursive bipartitioning framework for community detection that uses Bayesian modeling and the Bayes factor as a stopping rule, avoiding pre-specification of the number of communities. It discusses stochastic block, edge exchangeable, and latent space models, presents consistency results for recursive bipartitioning under the stochastic block model, and outlines Gibbs sampling inference and applications to simulation and stroke patient transfer data.

A study of the hot Jupiter WASP-121b found spectral signatures of water indicating a stratosphere, making it the strongest evidence yet for an exoplanet stratosphere. The planet, about 880 light-years away and nearly twice Jupiter’s size, was observed with Hubble during transits.

Winthrop will receive $1.1 million from a $20 million NSF grant for research on complex materials, supporting student research, faculty work, equipment, and outreach. The project, MADE in SC, includes multiple Winthrop faculty and focuses on intelligently designed optical, magnetic, polymer, and stimuli-response materials with applications in lasers, water treatment, and regenerative medicine.

The Patient Charter sets out NHS legal rights, pledges, and patient responsibilities, including free care at the point of use in most cases, equal access, safe and quality care, informed consent, privacy, choice, complaint routes, and fair treatment. It also says patients should look after their health, respect staff and other patients, follow treatment plans, and take part in vaccination and screening.

Coach Sutter said the series against Chicago was emotionally and physically taxing, with little rest before media day and practice, and that lineup changes and many first-time Stanley Cup Final players created adjustments. He noted some players, including Kyle, played well, stressed the importance of winning over chasing leads, and said younger players still have much to learn.

The passage explains the Average True Range (ATR) as a volatility indicator, shows how to calculate it in Python using pandas_ta on SPY data, and backtests a simple 14-day ATR trading strategy. The strategy holds the asset when volatility is high and sells when it is low, but the results are not very promising, though risk-adjusted performance is somewhat better.

A University of Bristol study found that the chloroplast lineage split from its closest cyanobacterial ancestor more than 2.1 billion years ago in low-salinity environments, with symbiosis with a eukaryotic host developing about 200 million years later. It also found that marine algae diversified much later, around 800–750 million years ago, suggesting early complex algae evolved in freshwater before colonizing marine habitats.

After Daily Stormer published a vicious article about Heather Heyer following the Charlottesville attack, GoDaddy gave the site 24 hours to move and Google soon canceled its domain registration as well. The site remains active, its hosting is obscured by Cloudflare, and its founder Andrew Anglin is also facing a lawsuit over harassment allegations and has not appeared in court.

NASA will broadcast an ISS spacewalk on August 17 involving Russian Expedition 52 crew members Fyodor Yurchikhin and Sergey Ryazanskiy, who will deploy five nanosatellites, collect residue samples, and install new handrails and struts during a six-hour mission.

A retrospective review of 267 measles admissions at Mulago National Referral Hospital in Uganda found high mortality (11.3%) and frequent complications, especially severe pneumonia. The average direct health care cost per case was 33.13 USD, with total direct cost including overheads estimated at 114.50 USD; higher costs were associated with male sex, comorbidities, longer hospital stay, and death.

Anne-Marie D'Amico was identified as one of the 10 people killed in the Toronto van attack. She worked for Invesco, and her family have been informed. Police say 15 others were injured, the suspect Alex Minassian was arrested, and the motive remains unknown.

The passage describes a recommendation model training method and apparatus for big data scenarios that improve ranking performance by sampling negative samples based on their relationship to positive samples, using estimated score differences, vector distances, and ranking-indicator variation. It also describes a recommendation method that ranks to-be-recommended objects by estimated scores and recommends the top M objects, along with related devices, storage media, and program products.

The A100 GPU supports PCIe Gen 4 and SR-IOV, and includes improvements for error handling, asynchronous copy and barriers, task graphs, and many architectural features for AI and HPC. It uses Ampere architecture with third-generation Tensor Cores, 108 SMs, 40 MB L2 cache, 40 GB HBM2, MIG partitioning, third-generation NVLink, and hardware acceleration for JPEG decode, optical flow, atomics, and video decode. The passage also describes CUDA 11 support for graph acceleration, async copy, barriers, L2 residency controls, and sparsity, plus DGX A100 scaling and software components.

The passage describes GHCB and SEV-SNP/SEV-ES protocol requests and responses, including CPUID, GHCB GPA registration, page state change, guest termination, AP creation, doorbell, timer, APIC ID list, guest requests, and Secure AVIC. It also explains NAE handling, VMGEXIT processing, guest/hypervisor responsibilities, and examples of guest initialization and AP boot behavior.

NVIDIA Corporation, SoftBank Group Capital Limited, and SVF Holdco (UK) Limited mutually terminated the September 13, 2020 Share Purchase Agreement on February 8, 2022 due to regulatory challenges. The Sellers will keep the $1.25 billion prepayment, NVIDIA will retain its 20-year Arm license, and NVIDIA expects to record a $1.36 billion charge in fiscal Q1 2023.

The High/Low zone offense uses outside passing and inside high/low rotation, can start from many alignments, and relies on movement, ball reversal, quick weakside attack, and accurate passing. It includes basic continuity, several entries such as Dribble Clear, 1-4 Slice, Mid Screen, and Horns, plus specials like Pin Down, Weakside Double, and Vegas.

The talk explains how to build business plan financial projections, focusing on revenue, cost structure, cash needs, and dilution. It emphasizes understanding business models, using quarterly spreadsheets, and comparing financial assumptions to investor expectations, especially for venture-backed companies.

The paper presents a knowledge-graph-based system for criminal investigations that processes instant messaging data, transcribes audio messages, extracts entities, and supports graph queries and semantic search. Experiments on two investigations showed useful investigator feedback but also limitations, especially for entity extraction on IMA data.

AQTWM, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus for an initial public offering of common shares in Canada, except Québec, through underwriters led by TD Securities, Canaccord Genuity, and RBC Capital Markets. The share number and price are not yet set, the offering is not guaranteed, and the company describes itself as an oilfield water management and logistics provider serving Canadian and U.S. onshore producers.

The passage is a presidential inaugural address affirming the Constitution, equality, and shared American purpose. It calls for collective action on the economy, education, health care, climate change, security, and civil rights, and says the nation’s unfinished work is to make liberty and opportunity real for all Americans.

The lecture reviewed bandwidth-limited coding for AWGN channels, emphasizing shaping gains, lattice constellations, trellis codes, and multi-level coding. It stated that shaping can yield at most about 1.5 dB, discussed notable lattices such as hexagonal, D4, E8, Barnes-Wall, and the Leech lattice, and explained how trellis codes and set partitioning improve performance. It concluded that practical systems are close to the Shannon limit and highlighted bit-interleaved coded modulation and multi-level coding as useful approaches.

Drugmakers are meeting with Donald Trump Jr. and Trump officials at a BlinkRx-hosted summit, raising conflict concerns, while Pfizer’s price deal has pushed other companies to seek similar agreements with the White House.

The lecture described thesis research on manufacturing microfluidic devices with thermoplastic polymers using hot embossing and nanoimprint lithography. It explained process parameters, modeling approaches, characterization experiments with PMMA, ZEONOR, and TOPAS, and highlighted issues such as pattern dependence, viscoelastic flow, anisotropy, and demolding damage.
UNC Chapel Hill reinstated Professor Dwayne Dixon after a threat assessment found no basis to conclude he posed a threat or violated university policy.

The passage explains that the gold/silver ratio is the number of silver ounces needed to equal one ounce of gold and is used by traders as a signal for buying or selling gold and silver, often with mean-reversion strategies. It also says the ratio has historically ranged from fixed government-set levels to volatile floating levels, but backtests in the passage found no robust profitable trading strategy and no meaningful risk-on/risk-off stock indicator.

Hetzner now peers directly at NAP Africa in Isando via a 10Gbps circuit, adding Johannesburg to its existing Cape Town exchange link. This increases local traffic routed through NAP Africa and JINX, reduces transit costs, and improves reach, latency, and resilience through settlement-free peering.

Deborah Jones argues the proposed Scott Road highrise conflicts with the North Delta Area Plan and Cougar Creek ISMP because it exceeds the six-storey limit, reduces tree cover, and eliminates stormwater infiltration. She says it should be rejected unless major environmental mitigation is added, including at least 15 per cent permeable land for trees and rainwater infiltration.

SFS attestation evidence should be requested through appropriate interfaces, and AMD will not modify firmware that some attestation schemes prevent from being updated. Update packages must verify required firmware versions before updating, and if any part cannot fully apply, the package should not be applied. Packages are non-persistent across reboots, require specific memory alignment and command buffer handling, and can be applied during boot or system operation. The ASP verifies signatures, loads and runs the patch, updates patch level information, and returns status. SFS packages are named by family, AGESA release, and sequence number, and update packages must match the system’s firmware combination.

Apple Inc.’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2018 reported net sales of $53.3 billion and net income of $11.5 billion for the quarter, both higher than the prior year, with growth driven mainly by iPhone, Services, and Other Products. The company reported total assets of $349.2 billion, cash and cash equivalents of $32.0 billion, and long-term debt of $97.1 billion. It also discussed tax changes from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, share repurchases, legal proceedings, and segment results across its geographic regions.

The passage introduces a conditional diffusion framework, EqDiff-CT, for CBCT-to-CT synthesis in head and neck imaging. It argues that diffusion models address limitations of registration-based and GAN methods, and reports that the proposed attention-enhanced, group-equivariant U-Net diffusion model outperformed baseline diffusion and CycleGAN on SynthRAD2025 using SSIM, PSNR, MSE, and MAE.

The speaker says the team made mistakes but expects Dallas to play better and is preparing for its best, focusing on the next game rather than past series. He stresses taking time away from Dallas’s skilled players, playing with better forechecking and physicality, and says the series is tied 1-1, so there is no reason to panic.

CDC data shows mosquito-, tick-, and flea-borne illnesses in the U.S. have tripled since 2004. The passage warns that Venice’s still waters can breed mosquitoes, notes West Nile Virus is present in Los Angeles County, and says residents should use insect repellent and remove standing water.

Weston Public Library will host eclipse-related events for the Aug. 21 solar eclipse, including free solar viewers starting Aug. 14, a pinhole projector activity on Aug. 15, and a NASA live stream with treats on Aug. 21, when Weston will see about 70% coverage.

The study developed a model to interpret H5 RNA detections in wastewater by estimating possible contributions from humans, cow milk, poultry feces, and wildfowl feces. It retrospectively tested wastewater solids from a California treatment plant for total IAV and H1, H3, and H5 RNA from September 2023 to May 2024, aiming to identify the first H5 detection and contextualize the findings.

The SteelSeries Arctis GameBuds are discounted to $128 at Amazon and are praised for gaming and everyday use. They offer portability, Xbox or PlayStation compatibility, low-latency 2.4GHz audio, Bluetooth, about 10 hours of battery life in the buds and 40 hours total with the case, plus ANC and game-specific EQ settings in the mobile app.

The study synthesized two Zn-based MIOC crystals, MIOC-4 and MIOC-7, and their melt-quenched glasses using chloride and ligand tuning. MIOC-7, with stronger π-π interactions, had higher melting and glass-transition temperatures than MIOC-4. In situ XRD, IR, Raman, NMR, and synchrotron XRD showed that melting begins with disruption of hydrogen-bonded structures while Zn-ligand coordination remains intact in the glass, and that glass formation preserves short-range order but removes medium- and long-range correlations. Mixed-ligand crystals showed lower melting points and tunable Tg values. MIOC-7 glass also displayed enhanced, excitation-dependent photoluminescence and higher PL quantum yield than the crystal.

James Harden scored 60 points with 10 rebounds and 11 assists as the short-handed Rockets beat the Magic 114-107, setting an NBA record as the first player to score 60 in a triple-double and breaking Houston’s single-game scoring mark. Orlando lost its third straight, while Houston also played without Chris Paul and Trevor Ariza and lost Eric Gordon early to injury.

The passage describes a networked exercise system, centered on a treadmill, that supports live and on-demand classes, social audio/video interaction, performance tracking, and gamified competition. It also details treadmill designs with slatted belts, sensors, displays, rotary and linear controls, emergency stop features, and user interfaces for browsing classes and viewing performance data.

The Socket 940 uses an LCP base and cover with specified flatness, thickness, markings, and an overlay for pin-hole protection. It has copper-alloy contacts plated with nickel and gold, tin-lead SMT solder balls, a stainless steel actuation lever, durability requirements, and electrical specifications including current rating, resistance, inductance, capacitance, impedance, dielectric withstand voltage, and insulation resistance.

The passage explains that successful early offense and press break depend on precise execution, spacing, timing, and practice habits. It recommends teaching with the Whole-Part-Whole method, using progressive breakdown drills, practicing against strong defense, and building confidence to attack presses, advance the ball under control, and flow into early offense. It also stresses playing disruptive defense, scouting opponents, and staying alert to defensive changes.

The passage says the goalie stayed calm after adversity, shut the door after bad goals, and has been strong mentally. It also compares two teams as similar in faceoffs, defense, forechecking, physical play, and team style, while stressing discipline, team-first identity, and the need for two good goalies because of the schedule and travel.

Kentucky valedictorian Christian Bales and student council president Katherine Frantz gave graduation speeches by bullhorn outside Holy Cross High School after the Diocese of Covington blocked them, saying the speeches were late and political. Bales said the controversy gave his message wider reach and emphasized youth activism, while his mother said the attempt to silence him backfired.

The Trump administration’s push to hire hundreds of new federal lawyers is off to a slow start, with assistant U.S. attorney hiring down by more than half from recent years. The slowdown is attributed to budget, political, and morale pressures, while some offices are now trying to recruit new prosecutors.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPUs, highlighting improved concurrent ray tracing, compute, and graphics processing; second-generation RT Cores with faster ray/triangle intersection and motion blur acceleration; third-generation Tensor Cores with TF32, BF16, and sparsity support; GDDR6X memory; RTX IO for GPU-based loading and decompression; and hardware video decode/encode updates, alongside performance and product comparisons for RTX and data center GPUs.

The passage explains the ADX indicator, created by Welles Wilder, as a lagging measure of trend strength ranging from 0 to 100. Backtests show ADX alone is only moderately useful, but it performs better when combined with other indicators or used as a filter, improving some strategies on the S&P 500 and Nasdaq.

The speaker discusses supporting teammates on a power play, competing on battles, and creating a clean chance on a delay penalty that helped decide the game. They praise the shot, express excitement to return home to a hockey town, and stress staying out of the box, defending against an elite power play, and having confidence in the team’s depth despite losing key players.

A Stanford-Harvard-Census Bureau study of 20 million children found that black boys earn less than white boys in adulthood in 99% of U.S. neighborhoods, even with similar socioeconomic backgrounds. It reported lower upward mobility for black and Native American children, especially black boys, and said the racial income gap is driven mainly by differences between black and white men.

On October 7, 2016, NVIDIA Corporation entered into a five-year Credit Agreement providing up to $575 million in revolving borrowing capacity for working capital and general corporate purposes, with an option for up to $425 million of additional commitments subject to conditions. The obligations are unsecured senior obligations and include customary covenants, defaults, and interest rate options.

Future Electronics and NXP are hosting a free seminar on the i.MX RT Series Crossover Processor in San Sebastian, Spain on July 4, 2018, including hands-on exercises. The workshop will introduce the i.MX RT Series and its real-time, high-performance features.

The speaker thanks Berlin and Germany, celebrates the fall of the Berlin Wall and German unity, and praises the courage of Berliners. He calls for building a peaceful, democratic, and united Europe, urges vigilance against division, and pledges continued American support, ending by declaring, “Berlin is free.”

Trump announced an agreement with Pfizer to lower U.S. drug prices, including discounted medicines for Medicaid patients and direct sales through TrumpRx.gov. Pfizer will also get a three-year exemption from pharmaceutical tariffs if it invests further in U.S. manufacturing, and said it plans to invest $70 billion in U.S. facilities.

NVIDIA Corporation reported that its Board appointed Tim Teter as senior vice president, general counsel and secretary, effective with his expected employment start on January 23, 2017. His offer letter provides an $850,000 annual salary, eligibility for incentive compensation and benefits, a $450,000 anniversary bonus, and RSUs with a target value of $5.8 million, and he is expected to enter into NVIDIA’s standard indemnity agreement.

The author says the retirement portfolio outperformed the S&P 500 in 2016, ending up 15% versus 11.66% for the index with dividends. Only 5 of 27 starting positions declined, with Chevron, JPMorgan, AT&T, 3M, and Aflac among the top performers. The portfolio added several stocks during the year, grew to 35 companies, and the author plans to keep buying dividend-paying stocks under fair value.

Virtual education offers flexibility, individualized learning, credit recovery, support for special needs, parental engagement, and potential future academic skills, but it also faces challenges such as internet access, motivation, delayed feedback, isolation, accommodation difficulties, and student engagement. In an Indiana study, COVID-19 was the main factor in adopting or maintaining virtual programs, and the top perceived benefits were enrollment during the pandemic, credit recovery, and flexibility, while the main challenges were student engagement, curriculum quality, and staffing.

The paper studies satisficing paths in multi-agent reinforcement learning from a topological perspective and introduces grouped satisficing paths, where groups of players maintain best-response strategies together. It proves that if strategy sets are convex and compact, payoffs are continuous and partially analytic, and every sub-game has an equilibrium, then any initial joint strategy has a finite grouped satisficing path to an equilibrium. It also derives existence results for N-player games and finite-state Markov games.

The passage covers an HP protein-folding model on a square lattice, where folding is scored by adjacent H-H bonds and the optimization problem is NP-hard. It describes a 1/3-approximation algorithm and notes uniqueness results for some closed and open chains. The second half discusses interlocked 3D chains, including separability results for short chains, bounds for cutting locked chains, specific interlocking examples, and PSPACE-completeness of deciding whether one 3D chain configuration can move to another.

E-mini futures are smaller electronically traded futures contracts on indexes, commodities, and currencies, used for speculation and hedging. Trading requires a broker account, margin, and risk management; costs, margins, and account needs vary, and backtesting and a written plan are recommended.

The passage is a WIRED roundup of Amazon Big Deal Days discounts on tested products under $100, including streaming devices, smart speakers, chargers, cameras, pet gear, kitchen tools, cleaners, bedding, grooming items, and games, with examples like the Roku Streaming Stick 4K, Ninja Blast Portable Blender, and Philips Sonicare ExpertClean 7500.

The passage discusses digital transformation in education, emphasizing digital literacy, readiness, culture, mindset, and leadership as key competencies for educators. It argues that Thailand’s education system must adapt to Digital Thailand 4.0 and Education 4.0, with bibliometric analysis used to identify future competencies for digital education leaders.

The study examines Songyang Academy’s history and educational philosophy through documentary and field research, finding that it emphasized moral education, unity of knowledge and action, autonomous learning, questioning, and practical teaching. It concludes that these ideas closely align with modern general education and can inform contemporary efforts to cultivate all-round talents.

The passage provides TI support and trademark notices, an ESD handling caution, a detailed revision history for MSPM0G3519/MSPM0G3518/MSPM0G1519/MSPM0G1518, and mechanical, packaging, and orderable information, including disclaimers and qualified automotive versions.

Kobe University researchers found that orchid seeds germinate only near decaying logs because wood-decaying fungi supply carbon from rotting wood. The seedlings form highly specific fungal partnerships, similar to those of adult orchids with coral-like roots, revealing a hidden carbon pathway in forests and a possible step in the evolution of fully fungus-dependent orchids.

The study surveyed 30 elementary teachers in Liloan District, Cebu, and found generally positive attitudes toward inclusive education, especially on philosophical and professional issues, but neutral concerns about logistical support. Teachers’ demographic profiles were not significantly related to their attitudes. The authors conclude that continuous professional development and stronger multi-level support are needed to improve inclusion practice.

Students and staff returned to Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School under heavy police security after the shooting that killed 17 people. The day included counselors, therapy animals, memorials, and nervous but determined students, while Florida lawmakers debated school-safety and gun-control measures, including raising the gun-buying age and arming teachers.

The speaker says it is a great honor to be recognized, though he was disappointed not to be nominated for the rookie trophy. He says preparation was most important, so he stayed one more year in Europe to get mentally and physically ready, then trained hard. After a slow start in his first five games, his confidence grew and things began to happen.

The author refers to their 21-year-old daughter as “The Girl” and says she seems suited to be a literature professor, but full-time literature teaching jobs are extremely scarce. They describe broader problems in academia, journalism, and publishing, note that librarianship may be a better option, and invite advice for talented young people who might have become professors.

The passage describes MSPM0 MCU peripherals and system features, including SRAM with two 64KB banks, GPIO, IOMUX, ADC, temperature sensor, VREF, comparator, DAC, security functions, TRNG, AESADV, keystore, CRC, math acceleration, UART, I2C, SPI, CAN-FD, LFSS with RTC_B and IWDT_B, WWDT, timers, debug and boot strap loader support, factory constants, application guidance, documentation resources, and revision and packaging information.

A paper found that if NIH had been 40% smaller, more than half of 21st-century drug approvals might have been linked to research at risk of losing funding, and that such drugs were often important innovations. It identified direct and indirect links between NIH-funded research and approved drugs, including priority-review drugs with higher average market value.

The Appellate Division unanimously affirmed dismissal of Brian O’Loughlin’s defamation complaint, holding that Caruso’s remarks in the PBA magazine were nonactionable expressions of opinion rather than false statements of fact.

Global population growth is increasing cereal production and pesticide use, with herbicides the dominant segment in grain and cereal crop protection. North America leads the market, while Asia Pacific is expected to grow quickly due to rising food demand and awareness in developing countries.

The vertical farming market involves growing crops in controlled environments without soil, often in stacked layers using methods such as hydroponics and aeroponics. Market growth is driven by food quality, population growth, reduced dependence on water and soil, and new technologies, but is hindered by high initial costs, energy use, and high-value crop production limits. North America held the largest share, Asia-Pacific is expected to grow fastest, and the market is projected to reach about USD 6 billion by 2022.

Kayleigh Gray, whose daughter Emilia was born at 27 weeks and treated at Royal Preston Hospital’s Neo Natal Unit, has donated 25 pairs of acrylic turtle doves to the unit with help from her employer, Sign Build. The doves are meant for parents to keep one with their baby and one at home as a sentimental item.

Players said they must keep the same mentality before game 6, stay focused until tomorrow night, and avoid getting too excited. They described Marian Hossa as a valuable, hard-working teammate and said the team will continue to pressure him and other top opponents. They also said reaching the Cup Final is a lifelong dream, the ride has been unexpected and enjoyable, and the team wants to play its best game of the series at home.
NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K on August 15, 2019 announcing results for the quarter ended July 28, 2019. The filing includes a press release and CFO commentary as exhibits.

The team said one goal was a major difference, praised a player’s second-effort performance and key saves, and noted they had to be better on a known scoring play and in the first period. They also said they needed to win on the road as a lower seed and were disappointed with a missed penalty opportunity and inconsistent sharpness.

Only 18% of American workers feel very confident about a secure retirement. The passage says retirement savings can be improved by estimating projected retirement income, checking fees, and confirming proper asset allocation.

A study of campaign contributions by lawyers and staff at BigLaw and large plaintiffs-side firms found 92.45% of donations in 2023 and 2024 went to Democrats, up from a 6-1 ratio in 2017-2020. Among top-grossing firms, Cleary Gottlieb, Fried Frank, and Mintz Levin gave the highest percentages to Democratic campaigns, while Nelson Mullins, Lewis Brisbois, and Ogletree Deakins gave the lowest.

E-mini Russell 2000 Index futures are CME Globex contracts based on the Russell 2000 Index, worth $50 times the index value, traded in quarterly cycles, cash settled, and ending at 9:30 a.m. ET on the third Friday of the contract month. The passage says the all-time high is 2460.8 in November 2021, the underlying index’s all-time low is 106.07 in October 1987, and key price factors include component stocks, interest rates, economic news, and the U.S. dollar.

WiseGuyReports’ report on the US data center UPS market forecasts 4.01% CAGR from 2016 to 2020. It covers market segments by UPS type and position, key vendors, drivers, challenges, and trends, noting increased data center power outages as a driver and UPS battery failure as a challenge.

New York’s Board of Regents unanimously approved an emergency plan allowing some special-education students to earn local diplomas through occupational assessments and CDOS requirements instead of minimum Regents exam scores in English and math. The change, which could affect thousands of students, has drawn praise from many parents and concern from some analysts and advocates about tracking and the speed of adoption.

Turkey secured a €974 million loan for a central Anatolia highway project aimed at improving connectivity, trade routes, and regional development. The passage also lists multiple financial and business headlines, including EU scrutiny of Italy’s bank merger rules, market gains, a gold price surge, and Google’s Gemini Enterprise launch.

Jawed Zia, former managing director of Novartis India, resigned 15 days after taking charge and may be moving to Abbott India. Novartis did not name a replacement, and the company is under antitrust investigation over alleged price collusion for its anti-diabetic drug Galvus.

The passage describes the emergence of SARS-CoV-2 and COVID-19 in Wuhan in December 2019, notes that no approved coronavirus therapies are available, and explains that the DAWN master study will test promising drugs or convalescent plasma in a proof-of-concept study. It also states that convalescent plasma may help clear infection but carries possible risks, so its efficacy and safety should be evaluated in a randomized controlled setting.

The court affirmed AHCA’s dismissal with prejudice of Glenwood Nursing Center’s hearing request as untimely. It held that equitable tolling did not apply, and that Glenwood’s April 16 letter to CMS did not constitute a proper Chapter 120 hearing request filed with AHCA.

The passage describes 10 backtested free swing trading strategies, notes that swing trading is difficult and often unsuccessful, and says realistic returns are about 5% to 20%. It argues that strategies and momentum methods can be improved, that the most successful swing traders use mechanical, quantified, backtested systems, and that buy-and-hold should remain the cornerstone of savings for most people.

The passage describes wood-type golf club heads, especially drivers, with raised sole portions that increase curvature, stiffness, and acoustics while reducing mass. Some embodiments include crown and sole inserts made of lighter materials, adjustable weight tracks or ports, channels, ribs, and cantilevered ledges to alter center of gravity, moment of inertia, forgiveness, and ball-flight characteristics.

Hiccup mode limits current cycle by cycle when CS_ILIM exceeds 1.05 V, charging CHICC until 0.6 V, then stopping switching and restarting after HICC falls to 0.3 V; CHICC sets delay and restart timing, with 3.3 nF recommended minimum. The FAULT pin can trigger shutdown if above 0.6 V for 0.4–1.4 µs, after which soft-start restarts following a frequency-dependent delay. The document also describes slope compensation, thermal shutdown at 175°C, fixed-frequency peak current mode operation, and provides application and layout guidance plus a push-pull design example with selected component values.

The passage explains how to deploy Mattermost on CentOS 7 using MariaDB, systemd, and Nginx with SSL as a reverse proxy. It covers creating the database and user, installing and configuring the server, starting it as a service, and then setting up the first account, team, site URL, and email notifications.

Federal regulators fined Altaba, formerly Yahoo, $35 million for failing to disclose a data breach that exposed personal data from hundreds of millions of accounts. Yahoo learned of the breach two years before notifying the public in 2016, and the SEC said it did not properly investigate or disclose the incident to investors.

U.S. Treasury yields rose on Monday as easing tensions between the United States and North Korea reduced demand for safe-haven debt. The 10-year yield rose to 2.222 percent and the 2-year yield to 1.314 percent after both had hit multi-week lows on Friday.

The study evaluated six machine-learning models on a synthetic pancreatic cancer dataset. All models had similar accuracy (76.05%–76.35%), but sensitivity was very low across models; Random Forest and Decision Tree had 0%, SVM had the highest sensitivity at 1.90%, and SuperLearner had the highest precision at 66.67% but only 0.42% sensitivity.

A 11Alive study said the CDC cut hundreds of thousands from HIV prevention programs while spending millions on a failed project. The passage says Atlanta has very high HIV levels, with limited access to prevention, testing, and treatment in lower-income communities, along with stigma and legal fears that discourage disclosure and testing. Georgia ranks 5th nationally for new HIV diagnoses, and a new state bill would add HIV/AIDS to the conditions covered by medical marijuana.

RTX Neural Faces uses a real-time generative AI model to improve face realism by taking a rasterized face and 3D pose data as input and inferring a more natural-looking face. It is trained on thousands of offline images under different conditions, then TensorRT optimized for real-time inference.

Salesforce said it will invest more than $2.2 billion in its French business over the next five years as Emmanuel Macron began a state visit to Washington. The company said it is experiencing rapid growth in France and plans to increase its headcount, real estate footprint and data center capacity.

Churchill, a community of 900, has been shrinking since the rail line washed out in spring 2017, with 30 families leaving since last May and about 40 fewer students at the local school. Officials and residents say low employment, rising costs, and the rail disruption are hurting the town, and there is still no timeline for the rail line to be fixed.

Microsoft’s March 31, 2017 Form 10-Q reports quarterly and nine-month financial results, including revenue of $22.1 billion and net income of $4.8 billion for the quarter, and details the LinkedIn acquisition, debt and investment balances, segment results, accounting guidance, and legal and restructuring matters.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2022 reports net income of $3.331 billion for the quarter and $8.880 billion for the first nine months, with total revenues of $21.454 billion and $57.144 billion, respectively. It also states that cash and cash equivalents were $19.532 billion and that Tesla had $74.426 billion in total assets as of September 30, 2022.

Faith-based organisations, especially churches, are increasingly supporting the NHS by providing health and social care initiatives that help fill gaps left by funding cuts and limited resources. The Cinnamon Network reported that more than 3,500 churches and 200,000 volunteers are involved, with projects addressing issues such as mental health, obesity and social isolation. The passage highlights parish nursing as a growing example, with churches recruiting nurses to offer support, prevention, monitoring and advocacy in the community.

The white paper says manufacturing enterprises are using simulation, modeling, data analysis, and HPC to improve innovation, quality, efficiency, and decision making. It notes growing demand for high-performance calculations, widespread interest in digital twins and cloud-based tools, and sees HPC as a game changer for product and process innovation.

Columbiana beat Lisbon 49-47 on two late scores by Alexis Cross and Kayla Muslovski, improving to 5-0 overall and 3-0 in the league. Izzy Perez led Lisbon with 17 points, while Muslovski and Cross scored 14 each for Columbiana. The Clippers also won the junior varsity game 33-23.

Reddit has surpassed Facebook to become the third most visited platform in the US, according to Alexa, with Google and YouTube ahead of it. Users spend more time on Reddit than Facebook, and Reddit’s desktop traffic is led by the US, followed by the UK and Canada.

The BCCI plans to oppose any ICC proposal to replace the 2021 Champions Trophy in India with a World T20, saying it could cost about $30 million. The passage also says India’s 2019 IPL was advanced to create a 15-day gap before the World Cup, and lists India’s revised 2019 World Cup fixtures, including Pakistan on June 16.

Suspected jihadists attacked a restaurant in Burkina Faso’s capital, killing at least 18 people and wounding several before security forces killed both attackers and rescued those trapped inside. Authorities called it a terrorist attack and said the toll was provisional.

Severe storms threatened 29 million people across the Southeast, with strong tornadoes, damaging hail and high winds expected in parts of Alabama, Georgia, Tennessee and Mississippi. Northern Alabama was identified as a major risk area, and some schools and Birmingham city offices closed early as storms and hail began in northern Mississippi.

The passage proposes iMOOE, a physics-guided invariant learning method for zero-shot out-of-distribution PDE forecasting, based on a two-level invariance principle: invariant operators and invariant composition relationships. It uses a mixture of operator experts and frequency-enriched risk-equality training. Experiments on five PDE systems and SST show improved zero-shot performance over baselines.

Indian markets rose early in the week but ended lower after late corrections, with the Nifty down 0.3%. Investor sentiment was hurt by U.S. tariff concerns, global rate-hike fears, political developments, RBI-related issues, and corporate news, while mid- and small-cap stocks outperformed. Macro data showed slower WPI inflation, strong IIP growth, and lower retail inflation.

The lecture reviews interacting Bose gases, including Bogoliubov theory, quantum depletion, sound, quasiparticles, and the Gross-Pitaevskii equation. It then discusses trapped condensates, vortices, optical lattices, the Bose-Hubbard model, and the superfluid to Mott insulator transition, including its phase diagram and experimental observation.

Crude sulfate turpentine is a Kraft process byproduct from pine resin distillation, mainly used in fragrances, flavors, cosmetics, food and beverages, and as a solvent or chemical raw material. Market growth is restrained by high distillation investment needs and limited black liquor recovery.

The passage describes a Learning Health System framework used to implement and evaluate Ambient AI, a generative AI tool for clinical documentation, through a pragmatic stepped-wedge randomized trial at UW Health. It outlines a PTOps playbook covering governance, user experience, technical integration, documentation sustainment, and analytics, reports alpha-phase findings and workflow adjustments, and states that the governance structure aligned operational and research priorities for the beta trial.

The team is focused on winning each shift and period rather than the game’s outcome, says they have been solid and executing well, and views the current opportunity as rare and important because many players have not won the Cup.

The Utah Court of Appeals affirmed summary judgment against Kari L. Baumann because she failed to timely disclose expert witnesses and reports, leaving her unable to oppose the motion. It held her challenge regarding a Dr. Tayler expert report was unpreserved and that Rule 26(d)(4), not Rule 16(d), governed the late Kroger expert report, which was properly excluded.

A Northamptonshire couple had to walk home after their wedding when police stopped their car for speeding and found the driver had no insurance. The couple were reportedly in high spirits and took a selfie with the officer before leaving.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Ampere GA10x GPU architecture, including GA102 and GA104, and highlights improvements over Turing in FP32 throughput, ray tracing, tensor performance, cache, memory bandwidth, power efficiency, and media features. It also covers RTX 30-series and professional GPUs, RTX IO, display support, NVDEC/NVENC, and EDR technology.

The president returned a bill to refund the national debt with objections, saying that while refunding was important, section 5 would seriously harm the national banking system by limiting banks to 3 percent bonds as security. He warned this would discourage new banks, weaken existing ones, reduce the security of bank notes, and risk damaging the country’s prosperity.

The paper studies LLM-based detection and fixing of API misuses in data science libraries, proposing DSCHECKER, which combines API directives and dynamic variable information. On the DSMISUSES dataset, the best results came from llama with full prompts, achieving 61.18% detection F1-score and 51.28% fix rate. Few-shot prompting helped some models but not consistently, and DSCHECKER also outperformed LLMAPIDET on the dataset. An agentic version, DSCHECKERagent, worked in a more realistic setting but with lower performance.

The passage discusses game strategy, emphasizing scoring first, avoiding mistakes, and feeding off a charged crowd. It also mentions family life during the playoffs and notes the significance of two European goalies facing each other, with one set to win the Cup.

A study of 2,066 millennial twins in England and Wales found that lonely millennials had twice the risk of mental health problems such as depression and anxiety, and a 38% higher risk of unemployment. It also found loneliness was linked to risky behaviours, and the researchers said early intervention may help prevent loneliness from lasting into later life.

Rice University and HMNS have partnered since 1988 on space-science outreach, including teacher programs, eclipse animations, and the fulldome show “Totality.” For the 2023–2024 Heliophysics Big Year, they expanded eclipse education through websites, teacher workshops, public events, free viewers, and Citizen CATE 2024 participation. They reported more than 1.5 million total reach, 5,405 teacher users, and over 180,000 views for the “Totality” show.

Sean McVay said Todd Gurley will get more preseason carries and “progressive work” as the Rams prepare him for their Sept. 10 opener against the Colts. Gurley had four carries against the Cowboys, said he felt good, and McVay emphasized balancing his workload to keep him ready and healthy.

The passage focuses on California’s energy crisis, including Gov. Gray Davis’s plan to buy utility transmission lines, federal approval concerns, warnings that shortages could worsen in summer, and reports that wholesale suppliers may have overcharged utilities by more than $500 million. It also describes PG&E’s partial payments to creditors and mounting pressure on generators to forgive debt or face bankruptcy-related losses.

Researchers found that island flying foxes help durian trees by pollinating their flowers, rather than damaging them. Camera traps in Malaysia showed the bats feeding on nectar without harming flowers, and the study says they improve durian reproductive success.

A Finnish study of 2,480 men found that higher blood linoleic acid, an omega-6 fatty acid, was linked to a 43% lower risk of premature death and a reduced risk of cardiovascular death, but not cancer death, over an average 22-year follow-up.

The lecture reviews inverse, ill-posed problems and gives examples including recovering velocity from noisy position data, seismology, medical imaging, gravity measurements, scattering, coefficient recovery in differential equations, GPS, and genomics. It emphasizes that noise can greatly affect solutions and introduces Tikhonov regularization, minimizing \(Ax-b\)^2 + \(\alpha x^2\), with a balance between over- and under-regularization.

The passage describes opioid misuse, MOR as a drug target, and [11C]carfentanil PET imaging, then outlines a study using whole-body PennPET Explorer imaging to examine extra-CNS reference regions in healthy adults. It details participant screening, MRI, tracer preparation, PET acquisition, and brain image analysis, including VOIs and DVR/%RO calculations.

Mitch Larkin is considering adding the individual medley to his Commonwealth Games trials program while staying focused on backstroke. He won the 400m IM at the Queensland titles, said he is hungry for redemption after a difficult year and Olympic disappointment, and believes his move to Dean Boxall’s high-volume program has reignited his motivation.

Ventura police will review their procedures after a man was fatally stabbed in a crowded steakhouse by a homeless suspect. Chief Ken Corney said officers should have responded in person to earlier reports about the suspect. Jamal Jackson, 49, is charged with murder in the April 18 stabbing of 35-year-old Anthony Mele.

A total solar eclipse on Aug. 21 will cross the U.S. coast to coast for the first time in 99 years, drawing major public and scientific attention. The path of totality will cover 14 states, with darkness lasting up to 2 minutes 44 seconds, and NASA will broadcast the event while crowds, events, and travel are expected along the route.

Canon’s EOS M6 is an entry-level mirrorless camera replacing the M3, with a 24.2-megapixel Dual Pixel CMOS sensor, Digic 7 processor, optional viewfinder, revised body, and 3.2-inch touchscreen. It is set to ship in April 2017 starting at $780 body-only, but the passage says Sony’s A5100 and A6000 offer similar or better value, making the M6 hard to justify at its higher price.

The lecture defines additive energy as the number of additive quadruples in Abelian groups, shows that small doubling implies large additive energy, and explains that the Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers theorem recovers a large subset with small doubling from large additive energy. It proves this via a graphical version using dense bipartite graphs, restricted sumsets, and path-length lemmas based on dependent random choice.

The passage describes how IT-based simulation, modeling, data analysis, and HPC help manufacturing enterprises improve innovation, quality, efficiency, and development speed, while also noting challenges such as data silos, security risks, high costs, energy use, and limited flexibility. It says cloud-based and hybrid HPC architectures are expected to become increasingly important for scalability and agility, and that many firms plan further investment in these technologies.

Deion Sanders underwent a blood clot procedure and said he hopes to return to practice the next day and be on the sideline this weekend. He said his leg was in pain during Colorado’s loss at TCU and noted he has had blood clot issues before.

Oncosec Medical Cmn (NASDAQ:ONCS) fell 12.71% in the latest session. Analysts project a 52-week target of $5.33, with targets ranging from $5 to $6, versus a latest close of $1.58. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 1 from 4 recommendations, all 3 analyst ratings being Outperform. Its ATR-14 is 0.15, weekly volatility is 6.79%, monthly volatility is 8.05%, RSI is 33.61, market capitalization is $54.72 million, shares outstanding are 34.63 million, and volume was 4.56 million versus an average of 2.4 million.

Scientists kept a tiny slice of mammalian cochlea alive outside the body for the first time and directly observed sound amplification in hair cells. The study found that a Hopf bifurcation drives the active process in the mammalian cochlea, confirming a principle of hearing and suggesting new paths for hearing-loss treatments.

NVIDIA Ampere adds BF16, TF32, and FP64 to Tensor Cores. BF16 and FP16 support mixed-precision training matching FP32 results, with 16x more throughput than FP32 on A100. TF32 enables default tensor-core AI training using FP32 inputs and outputs, while AMP still allows FP16 mixed precision with minimal code changes.

The passage describes memory arrays with vertically alternating insulating tiers and memory cells, where each cell includes a transistor with a horizontally oriented channel and a capacitor. It discloses several array configurations in which sense-line structures and/or capacitor-electrode structures extend through multiple tiers to electrically couple transistors or capacitors across tiers, including embodiments with stacked cells within a tier and multiple gates per cell.

The president thanked local officials and union workers in Pittsburgh, said unions built the middle class, and outlined a vision to rebuild America through the American Rescue Plan and a $2 trillion American Jobs Plan. He described investments in infrastructure, clean energy, high-speed internet, lead pipe replacement, care work, research and development, and job creation, and proposed financing it through higher corporate taxes, a global minimum tax, and stronger IRS enforcement while keeping taxes unchanged for people making under $400,000.

Each digital I/O maps to a specific PINCMx register for configuring pin function with PINCM.PF control bits. The IOMUX supports only one IOMUX-managed digital function per pin at a time, and PINCM.PF and PINCM.PC should be set to 0 when using non-IOMUX functions. Non-IOMUX signals such as analog inputs and WAKE inputs may be enabled alongside an IOMUX-managed digital function if there is no contention.

The XPIC delays clearing the IRR bit until one clock after the second interrupt acknowledge pulse, which can cause two interrupts to be sent to the CPU when AEOI is used. AEOI is bit 1 of ICW4, can only be enabled on the master PIC, and should be used only when nested multilevel interrupts are not needed.

The passage describes an automated storage, retrieval, and processing system with storage bins, destination bins, conveyance systems, and a programmable motion device that moves objects from selected storage bins to selected destination bins. It also describes perception-based grasp selection and planning, including use of surface normals and fiducial features such as barcodes, and multiple system configurations with separate, shared, or multiple storage, destination, and processing sections controlled by computer systems.

The President says only 653 troops, excluding marines, were assembled in Washington and that they were ordered there as a civil-support force to preserve peace and order before or during the inauguration of the President elect. He says the committee found no proof of a secret plot to attack the capital, but the reported danger and the need to protect public property, government archives, and the inauguration justified the precautionary measure.

Bear markets are described as shorter than bull markets but marked by higher volatility, sharp selloffs, and quick recoveries that can take years. The passage says traders can benefit from increased volatility, while long-term investors can buy stocks at lower prices. It cites the 2000–2003 bear market as an example, including major declines in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq.

An Arizona man, Douglas Haig, was charged with conspiracy to manufacture and sell armor-piercing ammunition without a license, allegedly supplying ammunition to Las Vegas gunman Stephen Paddock before the October 1 shooting that killed 58 people and wounded hundreds. Haig was released on bail pending a February 15 hearing and faces up to five years in prison and a $250,000 fine if convicted.

The writ was not considered because it was untimely filed under La.S.Ct.R. X § 5. The court stated that the relator has exhausted state post-conviction relief, and any successive application is allowed only under narrow exceptions in La. C.Cr.P. arts. 930.4 and 930.8. The district court was ordered to make a minute entry consistent with the ruling.

β-Ga2O3 has a wide bandgap, high breakdown field, and strong promise for power and optoelectronic devices, but low thermal conductivity creates thermal management challenges. Using first-principles-based machine-learning potentials and phonon BTE, the study finds that strain gradients suppress thermal conductivity more strongly than uniform strain while largely preserving thermal anisotropy, due to symmetry breaking and enhanced phonon scattering.

The passage says startup founders seeking investment should focus on ROI, the strength and presentation of themselves and their team, market opportunities, and a detailed strategy. It emphasizes showing credibility, traction, and a clear business plan with facts, figures, and awareness of risks and competition.

Hong Kong stocks closed slightly higher, with gains in shipping, Tencent, and banks offset by weakness in property shares. The Hang Seng rose 0.2 percent and the China Enterprises Index 0.1 percent, while real estate fell 0.2 percent amid tighter property curbs and Moody’s warning of rising risks from a potential property downturn.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated July 20, 2017, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2017. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and was not deemed filed under the Exchange Act.

UCLA researchers found that altering hair follicle stem cell metabolism to increase lactate can activate the cells and speed hair growth in mice. They identified two preclinical drugs, RCGD423 and UK5099, that promoted lactate production and hair growth, with no human testing or FDA approval yet.

Colgate-Palmolive’s revenues and earnings are improving, and analysts have turned more bullish, with Argus setting a $72 target and revenue and profit growth expected over the next few years. However, the passage argues CL remains a no-moat business facing stronger competition from e-commerce and niche products, making the stock risky despite its stable dividend history and consumer loyalty.

The DEBUGSS subsystem provides SWD debugging, a mailbox for communication with software, and security features such as SWD lockout and password-authenticated debugging. The FACTORY region stores read-only device capability, identification, and trim data, including DEVICEID and USERID values. The document also gives typical application guidance, development resources, device nomenclature, revision history, and mechanical and packaging information.

The speaker said the team had traffic, shots, and rebound chances but could not score the third goal, though they stayed with it. He also said the team settled in after a shaky start, liked their energy and territorial control, praised their play against a strong opponent, and noted the importance of controlled emotion, staying in the moment, and trusting leadership and routines.

European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker said India’s 5.7% GDP growth should not be called a slowdown, noting it is better than Europe’s 2% growth. The passage says this came amid criticism in India over growth slowing to a three-year low due to demonetisation and GST, while the World Bank President called the slowdown temporary and Yashwant Sinha described the economy as a “mess.”

Officials raised the AJC Peachtree Road Race alert to Code Red - Dangerous, advising runners to slow down, follow course changes and event instructions, and consider stopping if necessary. The 49th race was expected to have a dry morning with upper-80s temperatures, and the $70,000 prize purse would go to American athletes only, with top male and female winners each receiving $10,000.

The lecture reviews digital communication, source coding, and channel coding, then focuses on discrete source coding for a reliable binary channel. It contrasts fixed-length codes, variable-length codes, prefix-free codes, and uniquely decodable codes, presents the Kraft inequality, and introduces discrete memoryless IID sources as the next topic for probability-based coding.

The shallow cross concept pairs a basic route and a shallow drag to stress linebackers and create options against man and zone coverage. It can help quarterbacks get the ball out quickly against blitzes, with progressions that usually read downfield first and then move to the drag, basic route, and checkdown. It works well against man, Tampa 2, and Cover 4, but not as well against Cover 3. Variations include a bunch set and an empty post-wheel version.

The lecture explains that green buildings can create value for tenants, owners, and developers through higher willingness to pay, higher rents, lower vacancy, lower operating costs, lower risk, and higher resale value, which can raise NPV. It also emphasizes that these effects vary by case and market conditions, and introduces information asymmetry as a market failure that can lead to greenwashing and adverse selection, with certification presented as a solution.

A WIS special on Total Eclipse Columbia will air at 7:30 p.m. and explain the safety and science of the total solar eclipse. The passage says Columbia is directly in the path of totality on Aug. 21, when the moon will cover the sun and create daytime darkness.

Brea Police are using a new all-electric Polaris Gem Global Motorcar to patrol The Tracks at Brea trail, the downtown entertainment district, and park trails. The vehicle, introduced at the Centennial Parade, costs about $21,000, reaches 25 mph, travels 98 miles per charge, and was purchased with Air Quality Management District funds.

The passage argues that learning assessment is uncommon in noncredit continuing education but can be done through clear, measurable learning outcomes, outcome-focused surveys, and direct assessment activities. It gives examples and concludes that such assessment can improve courses, support decisions, and strengthen credentialing and resource arguments.

BG Group agreed to buy Enron’s offshore Indian oil and gas assets for $388 million, including stakes in the Tapti and Panna/Mukta fields and the CB-OS/1 exploration block. Enron is also seeking to sell its Dabhol Power stake, while reports said Dabhol had defaulted on a $24 million interest payment.

The lecture reviews eigenvalues and eigenvectors for Markov chains, showing that for block upper-diagonal transition matrices the eigenvalues are those of the transient and recurrent submatrices, and that left eigenvectors of a recurrent submatrix extend to the full chain. It then introduces rewards in Markov chains, expected aggregate reward, and first-passage time as a reward problem by making the target state a trapping state. Finally, it presents dynamic programming as an optimal decision process over finite time horizons, where the optimal reward is found by solving backward from the final step.

The application discloses methods, apparatuses, communication nodes, and a storage medium for sending and receiving report information including first type power parameter information or uplink channel state information. The report supports base-station scheduling to determine maximum power reduction and reduce human-body exposure impacts, including embodiments involving power headroom, virtual power headroom, antenna groups, reference signals, and triggering or configuration conditions for reports.

Bill Purswell’s conviction for transporting intoxicating liquor was affirmed. The court held that a search-and-seizure objection is personal to the owner or possessor of the premises, that a lawful arrest for a felony committed in an officer’s presence permits search without a warrant, and that appellant’s charge complaint was too general. On rehearing, the court found no shown jury misconduct and overruled the motion.

The appeal from the order denying Dairylea Cooperative’s motion to quash an Attorney-General subpoena was held proper, and the court affirmed the order. The court found that a sufficient request had been made by the Commissioner of Agriculture and Markets under Executive Law § 63(3), authorizing the subpoena.

The passage describes Enron’s rise from a pipeline company to a dominant trading firm under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling, driven by deregulation, aggressive recruiting, and a high-pressure culture. It also details Enron’s later troubles, including criticism of its accounting, failed ventures, falling stock price, and Skilling’s abrupt resignation after six months as CEO.

South Dakota’s Board of Regents directed staff and officials from the state’s two largest universities to prepare a plan to close the jointly operated Capital University Center in Pierre, with the plan due at the next board meeting. The discussion arose during a planning meeting in Pierre, where some regents said a wind-down was needed and one said the issue should no longer be delayed.

The company said safety protocols were followed, all personnel were safe, and no other facilities were impacted. Firefly’s stock has now pulled back more than 50% since its Nasdaq debut last month.

Its main strength is creating double teams and leverage to outnumber the defense, while its main weakness is backside pursuit and penetration, especially against odd fronts. It concludes that improving these usability issues may increase user satisfaction, engagement, and customer retention.

Other area election results included municipal races in Altus and Walters and school board races in several Southwest Oklahoma districts.

The ratio remained at a record 170.4 per cent in late 2017, slightly below the previous quarter’s peak, and the central bank continues to view high household debt as a major concern.

At the Republican National Convention, he accepted the nomination and said his top priority would be protecting Americans while pursuing peace through strength.

Kurtzman, that the Act is severable, has not been impliedly repealed, and can be constitutionally administered.

Cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash were $3.22 billion at quarter end, and total assets were $27.27 billion. It reported increased vehicle deliveries and customer deposits, a May 2016 common stock offering that raised about $1.7 billion, and subsequent July 31, 2016 agreement to acquire SolarCity.

Clemson passed for 399 yards, while UNC managed only 213 passing yards and 2-of-11 on third downs. Belichick said the team must keep grinding and praised its effort despite the blowout.

It argues the West should intensify sanctions and target the hidden assets of Putin’s associates in Britain and America.

The passage presents a periodically modulated coupled SSH-chain system that uses inversion symmetry and time-dependent interchain symmetry to produce braided topological edge states, enabling symmetry-protected adiabatic transport. After resolving operational problems and rebuilding staff and stakeholder confidence, the company has returned to acquisitions, including Prolift Access Limited and Platform Sales & Hire Limited, and expects further sustainable profitable growth.

Clark County schools are deciding at the school level how to spend new state weighted funding for students learning English and living in poverty. Garside Junior High received more than $450,000, and staff are considering uses such as more after-school tutoring and technology. Clark County schools received more than $34 million of the state’s $36 million allocation.

Researchers at Cornell are exploring bovine mammary stem cell secretions as an alternative mastitis therapy because antibiotics kill bacteria but do not repair damaged tissue. Their study found the secreted factors may promote tissue healing, blood vessel formation, cell migration, and antimicrobial activity, and could complement existing antibiotics.

The President transmits a treaty for annexation of Hawaii and urges Senate ratification, saying the monarchy had become weak and its restoration would be undesirable. He argues annexation is the best way to protect U.S. and Hawaiian interests, secure peace and order, and prevent other powers from gaining the islands.

Sunshine Coast Lightning will play Greater Western Sydney after a fortnight’s wait, and Bassett says the time has brought sleepless nights but also let her take it in. Geva Mentor and Laura Langman have helped prepare her, while Mentor has been training against tall Queensland men’s player Junior Levi to ready for the Giants’ offence.
