The system will collect data to improve vehicle communication with roads, signals, other cars, and pedestrians, with plans to use the findings for a highway infrastructure project in 2020.

The Dow dropped nearly 400 points, the Nasdaq fell 2.09%, and all 11 major S&P sectors declined amid trade-war worries, higher volatility, and caution ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting.

Officials said Juul is popular with youth, contains high nicotine levels, and the agency will also target misleading marketing and work on youth education and reducing tobacco product appeal.

Most schedules rely on long-running favourites such as Strictly and The X Factor, which are valuable despite declining ratings, and no major new format has emerged in the last decade except possibly The Voice UK.

Merkel agreed to close asylum transit camps near the Austrian border and to send rejected asylum seekers back through negotiated arrangements, prompting concern within the SPD and raising tensions with Austria and other EU states over migration policy.

Emergency services said the blaze spread across 15 kilometers and occurred in the planned fallout zone, while Roscosmos said the death was linked to difficult weather conditions and strong wind.

It held that objections to witness competency were insufficiently specific and that some testimony by James E. and Elizabeth Siver was admissible, and it also denied a request to retax costs against the administratrix individually.

Szemerédi’s graph regularity lemma says that for every ε, every graph has an ε-regular partition into at most M parts, where M depends only on ε. An equitable version is also discussed, with parts differing in size by at most 1.

The company completed its Nuance acquisition, announced workforce reductions of about 10,000 jobs, and said its share repurchase program had $31.5 billion remaining as of December 31, 2022.

The Bollinger Band Squeeze strategy looks for breakouts after low volatility, but the passage says backtests did not perform well on most assets and did not beat buy-and-hold for Pepsi. It is described as a breakout strategy that can produce whipsaws, and the passage says all assets behave differently, so it may work on some but not others.

A U.S. representative reports growing alarm in Korea, the arrival of U.S., Chinese, and Japanese warships at Chemulpo, and concern that unrest may be serious. The passage then includes a petition from Confucian scholars condemning heterodox influence and urging authorities to arrest its leaders, followed by an order stressing obedience to the law, loyalty, filial piety, and the duty to sacrifice life for king and parents.

Butterfield reported strong Q1 2018 results, with core return on average tangible common equity of 24.3%, net interest margin rising to 3.05%, and total assets about $11 billion. Management highlighted successful completion of the Deutsche Bank Global Trust Solutions acquisition, progress on another banking acquisition, stable fee income, benign credit conditions, and continued focus on expense control, capital deployment, and further acquisitions.

The speaker praises Andy as a key player who overcame injuries, stepped up in the playoffs, and plays hard and physically. The speaker says the game will be emotional and loud, but the team must stay controlled, avoid panicking, and play their usual game. The passage also notes that hockey is popular in Newfoundland and that another team there is expected to draw fans and help the local economy.

Pedro Russell, after an unconventional education and career path, co-founded GPS Partners to acquire education businesses, focusing on MedPro Institute, a for-profit medical technical school near Boston. MedPro offers vocational certificate programs and relies mostly on word of mouth for student recruitment. During due diligence, Russell identified major cost items and noted they include fixed, variable, and capped or mixed cost patterns, which he needed to assess before deciding on the acquisition.

Hammerson said it received a highly preliminary, non-binding £4.88bn cash-and-share proposal from Klépierre on 8 March and unanimously rejected it as undervaluing the company. The offer implied 615p per share, about 41% above Hammerson’s March 16 closing price, and Hammerson’s shares rose to around 545p after the news. Hammerson remains committed to its Intu Properties acquisition and said it prefers to be an acquirer rather than an acquiree.

Cory Booker campaigned in Alabama for Doug Jones, while also using the trip to build visibility for a possible 2020 presidential bid. The passage says Alabama and other Deep South states can be important in Democratic primaries because African-American voters there can be decisive, as in the 2008 and 2016 contests.

The passage discusses a goaltending opportunity created by Roli’s situation, with the speaker emphasizing confidence, staying focused, and treating it as a chance rather than dwelling on a bad play. It notes the difficulty of practicing game speed, the importance of preparation and confidence, and that Roli will still help by sharing tendencies and observations.

The Second Circuit reversed a tax deficiency against Pfeiffer, holding that a 1931 preferred-stock dividend on common stock was exempt from tax under section 115(f) of the Revenue Act of 1928. It rejected the Commissioner’s attempt to tax the 1931 distribution and declined to treat the 1931 redemption of 1928 dividend shares as taxable, while Judge L. Hand dissented and would have upheld the Board.

Dan Le Batard said the Miami Heat believed LeBron James had “checked out” during the 2014 NBA Finals because he knew he was leaving. The passage links that claim to James’s current situation with the Cavaliers and says it may be worth monitoring whether he would do the same again if his team reached the Finals and seemed likely to lose.

Bitcoin rose to about 1% below its all-time high at $123,874 as the U.S. government shutdown entered its third day, with investors treating it as a hedge amid political and economic tensions. Standard Chartered said bitcoin has been trading with “US government risks” and expects a new high soon.

The court held that failure to present a claim against an estate within the statutory period does not extinguish the debt, only the remedy. It also ruled that an executor cannot use equity to force a creditor to surrender trust-deed security or stop a sale, and reversed the injunction. Justice Crockett dissented, arguing the lien should be lost if the claim is not presented.

Google canceled Daily Stormer’s website registration for violating policies against inciting violence, after GoDaddy gave the neo-Nazi site 24 hours to find a new host. YouTube also terminated the site’s channel, while Facebook said it removes its links unless clearly condemned. The actions followed pressure after Daily Stormer’s hateful post about Heather Heyer and the Charlottesville violence.

Investigators found red-stained bedding and an empty Coricidin cold medicine box in the North Carolina home where Matthew James Phelps, 29, said he woke from a medicated stupor to find his wife Lauren, 29, stabbed dead. He called 911 early on September 1, said he may have killed her after taking cough medicine, and is awaiting trial on first-degree murder charges without bail.

The passage describes bonded optical devices for wearable electronics, where monochromatic LED or microLED optical elements are directly or hybrid bonded to carriers such as processor dies without adhesive to enable very fine pixel pitches, active pixel control, and superimposed multi-color images through optical pathways like waveguides.

Transport CS James Macharia blamed the boda boda menace on poor enforcement of existing regulations and said the ministry is working with county transport committees and the traffic department to improve implementation. Ruiru MP Simon King'ara called for a separate motorbike safety authority, said NTSA is overwhelmed, and noted the ongoing dispute between riders and county governments, including Nairobi’s CBD ban.

The IRS said it is furloughing nearly half its workforce because of the ongoing government shutdown. About 34,000 workers are furloughed, while 39,870 employees, or 53.6% of the workforce, remain on the job.

The GA10x SM adds third-generation Tensor Cores, doubled FP32 throughput, larger L1/shared memory, and improved concurrency for compute, graphics, and ray tracing. GA10x GPUs also feature second-generation RT Cores, hardware-accelerated motion blur, GDDR6X memory, RTX IO, AV1 decode, NVENC, and other performance and efficiency improvements over Turing.

The study reviews public financing instruments for innovative cleantech start-ups and SMEs in Europe, mainly under Horizon 2020. It finds that loan-based and equity-based financing are most common, with some grants and guarantees, and that instruments are managed mainly by the EIB and EIF. Many also provide non-financial support such as coaching, advisory services, and business acceleration, and most target SMEs, while some also target research institutions.

The speaker describes the Johnstown flood devastation in Pennsylvania and urges sympathy and charity. He reports a $2,000 relief offer from Jacksonville and proposes collecting food, clothing, and money in Washington for immediate aid and later rebuilding, noting he has already sent his own subscription to Johnstown.

The Tennessee National Wildlife Refuge headquarters and Visitor Center will be closed on Monday, August 21 for the solar eclipse. Visitors are directed to Cross Creeks National Wildlife Refuge in Dover, where staff and volunteers will assist with parking and information, and special glasses will be needed for full viewing. The eclipse partial phase begins at 11:56 am CDT, totality at 1:25 am CDT, and totality will last about 55 seconds.

The Louisiana Fourth Circuit affirmed William Brock’s conviction and ten-year hard-labor sentence for molestation of a juvenile, finding the evidence sufficient to prove the offense and the sentence not constitutionally excessive.

The study examined education faculty students’ attitudes toward the Research Methods in Education course using mixed methods. Attitudes did not differ by department but did differ by grade level, with a difference between first- and fourth-year students. Most participants said the course was necessary, helped their personal and scientific research skills, and that course duration was insufficient.

Centrica’s stock price has fallen 35% in a year, giving it an 8.6% dividend yield, but its outlook remains uncertain amid regulatory and business-model change. Volution reported interim revenue growth of 11.6%, raised adjusted operating profit 6.7%, acquired Simx Limited, and may have scope for faster dividend growth despite a current 2.2% yield.

In his final press conference, President Bush thanked the press corps and discussed the TARP request, Gaza, North Korea, the Republican Party, his record and mistakes, the financial crisis, U.S. moral standing, pardons, protectionism, New Orleans recovery, race, and President-Elect Obama. He said he would not request the remaining $350 billion unless Obama asked, supported a sustainable cease-fire in Gaza, believed the main security threat remained an attack on the U.S. homeland, and said Obama would feel the presidency’s burden quickly.

The court held that the defendants were no longer Colorado residents when served in California, so the California service of summons was invalid and the trial court lacked personal jurisdiction. The rule to show cause was made absolute.

This survey of 133 entry-level occupational therapy students found current mentorship was often insufficient, especially for students from historically underrepresented groups. Students wanted mentors with cultural humility, awareness of bias, empathy, anti-racism support, relevant experience, and help with transitions to practice, discrimination, and work-life balance. The study concludes that occupational therapy programs should implement culturally sensitive, hybrid mentorship programs and provide mentor training and institutional support to improve inclusion, belonging, and professional outcomes.

The passage lists financial and business headlines, including warnings about an AI bubble, record-high European markets driven by steel and banks, gold rising above $4,000 on Fed easing expectations, and Germany opening an antitrust probe into Temu. It also includes repeated publication and promotional text about financial news outlets.

The Sensex and Nifty closed slightly lower, while five stocks—AIA Engineering, Alkem Laboratories, KEC International, Exide Industries, and Kalpataru Power Transmission—hit new 52-week highs during an otherwise flat market. AIA Engineering and Alkem Laboratories rose after reporting higher profits, while the other three reached highs in early trade but ended lower or nearly unchanged.

Royal Rumble 2017 at the Alamodome is expected to feature Goldberg, Brock Lesnar, and John Cena, with The Undertaker expected and Shawn Michaels rumored to appear. The confirmed card includes AJ Styles vs. John Cena for the WWE Championship, Kevin Owens vs. Roman Reigns for the WWE Universal Championship with Chris Jericho suspended in a shark cage, and the 30-man Royal Rumble match.

Bad weather in southern England and northern Europe caused major travel disruption for Bath Rugby fans returning from Toulon after their 24-20 Champions Cup loss to Toulon. Many flights from Marseille, Nice and Amsterdam were cancelled or delayed, forcing supporters to take complicated routes by plane and train, and some were still stranded in France days later.

China tightened rare earth export controls ahead of an expected Xi-Trump meeting, and U.S. rare earth and critical mineral miners surged on speculation the White House may invest more in domestic supply chains. The restrictions require licenses for certain products and technologies, while U.S. companies said they are in close contact with the administration.

The passage describes two fatal Boeing 737 MAX 8 crashes in 2018 and 2019 that killed 346 people, linked to MCAS software, Boeing’s design and training decisions, and FAA certification weaknesses. It also outlines Boeing’s history, competition with Airbus, the rushed MAX development process, the aircraft’s grounding for 21 months, its later return to service, and the financial and reputational damage that followed.

The passage describes a hockey player’s return after months out of action, his desire to stay with the Detroit Red Wings, and the tense negotiations that ended when Detroit matched an offer. He says he was excited to rejoin the team, play again, and win back fans. It also mentions seeing Vladi in the stands during a game, which he found inspirational.

The passage presents a three-phase hybrid constraint acquisition framework that uses passive learning to generate candidate global constraints from examples, query-driven interactive refinement to reject or refine over-fitted candidates via oracle feedback, and final active learning to complete the model. It introduces confidence scoring, Bayesian updates, subset exploration, and adaptive query budgeting to improve accuracy while limiting query cost.

The passage reviews literature on research expectations and reports a survey of U.S. mathematics education faculty. Expectations vary by institution type, department type, and research commitment. On average, faculty are expected to publish about 1.64 papers per year, with research journal articles valued most; presentations and external funding often count, while professional development is valued little. R1 faculty typically have higher expectations, R2 faculty are more likely to have publication expectations written down, and faculty at Other institutions have the lowest publication expectations.

The study examined orbital and spin Edelstein effects in gated, doped monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides using a five-orbital tight-binding model fitted to DFT. Broken mirror symmetry produces chiral spin/orbital textures and a nonzero in-plane Edelstein response. The orbital response is generally larger than the spin response, especially for electron doping, and hole-doped responses are strongly enhanced when the Γ valley is occupied, which can be achieved by compressive strain.

Keltner Channels are a technical analysis tool created by Chester Keltner in the 1960s and later used to assess volatility, trend direction, and potential overbought or oversold conditions. They consist of three lines, expand and contract with ATR-based volatility, are not designed to repaint, and are often used for entry and exit signals, scalping, swing trading, momentum, and mean reversion. The passage says a common setting is a 20-period EMA with a 2.0 ATR multiplier, notes that settings can be customized, and describes a backtest with a 77% win rate, though profitability depends on market conditions and risk management.

On December 12, 2016, NVIDIA entered into a termination agreement with Goldman, Sachs & Co. to terminate 63,259,180.62 outstanding warrants issued under two 2013 warrant transactions. In exchange, NVIDIA will deliver shares of common stock to Goldman based on the daily volume-weighted average price during the period from December 13, 2016 to January 31, 2017.

Government shutdowns have usually had little economic impact, but this one could be different because Trump has threatened permanent furloughs, which may affect the labor market and create more uncertainty. A prolonged shutdown could also delay key economic data, including jobs and inflation reports, affecting the Federal Reserve and Social Security adjustments.

A Netflix documentary follows a Michigan high school catfishing case in which Lauryn Licari received months of hateful, threatening texts that led to a long investigation involving local officials and the FBI, including phone forensic examination. The passage also discusses cellphone risks for teens, Oklahoma’s new school cellphone ban, and concerns about cellphones contributing to crime.

The passage lists financial and technology headlines, including JPMorgan’s AI integration, the Bank of England’s largest six-month repo since 2020, and Opera’s Neon AI browser launch. It also notes U.S. and European stock gains, BOE liquidity demand, Moldova’s economy expanding 1.1% in the second quarter, and OpenAI’s parental controls update.

The Fabian market timing model, developed by Richard Fabian in the 1960s, is a rule-based, long-term trend-following strategy for the stock market using the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and utilities sector. It is based on 39-week moving averages, with trades executed at the end of each week. The passage says the model has performed well, with low volatility and low maximum drawdown, and emphasizes the importance of discipline in following the system.

A House subcommittee advanced a proposal to raise pension contributions for South Carolina public employees and employers, with employer rates increasing sharply to help close a $24 billion pension gap. The House also advanced a bill recognizing concealed weapons permits from all 50 states. Separately, the Senate passed a bill for Coastal Carolina University championship license plates to support scholarships, and a similar Clemson plate bill is also proposed.

Chelsea will face Barcelona in the Champions League last 16, with the first legs scheduled for February 13/14 or 20/21 and the second legs for March 6/7 or 13/14. Barcelona topped Group D with 14 points, while Chelsea finished second in Group C behind Roma. The teams last met in 2012, when Chelsea progressed to the final after a 3-2 aggregate win. Lionel Messi is highlighted as Barcelona’s star player.

The passage describes how voronoi honeycomb models were used to study osteoporosis by modeling trabecular bone loss, showing that randomness affects strength more than modulus, and that removing struts lowers properties more than thinning them. It also discusses 3D models, perturbed models resembling vertebral bone, metal foams as possible bone substitutes or implant coatings, and a study using trabecular bone architecture in a fossil ilium to infer possible bipedalism.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2021 reported $57.8 billion in total assets, $29.3 billion in total liabilities, and $27.1 billion in stockholders’ equity. For the quarter, revenue was $13.8 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders was $1.6 billion. Tesla adopted ASU 2020-06 on January 1, 2021, purchased $1.5 billion of bitcoin during the nine months ended September 30, 2021, and had convertible debt conversions and repayments during the period.

The article examines dialogue in education through cases from music and mathematics, arguing that epistemological and ontological dialogue both support participation, Bildung, and democratic citizenship.

The speaker argues that the United States should help establish a lasting world peace through a league or covenant, but only under conditions that make peace secure and just. He says the present war must end in a “peace without victory,” since peace imposed by a victor would create resentment and instability, while only a peace between equals and a community of power can endure.

A 19-year-old woman was sexually assaulted on a train from Weston-super-Mare to Taunton when a man from a group touched her inappropriately near Highbridge and Burnham. Passengers intervened, the assault stopped, and British Transport Police are appealing for witnesses after the incident on April 8 at about 4.45pm.

The lecture explains how gravitational waves are the transverse-traceless part of a metric perturbation, with two polarizations, and how they affect freely falling bodies through geodesic deviation rather than direct acceleration in a coordinate system. It describes how LIGO measures the waves via changes in light travel time between mirrors, and derives the quadrupole formula, showing that the radiative field is determined by the second time derivative of the source’s quadrupole moment projected transverse to the propagation direction.

Researchers reported that TRPM8 and TRPP3 on human brown fat cells may be drug targets for increasing brown adipose tissue and potentially helping treat obesity, diabetes, and related metabolic disorders. In experiments with human precursor cells, TRPM8 activation promoted browning, while blocking TRPM8 or eliminating TRPP3 prevented brown fat formation.

Whangarei District Council says winter brings parking congestion around Kensington Park and that, without plans to increase parking, it will use warning fliers before issuing tickets for parking infringements. It advises drivers to plan ahead, car pool, drop players off, or park and walk back.

JKPSC kept in abeyance the result of the Combined Competitive (Preliminary) Examination, 2016 and withdrew the notification for the main examination after discrepancies were found in question papers and answer keys. It will refer all papers and keys to independent experts for re-evaluation, and the next date for the main examination will be notified after the report is received.

Lyminster Primary School was told by Ofsted it requires improvement after a May inspection, despite noting positive changes under new headteacher Steven McGinley and saying the school is well placed to improve rapidly. McGinley said the report gives a clear focus, praised staff, pupils and parents, and said the school is confident it can bounce back to good.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended April 1, 2023, reporting net sales of $94.8 billion and net income of $24.2 billion for the quarter. Compared with the prior year, total net sales decreased 3%, with higher Services revenue partly offsetting lower Mac sales. The company reported total assets of $332.2 billion, cash generated by operating activities of $62.6 billion for the first six months, and repurchased $38.1 billion of common stock during that period.

Bluehole has launched a PUBG community event on Xbox One called Snipe City, asking players to achieve 400,000 collective kills with the M24 and Kar98 rifles. Players who participate and earn at least 1 BP are eligible for rewards if the goal is met, including the Bloody Tank Top, Padded Jacket, and two Militia Crates. The event runs until July 10, with updates on July 6 and July 9 and results on July 11.

Zacks Investment Research upgraded State Bank Financial Corporation (NASDAQ:STBZ) from sell to buy and set a $30 price target, while Hovde Group lowered its rating to market perform and cut its target to $24.50. The company reported quarterly EPS of $0.34, paid a $0.14 dividend, and had shares open at $26.86.

The court affirmed the divorce and custody award to the father, upheld jurisdiction, and found no reversible error in the jury trial on custody. It reversed and remanded the property division because the trial court failed to consider the value of goodwill in John Geesbreght’s professional corporation stock.

NVIDIA reported second-quarter fiscal 2019 revenue of $3.123 billion, net income of $1.101 billion, and diluted EPS of $1.76, compared with $2.230 billion, $583 million, and $0.92 a year earlier. Revenue rose in both GPU and Tegra Processor segments, driven by gaming, datacenter, professional visualization, and automotive, while operating expenses increased and the effective tax rate declined. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $7.943 billion as of July 29, 2018, and the company repurchased shares and paid dividends during the first half of fiscal 2019.

Asian shares fell as investors sold U.S. technology stocks on regulation fears, with Facebook dropping after reports of improper user-data access. Markets also awaited Jerome Powell’s first Fed meeting and watched for possible U.S. protectionist trade measures. U.S. and Asian stock indexes declined, while the euro and pound rose and oil prices were little changed.

Lagos and Ogun States have placed surveillance officers and health workers on high alert after Ogun confirmed one Lassa fever case in a 20-year-old male who is responding to treatment, with 66 contacts under surveillance. LUTH said confirmed cases there are also responding to treatment, and Lagos had earlier confirmed five cases, including two deaths and 150 people under surveillance.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2022 reported revenue of $49.36 billion and net income of $16.73 billion for the quarter, with year-to-date revenue of $146.41 billion and net income of $56.00 billion. The company completed its acquisition of Nuance Communications on March 4, 2022, and stated that Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 32% year over year.

The study validated a longitudinal Grade of Membership (L-GoM) model for Alzheimer’s disease in the community-based, multiethnic Predictors 3 cohort by comparing predicted survival and need for full-time care with observed outcomes. The model fit well for AD nonreverters and MCI cases, but not for AD reverters, who were likely misdiagnosed. The findings support use of the model in diverse community-dwelling older adults and extend it to MCI.

Motorola’s Moto Z2 Force is rumored to lose Verizon exclusivity in 2017, possibly launching unlocked or on carriers like T-Mobile and Sprint. The device is expected around June 2017, and this wider availability may help it reach more users.

Cleveland Central High School students presented the Purple Christmas Showcase at Delta Art Alliance, displaying photos, biographies, and quotes from interviews gathered for the Cleveland Yearbook project. Since September, the students worked with Charles Coleman to interview peers, teachers, residents, and business owners about local history and culture. The display will remain up until Wednesday.
Wall Street headhunters said candidates should be honest, and that specializing in an underpenetrated, valued niche sector can improve chances of landing a position.

Fibonacci trading uses Fibonacci ratios and tools to identify potential support and resistance levels, entry and exit points, stop loss levels, and profit targets. The passage says there is no best timeframe, recommends backtesting, and states that Fibonacci trading may not be very effective or scientifically supported, though it is popular and sometimes useful with other indicators.

The Dallas Stars and Vegas Golden Knights held pregame tributes for victims of the Las Vegas mass shooting, with players standing together for moments of silence. Dallas also honored a staff member who died in a car wreck and announcer Dave Strader, who died the same day as the shooting.

Day trading involves buying and selling financial instruments within the same trading day to profit from short-term price movements. Common strategies include momentum, range, scalping, breakout, pullback, and reversal trading, each suited to different market conditions. The passage also discusses risks, discipline, technical analysis, backtesting, emotions, leverage, timing, holidays, seasonality, and notes that while money can be made, most day traders do not, and consistent 1% daily returns are unrealistic.

A Yale-Brookings study says AI has caused only limited, targeted labor market changes, not a broad jobs crisis. It finds current employment shifts are more likely driven by a slowing economy, aging population, and lower immigration, while AI-related effects remain concentrated in specific industries and may take years to produce wider displacement.

U.S. wheat futures fell to nearly a three-week low on weak export demand and rain forecasts, while soybean futures declined for a fifth day on expectations of faster U.S. planting and concerns over export demand, especially to China. Corn futures were little changed, though USDA reported planting progress for corn and soybeans remained behind average.

The passage reports that Newcastle may renew interest in Besiktas midfielder Tolgay Arslan, while Chelsea, Borussia Dortmund, and Bayer Leverkusen are also linked. It also says Jose Mourinho told Real Madrid to consider another goalkeeper instead of David de Gea, and that Fred is expected to leave in June for either Manchester City or Manchester United.

The passage argues that universal Education Savings Accounts (ESAs) are a recent school-choice turning point, concentrated in red states, and are designed with little accountability while subsidizing private school tuition, homeschooling, and pods. It says ESAs can raise private-school tuition, increase state costs, weaken public and rural schools, and enable discrimination against students, faculty, and staff.

The passage argues that impact VC firms, which seek market-beating returns by investing in for-profit businesses that also provide social or environmental benefits, have raised $13 billion since 2001 and are growing quickly. It describes fund categories, notable firms and exits, key sub-sectors such as climate, emerging markets, consumer, financial services, and unrepresented founders, and predicts that traditional VC will eventually adopt this “GoodBusiness” thesis.

A Ukrainian startup, Dropla, is training its AI software Blue Eyes to detect Russian ambush drones and landmines along supply roads, analyzing live footage from quadcopters in real time and sending threat coordinates to Ukrainian commanders.

California’s energy crisis dominates the passage, with reports on claims that government-owned utilities, including Los Angeles DWP and Bonneville, helped drive up wholesale prices, while California lawmakers sought federal price caps and relief from FERC. The passage also covers California’s deal to buy Southern California Edison’s transmission lines to help avert bankruptcy, PG&E’s bankruptcy filing, and efforts by businesses and officials to conserve energy and expand supplies.

The speaker says they are taking advantage of every opportunity and do not want to return to waiting for injuries to play. They say the team feels better today, many players have their first Stanley Cup Finals experience, and each game should be treated as a must-win. Their goal is to win a game and go back with a split.

The Side Screen Offense is a two-player screen-and-roll isolation widely used in the NBA, with quick options for drives, pull-up shots, passes, post rolls, and kick-outs. The passage outlines eight defensive reads and counters, several entry sets and continuities, and emphasizes execution, coordination, scouting, and teaching methods for players and coaches.

Aldwick councillor Jacqui Maconachie has died at home after battling cancer, Arun District Council said. Tributes described her as a dedicated public servant who served Arun for 22 years, chaired the council from 2001 to 2002, and will be missed by her husband Dougal, family, friends and colleagues.

The passage describes a fluid end for hydraulic fracturing that uses multiple separate fluid end sections instead of a single housing, allowing individual section replacement. Each section has a single horizontal bore with a stuffing box, retainer, and a fluid routing plug that directs flow between suction and discharge valves, reducing stress points and manufacturing cost. The design also includes intake and discharge manifolds, seals, bevels, and valve guides intended to improve durability and limit wear, erosion, and leakage.

Admiral Harry Harris, originally nominated as ambassador to Australia, has been switched to ambassador to South Korea at the last minute, with his Senate hearing postponed. The change comes during sensitive US-South Korea negotiations over North Korea’s nuclear weapons and the Korean War.

Reports say Real Madrid want Marcus Rashford as a summer target, while Manchester United are also linked with Fulham’s Ryan Sessegnon, with Jose Mourinho considering a £40m move. Rashford is said to be happy at United, though his playing time has been limited since Alexis Sanchez arrived.

A study in the Journal of the American College of Cardiology found that more than 99% of people who had first-time heart attacks, strokes, or heart failure had at least one cardiovascular risk factor, usually nonoptimal blood pressure, cholesterol, blood glucose, or smoking history, and more than 93% had more than one.

MIG lets the A100 Tensor Core GPU be securely split into up to seven isolated GPU instances for CUDA applications. Each instance has its own memory-system paths, giving predictable performance, utilization, QoS, and isolation for multiple clients.

The disclosure describes wireless communication techniques for power saving in NR, including applying a minimum scheduling offset after a predefined delay, sending HARQ feedback for power saving signals, and adjusting default uplink beam selection when antenna panels are deactivated in a power saving state.

The Triangle & Two defense uses three players in a triangle zone and two chasers in full pass denial, and is effective against teams with two scorers or as a late-game strategy. It provides strong backside support, can create double teams on drives or against strong post players, and may be inverted against a two-guard front. The chasers’ pass denial is the key to disrupting scoring and set plays.

Ryan Walters’ tenure as Oklahoma education chief featured Christian prayer at meetings, Bible mandates, anti-LGBTQ actions, teacher monitoring, and other culture-war policies. The article says his administration mirrored Trump’s education overhaul, prioritizing conservative ideological goals over school improvement, and that he is now leaving to lead an anti-union group.

Andrew & Andrew family solicitors explain the UK legal process for divorce and civil partnership dissolution, which requires a court order and proof that the relationship is beyond repair on grounds such as adultery, unreasonable behaviour, desertion, or periods of separation. They also file needed documents, address children’s arrangements, and aim to resolve matters in the best interests of children and vulnerable family members, often within six months if there are no complications.

Hunter Greene, a 17-year-old Reds draft pick and two-way baseball prospect, is described as an unusually important and marketable prospect with star power, African-American heritage, and potential to impact baseball as both a pitcher and hitter.

Canada’s main stock index rose slightly in late-morning trading, led by financial and materials shares, while major U.S. indexes declined. The Canadian dollar and commodity prices, including oil, natural gas, gold, and copper, were higher.
A startup proposes democratizing AI by letting anyone run reinforcement learning, as US open source models fall behind and momentum grows around open source Chinese models.

The passage is a collection of Investing.com headlines and market commentary saying the U.S. shutdown may last into next week, gold has risen above $4,000/oz, stocks are not in a bubble yet, and the Bank of England warns of a sharp market correction if confidence in AI or the Fed weakens. It also discusses seasonal market weakness, lower yields, a weaker dollar, and related technical views on markets, commodities, and currencies.

Ohio State linebacker Arvell Reese is a strong 2026 NFL Draft prospect with elite athleticism, size, and run-defense ability. He plays multiple roles across the front seven, has upside in coverage, and is viewed as a viable first-round and potential top-10 pick.

The longest woolly rhino horn, found with a skull in Siberian permafrost and dated to about 19,600 years old, showed the species could live at least 40 years. Researchers also found the horn may have belonged to a female and may have been used to brush away snow when feeding.

Fusion trees are static, linear-space word-RAM data structures that use sketching, multiplication, and parallel comparison to support predecessor and successor queries in \( \log_w n \) time. The lecture explains how sketches keep only the important bits of keys, how to correct queries with a de-sketchification step, and how these techniques also help find the most significant set bit in constant time.

The Supreme Court relisted 17 cases, including disputes over parental rights and school gender-identity policies, religious exemptions to vaccine mandates, Section 230 immunity for Grindr, jury-trial rights in California cannabis enforcement, prison-condition relief in New Orleans, FAA arbitration exemptions for bread distributors, appeal waivers in criminal pleas, child-witness confrontation rights, tribal criminal jurisdiction, Jan. 6 dismissals, qualified immunity, Batson claims, and several other habeas and constitutional issues.

The passage lists multiple finance and business headlines, including Fifth Third’s planned $10.9 billion acquisition of Comerica, JPMorgan’s AI integration, AMD’s deal with OpenAI, Tesla’s record deliveries and teaser for a new affordable EV, and London IPO activity. It also includes a detailed note that Tesla’s teaser has sparked speculation about a lower-priced model or the long-delayed Roadster.

The passage explains life cycle assessment (LCA) using a hand dryer study, describing LCA’s four stages: goal and scope, inventory analysis, impact assessment, and interpretation. It emphasizes assumptions, data limits, system boundaries, allocation, and sensitivity and uncertainty analyses, noting that the Dyson Airblade generally showed the lowest impact despite many uncertainties.
Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated August 14, 2018 stating that it published a press release on that date, attached as Exhibit 99.1 and furnished under Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.

Sevilla midfielder Pablo Sarabia welcomed drawing Manchester United in the Champions League last 16 and said the only teams Sevilla wanted to avoid were Manchester City and PSG. He said the tie would be competitive, with Sevilla hosting the first leg on 21 February and playing the return on 13 March.

A report by the Children’s Rights Alliance says homelessness and emergency accommodation are harming children’s education in Dublin, with many going to school hungry, tired, and in dirty clothes, missing school, and struggling with homework and behavior. It says parents often must choose between food and travel costs, and recommends free school travel, extra school supports, and better accommodation near schools.

The passage describes a market research report on the global Angelica Seed oil market, covering historical, current, and projected revenues, market trends, segmentation, regions, key companies, and analyses such as SWOT, investment feasibility, and return. It lists product types, applications, and regions covered, and states the report is intended to guide market participants and provide forecasts through 2025.

This study in Muheza, Tanzania, found a 27% malaria prevalence and substantial malnutrition among school-age children. Malaria was associated with higher odds of stunting, low socioeconomic status was associated with underweight, and recent malaria illness was associated with thinness. Intermittent preventive treatment with dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine or artesunate-amodiaquine did not significantly change weight, height, or BMI compared with standard care.

NVIDIA Tesla T4 is a Turing-based inferencing GPU for data centers, enterprise, and edge devices, with 2,560 CUDA cores, 320 Tensor Cores, 16 GB memory, and up to 260 INT4 TOPS. The passage also describes Turing features including improved video, memory, NVLink, RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, Tensor Cores for AI features like DLSS and NGX, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, and other display and VR capabilities.

Construction at Elliott Field and Don Beebe Stadium is expected to make major progress in June and remains on schedule despite rain delays. Work has included steel beams for the Con Marshall Press Box, lower-level roofs and masonry, utility installation, excavation for grandstands, and plans for bleachers, turf, scoreboard delivery, and new field lighting. The construction zone and campus traffic routes have been expanded, and the track facility is expected to enter the design phase next month.

On August 26, 2022, the U.S. government imposed an immediate license requirement for future NVIDIA exports of A100 and H100 integrated circuits, related systems, and certain similar products to China, Hong Kong, and Russia, citing military end-use risk. NVIDIA said this may affect H100 development, A100 support, and some China operations, and that about $400 million in potential third-quarter China sales could be subject to the restriction.

Tokyo stocks rebounded sharply Wednesday, with the Nikkei up 1.03 percent to 19,437.98 and Topix up 0.95 percent, supported by a weaker yen and stronger U.S. equities. Exporters and financial shares rose, while Toshiba fell sharply after a poor earnings outlook.

The passage says many college graduates are adult learners with jobs or families, and nearly two-fifths of postsecondary enrollment in 2016 was students over 24. It advises working adults to build support, research programs and finances, use prior experience for credit, and choose flexible, career-relevant programs.

In a longitudinal study of 691 adults in India, CovishieldTM elicited higher seroconversion rates, antibody titers, neutralizing activity, and T cell responses than Covaxinâ, especially in seronegative participants; higher pre-vaccination antibody titers were associated with non-responsiveness in seropositive subjects.

The speaker says the Stanley Cup Finals are exciting, especially for first-timers, but players must avoid overexcitement and stick to their regular game. He expects the series to become more intense and physical, notes the other team is upset after scoring five road goals without winning, and says puck possession, traffic in front of the goalie, and wearing down their defensemen will be important. He also says his team usually controls the puck and outshoots opponents, but may need to do more to earn power plays.

Yankee is a pro-style shot play that uses a post-dig combination to stress safeties and linebackers, often from heavier sets to encourage 1-high looks. It works best against Cover 1 and Cover 3, but is less effective against Cover 2 and Cover 4. The QB reads high to low, with the deep post as the primary option, followed by the dig and underneath routes.

A Science Advances study says warm water is already pooling beneath Antarctic glaciers in at least two regions, accelerating melt through a positive feedback that could raise sea levels faster. The passage warns that if ice shelves collapse, cities like Miami and South Florida could face far greater sea-level rise than current predictions, possibly with superstorms.

The speaker expresses humility and uncertainty after a sad event, says any policy will be shown by future actions, and emphasizes his long commitment to free government and the rights of the American people. He asks for support in guiding the Government through its present dangers and believes its principles will endure.

Zebronics launched its Buddy Speakers for Rs. 1699, a lightweight 630g portable wireless speaker with LED display and RGB light. It offers 5W RMS output, up to 3 hours of playback on a rechargeable battery, Bluetooth connectivity, built-in FM, and USB/MicroSD/AUX support with a 10-meter wireless range.

The passage argues that construction apprenticeships are too selective and inaccessible, and that stronger pre-apprenticeships can help more workers enter them. It says these programs should provide career exposure, skills, mentoring, credentials, better funding, wraparound support, and outcome data to attract investment and expand access.

An AI tool called Waldo scanned more than 430,000 Reddit posts about cannabis use and flagged over 28,000 as possible harmful side effects; researchers verified 86% of 250 sampled flags. The study suggests social media scanning could help public health workers detect adverse effects, though the researchers say it should be used cautiously and ethically.

The paper presents RoboDoc, a medical chatbot that uses openAI APIs with model-choosing function calling and integrates diabetes, pneumonia, and OCT image models. Results show generally expected behavior, with some misclassifications and limitations, and the author concludes that public APIs and chatbots can provide low-cost, user-friendly interfaces for bioinformatics and medicine.

Most enterprises prefer external HPC infrastructures, with 87% using or planning cloud or other external providers. About 74% operate or plan their own HPC infrastructure in colocation datacenters, while 43% use or plan innovation partners. Only 6% currently have on-premises HPC infrastructure, though 28% plan to use it in the next two years.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture, highlighting enhanced Tensor Cores for AI inference, RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, and features such as Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, NVLink, and improved video, memory, and display capabilities. It also details Turing-based GPUs like Tesla T4, GeForce RTX 2080, and RTX 2070, and their use in gaming, data centers, VR, and hybrid rendering workloads.

NASA ambassador Theo Wellington told the Wilson County Commission the upcoming total solar eclipse could be the biggest public one-day event in U.S. history and would likely bring a major influx of visitors to the path, including Wilson County. The commission also approved allowing retiring officers to keep their service weapons and voted to fund a school resource officer for the future Springdale Elementary School.

The passage says Williams %R is the best swing trading indicator, based on stable results and the lowest average max drawdown. It defines swing trading as holding positions for days to a few weeks, recommends a 1–15 day time frame, and discusses six indicators: Williams %R, WilliamsVixFix, Bollinger Bands, Stochastics, Internal Bar Strength (IBS), and RSI.

The passage describes a video encoding/decoding method and apparatus that improve intra- and inter-prediction efficiency by using weight prediction parameters, reconstructed adjacent pixels, correction of intra-prediction results, and sub-block prediction. It also outlines encoding and decoding flows for motion information, weight parameters, intra-prediction modes, and correction coefficients.

The passage argues that national greatness depends on organized patriotism, cooperation among social classes, and especially efficient education. It emphasizes technical and industrial training for workers and farmers, says the National Government should set an example through District of Columbia schools, and stresses that agriculture now requires practical scientific and business education.

Microsoft reported for the quarter ended September 30, 2015 revenue of $20.379 billion and net income of $4.620 billion, compared with $23.201 billion and $4.540 billion a year earlier. Revenue declined mainly in More Personal Computing, partly offset by growth in Intelligent Cloud, and operating income was $5.793 billion. The company also reported a net $1.3 billion revenue deferral related to Windows 10, announced a phone business restructuring, and said it had 7,987,913,152 shares outstanding on October 15, 2015.

The Romanian leu was steady as investors awaited a central bank decision on whether to raise rates again, with many expecting a quarter-point hike. Central European currencies were mixed, while Hungary’s forint gained after the yuan’s rebound and the Hungarian central bank discussed inflation trends with analysts.

U.S. stocks rose Monday after the Easter holiday, led by technology shares and helped by stronger-than-expected first-quarter growth in China. Alere, Arconic and Straight Path Communications climbed on corporate news, while Eli Lilly, Incyte and Snyder’s-Lance fell after setbacks.

Singapore shares rose with most Asian markets, with the STI up 0.9% to 3,308.69 on easing US-North Korea tensions and weak US inflation data. OCBC and DBS led bank gains, while UOB fell. Olam reported higher second-quarter profit, while Asian Pay Television Trust posted lower quarterly profit.

Two TPS7H500x-SP controllers can operate in primary-secondary mode using SYNC, with the primary RT pin populated and the secondary RT pin left floating. This mode can synchronize two independent converters or support a single interleaved converter, where the latter also connects VSENSE, COMP, SS, and HICC. The secondary controller inverts the received clock, creating a 90° or 270° phase shift between corresponding outputs.

The passage explains how to backtest a MACD trading strategy in Python using Apple historical data from Yahoo Finance, pandas, and matplotlib. It describes calculating the MACD, signal line, histogram, and trading regime, then shows that the strategy achieved a 15.04% CAGR versus 19.07% for buy and hold while being invested 51.13% of the time.

After the Yonge St. van attack, Jean Chrétien and Steven Del Duca spoke at a Liberal nomination meeting in Vaughan-Woodbridge, urging unity, reflection, and support such as blood donation. They praised Toronto’s response and Premier Kathleen Wynne, while outside, LiUNA Local 183 members protested labour changes in the budget bill.

The passage presents 3DPCNet, a pose-only module that maps camera-centered 3D skeletons into a fixed body-centered canonical frame using a hybrid GCN-Transformer encoder to predict a global SO(3) rotation and optional residual correction. On MM-Fi, it reduced rotation error from 20–22° to 3–4° and MPJPE by about 27%, and on TotalCapture it produced kinematic signals more consistent with IMU ground truth than a geometric baseline.

The passage explains that changes in federal tax withholding tables under the new tax law could increase take-home pay for about 90% of workers, though amounts vary by income, family size, and W-4 details. It gives examples of larger increases for families with children, notes that some taxpayers may need to update their W-4 forms, and says bonus checks will now be withheld at 22% instead of 25%.

Christian Brothers defensive lineman Bill Norton, a four-star 2019 prospect, committed to Georgia over several other major offers. The 6-foot-6, 270-pound Norton is ranked by 247Sports composite as the nation’s 11th-ranked strong-side defensive end.

The study used Scopus-based bibliometric analysis of 53 documents on wartime and online education from 2000–2024. It found most publications came from the United States and Ukraine, with social sciences the leading subject area. The findings identified a research gap for African higher education, where wartime and online learning are underrepresented despite widespread conflict.

Dick Tuck, a Democratic Party operative known for political pranks aimed at Richard Nixon, died at 94 in Tucson, Arizona. His stunts included bogus fortune cookies, misleading campaign tactics, and a Chinatown sign referencing the Hughes loan. He also worked in Robert F. Kennedy’s 1968 campaign, ran unsuccessfully for California’s Senate in 1966, and later said Nixon’s 1974 resignation should be a national holiday called Nixmas.

Mathieu Henderson finished his four-year OHL career with a breakout season for the Flint Firebirds, ranking ninth among OHL defencemen in scoring with 10 goals and 44 assists in 68 games. He said he is happy with his junior career, credited his coaches and parents, briefly played three games for the ECHL’s South Carolina Stingrays, and is still deciding whether to play pro hockey in North America or Europe or go to school.

The lecture reviewed VCG mechanisms, explaining that they implement the utilitarian solution in dominant strategies but are not budget balanced and can be infeasible in large allocation problems. It then focused on Google’s advertising auctions, describing the generalized second price mechanism, bid shading equilibria, and why equilibrium payments replicate VCG payments. The lecture also discussed a model with consumer search and reserve prices, showing reserve prices can improve welfare, and briefly mentioned later papers on endogenous pricing and platform information design.

The civil aviation ministry has asked the finance ministry to delay GST implementation by two months, saying airlines need more time to update systems and address concerns about compliance, ticket distribution changes, and possible taxation of aircraft parts. The finance ministry said GST remains on track for rollout from July 1.

The passage describes a data intake and query system for collecting, indexing, storing, and searching machine-generated data using flexible, late-binding schemas, with support for data models, reports, security monitoring, and performance monitoring. It also states a disclosed process for optimizing the size of index files based on storage conditions related to indexed data.

The IRS announced higher federal income tax brackets and standard deductions for 2026 to adjust for inflation. The top 37% rate will apply above $640,600 for individuals and $768,700 for married couples filing jointly, and the standard deduction will rise to $32,200 for joint filers and $16,100 for single taxpayers. The agency also changed other tax provisions, including capital gains, estate and gift tax exemption, and earned income tax credit eligibility.

The passage describes GHCB protocol fields and many guest-hypervisor request/response events, including protocol negotiation, CPUID and page table encryption bit support, GHCB GPA registration, page state changes, guest requests, AP creation, doorbell and timer handling, and termination. It also outlines NAE handling, NMI and interrupt delivery through the #HV doorbell page, and notes that nested virtualization and SMM are not supported.

Egyptian archaeologists unveiled the tomb of Hetpet, an Old Kingdom priestess of Hathor, on the Giza plateau. The tomb contains well-preserved Fifth Dynasty wall paintings showing hunting, fishing, offerings, music, dancing, and rare monkey scenes, and excavations at the site are continuing.

SOS full court pressure is used to force backcourt pressure, create turnovers and rushed shots, wear down the offense, and adjust game tempo. The main “shadow” presses are Back shadow, Up shadow, and Face shadow, while “Blitz” pressures are the most aggressive and deny first passing lanes. Full court pressure depends on proper SOS fundamentals, forces the ball away from the middle, and usually ends in Base Go Red unless a hold action is used.

The UK and Ukraine discussed maintaining and strengthening trade and investment ties after Brexit. Ukraine welcomed efforts to avoid disruption, including continuity of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement and DCFTA, which supports over £1.7 billion in trade, and both sides agreed to work together on trade.

Amber Enterprises has received Sebi approval to raise about Rs 555 crore through an IPO, including a fresh issue of Rs 450 crore and promoter share sales worth Rs 105 crore. The company makes air-conditioners, refrigerator components, water purifiers and washing machines, and plans to use the proceeds for loan repayment, advance payments and general corporate purposes.

This study found increased hippocampal perineuronal net densities in human subjects with substance use disorder and in rhesus macaques with chronic alcohol self-administration, along with altered expression of ECM, synaptic, and glial markers. Subjects with major depressive disorder showed generally opposite changes, and comorbid SUD/MDD showed mixed effects, highlighting the importance of comorbidity in SUD pathology and treatment considerations.

The passage describes systems and methods for localizing and classifying abnormalities in medical images using jointly trained networks, detecting abnormalities by comparing incomplete and GAN-synthesized images to a learned normal image, and training deep learning models on multi-site datasets with deployment-stage refinement.

The speaker said the team did not play its game in Anaheim or tonight, and must move on and accept a disputed no-goal call. They noted the other team capitalized on a power play, followed its game plan, and that their own team now needs to focus on the next game.

Trump tweeted about the Russia investigation, calling it a “phony” witch hunt and claiming aides were devastated by it, while aides’ departures were largely due to internal infighting. The passage says Trump remains obsessed with the probe, is considering a Mueller interview, and continues attacking Mueller’s team, the FBI’s use of informants, and The New York Times over a source on the Kim Jong Un summit.

UVA Health System’s thoracic ERAS program shortened hospital stays by two days, reduced morphine-equivalent use by 59% to 74%, and saved over $1.3 million in its first year without increasing complications or readmissions.

Two Lashkar-e-Jhangvi militants escaped from Karachi’s Central Jail, prompting the suspension of about a dozen jail officials and a police case against them. In a separate incident, a robber was killed in a police encounter in DHA, while Karachi police said they arrested 15 outlaws in raids and recovered weapons and narcotics.
The passage says the team is preparing to go down and win one hockey game to win the Stanley Cup, treating it as just another game and not dwelling on past losses.

Nigerian papers focused on Emmanuel Macron’s first visit to Nigeria, including talks on security, intelligence sharing, Boko Haram, trade, and a reforestation and agricultural project in Ogun State. Macron also said France could help against terrorism but Nigeria must address violence by Fulani herdsmen. In South Africa, Times Live reported on child trafficking in Gabon, describing the rescue of two girls sold into forced marriage and the wider child labour problem.

The passage lists Investing.com market headlines and technical outlooks. It says AMD shares surged after an AI chip deal with OpenAI, gold rose above $3,900/oz, and the S&P 500 could reach 9,000 in 2026 in a bubble scenario. It also discusses USD/JPY, GBP/USD, and BTC/USD moves after weak U.S. data, plus upcoming BoE and Fed-related policy expectations.

A Joseph Rowntree Foundation study says families need £40,000 a year for a decent standard of living in the UK, with a working couple with two children needing £20,000 each and a single person needing £18,400. The passage argues that redistribution will not solve the problem and suggests lower taxes, cheaper childcare and housing, and stronger economic growth instead.

Culpeper beat Courtland 2-1 Monday by making the routine defensive plays while Courtland committed seven errors. Both pitchers threw complete games with nine strikeouts, but Courtland’s Alex Kobersteen took the loss despite allowing only two hits, both unearned.

The Department of Education will delay two Obama-era rules on student borrowers and for-profit colleges, replacing them with committees and July hearings to review them. The rules included gainful employment standards for schools and the Borrower Defense to Repayment rule for defrauded students. The department said it will still honor claims for 16,000 borrowers already being processed.

VentureWire’s November 30, 2000 issue lists top stories, new financings, product launches, personnel changes, fund news, and corrections. Major items include 724 Solutions’ planned $375 million acquisition of Tantau Software, El Dorado Ventures’ $250 million fund, MaMaMedia cutting staff to 15, and multiple venture investments, board appointments, and executive hires across Internet, software, and technology companies.

Etisalat Nigeria has not yet agreed a restructuring deal for its $1.2 billion loan with 13 local banks after missing a payment. A source said negotiations were still ongoing, while regulators have backed a default deal over receivership, and Etisalat’s CEO declined to comment.

The passage explains that goal kicks are taken after an attacking player last touches the ball over the goal line, with the objective of retaining possession and starting an attack. It describes basic Laws of the Game requirements, youth build-out line adaptations, teaching progressions for younger and older players, and adult tactics, emphasizing positioning, target players, and the direct nature of goal kicks.

Greece’s central bank chief urged Greece and its lenders to finish the bailout review by the end of February, warning that delays could renew uncertainty, hurt banks, and undermine the expected economic recovery. Talks have stalled over labour and energy reforms, fiscal targets, and IMF involvement, while the economy is expected to grow 2.7 percent this year.

Project Sashakat, endorsed by the Finance Ministry, proposes a five-pronged strategy to speed resolution of NPAs through independent AMCs, steering committees, an asset trading platform, and time-bound mechanisms. It recommends an AMC/AIF-led approach for cases above Rs 500 crore, a template-based SME Resolution Approach for loans up to Rs 50 crore, and does not recommend a bad bank.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced an agreement to build a Qatari Emiri Air Force facility at Mountain Home Air Force Base in Idaho, where Qatari pilots will train with U.S. personnel. He said the facility will host Qatari F-15s and pilots to improve combined training and interoperability, alongside an existing Singapore air force training contingent.

Researchers have launched a new experiment to study the causal effects of lower incomes on babies’ and toddlers’ brain development by giving new mothers a large untaxed monthly income in addition to existing benefits. The study will examine whether this extra income improves a child’s emotional and brain development during the first three years of life.

A prospective study at Tesseney Community Hospital in Eritrea found 165 scorpion sting admissions, with 4.8% fatality. Most patients had localized pain, sweating, and vomiting; class III symptoms were common, especially in children under 15. Cases peaked in summer, especially September and October, and most stings occurred at night on the foot or hand.

The passage is a mixed list of finance and business headlines, followed by an article on StarCompliance arguing that compliance should be treated as a strategic advantage through technology, real-time monitoring, and audit readiness. It also notes StarCompliance received Pan Finance’s Most Innovative Employee Technology Platform USA award and offers a free executive brief on non-compliance.

The report says U.S. policy toward Hawaii consistently opposed foreign aggression and repeatedly contemplated annexation, with annexation advocated or attempted at several points from 1850 through 1881. It also notes that U.S. official relations began in 1820 with the appointment of John C. Jones as agent for commerce and seamen, with supervision of American interests in the islands.

Official mpg figures are based on outdated, loophole-filled tests and can be unreliable, while Which? uses more realistic WLTP-based lab tests, including motorway and hybrid-specific cycles, plus emissions checks, to provide accurate mpg and car performance data for every reviewed car.

Anthurium, a South American plant with red, pink, or white flowers, is a natural filter for ammonia and xylene but may cause allergies. It needs bright indirect light, dampness, indoor temperatures of 18°C to 21°C, leaf misting in winter, and regular repotting.

The study uses a quasi-experimental approach to compare colleges choosing in-person, hybrid, or online teaching and examines effects on county-level COVID-19 cases and deaths. It finds that college reopening, especially in-person teaching, increases cases and deaths over time.

The passage argues that postwar economic exclusion threatens Austria-Hungary and Germany, and identifies potential Allied assets in Bulgaria, Turkey, German colonies, Russia’s revolution, the Vatican, American resources, and pro-peace, anti-old-diplomacy, and pro-league-of-nations sentiments. It also says Germany’s policy is shifting eastward toward Russia and may involve sacrifices elsewhere to secure that opportunity.

The passage explains random walk trading theory as the view that stock prices move unpredictably, making technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis unreliable, and it recommends diversification or passive investing in broad index funds. It also says random walk and EMH differ in assumptions but both imply that consistently beating the market is difficult, and it reports backtests where a random-entry strategy performed better in SPY than in GLD.

Harry S. Truman announced Germany’s unconditional surrender to the United Nations and proclaimed May 13, 1945, a day of prayer and thanksgiving. He urged Americans to continue working to finish the war against Japan, build a just peace, and honor those who died for victory.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated October 2, 2022, stating that it published a press release on that date. The report covers Items 2.02 and 7.01, includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1, and was signed by Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn on October 3, 2022.

Navient Cp Cmn (NASDAQ:NAVI) rose 2.27%, with analysts projecting a 12-month target of $16.89 based on 9 opinions and a current closing price of $13.51. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 2.75 from 8 recommendations, ATR-14 of 0.41, weekly volatility of 2.72%, monthly volatility of 2.82%, RSI of 51.03, a market cap of $3.55 billion, 263 million outstanding shares, and 5.78 million shares traded versus an average of 2.8 million.

The passage describes a hierarchical Bayesian multinomial model for estimating SARS-CoV-2 variant growth and prevalence using sparse, geographically uneven genomic data. It finds global sequencing is highly concentrated in a few countries and shows that the multicountry model provides more stable and accurate early estimates than single-country regression, including for BA.4, BA.5, and BA.2.12.1.

The speaker addresses violence and unrest, appoints the Kerner Commission to investigate the disorders, and says crime, not civil rights protest, must be stopped. He calls for stronger law enforcement, National Guard training, and long-term action against the causes of violence such as poverty, discrimination, and poor housing, while urging a national day of prayer and reconciliation.

The paper studies Gorenstein-projective modules over the dual integers ring Z[ε], focusing on their classification, properties, and related categories. It shows that several categories are equivalent, including the stable category of Gorenstein-projective Z[ε]-modules, a category of submodules of free Z[ε]-modules, Db(Z)/[1], and categories of perfect differential structures, and describes these categories as part of a chain and a commutative cube of dense functors.

Scotiabank’s 1832 Asset Management LP will pay an $800,000 fine and $150,000 in costs after an Ontario Securities Commission settlement found it provided improper lavish promotional benefits to financial advisers from November 2012 to October 2017, including tickets, gadgets, food, drinks and entertainment.

The episode covers five WIRED stories: federal workers being told to blame Democrats for the government shutdown, Peter Thiel’s Antichrist obsession, Tesla urging drowsy drivers to use Full Self-Driving, scientists making human eggs from skin cells, and OpenAI’s new Sora 2 social app for AI-generated videos.

Vodafone Ghana staff member Eunice Ampomah-Manu saved customer Andrew Kufuor by keeping him on the phone during a medical emergency, obtaining his wife’s contact, and enabling him to reach a clinic. Kufuor later visited Vodafone to thank her, and Chief Executive Yolanda Cuba said the company is committed to customer care.

Nick Kyrgios is set to face John Isner in Australia’s Davis Cup quarter-final against the United States in Brisbane, with expectations of many aces. Australia also has Jordan Thompson against Jack Sock, and Sam Groth and John Peers in doubles.

The passage says IT-based simulation, modeling, digital twins, and high-performance computing are expanding product development and manufacturing scenarios by speeding development, improving testing, enabling feedback loops, and supporting new digital products and business models. It also notes that HPC is increasingly seen as a game changer, with many firms using or planning external, cloud, or hybrid HPC due to cost, flexibility, security, and energy concerns.
Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on January 25, 2022, announcing a press release with its financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2021.

John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physics for demonstrating quantum tunneling and energy quantization in an electric circuit in the 1980s, work that helped lay the basis for superconducting qubits and quantum computing.

The passage gives design guidance and selected component values for a TPS7H500x-SP push-pull converter, including an 80-V GaN FET for synchronous rectification, an RCD clamp, a 0.47 µH output inductor, about 2.3 mF of output capacitance, a 7.5-Ω current-sense resistor, a 3.3 nF hiccup capacitor, 40.2 kΩ/15 nF/47 pF compensation components, and a 102 kΩ slope compensation resistor. It also recommends controller supply bypassing, detailed PCB layout practices, and notes revision history, support resources, and mechanical/orderable information.

The Open Source Definition was published about twenty years ago, building on free software advocacy. The term “open source” emerged in early February 1998 and was chosen as a more business-friendly way to describe software whose source code is available under licenses favoring user freedom. The passage says open source is now widely used by major tech companies and has become central to innovation, with Microsoft later embracing it after once opposing it.

The passage reports German and Austro-Hungarian messages about peace and war: Germany said the blockade would end if a reasonable conference could be arranged, while its envoy described submarine warfare as a means to force England to seek terms. Austria-Hungary said it was willing to negotiate a “peace without victory” but blamed the Entente for refusing that basis and said technical changes to submarine warfare were impossible.

The passage compares storage technologies, noting that lithium-ion batteries are becoming cheaper but are still costly, while pumped hydro is already much cheaper and better suited to large-scale grid storage. It says batteries may only be cost-effective under certain electricity tariffs, and that grid benefits are limited where demand is flat or falling.

The PMU generates regulated core supplies and supervises VDD; the clock module provides multiple oscillators and clocks; DMA moves data without CPU intervention; and the event manager routes digital events between peripherals, DMA, and CPU.

The passage contrasts the understated portrayal of physicist Ernest Walton in an Irish Times feature with the more dramatic publicity surrounding CERN and the Higgs boson. It describes Walton as a quiet, shy Nobel Prize winner at Trinity College Dublin, notes the article’s restrained treatment of his atomic physics achievement, and mentions that the image and related Irish Times book are available for purchase.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting an amendment to its Restated Articles of Incorporation that increased authorized common stock from 12.6 billion to 50.4 billion shares and provided for a four-for-one stock split of outstanding common stock at 5 p.m. Pacific daylight time on August 28, 2020.

Bitcoin futures were set to begin trading on Cboe Global Markets’ Cboe Futures Exchange, offering a regulated way to bet on or hedge bitcoin’s price. The launch followed a sharp rise and recent volatility in bitcoin, drew mixed reactions from banks and brokerages, and raised concerns about pricing accuracy, margin risk, and possible manipulation, though some analysts said futures could help improve price discovery and reduce volatility over time.

The Korean diet emphasizes whole, unprocessed foods such as fresh vegetables, whole grains, fermented foods, lean proteins, and healthy fats, while limiting processed foods, sugary drinks, unhealthy fats, and dairy. It may support wellbeing and weight loss, but can be high in sodium and carbohydrates, so portion control and attention to personal dietary needs are important.

The passage says new soccer players and coaches need general guidance on team tactics, including positioning, ball work, and team functions, and introduces a list of General “Rules of the Road” for on-field play that can be adapted to a coach’s preferences and style.

The passage summarizes how to transfer music, photos, and videos to a Sansa Fuze using drag-and-drop, Windows Media Player, and Sansa Media Converter, and how to play, manage, and delete media on the device. It also covers FM radio, voice recordings, system settings, troubleshooting, support, warranty, and software license terms.

The team expressed support for Mr. Horton and hoped for his full recovery, while saying they must move on. They said Aaron’s absence is tough, recalled a hard loss in Chicago, and said their mentality is to focus on the next game, make a few changes, and continue in hard-fought series.

The ADS9803 supports a speed-boost mode for up to 8MSPS on a selected analog input channel pair, while the other six channels remain idle. It uses SPI register banks for read and write access, supports daisy-chain SPI configuration for multiple devices, and includes registers for speed-boost, test patterns, averaging, bandwidth, and other settings.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 28, 2021, stating that it issued a press release about its fourth fiscal quarter 2021 financial results ended September 25, 2021. The filing includes Exhibit 99.1, the press release, and Exhibit 104, inline XBRL for the cover page.

In a retrospective study of 109 aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage patients, shunt-dependent hydrocephalus was predicted by age 65 or older, clipping rather than coiling, and Hunt and Hess scale 3 or higher. A nomogram based on these three factors had an AUC of 0.753.

Nike reported surprise fiscal first-quarter revenue growth of 1% to $11.72 billion, beating Wall Street expectations, but profits fell 31% and gross margin declined to 42.2% as its turnaround continues under CEO Elliott Hill.

Tyreek Hill dislocated his knee during the Dolphins’ win over the Jets, was carted off, and is undergoing further tests and will remain hospitalized overnight. The injury came early in the third quarter on a 10-yard catch, and Hill had 67 receiving yards on six catches before leaving.

Scientists studied live Kuphus polythalamia, a giant mud-dwelling shipworm found in the Philippines, to examine its microbes and search for antimicrobial substances. The species consumes hydrogen sulfide in mud, and researchers said it evolved from wood-eating ancestors.

The passage describes a seasonal trading strategy for the German stock market using EWG, based on historical monthly returns that are strongest in the final quarter. It explains that the DAX 40 is Germany’s main index of 40 blue-chip companies, and notes that the strategy invests only in the last three months of each year and backtesting showed it performed well.

Climate change is warming and drying northern Rocky Mountain streams, allowing invasive rainbow trout to move into cutthroat trout habitat and hybridize with them. Researchers found widespread hybridization, especially where rainbow trout were introduced, and warned that cutthroat trout could disappear if the problem continues.

Christian Nwosu told a Lagos Federal High Court that EFCC operatives coerced him into stating that he benefited N30 million from former Petroleum Minister Dieziani Alison-Madueke. He alleged they forced him to surrender property worth N30 million and N5 million cash, threatened detention, and dictated what he should write in his statement.

A nationwide study of over 1.1 million older adults found that long-term outdoor exposure to trichloroethylene (TCE) was associated with a 10% higher risk of Parkinson’s disease, though it did not prove causation.

State Street Corporation, which commissioned the “Fearless Girl” statue, agreed to pay $5 million to settle claims that it paid 305 top female employees and 15 black vice presidents less than comparable men and white employees. The company denied the allegations but said it is committed to equal pay practices.

A roundup of October 30, 2001 coverage shows Enron under heavy pressure after Moody’s cut its debt rating and it sought new credit lines, with its shares falling to eight-year lows and default insurance costs doubling. An article also says Enron’s forest products trading was growing, but faced industry and quality-related hurdles.

John Clarke, Michel Devoret, and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physics for demonstrating quantum effects in an electric circuit and bringing quantum effects to a scale once thought impossible.
