Little Beach in Port Stanley was under a swimming advisory because of high bacteria levels, but it remained open and people continued swimming. The Elgin St. Thomas Health Unit said the advisory warns of possible health risks, while a beach closure would require a higher threshold.

Sir John Deane’s sixth form college staged its fourth Evening of Jazz and Soul at the Macdonald Portal Hotel in Tarporley, featuring a 35-strong jazz collective performing soul and swing to a packed audience. Head of performing arts Alison Richards praised the students’ performance and the turnout. The college’s next event is a classical music evening at Arley Hall on February 9, with tickets on sale for £8, or £6 concessions.

The Evening Sun’s 2016 stories included Norwich children Evan and Brynn Meek handing out 220 bagged lunches to homeless people in Manhattan, Norwich Police officer Thomas Miller leaving for the Syracuse Police Department after eight years of service, and Tracy A. Price of Norwich being charged with torturing, injuring and neglecting a dog and granted $750 bail.

Researchers at Chalmers University of Technology used machine learning and simulations to identify the low-temperature structure of formamidinium lead iodide, a promising halide perovskite solar material. The findings could help design more efficient, durable, and controllable solar cells.

A 36-year-old man, Reinaldo De Jesus Henao of New York, was arrested at Coachella on suspicion of stealing more than 100 cellphones. Concertgoers used “Find my iPhone” to track him, and security detained him before Indio Police arrested him. He faces grand theft and possession of stolen property charges.

Wafa Yahia, the Syrian mother-in-law of Honolulu imam Ismail Elshikh and a plaintiff in Hawaii’s travel ban lawsuit, arrived in Honolulu after receiving US visa approval. Hawaii officials said her return was a positive moment, while the broader legal challenge to President Trump’s travel ban remains ongoing.

Cuba marked the 58th anniversary of its revolution with a military parade in Havana honoring Fidel Castro, who died on Nov. 25 at age 90. Tens of thousands marched without equipment, while Cuba also upheld his wish to avoid a cult of personality by banning monuments and named infrastructure. The country faces economic strain, Raul Castro’s expected final full year in power, and uncertainty over ties with the United States.

A study in the Journal of Experimental Psychology says general distraction can help people move on after a breakup, though it should be used sparingly. It also says focusing on the negative aspects of the past relationship may help people recover faster.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting that on July 27, 2021 it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2021, with the press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

Vale SA said its stock conversion plan succeeded, with 84.4 percent of preferred shares joining, above the required threshold, and it may accelerate listing on São Paulo’s Novo Mercado, possibly this year. The company said it is not considering cash incentives for non-participants, and the new single-share structure is intended to broaden investor appeal and reduce political influence, while the government keeps a golden share. Shares of Vale rose after the announcement.

The study examined primary school teachers’ views on virtual education for students with disabilities in inclusive settings during COVID-19. Teachers reported mixed participation, problems with lesson follow-up, homework, and parent cooperation, and suggested solutions such as stronger family-teacher coordination, device and internet support, and keeping schools open for in-person support.

The passage defines youth using the UN age range of 15–24, describes hard and soft skills, and explains experiential learning and co-op as integrated work-based learning. It reviews Nigerian labor market trends, co-op history and benefits, existing Nigerian youth employment programs, and argues that co-op could better align education with labor market needs and improve youth employability.

The study analyzed 48,615 Omicron BA.1 genomes from England and found at least 6,455 introductions, with most importations being singletons. Early introductions before or during travel restrictions seeded about 80% of infections by the end of January 2022, and Greater London played a central role in spread. Human mobility declined during mid-December to early January, and higher case numbers at hubs were associated with reduced travel connectivity.

The TLV321/2x comparators consume 40 µA per channel with 40 ns propagation delay and offer push-pull or open-drain outputs. Inputs operate from 200 mV below V− to 200 mV above V+, with 1.8 mV internal hysteresis, POR holding the output low during startup, and application notes covering hysteresis, current sensing, and layout recommendations.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x/Ampere GPU architecture, including increased FP32 throughput, larger unified L1/shared memory, second-generation RT Cores with motion-blur acceleration, third-generation Tensor Cores with TF32 and sparsity support, GDDR6X memory, RTX IO, AV1 decode, NVENC/NVDEC improvements, and data center/workstation products such as A40, A6000, RTX 3090, and RTX 3070.

The passage is a Commissioner.COM fantasy football email containing promotional offers and extensive NFL player news and lineup recommendations for Week 11, including updates on many players’ expected performances, injuries, and start/bench advice.
On August 16, 2018, NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K announcing the release of its results for the quarter ended July 29, 2018, along with a press release and CFO commentary attached as exhibits.

The passage argues that originalism does not support the Supreme Court’s racial districting doctrine under the 14th or 15th Amendments, and that precedent and stare decisis would require reconsidering that doctrine in Louisiana’s majority-Black district case.

The United States advanced to the Davis Cup quarterfinals after a four-set doubles win over Serbia, while Switzerland also exited after Kazakhstan won its tie. France, Croatia, Spain, Germany and Italy each held leads after doubles, with Belgium failing to clinch against Hungary.

TI provides technical and design resources “as is” without warranties, and they are intended for skilled developers who are responsible for product selection, application design, validation, testing, and compliance. The resources may change without notice, are limited to development use with TI products, and TI disclaims liability while requiring indemnification for claims arising from their use.

Investors Intelligence Sentiment Index, also called Advisor Sentiment, is a weekly contrarian survey of over a hundred investment newsletters that measures the percentages of bullish, bearish, and correction views among advisors. It is used to gauge market sentiment, with bullish readings over 55% seen as too optimistic and below 35% as too pessimistic; 10-week and 30-week moving average figures are also reported. Created by AW Cohen in 1963, it differs from AAII, which surveys individual investors, and it can be found on Chartcraft’s website.

Euclid, Ohio police said they will review a cellphone video showing a white officer repeatedly punching a 25-year-old Black man during a traffic stop after the man allegedly resisted orders. The officer is on paid leave, the NAACP is calling for a federal investigation, and the man was later released on bond after charges of driving under suspension and resisting arrest.

An explosion near the Port Authority bus terminal and Times Square in New York City injured the man wearing a homemade pipe bomb and three others. Police said one suspect was in custody, the injuries were non-life-threatening, and subway and bus service in the area were disrupted.

The passage recommends several children’s picture books, including a 35th-anniversary edition of Dear Zoo, new stories about crocodiles and a teddy bear, a republished dinosaur counting book, and titles about a penguin-like grandad and a bear in a garden.

The Rotary Club of Lakewood and Rocky River honored winners of its annual Speech, Music, and Visual Arts Contest at Beck Center on April 9. Speech winners were Nicholas Cleary, Taylor Heckel, and Gabby Murray; music winners included Angeliki Cintron, Hannah Cogar, and Emily Erhardt; visual arts winners included Elyza Mihalski, Mikah Inak, and Chloe Becker. The passage also notes Lakewood City Schools again received the NAMM Foundation’s Best Communities for Music Education designation.

Department of Education employees said their out-of-office email replies were changed without consent from neutral shutdown language to messages blaming Senate Democrats for the government shutdown, and some saw the partisan version reinstated after changing it back.

The brief argues that the out-of-school children (OOSC) indicator is too narrow because it measures only formal school enrollment and misses informal and non-formal learning. Using Afghanistan, where conflict, poverty, gender barriers, nomadic lifestyles, child labor, disability, and alternative education systems shape access, it proposes an out-of-education children (OOEC) indicator to better capture all educational pathways and support education system transformation.

SFS is an AMD firmware feature for applying high-priority firmware fixes at runtime without rebooting. Updates are delivered in signed packages, may be customer co-signed, and are controlled by patch levels including SFSPL, SPL, and SYSPL. The ASP verifies signatures, applies updates only when compatible, and versions are reported to the host OS.

The defendant’s conviction for criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree was affirmed. The court found no nonfrivolous appellate issues, granted counsel’s withdrawal, and held that the defendant’s pro se claims were barred by his valid waiver of the right to appeal.

The passage sets passport application rules requiring allegiance, personal description, witness certification, and different supporting documents for native, foreign-born, naturalized, female, child, and insular-possession applicants. It also states passports expire after two years, may include certain family members, exclude professional titles, and can be refused for unlawful or improper purposes.

Archaeologists in Mexico plan to excavate a sealed tunnel beneath Chichen Itza’s El Castillo to reach a hidden cenote, which may reveal more about Maya sacred geography and beliefs. The passage also describes cenotes’ importance to Maya life, cosmology, and human sacrifice, including evidence that many victims at Chichen Itza were children in poor health.
Lab tests suggest that jostling microbubbles of air and methane can create tiny lightning zaps, which may spark ghostly will-o’-the-wisps.

The EU has pledged €545 million to support renewable energy and electrification in Africa through Global Gateway, aiming to expand electricity access, cut fossil fuel use, and counter China’s Belt and Road influence. Planned projects include transmission lines, rural electrification, wind and hydro power, and mini-grids, with the EU estimating 38 million green jobs by 2030.
The Court affirmed the judgments of conviction without opinion. The case was argued on September 29, 1947, and decided on October 16, 1947.

Patriarch Theophilos III said the Jerusalem Orthodox Church will appeal an Israeli court ruling approving the sale of church property in East Jerusalem to companies representing Israeli settlers. The church, which has fought the deal for a decade, called the ruling politically motivated and said it will appeal to Israel’s Supreme Court.

The study surveyed 82 kindergarten teachers in Epirus, Greece, about distance education during COVID-19. Most had little prior familiarity or experience with it, mainly used Webex and email, and held mostly negative views about its suitability for kindergarten. ICT certificate level was linked to prior familiarity with distance education, while years of service and ICT familiarity were not significantly related.

A take a knee chart helps football coaches decide when an offense should use the victory formation to run time off the clock at the end of a game. It highlights clock management, noting that coaches must be careful with timing and play selection to avoid giving the opponent a chance to regain possession.

S&P Global Ratings downgraded Bridgeview, Illinois, to BB-minus, putting it at junk level because of debt pressures tied to its stadium financing. The agency said the suburb faces acute financial uncertainties, has very weak liquidity, and may face a further downgrade; Bridgeview is also considering restructuring $24.5 million of variable-rate bonds.
The passage is a photo gallery from the 3rd round of the Scripps National Spelling Bee in Oxon Hill, Md., on May 30, 2018, showing participants spelling words correctly or incorrectly.

The passage introduces ML²B, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating LLMs on generating full ML pipelines from 30 Kaggle competitions translated into 13 languages. It reports 15–45% performance degradation on non-English tasks, notes that English is consistently the strongest language, and describes structured metadata, modular grading, leakage controls, and several persistent failure patterns in generated code.

Amazon.com, Inc., incorporated in Delaware and headquartered in Seattle, filed this 2018 Form 10-K reporting net sales of $232.9 billion, operating income of $12.4 billion, and net income of $10.1 billion. The company operates in North America, International, and AWS segments, and cites intense competition, international and regulatory risks, fulfillment and data center challenges, security breaches, inventory risk, foreign exchange risk, and tax and payment-related risks among its major risk factors.

The passage is a collection of spam-like messages advertising hacking services, including database access, phone and email spying, credit score boosting, record deletion, and other illegal hacking jobs, with multiple contact emails provided.

The 9 EMA strategy uses the 9-period exponential moving average to generate buy signals when price moves above it and sell signals when price moves below it. It is described as useful for short-term trends and momentum, works better in trending assets like Bitcoin than in mean-reverting stock markets, and can be combined with other indicators such as RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, candlestick patterns, or a 200-day moving average filter.

Mark Palmer forwarded a California class-action complaint alleging that electricity generators and traders, including Reliant, Southern, Dynegy, NRG, AES, Williams, and Duke, manipulated wholesale electricity markets in 2000 and caused inflated prices and overcharges.

GOLDWOOD says it provides premium, uncompromising quality products and emphasizes teamwork, transparency, timely delivery, sustainable development, and quality manufacturing. GOLDWOOD PLY is presented as a top plywood manufacturer in Yamunanagar, Haryana, offering block board, flush door, and plywood across India.

The passage argues that laws are often most effective when passed without public excitement, and supports using criminal proceedings in trust and interstate commerce cases when appropriate. It cites successes in such prosecutions as deterrents and quotes Judge Holt urging severe penalties for deliberate railroad rebate violations, especially against the corporation involved.

The Missouri Student Union held its annual Veterans Day wreath-laying ceremony in Columbia to honor veterans and MU student veterans who have died. The event featured Col. Roderik Cox as keynote speaker, remarks from MU student groups and the Veterans Center, and a reception afterward at Bengal’s Lair.

The Konektadong Pinoy Act, made law on August 24, 2025, aims to reduce barriers to competition in the Philippine telco market and could bring more entrants, including Virtual Network Operators, to compete with PLDT. The passage says this may increase capital investment in an already mature, highly penetrated industry and pressure profitability, making the threat of new entrants a reason to avoid the stock despite its attractive valuation.

Passports expire two years after issuance and require a new application; naturalized citizens may use the old passport instead of a naturalization certificate if the original application has sufficient naturalization information. One passport may cover an applicant, wife, minor children, and entitled servants, but others need separate passports. Professional titles are omitted, a $1 fee is required for citizen passports, and the Department of State does not obtain foreign visés. The Secretary of State may refuse passports for unlawful or improper purposes or noncompliance. For insular possessions, applications are made to the chief executive, only persons owing allegiance to the United States may receive passports, and applicants must submit a sworn written affidavit with specified personal details and intent to return.

Joy Williams, BSN, RN, is a Louisiana nurse with over seven years of experience in agency and hospital work. She began as an LPN after graduating from Nunez Community College in 2009 and earned her BSN from Dillard University in 2016. She is a member of the National Black Nurses Association and the National Student Nurses Association, and credits her daughter Londen for inspiring her success.

The passage argues that small group differentiation can improve learning outcomes and inclusivity in elementary and higher education, especially for diverse students and English language learners. It describes differentiation as tailoring content, process, assessment, and learning environment to student needs, and notes that it is grounded in constructivist and sociocultural theories. The passage also identifies challenges such as time demands, large class sizes, and limited research, and recommends future longitudinal studies on differentiated instruction.

The paper presents the Atlas of Human-AI Interaction, an AI-based framework that extracts empirical findings from over 1,000 HCI papers into structured cause-effect triplets and a knowledge graph. It includes three visualization modes, identifies research clusters and cross-community gaps, and reports a user study where experts found it useful for high-level exploration, relationship discovery, and identifying research gaps.

The 4-3 defense uses four linemen, three linebackers, and four defensive backs, and is valued for run support, gap soundness, and versatile coverage. It can be attacked by spread offenses and edge runs, and common adjustments include nickel personnel, blitzes, Tampa 2, and Cover 3.

The passage lists multiple finance and business headlines, including warnings about an AI bubble, major bank and company deals, record-high valuations, gold rising above $4,000, Google’s Gemini Enterprise launch, and Germany’s antitrust probe into Temu.

The All Weather Portfolio is a diversified, defensive strategy using stocks, bonds, and commodities to perform across inflation, deflation, and stagflation. The passage says it has lower returns than stocks but smaller drawdowns, and it outperformed stocks in 2008/09, 2020, and 2022.

The mother appealed a dissolution judgment that set child support at $31 per month for each of two children and abated support during the father’s visitation. The court agreed the amount was too low and modified the judgment to require the father to pay $65 per month for each child.

Please, Continue (Hamlet) is a theatre work by Yan Duyvendak and Roger Bernat staged in real courtrooms with real legal professionals, where audience-selected juries decide Hamlet’s fate. It uses Shakespeare’s story alongside a real case to show the complexity of justice, and has been performed in 12 countries since 2011.

This systematic review and bibliometric analysis of 270 Scopus journal articles (2015–July 2024) found that research on metaverse in education began rising in 2020 and peaked in 2023. South Korea, China, the United States, and the United Kingdom were the most productive countries, while IEEE Transactions on Learning Technologies and Sustainability (Switzerland) were the most influential journals. The main topics were virtual reality, augmented reality, artificial intelligence, and student and teacher perceptions of metaverse adoption.

The Appellate Division affirmed the order, awarding $10 costs and disbursements. Thomas, J., dissented, stating the order was entered ex parte and deprived the plaintiff of a statutory right to reply to the answer.

Michigan State Police and Emergency Management and Homeland Security are urging residents to join a voluntary statewide tornado drill at 1 p.m. Wednesday during Severe Weather Awareness Week. Nearly all state facilities will participate, and officials advise residents to know shelter locations, practice drills, monitor weather updates, understand tornado watches and warnings, and prepare 72-hour emergency kits. If severe weather occurs on April 19, the drill will move to 1 p.m. Thursday.

The passage explains that strong transition defense begins with good offense, including ball security, good shot selection, offensive rebounding, and defensive balance. It stresses sprinting back with ball vision, defending outnumbered situations, disrupting outlet passes, recovering after turnovers, missed shots, blocks, and free throws, and using full-court or half-court pressure when possible. It also outlines coaching objectives and teaching methods for building transition defense habits.

The passage defines GHCB/NAE event rules, including VALID_BITMAP handling, guest/hypervisor state requirements, error signaling, and support for events such as MMIO, page state change, SNP guest requests, AP creation, doorbell pages, timers, APIC ID lists, secure AVIC, termination, and #HV interrupt delivery.

The Navy’s free Pier Pressure app, part of the Keep What You’ve Earned campaign, helps Sailors make responsible drinking choices through interactive features, a calorie counter, and ride service integration. It has been played more than 30,000 times and is available on iTunes and Google Play.

U.S. stocks fell sharply Tuesday, with the Dow down 424.56 points amid fears of rising interest rates and slower economic growth. Caterpillar, 3M, and Alphabet all declined, while rising Treasury yields above 3 percent raised concerns about tighter Federal Reserve policy and higher borrowing costs.

In a wrongful death suit arising from a collision that killed J. W. Summers, the trial court awarded damages to his wife, children, and mother, but the Court of Civil Appeals reversed and remanded. The court held that several jury instructions were erroneous because they assumed life expectancy, restricted or misstated recoverable damages, allowed consideration of nonpecuniary losses, and improperly handled issues such as sole proximate cause and counsel’s argument.

A security researcher found a disabled keylogger in Synaptics touchpad drivers pre-installed on more than 450 HP laptop, tablet, and workstation models. HP said it confirmed the issue, released patches, and that access required administrative privileges; the keylogger could be enabled after a registry change.

Police in China shot dead three knife-wielding assailants in Xinjiang after they killed five people and injured 10. Authorities said social order was restored and an investigation was launched, but gave no details on the attackers’ or victims’ ethnic backgrounds. The passage also notes Beijing’s accusations against Uighur separatists and references earlier attacks in Xinjiang and Kunming.

Philadelphia remained unbeaten in four and stayed in the playoff race after Borek Dočkal starred with a goal and two assists in a win over Chicago. The passage also highlights Ilsinho’s goal against Bastian Schweinsteiger and notes a late Teal Bunbury penalty gave New England a 1-1 draw.

Johnny Juzang is making a strong case for a Timberwolves roster spot after Nickeil Alexander-Walker’s departure, scoring 20 points in 14 preseason minutes and going 9-of-15 from three. On a non-guaranteed contract, the 24-year-old outside shooter is fitting Minnesota’s style and may become a bench option.

Researchers from Johns Hopkins and the Mayo Clinic published a guideline based on peer-reviewed evidence to help phase out CK-MB blood testing for suspected heart attacks, citing studies and guidelines that say it adds no diagnostic value. The report provides steps for hospitals to eliminate the test and improve reliance on troponin.

Synthetic observations of a collapsing prestellar core show that infall velocities derived from self-absorbed line profiles, using standard constant-velocity methods, systematically underestimate the true mass-weighted infall speed, sometimes by up to an order of magnitude. The study used SPH simulations, time-dependent chemistry, and radiative transfer, and found that line choice and aperture size affect the derived values, while optically thin-line velocity dispersions were closer to the true infall speed.

An Indian-origin surgeon, Dr Sachiendra Amaragiri, was struck off the UK medical register after a tribunal found he abused his professional position by sending a love letter to a female patient. The patient reported feeling distressed and called the police, while Amaragiri called it a “moment of madness,” apologized, and said he will appeal.

Tesla reported that effective March 11, 2021, Jerome Guillen transitioned from President, Automotive to President, Tesla Heavy Trucking to lead the Tesla Semi program, including related charging and servicing networks.

Compass Minerals International is rated a Buy because its shares appear undervalued, with improving revenue, volumes, EBITDA, and cash flow from salt, plant nutrition growth, and cost cuts. Higher debt and leverage remain a risk, but management expects further 2025 top-line growth.

CANSLIM, developed by William O’Neill, is a stock-screening method based on seven criteria and is mainly intended for long-term investing. Backtests suggest it beat the S&P 500 since 2003, but with high volatility and large drawdowns, and it has not performed well in recent years.

The speaker says the team needed a win and credited Rucchin’s two goals, strong play by Jiggy, and overall team effort. He said the team stayed focused, prepared the same way each game, played better after the first two games in New Jersey, and needs to tighten defense while maintaining offense. He also said he leads by example, was fine after a hard stick hit, and views the series as intense playoff competition.

Peter Crouch joked on Twitter after the birth of Kate and William’s third child, and Abbey Clancy replied with a blunt comeback. Crystal Palace also joked on Twitter by reacting to an AFP tweet announcing the birth with “Great name!”

Sony launched a U.S. instant rebate and trade-in promotion through September 30, 2017, offering up to $500 trade-in savings, up to $300 off select cameras, up to $200 off A7 cameras, up to $100 off selected lenses and accessories, and free U.S. shipping.

The passage discusses concern over the Golden State Warriors’ tendency to start slowly and rely on second-half comebacks, describing it as a “Superman syndrome.” Mark Jackson and Jeff Van Gundy say this is concerning, though they credit the team’s talent and ability to adjust. The Warriors led the NBA in third-quarter scoring and had several notable comeback wins, but also had games where they could not flip the switch.

The writer says pregnancy made sleeping difficult because of safety limits on back and stomach sleeping, so she bought a Leachco U-shaped pregnancy pillow after seeing it recommended online. She found it made sleeping much more comfortable and plans to keep using it after the baby is born, despite its size and minor drawbacks.

Investors are buying closed-end mutual fund equity schemes on stock exchanges at discounts to NAV because these funds have limited liquidity and can only be redeemed at maturity. Examples include Reliance and HDFC schemes trading below NAV, with discounts varying by time to maturity and tax factors. Experts suggest focusing on larger schemes with higher assets under management because many listed closed-end funds are rarely traded.

Airbus plans to test Project Vahana, an autonomous flying car designed as a helicopter-style airborne taxi for short-haul trips, with a prototype expected by 2017 and availability by 2021. The passage also notes similar flying-car efforts by Uber, Urban Aeronautics, AeroMobil, and investors including Skype’s co-founder and Larry Page.

A taped letter from fired assistant U.S. attorney Michael Ben’Ary said a false social media post apparently led to his dismissal during a terrorism prosecution, and accused DOJ leadership of punishing perceived Trump enemies over public safety and national security.

The passage describes a light emitting diode device and manufacturing method in which micro light emitting diodes are mounted between first and second diode electrodes on a thin film transistor substrate. A first passivation pattern is formed so each micro LED sidewall and the passivation sidewall lie in the same plane, reducing damage to bridge patterns that electrically connect the electrodes to the micro LEDs. The method uses a single mask process with two etching steps to form the passivation patterns and align the micro LEDs.

The passage previews MLB wild-card Game 3s after several Game 2 wins set up three winner-take-all games, noting the Yankees forced a Game 3, the Dodgers advanced to the NLDS, and the Tigers, Cubs, Padres, and Red Sox situations were discussed. It also mentions offseason MLB news, including Snitker not returning as Braves manager in 2026 and the Rockies firing GM Schmidt.

Aspen will replace its Fourth of July fireworks with a 15-minute drone show using 50 drones because of wildfire risk and fire restrictions in drought-hit Colorado. The show will take place in Wagner Park and feature patriotic colours and music.

The passage says the U.S. national debt passed $21 trillion, grew by $73 billion in one day, $215 billion in February, and over $1 trillion in six months. It argues debt growth is outpacing GDP growth, claims the debt matters despite common dismissals, and says people generally ignore it, deny its importance, or prepare for possible consequences.

Jio announced Jio Galaxy Club offers on the Samsung Galaxy J2 2018 and Galaxy J7 Duo, including Rs 2,750 instant cashback and data benefits. The J2 2018 gets 100GB extra data with Jio plans, while the J7 Duo gets double data on Rs 198 and Rs 299 plans. The offer is valid until September 30.

The CFPB finalized rules requiring payday and auto title lenders to assess borrowers’ ability to repay and limiting repeated account debits, potentially cutting industry loan volume in half and forcing many stores out of business. Supporters say the rules protect borrowers from costly debt traps, while critics and Republicans argue they would hurt access to credit and may be rolled back by Congress.

In 67 sarcoma patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, tumors clustered into immune-hot and immune-cold groups based on baseline immune infiltrates. Immune-hot tumors had higher response rates, longer progression-free survival, lower purity, and higher expression of transposable elements, IKZF1, PD-L1, and immune/inflammatory pathway signatures. These findings were replicated in a TCGA sarcoma cohort, where immune-hot tumors were associated with improved overall survival.

Meagan Holt, whose 3-year-old daughter Madeline has Zellweger Syndrome, is taking part in a Seattle Children’s writing program that helps parents journal about their emotions. Holt says writing gives her an outlet and helps her cope, while PACT consultant Julie Arguez says the program can bring calm, relief, and acceptance.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 27, 2022 announcing its third quarter 2022 financial results and including related exhibits on the press release and non-GAAP financial measures.

Happy Home Furnishers is closing its Neath store after 33 years, citing lack of free parking, rising business rates, and anti-social behaviour. The company said staff and customers had been affected by disorder outside the shop, while Neath Council said recent works, parking facilities, and anti-social behaviour measures were intended to benefit the town. The business will continue elsewhere and may look for another Neath location.

The study explored physics teachers’ attitudes toward physics education research using interviews with 13 teachers and a survey of 174 teachers. Four profile types were identified: Sceptical Ones, Uncertain Ones, Undersupplied Ones, and Research Advocates. Most teachers showed some scepticism about the cooperation between research and school practice, and frequent reading of instructional journals was the only significant predictor of profile membership.

The Ravens traded Odafe Oweh and a 2026 fifth-round pick to the Chargers for safety Alohi Gilman. The move gives Baltimore help at safety and Los Angeles a young edge rusher, as the Ravens continue to struggle on defense at 1-4.

African tax officials at a VADA forum in Lilongwe called for modern technology to improve tax compliance and revenue collection. Ben Botolo said Malawi had made progress in electronic monitoring of tax compliance, though more improvement was needed, while Henry Saka urged formal regulatory strategies and African solutions to tax evasion.

The lecture reviewed Green’s functions and their contour prescriptions, noted that vacuum n-point functions in the free theory factorize into products of two-point functions, and discussed singular composite operators and renormalization. It then introduced interacting theories via a \(\phi^4\) term, explained that exact solutions are unavailable, and motivated scattering and the S-matrix as the key observable, with the LSZ theorem relating scattering amplitudes to time-ordered vacuum correlation functions.

The writer clarifies that his earlier message did not deny Congress the power to regulate the custody, safekeeping, and disposition of public money and property. He states that the Legislature may designate where public funds and property are deposited and regulate them by law, and that the Executive has no right to interfere except as authorized by law. He asks that this clarification be entered with the original message on the Senate journal.

The passage discusses playoff hockey, emphasizing that the team must stay focused, play a complete game, and win away from home. It praises the confidence and resilience of the goaltenders, the effectiveness of player pairings and defensive coverage, and says penalties and distractions should be avoided.

The passage describes a sidelink positioning method and apparatus in which terminal devices measure sidelink reference signals to determine relative or absolute positions with improved accuracy and reduced latency by avoiding core network transmission of measurement values. It provides multiple configurations and variants involving first and second terminal devices, network device coordination, and measurement types such as Rx-Tx time difference and angle of arrival.

The passage describes multiple figures showing perspective, front, back, side, top, and bottom views of first and second embodiments of an analytical instrument, and notes that broken-line features are not part of the claimed design.

The author describes decluttering his house by tossing out decades-old McGill law school books after deciding he no longer needed them in retirement. He recalls notable cases and legal concepts from the books, then recycles most of them, keeping only one large volume to use as a reading stand.

A Wall Street Journal article in June 2014 reported that Hertz would restate and correct results from the past three years, and its stock fell about 9%. The passage reviews the U.S. car rental industry, Hertz’s history and operations, its revenue and earnings growth, and explains depreciation of rental fleet assets. It notes Hertz’s accounting for revenue earning equipment, useful life estimates, program and non-program cars, and provides data for comparison with Avis Budget Group.

The passage says AI may augment human cognition, learning, creativity, and skills, but warns against over-reliance and poor internalization of learned abilities. It also describes potential changes to work, collaboration, business models, social science research, and AI governance, emphasizing human-AI collaboration, careful regulation, and mitigation of societal risks.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 25, 2018 reporting that it announced third quarter 2018 financial results, with the related press release and non-GAAP information included as exhibits.

The passage explains that unused comparator inputs should not be tied together, but connected to valid voltages with at least 50 mV differential. It describes 1.8 mV internal hysteresis, push-pull and open-drain output behavior, ESD protection, power-on reset, external hysteresis circuits, and design/layout guidance for comparator applications, including bypassing and minimizing noise.

Rivers State Governor Nyesom Wike urged the United States to establish a Visa Office in Port Harcourt, said the NDDC is focused on politics and corruption rather than development, and called for stronger cooperation on Ogoni cleanup and investment in agriculture, oil and gas, and industrialization. The US Ambassador said he was in the state to interact with the people and learn about the state.
Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on March 19, 2020, stating that it published a press release on that date, which was furnished under Item 7.01 and included as Exhibit 99.1.

Coach Vigneault said the team must bring its A game to beat a very strong, structured opponent, as B-level play will not be enough. He emphasized competing hard, executing the game plan, and making adjustments after a loss, while praising several players for their contributions and noting one player’s improving stamina and overall play.

The talk discusses possible pathways to nuclear war, climate change versus nuclear risk, nuclear deterrence, proliferation, the Non-Proliferation Treaty, Iran negotiations, and arms control. The speaker argues that fear, distrust, and unstable alert systems create risks of accidental or escalatory nuclear war, criticizes aspects of U.S., Russian, Indian, Pakistani, and North Korean policies, and says nuclear abolition is desirable but unlikely.

The passage urges creating a Cabinet-level secretary of commerce with broad powers, advocates reciprocity treaties with Cuba and Newfoundland, supports arbitration and the Hague tribunal for international disputes, commends Hawaiian fire claims to Congress, and backs construction of the Panama canal as a continuing national policy.

CPRE Bedfordshire said Central Bedfordshire Council’s housing target is too high and would mean loss of countryside, arguing that 60% of the homes would be for people moving into the area. The council said it must plan for new homes using government policy and migration trends, and that the target is based on a standard formula.

Andrew Johnson transmitted to the House of Representatives correspondence with General Grant about Grant’s temporary tenure of the War Office and the dispute over Mr. Stanton’s suspension. Johnson argued that Grant had intended from the start to frustrate the President and had been insubordinate in refusing direct orders. Five Cabinet members submitted statements supporting Johnson’s account of the January 14 conversation, while Grant replied that he meant only to interpret the President’s order and denied any intention to disobey a lawful direct order. The passage also includes related War Department correspondence involving requests for military assistance and information.

Woodstock grief specialists advise limiting holiday events, making exit plans, being honest with hosts, sharing emotions and memories, and creating new traditions while keeping some old ones. The Surviving Suicide Grief Support Group, led by trained peer volunteers, meets twice monthly at Smith-Leroy Funeral Home, and other grief programs are also available in Woodstock and Ingersoll.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting that it issued a press release on October 20, 2016 announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2016, with the press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The study explored medical students in Dubai’s perceptions of a curriculum-based resilience course. Students described resilience as an ongoing, proactive process linked to mindfulness, reflection, self-awareness, and coping with stress, and valued the course for improving wellbeing, self-efficacy, and application of resilience skills in daily and clinical life.

Bill Belichick said North Carolina will keep its approach despite a 38-10 loss to Clemson, which dropped UNC to 0-3 against Power 4 teams and left the team frustrated after five games. He said the issues are execution, concentration, and coaching, while acknowledging UNC is “building” and will keep playing the best performers.

The passage describes an undergraduate inclusive special education course that centers advocacy through recurring TED Talk analysis, reflections, a law-and-policy jigsaw, debate, and policy-focused writing. It argues that advocacy should be woven into special education preparation to build pre-service teachers’ skills, agency, and ability to influence policy and practice.

The passage argues that community-based and out-of-school-time organizations should be part of the student mental health solution because they already build trusted relationships with young people. It calls for investment in staff training, basic mental health infrastructure, partnerships with providers, and support for frontline workers to complement school-based efforts.

The lecture contrasts too much cooperation, such as collusion and data pools, with too little cooperation on digital platforms. It focuses on two-sided platforms, contestability, and fair access/compensation, arguing that the Chicago School explanation for non-discrimination fails because prices to consumers are often at a zero lower bound and because low access charges can induce foreclosure. The lecture discusses the Digital Markets Act, interoperability, access pricing, and concludes that the optimal access charge should be based on the value of ancillary benefits, denoted b.

Avoyelles Parish is projected to spend about $8,123 per student in 2017-18, with $2,102 from local revenues, ranking near the bottom among Louisiana’s 69 public school districts. The state average is $9,015 per student, and the City of Bogalusa School District is highest at $11,546. Louisiana’s funding formula gives more state aid to poorer districts, includes various student and program adjustments, and the Senate has asked for a study of the actual cost of education in the state.

EO 11905 replaced the 40 Committee with the Operations Advisory Group and banned U.S. government involvement in political assassinations and domestic intelligence activities. Carter then replaced the OAG with the SCC, later reaffirmed in EO 11985 and EO 12036, while creating the SAWG as a lower-level working group. The Carter administration also used worldwide or generic covert-action findings supported by “Perspectives,” with riskier operations requiring separate findings or MONs.

The passage previews Super Bowl LII between the Patriots and Eagles, lists five game-related questions and two bonus questions, and recaps prior Steelers-related question results, including leaderboard standings and discussion of the Hall of Fame, MVP, and awards.

The lecture introduces Real Analysis, emphasizing proof skills and the goal of describing the real numbers. It reviews sets and set notation, including empty sets, subsets, unions, intersections, complements, and disjoint sets, then proves DeMorgan’s laws. It also presents induction using the well-ordering property of natural numbers, proves the induction principle by contradiction, and gives two induction examples: a geometric-series formula and the inequality \(1+c^n \ge 1+nc\) for \(c \ge -1\).

The passage lists late-breaking news items including investigations into Russia, a possible U.S. policy shift on Israel-Palestine, the killing of Kim Jong Nam, NATO talks, cracks in California’s Oroville Dam spillway, risky driving behavior, Boeing unionization voting, high-tech produce labeling in Sweden, Kate Upton on Sports Illustrated’s cover, and Rumor winning best in show at Westminster.

New computer modeling and revisited data suggest Uranus emits about 15% more energy than it receives from the Sun, indicating it has some internal heat. The finding may help explain its past and improve understanding of similar-sized exoplanets.

Oclaro Inc shares fell 0.99% in the latest session. Analysts project a 52-week target of $9.27 based on 13 opinions, with targets ranging from $6.5 to $11.25, while the last close was $9.04. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 2.38, with 2 buy, 3 outperform, and 9 hold ratings. Its ATR-14 is 0.29, weekly volatility is 2.50%, monthly volatility is 3.07%, RSI is 55.48, market capitalization is $1.53 billion, and 1.62 million shares traded versus an average of 5.58 million.

The study developed and externally validated machine learning models to predict restriction from spirometry, demographic, and anthropometric data. In validation, the random forest model outperformed the FVC LLN for excluding restriction, with higher NPV and better equity, especially between non-Hispanic Black and non-Hispanic White patients.

The court held that liquor-permit applications are governed by general statutory construction rules, that section 2389 does not make first-term hearing mandatory or strip the court of discretion, and that failure to hear the application before adjournment did not dismiss it or destroy jurisdiction. A continuation to a later term was presumed proper, and the proceeding was dismissed.

Tesla’s 2018 Form 10-K states that the company designs, manufactures, sells, and services electric vehicles, energy storage products, and solar energy systems, and reports two segments: automotive and energy generation and storage. It describes Model S, Model X, Model 3, planned future vehicles, Powerwall 2, Powerpack 2, and Solar Roof, along with manufacturing facilities in California, Nevada, the Netherlands, Buffalo, and Shanghai. The filing also outlines regulatory, competition, intellectual property, employee, and financial information, and lists major risks including production ramp delays, supplier dependence, growth execution, product defects, and material cost or supply disruptions.

Asian stocks were mostly weak as trade-war fears and tariff deadlines pressured markets, while the Chinese yuan stayed near 11-month lows despite central bank efforts to calm it. U.S. stocks fell, led by technology shares and declines in Facebook, Tesla and Micron, which also hit Japanese chip-related stocks. The Mexican peso rose sharply, the euro was little changed, oil prices held firm on a larger-than-expected U.S. stockpile drop, and copper remained near nine-month lows.

The passage explains a stock-screening process for selecting the “best all-around” CCC stocks using the Dugan Stock Scoring System and several filters, including yield, market cap, payout ratio, dividend growth, EPS growth, debt/equity, and minimum Dugan score. It says the system evaluates current condition and expected future performance across risk, value, past performance, and future expectations, and that the 2017 formula produced 21 highest-scoring filtered CCC companies.

The East of England Ambulance Service NHS Trust was rated Requires Improvement overall by the CQC, though its caring was rated Outstanding. The inspection found progress in safeguarding, Mental Capacity Act understanding and incident reporting, but the trust still failed to meet ambulance response standards, had low staff morale, and needed further improvements in performance, procedures, risk registers, and staff support.

Coach DeBoer said the team should not panic or make changes just because it is losing, noting they have been in similar situations before and can still win multiple games in a row. He said the team has had good scoring chances but has not finished them, needs more goals and the first goal, and should credit the opposing goalie and team. He also discussed travel, discipline, officiating, and said the team battled until the final buzzer.

Temple Grandin will present “Livestock Handling and Animal Behavior” at a breakfast event on Friday, Feb. 23, in Red Bluff, sponsored by Shasta College Ag Leadership Club and UC Cooperative Extension. Breakfast is $15, and more information is available from Josh Davy.

Apple Inc.’s Q2 2019 Form 10-Q reported six-month net sales of $142.325 billion and net income of $31.526 billion, with total assets of $341.998 billion. For the quarter ended March 30, 2019, net sales were $58.015 billion and net income was $11.561 billion, driven by lower iPhone sales partly offset by higher Services and Wearables, Home and Accessories sales. Apple also reported stock repurchases, dividends, debt, marketable securities, and several accounting and legal updates.

Israel and Canada signed a modernized free trade agreement in Montreal to replace the 1997 deal, removing duties on more products and adding chapters on labor, environment, trade and gender, SMEs, and corporate social responsibility. The agreement aims to expand trade, improve market access, and must be ratified by both parliaments before taking effect.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture introduces RT Cores for efficient real-time ray tracing, along with NVIDIA RTX software and filtering to enable photorealistic rendering. It also supports Microsoft’s DirectML and DXR APIs, adds advanced shading features, and inherits CUDA improvements from Volta.

This meta-analysis of 13 studies found that AI-related technologies in education had a significant positive overall effect size of 0.86 (95% CI [0.45, 1.27], p < 0.0001). Chatbots and generative AI showed the largest effect size of 1.02, while online learning and virtual reality showed a positive but not statistically significant effect. The study used PRISMA guidelines and reported substantial heterogeneity across studies.

The passage says that during winter, infections spread more easily and that food can help support recovery and immune function. It highlights fruit and vegetables, protein, herbs and spices, probiotics, nuts and seeds, and nutrients such as vitamins A, C, and E, magnesium, zinc, and fibre as beneficial for immunity and health.

A Danish study of 4,741 mothers found that older mothers were associated with fewer behavioural, social and emotional problems in their children at ages seven and 11, but not at 15. The researchers linked this to older mothers being more psychologically mature, tolerant, emotionally stable, and generally more positive during pregnancy and parenting, though they also noted health risks of later childbirth.

The speaker said Fredrik had X-rays and a report was expected by the end of the day. He said the team had a poor start, made too many bad passes and turnovers, took better shots than usual on the power play, and needs to improve puck entries, forechecking, balance in ice time, and overall play to even the series.

Scientists coaxed human skin cells fused with empty eggs to undergo meiosis and become functional eggs that could form early embryos, a proof-of-concept that may one day help infertile people have children.

Niu Technologies has had strong stock gains in 2025, helped by recent growth, but the passage says future growth may not continue fast enough to justify the rally and valuations, so the stock is rated neutral/hold.

The invention relates to CAR-engineered immune effector cells with reduced or eliminated Tet1, Tet2, or Tet3 function, especially Tet2, to decrease 5-hydroxymethylcytosine and improve CAR T-cell proliferation, function, and therapeutic efficacy. It also provides Tet inhibitors, gene editing systems, manufacturing methods, and treatments for cancers and other diseases associated with tumor antigen expression.

Russian math is a growing after-school trend in the U.S., driven by the Russian School of Mathematics and other programs that emphasize reasoning, deeper understanding, and early algebra and geometry. Parents enroll children to improve math skills, challenge advanced students, or supplement school instruction, but the trend raises concerns about pressure, cost, and widening gaps between students.

This Mendelian randomization study found genetically determined pericardial adipose tissue was associated with higher risks of CVD, HF, HTN, CHD, IHD, IS, and VTE, and that hypertension mediated part of the associations with CVD, HF, CHD, IHD, and IS. It suggests PAT may be a potential therapeutic target, especially for people with obesity.

Enron disclosed that the SEC had requested information about transactions involving partnerships run by CFO Andrew Fastow, triggering a sharp stock decline and renewed scrutiny of the company’s $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity tied to those arrangements.

Three youth were killed by troops in Shopian’s Awneera area during a search operation that also damaged a mosque and houses and triggered protests, with civilians injured by pellet firing. Indian soldiers and troops were also reported killed or injured in separate attacks, trains remained suspended on some routes, and Kashmir leaders condemned attempts to alter Jammu and Kashmir’s status.

The passage says the Akindele case exposed widespread sexual harassment in universities and other institutions. It states that Richard Akindele was found guilty of soliciting sex from a student and dismissed by the University Council, praises OAU for acting quickly, and urges other universities to punish sexual abuse and protect female students.

Tom Evans said Alfie Evans has been breathing unassisted for nine hours after life support was withdrawn, and claimed doctors later gave him oxygen and water. He said Alfie’s mother was lying next to him and that the doctors were “gobsmacked” by his condition.

The passage is an Enron mentions roundup dated June 4, 2001, featuring articles on Karl Rove’s Enron stock holdings, Saudi Arabia’s $25 billion oil sector pacts with nine firms including Enron, commentary on energy prices and Enron, India-related reporting on ratings concerns and the Dabhol dispute, criticism of Enron by Nigeria’s president, and comments on Japan’s electricity deregulation.

The speakers discuss preparing for a road playoff game by setting the tone early, expecting a desperate opponent, and using the day off to rest and practice adjustments. They emphasize awareness of crowd energy, better execution and faceoffs, the team being banged up, and the value of a teammate who fills many roles, competes hard, and provides helpful guidance.

The study developed a metagenomic sequencing workflow using HostEL for human background depletion and AmpRE for single-tube DNA/RNA library preparation. In plasma validation, it detected bacteria, fungi, and DNA/RNA viruses, showed high sensitivity and specificity, and achieved 93% agreement with qPCR on 42 clinical samples.

Cruzin’ for Life retrofitted a wheelchair-accessible van that has transported more than 2,600 cancer patients and logged over 34,000 miles in its first year serving Mission Hope Cancer Center patients in Santa Maria and nearby areas. The nonprofit continues fundraising through its Valentine’s Day crab feed and may consider adding a second van if need and funding allow.

After a car crash near Carletonville, South Africa, a woman declared dead by paramedics was later found alive in a mortuary refrigerator. The ambulance service said the crew had followed procedure and launched an investigation, while two other occupants of the car were killed.

Jim Montgomery begins his first full season as Blues head coach in 2025–26 after taking over midseason last year, with the team aiming to return to playoff contention. The Blues have an early home-heavy schedule, key rivalry games, and a February Olympic break that could mark a midseason checkpoint, while Montgomery’s ability to improve defense, develop young forwards, and handle 26 division games may determine their playoff chances.

San Juan Mayor Carmen Yulin Cruz called new estimates of Hurricane Maria’s death toll in Puerto Rico a “day of collective mourning,” saying the government had not told the truth. A Harvard study estimated 4,645 excess deaths between Sept. 20 and Dec. 31, far above the official toll of 64, with a likely figure of about 5,000. Cruz criticized Trump’s response and said Puerto Rico is not prepared for another hurricane season.

NIFTY 50 shows a positive end-of-month effect in the backtests, with a strategy entering near the end of the month and exiting at the close of the second trading day of the new month. The article reports a CAGR of 10.5% on 100,000 invested, 30% market exposure, and a 26% maximum drawdown, and says the result is reasonably robust.

Celtic’s 2-1 win over Rangers has left them 19 points clear, with a game in hand, creating the biggest gap between the clubs in 91 years, since 1925-26. In that season, Celtic won the title while Rangers finished sixth.

The passage reviews literature on drama in education and STEAM, and reports a qualitative pilot study with 19 first-year university women who took part in two drama activities: a butterfly life cycle dance and a role-play on the Indian caste system. Observations and student reflections showed increased creativity, collaboration, problem-solving, and motivation, suggesting drama can support STEAM learning, though the study notes limits from its small, narrow sample.

The passage describes an autonomous vehicle system with a primary AV control sub-system and independent auxiliary control units that provide redundancy, bypass/failsafe responses, and trajectory verification for predefined safety-related conditions. The auxiliary units can independently detect hazards or AV control failures and trigger predetermined vehicle actions such as braking or steering.

TrackR unveiled new Bluetooth tracking products ahead of CES: the cheaper TrackR pixel, the updated TrackR wallet 2.0, and the TrackR atlas smart plug. The devices use smartphone tracking and a crowd GPS network, have replaceable batteries lasting about a year, and the atlas can locate items by room and works with Amazon Alexa.

The passage lists five lightning myths and explains that lightning is not attracted to metal, tires do not protect a car, lightning can strike far from thunderstorms, it can strike the same place more than once, and sheltering under a tree is unsafe. It says height, pointy shape, and isolation influence strikes, and notes that people near water are often killed during leisure activities.

NVIDIA reported that it and Samsung agreed to settle all pending intellectual property litigation between them, leading to immediate dismissal of related cases in U.S. district courts, the U.S. International Trade Commission, and the U.S. Patent Office. The settlement included limited patent licensing by each company to the other, with no broad cross-licensing or other compensation.

Thinking Machines Lab, led by former OpenAI researchers, launched Tinker, a tool that automates fine-tuning custom frontier AI models. It currently supports Meta’s Llama and Alibaba’s Qwen, is initially free, and is intended to make model training more accessible to researchers, developers, and others.

Amazon’s 2021 Form 10-K says it operates in three segments—North America, International, and AWS—serving consumers, sellers, developers, enterprises, content creators, and advertisers. It reports intense competition, significant operational and regulatory risks, and major investments in fulfillment and technology infrastructure. As of December 31, 2021, it had about 1.608 million employees, $96.0 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities, and 508,844,410 shares outstanding.

This study developed and externally validated deep learning MRI biomarkers for extra-prostatic extension and seminal vesicle invasion in localized prostate cancer. The biomarkers were associated with biochemical recurrence, improved prognostic performance in combination, and enhanced NCCN and UCSF-CAPRA risk stratification.

Microsoft’s 2015 Form 10-K says the company’s mission is to empower every person and organization and that its strategy is focused on mobile-first, cloud-first platforms and services. It describes six operating segments, major products and services, global operations, research and development investment, distribution channels, employees, executive officers, and key risk factors including competition, cloud execution, security, intellectual property, regulation, and supply chain issues.

The passage describes many device reset types and their effects, including software global warm reset, test reset, reset priority, reset isolation for the PCI Express and EMAC switch modules, and pin behavior during reset. It also outlines device clock inputs, PLL operation, SYSCLK and module clock limits, interrupt controllers, JTAG and trace features, and timing requirements for numerous peripherals. Later sections cover Ethernet, GPIO, GPMC/NAND/NOR flash, HDMI, HDVPSS, I2C, imaging, and DDR2/DDR3 interfaces, along with register descriptions and routing/timing specifications.

The passage says Michael Flynn resigned after reports that he discussed U.S. sanctions with Russia’s ambassador before Trump’s inauguration, prompting questions about what Trump knew and when. It notes that some officials, including Sally Yates and Donald McGahn, were informed, and suggests investigations or Senate hearings could make Flynn a key witness.

The Power offense is a set offense used to free shooters with baseline and down screens, attacking both sides of the defense and continuing with alternating screening away and down screens. It includes baseline cross entries, down-screen reads and counters, offensive rebounding emphasis, automatic counters, continuities such as motion, side screen, drive & kick, and triangle post, plus a Single/Double variation. The passage also stresses execution, communication, defensive recognition, scouting, and using side screens when the shot clock is low.

The passage says the British government declined U.S. proposals to arbitrate the Venezuela-Great Britain boundary dispute. It argues that the Monroe doctrine remains vital and applicable, and recommends a U.S. commission to determine the true boundary, with resistance to any British appropriation of territory found to belong to Venezuela.

Apple Inc. entered into an underwriting agreement on June 3, 2015 to issue and sell ¥250 billion of 0.350% Notes due 2020. The notes will be senior unsecured obligations, with interest payable semi-annually beginning December 10, 2015 and maturity on June 10, 2020.

Amazon.com, Inc. reported Q2 2015 net sales of $23.185 billion and net income of $92 million, versus a net loss of $126 million in Q2 2014. For the six months ended June 30, 2015, net sales were $45.901 billion and net income was $35 million. Cash and cash equivalents were $10.269 billion at June 30, 2015, total assets were $52.440 billion, and long-term debt was $8.250 billion.

Ruston, 4-0 and ranked No. 2 in Louisiana, traveled to Stephenville, 5-0 and ranked No. 25 in Texas, for a high school football matchup. Stephenville took an early lead after a Ruston fumble set up a 19-yard touchdown pass from Trot Jordan to Jhett Banuelos.

The October 2025 Supreme Court term is expected to be momentous, with major cases on presidential power, birthright citizenship, Voting Rights Act disparate impact liability, conversion therapy, transgender athletes, and Fourth Amendment emergency aid. The Court has already issued several 6-3 shadow docket rulings favoring the Trump administration, and the term is likely to produce blockbuster decisions affecting law and American society.

The passage highlights three local good-news stories: Parkway Elementary parent Karmel Davis was named Tupelo Public School District’s 2017 Parent of the Year; Corey Crayton’s family received a new home built by Habitat for Humanity and funded by HomeStretch Furniture; and Belden native Noah Barbieri was named a Truman Scholar, one of 62 students in the U.S. to receive the award.

DHS proposed capping international students’ stays at four years, ending duration of status and restricting major changes and transfers. Commenters from universities, hospitals, and industry opposed the plan, warning it would hinder degree completion, research, health care, and employers, while DHS said it aims to reduce visa overstays.

The speaker says losing such a long, hard-fought finals game was difficult, but the team must regroup and play better tomorrow. They note the unusual scoreless, overtime nature of the game, praise both goalies, and say the team will try to do things differently without dwelling on missed chances.

The study examined bilingual and monolingual early childhood teachers in Ankara and found that both groups viewed bilingualism as an advantage, especially for children’s self-confidence, communication, and future career prospects. Teachers differed on bilingual children in monolingual schools, bilingual program structure, challenges, and children’s development, and many lacked sufficient knowledge or training about bilingual education. All participants supported expanding bilingual schools in Türkiye and emphasized the importance of parental support and better teacher preparation.

AI is raising new patent questions, including whether it can be an inventor, whether it can hold a patent, and how it affects what a “person skilled in the art” would know; these issues may be resolved in future litigation.

This review examined lung cancer screening biomarkers and found ctDNA and 68Ga-Alfatide II PET/CT scans had the best sensitivity and specificity. It also reported that low-dose CT screening has false positives and overdiagnosis, and that biomarker-based screening may improve early detection and reduce mortality.

The study compared three physician surveys on EHR interoperability: the 2021 NEHRS, 2022 ABFM CCQ, and 2022 UCSF survey. The CCQ had the highest response rate and generally more favorable interoperability reports than the other surveys, while NEHRS and UCSF had lower response rates and different respondent compositions. Across all three, physicians reported limited EHR satisfaction and persistent interoperability problems, suggesting survey source and respondent mix affect results and policy interpretation.

A 12-month dementia-specific exercise and rehabilitation programme (PrAISED) was well received and delivered with reasonable adherence, but in a randomized controlled trial of 365 patient-carer dyads it did not improve ADL, physical activity, quality of life, balance, mobility, cognition overall, or other health outcomes. Falls were not significantly reduced, and the study concludes that exercise or functionally oriented rehabilitation is unlikely to change the loss of ability in dementia.

On August 17, Russian cosmonauts Fyodor Yurchikhin and Sergey Ryazanskiy will conduct a live spacewalk from the ISS to deploy five nanosatellites, collect residue samples, and install handrails and struts. It will be Yurchikhin’s ninth spacewalk, Ryazanskiy’s fourth, and the 202nd spacewalk in support of space station assembly and maintenance.

SR9009, also called Stenabolic, is a synthetic oral Rev-Erb ligand developed by Scripps Research Institute under Thomas Burris. It is described as increasing fat loss, endurance, muscle strength, and metabolism by activating Rev-Erb proteins, increasing mitochondria and energy expenditure, and reducing triglycerides, cholesterol, glucose, insulin, and IL-6.

The court granted defendant’s summary judgment motion and dismissed with prejudice Steven C. Gittens Sr.’s ADA disability discrimination complaint because he failed to respond to the motion or court orders and failed to show he was disabled under the ADA.

The passage argues for justice under law rather than mob violence, condemns lynching, and says education, especially public and industrial schooling, helps prevent criminality and improve race relations. It also warns against demagogues who inflame class hatred against wealth, saying such agitation spreads corruption and harms genuine reform.

Pocatello-Chubbuck School District will use three new focus groups to gather input before finalizing controversial high school boundary changes. The groups will include students, public and business representatives, patrons, and members of previous boundary committees, and their meetings will be open to the public. Trustees delayed the decision last month to seek more feedback after years of school choice led to enrollment and socioeconomic disparities among the district’s three high schools.

The bankruptcy court confirmed Jeffery and Paulette Smith’s amended Chapter 13 plan, overruling the Trustee in part. It held that the different treatment of Chrysler’s claim was not unfair discrimination, found the plan was proposed in good faith, and ruled the debtors’ ERISA-qualified profit sharing benefits were not disposable income unless actually received in cash. The court modified the plan to reduce Chrysler’s interest to 3.9%, require semiannual income updates, increase monthly plan payments by $75, require overtime income above projections to be paid into the plan, and require any cash distribution from the profit sharing plan to be paid to creditors.

The passage reports that Linux Foundation executive director Jim Zemlin highlighted Linux’s widespread use and the value of the foundation’s projects at an open-source event. It also notes Hart’s Gold Membership and development of HartOS, a HIPAA-compliant API platform for healthcare data, plus a free open source software basics publication and 11 new members announced by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation.

The passage includes a passport oath and affidavit form, followed by a U.S. legation report on an Argentine presidential message. The report says the message was generally hopeful but disappointing on international relations and finances, especially the negotiations with Chile for limiting armaments, which were described as a response to costly military spending, debt, deficits, and weak business conditions in both countries.

The passage argues that Snap has weak competitive advantages, faces pressure from larger platforms, and has low marketer adoption. It also says the upcoming lock-up expiration could add heavy selling pressure, while recent fundamentals missed expectations. The author concludes Snap is volatile and makes no trade recommendation.

Safety endpoints were similar between groups at 24 and 48 weeks. Before Week 24, AE and serious AE rates were comparable, bleeding events were slightly higher in the Additional Educational Program group, and one fatal bleeding event occurred there. Between 24 and 48 weeks, AE, serious AE, discontinuation, and bleeding rates were similar across groups, with two fatal bleeding events reported. Overall, 24 deaths occurred, no pregnancies were reported, and laboratory data showed no clinically concerning hepatic or renal signal. The study concluded that adherence and persistence were high and sustained, but the proactive educational program did not add benefit.

The passage explains how the Single/Double offense can be used to attack Triangle & Two defense by freeing shooters with screens, base screens, and side screens. It stresses communication, timing, defensive recognition, and proper execution, and notes that scouting opponents and varying alignments can help exploit weak defenders.

Greek primary teachers viewed STEM education as innovative and interdisciplinary, with benefits including problem solving, collaboration, critical thinking, and connections to everyday life. However, they reported limited confidence in teaching science and mathematics, and identified major barriers such as insufficient training, lack of equipment and materials, and too little time in the curriculum.
Newly analyzed microstructures help explain why dandelion seeds can be hard to dislodge, since they can provide lift-off or help the seeds wait for a better breeze.

South Korea’s birthrate fell sharply from the mid-1980s as more married women attained higher education. The total fertility rate dropped to 1.6 in 1987 from 2.1 three years earlier, and by 2015 it was 1.24. The report said married women’s education and labor force participation rose over time.

The passage outlines SAP rules for coding and summarizing concomitant medications, defining prior versus concomitant use, and using WHO ATC/WHODrug coding. It also specifies primary and secondary efficacy analyses for time to plasma glucose recovery and glucose changes, including censoring rules, covariates, statistical tests, PK/PD handling, and safety summaries for AEs, labs, vital signs, ECG, local tolerability, and immunogenicity.

Amsterdam archaeologists found 700,000 discarded objects in the Amstel riverbed during subway construction, ranging from Neolithic stone axes to cellphones. The collection, part of the “Below the Surface” project, offers clues to the city’s history and is displayed through station exhibits, an online database, and a book-catalog called “Stuff.”

The speaker describes making key goalie saves, including a crucial stop on a breakaway, and says the team is still focused on work to be done in the finals. He reflects on the emotional ups and downs of playoff hockey, the confidence boost from timely saves, and how special it is to play in Nashville, where the city and fan support have grown significantly.

The passage explains Bogolyubov’s lemma in finite fields and in \(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}\), showing that if \(A\) has constant density then \(2A-2A\) contains a large subspace or Bohr set of codimension/dimension less than \(1/\alpha^2\). It then uses geometry of numbers, especially Minkowski’s second theorem, to prove that every large Bohr set contains a large proper generalized arithmetic progression.

Japanese universities were behind in ICT use before COVID-19, but the pandemic forced a rapid shift to online classes and accelerated digitalization. MEXT and the Cabinet promoted remote learning, revised credit-limit rules, and supported digital projects, while universities faced challenges such as limited interaction, faculty and student concerns, and personal-information risks. The passage also discusses changes in teaching, student learning, and lifelong learning, noting that digitalization advanced most in distance and vocational programs but remained limited in other areas.

A £95,220 donation from the ScottishPower Foundation will help Sussex Wildlife Trust’s education programme at Woods Mill, enabling events for 1,300 more people, ten wildlife identification courses, 250 wildlife champions, and a young naturalists club. The funding will also support habitat and visitor improvements, including reed bed restoration and better path access, and has already funded a camera in a kestrel nesting box.

The passage describes NVIDIA A100 Ampere architecture improvements over V100, including faster Tensor Cores, asynchronous copy and barriers, larger and more efficient L2 cache with residency controls and compression, higher DRAM/L2 bandwidth, MIG for partitioning one GPU into up to seven isolated GPU Instances, third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4 with SR-IOV, better fault handling, and added features such as NVJPG decode, optical flow, improved atomics, NVDEC, CUDA graphs, and sparsity support.

The study developed and tested an online version of the SInQUE social inclusion assessment for mental health supported accommodation. Staff and service users generally found it acceptable, user-friendly, and potentially useful for care planning, though uptake was only about 10% of service users in one borough and was higher in supported housing than in residential care or floating outreach.

Steven Kean forwarded Enron mentions to Jeffrey McMahon, congratulating him on “shaking things up.” The attached items included news on a Wisconsin Gas pipeline purchase involving Enron subsidiary Northern Natural Gas, commodities reports mentioning possible Enron-related copper stock increases, a Reuters report on the FTSE 100, a Bloomberg story on a new coal futures contract in New York, and a Modern Metals article discussing Enron’s push into the steel market.

The speaker says goodbye to the Cabinet and White House staff, praises their devotion and integrity, and urges them to continue serving the next President and the country. He emphasizes that government service is a cause bigger than oneself, notes that no one in the Administration profited personally, and uses examples from his family and Theodore Roosevelt to encourage perseverance, humility, and pride in public service.

A Dalhousie University researcher says native bees on P.E.I. blueberry fields are numerous and efficient enough that farmers do not need honey bees. Native bees, which are more common in the Maritime climate and can buzz pollinate, may do most of the pollination; bringing in honey bees is costly and can introduce parasites.

Michael Dell said AI demand remains strong and the data-center boom is not over, citing customers’ need for computing power and power-grid limits. Dell Technologies’ stock, server-networking business, and future revenue and EPS growth forecasts have all risen, though some market observers warn of stretched valuations and possible AI-related froth.

The document standardizes the GHCB for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests, including protocol versioning, required guest state, hypervisor feature advertisement, and VMGEXIT handling. It defines GHCB/MSR protocols and NAE events for CPUID, AP booting, page state change, guest requests, TIO, Secure AVIC, and #HV doorbell/timer support, while also specifying unsupported features such as SMM and nested virtualization.

Siddharth Agrawal runs the family-managed Silkasia garment and home textile export business in Jaipur, with operations in several Indian cities. He is also involved in native cow research, agriculture, rooftop farming, and startup investing, and with his wife has created the women’s clothing brand Mayori. He is a member of EO Jaipur, YPO Rajasthan, and RAIN, and serves as President of TiE Rajasthan.

Vladimir Putin was declared the winner of Russia’s presidential election, earning more than three-quarters of the vote and beginning a fourth term that will last six more years. The passage says the election was widely seen as pre-determined, with the opposition reporting harassment, ballot stuffing, and no unified alternative.

The passage is a roundup of media coverage on Enron’s collapse, the Dynegy takeover, and related market and asset-sale reports.
