It also includes commentary on Enron’s accounting, executive compensation, investor losses, energy stocks, and the sale of Wessex Water, plus brief business news on Quanta, Burlington Resources, Azurix, SBC, and airlines.

The Dark Cloud Cover is a bearish reversal candlestick pattern that appears after an uptrend, when a bearish candle opens above the prior bullish candle’s close but closes below its midpoint. It can signal short selling or closing long positions, but it is not a guarantee of reversal and should be confirmed with other analysis, indicators, and risk management. The passage says it is best suited to bearish markets, can be used across asset classes, and its timeframe should match the trader’s goals and risk tolerance.

Tesla Motors filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2015, reporting $936.8 million in quarterly revenue and a net loss of $229.9 million. Cash and cash equivalents were $1.43 billion, total assets were $7.55 billion, and total liabilities were $6.19 billion. The company said it began Model X customer deliveries in September 2015, continued ramping production, and expected 2015 deliveries of about 50,000 to 52,000 vehicles.

Apple Inc. reported first-quarter fiscal 2017 net sales of $78.4 billion and net income of $17.9 billion, up 3% and down from $18.4 billion, respectively, versus the prior year. iPhone and Services sales increased, while iPad sales declined. Gross margin fell to 38.5% from 40.1%, operating income was $23.4 billion, and cash generated by operating activities was $27.1 billion. The company ended the quarter with $246.1 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, repurchased $10.9 billion of common stock, and paid $3.1 billion in dividends.

Doug Jones and Roy Moore faced off in Alabama’s special Senate election, which drew national attention amid allegations that Moore dated and molested teenage girls. Jones campaigned actively across the state, while Moore denied the allegations and had been mostly absent from the campaign trail.

Thousands of Armenian-Americans protested in Los Angeles to commemorate the estimated 1.5 million Armenians killed under the Ottoman Empire and to urge Turkey to recognize the deaths as genocide. The demonstrations followed the resignation of Armenian Prime Minister Serzh Sargsyan and included calls for remembrance, recognition, and an end to Turkish denial.

The speaker says Manny has stayed around the team during his injury and has been a major part of their success, leadership, and room presence, so his return would be a big boost. The passage also mentions that people sometimes struggle to tell the speaker and Alex apart, though those who know them well usually can.
The speaker says joking and laughter help keep the team loose, mentions a couple of missed wide open net chances, and says the team is relaxed because they need to win one game at a time.

The paper uses Bacchi’s WPR framework to analyze South Australia’s “World Class” public education policy and argues it centralised control, increased surveillance and accountability, relied on McKinsey’s Universal Scale and NAPLAN, and reduced trust in teachers and principals. It concludes that this approach narrowed public education’s social purposes and proposes a more democratic, equity-focused alternative called “Beyond World Class.”

The passage describes Mn5Al8 as a polar metal that transforms from cubic γ-brass to polar rhombohedral γ2 near 880°C and forms herringbone domain structures with head-to-head and tail-to-tail boundaries. Electron microscopy, DPC-STEM, low-voltage SEM, copper deposition, and oxidation patterns indicate different surface reactivity at these boundaries, with evidence suggesting carrier enrichment at one type and depletion at the other. The study also identifies additional metallic distortive polar metals in a chemical survey.

The Jonathan Hunt Chapter of the Daughters of the American Revolution held a tea at Parkwood Assisted Living to honor Good Citizens selected from seniors in eight high schools. Students submitted applications and essays on citizenship, heritage, and freedom, and attendees received recognition, with the overall winner receiving a monetary award.

Jane Goodall, the pioneering primatologist and conservationist who discovered chimpanzees use tools and engage in warfare, died in California at age 91 of natural causes. She founded the Jane Goodall Institute in 1977, launched Roots & Shoots in 1991, and became a prominent advocate for wildlife conservation and chimpanzee welfare.

The passage is a STAT newsletter and site excerpt featuring John Wilkerson’s health care politics coverage, links to stories on biotech, drugs, women’s health, and government shutdown and ACA subsidy negotiations, plus subscription and alert prompts.

Argentine defender Federico Allende admitted on radio that he repeatedly used a needle to hurt Estudiantes strikers during Sport Pacifico’s 3-2 cup upset, prompting outrage and a vow from Pacifico’s president to expel him.

The passage describes political unrest in Hawaii from 1889 to 1892, including a failed insurrection by Robert W. Wilcox and Robert Boyd, a constitutional dispute decided against the King, and the death of King Kalakaua, after which Liliuokalani became queen. It also notes U.S. involvement, concerns about the Queen’s actions, a court ruling on the cabinet’s status, and later efforts to revise the reciprocity treaty with the United States.

In a randomized trial of 25 frontline physicians and nurses with depression and burnout, group MBSR plus psilocybin-assisted therapy was safe and feasible and produced greater short-term reductions in depressive symptoms, depersonalization, demoralization, and connectedness improvements than MBSR alone, with no serious adverse events.

Stock trading strategies use defined rules to buy and sell stocks, including ETFs, over short time horizons such as minutes, days, or weeks. The passage covers many types, including day trading, swing trading, momentum, trend following, scalping, arbitrage, pair trading, sector rotation, mean reversion, and others. It says strategies can be backtested, automated with algorithms, and adjusted for volatility, costs, timing, news, and market conditions. It also states that single-stock trading is risky for retail traders, diversification can reduce risk, and trading differs from long-term investing in its shorter time frame.

Churchill High School senior Deanthony Gordley, who lost both parents after moving to San Antonio following Hurricane Katrina, experienced homelessness but received help through his school and the McKinney Vento Homeless Project and earned his diploma. He hopes to inspire others and shares his experiences through music sold on iTunes.

Jalen Carey’s verbal commitment helped Syracuse form a 2018 recruiting class that could be among the program’s best, alongside Darius Bazley and Buddy Boeheim. The passage introduces a ranking of Syracuse’s top recruiting classes based on recruiting rankings at arrival, using several recruiting sources.
Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in chemistry for work on metal-organic frameworks, which can trap gas, water and other chemicals.

Stripe is launching Open Issuance, a product that lets businesses create and manage their own stablecoins and keep the yield from reserves. The move follows Stripe’s $1.1 billion acquisition of Bridge and comes after new U.S. stablecoin legislation, with early adopters including Phantom, Hyperliquid, and MetaMask.

Ann Schmidt’s email listed Enron-related and other news stories from May 12-13, 2001, including California power shortages, BT’s credit downgrade, Houston technology and planning articles, Dabhol project developments, and Oregon proposals to have the state buy Portland General Electric.

The 3-2 zone defense is a variation of the 1-2-2 zone that widens wing defenders, denies wing passes, and protects the high post. It can leave the point guard open, but can be adjusted if needed. It is also effective for fast breaks. The passage lists basic defensive shifts and a point-wing interchange for different ball locations.

Fairall 9 shows SED changes dominated by a brighter disc-like component and a higher mass-accretion rate, while the integrated X-ray power stays nearly constant and mainly softens. Fourier analysis finds complex UV/X-ray lags and reduced coherence, with a likely additional slow inwards-moving component during the rising phase, and the authors conclude the inner accretion structure evolves on observable timescales.

The passage says markets turned risk-off after a weak jobs report, negative revisions, and policy uncertainty, with major indexes breaking down from highs in a bearish engulfing pattern. It also notes strong Q2 earnings and revenue beats, rising earnings revisions, and market expectations for Fed rate cuts, while sectors, internals, and several market indicators weakened.

The global organic pigments market is projected to grow at around 4.5% during the forecast period, driven by demand from paint & coating, plastic, textiles, and printing inks. Asia-Pacific is expected to be the largest and fastest-growing region, with China contributing significantly, while key players include BASF, Dow Chemical, Huntsman, Nippon Kayaku, Cabot, Clariant, and others.

West Midlands house prices rose by about £12,000 last year to an average of £181,000, with regional growth of 7.1%. UK house prices rose 7.2% overall, led by England at 7.7%, and varied widely across local areas, from a 26.1% rise in Shetland to a 9.8% fall in Aberdeen.

Cierra Dillard scored 22 points as 11th-seeded Buffalo upset No. 3 Florida State 86-65 to reach the women’s NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 for the first time in school history. Buffalo shot 47.4% from the field, dominated at the foul line, and limited Florida State to 33.8% shooting.

The passage describes a storage system with bins stacked in a grid framework and robotic load handlers that move above the stacks to retrieve containers. The invention adds services within the framework, including power, data communications, lighting, sensing, fluids, and monitoring, to control and condition-monitor the system and its contents, improve reliability, and reduce cost.

At the April 29 Town Meeting, Nahant residents will consider creating an Ambulance Enterprise Fund, but the Finance Committee does not recommend it. The committee also recommends postponing action on the Coast Guard Housing article and approving funding for drainage repairs, two DPW pickup trucks, and pumping station maintenance.

The passage argues that Saudi Arabia and Western mainstream media distort Islam and political opposition, respectively, and should be condemned similarly. It then links media criticism of Donald Trump and anti-Trump rhetoric, including a Kathy Griffin photo, to the shooting of five people at a baseball game by James Hodgkinson, who died after being shot by police and was described as a Bernie Sanders supporter and anti-Republican letter writer.

Mineral companies owe over $42 million in delinquent taxes to 12 Wyoming counties, largely because bankruptcy leaves county tax debts unpaid. Sheridan County is owed about $7.46 million, with most of that from Storm Cat Energy Operating Corporation and Summit Gas Resources, and the unpaid taxes affect schools and public services. The report recommends monthly collections, perpetual liens, a state bankruptcy assistance pool, and a way to check tax debt before asset transfers.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit SAR data acquisition system with simultaneous sampling, configurable single-ended or differential inputs, internal clamp protection up to ±18V, programmable gain and bandwidth, a 4.096V internal reference, and up to 2MSPS per channel; it also supports speed-boost mode up to 8MSPS for one selected channel pair, multiple data interface modes, averaging, test patterns, and SPI/daisy-chain configuration.

UNMC’s Children’s Dental Day in Lincoln provided free dental care and education to Nebraska children, treating 159 to 200 children each year with services including cleanings, fluoride, sealants, fillings, extractions, and root canals. The program has run since 2001 and has provided more than $3 million in dental work.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated February 8, 2018, reporting that it issued a press release and CFO commentary on its results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 28, 2018. The press release and commentary were furnished as exhibits and not deemed filed for Section 18 or Securities Act purposes.

Amazon reported Q1 2021 net sales of $108.5 billion, operating income of $8.9 billion, and net income of $8.1 billion. Cash and cash equivalents plus marketable securities were $73.3 billion at March 31, 2021, and the company provided second-quarter 2021 guidance for net sales of $110.0 billion to $116.0 billion and operating income of $4.5 billion to $8.0 billion.

The passage emphasizes that defensive boxing out on free throws is critical, as offensive rebounds can be game-changing. It describes stepping up the lane with feet together and hands high, boxing out the shooter, using pinching against strong rebounders, and practicing early push-off situations with clear assignments for made and missed free throws.

A Cherokee County community will gather to honor Maleka Johnson, a local school leader who was killed in a Bahamas boat explosion while on vacation with her husband, Tiran, who was critically injured. Johnson, originally from Tennessee, was celebrating 15 years of marriage, and family members are now supporting their 12-year-old son, Cameron.

The speaker, newly elected president, takes the constitutional oath and pledges to govern for the whole country. He says he will rely on the Constitution, appoint honest officials, keep the Army and Navy efficient, avoid foreign entangling alliances and remain neutral, enforce accountability and economy in government, support measures that promote national interests and the Union, and preserve the country’s prosperity through prudence, moderation, and patriotism.

The article backtests a calendar-based strategy that buys the S&P 500 during options expiration week and sells at the close of the week. It finds above-average returns during options expiration week, but weaker performance in the following week, with August relatively strong and September poor.

Vote counting is underway for by-elections to four Lok Sabha and 10 Assembly seats, with particular attention on Kairana in Uttar Pradesh and seats in Maharashtra. The BJP, opposition parties, and other major parties campaigned heavily, and several vacancies arose after the deaths of sitting BJP leaders.
The passage describes an under sink organizer with a sliding storage basket and lists its various drawing views, noting that broken lines show unclaimed portions of the design.

The lecture explains corporate carbon footprinting using WidgetCo’s supply chain case study, focusing on measurement methods, emission scopes, organizational boundaries, data challenges, and disclosure decisions. It emphasizes that scope one and two are required once a boundary is set, while scope three is discretionary, and notes that different boundary choices can make comparable companies appear very different.

The passage discusses preparing for the next Stanley Cup Final game, stressing discipline, physical play, and taking advantage of chances against a strong opponent expected to come out angry and hungry. It also praises Jason’s growing leadership and notes that the team’s chemistry, hard work, and home-ice advantage are important, while emphasizing that the first win means little without the next one.

A retrospective study of 1,383 noma patients treated at Noma Children’s Hospital in Sokoto from 1999–2024 estimated an overall incidence of 114.5 cases per 100,000 in northern Nigeria, with higher incidence among males, children under 10, and cases with gangrene. Sokoto had the highest incidence and Adamawa the lowest, and annual incidence increased notably from 2020 to 2024.

Eliud Kipchoge visited Tottenham Hotspur’s Hotspur Way after winning his third London Marathon title, where he met Victor Wanyama, Mauricio Pochettino, and some Tottenham players with coach Patrick Sang. Wanyama had congratulated Kipchoge after the win, and Kipchoge later thanked them for the day on Twitter. The passage also says Kipchoge was crowned World Marathon Majors Champion and is expected to attempt Dennis Kimetto’s world record at the Berlin Marathon in September.

The study used Q methodology with 13 Turkish university mathematics education faculty members to examine barriers to distance education after COVID-19 and the 2023 earthquake. It found three factors: student-related barriers, technology-related barriers, and pedagogical barriers specific to mathematics, with no teacher-related barrier factor emerging. Participants generally viewed distance education as insufficient on its own for mathematics and preferred blended models for the future.

The passage describes a system for securely sharing encrypted medical and other user data between client devices and servers using client-side-held keys, layered key hierarchies, and zero-knowledge storage. It uses password- or question-derived keys to decrypt a master encryption key and data encryption key, supports public-key sharing and shared data key hierarchies for group access, and keeps encrypted data inaccessible to the server or cloud provider.

The Ninth Circuit affirmed Noe Martinez Paredes’s guilty-plea conviction and 57-month sentence for conspiracy to distribute and possess with intent to distribute methamphetamine and heroin, found no arguable grounds for relief, and granted counsel’s motion to withdraw.

The Senate approved on third and final reading the unified national identification system bill, or Philippine Identification System Act of 2018, by 17 votes to 2. The measure would create a single official ID for citizens and foreign residents, assign each person a PhilSys Number, and make the PSA the PhilSys Registry. Senator Panfilo Lacson said it could aid law enforcement while protecting privacy, and said the system is expected to roll out in 2019 with P2 billion allotted by the DBM.

Natural bacteria on grape plant leaves may help reduce wildfire smoke taint in wine by breaking down guaiacol, a smoky compound. Researchers identified two strains that degraded guaiacol and the gene involved, suggesting a more specific mitigation approach than current methods.

Telstra chief Andy Penn faces pressure ahead of investor day after the company’s share price fell following a downgraded earnings outlook and an S&P Global ratings downgrade. Analysts expect possible dividend cuts and want signs of how earnings can improve after NBN compensation payments end, though some recent analyst commentary has become more positive.

Six months after Abby Williams and Libby German were killed near the Monon High Bridge in Delphi, there have been no arrests, but police say the case is still active. Investigators have followed more than 24,000 tips, received over 3,000 responses to a suspect sketch, and are still testing DNA from the crime scene.

Ajay Bodke says retail investors need not worry about LTCG tax because equities remain the only asset class offering inflation-beating returns, and the 10% tax is fair. He expects Indian equities to benefit from corporate earnings revival, a relatively strong macro outlook, range-bound crude oil prices, and a shift from unorganized to organized players. He also favors insurance and retail-focused private sector BFSI stocks.

Montclair State University’s mascot, Rocky the Red Hawk, celebrated his 16th birthday with campus events, free bagels, candy, cupcakes, gifts, raffles, dancing, photos, and a donation drive for a local food pantry. Students and staff attended the party, sang happy birthday, and praised Rocky for bringing joy to campus.

The passage is an AMD Geode CS5535 companion device specification update listing many revision A3 issues, including DMA, PIC, UART, ACPI, PCI, USB, IDE/ATAC, KEL, SMB, GPIO, and sleep/standby problems, with descriptions, implications, and workarounds or resolutions for each.

The study compares interdisciplinarity in impactful and less impactful medical journals using MeSH-based correlation networks from PubMed articles in 1999, 2010, and 2022. It finds that less impactful journals are more interdisciplinary, while impactful journals are more compartmentalised; cancer-related research is identified as a key driver of interdisciplinarity. Differences between the networks cluster around topic areas that vary over time, but both journal types share a stable core knowledge structure.

Police bodycam footage shows Emily Weinman refusing to give officers her last name during a Memorial Day beach stop in Wildwood, New Jersey, after being questioned for underage drinking. The encounter escalated, and officers arrested her after she refused to comply. Video and comments led to public outrage, and the officers were reassigned to desk duty pending investigation. Weinman was charged with multiple offenses, including aggravated assault, resisting arrest, obstruction, disorderly conduct, and minor in possession of alcohol.

A Legislative Analyst’s Office report says Gov. Jerry Brown’s tentative contract offer to correctional officers has a weak justification and that there is no evidence of recruitment or retention problems to support a 5 percent raise. The report says the deal could cost about $338 million over two years, possibly more because of overtime and pension costs, and notes that correctional officers’ wages have already exceeded inflation since 2001.

Archaeologists in Repton, Derbyshire, found a mass grave of more than 250 Viking warriors from the Great Heathen Army. A new study dated the remains to winter 874, after correcting earlier carbon dating for a marine reservoir effect caused by a seafood-rich diet, and concluded the site contains members of the Viking Great Army.

Police continued a nationwide manhunt for Steve Stephens after he posted Facebook videos of himself killing Robert Godwin Sr. in Cleveland. Authorities said they do not know what triggered Stephens, whose acquaintances described him as pleasant but possibly troubled by gambling problems. Godwin was described by his family as a gentle man who was shot while collecting cans, and a vigil was held for him in Cleveland.

Camp America offers students over 18 a chance to work at U.S. summer camps and travel afterward. It has over 8,000 places, recommends early applications, and holds a UK recruitment fair in January and February. The £599 package includes fees, medical insurance, 30 days of travel, return flights, and $650-$1200 pocket money.

The lecture introduced simplified plasma equilibria for spectroscopy, including thermodynamic equilibrium, local thermodynamic equilibrium with the Saha equilibrium, coronal equilibrium, and non-local thermodynamic equilibrium. It then described a spectroscopy workflow for estimating plasma density and temperature, using line ratios and X-ray spectroscopy. The lecture also covered X-ray filters, X-ray imaging with pinholes and bent crystals, and detector types including film, image plates, time-gated cameras, and streak cameras.

Aarhus University researchers studied on-farm milk concentration using reverse osmosis and ultrafiltration with Arla. They found no negative effects on bacterial count, free fatty acids, or protein breakdown, and milk powder quality and durability were unchanged; cheese made from concentrated milk coagulated about ten minutes later. Farmers showed interest, but dairies remain cautious about profitability and handling.

Agriculture-related stocks rose up to 13 percent after the government raised the minimum support price for paddy by a record Rs 200 per quintal. Fertiliser stocks also gained, and the cabinet approved MSPs for 14 kharif crops for the 2018-19 season.

Nested virtualization is not supported under SEV-ES and SEV-SNP. SNP-protected guests require RestrictInjection, limiting host interaction to a #HV exception, and the document defines common host notification information for OS-level dispatch while leaving driver-specific communications flexible.

Assistant U.S. Attorney Will Rosenzweig of the Southern District of Florida was fired by email after conservatives publicized old blog posts attributed to him that criticized President Donald Trump. The posts allegedly called Trump “mentally unfit” and “an institutional terrorist.” Rosenzweig had worked in the economic crimes section and joined the office in September 2020. The DOJ also fired three other prosecutors in the district who had worked with Jack Smith.

The note says peace must be based on a sound international order, not just on treaties or territorial changes. It supports Allied territorial changes, including ending Turkish rule over alien races, but argues that lasting peace also requires stronger security against German militarism and aggression.

The passage promotes several low-interest and rewards credit cards with introductory 0% APR offers, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses from issuers including Bank of America, Capital One, Citi, Discover, and others. It also explains that low-rate cards can save money, describes variable versus fixed APR, and notes that the site uses an objective ranking system despite receiving compensation.

A thermal alarm places the system in Faulted Standby, but the PMC cannot recover automatically because the alarm is in the Work domain. While in Standby, the alarm timer is blocked and the alarm cannot be detected; when the system exits Standby, the alarm timer restarts if the alarm is still asserted. Power removal is intended to cool the system and clear the alarm, and if it does not clear within the delay, Standby is forced again repeatedly.

Barbeque Nation Hospitality has filed its DRHP for an IPO comprising a Rs 200 crore fresh issue and an offer for sale of 61.79 lakh shares, equal to 14.22% of post-offer paid-up capital. The fresh issue proceeds will be used for new restaurants, loan repayment, and general corporate purposes, while the company will receive no proceeds from the offer for sale. As of June 30, 2017, it operated 81 restaurants in India and one in Dubai.

The passage compares dating to choosing a content marketing partner and offers five tips: find aligned interests, interview several candidates, verify results with references and examples, clarify what you need, and start with a trial period before committing.

Play action pass in football is a pass play designed to look like a run to deceive the defense, usually after a team has established the run. Its success depends on the offense selling the fake, the line protecting as if for a run before switching to pass protection, and routes that exploit space behind linebackers and safeties. Common uses include short-yardage, goal line, and red zone situations, and examples of concepts include Double Post and Bubble Y Over. It differs from an RPO because a play action pass is always a pass.

The passage says gold rose while silver, miners, and platinum did not, which is presented as bearish for precious-metals stocks. It also says the USD Index is likely to rally, stocks may decline further, and the overall setup resembles 2008 amid political and economic uncertainty.

Resolute Marine Energy sought to commercialize a wave-driven desalination system for South Africa, where weak grids made drinking water costly. By 2012, with pilot interest from Ugu and funding interest from the Development Bank of South Africa, the company was choosing among three paths: an electricity-producing WEC, a hydraulic WEC for desalination, or a vertically integrated “black box” system.

New York State Attorney General Schneiderman announced the arrest of Guilderland Town Judge Richard Sherwood and financial advisor Thomas Lagan for allegedly stealing over $4 million from family trusts they oversaw for the Bruggeman family. Both face felony charges including grand larceny, scheme to defraud, and criminal possession of stolen property.

The Federal Circuit affirmed an award of PSOBA death benefits to Christine H. Roberts’s estate, holding that eligibility is determined when the public safety officer dies and that a beneficiary’s later death does not end entitlement before payment.

A lorry driver, Jaroslaw Buczkowski, admitted drink-driving after being caught speeding up to 70mph in 40mph zones in Boston on New Year’s Day. He gave a breath reading more than twice the legal limit and was banned from driving for 20 months, reduced by 20 weeks if he completes a rehabilitation course, and fined £350 plus £120 costs.

Apple has recently underperformed the S&P 500, with its stock falling 6% over two days and trading below its all-time high while the index hit new highs. The passage notes that fiscal 2017–2019 EPS estimates have risen since May 31, but revenue estimates have slightly declined, and it argues Apple may be entering a period of lagging relative performance if high fiscal 2018 expectations are not met.

The AEGEAN study found high apixaban adherence and persistence through 24 and 48 weeks, with no additional benefit from the proactive educational program. Safety outcomes were similar across study groups, with reported adverse events, bleeding, deaths, and no concerning laboratory signals.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated October 25, 2022, reporting that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2022. The report includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1 and lists the company’s registered securities, including common stock, 3.125% notes due 2028, and 2.625% notes due 2033.

The US Department of Transportation plans to ban Chinese airlines from flying over Russia on US routes, saying it would reduce an unequal advantage over US airlines by forcing longer, costlier flights. The order targets seven Chinese carriers, while Chinese officials said it would hinder travel and exchanges.

The teams are both hungry in the Stanley Cup Final, and the speaker says their playoff schedule and week off helped with rest. He credits the team’s depth, including contributions from defense and forwards, and says their offense often comes from strong defense. He also notes Sidney Crosby’s skill and says the team must stay aware of Pittsburgh’s speed and danger throughout the game.

The passage discusses Industry 4.0, digital startups in Indonesia, and the need for strong business models to improve competitiveness and avoid losses. It explains using the Lean Canvas business model as a descriptive qualitative method with 120 respondents, and presents a lean canvas example for the “Beautiful Memories” digital startup.

A Lodi man who once struggled in school, Steven Ma, credits former teacher Linda Brandt with changing his life. Ma, now CEO of Thinktank Learning and the state’s first international education liaison, is giving two $15,000 Linda Brandt Scholarships to Lodi High School students and inviting Brandt to visit schools in China.

Jeff Smith joined KBC Networks as Midwestern regional sales manager, bringing nearly three decades of security industry sales and system integration experience. He will support system integrators and distributors in the central United States and provide localized support. Before KBC, he managed American FiberTek’s OT Systems product line and earlier worked at Alarm Detection Systems and Convergent Technologies in sales, technical support, and pre-sales engineering roles.

CoSn2 shows a low-temperature resistivity slope change below 25 K without specific heat or magnetic anomalies. X-ray diffraction reveals weak superlattice reflections and a symmetry reduction from tetragonal I4/mcm to acentric monoclinic C2, while angle-dependent magnetoresistance changes from fourfold to twofold symmetry. Calculations and ARPES indicate an electronically driven, orbital-anisotropic instability in this nonmagnetic material.

Tesla’s June 30, 2022 Form 10-Q reports higher revenue and net income year over year, with total revenues of $16.934 billion for the quarter and $35.690 billion for the first six months of 2022, and net income attributable to common stockholders of $2.259 billion and $5.577 billion, respectively. It also describes balance sheet increases in cash, inventory, property and equipment, debt reduction, digital asset impairments, stock-based compensation, tax uncertainties, and several ongoing legal proceedings.

The passage describes an interpretable causal Bayesian network for Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis that combines literature, data from the NACC dataset, and expert judgment. It models suspected and diagnosed AD, symptoms, tests, risk factors, complications, and treatment, and reports validation results showing probabilities change with observed clinical scenarios.

The passage is a collection of news items on energy and power issues, including California electricity investigations and political attacks on Enron, the U.S. Senate shift’s possible effects on industries, Brazil’s power rationing, India’s efforts to settle the Dabhol-Enron dispute, gas market changes in Central Europe, and company plans by Endesa and Dynegy.

Toronto police Const. Ken Lam was praised for apprehending the suspect in Monday’s van attack without firing, using verbal commands, a drawn weapon, and then a baton before handcuffing him. The 37-second arrest came after the attack killed 10 people and injured 15, and police say there is no evidence the suspect was armed. Alek Minassian, 25, was charged with 10 counts of first-degree murder and 13 counts of attempted murder.

Police in Colombia say kidnappings fell 92% since 2000, with 188 abductions in 2016, due to a peace deal with the Farc and improved security. The Farc reportedly kidnapped no one in 2016, while most kidnappings were blamed on common criminals.

In a malicious prosecution action by Susan Ann Vansickle against Brown, the court held that insulting conduct by the arresting officer was inadmissible absent proof it was instigated by Brown, a prior trespass judgment was properly excluded, verbal county court directions could be admitted to show Brown’s good faith, and Brown could testify to his own good faith. The court also held that probable cause depends on the defendant’s honest and reasonable belief in the plaintiff’s guilt, that waiver of a preliminary examination and recognizance is prima facie evidence of probable cause, and that malice must be shown; the judgment was affirmed.

The passage describes AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) feature, which uses a firmware engine to migrate pages between system physical addresses and support concurrent DMA and SNP guest page migration. It outlines command types, multi-page lists of up to 128 entries, ring buffer and driver initialization, interrupt behavior, SPA encoding, reload of TMPM firmware, and restrictions on migratable data and page alignment.

Apple Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on August 8, 2022, it issued and sold $5.5 billion in senior unsecured notes due in 2029, 2032, 2052, and 2062 under an underwriting agreement and indenture. The notes pay interest semi-annually and rank equally with Apple’s other unsecured, unsubordinated debt.

The Pennsylvania DEP issued MAWA a construction permit for fluoridation facilities, but MAWA still needs an operations permit before it can add fluoride to the water. The board is expected to discuss bids and the construction timeline on July 18.

The Yield Hog Dividend Growth Portfolio is down about 2% including dividends after nearly seven months, but its annualized income has risen from $4,094 to $4,369, helped by dividend increases from 17 of 22 holdings and reinvestment. The author is not adding to Enbridge because of risks, but is buying eight more shares of TransCanada, citing its dividend yield, growth outlook, valuation, and analyst support.

Holmer was described as causing havoc in front of the net on the power play and drawing a penalty through his physical play. The speaker also said the team was confident, had broken the “Hasek jinx,” and was focused on getting the puck behind him to build on their two goals.

The study examined pedagogical approaches for teaching education for sustainable development in South African Technology Education. Teachers showed knowledge of sustainable development and identified opportunities in the curriculum, but classroom practice mainly used demonstrations and did not fully integrate sustainability. Collaborative learning was presented as a promising approach.

The passage gives short-term forecasts for several instruments: EUR/USD may consolidate then move between 1.0604, 1.0660, and possibly 1.0554; GBP/USD is in consolidation with upside target 1.2700 or downside target 1.2345; USD/CHF may correct to 0.9998 before rising to 1.0067; USD/JPY may fall to 112.81, then rise toward 114.16 or 115.30, or fall to 112.00; AUD/USD may reach 0.7700 before dropping to 0.7600 or 0.7500; USD/RUB may break upward toward 59.50; gold may reach 1220, then 1233, before falling toward 1185; and Brent may fall to 55.66, with possible moves to 59.90 or 54.40.

U.S. stocks rose Wednesday as energy shares and easing fears over Italy’s political turmoil helped Wall Street recover from Tuesday’s selloff. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq were all higher, with energy and financial stocks leading gains.

The passage argues that UK businesses should pay living wages and not exploit customers or staff, condemning high rural delivery charges and calling for criminal charges against firms that overcharge or underpay workers.

The passage describes a randomized placebo-controlled trial in Thailand that will enroll 90 adult women with metastatic breast cancer receiving chemotherapy to test Thai cannabis oil (Ganja Oil, Metta Osot) for effects on chemotherapy-related symptoms and quality of life. The study will also assess adverse effects, microbiome changes, cytokines, bacterial metabolites, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacogenetics before and after treatment.

The passage explains the evolution of soccer position numbers: an original 1920s English scheme linked jersey numbers 1–11 to fixed positions in a 2-3-5 formation, later adjusted with the 1950s W-M formation and then largely broken down by the 1960s as players chose their own numbers. It also describes U.S. Soccer’s 2012 effort to standardize numbers and position names around a 4-3-3 formation and notes terms such as “Number 9,” “Number 10,” “False 9,” and “Double-9s.”

Jonathan Huberdeau scored with 7.7 seconds left to lift the Florida Panthers to a 3-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings. Aleksander Barkov and Aaron Ekblad also scored for Florida, while Danny DeKeyser scored both Detroit goals.

A punter helps flip field position by kicking the ball with hang time, accuracy, and touch, and may also serve as a holder or take part in fake punts. The passage says punters are important because they help position the defense and force opponents to drive farther for scores.

The passage describes a cloud computing microservices architecture that discovers, registers, provisions, chains, and load-balances hardware and software microservices through a microservices API, service discovery function, and message forwarding to dynamically select the best available resources such as software, CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, and hardware accelerators.

Millennials are generally saving well for retirement, with 71% saving and 39% saving more than 10% of salary, but many are cautious about investing in stocks. Studies show they hold more cash and stable investments than older generations, and some experts say avoiding stocks could hurt long-term retirement security.

Micro E-mini S&P 500 Index futures (MES) were created in 2019, are 1/10th the size of E-mini contracts, trade on CME Globex, and are financially settled. The contract size is $5 times the index value, the minimum price fluctuation is 0.25 index point, and the tick size is $1.25. The all-time high is 4808.25 and the lowest reported level is 2174.00; trading is quarterly, with no block trade eligibility.

The passage is a collection of news items about Enron and Bush administration energy policy, focusing on Enron’s lobbying ties, the Bush energy plan’s benefits to traditional energy industries, opposition from Japanese utilities to Enron’s liberalization proposal, and Enron’s reported withdrawal from the Dolphin project.

The passage describes a tested in-store Meijer deal for a PS4 Pro using mPerks coupon stacking: a 5% off new mPerks account coupon and a $50 electronics/toys coupon, reducing the $349.99 PS4 Pro to $282.50. It says the offer was confirmed that morning and is only available in store.

Janata Congress Chhattisgarh announced 11 candidates for next year’s Chhattisgarh assembly elections, with Ajit Jogi saying more names, including six sitting MLAs and 7-8 core committee members, would be announced later. Jogi said the move was meant to give candidates time to prepare and signal readiness for all 90 seats, while BJP’s Sunil Soni called JCC Congress’s “B team” and said BJP aimed for 65-plus seats.

The speaker praises a teammate’s experience and playoff goals, saying the team uses him well. The team feels confident in overtime, plays its own game, and is not afraid to lose. The speaker says the team responded all year, gave the opponent too much respect, and has been enjoying its play, especially in tight, exciting overtime games.

The passage is a collection of July 17, 2001 news items focused on California’s electricity crisis, including Gov. Gray Davis’s expanded state role in power purchasing and utility rescue efforts, criticism of Edison bailout plans, conflict-of-interest questions about energy consultants, church outreach to help low-income customers save on bills, federal support for the Bush energy plan, and uncertainty over possible rate increases to support a large state bond issue.

Google laid off more than 100 employees in design-related roles in its cloud unit, including quantitative user experience research and platform and service experience teams. Some affected employees are U.S.-based and have until early December to find another role within the company, as Google continues cutting headcount to prioritize AI investment.

China’s official manufacturing PMI rose to 49.8 in September, still in contraction but the strongest since March, while RatingDog’s private PMI reached 51.2, above forecasts. The official non-manufacturing PMI slipped to 52.9, and RatingDog’s services PMI eased to 50.

The passage lists festive opening times for Wickes, B&Q, Homebase and Argos, noting reduced hours and some closures on Christmas Day and New Year’s Day. It advises checking local store finders for specific times, with details provided for Christmas Eve, Boxing Day and New Year’s Eve.

The MOVE Index measures U.S. interest rate volatility and is often called the “VIX of the bond market.” A backtest on TLT found that avoiding high-MOVE periods produced only modest results, with lower drawdowns than buy-and-hold but not a highly profitable strategy.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated November 15, 2018, reporting that it issued a press release and CFO commentary on results for the quarter ended October 28, 2018. The press release and commentary were furnished as exhibits and not deemed filed.

The passage explains that vision is essential in soccer for effective passing, defending, and decision-making, and that players should constantly scan the field, keep their heads up, anticipate options, and communicate. It also describes coaching tips and drills to improve field vision, spatial awareness, and first-touch positioning.

NatWest’s digital safety report says consumers should watch for eight rising financial scams, including malware on smartphones, fake discounted FIFA World Cup ticket sites, social media spying, Brexit-proof investment products, money mules, fake wedding websites, catfishers on dating apps, and hackers impersonating solicitors. The report says online shopping, mobile banking, and social media are common vulnerabilities, and advises people to verify requests directly and keep security software updated.

NVIDIA’s Compensation Committee adopted the Fiscal Year 2022 Variable Compensation Plan on March 15, 2021, providing eligible executives cash payments tied to fiscal 2022 corporate performance goals based on revenue achievement. Named executive officer target awards were set for base operating plan achievement, including $2.0 million for Jen-Hsun Huang and smaller awards for the other officers listed.

An experiment on fake science conferences found that predatory publishers and journals reused submitted abstracts and contact details to send unsolicited publication offers, showing that even one interaction can lead to repeated scam contact.

Gianluca Vialli said Juventus’ main task against Barcelona is to control the Camp Nou atmosphere, stressing Sergio Busquets’ importance, warning Lionel Messi may be especially motivated, and praising Juve’s first-leg performance, Buffon, and their transition play.

The Pakistan Bureau of Statistics has begun rebasing inflation indices, with completion expected by June 2018 and the new base likely to be operational in 2018-19. The current 2007-08 base for CPI, WPI and SPI is outdated, and PBS also plans to release rural, urban and total CPI to address concerns about urban bias.

Jesse Williams said he looks for roles that do not harm Black people, offer positive representation, challenge him creatively, reflect diverse interests, and help him learn something new, such as Italian while filming Hotel Costiera.

VentureWire’s June 6, 2001 issue reported Napster’s licensing deal with MusicNet, Comdisco Ventures CEO James P. Labe’s resignation as the unit wound down, Charter Growth Capital’s name change to Focus Ventures, and Movaz’s $62 million second-round financing. It also covered funding for several companies including InsureZone, Mergermarket, Epicentric, Efficio, Clustra, Screentec, AtriCure, Verimetra, OmniCluster, DataCert, Project Time & Cost, Clickmarks, Urbanpixel, Alloptic, Vibration Technology, e-Commerce Solutions, GotMarketing, and FolloWAP, along with shutdowns at WhatsHotNow.com, Hologix, TerraShare, Ditto.com, and The Dock, and personnel changes at Blackboard, Alerts, Xtremesoft, Ellipsus Systems, Global Metro Networks, Conning Capital Partners, and Newbury Ventures.

European shares rose, with the STOXX 600 up 0.4% to its highest close in nearly 16 months and Germany’s DAX near a record high, as Brexit formalized with little market reaction. Daimler lifted autos, LSE and Deutsche Boerse rose after EU blocked their merger, Deutsche Bank gained on cash-call optimism, while Scout24 and Aurelius fell sharply.

Hucknall and Linby Dolphins competed in a novice gala for 9- to 11-year-olds at Matlock and finished fifth of eight teams after being third early on. Katie Hill earned three runner-up spots, several other swimmers placed second or third, and the boys U10 4x25 medley relay was won by Lewis Kemp, Joel, Ben and Tyler Dennis.

Mats Zuccarello said his team is confident after playing two good games, believes they played their best hockey and best game in the last outing, and wants to limit mistakes. He said the team has strong leadership, does not rely on one or two players, and needs to focus on winning the next game, with the goal of winning two at home to even the series.

The S&P 500 fell 1.60% Friday and 2.36% last week after recent record highs, with investors considering whether the pullback is a consolidation or a deeper correction. The VIX rose to 21.90, oil fell after OPEC+ announced more output hikes, and the outlook notes earnings and macro risks may support more defensive positioning.

The DAWN-PLASMA study was a randomized, open-label, phase 2 multicenter trial in hospitalized adults with COVID-19 comparing standard of care plus high-titer convalescent plasma versus standard of care alone. The primary endpoint was the percentage of patients alive without mechanical ventilation at Day 15. Participants were randomized 2:1, and 489 patients were randomized between May 2, 2020 and January 26, 2021. In the plasma group, the median time to first transfusion was 5 hours and the median volume given was 884 mL.

XLP is the Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Fund, tracking major consumer staples in the S&P 500. The passage says it is good for trading because it is low volatility, mean reverting, less correlated with other stock ETFs, useful for diversification, and has profitable short strategies.

Chesterfield residents have supported 33-year-old Craig Burr after he threatened to jump onto the A617 Hasland bypass, was taken to hospital, and later spoke publicly about his mental illness. The Derbyshire Times says it will keep in contact with him, and Craig has thanked people for their kind words.

Diversification reduces portfolio risk, but it can fail if investors do not count all holdings, hold too many investments, buy products they do not understand, lose sight of financial goals and liquidity needs, or let asset allocation drift without rebalancing.

The speaker says Holik was important, especially under pressure, and that his return to New Jersey helped the team reach the Stanley Cup Finals. They say the playoffs will get harder, but the team has responded well to adversity and is hopeful it can do so again despite playing in a difficult building and on an unfamiliar surface. They also note the opponent has momentum, but the team needs one win to regain home-ice advantage and believes it can be okay if it plays well.

The passage describes the development and evaluation of UZEP, a cloud-based distance education platform for higher education created to support emergency online learning during Covid-19. UZEP includes modules for learning management, virtual classrooms, online exams, homework, material sharing, announcements, surveys, and reporting, and was tested by 12 universities in Türkiye. Evaluations found it easy to learn and use, scalable, and suitable for quick deployment, but identified weaknesses in communication, social tools, and some assessment and reporting features.

The passage says a “boring” strategy of buying on weakness and selling on strength seems to work well, with entry at the next day’s open and exit at 11:30 the same day. Buying on the close gives similar results but with larger drawdowns, and targets or stop-losses did not improve performance.
AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) will be discontinued on December 15. The company said communication has changed and thanked users, while many people shared nostalgic #AIMmemories on social media.

The disclosure describes apparatus and methods for measuring tissue viability and burn depth using capacitance-based sensors and sub-epidermal moisture (SEM) values. It includes electrode arrays, visual indicators, and projector-based systems for identifying and marking boundaries between viable and non-viable tissue, especially around burns and other wounds.

Apple Inc. reported that on December 29, 2020, its Board appointed Monica Lozano as a director effective January 4, 2021. She will serve on the Audit and Finance Committee, receive a $100,000 annual retainer paid quarterly, receive an initial grant of 281 restricted stock units, and enter into Apple’s standard indemnification agreement.

Wound Care Advantage, Dr. David G. Armstrong, SALSA, and Gen1 Research launched Advanced Discovery, an investigative research alliance focused on evidence-based wound care research, using de-identified clinical data and international treatment center networks to improve outcomes and reduce treatment costs.

The passage describes a 5G wireless system focused on reducing MAC PDU latency by allowing a WTRU to determine transmission parameters before a grant, including MCS, resource ranges, decoding parameters, and HARQ feedback timing. It also describes incremental creation, segmentation, assembly, and multiplexing of fixed-size data blocks and transport blocks before grant reception, along with configurable spectrum, waveform, duplexing, scheduling, and acknowledgment procedures.

The court denied both parties’ cross-motions for summary judgment in an ERISA suit seeking to compel Waterworks, Inc. to submit to an audit, finding a genuine issue of material fact about whether a collective bargaining agreement was formed and whether Waterworks’ conduct showed an intent to be bound.

The passage promotes several credit card offers with 0% intro APR periods, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses, and explains that low-interest cards can help reduce borrowing costs. It also notes that the site uses a data-driven rating system and receives compensation without it affecting ratings or reviews.

NVIDIA’s 2022 Form 10-K reports fiscal year ended January 30, 2022, with common stock traded on Nasdaq under NVDA and 2.51 billion shares outstanding as of March 11, 2022. The company describes businesses in Graphics and Compute & Networking, serving Gaming, Data Center, Professional Visualization, and Automotive markets. It states that the Arm acquisition was terminated in February 2022 due to regulatory challenges and that a $1.36 billion charge is expected in fiscal 2023.

Sungi Cho, a former Army Black Hawk pilot with an engineering background, founded P6 Gear after developing 3D-printed gear solutions for soldiers, starting with the Warbelt Hanger and later the MOLLE Backer. After moving to MIT Sloan and observing stable monthly Backer sales of about 1,800 units, he considered switching from in-house 3D printing to injection molding to improve efficiency and product strength, but needed to compare higher upfront mold costs against production and labor differences.

The passage says unknown artist/album usually means ID3 tags or WMA metadata are missing, the Sansa Fuze can read and write microSD and microSDHC cards, and a power reset is done by sliding the power button up and holding it for about 10 seconds. It also provides SanDisk support contact information, warranty terms, and software license restrictions.

Options trading in EEM can offer exposure to rising and falling markets and leverage, but it carries high risks including losses, time decay, liquidity issues, and volatility. The passage recommends using the Black-Scholes model, technical analysis, hedging, proper risk management, and a reputable broker, while noting costs, margin, minimum deposits, tax implications, and common strategies such as long call, long put, covered call, straddle, strangle, collar, and butterfly spread.

The device has configurable high and low input alarms with programmable thresholds and hysteresis, plus fixed AVDD alarms at typical 5.3 V and 4.7 V. It uses a multiSPI interface with RESET, ACQ, and CONV states, supports single or daisy-chain connections, multiple SPI and source-synchronous read protocols, and nine configuration registers for control, data output, ranges, and alarms.

E. Nkem Odinkemere, an Irvington attorney admitted in 1993, was immediately temporarily suspended from practicing law on November 15, 2000, and his New Jersey funds were restrained pending further court order. He was also ordered not to practice law during the suspension and to comply with Rule 1:20-20 for suspended attorneys.

Eastern New England is forecast to get more snow, with Maine, New Hampshire, and Vermont expected to receive close to a foot, and even more in the mountains, while Connecticut will likely get only a dusting. The region already has over 2 feet of snow in many areas, with some places over 50 inches.

The passage lists repeated financial and news headlines, including South Korea restoring public services after a data centre fire, OpenAI adding parental controls, U.S. stocks rising amid shutdown concerns, and several major business, policy, and infrastructure developments.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that Rosalind G. Brewer informed the company on January 26, 2021 that she would resign from the Board of Directors, effective February 16, 2021.

The study retrospectively analyzed 266 GBM patients to assess whether MRI could predict pTERT mutation status. ResNet models using diffusion-weighted imaging plus ADC maps performed best, especially with the whole tumor ROI, while conventional structural MRI and added clinical characteristics showed lower predictive value.

This scoping review will examine modifiable and non-modifiable determinants of antipsychotic-induced metabolic syndrome in community-dwelling adults, the non-pharmacological interventions used to prevent or treat it, and the preferred context for delivering these interventions. It will search multiple databases and grey literature, include qualitative, quantitative, mixed-method studies and evidence syntheses, and map evidence to identify knowledge gaps.

The Colorado Court of Appeals affirmed summary judgment for Shelter Mutual Insurance Company, holding that its policy unambiguously barred stacking uninsured motorist benefits from multiple Shelter policies and that the reasonable expectations doctrine did not apply.

The ANC Free State provincial congress has been delayed several times and has not yet started, with Ace Magashule expected to contest the chairperson post again. A court ruling required 29 branch general meetings to be rerun before the congress could proceed, and ANC secretary William Bulwane said 28 had succeeded while the 29th was underway.

The pilot study in Kisumu, Kenya found high acceptability of self-administered intravaginal 5FU among 12 women living with HIV after CIN2/3 treatment: all completed the regimen, felt confident they used it correctly, and preferred it over ablation or excision. Participants valued home use, privacy, reduced pain, and convenience, though some reported challenges with dosage measurement, tampons, partner support, condom use, and side effects.

The Trump administration shifted control of career and technical education from the Education Department to the Labor Department to increase workforce focus. Supporters say it could improve alignment and accountability, while critics worry it will reduce capacity, limit student pathways, and overemphasize short-term job training.

MetSoc of CIM announced its 2018 award recipients, recognizing achievements in metallurgy and related fields. The awards will be presented at the 57th Annual Conference of Metallurgists on October 15, 2018, in Columbus, Ohio. Recipients include Sam Marcuson, Priti Wanjara, Jun Song, the AU-E non-destructive testing technique, Xinjin Cao, Georgios Kolliopoulos, and Shauna Litke.

Iran’s President Hassan Rouhani warned that Iran could abandon the 2015 nuclear deal within hours if the United States continues imposing new sanctions. He said Trump had shown the world that the US is not a good or reliable partner and accused Washington of repeatedly breaking its promises in the agreement.

The Ministry of Education will fund a $28.5-million replacement for Walnut Park Elementary in Smithers, which is over 50 years old and on unstable land. The new two-storey school will hold 440 students, include StrongStart and a neighbourhood learning centre, meet LEED gold standards, and is expected to open for the 2020-21 school year.

The study evaluated six machine-learning models on a synthetic pancreatic cancer dataset. All models had similar accuracy (76.05%–76.35%) but very low sensitivity; SVM was highest at 1.90%, SuperLearner had the highest precision at 66.67%, and Random Forest and Decision Tree detected no true positives. The authors conclude that class imbalance and interpretability are major challenges and suggest resampling, feature engineering, threshold tuning, and real-world validation.

The Indiana Supreme Court held that David Shaner’s wrongful death survivor-damages claim did not abate when he died intestate and did not depend on the existence of an heir, reversing partial summary judgment for the defendants and remanding to determine the proper party to continue the claim.

The passage promotes multiple credit cards with introductory 0% APR offers, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses, and says low- or zero-interest cards can help save money. It also explains that card offers change often and describes how the site selects and rates cards.

Pupils from Richardson Dees Primary School in Wallsend have transformed a rooftop garden at The Forum into a productive space growing flowers, fruit, vegetables and herbs. The project, started to strengthen the centre’s partnership with the school, is said to promote gardening knowledge, healthy eating, responsibility, confidence and self-esteem.

Kim Jong Un appears to seek sanctions relief and international legitimacy while retaining nuclear weapons until he feels secure enough to do without them. His recent diplomacy with China and South Korea has shown a more flexible style, but his planned summit with Donald Trump remains uncertain because the two sides disagree over denuclearisation and security guarantees.

The passage contrasts poker tournaments and cash games, then focuses on preflop play, emphasizing hand equities, when to shove or call all-in, Nash equilibrium ranges, raise sizing, and how position and stack depth affect optimal decisions.

The device provides an active-high alarm output on the ALARM/SDO-1/GPO pin when configured for alarm functionality. It supports input and AVDD alarms, with AVDD thresholds at 4.7V low and 5.3V high. Both alarms are enabled by default, can be disabled separately, and each has active and tripped flags read in ALARM_REG. Alarm flags can be read via the pin, internal registers, or appended to the data output.

The passage says Trump plans a 100% tariff on China starting November 1, which helped trigger a drop in US stock indexes. It also says July was a strong month for the S&P 500, but August began weakly and charts show early warnings despite the broader trend still being intact.

The S&P 400 Midcap index tracks 400 mid-sized U.S. companies and was formed in 1991. E-mini S&P MidCap 400 futures are financially settled CME contracts with quarterly expirations, trading on CME Globex, and a contract value of $100 times the index. The index’s all-time high and low are 2925.93 and 119.43, respectively, and the futures all-time high is 2924.2. Trading requires a futures broker, and factors affecting prices include component stocks, interest rates, economic news, and the U.S. dollar.

Tyreek Hill returned to the Dolphins’ facility and addressed the team three days after season-ending surgery on his dislocated left knee. Coach Mike McDaniel said Hill spoke at Friday’s meeting to encourage teammates, and Miami will rely more on Jaylen Waddle and others while not overcompensating for Hill’s absence.
Rob Hanna’s study found 25 Russell 2000 death crosses since 1988, with the S&P 500 rising in 84% of the following years, including a gain of over 60% in 2020, though drawdowns were often sizable.

Apple Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on November 9, 2021, the Board appointed Alex Gorsky as a director, named him to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, and granted him 486 restricted stock units along with standard non-employee director compensation and indemnification. The Board also amended the bylaws to increase the Board size from eight to nine members.

The passage contains multiple news items, including Enron appointing James Fallon to lead its broadband unit amid restructuring and losses, analysis of Enron Broadband’s declining market and reduced visibility, reports on Karl Rove’s meetings with companies including Enron and calls for a Justice Department review, a Mississippi power plant permit for Calpine, an interview saying EnronOnline expects volume growth, a Red Cross relief fundraiser mentioning Enron’s contribution, and Indian reports on the Dabhol power project inquiry and Maharashtra’s financing issues.

John Mellencamp performed “Easy Target” on “Late Show With Stephen Colbert” and then knelt with his fist raised in support of Black Lives Matter. The song, from his album “Sad Clowns & Hillbillies,” addresses racial inequality, and Mellencamp said the kneeling was a pure protest of racial and social injustice.

The passage gives varied Super Bowl 52 predictions, but most favor the New England Patriots over the Philadelphia Eagles. It also notes local disappointment that the Broncos were not in the game and suggests the event could still be a festive party.

The lecture discussed supply-side inversion in demand models, showing how first-order conditions can recover marginal costs and be used with demand estimates to test conduct assumptions. It then reviewed BLP car-market results, emphasizing that random coefficients and supply-side restrictions improve fit and capture heterogeneous substitution patterns better than logit. Next, it summarized Nevo’s cereal-market paper, which uses demand estimates and conduct tests to show high markups are consistent with own-profit pricing and multi-product effects rather than collusion. Finally, it introduced the common ownership hypothesis and described a cereal-market test that rejects common ownership and supports own-profit maximization.

The Ichimoku trading strategy is a technical analysis system that uses five components to identify support and resistance, trend direction, and momentum. It can generate signals from cloud breakouts, Tenkan/Kijun crossovers, and Chikou Span confirmation, but the passage stresses that it should be backtested and that its signals may be unreliable.

The passage describes the casual dining restaurant industry and Bloomin’ Brands, which started Outback Steakhouse in 1988, went public in 2012, and by June 2016 owned 1,335 restaurants and franchised 166 across four brands. It also provides financial and valuation data for Bloomin’ Brands and 13 comparable restaurant companies.

Microsoft reported first-quarter fiscal 2023 revenue of $50.1 billion, net income of $17.6 billion, and diluted earnings per share of $2.35. Revenue increased 11%, driven by Intelligent Cloud and Productivity and Business Processes, while More Personal Computing was flat; operating income rose 6% to $21.5 billion. The company also said it completed the Nuance acquisition, had a pending Activision Blizzard acquisition, and increased the estimated useful lives of server and network equipment from four years to six years.

The 60/40 portfolio allocates 60% to equities and 40% to bonds, relying on their usually low correlation for diversification and risk reduction. The passage notes strong long-term historical returns, but highlights weak performance in 2022 and discusses alternatives such as the All-Weather Portfolio, trend-following, gold, crypto, international equities, and tail risk strategies.

The Rhode Island Supreme Court affirmed Andrew A. Bucci’s conviction for giving legal advice while suspended from practicing law, rejecting claims of variance, lack of pecuniary benefit, and improper sentencing after trial de novo.

A South Sudanese seed distributor in Gbudue wants the government to restrict imported seed and promote local suppliers, saying FAO imported seeds instead of buying locally. FAO said it supports farmers through seed purchases and seed fairs, follows transparent procurement rules, and had a waiver to import maize seed last year because of low production and conflict-related displacement.

A University of Liverpool study of 38 healthy adults found that higher musical aptitude was associated with lower hallucination proneness and greater corpus callosum integrity, while hallucination proneness was linked to lower integrity. The relationship between musical aptitude and hallucination proneness was mediated by corpus callosum microstructure, suggesting possible clinical implications for musical training.

The Assam AHSEC Class 12 result 2018 was scheduled for release on May 31 at 9:30 am, and students could check it on ahsec.nic.in, resultsassam.nic.in, or other sites like examresults.net. The exams were held from February 23 to March 22, with minimum passing marks of 20 in each subject and distinction for 70% or above. Results could also be checked by SMS or app using a registered roll number.

The study compared group-based and individualized brain parcellations in early psychosis and found that individualized parcellations produced more homogeneous regions but fewer and smaller case-control functional connectivity differences. Group-based parcellations inflated estimates of dysconnectivity, while network-level findings were largely consistent across methods.

Asian shares edged higher for a fourth session as optimism about global growth continued, supported by strong Chinese credit data. Wall Street rose, with technology and energy stocks leading gains. This scoping review of 65 studies from 22 sub-Saharan African countries found 41 SES measures grouped into 11 categories. The asset-based wealth index was most common, usually calculated with PCA, and the review calls for standardized SES measurement methods adapted to local contexts.

Researchers used 3D modeling, physics, and field experiments to confirm that Rapa Nui’s moai statues were moved upright in a rocking “walking” motion with rope and few people. The statues’ forward lean, curved bases, and the island’s concave roads helped make this transport possible, and a 4.35-ton replica was moved 100 meters by 18 people in 40 minutes.

Poway Unified School District is recognizing 28 high school teacher retirees, including seven with long careers and profiles, such as Traci Barker-Ball, Don Jones, Melinda Watson, Patsy Malta, Lori Brickley, Keith Koelzer and Robert Saxton. Each shared reflections on teaching, changes in education, memorable moments and retirement plans.

Sudan, the last male northern white rhino, died in Kenya at age 45 after a worsening leg infection. His death leaves only two females, and scientists are trying assisted reproduction to prevent the species from vanishing, though major obstacles remain.

The study developed and tested a maternal vulnerability segmentation tool in Oromia, Ethiopia, using baseline data from 1,189 households. It identified a small set of factors that segmented pregnant women by vulnerability and found higher vulnerability was associated with lower antenatal care use and health facility delivery. The tool is intended to help frontline workers target interventions and should be further validated in other contexts.

The global cheese snacks market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 5.2% from 2017 to 2025, driven by changing lifestyles, demand for convenient snacks, westernization, and growing health awareness. Popular products include savory snacks, frozen and processed cheese, and manufacturers are focusing on taste and quality. Leading companies include Sargento Foods Inc., PepsiCo, McCain Foods Limited, TINE SA, UTZ Quality Foods, ITC Limited, and General Mills, Inc.

Soumya Swaminathan, currently ICMR Director General, will become WHO Deputy Director General (programmes) in Geneva, becoming the first Indian in the role. She says her priorities will align with WHO’s focus on universal health coverage, epidemics, non-communicable diseases, and access to diagnostics and drugs, while highlighting preventive and promotive healthcare as an important gap in India. She also says her father viewed the move as valuable international exposure and learning.

The SAP specifies summary tables, listings, and figures using ICH numbering and SAS 9.4+, with 0.05 two-sided significance testing, observed data only, and FAS as the primary efficacy set. It defines treatment groups, analysis populations, baseline characteristics, concomitant medication coding, efficacy and PK/PD analyses, safety analyses, and QC requirements, including hierarchical testing for dasiglucagon versus placebo and descriptive analyses for safety, laboratory, ECG, and immunogenicity data.

Castle Gardens is a purpose-built care home in Invergordon offering dementia, nursing, residential and end of life care. It has en suite, wheelchair-friendly bedrooms with TV points and nurse call systems, plus a GP service, mobile hairdresser, small pets allowed, organised activities, and a garden with greenhouse and potting shed.

The share of 22- to 27-year-olds without college degrees who are working or looking for work has fallen, while disconnected youth ages 18 to 24 have trended upward to about 12%. Experts say the causes include economic, cultural, and psychological factors such as stigma around non-degree jobs, mental health challenges, family support, and the gig economy, and they recommend practical education paths and reducing stigma about trades.

The SPREAD offense is a 3-2 motion offense with no post, involving all five players and emphasizing passing, handling, and reading defensive overplays. Basic movement includes cuts, clears, back cuts against pressure, dribble penetration with kick-outs, and back-door options on either side.

Deepa Das Acevedo argues that attacks on tenure have eroded faculty job security and academic freedom, especially amid recent dismissals over social media posts. She says tenure still provides important employment security and protection from arbitrary discipline, and that claims it reduces productivity or protects bad actors are overstated.

Research from Ben-Gurion University found that smiley emojis in work-related emails can reduce perceptions of competence without increasing warmth. In experiments with 549 participants from 29 countries, emails with smileys led to less detailed responses and, when the sender was unknown, people were more likely to assume the sender was a woman. The researchers said smileys should be avoided in initial workplace interactions.

Trainers and trainees in a UK deanery supported developing a regional teaching programme for Stage 1 anaesthetists, citing new curriculum demands, trainee variation, and unequal teaching across hospitals. They also identified logistical, funding, and quality-control challenges, and emphasized that any programme would need ongoing evaluation and collaboration to succeed.

A GWAS of neonatal jaundice in nearly 30,000 Norwegian trios found two significant loci: a strong protective UGT1A4 missense variant and a CHRDL1-region signal. Maternal analysis also identified an ABO-region locus consistent with maternal-fetal blood group incompatibility. The UGT1A4 signal differed from adult bilirubin genetics, which were driven by different variants and loci.

U.S. Border Patrol agent Larry O’Neal of Houlton was indicted and arrested on a federal child pornography possession charge after investigators traced a suspected download to his home IP address. Authorities say they found child and adult pornography on his computer and external drive, and O’Neal pleaded not guilty.

The passage describes hard-sided, collapsible portable shelters and campers that provide rigid, weather-tight, lockable protection while remaining compact and transportable by vehicles, trailers, motorcycles, bicycles, or by hand. The shelters can expand for sleeping or standing space and collapse into low-profile cases for storage or transit. They may include insulated composite walls, roofs, floors, windows, doors, solar panels, climate control, plumbing, electrical systems, beds with adjustable heights, and kitchen or bathroom fixtures.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that on January 26, 2016 it issued a press release, data sheet, and supplemental materials about its first fiscal quarter results ended December 26, 2015. The exhibits were attached as 99.1, 99.2, and 99.3.

The passage says pivot points are calculated from the previous day’s high, low, and close and are used as support and resistance levels in trading. It states that pivot points were invented by floor traders, are easy and objective to use, but are lagging and had low win ratios in backtests. After testing six strategies on ES, NQ, RTY, and USD/CHF, the article concludes none were consistently tradeable, though some day-trading ideas may merit further research.

RWE Supply & Trading expects its LNG derivatives trades to double or triple this year from 2017 as it manages price risk for physical cargoes. The company also said physical LNG trading rose last year, and increased spot demand and fragmented Asian demand are boosting short-term trading and JKM activity.

The lecture introduces the stress-energy tensor as a key tensor for describing energy and momentum in matter, including dust, perfect fluids, point particles, and electromagnetic fields. It explains its components as energy density, energy flux, momentum density, and momentum flux, motivates its symmetry, and states that its spacetime divergence is zero as a covariant conservation law. The lecture then begins a transition to flat spacetime in curvilinear coordinates, introducing polar coordinates, a non-normalized coordinate basis, and transformation notation in preparation for curvature.

Lawton High School unveiled the second panel of a 22-foot Wolverine mural in its cafeteria, painted by art teacher Kenneth Hobbs and funded by the class of 2014. The new panel shows the school’s front and south side and continues a mural series begun in 2010 with a class of 2006-funded panel depicting the school’s history and championship teams.

The passage argues that although federal policy aims to reduce minority overrepresentation in special education, the cited study found the opposite: racial, ethnic, and language-minority children were less likely than similar White, English-speaking children to be identified as disabled and were underrepresented in special education.

The speaker disagrees with Curtis, saying the key to shutting the other team down is limiting their time with the puck and keeping it out of their end. They note the opponent forechecked well and worked the puck low, and say Brett’s status is uncertain. The speaker also describes Mike as a top player who skates well, handles the puck, and creates chances, and says Joe Nieuwendyk is also difficult to stop unless given less room and time.

Minnesota nonprofits such as Know the Truth and Restoration for All provide school-based mental health support that addresses addiction, recovery, and culturally specific needs for immigrant and refugee students. Peer support specialist Tiffany White uses her own recovery experience to work with students, while Restoration for All says culturally informed services and staff training help bridge misunderstandings and support youth mental health.

South Korean lawmakers said the spy agency suspects two female North Korean agents assassinated Kim Jong Nam in Malaysia, and U.S. sources also believed he was murdered. Malaysian police said the 46-year-old died on Monday after falling ill at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, with the cause still under investigation. South Korean officials said he may have been poisoned, possibly by two women who fled in a taxi, and noted Kim Jong Un had reportedly issued a standing order for his assassination.

An unnamed Salvadoran mother, deported from Texas after trying to reach her surviving child in Houston, said she fled El Salvador after two of her children disappeared and she feared gangs would kill her family.
