The passage describes widespread gang violence, extortion, and threats in El Salvador, Honduras, and Guatemala, and says many migrants are fleeing that violence but are caught and returned under the Trump administration’s zero-tolerance policy.

A Thames Centre councillor is urging the Thames Valley District School Board to adopt a defibrillator policy and install AEDs in schools. West Nissouri Public School students raised funds for one after a child in the area died during a soccer game, but the board has declined to install it and has not commented.
The appeal in Tom Belcher et al. v. Kitsap County et al. was from a Kitsap County Superior Court judgment entered September 18, 1989, and the judgment was affirmed.

Adrienne Motley passed Octavia Blue for seventh on Miami’s all-time scoring list as No. 16 Miami defeated Clemson 81-57. Jessica Thomas also reached 1,200 career points, while Motley scored 15 and Thomas led Miami with 18. The Hurricanes led for most of the game, celebrated their women’s athletic program and Play4Kay game, and next play No. 14 Duke.

The newsletter says Texas faces Colorado in a do-or-die game, with Major Applewhite named the starter and Chris Simms used only if needed. It also notes promotions for Roy Williams and B.J. Johnson, more playing time for Kenny Hayter, and discusses concerns about coaching, leadership, play-calling, and the impact of the Oklahoma loss.

Several leases and one sale were reported on Long Island: The Law Office of Peter D. Baron renewed 2,510 square feet at 532 Broadhollow Road in Melville; Jersey Mike’s Subs, Hand and Stone Massage, and Fortunoff Bedding leased retail space at 204 Glen Cove Road in Carle Place; Hartford Fire Insurance and Hollander Legal Group leased office space at 105 Maxess Road in Melville; SCH Sheet Metal leased 11,500 square feet in Ronkonkoma; and Marbai Profit Sharing bought a property at 100 North Country Road in Miller Place for $850,000.

Banks and energy companies led a broad stock rebound Wednesday, with investors hoping Italy could avoid new elections. The S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq, and Russell 2000 all rose, and most indexes were slightly up for the week and year except the Dow, which was down for both periods.

Travis Phippen, who was shot and wounded in the Las Vegas mass shooting that killed his father John Phippen, has filed a civil lawsuit against gunman Stephen Paddock’s estate seeking control of the estate’s assets.

Alexandr Wang said 13-year-olds should spend all their time “vibe-coding” and logging thousands of hours with AI tools, arguing this could create a career advantage like early exposure to personal computers did for Bill Gates and Mark Zuckerberg. He said AI coding has been a radicalizing force and that the next Bill Gates may be a child learning AI coding now.

A petition opposing the closure of Gresford Health Centre has gathered more than 600 signatures, as Alyn Family Doctors seek to shut the branch and merge patients with their Llay and Rossett surgeries. The practice says it lacks the manpower to run three sites, while patients and residents fear travel difficulties, longer waits, and added pressure on local services.

The passage explains defending-team responsibilities on a live penalty kick: all players except the kicker and goalkeeper must be positioned properly, wait for the ball to be touched and move forward, then react quickly to rebounds or saves to clear the ball. It also covers a rare “tap” penalty kick, practice methods, and notes that these rules do not apply to shoot-outs.

The disclosure describes a gaming machine, control method, and program that synchronize game event display timing with the beat of background music by using tempo data. The controller determines event timing from BGM tempo data, dynamically configures animation data, and displays events accordingly, including reel stops, bonus events, event sounds, and illumination.

The speaker expresses gratitude for being called to office and outlines principles for governing, praising the United States’ constitutional government, prosperity, commerce, territorial growth, religious freedom, and success in war and foreign affairs. He stresses preserving the Union, promoting public intelligence, maintaining peace, fortifying defenses, supporting the militia, improving roads and canals, encouraging manufacturers, managing public finances carefully, and sustaining harmony and independence through virtuous citizens and wise administration.

This qualitative study interviewed 10 infectious disease diagnostics stakeholders in the UK about metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS). Participants saw mNGS as a useful addition to clinical diagnostics but identified barriers to routine use, especially cost, speed, infrastructure, training, standardisation, data storage, and communication. COVID-19 was described as proof of concept for genomics and a driver for wider adoption.

Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in chemistry for metal-organic frameworks, porous molecular structures that can store gases and other chemicals, collect water from air, and capture greenhouse gases.

Andrew Lo explains that assets are sequences of current and future cashflows, and their value is the present value of those cashflows using market-determined exchange rates or discount factors. He illustrates this with the Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac takeover, then derives net present value and the time value of money under perfect certainty, using r as the interest/discount rate.

VentureWire’s November 7, 2000 issue reported Broadcom’s acquisition of SiByte for up to $2 billion, Alta Partners’ effort to raise a $275 million to $325 million fund, Furniture.com’s shutdown, and eStellarNet’s $30 million first round. It also covered numerous financings, acquisitions, management changes, VC fund developments, and industry corrections.

At Puerto Cortés in northern Honduras, Sergio Romero visits the 97-year-old schooner Avontuur, a wind-powered cargo vessel that arrived from Europe through the Caribbean, unlike the fuel-burning freighters around it.

NHS staff at Sandwell and West Birmingham Hospitals recreated a 1927 photograph found in a broom cupboard to mark the NHS’s 70th anniversary. The original image, taken at Hallam Hospital in West Bromwich, showed a matron, her assistant and nurses in old-style caps. The recovered photos will be displayed at Sandwell Hospital during a tea party for the anniversary.

The report finds that Title IX staffing in higher education has increased over the past five years, but 56% of institutions still lack a dedicated full-time Title IX position. Most Title IX staff are located in human resources or student affairs, and doctoral institutions are most likely to have multiple dedicated Title IX roles. Women hold 77% of Title IX positions, and Title IX staff are paid equitably compared with White men.

The speaker said the team’s effort has been there, but they did not work well as a unit and were unhappy with the last game. They said the team must keep talking, then act on what they say, and noted that players should be driven by their childhood dreams. They added that injuries have forced others to play more minutes, and while they would like Griz and Z back, other players can step up again if needed.

Berkshire Hathaway sold 10.6 million General Electric shares in the second quarter, ending a stake tied to Warren Buffett’s 2008 crisis-era investment that generated more than $1 billion in profit. The filing also showed Berkshire bought shares of Synchrony Financial, Bank of New York Mellon and Apple, while other investors made mixed moves in broad market and tech funds and in Wells Fargo.

Gary Allen Darnell, 45, a convicted sex offender from Cottage Hills, was arrested in Grafton and charged with loitering within 500 feet of a park after allegedly approaching children and offering them fishing poles. Prosecutors said he faces a Class 4 felony and will seek maximum penalties.

The passage requests U.S. recognition of a kingdom as a sovereign independent state, citing major reforms in language, education, government, laws, and courts, and arguing that its independent status benefits commercial nations because of its strategic Pacific location.

The study found that kindergarten teachers in Piraeus generally view visual arts as crucial for pre-school education, especially for creativity, imagination, intellectual development, emotional expression, and social skills. Most teachers reported children respond well to art activities and preferred a free, exploratory teaching approach, but they also faced challenges, mainly child management and limited resources. Demographic factors did not significantly affect teachers’ views.

A Spring ISD middle school teacher is under investigation and on administrative leave after allegedly using a racial slur to describe African American students at Dueitt Middle School. A parent said students confirmed the remark, and the district replaced the teacher with a substitute while the investigation continues.

A German ambassador reported Germany’s proposed peace terms, including giving up Belgium, restoring Russian territory, keeping France’s coast intact, and treating Serbia and Roumania properly, while suggesting England’s hesitation stemmed from difficulty reconciling its maximum and minimum terms with its allies. The Greek Chargé replied that Greece welcomed the U.S. peace initiative, described severe wartime suffering and blockade, and said Greece was ready to join future action for a stable peace and guaranteed state rights.

The passage describes SOS defensive rotations and traps against side screen actions, including below- and above-free-throw-line scenarios, all-out disruption, and secondary traps. It details how defenders switch, trap, close out, front, and rotate into helpside, snuggle denial, smother, and set positions as the ball is passed or screened.

Whitman Howard raised Produce Investments’ target price to GBX 240 from GBX 210 and kept a buy rating. Shore Capital and Numis Securities also reiterated buy ratings, with Numis setting a GBX 286 price objective. The shares rose 0.54% to GBX 187.00, and the company announced a GBX 5.03 dividend payable on December 5 to shareholders of record on November 2.

Amazon.com, Inc. entered into a 364-day unsecured revolving credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and other lenders on November 18, 2022. The facility allows borrowing up to $10.0 billion, may be extended for another 364 days, carries interest at SOFR plus 0.45%, and has a 0.05% commitment fee on undrawn amounts.

Marines with Task-Force-Southwest practiced using Instant-Eye small unmanned aerial systems at Camp Lejeune before a spring deployment to Afghanistan. Marines from 2nd Law Enforcement Battalion completed grenade-assault training, and 91-year-old Lee Anderson received the Purple Heart 72 years after being wounded at Iwo Jima.

Three University of Dayton students reported a naked white male in his mid-20s entered their bedrooms early Wednesday morning at homes on Woodland Ave., Frericks Way, and College Park. He left after being confronted in two cases and tried to restrain one student before she escaped; police are investigating.

The passage is a presidential address praising the nation’s prosperity and progress, reporting on agriculture, commerce, credit, the Bank of the United States, western frontier defense, treaties with Indian tribes, the excise law, the federal district on the Potomac, the census, and foreign loans. It also urges congressional attention to the militia, post offices, the mint, weights and measures, and the sale of vacant lands.

The passage discusses Corey Perry’s playoff experience and effectiveness, the team’s training and lineup decisions, uncertainty about a player’s hand injury, and the importance of a strong, even-keeled mindset. It emphasizes preparation, teamwork, leadership, and playing a structured game against the Ottawa Senators.

Hampton and Newport News police pursued a 15-year-old suspect after an alleged January 31 armed robbery at a Tinee Giant in Hampton. Police found him near the Ford SUV with a handgun and outstanding juvenile petitions, and charged him with firearm and tobacco offenses, but not with the robbery itself.

The passage argues that although colleges have long lacked viewpoint diversity, definitions of it vary, and the Trump administration is using the issue to advance its own political agenda through federal funding conditions. It says students increasingly care about campus viewpoints, but warns that tying funding to White House priorities could reduce intellectual pluralism.

A Sarasota couple, Michael Bennett and Trisha Steffes, were arrested after accepting a package containing carfentanil, a synthetic opioid the DEA says is 10,000 times more potent than morphine. Detectives later found more than 7 grams of fentanyl and other drugs in their home, and both face drug and paraphernalia charges.

The passage describes a display device with a substrate, display area, pad area, circuit area, and crack sensing lines connected to a crack sensing circuit. Static electricity discharge elements, such as capacitors, are connected to the crack sensing lines or test data lines to protect defect-detecting elements from static electricity and improve defect detection accuracy. The device may also include switching elements, test data lines, a bending area, and variations in the placement and structure of the discharge elements.

Alexander Zverev beat Dusan Lajovic in five sets to reach the French Open third round, while Grigor Dimitrov, Kei Nishikori, Novak Djokovic, Simona Halep, Petra Kvitova and Elina Svitolina also advanced.

Amazon.com, Inc. announced a temporary blackout period for its 401(k) Plan due to a change in recordkeeper to Fidelity Investments. During the expected January 2 to week of January 12, 2020 blackout, participants could not make exchanges, asset allocation changes, loans, or withdrawals. The company also notified Section 16 officers and directors of trading restrictions during the blackout.

The passage describes systems and methods for indicating wireless channel status in 5G NR communications, especially after beam failure recovery. It proposes UE techniques for using assumed or updated quasi-co-located relationships and transmission configuration indication (TCI) states to decode PDCCH or PDSCH, or alternatively to avoid using QCL configuration until TCI states are updated, with the goal of reducing signaling overhead and improving performance.

The passage describes the record sources and declassification access used by the Foreign Relations series, including State Department files, Reagan Library records, and the RAC project, and explains the editorial method for arranging and reproducing documents chronologically while preserving original wording, noting corrections, omissions, classifications, and source information.

The passage says adults should use open-ended, specific questions, engage children’s questions seriously, admit when they do not know answers and show how to find them, and model listening and follow-up to help children become more curious and comfortable asking and answering questions.

This cross-sectional study of 225 10th- and 11th-grade students at Capa Science High School found that higher physical activity was correlated with higher self-esteem. Males had higher self-esteem than females, regular exercise was associated with higher self-esteem, self-esteem was linked to school success, and height was positively correlated with self-esteem.

The ADS868xW includes user-programmable input and AVDD alarms, with adjustable thresholds and hysteresis to improve noise immunity for temperature sensing applications using an NTC thermistor. The device uses separate AVDD and DVDD supplies, recommends decoupling capacitors, and supports low-power NAP and power-down modes. It also provides PCB layout and reference decoupling guidance, plus documentation update, support, trademark, ESD, revision history, and ordering information.

Canadian researchers found celiac disease affects about 1% of people, but about 90% of cases are undiagnosed. The study of more than 2,800 Toronto blood samples suggests the problem is common in Canada and important for health care planning.

U.S. stocks were mixed after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter-point and said it would begin gradually shrinking its $4.5 trillion balance sheet later this year. Weak inflation and retail sales data, along with falling oil prices, weighed on markets; the Nasdaq fell the most, while Tesla, H&R Block, and Alexion rose.

The passage describes a device, medium, and process for using insulin delivery records from an artificial pancreas or automated insulin delivery system to estimate and modify a user’s basal insulin dosage. It determines the proportion of total insulin delivered as basal insulin over a time period, compares it to a threshold, and generates a modified basal dosage instruction for a wearable drug delivery device. It also describes segmenting insulin delivery history, applying clustering to time-of-day patterns, and adjusting basal recommendations based on glucose control and hypoglycemia history.

The court affirmed dismissal of alien enemies’ suit to recover property seized during World War I, holding that Public Resolution No. 53 barred recovery even for allegedly illegal seizures. Relying on Cummings v. Deutsche Bank, it concluded Congress validly suspended the right to recover such property.

Schneider Electric introduced the Edge Module for telco edge applications, a pre-integrated, turnkey solution with power, cooling, software, and IT components for flexible, scalable, autonomous edge deployments. It supports remote monitoring and control, multiple power and cooling configurations, and built-in security features for distributed edge endpoints.

The passage describes boot-configuration and GPMC-multiplexed pins, stating that some pins are sampled at reset to select XIP, Ethernet PHY, or ARM Cortex-A8 boot modes, and then function as GPMC data/address pins after reset. It also defines pin notation and internal pull states (IPD, IPU, DIS).

OpenAI announced a preview SDK for building third-party apps inside ChatGPT, with examples from Spotify, Canva, and Zillow, and said it plans new monetization features including instant checkout. The company is also expanding tools for agents and coding, while positioning ChatGPT as a chat-driven operating system rather than just a chatbot.

Stocks fell sharply on Friday as stronger-than-expected U.S. jobs data, rising wage growth, and surging bond yields fueled concerns about inflation and faster Fed rate hikes. The Dow dropped 665.75 points, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also posted steep losses, leading Wall Street to its biggest weekly declines in two years. All 11 S&P 500 sectors declined, volatility jumped, and several major stocks fell on weaker-than-expected earnings or outlooks.

The passage explains tail risk, or fat tails, as rare but extreme market events that occur more often than a normal distribution suggests, and describes why investors may hedge against them to avoid large losses, survive market downturns, and reduce behavioral mistakes. It lists several hedging approaches: put options, foreign assets, cash, Cambria’s TAIL ETF, Ray Dalio’s All Weather Portfolio, and trend-following strategies. It also notes that these protections generally reduce returns because they come at a cost.

The thesis analyzes digitized event management and evaluates 200 event management websites using 103 criteria. It compares Croatian and foreign websites and finds foreign sites stronger in social media presence, user support, and user experience, while Croatian organizations have significant room for improvement, especially in mobile applications and online presence.

The passage explains that AI, especially generative and agentic AI, is increasingly transforming the legal profession and can help with document review, legal research, and client communication. It also lists several AI tools lawyers can use and notes that AI is useful for analysis and drafting, but not every task requires it.

Real Madrid will face Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League last 16, while Barcelona play Chelsea, Manchester City meet Basel, Bayern Munich face Besiktas, Juventus take on Tottenham, Manchester United play Sevilla, Liverpool face Porto, and Shakhtar Donetsk meet Roma. First-leg matches are scheduled for 13/14 and 20/21 February, with second legs on 6/7 and 13/14 March.

The Minnesota Wild signed Kirill Kaprizov to an NHL-record eight-year, $136 million extension through 2033-34. The deal has the highest total value and average annual value in NHL history, and Kaprizov had 25 goals and 31 assists in 41 games last season.

Photographer Mark Bickerdike spent several years documenting Ricky’s School of Rock in Linthwaite, capturing about 50 RockJam gigs and the progress of young musicians over 10-week courses. The school’s founder, Ricky Comiskey, said the courses build confidence, have led some pupils to form bands, and include adult classes as well.

Cette étude qualitative menée auprès de 18 enseignants d’ÉPS en formation initiale au Québec a identifié comme principaux défis anticipés la gestion de classe et le manque de motivation des élèves. Pour le soutien de la motivation, cinq défis ressortent : l’hétérogénéité des élèves, la conception d’activités motivantes, l’engagement, la gestion des élèves désengagés et les différences entre les sexes. Les participants demandent davantage de préparation sur la planification, la mise en œuvre des stratégies motivationnelles et des occasions de pratique.

The passage explains that in AdS/CFT, the asymptotic behavior of a bulk scalar field near the boundary has two modes, one normalizable and one non-normalizable. The non-normalizable mode acts as a source deforming the boundary theory, while the normalizable mode corresponds to a state or expectation value. It derives the mass-dimension relation for a scalar field, shows how the operator dimension matches the bulk mass, and notes analogous results for gauge fields and the stress tensor.

A Tom Thomson painting once given as a gag gift sold for $481,250 after experts authenticated it, and Heffel’s Toronto auction raised $14.1 million in total. Other notable sales included a Paul-Emile Borduas work for $3.6 million, Lawren Harris’s “Morning, Lake Superior” for $1.1 million, and record prices for Jack Bush and several other works.

Southwest Airlines employee asked coach Lindsay Gottlieb to prove her biracial 1-year-old son was hers by requesting a birth certificate and later a Facebook post, which Gottlieb called demeaning and suspected was due to his skin color. Southwest apologized and said its policy is to verify lap children under age two, while some others, including Chrissy Teigen, defended the request as a precaution.

The VIX is a measure of implied volatility in S&P 500 index options and often moves inversely to the S&P 500. It is described as a mean reversion indicator, where rising VIX may suggest buying stocks and falling VIX may suggest selling. The passage also notes that many VIX trading strategies are complex and presents simple strategies based on VIX movement and SPY.

UAE Energy Minister Suhail bin Mohammed al-Mazroui said OPEC and non-OPEC producers plan to announce an exit strategy from supply cuts at their June meeting, but this would not mean ending the deal then. He said the strategy is premature to define now, while Russia has said any withdrawal should be gradual and may take three to six months.

Nigeria’s inflation fell to 16.25% in May from 17.28% in April, though month-on-month headline inflation rose to 1.88%. Food inflation increased to 19.27% year-on-year, driven by higher prices for meat, bread and cereals, fish, potatoes, milk, cheese, eggs, and vegetables such as tomatoes.

The paper presents an exact Nash equilibrium algorithm for multiplayer imperfect-information games by formulating the problem as a nonlinear complementarity problem and then as a quadratically constrained feasibility program. On reduced three-player Kuhn poker, it solves the game in under 3 seconds, while Gambit’s only applicable exact method took over 40 seconds; however, the approach does not scale to the full game.

Box reported first-quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on earnings, revenue, and billings, added about 3,000 paying customers to reach 85,000 total, and gave second-quarter guidance above analysts’ estimates, though the stock fell after hours.

The court affirmed a judgment for appellee recovering 117½ acres and rents. It held that an over-30-year-old transfer of a land certificate from proper custody was admissible as an ancient instrument, sufficiently identified the certificate, and carried a conclusive presumption of the agent’s authority. The court also held that a Land Office affidavit was inadmissible, evidence of defendant’s character for truth was properly excluded, and the evidence supported the verdict.

The passage contains certified copies of a contract for Thomas Scullun to command the bark Cape Horn Pigeon on a whaling voyage in 1891, customs clearance and manifest documents from San Francisco, and a Russian report stating the vessel was detained in the Sea of Okhotsk in 1892 but later released after the arrest was deemed a misunderstanding.

The passage describes a continuation patent application for an intelligent automated assistant for media exploration. It focuses on auditory-based digital assistant interfaces that can refine media requests during playback, provide media while responding verbally, suggest different media after non-affirmative responses, and merge preference profiles for multiple users.

Dusty Baker supports Jeff Kent’s Hall of Fame case, saying Kent deserves induction. Kent, eligible since 2013, has remained around 15 percent on ballots despite a 17-year career with 377 home runs, eight 100-RBI seasons, a .290 average, and a 2002 NL MVP award.

Carol Moore and others say a 2010 land deal championed by Jane Sanders led to Burlington College’s closure. Federal authorities are reviewing whether Sanders accurately represented donations used to secure the loan. Moore also criticized a separate agreement with Driscoll's Vermont Woodworking School, calling it a favorable deal for Carina Driscoll, Jane Sanders’ daughter.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on Ampere architecture, adds features for faster AI and HPC performance, including third-generation Tensor Cores, TF32, BF16, FP64, sparsity, asynchronous copy and barriers, CUDA task graphs, L2 cache residency controls, MIG partitioning, and third-generation NVLink. It also includes larger HBM2 and L2 caches, ECC protection, improved atomics, NVJPG, NVDEC, optical flow acceleration, PCIe Gen 4, and support in CUDA 11 for improved programmability and multi-instance workloads.

QuantifiedStrategies.com offers trading strategies for TradingView and invites users to sign up for notifications, browse available strategies, and request selected strategies be translated into Pinescript. It also includes a trading risk disclaimer.
Pete Hegseth summoned hundreds of generals and admirals from around the world and argued for changing a military he said had become soft and “woke.”

Amazon reported higher Q1 2019 net sales and net income, with total net sales of $59.7 billion and net income of $3.6 billion, versus $51.0 billion and $1.6 billion in Q1 2018. Operating income rose to $4.4 billion, driven by growth in North America, International, and AWS. The company also adopted new lease and film cost accounting guidance in 2019 and disclosed significant lease, debt, tax, and legal contingencies.

The comparator should assert a logic high when the amplifier output exceeds 1.1 V and use the shown circuit configuration. It requires close, low-ESR 0.1 µF bypass capacitors on the supply pins, stable low-noise power, careful trace layout to reduce coupling, and possible series resistors to damp ringing.

Qualcomm accidentally revealed details of an upcoming Asus Zenfone AR, a Google Tango-enabled phone and the second consumer-facing Tango device, which also supports Google Daydream View and uses a Snapdragon 821. Evan Blass posted renders of the phone, and pricing and availability were not yet announced.

The IMF said Ukraine’s pension system is unsustainable because it supports about 30 percent of the population and operates at a loss. IMF mission chief Ron van Rooden said pension reforms have been delayed too long, urged fewer early retirements and better collection of pension taxes, and noted Ukraine wants more IMF funding. Ukraine has resisted raising its pension age.

The 20-day EMA trading strategy uses the 20-day exponential moving average to generate buy signals when price rises above it and sell signals when price falls below it. A backtest on SPY showed weak performance, low CAGR, and a significant drawdown, but adding another indicator improved results. The strategy worked much better on Bitcoin, and the passage concludes that the added indicator can improve the 20 EMA strategy.

The passage explains typical sets and the AEP for discrete memoryless sources, showing that typical sequences have probability near 1, size about 2^(nH(X)), and individual probability about 2^(-nH(X)). It then introduces Markov sources, steady-state and ergodic Markov chains, and states that coding with memory can achieve rates based on conditional entropy H(X|S). Finally, it describes the Lempel-Ziv universal compression algorithm, which finds longest matches in a sliding window and asymptotically compresses at the conditional entropy rate without knowing source probabilities.

The speaker thanks West Point leaders and cadets, reflects on losing in sports, and says the President’s most important role is Commander in Chief. He argues that after the Cold War the United States must remain engaged and lead in world affairs, using military force selectively with clear missions, allied support when possible, and adequate, well-led armed forces. He praises the All Volunteer Force, public service, and the cadets’ commitment, then closes with encouragement and amnesty for the Corps of Cadets.

Coach Quenneville discussed player roles, consistency, ice time, and line matchups, praising the team’s overall season, strong defense, improved goaltending, and ability to handle playoff adversity. He also said he values Chicago as a special place to coach and described several players’ contributions, including hard work, puck possession, and defensive reliability.

The passage argues that treaty language on the Pacific Ocean did not support exclusive Russian jurisdiction over the Bering or Okhotsk Seas beyond ordinary territorial waters. It cites international law authorities stating that connected seas remain open to all nations, with only limited coastal restrictions justified by security, and rejects claims of sovereignty over large bays or seas such as the Baltic, Kara Sea, or Hudson Bay.

Damian Lillard scored 32 points and became the fastest Trail Blazer to reach 10,000 career points, but Portland lost to Toronto 130-105, ending its four-game winning streak. DeMar DeRozan led the Raptors with 35 points, and Toronto made a season-high 19 3-pointers.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x and related technologies, including GDDR6X memory with PAM4 signaling, RTX IO for GPU-based loading and decompression, A40 and A6000 data center GPUs, Ampere display and video features, AV1 decode, NVENC encoding, and performance improvements for gaming, creative, AI, and data center workloads.

Harvey Weinstein has been indicted by a grand jury on rape and criminal sexual act charges involving two women. Manhattan District Attorney Cyrus Vance Jr said the indictment brings him closer to accountability, while Weinstein’s lawyers said he would not testify because he had insufficient time to prepare.

The passage presents a fine-grained hierarchy of replica quantum advantage. It proves that estimating tr(ρ^(k+1)O) with k-replica protocols needs exponentially many samples in the dimension, while (k+1)-replica protocols can estimate it efficiently. The work develops an indistinguishability principle for Haar-assembled ensembles and applies it to lower bounds for spectrum testing and rank testing, along with matching upper bounds for estimating nonlinear observables.

The passage describes Enron’s rise from a pipeline company to a dominant trading firm under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling, driven by aggressive hiring, high-pressure culture, and innovative but controversial accounting and trading practices. It also recounts Enron’s later troubles, including criticism over California energy issues, failed ventures, falling stock, Skilling’s resignation as CEO, and Lay’s effort to refocus the company.

Vertex Resource Group Ltd. acquired a private hydro-vac services company serving the Edmonton region for $4.3 million, adding 11 units and doubling its hydro-vac fleet. The acquisition expands Vertex’s services into Edmonton and is expected to add about $5 million in annual revenue.

The speaker tells Foreign Service Institute students that their task is peace and says NATO is a living institution created to preserve peace through collective action and unity. He argues NATO has deterred war, should adapt through consultation among members, and remains essential to Atlantic security and human solidarity.

The passage explains flash memory characteristics, including erase/program endurance for the lower 32 kB or entire flash on smaller devices, cumulative erase operations before failure, maximum write operations per word line, and definitions of program and sector program time.

Iron sulfate heptahydrate, also called ferrous sulfate heptahydrate, copperas, or green vitriol, is a water-soluble sulfate produced during titanium dioxide manufacturing and by crystallizing hot sulfate solutions. It is used medically to treat iron deficiency and industrially for treating iron chlorosis, water purification, sewage phosphate removal, cement applications, and as an iron supplier in agriculture.

Microsoft’s 10-K for fiscal year ended June 30, 2019 describes the company as a technology firm focused on the intelligent cloud, intelligent edge, and more personal computing, operating through Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing segments. It reports a large global workforce, major products and services including Office, Azure, LinkedIn, Dynamics, Windows, Surface, Xbox, and Bing, and outlines competition, operations, research and development, distribution, and legal and regulatory risks.

A penalty-kick shoot-out is used to decide tied soccer matches when a winner is required, usually after regulation and extra time. Teams alternate five kicks from the penalty mark, then continue in sudden death if still tied. The referee conducts coin tosses, records results, and ensures eligible players and goalkeeper changes follow the rules. Coaches are advised to prepare players mentally, tactically, and through practice before and during the shoot-out.

The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is a $0 annual fee card with a 0% intro APR for 21 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, but it has no ongoing rewards. It also charges a 5% balance transfer fee, a 3% foreign transaction fee, and offers up to $600 of cellphone protection.

Tesla entered into a 90-day indemnification agreement with Elon Musk on June 24, 2020, under which Musk will provide up to $100 million in directors’ and officers’ indemnity coverage from personal funds if Tesla cannot provide it. Tesla will pay Musk a one-time fee of $972,361 and may pay an additional amount based on a market quote for comparable coverage.

Sony says the Xperia XZ Premium will get Android Oreo later this year, adding the 3D Creator app for scanning objects and improved camera features, including smarter predictive capture and enhanced burst mode.

The appellate court affirmed dismissal of Patrick Sutherland’s CPLR article 78 petition challenging the denial of parole. It held the Board could rely on the presentence report, found the Board considered the relevant statutory factors, and concluded the parole denial was not irrational.

AGNC Investment is described as a top mortgage REIT benefiting from recent and expected Fed rate cuts, with lower rates expected to cut financing costs and support book value. It posted a third consecutive quarter of positive NII in Q2 2025, trades at a premium to book value, and is viewed as a bullish income stock with an attractive monthly dividend.

The address calls for a break with tradition and a broad reform of American programs and institutions in the 1970s, emphasizing peace, ending the Vietnam War, sharing responsibility with other nations, and improving relations with the Soviet Union and China. It also urges major domestic reforms in welfare, federalism, opportunity, inflation control, crime reduction, environmental protection, growth policy, and national renewal, envisioning an America at peace and better serving its people and the world.

A new remote-controlled swimming robot, the “mini manbo,” will inspect damage inside Fukushima Dai-Ichi’s Unit 3 in July to help locate melted fuel and assess reactor damage. Equipped with lights, two cameras, and a radiation detector, it is designed to operate in highly radioactive submerged conditions after earlier robot inspections failed.

Andrea Conti’s agent said the 23-year-old wing-back only wants a move to Milan and that his time at Atalanta is over. Giuffredi urged Atalanta and Milan to work out a solution, saying Conti should not be blocked from making his dream transfer.

The passage summarizes Nassim Nicholas Taleb’s books and ideas, including randomness, tail risk, antifragility, skin in the game, and the barbell strategy. It says Taleb made most of his money through options strategies, gained during the 1987 crash, and later co-founded Universa Investments with Mark Spitznagel, which uses tail-risk hedging and barbell principles.

The speaker said everyone was disappointed with the outcome, praised the team’s effort in three overtime games, and said the Stanley Cup Final loss was very tough. Coach Vigneault said he was proud of the group, noted both goaltenders were outstanding, and said the team had to reflect before discussing more. He also said the team needed better puck possession, had played well in the building and on the road, and hoped the power play would finish chances.

Malawi Health Equity Network has urged government to deploy internal auditors to all 28 district councils, citing poor fund management, weak coordination with NGOs and CSOs, and exclusion of rural communities from budget planning. Government said the deployment of auditors is at an advanced stage and would improve transparency and financial management.

ICOs are described as a new crowdfunding method in which startups sell crypto tokens to raise money, usually before the network is functional. The passage says most ICOs were marketed on ideas, often with centralized development, and many had open-source code only later. It highlights factors for evaluating ICOs such as the token use case, white paper, source code, team, venture capital backing, community, monetary policy, and token distribution. It also notes that the ICO boom raised about $25 billion in 12 months, but most ICOs had already failed and the market was declining.

The passage says Trump described the Canada-U.S. trade relationship as only needing a “tweak,” but notes Canada is far more dependent on U.S. trade than vice versa. It praises Trudeau’s diplomatic handling of his White House meeting with Trump, while warning that serious trade issues remain, including agriculture, softwood lumber, and competitiveness. It concludes that the leaders emphasized cooperation and produced a respectful, supportive joint statement.

Coach DeBoer said home crowd, sleeping in their own beds, and limiting distractions are important, and that his team needs to focus, build its game, attack more, and have the puck more. He said they expect better play, will make lineup decisions on game day, and must take care of business at home. He also noted Pittsburgh’s speed, Crosby, Kessel, and Malkin as matchup challenges, and described the series as a momentum battle between two very good teams.

The report on Chicago stock yards found unsanitary, dangerous conditions and urged immediate federal legislation for thorough inspection of stockyards, packing houses, and meat products entering interstate commerce. It said existing law was inadequate, the investigation was preliminary and unfinished, and recommended measures known as the “Beveridge amendment,” with inspection costs to be covered by a fee on each animal slaughtered.

Santa Cruz County appointed Carlos Palacios to replace retiring County Administrative Officer Susan Mauriello. Palacios, currently assistant county administrative officer and a former Watsonville city manager, will become the county’s first Latino in the top administrative role, overseeing 2,400 staff and a $720 million budget.

A 26-year-old man was arrested after armed police responded to reports that he threatened two people with a gun at Shackleton Court in Newton Heath around 4:30pm on Monday. Witnesses reported a large police presence, and the man remains in custody.

The passage introduces the ML-separability problem for the modal µ-calculus and studies definability, separability, and Craig interpolation over all models and trees of bounded outdegree. It reports ExpTime-completeness for ML-separability over all models, PSpace-completeness over words, and higher complexity for trees of outdegree at least 3, including failure of Craig interpolation there. It also presents constructions of separators and definitions, and an application to graded modalities.

The DAWN-PLASMA phase 2 multicenter randomized open-label trial compared best supportive care with or without convalescent plasma in hospitalized adults with COVID-19. Among 489 randomized patients, the intervention did not improve the primary endpoint of being alive without mechanical ventilation at Day 15, and no significant differences were found in secondary outcomes or safety overall.

A&O Shearman associate Ashley Hollis won “Big Brother,” saying she hid her profession by posing as a social media marketing manager and used attorney-style strategy in her final speech. She said she was inspired by Elle Woods and plans to give much of her $750,000 prize to her parents.

This bibliometric study analyzed Scopus documents on STEAM education and gamification from 2017–2023, identifying 34 English-language publications. It found rising publication output, most papers in computer science, and frequent keywords such as gamification, steam, and steam education. Thailand led in publications and citations, while the most cited article received 30 citations.

Tharisa plc presented its phased transition from open-cast to underground mining as open-pit resources are depleted. CEO Phoevos Pouroulis said the company has studied this for years and aims to create a fully integrated mining complex that continues unlocking value from platinum group metals and chrome concentrate.

The passage describes a Freirean, CHAT-based remote educational activity using Discord during the COVID-19 pandemic in a physics teacher education course. Students discussed school reopening, researched sources on COVID-19, and collaboratively produced an infographic, with Discord enabling dialogue, self-organization, and student agency.

Libyan National Army forces in Benghazi have lost four men and had 10 wounded in December amid ongoing clashes in the Khreibish district, five months after Haftar declared victory in the city. Three were killed by snipers and one by a landmine, and daily fighting and occasional air strikes have continued.

The passage describes electronic gaming systems and methods with a stop-based bonus game in which selecting a stop position associated with a lower-value award can replace it with a higher-value jackpot award for future play, increasing later chances of winning jackpots. It also describes bonus wheels, secondary jackpot wheels, and other constructs such as reels, dice, and grid-based treasure maps, along with related gaming machine and system implementations.

Fran Horowitz says Abercrombie & Fitch is not trying to be “cool” but a long-lasting lifestyle brand. Since taking over in 2017, she raised clothing quality and shifted management to be more collaborative, helping sales nearly double from 2019 to 2024. Combined sales of Abercrombie and Hollister are expected to top $5 billion this year, with new partnerships aimed at growing awareness and customers.

A spring 2025 study at a western U.S. university compared a traditional physics lab, a prebuilt AI simulation, and a student-built AI simulation on electric potential and equipotential lines. Both simulation groups outperformed the physical lab on immediate conceptual questions, with no significant differences on midterm or final exam scores. Students reported more positive attitudes toward both simulation approaches than the physical lab, and the AI-based approach was presented as a way to support conceptual learning, modeling skills, and productive use of generative AI.

A veteran, Rodney Orton, who relied on a mobility scooter for 15 years after developing breathing problems, lost use of his scooter and was told by the VA he would need a new evaluation and wait six weeks for an appointment. After a Problem Solvers team intervened, the VA quickly found a local scooter in inventory and delivered it to his hospital room the next morning.

The passage is an AMD Geode CS5535 specification update listing numerous silicon revision A3 issues and workarounds, including DMA, PIC, UART, ACPI, PMC, USB, IDE/ATAC, LPC, SMB, GPIO, and sleep/clock-gating problems, plus one PIT deviation from standard operation.
Some dogs show an irresistible attraction to toys that may parallel human behavioral addictions.

Stanford researchers found that vegetables given delicious-sounding labels were chosen more often in a dining hall study of nearly 28,000 students than the same dishes with basic or healthy-sounding labels. The appetizing labels led to 25% more veggie selections than basic labels, 35% more than positive healthy labels, and 41% more than restrictive healthy labels. The passage also suggests using taste-first, appealing names to encourage more vegetable eating at home.

NASA shared a Hubble Space Telescope image of the Tarantula Nebula, also known as 30 Doradus, named for its spindly gas filaments. The image also shows the Honeycomb Nebula, whose bubble-like shape has puzzled astronomers since its discovery and was linked in 2010 research to interactions between two supernovae and the viewing angle.

The passage explains electroweak unification by combining weak and electromagnetic interactions through redefined left- and right-handed currents, weak isospin doublets, and hypercharge. It shows how the charged weak currents, a neutral current, the photon, and the Z boson arise from mixing the isospin triplet and singlet components using the weak mixing angle.

The message reports national strength, peace efforts, and detailed policies on foreign relations, defense, finances, tax reduction, debt settlements, agriculture, tariffs, public works, transportation, banking, conservation, social services, health, prisons, immigration, veterans, civil service, reorganization, prohibition, and law enforcement. It emphasizes economic prosperity, the need to restrain government spending, and broader efforts to improve administration and preserve peace and ordered liberty.

Kevin Stefanski said there is no single thing Shedeur Sanders must do to earn the Browns’ backup quarterback job, stressing player and quarterback development. Rookie Dillon Gabriel remains the starter, Bailey Zappe is also in the mix, and Sanders is likely to stay in the emergency third-string role for now.

The passage offers five tips for Abalone: avoid rushing into offense, plan moves ahead, control the center, switch to offense after starting defensively, and split the opponent’s pieces to make them easier to attack.

In 1,067 Amish adults, plasma p-tau181 and Aβ42/p-tau181 differed by AD status, while Aβ42/Aβ40 was associated with cognitive preservation, especially among APOE ε4 carriers. Models using all biomarkers or Aβ42/p-tau181 best distinguished AD, and clustering of Aβ42/Aβ40 and p-tau181 identified Amish subgroups with distinct biomarker risk profiles.

The passage describes automated cryogenic storage systems for storing, retrieving, and transferring individual samples between cryogenic vaults and removable cryogenic storage devices. It includes a sample handling module with a robotic arm, controller, refrigeration and humidity control, specialized racks, trays, docking interfaces, and disaster recovery methods for jammed trays and vault repair.

The passage describes deuterated heterocycle fused gamma-carbolines that antagonize 5-HT2A receptors, inhibit SERT, and have improved metabolic stability. It claims these compounds and related pharmaceutical, depot, and oral sustained-release compositions are useful for treating central nervous system disorders, especially psychosis, schizophrenia, sleep disorders, depression, anxiety, and related conditions, alone or with other therapeutic agents. Examples and studies show lower metabolite formation and similar receptor binding compared with the non-deuterated compound.

The speaker says the team’s puck pursuit, veteran leadership, and balanced forward group make them hard to play against, and emphasizes staying patient and continuing to play through adversity. He praises several players, including Crosby, Malkin, Kessel, Conor, Chris, Rusty, and a defenseman, for their effort, scoring ability, skating, and chemistry, and notes the coaching staff manages minutes and uses players to their strengths.

The speaker thanks teammates, coaches, family, and Adam for support, says switching to right wing was difficult but is now working well, and says he feels happy, back on track, and proud of the award and history. He also says his foot is improving, he is starting to play tennis soon, and he believes injured players should still play if they can.

The passage announces that metal-organic frameworks won the chemistry Nobel, then includes newsletter and health-news promotional text, a report that former FDA vaccine regulator Peter Marks joined Eli Lilly after resigning in March, and a list of other article headlines.

The Triangle Rotation offense attacks the triangle zone of a Triangle & Two defense using simple clockwise and counterclockwise three-player rotations, with two shooters involved if the first inside rotations do not create a good shot. Key options include a pop-out, baseline cut, lob, and side-screen action. Success depends on simple execution, coordination, defensive recognition, communication, timing, and scouting or in-game observation.

Two government animal studies found a weak link between high cellphone radiation exposure and some rare heart tumors in male rats, but no clear evidence of brain tumors or significant effects in mice or female rats. Federal regulators and several scientists said the findings do not change current views that cellphone use is safe, though some critics said the results do not rule out risk from excessive use.

Michael Johnson, Babson College provost and marketing professor, has been named president of John Carroll University, becoming its first lay leader in 131 years. He will begin July 1 on a five-year contract, replacing retiring Rev. Robert Niehoff, and will also join JCU’s management, marketing and supply chain faculty.

The passage reviews ChatGPT’s development and its use in education, noting that it can generate coherent writing, support learning, and sometimes pass exams, but it also has limits in deep understanding, critical thinking, accuracy, complex scientific tasks, and calculation problems. It reports concerns about hallucinations, plagiarism, cheating, and unreliable or repetitive answers, and recommends validation, new assessment methods, policies, and student guidance.

This cross-sectional study at Hemen Medical Center, Addis Ababa, found that 78% of 230 pregnant women had heard of labor epidural analgesia, but only 14.3% were willing to use it. Awareness mainly came from previous users, family and friends, and the internet, while healthcare providers were rarely the main source. Education level, family income, concern about fetal harm, and perceived pain-relief effectiveness were significantly associated with the decision to consider labor epidural analgesia.

A study by King’s College London analyzing 49 studies with 266,939 people found that regular physical activity was linked to lower odds of developing depression across children, adults, and older adults. The researchers said the protective effect remained after accounting for factors such as BMI, smoking, and physical health conditions, and they called for more research and policy changes to promote physical activity.

Four Down is a spread offense often used for the last shot of a period, featuring a ballhandler isolated with four non-ballhandlers along the baseline. Its main options are a drive or jumper, with counters like drop passes to the post, kick-outs to shooters, and pressure-release passes from the corners. It also includes crunch-time specials such as Mid Screen, Triple Base Screen, and Misdirection Double.

The 2-3 zone is a common zone defense that protects the basket and dribble penetration, works well against poor outside shooting, and can be adapted for trapping or defending strong low-post players. The passage describes basic player positioning, common shifts, wing adjustments, variations, trap options, and special adjustments for defending an outstanding low-post player.

Intercontinental Exchange, the New York Stock Exchange’s parent company, is investing $2 billion in Polymarket in cash, valuing it at $9 billion. The companies will also distribute Polymarket’s data and collaborate on tokenization initiatives. Polymarket, founded in 2020, has grown from a niche crypto platform into a mainstream prediction market, boosted by the 2024 U.S. presidential election.

Zacks Investment Research downgraded Caesars Entertainment Corporation from buy to hold, while other analysts issued mixed ratings and a consensus Buy with a $14.39 price target. The stock fell 0.76% to $13.00, and the company reported a quarterly loss and revenue below estimates.

The sense resistor detects transformer ripple current and can shut down switching if peak current exceeds the set limit; the CS pin threshold is about 1 V. The passage also gives PCB layout guidance, including keeping noisy and feedback traces separated, placing capacitors and compensation parts close to the IC, using short thick power traces and a ground plane, and separating power ground from signal ground.

Steven Kean forwarded a compilation of energy-related articles on California’s electricity crisis, including claims of a likely summer power shortage, stalled peaker plant construction, business concerns over the crisis, Gray Davis’s increased public role, California’s low per-capita energy use, western spot power prices, and legislative doubts about Davis’s transmission-line buyout plan.

The Court held that Community Board 7 lacked capacity to maintain its article 78 proceeding to compel disclosure of FOIL-requested documents. Although the board had standing, the City Charter and ULURP did not authorize such a lawsuit, so the judgment for the board was reversed and the petition dismissed.

Cboe said the smooth launch of bitcoin futures could lead to more cryptocurrency products, including options and ETFs, though regulators may take time. The first U.S. bitcoin futures trading saw heavy interest, volatility, a brief halt, and orderly trading, and Cboe plans to wait for a few settlements before adding new crypto-derivative products.

The ADS9803 can be powered down via the PWDN pin or PD_CH field and requires an initialization register-write sequence with a free-running sampling clock after power-up or reset. It supports SPI register access across multiple banks, speed-boost mode for one selected channel pair, and daisy-chain SPI configuration for multiple devices. Several registers control mode selection, data format, test patterns, averaging, bandwidth, common-mode range, output lanes, and speed-boost settings.
Premium subscription features include the Lex column, Editor’s Choice, FT Newsmine Blog, and Martin Sandbu’s Free Lunch, along with the daily FT ePaper and exclusive weekly emails.

The device supports an external 4.096V reference through REFIO when INTREF_DIS is set, with REFCAP requiring minimum 10µF and 1µF capacitors. It provides straight-binary ADC output, input and AVDD alarms, multiSPI communication with multiple read/write protocols, RESET/ACQ/CONV operating states, nine configuration registers, and low-power NAP and power-down modes.

PPL Corporation shares rose $0.19 to $37.65, but trading showed a net outflow of $29.88 million. Recent analyst actions left the stock with a consensus “Hold” rating and $38.94 price target. The company reported quarterly EPS of $0.52, paid a $0.395 dividend, and insiders sold 47,163 shares in the last three months.

The passage argues that digital wellness services on smart mobile platforms could help young elderly maintain wellness routines, improve health, and reduce health and social care costs. It presents the BeWell project in Finland, a four-dimensional wellness model, and survey results from 101 young elderly respondents showing that mobile app use and wellness issues are important for many in the group.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on April 26, 2018 it announced its first quarter 2018 financial results, with the press release and non-GAAP information attached as exhibits.

The passage is a series of postgame hockey comments about a tied playoff series, with players praising goals, overtime wins, team depth, physical play, and strong forechecking. Patrick Kane, Brent Seabrook, and Bryan Bickell discuss the team’s confidence, contributions from different players, concern for defensive improvements, and pride in the Blackhawks’ history and logo.

FreeNAS version 11 is released, based on FreeBSD 11-STABLE, with bhyve for virtual machines, AWS S3 compatibility, Slack and HipChat integration, boot-service selection, and FreeBSD jails. Docker support is postponed to a future point release, and the new Angular GUI is still in beta.

This study examined the spatiotemporal evolution of SARS-CoV-2 Alpha and Delta variants in Vietnam in 2021. Alpha was introduced in multiple events but remained in sporadic clusters, while Delta AY.57 appeared in April and drove the nationwide outbreak from May onward. Genomic surveillance suggested limited interregional spread, distinct local clusters, increased genetic diversity during the outbreak, and the importance of public health measures.

JPMorgan Chase & Co. reduced its DeVry Education Group stake by 9.6% in the third quarter, while several other institutions increased holdings. DeVry shares fell 0.16% to $31.20; the company reported quarterly EPS of $0.39 versus a $0.41 estimate, revenue of $449.9 million, and paid a $0.18 semiannual dividend. Analysts have a consensus “Hold” rating with an average target price of $26.11.

Ostersunds were drawn against Arsenal in the Europa League last 32 after a strong run through qualifying and finishing second in Group J. Borussia Dortmund, Atletico Madrid, Celtic and Napoli dropped into the Europa League and will face Atalanta, Copenhagen, Zenit and RB Leipzig respectively.

This systematic review of 9 studies (2,526 participants) found that marijuana, medical cannabis, and endocannabinoid supplements were associated with changes in the microbiota in several conditions, including HIV infection, inflammation, obesity, and cognitive deficits. The review also reported some adverse events and concluded that more research is needed.

Chinese textile firms are increasingly using North Korean factories and workers to cut labour costs, with garments often labelled “Made in China” and exported worldwide. The practice is widespread in Dandong, driven by lower wages, higher productivity, and China’s role as North Korea’s economic lifeline despite U.N. sanctions.

Glenner Town Square is a 1950s-style daycare village in Chula Vista for Alzheimer’s and dementia patients, with interactive storefronts and services, and it opened in April 2018. The passage also lists other licensed adult day programs for cognitively impaired people in San Diego County, including locations, services, hours, and contact information.

The speaker says reaching the finals again with a third team is unique and that they want to win and touch the trophy. They reflect on learning from past losses, praise their team’s hard work and great run, and note the city’s strong fan enthusiasm. They also say the series will be tight and that winning the trophy is the main goal.

The speech says America has recovered through bipartisan cooperation, with lower inflation, higher purchasing power, tax cuts, deregulation, and job growth. It calls for reducing deficits, limiting government, simplifying taxes, supporting a balanced budget and line-item veto, and investing in space, the environment, education, traditional values, crime prevention, and peace. It also urges stronger defense, democratic progress abroad, and continued national unity and confidence.

Ben Rice was born and raised in Cohasset, Massachusetts, attended Noble and Greenough School in Dedham, and played college baseball at Dartmouth. The Yankees drafted him in 2021 after limited college playing time, and he hit 26 home runs in 2025 while splitting time between first base, catcher and designated hitter.

The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate for the third consecutive quarter to 1 percent-1.25 percent, citing strong job growth and moderate economic growth. It also acknowledged weaker-than-expected inflation, lowering its 2017 inflation forecast to 1.6 percent while still predicting 2 percent next year.

The study used a simplified SIR-based model and simulations to evaluate community-wide screening-isolation in a semi-isolated community without vaccines or medications. It found that screening can control transmission when done frequently and with sufficient efficiency, but effectiveness declines with longer delays, lower frequency, higher reproduction numbers, and greater external influx; strict border control was also shown to be necessary.

Tom Brady’s agent said Brady intends to keep playing beyond his current contract, potentially into his mid-40s, despite retirement rumors and missing the start of voluntary workouts. Brady has two seasons left on his deal, and Patriots owner Robert Kraft said the team is not focused on giving him a new contract.

MultiChoice says Netflix has hurt DStv Premium in South Africa, even though total subscribers grew; Premium subscribers and average revenue per customer declined. CEO Calvo Mawela says the company is moving toward a standalone streaming-only DStv package, but still needs streaming rights for all entertainment content and has warned against over-regulation by ICASA.

CoreWeave has rallied on major AI deal wins and bullish sentiment, including $22.4B in OpenAI deals and $14.2B in Meta deals, but Microsoft remains a major revenue concentration risk. Its aggressive, debt-funded capex strategy and high forward revenue multiple raise sustainability and valuation concerns, and the stock may be due for a cooling-off period.

At Joppatowne High School’s 2018 commencement, more than 130 seniors graduated, with about 95 percent planning to continue to college, technical school, the military or law enforcement. Amya Hill said she will study nursing at Albany State University, and other speakers and officials addressed the class about future goals, moving forward, and public service.

The speaker says the team will not analyze last night’s game publicly, that the long flight should help players feel better, and that Tampa has no pressure because Calgary is expected to win in front of a home crowd. He says the team’s goal is to extend the series, that playoff success depends on battles and big plays, and that Calgary may be affected by the pressure of an elimination game.

A letter taped to fired prosecutor Michael Ben’Ary’s door said he was terminated after a false social media post while working on a terrorism case, and accused DOJ leadership of prioritizing punishment of perceived Trump enemies over public safety and national security.

The manuscript reports an intermediate superconducting phase in half-filled second moiré bands of twisted bilayer MoTe2, between a ferromagnetic Chern insulator and a non-Abelian fractional spin Hall insulator. Exact diagonalization shows that reducing screened intervalley interactions produces a time-reversal-symmetric, extended nodal s-wave superconductor with negative binding energy, finite superfluid stiffness, and pairing between opposite spins and valleys. The authors also describe a continuous transition to the fractional spin Hall insulator and argue that realistic band geometry is important for stabilizing the superconductivity.

The OTC market is a decentralized, electronic market where parties trade directly without an exchange, often for less liquid or specialized assets. OTC stocks usually have less transparency, weaker liquidity, higher risk, and lower long-term returns, while crypto can also trade over the counter.

OptumCare offers 12-week “brainsaver” classes at three Valley locations, combining physical exercise, stress reduction, cognitive exercises, education, socialization, and diet guidance to support brain health and reduce Alzheimer’s risk.

A meeting between President Trump and top congressional leaders ended without a funding deal, making a federal government shutdown more likely. JD Vance blamed Democrats, while Chuck Schumer said the sides had “very large differences” and blamed Republicans. Democrats want health care provisions, including an extension of enhanced Obamacare tax credits, in a stopgap funding bill, while Republicans want a clean continuing resolution.

Moina Shaiq created “Meet a Muslim” after realizing people were afraid to ask her about Islam; the program has drawn crowds and expanded across the U.S. She speaks about Muslim beliefs and stereotypes to promote understanding amid anti-Muslim incidents, though some critics question whether such efforts are effective.

The disclosure describes a wireless communication method and device for transmitting and receiving SRS, including configuration of a guard period for SRS antenna switching and its priority relative to PUCCH or PUSCH. It proposes signaling Y-symbol guard periods, handling collisions with uplink channels and between SRS resource sets, and reducing performance deterioration from antenna switching and resource collisions.

Turing Tensor Cores are specialized units for tensor and matrix operations in deep learning, with new INT8 and INT4 modes for inferencing. They provide speed-ups for neural network training and inferencing, enable AI features on GeForce gaming PCs and Quadro workstations, and power DLSS, which uses a neural network to combine details from multiple frames into a final image with fewer input samples than TAA.

Zsolt Lakatos, sentenced to 13 years for violently shaking his four-month-old son and causing catastrophic brain injuries, was arrested after hiding for eight days and later given an additional 10 days for breaching bail. The child, now 22 months old, lives in foster care and requires lifelong care.
Tesla Motors, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that it published a press release on January 3, 2016, furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01, with the press release attached as Exhibit 99.1.

The coach discussed team consistency, accountability, and open communication, praised the leadership and effort of key players, and said the team rises to playoff challenges by playing faster and more decisively. He also addressed goalie competition, player progression, and the need to trust players based on their defensive play and recent performance.

Cover 0 is a man-to-man defense with no safeties over the top, used to create maximum blitz pressure while keeping all eligible receivers covered. It is strong against the run, RPOs, short routes, and can pressure the quarterback heavily, but it is high-risk because beaten defenders have no help and it can be vulnerable to draws, scrambles, deep routes, and pick plays.

The study argues that holistic education should integrate mind, matter, and spirit, and uses literature reviews to identify four core dimensions in the Indian higher education context: empathy, mindfulness, compassion, and critical inquiry. It finds these dimensions supported by existing holistic education literature and aligned with Indian sages’ educational philosophies, NEP 2020, and SDG 4.7, while noting the need for culturally grounded assessment tools and broader future research.

Soybean May futures closed higher as supplies declined and crushing demand stayed strong due to encouraging soy meal exports. Arrivals fell sharply in April 1-15 versus March, and the report expects higher prices from strong crusher demand, though adequate supplies and cheap imports may pressure prices while domestic demand supports them.

A study of 1,099 college students found that sustained regular consumption of highly caffeinated energy drinks was linked to higher risk at age 25 of cocaine use, nonmedical use of prescription stimulants, and alcohol use disorder, while declining or no energy drink use was not associated with higher risk.

Astronomers say Oumuamua, the first confirmed object from outside our solar system, likely came from a binary star system and was ejected as planets formed. The cigar-shaped asteroid, discovered in October, is tumbling through space and is expected to keep doing so for billions of years.

Consumer advocates reported enrollment glitches on HealthCare.gov, including incorrect messages in Illinois saying no plans were available, though every county has at least one ACA insurer. The administration said the issue was resolved, but advocates said it continued. Friday is the last day to enroll for subsidized coverage in 39 federal-website states, with heavy demand expected and possible website delays. Some hurricane-affected areas may get an extension to Dec. 31, and states running their own exchanges have later deadlines.

President Woodrow Wilson proclaimed that a state of war existed between the United States and the Imperial German Government on April 6, 1917, and directed Americans to support the war effort. He also issued regulations for German male alien enemies age 14 and older, restricting possession of weapons, aircraft, cipher materials, and access to certain areas, and authorizing seizure, registration, restraint, removal, or summary arrest for violations.

The Nationals’ fifth starter competition may extend past opening day, with Jeremy Hellickson added to A.J. Cole and Erick Fedde, while Max Scherzer was named opening day starter and Stephen Strasburg, Gio Gonzalez, and Tanner Roark follow in the rotation. Hellickson is expected to make a spring debut soon, Cole is likely to make the team, Fedde is likely headed to the minors, and Trea Turner may return Tuesday after treating an ingrown toenail.

Tesla announced the $36,990 Model 3 Standard and $39,990 Model Y Standard, lower-cost versions with fewer features, including no Autosteer on the Model Y Standard and no FM/AM radio in either vehicle. Tesla said the Model Y Standard is expected in November to December and the Model 3 Standard in December to January, and its stock fell after the announcement.

VentureWire’s November 14, 2000 issue lists top stories on Apax merging its European and Israeli units and pledging $600 million for Israeli companies, New Edge Networks laying off 135 employees, KSolutions raising $50 million, and Cisco acquiring Radiata for $295 million. It also reports numerous funding deals, executive and board changes, company shutdowns, product renamings, acquisitions, and venture capital news.

The defendant appealed his conviction for simple assault, arguing the court erred in restricting certain testimony and allowing him to be asked to demonstrate how he drew and opened his pocketknife. The court held the cross-examination was proper and that evidence about alleged threatening letters was a collateral issue, so excluding it did not justify reversal. The judgment was affirmed.

The passage describes NVIDIA Blackwell’s neural graphics features, including Ray Reconstruction, DLAA, neural shaders, and technologies like RTX Neural Materials, Neural Texture Compression, Neural Radiance Cache, RTX Skin, and RTX Neural Faces. It also lists Blackwell GPU families GB202, GB203, and GB205, along with their core counts and the GeForce RTX 5090, 5080, 5070 Ti, and 5070 product plans.

A 6-year-old girl in Chester, Pennsylvania told police she saw her mother, Devanna Cornitcher, stabbed to death by her boyfriend, Alonzo Carter, who was arrested and denied bail. Carter allegedly said he acted in self-defense. Both children were present at the scene.

The case held that district courts have only original, not appellate, jurisdiction under the organic act, and that appeals from justices of the peace to district courts are tried de novo, with the transcript serving only to show the case was properly appealed. It also held that discrepancies in testimony are for the jury, and that the trial court did not err in denying a new trial because the verdict was not clearly against the weight of the evidence.

The passage lists documents from Chapter I, covering U.S. consultations with other major powers and the Yalta Conference on international organization, along with telegrams and related records from January 1 to March 8, 1945. It includes a circular telegram from the Secretary of State to diplomatic officers in certain American Republics discussing Dumbarton Oaks proposals and preparations for a conference of American Republics associated in the war.

The speaker says the early game was difficult for both teams, especially on power play and penalty kill, and notes the home crowd was important. They say the team must rely on that support, acknowledge the opponent’s talent, and say their own effort has been frustrating. With two home games ahead, they expect to turn things around and improve their puck possession against the opponent’s defense.

Using three cohorts, the study found that poor sleep quality predicted depressive symptom severity, and anxiety improved prediction and mediated the association. Brain structure and function did not meaningfully predict depressive symptoms or mediate the link, and the reverse prediction from depressive symptoms to sleep quality was weaker.

The passage describes the Base Cross Offense as a basketball set that uses entry passes, baseline screens, down screens, and ball reversal to create post mismatches and open shots. It outlines several entries, reads and counters against different defensive reactions, teaching methods, and game strategies, emphasizing execution, spacing, and defensive recognition.

Kirkpatrick argued that Carter’s policies in Iran and Nicaragua replaced friendly moderate autocrats with extremist ones and reflected a lack of realism. She said traditional authoritarian governments are generally less repressive and more compatible with U.S. interests than revolutionary autocracies, which tend to create greater repression and instability.

Des Moines Public Schools Superintendent Ian Roberts resigned effective immediately after being detained by ICE, and after the Iowa Board of Educational Examiners revoked his license. Roberts is being held at Woodbury County Jail while his attorneys seek to reopen his immigration case and request a stay.

The passage says markets turned risk-off last week amid weak jobs data, policy uncertainty, and technical deterioration, while earnings remained generally strong; it also mentions items such as Netflix closing lower after Elon Musk urged cancellations and the U.S. government shutdown continuing after a Senate funding bill failed.

A motorist led police on a two-hour chase through Kansas and Missouri in a pickup truck with four flat tires before crashing into a ditch in Savannah, Missouri. Officers found drugs and three loaded weapons in the vehicle, and the suspect was taken to a hospital after police believed he had ingested methamphetamine.

The Patient Charter, part of the NHS Constitution, sets out patients’ legal rights, NHS pledges, and responsibilities. It covers access to care, quality and safety, medicines, consent, choice, complaints, and the need for patients to use the NHS fairly and respectfully.

A study found that people reported stronger nocebo side effects when a fake cream was presented as more expensive. Volunteers given the expensive-looking cream reported nearly 30% more pain than those given a control cream, compared with about 3% for the generic-looking cream, and brain imaging showed activity changes in pain-related regions.

NVIDIA’s FY2018 10-K describes the company as a GPU and AI computing platform provider serving gaming, professional visualization, datacenter, and automotive markets, with major reliance on third-party manufacturing, global operations, and significant R&D. It also outlines executive officers, properties, stock performance, dividends, share repurchases, and numerous business and legal risk factors.

Goal side in soccer means a defender positions themselves between the goal and the opponent, keeping the opponent in front. Youth players should be taught to “get in their way,” move past opponents if behind them, and learn proper positioning on the right, center, and left while adjusting to opponent movement. Drills should start slowly without a ball, then add a ball and increase speed; defenders must not block or use outstretched arms.

The Alabama Court of Civil Appeals denied James F. Robertson III’s mandamus petition seeking a default judgment in his divorce action because he did not show that the affidavit required by Rule 4.3(d)(5) proving service by publication had been filed with the trial court.

The United States appealed the appraised values of imported fishing equipment at Seattle. The importer conceded that two outside packing charge deductions were dutiable, and the court found no evidence to challenge another 26.557 yen deduction. The merchandise was valued at the appraised amounts minus the listed shipping, consular fee, insurance, and petties charges, plus the 26.557 yen deduction in consular invoice 3806.

The Sensex rose 270 points to 29,683.87 and the Nifty climbed above 9,200 to 9,214.15, led by gains in metal, energy, FMCG and banking stocks. Tata Consultancy Services was flat ahead of its earnings report. Asian markets were mixed, and the rupee opened at 64.51 per dollar before trading at 64.40.
