WMCC vocational students built cabinets and countertops for the Kidder United Methodist Church kitchen, helping prepare it to become a disaster relief center. The church paid for materials, the prison provided labor, and officials said the project gave offenders real-world experience and community benefit.

The passage outlines cryptocurrency trading strategies, key market factors, risks, fees, and differences from stock trading. It explains that halving events, hard forks, Tether (USDT), DeFi projects, and macroeconomic events can affect prices and trading conditions, and says effective trading depends on strategy, analysis, and risk management.

The panel discussed financing sources for startups, including venture capital, angel and friends-and-family money, grants, crowdfunding, incubators, and accelerators. The speakers emphasized choosing financing that fits the company’s stage, capital needs, dilution tolerance, and alignment with investor interests, and warned about risks such as strategic investors, convertible notes, and poor capitalization structure.

The Washington Supreme Court reversed dismissal of the Lapp marital community, holding that Colorado had the most significant relationship to the promissory note and that Colorado law allowed Pacific Gamble Robinson to reach property subject to Mr. Lapp’s debt, including his wages, despite the Lapps’ later move to Washington. A dissent argued Washington law should control the source of funds for payment and that the community should not be liable.

The court affirmed the circuit court’s judgment, stating that this case involved the same facts and principles as Century Realty Co. v. Frankfort Marine, Accident and Plate Glass Insurance Company, and was decided for the same reasons.

The passage introduces Flow Matching for Corrected Posterior Estimation (FMCPE), a method for improving simulation-based inference under model misspecification by using scarce calibration data and abundant simulations. It first learns a simulation-space transport map and then refines a simulation-based posterior with a second flow matching step, aiming to better approximate the true posterior. Experiments on two synthetic and two real-world tasks show FMCPE is more robust and accurate than NPE and MFNPE, especially with limited calibration data.

The passage describes the SD memory card physical layer, including card types by capacity, voltage ranges, bus speed modes, bus protocols, card states, initialization, read/write and erase operations, write protection, password locking, and COP features. It also outlines UHS-I and UHS-II modes, command sequences, and related register and response behavior.

The passage lists several news headlines and brief summaries about South Carolina politics, state archives funding, the State Ports Authority selling offices, Charleston as a Medicare test market for cardiac care, Mayor John Tecklenburg reflecting on his first year in office, and new state laws taking effect in 2017.

Apple announced a free battery replacement program for some 13-inch MacBook Pro models made between October 2016 and October 2017 that may have a component causing battery swelling. Owners can check eligibility on Apple’s support page using their laptop’s serial number.

A study by the Children’s Hospital Oakland Research Institute found that 173 women who usually drank less than a litre of water a day lost weight after adding half a litre of water to breakfast. The passage also says drinking water in the morning may support long-term weight loss and fat loss.

The passage argues that the Central powers used brutality and terror to intimidate neutrals, and that peace based on such methods would be unstable and harmful to international law. It says durable peace requires reducing causes of unrest, discrediting the Central powers’ aims and methods, and creating international sanctions, and claims this is why the country is making great sacrifices. It also notes Greece accepted the ultimatum conditions, and that the Persian government endorsed the President’s December 18, 1916 note and sought U.S. support for Persia’s integrity and rights at any peace conference.

The Yankees and Red Sox will meet in New York for a best-of-three 2025 AL Wild Card series starting Tuesday, Sept. 30. The series will air on ESPN, with Karl Ravech, David Cone, Eduardo Perez, and Buster Olney covering it. Boston is the No. 5 seed after trading Rafael Devers, and New York is the No. 4 seed despite having the AL’s second-best record. This is their sixth postseason matchup, with Boston leading 3-2.

Sell the rip is a strategy that sells an asset when it appears overvalued or overbought, often to take profits or open a short position. It is based on mean reversion and is most suitable for short-term trading, especially in weak stocks, while a backtest on SPY showed improved results with a stronger sell criterion.

Jacques Bailly, needing breaks during the expanded Scripps National Spelling Bee, was temporarily replaced by longtime associate pronouncer Rev. Brian Sietsema. More than 500 spellers competed in preliminaries, 41 reached the semifinals, and stories included a busy veteran speller, a reinstated contestant after a homonym issue, and a deliberate speller from Alaska.

The passage introduces DS-STAR, a data science agent that analyzes heterogeneous files, generates code through iterative planning and verification, and uses an LLM-based judge and router to refine plans. It reports improved results over baselines on DABStep, KramaBench, and DA-Code, and finds that the data file analyzer and router are important components.

The passage argues that AI and personalized learning require education systems to give students more autonomy, but the prescribed curriculum still dominates schools. Using panarchy theory, it explains that education systems are resilient and adaptive yet lack transformability, so real change should begin in small subsystems where students control more of their learning. It also provides examples of such programs, including ICEE in China and similar initiatives in Australia.

The speaker says the team’s defense has been strong all year, crediting top players plus Matt Irwin and Yannick Weber for handling tough minutes against teams with strong centermen. The speaker also reflects on learning from players and coaches, says the team has earned its place through hard work, and describes playoff hockey as serious business despite some enjoyment, with both teams hungry and prepared to win the Cup.

The device supports four legacy SPI-compatible protocols for configuration and read/write operations, defaulting to SPI-00-S after power-up or asynchronous reset. Protocol selection is set with SDI_MODE[1:0], and SPI-compatible reads require SDO_MODE[1:0] = 00b; dual SDO and source-synchronous SRC modes are also supported through SDO_CTL_REG. The passage also describes several configuration registers, including device ID, reset/power control, protocol control, data output, range selection, and alarm threshold registers. It further outlines application examples, power-supply and decoupling recommendations, low-power NAP and power-down modes, PCB layout guidance, and notes that ADS8685W and ADS8689W changed from Advance Information to Production Data.

Amazon.com, Inc. completed its acquisition of Whole Foods Market on August 28, 2017, through a merger in which Whole Foods Market became a wholly owned subsidiary. Whole Foods shares and certain equity awards were converted into cash consideration, and the aggregate value paid was approximately $13.55 billion. Amazon financed the acquisition with net proceeds from previously disclosed debt financing.

Martingale trading adds larger positions to losing trades in hopes of a reversal that recovers losses plus the initial profit. It is a high-risk, loss-averse strategy based on doubling after losses, and the passage says it can be dangerous in stocks because losses can grow or stocks can fall to zero.

A New York Times survey found that most responding federal judges were dissatisfied with the Supreme Court’s emergency docket decisions in Trump-related cases: only 12 of 65 said the Court used it appropriately, only 12 said lower courts received sufficient guidance, and only 2 of 54 said it improved public perception of the judiciary. Several judges criticized the orders, while the Times noted the survey may not represent the full judiciary and included a critique that respondents may have been biased toward disapproval.

The article examines whether dance education can be integrated with social studies education in U.S. schools. A survey of 91 dance educators found that several social studies concepts appear in dance curricula, especially people, places and environments and individual development and identity, while culture was often understood literally or implicitly. The study argues that formal testing and curriculum structures limit interdisciplinary education and suggests policy and curriculum changes.

Colorado’s Prescription Drug Affordability Board voted to cap what state health plans pay for Amgen’s Enbrel at $600 per unit, creating a payment ceiling for government agencies and commercial plans and potentially encouraging similar action in other states.
Turkey will extend its state of emergency by three more months from April 19, citing terror threats linked to FETO after the failed July 15, 2016 coup.

The Dolphins earned their first win of the season over the Jets, but Tyreek Hill suffered a feared dislocated left knee and was carted off for further evaluation. Darren Waller scored two touchdowns for Miami, while the Jets committed three turnovers and 12 penalties in a sloppy loss.

A new paper proposes searching for distant alien societies by detecting large swarms of artificial satellites around exoplanets during transits, rather than relying on synchronized signals like radio or lasers. This method could work with existing exoplanet data and might reveal long-gone civilizations.

China reduced the US dollar’s share in its trade-weighted foreign exchange basket from 26.4% to 22.4% and expanded the basket to 24 currencies from 2017, adding 11 currencies. The move was described as a technical adjustment amid the yuan’s decline against the dollar and ahead of Donald Trump’s presidency.

IMI plc has a consensus “Hold” rating from 18 research firms, with two sells, 12 holds, and four buys. The average 12-month target price is GBX 1,027.29, and recent reports included raised targets and ratings from BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, Barclays, Credit Suisse, and J P Morgan. The stock opened at 1216.00, with a market cap of GBX 3.29 billion and a 52-week range of GBX 751.00 to GBX 1,223.00.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 28, 2022, stating that it issued a press release on its third fiscal quarter 2022 financial results and attached the press release as Exhibit 99.1.

The passage lists major American foreign policy statements and addresses from January to December 1945 by Roosevelt, Truman, Stettinius, Byrnes, Grew, and Hull, covering topics such as the United Nations, the Yalta and San Francisco conferences, Germany’s surrender, Japan, atomic energy, and U.S. policy in China.

The passage explains Arnoldi and its symmetric case, which yields a tridiagonal matrix whose eigenvalues can approximate low eigenvalues of a large symmetric matrix. It then presents conjugate gradients for symmetric positive definite systems, describing its orthogonal residuals, conjugate search directions, low per-step cost, and interpretation as minimizing a quadratic energy. It contrasts this with steepest descent and briefly introduces minimum residual methods for nonsymmetric or indefinite problems, noting their greater cost and reliance on Arnoldi.

Police and Crimestoppers are warning about counterfeit banknotes during the festive shopping season, when fraudsters target busy shops and cash-handling businesses. More than 237,000 fake notes worth over £4.88 million were removed from UK streets in the first half of 2017, and Crimestoppers and the Bank of England have launched a Banknote Checking Scheme. People are asked to report information anonymously.

GSK will appoint chief commercial officer Luke Miels as CEO on Jan. 1, replacing Emma Walmsley. AstraZeneca plans to list its shares on the New York Stock Exchange while keeping its London listing, alongside its existing Stockholm listing.

The Department of Livestock and Veterinary Services is struggling to vaccinate cattle against Foot and Mouth Disease because vaccine supplies have been inconsistent for two years. Active infections are reported in Chipinge South, Mwenezi, Chivi and Chiredzi, and the virus has spread in several provinces. The department also faces weak staffing, poor logistics and funding, vandalism, movement of livestock across control zones, and loss of FMD control zones.

VentureWire’s September 19, 2000 issue reported Pseudo.com shutting down and laying off all 175 employees, Broadbase’s planned $645 million acquisition of Servicesoft, Enfrastructure’s launch with over $100 million, RightWorks naming Mary Coleman CEO, Interregnum launching a $105 million IT fund, and Q9 Networks raising $26.5 million in Series A funding. It also listed numerous financing rounds, product and company name changes, acquisitions, board appointments, executive hires, fund news, personnel moves, and corrections.

Cheltenham Town are again trying to keep Harry Pell, as another League Two club wants to sign the 26-year-old midfielder. Pell nearly joined Blackpool last summer, but the move collapsed over personal terms. He has been an influential player for Cheltenham since joining in 2015, making more than 120 starts and scoring three goals in his last five games.

UNL is investing in ag and environmental-studies facilities and research through targeted building upgrades, new centers, and interdisciplinary projects. Trails & Rails Museum opened its Family History Center to preserve artifacts and documents and expand exhibits. Lincoln Public Schools should preserve its small class sizes to support student success. Alliance’s Carhenge has become a major attraction, especially for the coming total eclipse.

Stone tools found at Attirampakkam in southeast India were dated to 385,000–172,000 years ago, suggesting human migration from Africa may have occurred much earlier than previously thought. No human remains were found, and researchers said the makers of the tools are unknown.

This cross-sectional study of 346 specimens from a Chennai tertiary care hospital found positive cultures in 76.3%, with Gram-negative bacteria dominating (75.4%). E. coli was the most common isolate, followed by Klebsiella spp. and Staphylococcus spp. High resistance was seen to cefoperazone/sulbactam, cefotaxime, cefuroxime, and polymyxin B, while amikacin and gentamicin showed higher sensitivity.

The passage describes a cloud-based industrial data services platform for registering industrial assets, selecting data service applications, collecting industrial data from gateway devices, and processing the data according to selected applications. It also describes basic information data types (BIDTs)—state, rate, odometer, and event—used by industrial devices and gateways to structure, model, discover, and present industrial data through hierarchical asset and plant models.

The study used synthetic thoracic aortic aneurysm simulations to compare neural network models trained on dilatation alone versus dilatation plus distensibility for identifying combined elastic fiber integrity and mechanosensing insults. Distensibility improved prediction accuracy for all models, and UNet performed best overall.

The passage reviews key legal issues for startups, especially intellectual property, business formation, employee equity, and financing. It explains trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, and patents; stresses ownership, timing, and disclosure rules; discusses university licensing at MIT; and outlines Delaware corporations, S-corp taxation, Section 83, vesting, stock compensation, securities law, and venture financing terms such as liquidation preference and anti-dilution protection.

The President approves a bill to regulate the counting of electoral votes and resolve disputes over the presidential election of 1877, saying it provides a constitutional, orderly way to prevent national unrest. He argues the measure is necessary because the election result is disputed, the country needs peace, and one candidate must lawfully be recognized as President.

The Sansa Fuze is a portable digital audio/video player with a 1.9-inch color screen, FM radio, built-in microphone, microSDHC expansion, rechargeable battery, and support for music, video, photos, voice recording, and audiobooks. The passage explains setup, charging, computer connection, file transfer, playback, settings, troubleshooting, support, warranty, and software license terms.

The passage compares Trump administration autism rhetoric to Soviet-era political interference in disability policy, arguing that rising autism diagnoses are better explained by changing diagnostic criteria, diagnostic substitution, and improved access to diagnosis than by a true epidemic. It also notes the Developmental Disabilities Act’s role in expanding services and criticizes proposed cuts to that law and Medicaid.

The paper examines whether digitalization affects sustainable development and whether cultural characteristics influence digitalization, using DESI for 28 EU countries. It finds significant positive correlations between digitalization and competitiveness, innovation, entrepreneurship, GDP, social sustainability measures, and SDGI, but a negative relationship with environmental wellbeing. Cultural results show higher digitalization in societies with lower power distance and uncertainty avoidance, and higher individualism and indulgence.

The Sixth Circuit affirmed the judgment, holding that the trial court did not err in instructing the jury about the inconsistency between interrogatory No. 4 and the general verdict, and that substantial evidence supported the verdict.

The Astros beat the White Sox 7-1 to complete a three-game sweep, extend their winning streak to six, and outscore Chicago 27-2 in the series. Jose Altuve drove in the go-ahead run in a five-run seventh inning, while Lance McCullers Jr. allowed one run over six innings. The White Sox lost their seventh straight game and 12th of 13.

COP cards support a COP Unlock command that enables CMD42 ver.2.0 mode; before unlock, CMD42 with COP bit set is ignored except for COP Unlock. FEP can be set or cleared with CMD42 using the current password, and setting or clearing FEP changes which erase and PWD operations are allowed. Incorrect passwords or unsupported COP functions set LOCK_UNLOCK_FAILED. The passage also describes CMD42 parameter rules, force erase and FEP force erase behavior, ACMD6 restrictions when locked, accepted commands in locked state, and CMD6 switch-function modes for checking or setting card functions.

Toronto’s hot housing market has driven many owners to cash out and move to cheaper areas, with some realizing large profits, though agents say the market may be cooling and future gains are uncertain. Similar price spikes and shifting buyer interest are reported in Burlington, Nova Scotia, and Vancouver, where sellers are reacting to changing conditions and policies.

A fire at Scope Hospital in Lucknow’s Vrindavan area caused panic early Monday, but no injuries were reported. More than 50 patients and attendants escaped, over two dozen ICU patients were moved to nearby private hospitals, and authorities ordered a probe into fire safety measures.

Defending champions India will face Bangladesh in the Champions Trophy second semi-final at Edgbaston on 15 June, with India aiming to dominate under Virat Kohli and Bangladesh hoping to challenge with their pace and spin attack. The match will be shown live on Star Sports Network and streamed on Hotstar from 3 PM IST.

LeBron James is a billionaire NBA star who has hinted at retirement but has not announced it. He has earned hundreds of millions from NBA salaries and endorsements, especially Nike, and has invested in businesses, sports teams, media companies, and real estate. He also spends on luxury cars, homes, family gifts, and health and training care, while supporting charitable projects like the I Promise School.

The passage compares the 2018 Baku NAM Declaration and CHOGM Communiqué, arguing that both criticize protectionism and support South-South cooperation, but do not address deeper global economic inequalities. It also notes their strong statements on Palestine, intolerance, refugees, and the Rohingya crisis, while criticizing India’s responses on these issues and questioning the relevance of non-alignment and policy autonomy today.

The Federal Circuit reversed the district court, holding that Melchior’s asserted patent claims were invalid: claim 22 of the ’017 patent was anticipated by Danckert, and the remaining ’506 and ’254 patent claims were obvious over Danckert in view of Shirai. A concurring judge agreed there was no liability, but on the ground that infringement was not supported by substantial evidence.

The passage says digital technology use in Norwegian PE and PETE is limited, but digital competence is part of the curriculum and may improve learning and motivation. It then describes a study of 22 Norwegian PETE students who experienced flipped learning in two units. Students generally viewed it positively, reporting better preparation, deeper learning, a more supportive environment, and increased motivation, though some missed immediate teacher interaction, had technical problems, or found it time consuming.

St. Jude researchers identified kinases Mst1 and Mst2 as hidden regulators of dendritic cell function and T cell production. Using the NetBID systems biology algorithm, they found Mst1/2 and Hippo signaling control distinct dendritic cell subsets, metabolic activity, and cytokine signaling, including IL-12 production, with implications for cancer and immune disorder treatment.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 27, 2021, stating that it issued a press release on that date regarding financial results for its first fiscal quarter ended December 26, 2020. The filing lists Apple’s registered securities and includes the press release as an exhibit.

A Roman pottery fragment found on Chapel St Leonards beach may indicate a lost Roman settlement nearby, adding to earlier finds there of a Roman coin and brooch. Experts say the pottery likely eroded from a Roman site under the sand, and Lincolnshire County Council is asking people to report coastal artefacts.

The Alabama Supreme Court held that an insurance policy provision limiting “insured” to employees acting within the scope of duties does not conflict with a separate provision covering “violations of constitutional/civil rights.” It concluded the policy was neither ambiguous nor illusory and answered the certified question in the negative.

The study examined Tomsk COVID-19 hospitalizations from January 1 to March 31, 2022, and found that drops in outdoor temperature of more than 3°C were associated with increased hospitalizations after a 1–2 day lag. It proposed a “compromised airway epithelium” mechanism and concluded that short-term cold exposure may worsen COVID-19 symptoms and severity.

Peter Joseph Saville, a Worthing dentist who served the community for more than four decades, died peacefully at home on June 27 aged 90. His family paid tribute to his kindness, faith, sporting life, and service to local organisations and charities. He is survived by his wife Josephine, six children and eight grandchildren, and his funeral mass is scheduled for July 12.

Minor league baseball’s first full week featured Mike Soroka as top performer, going 2-0 with a 0.77 ERA and 11 2/3 innings for Double-A Atlanta. Other highlights included Kyle Tucker’s seven-RBI game, Jose Medina’s three-homer game, strong pitching by Dane Dunning and Josh Staumont, combined pitching feats by Visalia and Kane County, notable defensive plays, category leaders Ian Happ, Jorge Mateo, and Mike Clevinger, and Phillip Wellman’s 1,000th managerial win.

The attack often ends with a cross or shot, and coaches are advised to vary overlap and underlap runs depending on effectiveness.

In mice, loss of ACOX2 reduced cold tolerance and insulin sensitivity and increased weight gain, while higher ACOX2 improved heat production, weight control, and metabolic health.
