He says investors care about why a business matters, why now, why this team, and why it will work. Using examples from failed and successful product launches, he emphasizes identifying the real customer, understanding what they want, focusing on benefits, and using customer feedback to iterate and build demand.

The passage claims planetary positions indicate strong astrological support for housing finance and liquor sectors, and says financial astrology can identify outperforming sectors and stocks. It also promotes early subscription to “Sectors of Samvat 2074” and cites past predictions, including strong gains in dyes/chemical/sugar stocks during Samvat 2073.

Baidu is incorporating NVIDIA Tesla P40 GPUs and NVIDIA deep learning software into its new cloud. The Tesla P40 is described as a high-throughput inference GPU, and Baidu says the partnership supports its autonomous driving unit, which is developing Level 4 technologies and aims to commercialize autonomous driving by 2018 and mass production by 2020.

The American Indian College Fund announced a two-year, $600,000 study with Strada Education Network to assess the economic, social, and graduate outcomes of five tribal colleges in North Dakota, including graduate employment, a Gallup survey of 5,000 scholars, and a pilot study on language and culture preservation. The results will be published in September 2019 and shared with policymakers.

The paper develops an ACE machine-learning potential for YBCO that matches DFT results for the equation of state, lattice parameters, and oxygen Frenkel-pair energetics, and reproduces the orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition in long NPT simulations. The transition is described as an entropy-driven order-disorder process in the basal oxygen sublattice, involving migration of O atoms from CuO chains and apical sites to O5 interstitial positions, with reduced Frenkel-pair formation energy at expanded lattices.

The passage reviews how AI can support inclusive education by personalizing learning, improving feedback, aiding assistive technologies, and helping educators address diverse student needs, while also noting limitations such as bias, cost, overreliance, and reduced human interaction. It concludes that AI can enhance inclusion but must be implemented alongside inclusive practices, educator involvement, and supportive policies.

The lecture contrasts ion traps with neutral-atom traps, noting ions can be confined strongly by electric fields and are used for clocks, quantum information, and quantum simulation. It explains that ions require dynamic trapping, especially RF/Paul traps, where rapid switching creates an effective confining potential through micromotion, and describes the Cirac-Zoller ion quantum gate using center-of-mass motion as a data bus.

National Eat at a Black Coffee Shop Day, organized by The Black Star Project, will encourage customers to visit Black-owned coffee shops on May 29, 2018, while Starbucks closes U.S. stores for diversity training. The campaign aims to increase Black consumer spending within Black communities, and more than 400 Black coffee shops and tea houses are expected to participate.

Cadillac sold 35,020 vehicles globally in September 2017, extending its growth streak to 16 months. Year-to-date sales reached 256,613 units, up 20.9 percent from 2016, with strong gains in China and modest U.S. growth. The XT5 led sales, while ATS and CT6 also increased.

NVIDIA’s Board amended and restated its bylaws on November 29, 2016 to implement proxy access and revise advance notice provisions for stockholder proposals and director nominations. The new bylaws allow qualifying stockholders or groups owning at least 3% for three years to include director nominees in proxy materials, with nominees limited to the greater of two directors or 20% of the Board.

This study of 2,284 Black and White adults aged 55+ found that blood pressure status was associated with cognitive decline differently by race. There were no racial differences among participants with normal blood pressure, but White adults with high or variable blood pressure showed faster decline than Black adults in several cognitive domains, especially with variable blood pressure.

The passage is a collection of repeated financial and business headlines, with a detailed item on AMD rising after announcing a multiyear AI chip supply deal with OpenAI. It also mentions various topics including bank acquisitions, IPO activity, Tesla, oil prices, and infrastructure and tech developments.

Judges are sanctioning attorneys for AI-generated citation errors in legal briefs. In Puerto Rico, several firms will share $24,492 in fees after defective citations, while in California a lawyer was fined $10,000, paid to the court, after filing fake quotes and off-topic cases generated by AI; the court declined to award fees to opposing counsel because they did not detect the errors.

The speaker mourns Franklin D. Roosevelt, vows to continue the war until unconditional surrender, and calls for national unity. He also urges support for a strong United Nations, lasting peace based on law and justice, and a continued effort to improve America and help lead the world to peace and prosperity.

The passage introduces a Bayesian interpretation of dynamic mode decomposition using Gaussian process regression and reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. It aims to improve extended DMD by handling noisy nonlinear data, enabling hyperparameter optimization, sparse dictionary learning, and uncertainty-aware multi-step predictions while reducing computational cost.

BMW, Audi, Volkswagen and Volvo have discontinued several manual models in South Africa, including Audi’s A4 1,4T FSI, BMW’s 120i, M140i and some 2 Series variants, Volkswagen’s Polo GTI, Scirocco 2,0TSI Highline and Jetta 1,6TDI, and Volvo’s S60 T3 Kinetic. The passage says the move is due to low demand, while Porsche and Jaguar SA still offer manual models.

The passage says the Belgium Government would facilitate active development work in the Congo if needed, with no restrictions, and that negotiations were being prepared on Congo supplies and civilian consumption requirements. It also states that Belgium and British authorities were told to send reciprocal supply data to the Department of State and relevant boards in Washington, that Congo export duties had recently been increased, and that signing of the tripartite Belgian agreement was postponed but made retroactive to the expiration date of the existing Anglo-Belgian agreement.

Ahead of Stranger Things season 3, cast salaries reportedly increased into three tiers: Winona Ryder and David Harbour at $350,000 per episode, Finn Wolfhard, Gaten Matarazzo, Caleb McLaughlin, and Noah Schnapp at $250,000, and Natalia Dyer, Joe Keery, and Charlie Heaton at $150,000. Millie Bobby Brown was not included, as her deal was reportedly negotiated separately.

A University of Birmingham academic and Birmingham City Council said flooding in Birmingham was caused by extreme rainfall overwhelming drains, not by blocked drainage. The Met Office issued a yellow warning for Birmingham and the West Midlands, with more thunderstorms and possible flooding expected on Thursday.

The article describes a simple monthly ETF rotation strategy among SPY, TLT, and EEM, choosing the best-performing ETF from the prior month. A backtest over two decades showed it outperformed buy and hold with lower drawdowns until 2022, when performance weakened; since inception CAGR was 11% and the 2022 drawdown reached 41%.

Charlie Javice, founder of Frank, was sentenced to just over seven years in prison for defrauding JPMorgan Chase by overstating the startup’s customer base. A jury found her and Olivier Amar guilty of fraud and conspiracy, and she was also ordered to pay restitution and forfeiture while remaining free on bail during her appeal.

A crack shut down the North Sea Forties Pipeline System, with Ineos saying repairs could take weeks. The outage pushed Brent crude above $64.50 a barrel, raised concerns about North Sea supply, and could have broader effects on oil markets worldwide.

The passage discusses market declines and possible consolidation after recent S&P 500 losses, higher volatility, and a rebound expected at Monday’s open. It also notes improved investor sentiment, crude oil falling after OPEC+ output hikes, and upcoming earnings from Palantir and AMD, while warning that defensive positioning may become more important.

The passage describes repeat competitors at the Scripps National Spelling Bee, including Erin Howard, Cameron Keith, and Naysa Modi, all of whom have spent years preparing through long hours of study. Erin is better prepared for trademarked words after missing “Klydonograph” last year, Cameron is calmer in competition after tying for 18th in 2016, and Naysa qualified for the final round after spelling “stabilizer” correctly.

The passage says Trump plans to impose a 100% tariff on China starting November 1, which helped send US stock indexes lower. It also says the economy is showing signs of slowing, with July jobs data missing expectations, while Q2 earnings have been strong and S&P 500 earnings growth has risen to 11.2%.

Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) is an AMD feature for non-persistent runtime firmware updates without BIOS reflashing or system reset. It applies only to selected AMD firmware components, uses signed update packages, can optionally be customer co-signed, and requires a customer SFS Deployment Agent and early-boot key setup. SFS tracks patch levels, supports version checks and sequential package application, and includes security, attestation, and resiliency requirements.

Most Southeast Asian stock markets fell on Thursday as investors worried that the Federal Reserve may begin reducing stimulus, raising the risk of capital outflows. Indonesia closed at a record high, while Philippine shares fell and Vietnam and Thailand were closed for holidays.

The passage reviews distance education and artificial intelligence in education, especially during Covid-19, and discusses AI-supported, face-to-face, and simulation-based learning. It notes possible benefits such as efficiency, personalization, and rich learning environments, but also concerns about privacy, isolation, unemployment, and human control.

Marco Gonzales pitched 6 2/3 scoreless innings, and the Mariners beat the Rangers 2-1 for their ninth win in 10 games. Seattle, which has 16 one-run wins and reached 13 games above .500, scored both runs in the sixth inning after a Rangers defensive miscue.

FCA data from the 2017 Financial Lives Survey shows many pension providers are not asking customers about their access choices, with up to 70% of respondents saying they had not been asked. Most respondents had also not received advice from a provider adviser, and many who avoided advice said they could decide for themselves or could not afford fees.

Taxify will launch in Sydney from Tuesday with half-priced fares for one month, offering a 15% commission and entering the Australian market for the first time. The company says it has over 4,000 registered drivers, operates in 20 countries, and is backed by Didi Chuxing.

El texto describe el neuromarketing audiovisual como una aplicación de técnicas de neurociencia al marketing para mejorar la efectividad y el ROI. En España, su uso es incipiente y se concentra sobre todo en Atresmedia y Mediaset, con barreras como el desconocimiento, la desconfianza, el precio y la dificultad de interpretar datos. Las entrevistas concluyen que los equipos deben ser multidisciplinares, que las productoras muestran interés pero poca inversión, y que la evolución futura se considera positiva.

The passage argues that improving school air quality can raise test scores, attendance, and health. It cites studies and examples showing benefits from air filters, ventilation, and mold removal, and says these interventions may be highly cost-effective, easy to implement, and especially helpful for low-income students.

State officials broke ground on the Mauka Concourse at Daniel K. Inouye International Airport, part of a $1.3 billion modernization project. The $220 million concourse is expected to add gate capacity, larger aircraft access, and 260,000 square feet of new space, with completion planned for the end of 2020.

The passage describes an Index Markets Research report on the global Plastic Granules market, covering market size, trends, segmentation, regional analysis, key players, applications, product types, costs, and forecasts, along with SWOT and investment analyses.

Research in Nature Climate Change says climate change and extreme weather are causing sudden, often irreversible ecosystem collapses across Australia, including kelp forest loss, mangrove dieback, forest destruction and species declines. The authors warn that many seemingly healthy ecosystems are at a tipping point and may require costly intervention.

In a retrospective cohort of 99,935 adults aged 50+ from the All of Us dataset, machine learning models predicted healthy aging from SDOH, with XGBoost performing best (AUROC 0.793) and showing predictive parity across race and sex. Health insurance type was the most important predictor, followed by employment status, substance use, and insurance coverage.

The Bengals will start Joe Flacco at quarterback against the Packers after trading for him from the Browns. Coach Zac Taylor said Jake Browning will move back to backup, and Cincinnati hopes Flacco can help end its three-game losing streak while Joe Burrow remains on injured reserve.

Iamgold Corp (NYSE:IAG) is projected by analysts to reach $7.65 over the next 52 weeks, based on 13 opinions, with targets ranging from $6.25 to $9.05 versus a latest closing price of $4.9. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 2 from 9 recommendations, with 3 Buy, 6 Outperform, 6 Hold, 2 Underperform, and 0 Sell ratings. Its ATR-14 is 0.2, weekly volatility is 3.09%, monthly volatility is 3.60%, and RSI is 30.76. The company has a market capitalization of $2.29 billion, 468.31 million outstanding shares, and 7.92 million shares traded in the previous session versus an average of 4.66 million.

On October 22, 2001, multiple reports said Enron shares fell about 20% after the SEC requested information on related-party transactions involving partnerships run by CFO Andrew Fastow. A shareholder also filed a derivative suit, and a class action was filed alleging securities fraud and losses from concealed partnership dealings.

The study uses one year of telematics data from 10,441 private users in Asti, Italy to simulate ICE-to-BEV transition under four charging policies and four BEV models. Results show that current BEV technology fits only part of the population: overnight or low-SoC fast charging performs best, and with the largest battery vehicle 72% of users can complete all trips, while even the best scenario does not suit 5% of users.

IES Holdings has outperformed infrastructure and Russell 2000 stocks, with its share price nearly doubling year to date. Despite a weak residential division, data center projects are driving growth in other divisions, backlog has topped $2 billion and is rising 20% year over year, and cash flow and cash balances are strong. However, the stock is considered overextended, with a weak FCF yield and higher insider sales.

Kevin Deery said Institute’s third straight draw against Larne was frustrating and that his team had done enough to win but were lacking luck and making poor decisions in both boxes. He noted missed chances, two own goals in recent matches, and said the team remains in the top six with 13 games left.

The passage lists several ACC Tournament-related headlines, including Virginia’s championship win over North Carolina at Barclays Center, Duke-North Carolina and Virginia tournament games, and other notes about Duke, North Carolina, Clemson, and the venue’s future with the ACC Tournament.

Sarah Palmer circulated a roundup of Feb. 6, 2002 Enron-related news and articles, mostly about congressional hearings, subpoenas, Jeffrey Skilling and Kenneth Lay testimony, William Powers’ findings on Enron partnerships, Arthur Andersen’s role, Fastow, bankruptcy financing, back taxes, and the Astros’ fight over Enron Field naming rights.

The Maui News reported that former councilmember and mayoral candidate Mike Victorino was driving in an April 13 collision on West Papa Avenue that injured two teenage boys, who suffered nonlife-threatening injuries. Victorino and police said he was not speeding or under the influence, and he said he was devastated and hoped for their recovery. The report also noted conflicting accounts about whether the teens were in a crosswalk.

Linebackers are key defensive players who line up behind the defensive line, help organize the defense, and stop both the run and pass. The passage says they need toughness, athleticism, intelligence, and skills like tackling, block shedding, and coverage ability, and notes that versatile linebackers remain valuable despite changes in NFL offenses.

The loonie has risen as markets bet on stronger Canadian economic data and possible Bank of Canada rate hikes, despite the bank’s desire to keep the currency lower for exporters. It recently reached nearly 75.50 U.S. cents, after earlier falling to 72.73 cents this year, with oil prices and the Canada-U.S. interest rate gap also affecting its movement.

At the first two on-campus football games, attendance was 37,583 and 27,038. CSU officials said tailgating awareness and lot use need improvement, while parking, transit, and traffic generally went well, with 50 cars towed each game weekend and transit use exceeding predictions.

The study tested role-taking and literacy interventions to reduce demographic and appearance-based bias in social engineering decisions. In an online experiment with Arab participants, neither intervention significantly changed trust or risk-taking responses, but issue involvement decreased after intervention. Participants generally found the intervention engaging, and the authors conclude that deeper, longer-term approaches may be needed to change entrenched biases.

The Michigan Court of Appeals affirmed a divorce judgment giving the father physical custody of the two older children and the mother custody of the two younger children. The court held that, although siblings are usually kept together, the best interests of each child control and the trial court did not abuse its discretion in separating the children.

The Great Southern Storm have named a 45-player initial colts squad for next month’s Great Southern Colts Carnival in Kulin under new coach Glynn Verbruggen, replacing Phil Gilbert. The squad will train twice before final selection, includes State 16 players Heath Spinks and Jacob Blight, and has strong representation from North Albany, Railways, Albany and Royals.

A district and sessions judge in Zhob sentenced four convicts in separate murder cases: Shehzado received the death penalty and a Rs. 200,000 fine, Ajab Khan and Fateh Khan each got 25 years in prison and a Rs. 200,000 fine, and Dilbar Khan received 25 years in prison and a Rs. 105,000 fine.

Allen Iverson discussed his sobriety and said his lowest point came during his divorce from Tawanna Turner, which he described as self-inflicted. He said alcohol was a major problem, reflected on rebuilding his marriage, and noted that he sees young NBA players looking up to him.

The passage argues that Germany seeks to organize Central Europe for its own foreign policy by controlling the Poles, Czechs, South Slavs, and Bulgaria, and that U.S. policy should oppose the control of Middle Europe rather than economic unification itself. It identifies the main ties binding Vienna, Budapest, Sofia, Constantinople, and Berlin, then says the chief American asset is economic exclusion of Germany, especially after peace, and that in Austria-Hungary nationalist discontent should be stirred up while avoiding dismemberment of the empire.

Texas’s new law replacing STAAR with three tests a year is intended to reduce pressure, but parents, teachers and administrators worry it will increase stress and testing time. Critics say accountability ratings will still depend heavily on the end-of-year test, and many want more teacher input and fewer testing-day restrictions.

The passage introduces LAPIS, an MLIR-based compiler framework that aims to combine performance, portability, and productivity for computational science and AI/ML. LAPIS adds a custom Kokkos dialect, lowering passes, a portable memory model, and a C++ emitter to translate Python/MLIR and CSE code into Kokkos-based C++ for multiple CPU and GPU architectures, demonstrating portable linear algebra and SciML/ML use cases.

The paper studies pseudorandom unitaries in the quantum Haar random oracle model and proves that strong pseudorandom unitaries exist there. It gives a simple two-query construction using a Haar-random oracle and short random keys, and analyzes it via path-recording isometries, an approximate merge isometry S, and a sequence of hybrids to show indistinguishability from two independent Haar unitaries.

Chipotle’s new queso, released on Sept. 12, has drawn complaints about its $2.95 price and taste, with many customers criticizing it on Twitter. Chipotle said it will not lower the price because the queso uses real, whole ingredients and costs more to make.

The State Bar of Michigan e-Journal for May 23, 2001 listed case summaries in bankruptcy, civil rights, criminal law, employment and labor, family law, insurance, litigation, municipal, negligence, and real property, plus classified ads, fields of practice listings, and bar notices.

Energy Central’s forum asked whether natural gas policy should encourage more exploration on federal lands and the continental shelf. The message also included prior responses on California electricity price spikes, with commenters divided between blaming market manipulation, regulation, supply shortages, and opposing price caps or re-regulation.

CEMEX grew from a small Mexican cement company into a global building materials leader through acquisitions and a formal post-merger integration process called the CEMEX Way, which standardized practices while learning from acquired firms. Key milestones included expansion into Spain in 1992, acquisitions in Latin America and Asia in the 1990s, Southdown in 2000, RMC in 2005, and Rinker in 2007. The company used technology, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement to integrate acquisitions and expand internationally.

Paul Clement is set to become Swansea manager after Bayern Munich allowed him to speak to the club. Swansea, who sacked Bob Bradley after a 4-1 loss to West Ham, hope to complete a deal through 2019 and give Clement a £30million transfer budget. The club are 19th in the Premier League, while Neil Taylor said the players would support Clement if he gets the job.

The 1956 Hungarian revolt was a nationwide uprising against Communist rule, driven by discontent, economic failure, and encouragement from events in Poland and Soviet de-Stalinization. After initial Soviet withdrawals and assurances, the USSR invaded with overwhelming force in November, crushing resistance by the end of the month and killing about 25,000 Hungarians and 7,000 Soviet soldiers.

A federal judge dismissed Drake’s defamation lawsuit over Kendrick Lamar’s 2024 song “Not Like Us,” saying a reasonable listener would view the “certified pedophile” lyric as hyperbolic, nonactionable opinion in a heated rap battle. The judge also dismissed claims against Universal Music Group, and Drake plans to appeal.

Springfield police officer Conrad Lariviere faces disciplinary action after posting “Hahahaha love this” on Facebook about a car striking a counter-protester at the Charlottesville white supremacist rally. He apologized and said he is not racist, while Springfield officials opened an internal investigation and condemned the comment.

DAWN-PLASMA was a randomized, open-label, phase 2 multicenter trial in hospitalized adult COVID-19 patients comparing standard of care alone versus standard of care plus high-titer convalescent plasma (2:1 allocation). The primary endpoint was the percentage alive without mechanical ventilation at Day 15; six patients withdrew or screened failed before intervention and were replaced, and no patients were lost to follow-up after intervention.

Williams & Connolly said hackers accessed a small number of attorney email accounts through a zero-day attack, but it found no evidence of client data theft or further access to its IT system and said the threat has been blocked.

The passage describes digital video output pins and their functions in different modes: one set carries the 8 MSBs of green/Y/YC data, another carries the 8 MSBs of blue/Cb/C data, and another carries the 8 MSBs of red/Cr data. It also defines pin-state abbreviations and notes internal pullup/pulldown defaults after reset.

Maryland’s Coppin State University says its Expand Eagle Nation program, which offers in-state tuition to students from states and territories without an HBCU, has sharply increased out-of-state enrollment and overall enrollment. The university is also expanding housing and recruitment efforts to support the growth.

The TPS7H500x-SP controllers use an EN pin, internal 1.23-V reference, transconductance error amplifier, programmable output voltage, soft start, selectable switching-frequency modes, primary and synchronous rectifier outputs, programmable dead time and leading-edge blank time, pulse skipping, duty-cycle control, current-sense PWM generation, hiccup and fault protection, slope compensation, and thermal shutdown. They operate in fixed-frequency peak current mode for space-grade DC-DC converter designs and require careful layout and external components for stable operation.

The passage describes a Democratic change in government and argues it reflects a national reexamination of society. It praises the nation’s greatness but says wealth and progress have brought waste, injustice, and misuse of government. It calls for restoration through economic, industrial, agricultural, and social reform, and ends as a dedication to justice and public duty.

Indianapolis Public Schools is opening public discussion on a proposal to close three high schools by the 2018-2019 school year. A taskforce report says district enrollment has steadily declined since the 1970s, leaving all seven high schools under capacity, and the administration will likely identify schools for closure by June before a September board vote.

The passage introduces LG-CD, a language-guided remote sensing change detection model that combines SAM2 visual features with CLIP text features. It uses adapters, a text fusion attention module, and a visual-semantic fusion decoder to improve change detection accuracy, robustness, and generalization.

The White House said it was not defending Roseanne Barr’s racist tweet, but Trump and Sarah Sanders said ABC owed Trump an apology for derogatory comments about him. Sanders argued the issue showed media hypocrisy and listed examples of negative remarks about Trump from media figures, while saying Trump was focused on other matters.

Kyle Shanahan said practice was good, with both offense and defense battling evenly, though the team still has work to do. He also said his father provides helpful football feedback, he plans to rest during a few weeks off, and play-action is an important part of his offense because it stresses defenses and creates easier explosive plays.

The lecture covered post-flop poker strategy, including continuation betting, value betting versus bluffing, when to check, call, raise, or fold on different flops, and the effects of position and stack size. It also explained implied odds, reverse implied odds, set mining, leading into preflop raisers, and bluffing with draws, ending with two “bluffing epiphanies” about outs and what hands your play represents.

The email forwards multiple news articles about California’s energy crisis, including legislative efforts to rescue Southern California Edison, PG&E’s lawsuit over seized power contracts, consumer criticism of utility rescue plans, state power purchases and sales, and local energy conservation projects.

Cervical cancer is a malignant disease of the cervix, caused in almost all cases by sexually transmitted HPV, especially types 16 and 18. It may start without symptoms, then cause post-coital bleeding, foul-smelling discharge, abnormal bleeding, and later weight loss, pain, and organ involvement. Pap smears and tissue biopsy confirm diagnosis; early-stage disease can be cured, while late-stage disease is usually only managed, and prevention through screening and HPV vaccination is emphasized.

A federal judge ruled that Nirvana’s 1991 album cover showing a naked baby underwater is not pornography and dismissed Spencer Elden’s lawsuit over the image. The judge said the picture was most like a family photo of a nude child bathing and not lascivious.

The passage introduces the importance of accurately estimating polynomial functionals of an m-qubit state, especially purity and higher-order moments, which are used in quantum information science, statistical mechanics, many-body physics, entanglement and coherence measures, and randomness certification.

The coach said his team is better than in the first two games and must prove it, with improvements needed in faceoffs, puck possession, forechecking, and discipline. He said the team will adjust for Anaheim’s style, expects a strong home crowd, and plans to use the fourth line more. He also said Chris Neil had the day off because his wife is having a baby.

The passage argues that AI is increasingly present in education, especially higher education, and can support personalized learning, research, and administration. It also identifies major challenges, including equity, ethics, training, costs, and policy issues, and calls for AI literacy, participatory implementation, and changes in teacher roles.

The speaker says they were surprised and grateful to be put back in the lineup after two weeks, and tried to do their part to help the team win. They describe winning three cups in nine years as special, credit the team’s hard work and additions like Madden and Marshall, and praise coach Pat for keeping the team focused and preventing complacency.

An analysis of campaign contributions by lawyers and staff at BigLaw and larger plaintiffs-side firms found that 92.45% of contributions in 2023 and 2024 went to Democrats, up from a 6-1 Democratic-to-Republican ratio in 2017-2020. The studied firms gave about $52 million to Democratic-affiliated groups and about $4 million to Republican-affiliated groups. Among top-grossing firms, Cleary Gottlieb, Fried Frank, and Mintz Levin had the highest share of Democratic contributions, while Nelson Mullins, Lewis Brisbois, and Ogletree Deakins had the lowest.

The lecture reviews discrete symmetries in quantum mechanics and field theory, explaining that time reversal is anti-unitary and introducing parity, time reversal, and charge conjugation for complex scalar and Dirac fields. It derives how these symmetries act on fields and creation/annihilation operators, then introduces Grassmann variables and the basic rules of fermionic path integration, including their anti-commuting calculus and integration conventions.

U.S. stock index futures rose on Thursday as earnings season started strongly and oil prices rebounded, though tensions with North Korea and the upcoming French election limited risk-taking. Most S&P 500 companies reporting so far have beaten expectations, with first-quarter profits estimated to have risen 10.8 percent. Qualcomm rose after beating estimates, while eBay fell on a weak profit forecast.

The passage describes a system, device, and method for synchronizing a rotating LIDAR sensor with one or more cameras or image sensors. The cameras are arranged so their sensing rows align with the LIDAR’s axis of rotation, and the controller obtains image pixel rows in an order and timing based on the LIDAR’s rotation and emitted light beams. This synchronization is used to better match camera data with LIDAR reflections for combined representations such as 3D point clouds.

Quantbot Technologies LP increased its Zoe’s Kitchen stake by 114.5% in the second quarter to 17,056 shares. The company reported quarterly EPS of $0.06 on revenue of $74.30 million, and analysts have a consensus Hold rating with a $17.55 target price.

The appellate court affirmed both judgments convicting Bradford Washington of murder and related offenses, rejecting his claims about detective testimony, the consciousness-of-guilt charge, and the prosecutor’s summation, and affirming the second conviction as well.

Darren Osborne was sentenced to life in prison with a minimum term of 43 years for driving a van into worshippers outside Finsbury Park mosque in London, killing Makram Ali and injuring nine others. He was found guilty of murder and attempted murder, and the victims’ family said they were pleased with the verdict.

Several hedge funds reduced healthcare holdings in the second quarter as healthcare stocks outperformed the broader market and Republican healthcare repeal efforts stalled. Jana Partners exited nine healthcare stocks, and Third Point cut stakes in Humana and Baxter. Hedge funds also sold energy stocks, including full exits by Third Point, Jana Partners, and Omega Advisors.

Facebook is adding a “Trending News” section to its iOS and Android app under the Explore tab, aggregating stories from multiple sources and ranking them by how many publications share them. Users can open a story to view headlines, videos, photos, and top Facebook posts, as part of a redesign first announced in May.

The passage describes electronic smoking devices using a coil-less atomizer with one or more woven fiber tubes that both heat liquid and wick it by capillary action. The tubes can be conductive, shaped in various forms, connected by leads or electrical contacts, and used with different liquid supply configurations to vaporize liquid into aerosol.

The court denied Fincke’s motion for reconsideration, found that only Zimmel’s October and November 2002 stock purchases were made by means of the false Business Plan statement, and entered judgment for Zimmel for $1.5 million plus interest and costs, and for Access for $281,534.62 plus interest and costs.

The BIRDS workshop aims to bridge digital library practitioners and computational researchers through an interactive, full-day event with keynote, scientific speed-dating, panel, and breakout discussions. Its goals are to foster collaboration, identify shared challenges, explore computational solutions, and produce a SIGIR Forum report, with plans to continue the workshop series at future digital library conferences.

The Ohio Supreme Court upheld R.C. 3105.03’s one-year residency requirement for divorce, ruling it does not penalize interstate travel and serves the state’s compelling interest in regulating marriage and divorce.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K stating that on August 17, 2022, its Compensation Committee approved an Executive Cash Incentive Plan and its Board approved amended and restated bylaws, both effective that day. The bylaw changes updated shareholder meeting, nomination, proxy, special meeting, written consent, and emergency procedures.

The passage argues that Oliver Stone’s Wall Street remains the most enduring film about finance because it blends a rags-to-riches story, 1980s excess, and Michael Douglas’s iconic Gordon Gekko performance, making it a memorable cautionary tale and cultural time capsule.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed its 2016 Form 10-K, reporting net sales of $135.987 billion, operating income of $4.186 billion, and net income of $2.371 billion. The company operates in North America, International, and AWS segments, faces intense competition and numerous operational, legal, tax, and foreign exchange risks, and employed about 341,400 workers as of December 31, 2016.
A modified Google Camera app can enable HDR+ on Android phones with Snapdragon 820, 821, or 835 processors, potentially improving photos in high-contrast scenes.

Kennedy’s memoir emphasizes judicial humility, rejects strict originalism and pragmatism, and discusses controversial cases including Citizens United, same-sex marriage, Bush v. Gore, flag burning, abortion, and his role as the Court’s “swing justice.” He also writes about Scalia’s dissent, his meeting with Putin, opposition to cameras in the courtroom, and personal events involving the Manson case and his family.

The paper studies diurnal temperature-driven phase drift in the Simons Observatory LAT SMuRF readout system. Off-resonance tones show temperature-correlated delays of only a few picoseconds over one day-night cycle, and the inferred signal contamination is small, within the readout noise budget and unlikely to affect mapping speed.

Tesla’s 2022 Form 10-K says it designs, manufactures, sells, and leases electric vehicles and energy generation and storage products, operating in automotive and energy generation/storage segments. It reports key risks including supply chain disruptions, production ramp delays, competition, product defects, financing and credit risks, regulatory challenges, dependence on Elon Musk, and cybersecurity threats.

Evelyn Montiel, raised in East Oakland, helped run her family’s ice cream and fruit business while excelling in school. Students Rising Above supported her through college, internships, and a later job interview, leading to her current career as a broker at a Silicon Valley startup.

NVIDIA’s FY2017 10-K says it designs GPU and Tegra-based platforms for gaming, professional visualization, datacenter, and automotive markets, with revenue supported by partner channels and global operations. It reports risks related to competition, manufacturing dependence, cybersecurity, product defects, supply chain, customer concentration, international operations, legal and regulatory matters, debt, and stock dilution, and notes its Santa Clara headquarters, cash and dividend/share repurchase programs, and key executive officers.

VentureWire’s September 26, 2000 issue reports major private-company news, including Chiaro Networks’ $100 million third round, Bertelsmann and iSyndicate’s European joint venture, Novalux’s $109 million financing, Miadora’s shutdown, Sun Microsystems’ $50 million Asian investment program, and Mayfield Fund’s new marketing partner. It also lists numerous funding deals, product launches, mergers, board and management appointments, venture fund news, and corrections.

The passage reports that Enron was struggling to find sellers for near-term gas and power, while several news items said Dynegy was in talks to renegotiate their merger, possibly cutting the deal price by more than 40%. Enron’s shares fluctuated but remained depressed, investors were skeptical, Moody’s kept its rating unchanged for the day, and some investors had refused to provide new financing.

The passage introduces cavity QED, where electron–photon interactions in optical cavities modify molecular electronic structure, but standard quantum chemistry methods are not directly applicable. It highlights the sinc basis as an orthonormal, systematically improvable grid-based approach that can represent molecular orbitals and may help address the long-range electron–photon coupling, despite an O(N^4) cost for two-electron integrals.

The DAWN-PLASMA randomized, open-label phase 2 trial compared convalescent plasma plus standard care with standard care alone in hospitalized COVID-19 patients. Between May 2020 and January 2021, 489 patients were randomized (2:1); the primary endpoint, alive without mechanical ventilation at Day 15, was not improved, and no significant differences were found in secondary outcomes. Safety results were similar between groups, with comparable rates of adverse events and serious adverse events.

In a nationally representative NHANES study of 32,498 US adults, four empirical dietary patterns were identified. The least healthy “American” pattern was most common and more frequent among adults with prevalent CVD, higher social risk, and SNAP participation or income-eligible SNAP status. Higher social risk and SNAP status were associated with less adherence to the Prudent and Fruit/Whole Grain/Dairy patterns and more adherence to the Legume pattern.

The State Bar of Michigan e-Journal for June 4, 2001 included case summaries in business law, civil rights, contracts, criminal law, employment and labor law, family law, litigation, and negligence and intentional tort, along with classified ads, fields of practice listings, news and moves, bar events, and contact information.
A study found that biased online images lead AI bots to perceive women as younger and less experienced, with large-scale evidence of discrimination against older women in the workforce.

The passage says a player’s stable personality, skill, size, and strength help him perform under pressure and score big playoff goals. It also says the team focused on playing a puck-in, hard-checking game, staying mature and focused on one game at a time, and believed repeating their strong defensive, five-on-five play would likely produce the same result.

The Wham play is described as a trap-like run where a tight end or fullback pulls to kick out a defensive lineman instead of a guard. Its strengths are quick, often unexpected favorable angles and its use as a complementary change-up. Its weaknesses are that it is complicated to teach and install, requires correct blocking assignments and the right player for the Wham block, and teams often use specific formations to create a predictable front. The passage also outlines Wham responsibilities against 3-4 odd and 4-3 even fronts and gives two variations: Gun H-Back Wham RPO and Shotgun Influence Wham.
Microsoft reported on March 13, 2020 that Bill Gates resigned from its Board of Directors, effective that date.

The study assessed horizontal household transmission of HCV among household members of HCV-positive patients at CUSP in Huye, Rwanda. Among 148 participants from 30 families, HCV prevalence was 10.8%. Unprotected sex, HBV, and HIV were significantly associated with HCV, while blood transfusion was not; awareness of HCV transmission was low. The study recommends early screening, follow-up, and education for household members.

The passage is a mixed collection of financial news headlines and repeated promotional text. It highlights JPMorgan’s AI integration, record Tesla deliveries, OpenAI’s $500 billion valuation, a U.S. freeze of $18 billion in New York City infrastructure funds, and President Trump’s nomination of Travis Hill to lead the FDIC.

Santa Barbara County sheriff’s detectives are investigating a Tuesday morning robbery at the Summerland Antique Collective, where a suspect allegedly threatened two female employees, bound them with duct tape, and stole cash and merchandise before fleeing. The victims were found about 20 minutes later and did not appear seriously injured.

Iqaluit-Tasiluk MLA George Hickes said Nunavut civil servants should not be discouraged or intimidated from speaking to their MLAs, arguing that employees have the right to do so and that this helps MLAs address constituent concerns. Minister David Akeeagok said public servants are free to provide information to MLAs and are protected under the Public Service Act and ethics processes.

The Mining Expo & Conference will be held on April 25 and 26 at the Windhoek Show Grounds under the theme “Maximising the multiplier effect from Namibia’s mining sector.” Nedbank Namibia CIB’s Mining and Resources team will showcase its financing capabilities, offer networking opportunities, and say it supports the mining sector’s role in the Namibian economy.

The speaker says penalties, fights, and physical play are part of playoff hockey and should not be overhyped. He says the turning point was a turnover after an offensive faceoff that led to a penalty and a power-play goal, and stresses that the team must focus on winning the next game and maintaining momentum. He also says faceoffs and puck possession are important, the team is fine for travel, and moving from six to seven defensemen is about chemistry and flexibility.

The email is a Commissioner.COM football fantasy report dated October 18, 2001, containing promotional offers and extensive NFL player injury/news updates, including status notes for multiple players and fantasy recommendations.

The passage introduces the Construction Defining Functionality (CDF) framework, which models functions and computational problems through syntactic, semantic, and logical spaces linked by mappings αf, βf, and γf. It argues that problems are either compositionally coherent (ComCDF) or explosive (ExpCDF), with 2SAT presented as stable and decomposable, and 3SAT as non-local, semantically explosive, and structurally tied to NP-complete intractability.

The passage explains how expired patents helped spread 3D printing from industrial systems to low-cost desktop machines, while industrial AM remains expensive and specialized. It highlights major processes, materials, sizes, throughput, and applications in aerospace, automotive, and manufacturing, and notes the Wohlers Report as a key industry resource.

European shares rose 0.4 percent on Wednesday, with the STOXX 600 reaching its highest close in nearly 16 months, as Brexit proceedings began with little market reaction. German shares also rose, led by Daimler, while LSE and Deutsche Boerse advanced after their merger talks were halted. Banks fell slightly, Engie and 3I Group gained on upgrades, and Scout24 and Aurelius dropped sharply.

China is described as leading the clean energy transition, with Xi Jinping reaffirming commitments to cut greenhouse gas emissions 7%–10% by 2035, reach 3,600 GW of wind and solar capacity, expand renewables to over 30% of the energy mix, boost electric vehicles, extend carbon trading, and increase forests. The passage says China invested $625 billion in clean energy last year, reshaping global green technology markets and driving down renewable prices.

In an open-label randomized trial in Cambodia, G6PD-normal P. vivax patients received artesunate plus either no primaquine, 3.5 mg/kg primaquine, or 7.0 mg/kg primaquine over 14 days. Recurrence within 90 days was 81.4% with no primaquine, 24.4% with 3.5 mg/kg, and 4.7% with 7.0 mg/kg, and both primaquine regimens were well tolerated. The study concludes that 7.0 mg/kg is more effective than 3.5 mg/kg for preventing P. vivax recurrences and should be recommended in Cambodia and likely other Southeast Asian countries.

Paulo Dybala said he has been training with Juventus and expects to play against Barcelona, while also confirming he chose to renew his contract until 2022 because he is happy at the club. His return would be important for Juventus after his two goals and strong play in the first leg.

Sebi has allowed debt issuers to seek review of ratings by credit rating agencies, with such requests reviewed by a committee with a majority of independent members. It also ordered disclosure of all non-accepted ratings for 12 months and half-yearly rating summary sheets, aiming to improve transparency, fairness, governance and accountability.

Melinda Rosetti-Spence was sentenced to 10 years in prison and ordered to repay about $181,000 for embezzling about $266,600 from the Pink Hearts Fund cancer charity. She pleaded guilty to writing 132 checks to herself, said she had a gambling problem, and had not made repayments since her arrest.

English local authorities are due refunds after being overcharged for council tax summons fees since 2013-4 because of an administrative error. The Ministry of Justice said councils overpaid about £9m a year, had been charged £2.50 too much per application, and would be compensated in full.

The U.S. government froze about $18 billion in federal funding for New York City infrastructure projects, citing concerns over DEI-based criteria, prompting criticism from city officials and warnings of delays, job losses, and cost overruns. The passage also lists several other financial and business headlines, including record Tesla deliveries, OpenAI’s $500 billion valuation, and JPMorgan’s AI integration.

LG will release webOS TVs later this month, and Sky TV will be integrated from launch through Sky’s EPG. Users will be able to view Sky content in the webOS menu, control it with the LG remote, and use the Today menu to switch between services like Netflix, Sky Now TV, YouTube, and live TV.
enGene hired Hussein Sweiti as chief medical officer; he previously was global medical head, oncology clinical development at Johnson & Johnson.

A group of college accreditors is backing AI to improve transfer credit evaluation and reduce credit loss, delays, and administrative burden. The statement encourages institutions to use AI and other technologies to identify course equivalencies and support student completion, while keeping humans in the process.

Cryotherapy is a growing wellness trend in which people spend three minutes in a chamber as cold as 180 degrees below zero. Enthusiasts say it may aid recovery, reduce pain and inflammation, improve mood and circulation, and burn calories, but it is not FDA-approved and has safety warnings. Polar Brrr Cryo in West Michigan offers the therapy for athletes and others, with supervised sessions and introductory pricing.

A 2,100-year-old stone bowl fragment engraved with the name “Hyrcanus” was found in Jerusalem, but it is unclear whether it belonged to royalty or a commoner. Researchers said it is one of the earliest examples of chalk vessels in Jerusalem and was found under the Givati parking lot near the City of David and the remains of the Akra fortress.

Bollinger Bands are a volatility indicator with a middle SMA band and two standard-deviation bands; widening signals higher volatility and contraction signals lower volatility. The passage describes strategies including squeeze, breakout, bounce, reversal, walks, width, RSI divergence, pinch play, volatility contraction, and triple strategy. It says Bollinger Bands can be profitable in some markets, especially as a breakout indicator in gold, but results vary by asset and they should be used with other indicators and risk management.

Apple Inc. reported that at its March 1, 2019 annual shareholders meeting, all listed directors were elected, Ernst & Young LLP was ratified as independent auditor for 2019, and executive compensation was approved; the shareholder proposals on proxy access amendments and a true diversity board policy were not approved.

The article reviews holiday effects in the S&P 500 and finds significant patterns mainly for Independence Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. It says most holiday effects are small, but a post-holiday strategy on SPY showed the second day after the holiday had the best returns, with one overnight version producing 100 trades, a 0.56% average gain, a 71% win rate, and a profit factor of 4.

Scottish councils are deciding whether to raise council tax by up to 3%, ending the freeze, though some properties in bands E to H will pay more regardless due to a higher multiplier. About 26% of households will see bills rise anyway, and the Scottish government’s budget and council funding remain disputed.

The passage lists headlines about Amazon’s Alexa and Echo products, including work on a faster AI chip, a popular Super Bowl ad, competition with Google in speaker pricing, strong Echo Dot sales, an Apple hardware delay, and an Alexa-powered talking fish.

On Oct. 29, 2001, multiple reports said Enron was seeking additional credit after drawing about $3 billion from bank lines, while Moody’s downgraded or reviewed its debt and commercial paper, and Enron’s shares fell to near seven-year lows. Traders and analysts said counterparties were watching the company closely, though U.S. energy trading with Enron was still described as normal.

A report by Lucas Chancel and Thomas Piketty says India’s inequality rose sharply from the 1980s, with the top 1% now receiving about 22% of national income, the highest since 1922. It says inequality fell from the 1950s to the 1970s but increased again with pro-business liberalisation, benefiting the top 10% more than the middle 40%.

The document defines the SEV-ES and SEV-SNP Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block protocol, where guest register state is protected from direct hypervisor access and communicated through a decrypted 4 KB GHCB page. It standardizes VMGEXIT handling, supported non-automatic exits, GHCB MSR negotiation, feature advertisement, page state changes, guest requests, AP booting, restricted injection, and other guest-hypervisor interactions, while also stating export, warranty, and liability terms.

Russia is increasingly targeting Ukrainian drone pilots with missiles, bombs, and other weapons because they are seen as high-value threats. Ukrainian soldiers say pilot casualties have risen sharply, and both sides now treat enemy drone operators as important targets.

The passage says the NHS recommends 6–8 glasses (about 1.2 liters) of water a day, with some coming from food, and notes that drinking according to thirst is usually sufficient. It also warns that excessive water can cause water intoxication, though this is rare, and says drinking water before meals may help with weight loss.

The passage describes Doublethink, a Bayesian model-averaging method that can be translated into adjusted p-values, and applies it to 1,912 UK Biobank variables to identify direct risk factors for COVID-19 hospitalization. It reports significant individual and grouped effects for variables including age, sex, deprivation, obesity, smoking, dementia, respiratory infection, falls, and some measures of comorbidity and education, while noting computational cost and limitations focused on direct rather than total effects.

The passage outlines defensive and offensive jump ball strategies for three situations: defensive, even, and offensive. It describes player rotations, alignments, boxing out, and tip directions for each, and lists several proven offensive jump ball plays such as Possession, Double Tap, Split, Jumper Fly, Forward Fly, Spread, Tandem, and Loop.

The passage traces the evolution of software patterns from algorithms and object-oriented design to open source and distributed systems, arguing that patterns provide reusable components, shared language, and guidance. It explains single-node container patterns: sidecars add functionality, ambassadors broker access to services like shards or experiments, and adapters normalize interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks. It then introduces multi-node patterns, including replicated load-balanced services, caching layers, SSL termination, sharded caches, and replicated sharded services.

The passage describes U.S. and British diplomatic efforts regarding Finland in January 1942. It includes a Finnish Minister’s note about travel restrictions on Finnish legation and consular staff, a British report that the Soviet government was prepared to contact Finland secretly through Swedish channels, and U.S. instructions to tell Finnish officials that the United States and Britain were not inclined to be lenient toward Finland’s current policy.

The passage describes a Stanley Cup victory, with players crediting Fleury’s saves, Crosby’s leadership, and team sacrifice for the win. It says they felt fortunate to be there, enjoyed the moment, and viewed the championship as special for the team, its future, and for Mario, who helped keep the team in Pittsburgh.

Survivors and families of the 72 Grenfell Tower fire victims gave emotional tributes during the first phase of a public inquiry, which is investigating the causes of the disaster and ways to prevent it happening again. The accounts described deaths, delays in evacuation, and criticism of fire authorities, building managers, local government, and officials over fire safety failures.

After backlash over his initial response to the Charlottesville rally, Donald Trump tweeted at Merck CEO Ken Frazier after Frazier resigned from the American Manufacturing Council to protest intolerance and extremism. Frazier was the latest executive to leave one of Trump’s advisory councils.

Research and Markets added a report on the global industrial hybrid stepper motors market, which is expected to generate more than $1,000 million in revenue by 2022. The report highlights rising demand for automated industrial equipment as a key driver, miniaturized stepper motors as a trend, and competition from servo and conventional stepper motors as a challenge. Key vendors include AMETEK, MinebeaMitsumi, Moons', Nidec, and Schneider Electric.

The passage compares two 7.1% forecast-yield stocks. Taylor Wimpey’s dividend is described as affordable and sustainable, supported by strong free cash flow and housing demand. Connect Group’s dividend is also covered by cash flow, but high debt and negative tangible assets make the payout riskier, with the risks seen as outweighing the rewards.

A Regina Police Service survey of 462 people found public satisfaction was generally high, with 79% rating service very good to excellent and over 80% viewing the RPS as honest and having integrity. Nearly 25% said RPS was not sensitive to their ethnic group, especially Indigenous people, and Chief Evan Bray said the service plans more reconciliation training.

The passage explains that baseline out of bounds plays are unique because the defense has a 5-on-4 advantage and must defend differently than in normal half-court situations. It presents four defensive approaches—Jam, Jump Switch, Trap, and Combination Defense—with step-by-step instructions for each.

This study compared Morton’s neuroma nerves with control nerves using RNA sequencing and immunofluorescence. It found widespread differential gene expression, with immune and inflammatory pathways upregulated and nervous system development, including myelination, downregulated. Macrophage-related signatures, especially MARCO, CD163, and STAB1, correlated with paroxysmal pain, and histology confirmed demyelination, increased intraneural T cells, and increased CD163+MARCO+ macrophages in Morton’s neuroma.

The passage introduces diffusion models and flow matching as approaches to generative modelling and frames both as special cases of the Schrödinger bridge problem. It proposes extending iterative proportional fitting to data-to-energy and energy-to-energy settings, where one or both marginals are unnormalised densities, and claims this is the first general method for such bridges. The paper reports three contributions: learning low-cost bridges on synthetic data, improving data-to-data IPF by learning diffusion coefficients, and applying the method to latent-space prior-to-posterior translation for data-free image-to-image translation.

The passage is an Enron mentions roundup from late May 2001, highlighting reports on Kenneth Lay’s push for California deregulation, Enron’s dispute with Dabhol in India, Saudi gas project developments involving Enron, executive pay in Houston energy firms, and Senate scrutiny of energy regulators and price gouging.

The speaker says the game was decided by a penalty and one goal, and that his team missed key chances. He emphasizes speed over physical play, says the team is still in the series because they learned from past losses, and discusses lineup matchups, coaching relationships, and roster management under budget limits.

The passage explains that overnight trading means buying at the close and selling at the next day’s open or close, aiming to capture the overnight edge. It describes several overnight strategies, including Turnaround Tuesday, holiday, end-of-month, weekday, mean-reversion, and options-expiration effects, and says combining many uncorrelated strategies across assets and time frames can improve risk-adjusted returns and reduce drawdowns.

SpaceX is launching a Dragon cargo spacecraft from Kennedy Space Center on an unmanned supply run to the ISS, carrying about 6,400 pounds of supplies. The mission is notable because it will be the last time NASA sends a brand new Dragon cargo craft to the station; future flights will use flight-proven hardware.

The passage discusses team depth, respect for opponents’ strengths, defensive positioning, learning from experienced players, and the importance of staying simple and prepared for the playoffs, while noting the pressure, hype, and determination surrounding a long-awaited return.

Small-sided soccer games use fewer than 11 players per team on reduced fields to increase touches, involvement, and development. They are used in practice and youth competition, with U.S. Soccer standards applying from U-6 through U-12, including smaller fields, build-out lines at U-9, and rules such as no offside before U-9 and bans on headers, punts, and drop kicks.

Dr. Pasvolsky explained that “peace-loving states” was chosen to stress peace, and that admission of new states would be decided jointly by the Assembly and Security Council. Mexico said permanent peace through cooperation of all states should guide Chapter III. Later discussion of Chapters IV and V focused on the principal organs, the possible role of the Economic and Social Council, and the limited powers of the General Assembly, while the Security Council was described as having primary responsibility for peace and security.

The Syrian opposition wants direct face-to-face negotiations with the government in Geneva to discuss a political transition, and says President Bashar al-Assad should have no role in it. The High Negotiations Committee said it had not yet received an agenda for the talks, which are due to begin on Feb. 23, and has named a 22-member delegation.

A Northern California jury convicted Gonzalo Curiel, then a minor, of torturing, starving and beating two children killed in 2015 and of torturing their older sister. His former girlfriend, Tami Huntsman, pleaded guilty to two murder counts. The oldest sibling testified that the children were abused and that Curiel and Huntsman killed the younger two.

The passage describes analyte monitoring systems and methods for sterilizing assembled sensor control devices without separating components, using a collimator to focus radiation on the sensor and sharp while protecting electronics, with optional seals and shields.

The passage describes patent applications for metal-assisted delayed fluorescent emitters based on Pt(II), Pd(II), and Ir(III) complexes employing benzo-imidazo-phenanthridine and analogues for OLEDs, full-color displays, and lighting. It presents general formulas, definitions of substituents, device implementations, and numerous synthesis examples yielding ligands and metal complexes.

Ann Schmidt circulated a roundup of recent Enron-related media mentions, including weather risk management, the Houston arena referendum, Azurix litigation and takeover plans, California power market reforms, a Transwestern gas pipeline disruption, and natural gas price movements.

Tesla Motors, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on March 3, 2015, its board adopted an amended 2010 Equity Incentive Plan prohibiting certain repricing transactions and approved amended bylaws requiring majority vote for uncontested director elections, with both changes not requiring stockholder approval.

The lecture presents a construction of SNARGs using two ingredients: BARGs and somewhere extractable hash functions. It recalls BARG completeness and semi-adaptive soundness, defines somewhere extractable hashes with completeness, index hiding, and binding at selected locations, and explains how repeating the hash yields binding on multiple locations. It then outlines a SNARG where the prover hashes all circuit wires and uses a BARG to prove every gate is satisfied, with verification reduced to checking the BARG.

The passage describes a girl detained under the Mental Health Act after seeking an abortion while suicidal, and says a second psychiatrist found no evidence of mental disorder and she was released. It argues that psychiatry and mental illness are hard to define, that treatment is often trial and error, and that mental illness is not the same as brain illness.

Amazon.com filed a Form 8-K announcing that Andrew R. Jassy will become President and CEO on July 5, 2021 and will then join the Board of Directors. The company also approved a restricted stock unit award for 61,000 shares, ten-year vesting, security arrangements, and an indemnification agreement for him.

The passage studies a cavity-coupled quantum spin system near a quantum critical point and shows that direct coupling of the cavity mode to the critical order parameter of the transverse-field Ising model can make the superradiant phase transition accessible at arbitrarily weak light-matter coupling. It also reports enhanced intrinsic squeezing, quantum entanglement, and quantum Fisher information near the quantum critical point, while coupling to a non-critical mode produces competing, more complex phase behavior.

The passage lists research materials being prepared for the Inquiry, including newspaper examinations, a Who’s Who, treaty obligations, briefs on subject nationalities, charts of international plans and events, materials on Poland, and geographic studies of several regions. It also specifies reports on government structure, racial participation and restrictions, and maps and articles on relief, climate, soils, minerals, agriculture, and forests.

Brewers rookie Jackson Chourio exited the NL Division Series opener with a hamstring injury and got an MRI after a first-inning outburst in Milwaukee’s 9-3 win over the Cubs. The passage also notes several MLB playoff roster and managerial updates, including the Mariners leaving Logan Woo off their ALDS roster, the Blue Jays leaving Bo Bichette off theirs, and Skip Schumaker agreeing to manage the Rangers on a four-year deal.

The passage describes a reconfigurable power station for UAVs that autonomously guides landing, exchanges depleted swap cartridges for energized ones, and can recharge or store cartridges in modular power bays. It also includes related systems such as a dynamic terminal landing system, universal swap cartridge receptacles, a universal swap cartridge processor, sensors, and a central processor for communication, tracking, and control.

JM Smucker sued Trader Joe’s in US District Court in Northern Ohio, alleging its crustless peanut butter and jelly sandwiches are an “obvious copycat” of Uncrustables and infringe protected design elements like a crimped edge and specific blue packaging. Smucker says Uncrustables is a nearly $1 billion brand and is seeking disposal of Trader Joe’s products and marketing materials, plus profits from sales.

The passage reviews recent experimental and theoretical progress in orbitronics, emphasizing methods such as torque, magnetoresistance, pumping, and direct imaging of orbital angular momentum. It reports strong orbital effects in several heterostructures, long orbital transport lengths, unresolved questions about orbital relaxation and reciprocity, and discusses applications and challenges for MRAM, THz emission, and other devices.

The passage is a collection of news items and articles about Enron, including its planned sale to Dynegy, possible asset sales such as Wessex Water and Dabhol, investor concerns over disclosure and regulatory review, and broader coverage of related bond, credit, and market issues. It also includes articles on zero-coupon convertible bonds, brokerage stock-picking performance, and a Russia mutual fund.

Jammu and Kashmir Assembly saw noisy protests over alleged assaults on Kashmiri students in Haryana, with opposition members staging a walkout and accusing the government of inaction. The government said it had taken up the matter with Haryana and that three people had been arrested. The House also discussed an all-party meeting on panchayat elections, and BJP members raised the deaths of three Army personnel in an avalanche and a rescue operation by the Army.

Ryan Dempster said it was gratifying and meaningful to see Kyle Hendricks, whom the Cubs acquired in the trade involving Dempster, become a key starter and begin Game 1 of the postseason. Dempster said the trade and Hendricks’ success felt like a full-circle moment and a source of pride.
On July 25, 1977, the petition for a writ of habeas corpus in The People of the State of New York ex rel. Harry H. Boddie v. Ronald R. Emery was denied, with all listed judges concurring.

The passage is a lecture on origami art and design, focusing on representational origami, Yoshizawa’s influence, traditional versus nontraditional styles, and modern realism. It explains tree theory, uniaxial bases, and circle/river packings, then gives design examples using TreeMaker, including a crab and a folded proof-of-concept model.

An American prisoner, Christian Beasley, escaped from Bali’s overcrowded Kerobokan prison after allegedly sawing through a ceiling and climbing a wall. Another American inmate was caught during an attempted escape, and authorities are investigating possible guard involvement.

The coach said his team must avoid frustration, stay emotionally controlled, and keep refocusing on the next shift or game. He said the team has played well at times and outshot/outchanced the opponent, but has been beaten by stronger net-front presence, loose-puck battles, and scramble goals, so they need to drive to the net and protect their crease better.

HHH defended excluding women from The Greatest Royal Rumble, saying cultures differ and WWE cannot dictate to countries or religions. He said WWE is helping drive women’s evolution and hopes women will be allowed to compete there in the next few years as Saudi Arabia changes.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU uses 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, larger L2 cache, ECC protection, and third-generation Tensor Cores for higher performance than Tesla V100. It adds features including MIG for partitioning one GPU into up to seven isolated GPU Instances, third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, improved error handling, JPEG decode, optical flow, NVDEC, and CUDA enhancements such as async copy, asynchronous barriers, L2 residency controls, and cooperative groups.

The World Health Organization said Yemen’s outbreak has caused 503,484 suspected cases and 1,975 deaths since late April, affecting more than 500,000 people. It said the spread has slowed since early July but still affects about 5,000 people daily, amid worsening sanitation, limited healthcare, and a conflict that has damaged infrastructure and left millions without clean water.

President Rutherford B. Hayes proclaimed that unauthorized attempts to settle Indian Territory would violate U.S. laws, warned such persons not to enter without permission, and stated they would be removed by Indian Department agents with military assistance if necessary.

Tooth whitening is a large and growing cosmetic industry with many confusing products and limited FDA regulation. The ADA seal can help identify products reviewed for safety and effectiveness, but many products without it may still work if used correctly. Over-the-counter, dentist-made, and in-office bleaching options vary in cost, speed, and strength, and all are temporary; some stains cannot be bleached and may require crowns or veneers.

The tug Ocean Prince, pushing the oil-laden barge New London on the Hudson River, struck a charted rock and caused a major oil spill. The Second Circuit held that Red Star’s negligence and unseaworthiness were within its privity and knowledge, denied limitation of liability, and found Red Star liable for Pittston’s damages and cleanup costs. It affirmed dismissal of claims against the United States, but ruled Red Star’s conduct constituted willful negligence or willful misconduct under the pollution statute.

The email compiles Reuters and Dow Jones items, including Colombia delaying ISAGEN privatization until June 30, market comments on Bush tax cuts, HMO lawsuit rulings, Toronto exchange technical levels, and notes on several companies including Enron, Applied Materials, Celestica, Alza, Schwab, and Vlasic.

AMD disclaims liability and warranties for the document’s contents and products, reserves the right to change specifications without notice, and states its products are not intended for life-support or other high-risk applications.

The Single/Double offense is a set offense used to free a strong shooter through double baseline and down screens, with the initial attack through the middle to stress both sides of the defense. It includes reads and counters for screen defense, options for screeners to score, strong post-ups, offensive rebounding emphasis, and continuities such as motion, side screen, and drive-and-kick actions.

The speaker says his overtime goal helped tie the series and reflected the team’s improved effort, confidence, and determination after poor play in the first two games. He praises teammates, leaders, family support, and his trade to Anaheim, and says the team’s belief and overtime success give them a strong chance to win if they stay tied after regulation.

CBD, a cannabis-derived drug made from purified marijuana without THC, is being considered for FDA approval only to treat seizures linked to Lennox-Gastaut syndrome and Dravet syndrome in patients aged 2 and older. The FDA said studies show it is effective for these severe, rare epilepsies and that its risks appear acceptable, while doctors emphasized it is a specific pharmaceutical product made under manufacturing guidelines.

After a birthday sleepover near Milwaukee, Payton Leutner was found with 19 stab wounds, and two missing girls, Morgan Geyser and Anissa Weier, were later located and questioned. The passage says the girls described a months-long plan to kill Payton, linked to their belief in the fictional character Slender Man, while doctors said one wound nearly killed Payton.
Google’s Pixel 2 and Pixel 2 XL look similar in marketing but feel very different in person, with the smaller Pixel 2 seen as a design step back and the Pixel 2 XL as the better-built phone.

The passage introduces a proposed two-frequency Paul trap for simultaneously confining a Ca2+ ion and an electron, aiming to study trap-induced and Rydberg-like electron states for quantum applications. It argues that trapped electrons could enable faster gates than trapped ions, describes the trap’s energy-level structure and optical couplings, and presents a planar ring-trap design chosen to improve field steepness and support the intended experiments.

The disclosure describes ultrasonic fingerprint sensor systems for under-display use, especially with OLED displays. It includes apparatuses, multilayer films, and manufacturing methods using light-blocking, electrical shielding, adhesive, and mechanical stress isolation layers to support ultrasonic transmission while reducing light, electrical interference, and stress, and it also describes flexible sensor substrates, piezoelectric transceiver layers, and backing or cavity structures.

Reuters lists several Spanish stocks that may be affected by reports: OHL will pay a gross interim dividend of 0.349 euros per share; Gas Natural has abandoned its LNG project in northern Italy; Minor is reportedly the lone bidder for NH Hotel Group’s 26.3 percent stake held by HNA at about 6 euros per share; Acciona will pay a gross dividend of 3 euros per share on July 2; Dogi’s shareholder will propose renaming the company Nueva Expresion Textil; and Parques Reunidos reported an H1 net loss of 58.6 million euros versus 65.4 million euros a year earlier.

Zacks Investment Research downgraded Time Warner from buy to hold, citing mixed positives and concerns, while other analysts had mixed ratings. Time Warner beat quarterly earnings and revenue estimates, reported higher year-over-year revenue, and declared a quarterly dividend. The stock traded at $96.26, near its 12-month high, with a market cap of $74.31 billion.
