It reviews failed efforts at mediation, argues that Cuba’s independence should not yet be recognized, and asks Congress to authorize U.S. military and naval action to end hostilities and provide relief, while noting Spain has recently ordered a suspension of hostilities.

Shalah Dawn Nelson of Enderby pleaded guilty in Salmon Arm Provincial Court to causing an animal to continue to be in distress after tying an elastic hair band around a neighbour’s dog’s testicles in December 2016. Two related Criminal Code charges were stayed. She was fined $1,000, placed on 12 months’ probation, ordered to avoid contact with the dog’s owner, and required to pay $850 restitution.

Electronic Arts received a consensus “Buy” rating from 28 analysts, with an average 12-month price target of $121.55. The stock traded at $120.09, and the company reported quarterly EPS and revenue above analyst estimates.

Delhi is hosting a Human Library event, where people can “borrow” human books for about 20 minutes to ask questions and reduce misconceptions. Started in Copenhagen in 2000, the concept has spread to 80 countries and is coming to Delhi on June 18 at Innov8, Connaught Place, featuring people from 11 categories such as a tea-vendor turned author, female solo traveller, cancer survivors, drug abuse recovery, and bullying victims.

The passage says gold rose while miners failed to confirm the move, the USD Index appears set to rally, and stocks look weak after recent declines. It argues this setup resembles 2008 and suggests further declines may be ahead.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data acquisition system with selectable data formats, sampling clock options, synchronized sampling, internal or external reference support, 2-lane or 4-lane SDR/DDR data interfaces, randomized data output, averaging modes, test patterns, speed-boost mode, and SPI register control including daisy-chain support.

Reports say YouTube may launch a music service called Remix in March next year, with support from Warner Music Group and talks with Sony, Universal, Merlin, and artists, as it seeks to compete with Spotify.

A study in Frontiers in Physiology found that 10-year-old boys’ muscles resist fatigue and recover from high-intensity exercise similarly to elite endurance athletes, and faster lactic acid clearance may explain this. Researchers said this does not mean children are as fit as endurance athletes, but the findings may help guide youth training and understanding of age-related health changes.

Bleacher Report named Braves legend Chipper Jones the “wildest” candidate for Atlanta’s open manager job, noting it is “very wishful thinking.” Jones spent his 19-year career with the Braves, was an eight-time All-Star, and recently managed a side in the 2025 Futures Game.

The study used NLP to automatically identify goal-of-care discussions in clinical notes from seriously ill patients. An ensemble classifier trained with active learning improved performance on highly imbalanced data, reaching an F1 score of 0.629 for note classification and retrieving 72% of positive notes while reducing annotation effort.

Daniel Ricciardo said Red Bull were not as quick on the straights at the Japanese Grand Prix, but he did not think the engine was the cause. He was third fastest in FP1, missed FP2 because of heavy rain, and said the car’s balance was good but that more downforce may be costing straight-line speed. He also said Red Bull saved wet tyres for possible rain later in the weekend and suggested tyre rules should be changed next year.

Jenny Han, author of “The Summer I Turned Pretty” and “To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before,” worked as a server at Olive Garden, a nanny, and a school librarian before major deals with Netflix and Amazon. She said her librarian experience helped her understand young readers and shape her audience.

The Belgian Congo agreement was being negotiated among the United States, United Kingdom, and Belgian representatives, with discussion of using a parallel rather than joint approach in communications. Biddle reported preliminary talks and a draft framework for the agreement, while Belgium’s Vleeschauwer planned to leave for Congo via the United States on May 15.

The passage covers Investing.com headlines and technical outlooks for USD/JPY, GBP/USD, and BTC/USD, noting market reactions to weak US jobs data, expectations for a BoE rate cut, and BTC support near 112,000. It also includes stock-screening promotions, market commentary, and site disclaimers.

The passage explains HQET matching, renormalization, and power corrections. It derives wave function and operator renormalization for heavy-to-light and heavy-to-heavy currents, noting an anomalous dimension that is independent of spin structure but depends on \(w=v\cdot v'\) for heavy-to-heavy transitions. It also discusses a simplification for matching using dimensional regularization in both UV and IR, where HQET graphs become scaleless. Finally, it introduces \(1/M_Q\) power corrections, identifies the kinetic and chromomagnetic terms, and shows that reparameterization invariance fixes the kinetic coefficient to 1 while the chromomagnetic term has an anomalous dimension.

Trump and Macron toasted the Franco-American alliance at the White House during the first Trump administration state dinner. Trump praised Melania and said he hoped the friendship between the two countries would deepen, while Macron linked recent U.S.-French airstrikes in Syria to a shared history of defending freedom and values. The dinner hosted 123 guests, featured formal attire, rack of lamb and nectarine tart, and entertainment by the Washington National Opera.

It defines Laurent sequences and shows they form a field, then describes a rate-1/2 convolutional encoder, its impulse responses, code equivalence, and the free distance of the example code as 5.

Travis Stork became a doctor after working at a free clinic following college, then changed careers from math major to MD. On “The Doctors,” he discusses health topics and recommends gradual weight-loss changes, healthier Super Bowl snacks, and couples cooking or exercising together to support heart health.
Teurlings Catholic High School announced Robert Boudreaux as director of institutional advancement, Maria Latiolais Hanes as development director, and Rev. Dustin Dought as chaplain.

The Diamond & One is a Box & One derivative in which four defenders play zone and one defender denies the opponent’s scoring ace. It is best against odd or one-guard fronts, but can give up the corner. The passage also describes defender shifts, chaser responsibilities, and a low-post double-team/trap approach.

Kano State Governor Abdullahi Umar Ganduje launched the distribution of 10,000 free delivery kits to women in all 44 local government areas, funded by N145 million. He said the kits are meant to reduce infections and maternal and neonatal deaths, and noted that the state has also trained 1,936 traditional birth attendants, renovated over 300 health facilities, and upgraded healthcare services. WHO and other speakers praised the initiative and emphasized its role in promoting safe motherhood.

Zambia’s parliament suspended 48 opposition UPND lawmakers for 30 days after they boycotted President Edgar Lungu’s speech, stopping their pay and barring them from the building. The party called the move unconstitutional, while its leader Hakainde Hichilema and five others face treason charges.

The court affirmed reformation and enforcement of a land-sale contract, finding the written requirement to convey a good title was inserted by mistake and that the buyer, who knew the facts and acted on counsel’s advice, was not entitled to rescind for mistake. It also held the buyer’s agreement was supported by valuable consideration despite later claims that his title was better.

Apple options are described as highly liquid, highly volatile, and more competitive than other stocks’ options. The passage outlines common strategies such as buying and selling calls and puts, covered calls, protective puts, straddles, strangles, and delta hedging, along with risks like leverage, time decay, and market risk. It also explains that option prices are affected by stock price, time to expiration, volatility, interest rates, dividends, corporate news, and macroeconomic conditions, and notes that limit orders are recommended for entering and exiting trades.

The passage promotes several credit cards, especially the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, highlighting unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 spend, a 0% intro APR for 12 months, no annual fee, and cell phone protection up to $600. It also lists offers for Capital One Quicksilver and a Citi card, along with disclosures about compensation, editorial independence, and credit-score requirements.

A Delaware businessman survived the Istanbul nightclub terror attack when his cellphone stopped a bullet, while the passage also mentions Rosie O'Donnell criticizing Trump, a 2017 love-life prediction, two Fort Bliss soldiers disappearing, and tips for staying fit after 40.

It claims the strategy performs well, with average gain per trade of 0.57%, a 75% win rate, a 23% maximum drawdown, and a profit factor of 2.3, and says it can be improved with one additional parameter.

PlayStation Russia posted a cryptic tweet that sparked speculation about possible PlayStation-related announcements, including PS Vita 2, PlayStation Now in Russia, cross-play, or other online or store functionality. The exact meaning was unclear, and no concrete next-gen announcement was expected.

The study used a qualitative case study of a Digital Photography in Nature course to examine AI-supported course design and student experiences. It found that AI helped with personalized feedback, technical skill development, academic language, and assessment, but also posed risks such as passivity, over-reliance, misinformation, and infrastructure barriers.

The Education Department’s rule-making committee began meeting Monday on graduate loan caps and income-driven repayment plans, but a possible government shutdown could delay or alter the session. Officials first said the work would resume virtually in two weeks if funding ran out, then later said the committee might continue in person through Friday. The department plans to furlough nearly 87% of employees in a shutdown, while keeping those working on rule-making and the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

Apple reported that shareholders approved the 2022 Employee Stock Plan at the March 4, 2022 Annual Meeting, ending future grant authority under the 2014 Plan after Form S-8 registration. Shareholders also approved the auditor ratification, executive compensation, and several board and shareholder proposals, with some shareholder proposals not approved.

Tyson Foods has a consensus “Buy” rating from 17 brokerages, with an average price target of $72.96. The stock recently traded at $70.66, and the company reported quarterly EPS of $1.28 on revenue of $9.85 billion. Tyson Foods also announced a quarterly dividend of $0.225 per share.
FDA approved a second generic version of the abortion pill mifepristone.

Montreal’s health authority says 11 people have died from heat-related complications, with four more deaths reported in the Eastern Townships. Urgences-Santé says it is overwhelmed by about 1,200 calls a day in Montreal and Laval, and is urging people to use 911 only for real emergencies as the heat warning continues.

Scientists found that bacteria inside tumors produce 2-methylisocitrate (2-MiCit), a molecule that damages cancer cell DNA, disrupts metabolism, and makes colorectal cancer cells more vulnerable to chemotherapy. The effect was confirmed in worms, flies, and human cancer cells, and a modified version of the molecule was even more effective.

NuVasive will host an AANS Lunch and Learn workshop on April 30 on single-position lateral surgery solutions for L4-S1, featuring 3D-printed implants and LessRay radiation reduction technology, along with booth demonstrations and Archie Manning discussing his XLIF experience.

The passage says the team benefits from experienced players who set an example for younger players, and from coach Hitchcock, who is demanding and has helped the speaker improve. It emphasizes that the team values winning over individual scoring, stays simple and focused, works hard in the corners and along the boards, and tries to wear down defenders to create goals.

Reno County Jail booking activity on 10/05/17–10/06/17 included arrests for failure to appear, probation violation, drugs and paraphernalia offenses, and interference with law enforcement. Named suspects included Candice Marie McGee, Eduardo Francisco Benitez, Derrin Lee Lovell, Jimmy Dale Behel, Alejandro David Mendoza, and John Michael Ford.

The Allies say they deplore war losses to neutrals and belligerents but are not responsible for the war, reject any assimilation of the two sides in the American note, and accuse Germany and Austria-Hungary of aggressive war and atrocities. They state their war aims include restoring and indemnifying occupied countries, evacuating invaded territories, reorganizing Europe on principles of liberty and justice, and securing peace based on international obligations.

The court vacated a preliminary injunction against defendant’s used car lot operation, holding that plaintiff’s conclusory affidavit and complaint did not sufficiently show irreparable harm under Rule 65 and N.C.G.S. § 160A-175(e).

It also describes bin removal mechanisms, box tray assemblies, grasp selection based on perceived object surfaces, and embodiments with multiple processing sections controlled by a computer system.

The passage describes Korean efforts to preserve independence amid pressure from China and Japan. It says Korea should become prosperous and strong by modernizing government and commerce, and reports that Korea declared itself an independent state with complete sovereignty. It also says Japanese troops remained in Korea, Japan refused to withdraw them, and foreign ministers sought U.S. help to avert conflict and secure troop withdrawal.

The speaker describes winning after a long season and years of waiting, crediting the team’s unity, belief, discipline, and system for the result. They say the victory is special and unbelievable, and praise a teammate for outstanding play throughout the playoffs and finals.

Microsoft’s March 31, 2019 Form 10-Q reported higher revenue, operating income, and net income year over year, with growth across all three segments. Commercial cloud revenue rose 41%, and the company completed the GitHub acquisition and recognized a $157 million tax expense adjustment related to the TCJA.

The conviction for first-degree robbery and sexual abuse was unanimously affirmed. The court found the evidence sufficient and held that, although part of the supplemental charge on intent was inappropriate and potentially confusing, the charge as a whole did not shift the burden of proof.

Tesla subsidiaries amended two warehouse agreements with Deutsche Bank on August 16, 2018, extending borrowing availability to August 16, 2019 and maturity to September 2020. The shared lender commitment remained $1.1 billion.

The swinging gate is an unconventional special teams formation used mainly on two-point conversions, allowing the offense to either run a trick play or shift into a kicking formation. Its goal is to surprise the defense and create an advantage, with common plays including a side snap run and a quick screen pass. The passage also explains defensive adjustments, emphasizing matching personnel and protecting the heavy side and alleys.

Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jacory Croskey-Merritt’s increased Week 5 workload came after a good week of practice helped him earn more time. Croskey-Merritt posted season highs in carries, touches, snaps, scrimmage yards, and touchdowns.

It describes cable plans from California to the Philippine Islands via Hawaii, with conditions including a commercial rate limit and a line to China. It also praises Porto Rico and says peace, amnesty, and civil government have been established in the Philippines, where U.S. troops and civil authorities have prepared the way for self-government.

Margin debt, a measured form of stock-market leverage, fell from a January record of $665.7 billion to $645.1 billion in February and $645.2 billion in March, remaining below January levels. FINRA warned that investors may underestimate the risks of trading on margin and could face forced liquidations under unfavorable market conditions. The passage says leverage amplifies both stock-market gains and losses and notes that the recent decline in margin debt has been orderly, unlike past spikes that were followed by crashes.

Palladium rose about 8.5% as part of a broader precious metals rally, breaking above a prior ceiling that is now seen as support. The passage says this may be the start of a larger commodities supercycle, while also noting gold has surpassed $4,000.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K on March 4, 2020 reporting that its Compensation Committee adopted the Fiscal Year 2021 Variable Compensation Plan, which provides eligible executive officers with cash awards based on fiscal 2021 revenue performance goals. The report also lists target award opportunities for named executive officers.

Flir Systems reported fourth-quarter 2016 adjusted EPS of $0.52, GAAP EPS of $0.45, and revenue of $474.7 million. It projected 2017 adjusted EPS of $1.81 to $1.91 and revenue of $1.78 billion to $1.83 billion, raised its quarterly dividend 25% to $0.15, and approved a share repurchase program for up to 15 million shares.

If that test fails, Fisher’s test is used. Plasma glucose changes from baseline at the same time points are analyzed by ANOVA with treatment, age group, and injection site factors, using the rescue IV glucose value if rescue occurs earlier.

Hello Wood’s Pebl Grand is a prefabricated tiny cabin that blends natural materials with a spaceship-like design. It starts at €73,000 ($86,247), includes a king-size bed, kitchenette, dining nook, and bathroom, and can be customized with upgrades such as a sauna and panoramic window. The company says it can be delivered and installed in a few months and used as a home, suite, lounge, or green room.

Mutual funds raised their exposure to IT/software stocks to a record Rs 70,773 crore in April, or 7.37% of equity AUM, up from Rs 64,265 crore in March and Rs 42,023 crore a year earlier, as a weaker rupee and market volatility boosted interest in dollar-earning companies.

U.S. dollar and Treasury yields fell after Trump said the dollar was too strong and rates should stay low, while North Korea tensions lifted South Korean CDS to a 9 1/2-month high. Asian markets were mixed, Europe was set for a flat to lower open, and oil prices declined on rising U.S. supply.

Cam Newton apologized on social media for a sexist remark, possibly to avoid further questions from reporters. The passage says he may face continued questioning after his next game against the Lions, despite saying he has already addressed the issue.

It also records a telephone conversation clarifying that the rule applied to officially notified Legation personnel, including honorary consuls, and discussing its application to consular districts and family travel.

Finance Minister Arun Jaitley said India’s growth remained strong, averaging 7.5% from 2014-15 to 2016-17, and noted fiscal deficit targets of 3.9% in 2015-16, 3.5% in 2016-17, and 3.2% budgeted for 2017-18. In a pre-budget consultation with economists, participants urged continued fiscal consolidation, tax and GST reforms, higher investment incentives, PSU disinvestment, social security improvements, lower corporate tax, stronger DBT, and measures to boost jobs, investment, and farmer incomes.

Saudi Arabia’s stock market fell as Dar Al Arkan dropped 9.9 percent after a sharp recent rise, while Saudi cement shares remained strong ahead of the 2018 state budget. Qatar’s index rebounded 1.2 percent from near six-year lows, and Dubai’s index rose 0.6 percent as Emaar Development recovered slightly but stayed below its IPO price.

Gold prices in New Delhi were steady at Rs 28,300 per 10 grams on the first trading day of 2017 due to scattered demand and lack of global market cues, while silver fell by Rs 100 to Rs 39,300 per kg on reduced industrial demand. At MCX, February gold futures rose Rs 83 to Rs 27,528 per 10 grams on speculative buying.

A 2015 Carnegie Mellon study found that regular volunteering among adults 50+ was linked to lower risk of high blood pressure, reduced stress, less loneliness and depression, and better memory and cognitive health. The passage also announces a Virginia Cooperative Extension training for Master Food Volunteers beginning April 18 at the Brambleton Center, with applications due April 3 and scholarships available.

It also notes expectations for a Bank of England rate cut, concerns over U.S. shutdown risks, and several ad and disclaimer sections.

Duke extended head coach Jon Scheyer through the 2030-31 season, adding two years to his previous deal. Scheyer has won 89 games in three seasons, led Duke to the Elite Eight in 2024 and the Final Four in 2025, and has kept the program strong in recruiting.

Virgin Galactic completed its second rocket-powered test flight of VSS Unity over Southern California, reaching 114,500 feet before landing at Mojave Air and Space Port. Richard Branson greeted the crew, and the company said the flight was another step toward commercial operations.

Vincent Bollore told the European Commission he will obtain sole control of Vivendi after the April 25 shareholders meeting. His 20.65 percent stake would give him 29 percent of voting rights, and the Commission has until April 24 to approve the situation.

Student Association State Quad senators say residents are confused about asbestos notices and want more direct communication than door signs and housing documents. Residential Life says asbestos warnings have been posted for about 20 years, ceilings have not been disturbed recently, and RAs are instructed to refer questions to higher-ups.

Mick Schumacher says he is not ready to think about Formula One yet and wants to keep proving himself in European F3 after an unsuccessful Formula 4 stint. He aims to learn, improve, and eventually win, while acknowledging interest from Mercedes and Ferrari and the media attention around his career.

Apple Inc.’s Q1 2021 Form 10-Q reports net sales of $111.4 billion and net income of $28.8 billion for the quarter ended December 26, 2020, both above the prior-year quarter. Cash and cash equivalents were $36.0 billion, total assets were $354.1 billion, and shareholders’ equity was $66.2 billion. The filing also describes revenue by product and segment, debt, share repurchases, tax matters, litigation, and the effects of COVID-19.

Family Court found the father’s violations of the custody order and relocation to Florida changed circumstances but denied a custody change. On appeal, the order was modified: custody was left with the father, but the case was remitted for immediate consideration of court-ordered visitation between the mother and the younger daughter, because leaving visitation to the child’s wishes was improper; the suspension of the mother’s child support was affirmed.

The passage says Charlottesville made educators rethink how to confront racism and white supremacy, and it highlights Facing History and Ourselves as a long-running curriculum that helps students examine moral choices and bigotry. It also lists resources, lesson ideas, and books for teaching about race, civil rights, diversity, and current events.

Denise Ricco’s son was diagnosed with autism in fourth grade, prompting her to join SPARK, a large study seeking genetic markers of autism spectrum disorder. The study aims to test families of 50,000 people with autism through home cheek swabs or professional testing at Chicago-area sites, and researchers hope to better understand how autism is inherited and identify genetic markers, though prevention is not the goal.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2016. Revenue was $20.5 billion, net income was $4.7 billion, and diluted EPS was $0.60. Total assets were $212.5 billion and stockholders’ equity was $70.4 billion. Revenue rose in Productivity and Business Processes and Intelligent Cloud, while More Personal Computing declined.
Strix Group Plc said its half year ending 30 June had mixed fortunes, with Billi delivering strong double-digit growth supported by new products and geographic expansion.

It also includes analysis of the China market and identifies opportunities for investors and businesses.

It outlines strengths, weaknesses, player fundamentals, basic rules, screen options, post play, offensive rebounding, 3-, 4-, and 5-person variations, zone adjustments, and coach benefits.

The appeal from the order was dismissed because it was terminated by the entry of judgment. The judgment was affirmed, with costs awarded to the defendant, because the jury’s finding that the defendant was not negligent was based on a fair interpretation of the evidence.

A systematic review of 39 studies found that digital leadership in education lacks a settled definition, has mostly been studied for its effects on teachers and schools rather than students, and is influenced by internal factors such as age, gender, experience, and digital literacy, as well as external factors including infrastructure, school culture, policies, training, and the COVID-19 pandemic.

It opposes major concessions on arms control, regional issues, and economic contacts, warns against summitry and broad dialogue, and says any progress should depend on clear Soviet moves reducing threats and improving behavior on key issues.
Santander UK CEO Mike Regnier will step down in the first quarter of 2026 as the bank prepares for its merger with TSB, and Santander has started searching for a successor.

Fitch assigned expected 'BB(EXP)' ratings to Telenet International Finance S.a.r.L.’s Term Loan AH and Telenet Financing USD LLC’s Term Loan AI, both senior secured loans intended to partially refinance existing bank debt. Fitch cited Telenet’s strong operating position, stable cash flow, manageable wholesale regulation impact, and strong liquidity, while noting that higher leverage remains a constraint.

Targeting in college football is a foul for taking aim at an opponent with forcible contact beyond a legal tackle or block, often involving helmet-to-helmet contact or a hit on a defenseless player. It carries a 15-yard penalty and automatic disqualification, with second-half fouls leading to a suspension for the first half of the next game. The NCAA adopted the rule in 2008; it was amended in 2013 and required video review in 2019.

Keith Chegwin died at age 60 after a long battle with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a progressive lung condition. His family said he died peacefully at home on 11 December, with his wife, daughter and son by his side.

Halcon Resources shares fell 0.18%, while analysts set a 12-month average target of $10.56 based on 10 opinions, with targets ranging from $6 to $14. Facebook shares fell 6.8% amid regulator criticism over user data access by Cambridge Analytica, putting the stock on pace for its biggest percentage decline in four years and erasing nearly $40 billion in market value. Analysts said the issue poses public relations and regulatory risks, though they differed on the near-term business impact, and the broader tech sector also declined.

The speaker says the team focused on winning the game at hand, played their own game, and did not change their approach despite tough calls. They expected a strong, fast opponent with good forechecking and puck control, and emphasized taking each shift and game seriously, not giving up when behind, and finding ways to win in different situations.

Adm. Harry Harris will become the next U.S. ambassador to South Korea instead of Australia, according to Australian Foreign Minister Julie Bishop. It also notes mixed long-term performance of Chinese stocks, describes China’s government and economy, and presents three backtested FXI trading strategies with positive combined results.

Apple Inc.’s Q2 2021 Form 10-Q reported net sales of $89.6 billion and net income of $23.6 billion for the quarter ended March 27, 2021, both up from the prior year, with higher sales across iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables, and Services. Total assets were $337.2 billion, shareholders’ equity was $69.2 billion, and the company repurchased $43.0 billion of common stock during the first six months of 2021.

East Whittier City School District used bond funds from Measures R and Z to complete summer upgrades at several schools, including a new, safer playground at La Colima Elementary and improvements such as roofs, fences, concrete, paint, walkways, storage bins, and lunch shelter painting. The projects cost about $6 million, with about $88 million remaining for future work.

Tesla’s Q1 2020 Form 10-Q reported $5.985 billion in revenue, $68 million in net income, and $8.08 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of March 31, 2020. The company said COVID-19 disrupted operations and deliveries, increased inventory, and affected manufacturing. It also disclosed debt, stock-based compensation, and multiple legal proceedings, including suits related to the SolarCity acquisition, Model 3 production, the 2018 CEO performance award, and the potential going-private transaction.

A large teddy bear named Big Ted visited Warwick events and Warwick East State School on the last day of the school year as part of a promotion for Blackbird and Finch. Principal Marina Clarke said students and staff enjoyed cuddling the bear, which was moved on a trolley because it was too big to carry, and it also visited the Uber Markets on Sunday.

The passage introduces the AMD Secure Random Number Generator Library and explains that random numbers are important for cryptography, which requires unpredictable and robust numbers. It contrasts software-based pseudorandom number generators with hardware random number generators and states that AMD Zen microprocessors include a cryptographic coprocessor for generating cryptographically secure random numbers through an easy-to-use Secure RNG API.

The passage discusses a goalie’s decision-making, praising team scoring spread across multiple players, and emphasizing that the team must keep playing the same way with contributions from everyone. It says the team is still down but more back in the series after a needed win, and notes that a former player’s intensity and excitement when the team wins still rub off on them.

Erdogan said Turkish forces and Syrian rebel allies will expand their offensive against the Kurdish YPG further east in Syria and into northern Iraq. After taking Afrin, Turkey plans to move toward several Syrian border towns and may act around Sinjar in Iraq against the PKK, which Ankara links to the YPG.

The passage describes the ambassador pattern for sharded services, service brokering, request splitting, and monitoring/logging adapters, then introduces microservices and replicated load-balanced services, including caching and SSL termination. It also explains sharding functions, consistent hashing, sharded and replicated sharded systems, scatter/gather patterns, and the benefits and limitations of FaaS and event-driven processing.

This cross-sectional study of 46 UTI patients found reduced urinary creatinine, increased urinary protein in severe cases, and a significantly higher protein-to-creatinine ratio with increasing disease severity. The authors conclude that the P/C ratio is a more reliable marker of UTI-associated renal impairment than protein or creatinine alone.

The passage argues that jurisdiction over enclosed waters like Hudson Bay and the Bay of Fundy does not extend to the Okhotsk Sea beyond ordinary jurisdictional waters. It describes the seizure of the Cape Horn Pigeon by Russia, notes Russian admissions limiting its jurisdiction, and states that the seizure was outside any claimed Russian jurisdiction, with Russia ultimately disclaiming exclusive control and taking responsibility for damage from the seizure.

Options trading in TSLA involves buying or selling derivatives that give the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell shares by a set date and price. It can offer leverage, hedging, and profit potential, but also carries substantial loss risk and complexity. The passage recommends backtesting, quantified analysis, risk management, and choosing strategies based on risk tolerance, goals, and market outlook.

The speaker says the team has had success there and wants to build on it, believes enough has been said and it is time to play, notes the game feels faster and more intense, and says home ice seems to be the momentum in the series. They add that the team should stay focused and try to play a solid, perfect game.

United Airlines reported Q1 earnings above estimates and maintained strong Q2 guidance despite a passenger removal scandal. The passage says Q2 PRASM is guided to rise up to 3%, pre-tax margins are expected at 10% to 12%, and costs are targeted to increase 3% annually. It argues the stock remains inexpensive and that further dips from the scandal could be buying opportunities.

Ernesto Guevara, youngest son of Che Guevara, runs La Poderosa Tours in Cuba, offering six- or nine-day Harley-Davidson motorbike tours for tourists. The business, which he operates with his wife, attracts biking enthusiasts from around the world, including more visitors from the United States, with prices ranging from about $3,000 to $6,000.

The passage argues that Congress has no general constitutional authority to fund internal improvements, except when a specific work is necessary to execute an enumerated federal power. It reviews past presidential opinions, legislation, and maritime jurisdiction practices, and recommends limiting federal appropriations to works essential to national powers, with other improvements left to the States or private enterprise.

Amazon.com, Inc. elected Daniel P. Huttenlocher to its Board of Directors and appointed him to the Leadership Development and Compensation Committee effective September 7, 2016. He received a restricted stock unit award for 1,131 shares, vesting in three annual installments beginning November 15, 2017, and entered into the company’s standard indemnification agreement.

The passage outlines key 2017-2018 Canada Summer Jobs documents and events, including speaking points, media lines, and applicant guidance about new eligibility rules and a declaration tied to human rights and reproductive rights. It notes that religious organizations were not ineligible, faith-based groups had to meet the same criteria as others, some funding details from 2016 were blacked out to avoid financial harm, and Hajdu later announced 2018 funding with many faith-based groups having received support after marking the attestation box.

The passage describes autonomous vehicle systems that use a machine-learned yield model to process feature data about perceived objects and output yield decisions, which are then used to plan and control vehicle motion. It discusses applications such as traffic signals, gaps with other vehicles, unprotected turns, and gridlock prevention, as well as training from labeled driving logs and simulated scenarios.

Justice Hyeladzira Ajiya Nganjiwa sought to stay proceedings in his corruption trial pending an appeal, but the court did not grant the request. He had been arraigned by the EFCC on a 14-count charge involving alleged $260,000 fraud, N8.6 million corrupt enrichment, and false information to EFCC officials, and he pleaded not guilty after his preliminary objection was dismissed.

A study published in Nature Communications found that grape-derived compounds may help treat depression by targeting inflammation and synaptic plasticity. In mice, DHCA and Mal-gluc promoted resilience against stress-induced depression-like effects.

Japan’s financial regulator conducted surprise checks on Coincheck after a $530 million hack, saying it had previously asked the exchange to fix system flaws that helped prevent official approval. The FSA ordered all Japanese cryptocurrency exchanges to report on risk management, while Coincheck said it would repay about 46.3 billion yen and authorities continued investigating the theft.

The passage is a collection of energy-related news items on U.S. energy policy, Texas electricity deregulation, Qatar gas export plans, and Enron’s Dabhol Power Company serving a termination notice in India.

Henry James Review will move to Creighton University next year, where Greg Zacharias will become editor. The journal will support Creighton’s Center for Henry James Studies and offer research opportunities for students.

A federal judge questioned several charges against Dallas County Commissioner John Wiley Price, saying she is 99 percent sure she would dismiss the mail fraud counts even if a jury convicts him. She also questioned whether prosecutors proved a quid pro quo between Price and Kathy Nealy. Closing arguments are set to begin Tuesday.

A lengthy rain delay for Mariners-Tigers changed the TV schedule for ALDS Game 3: instead of FS1, the game will air on MLB Network and FS2, while still streaming on the Fox One app and Fubo. The series is tied 1-1, with Logan Gilbert starting for Seattle and Jack Flaherty for Detroit.

Former NFL quarterback and Fox Sports broadcaster Mark Sanchez was arrested in Indianapolis and faces three misdemeanor charges related to an incident in which he was stabbed and hospitalized. Police said he was arrested on suspicion of battery with injury, unlawful entry of a motor vehicle and public intoxication, and he will not work Sunday’s broadcast.

Foothills Audubon Club’s first 2017 program will be held Monday, Jan. 9 at 7:00 p.m. at the Berthoud Community Center in Berthoud, Colorado. The free, public event will feature the PLANET EARTH segment “Saving Species” on global conservation efforts, followed by refreshments.

Devon and Cornwall Police has been charged under the Health and Safety Act over the 2012 death of Thomas Orchard, who died in hospital after being restrained in custody. The force will appear in court on May 24.

The passage says recent studies found that more time outdoors protects children against developing myopia, while near work like reading, computer use, and television is not an important cause. In one long-term study of 4,979 children, about 14 hours per week outdoors reduced the effect of hereditary risk from two nearsighted parents from about 60 percent to about 20 percent. It also notes that outdoor light may help by slowing abnormal eye growth, though more research is needed.

The passage is a speech celebrating the signing of the Americans with Disabilities Act, thanking Congress, administration officials, advocates, and people with disabilities. It describes the act as a historic civil rights law that prohibits discrimination, expands access to employment, public accommodations, transportation, and telephone services, and brings people with disabilities into the mainstream of American life.

The paper studies how early-stage Internet-of-Things startups develop their systems, using multiple-case interviews with eight startups. It finds common team compositions, three MVP types with increasing functionality and quality, and practices such as in-house design, outsourcing, rapid prototyping, reuse of ready-made components, and iterative development.

The passage explains link-cut trees for maintaining dynamic forests of rooted trees with make-tree, link, cut, find-root, and path-aggregation operations. It represents each preferred path as a splay tree in a “tree of auxiliary trees,” uses access to update preferred paths, and analyzes performance with heavy-light decomposition and the splay-tree access lemma to obtain amortized O(log n) time per operation.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 18, 2018, stating that its 2017 Letter to Shareholders, accompanying the annual report for the year ended December 31, 2017, was attached as Exhibit 99.1.

Cpl. Marcus Hirschfield described surviving a 2013 crash that broke both his legs and led to three months in hospital, and said his recovery has continued with physiotherapy. Back at work as an RCMP officer, he urged support for STARS Air Ambulance, which is partly government-funded and relies on donations and a lottery that may not sell out for the first time in 23 years.

The passage promotes multiple credit cards with introductory 0% APR offers, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses, and explains that low-interest cards can help reduce borrowing costs. It also states that the site uses a data-driven ranking system and that compensation does not affect its ratings or reviews.
The figures show multiple views of an embodiment of a centrifugal pump, and the broken lines indicate portions that are not part of the claimed design.

All women have postpartum bleeding after a C-section or vaginal delivery because the placenta site continues to bleed lightly and shed lochia. After a C-section, bleeding is usually heavy for several days, then gets lighter and typically stops within four weeks; bleeding lasting six to eight weeks or signs of heavy bleeding, fever, or low blood count should prompt a call to a doctor.

An investigation found around a third of Scotland’s roads needed repair, with about 30% of A-roads and 35% of B-roads classed as red or amber. Scotland’s road condition was much worse than England’s, though spending per head on roads was higher in Scotland. Argyll and Bute and the Western Isles had the highest proportions needing repair, while West Lothian had the lowest.

Lawrence Timmons returned from suspension, joined the Dolphins’ starting lineup immediately, and played every snap against the Saints. He said he was not at his best but felt good overall, worked to stay in shape during his time away, and expects to keep improving.
Apple Inc. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2019 announcing a press release about its second fiscal quarter results for the period ended March 30, 2019, and attached the press release as Exhibit 99.1.

Microsoft reported that directors Charles H. Noski and Helmut Panke, both board members since 2003, will retire from the board and not seek re-election at the December 4, 2019 annual shareholders meeting, effective that date.

A cross-cultural study of 2,324 university students in eight countries found that people reported greater life satisfaction and fewer depressive symptoms when they experienced the emotions they wanted, even if those emotions were unpleasant. The research suggests happiness may involve feeling the “right” emotions, not just pleasant ones.

Microsoft held its 2016 Annual Shareholders Meeting on November 30, 2016, where shareholders elected all 11 director nominees, approved executive compensation, ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as auditor for fiscal 2017, approved an amendment to the Articles of Incorporation and the French Sub Plan, and rejected a proxy access shareholder proposal.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 10-K for fiscal year ended September 24, 2016, reporting its business, products, services, risks, properties, legal proceedings, stock performance, and share repurchases. It designs, manufactures, and markets hardware, software, services, and digital content worldwide, with major products including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and iPod. The filing highlights strong competition, supply chain and component risks, legal and regulatory exposures, and quarterly and foreign currency volatility.

The CCI (Commodity Channel Index) is a momentum oscillator that measures price relative to an average over a period and is used to identify overbought and oversold conditions. It was invented by Donald R. Lambert in 1980, originally for commodities, but later used for stocks, ETFs, and other securities. The passage says CCI works best on stocks and bonds, especially with short lookback periods and daily bars, and notes that the best strategy is using oversold levels in the stock market.

The Second Circuit reversed and vacated a preliminary injunction against H. P. Hood & Sons, holding that Jackson Dairy had not shown irreparable harm because any lost business could be compensated by money damages. A concurring judge would have reversed instead because Jackson failed to show a contractual violation or other meritorious basis for relief.

The passage promotes several credit card offers with 0% intro APR periods, cash back, travel rewards, and sign-up bonuses, and explains that low-interest cards can help consumers save money. It also says the site uses an objective rating system and that compensation from issuers does not influence its ratings or reviews.

Subgroup analyses found no significant interaction for adherence at 24 and 48 weeks. From Week 24 to Week 48, a significant interaction was seen by atrial fibrillation type, with the largest adherence difference in permanent atrial fibrillation, and by sex, with a difference reported for males.

Pneumococcal disease caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae is a major global cause of illness and death, especially in young children and older adults. China has two pneumococcal vaccines available, but they are not in the national immunization program and uptake is low. Sinovac developed a preservative-free PPV23 vaccine approved in 2020, and this phase 4 trial compared its immunogenicity, tolerability, and safety with another PPV23 vaccine in Chinese children, adults, and elderly people.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 31, 2019 reporting that it announced its fourth quarter 2018 and year ended December 31, 2018 financial results, with the related press release and non-GAAP information included as exhibits.

KMT Chairwoman Hung Hsiu-chu said she would resign on June 30, before her term expires on Aug. 20. She thanked party colleagues after the KMT’s major election defeat, named Lin Cheng-tse acting chairman, and urged chairman-elect Wu Den-yih to take office soon and complete the party transition, especially staffing matters related to the party’s assets and lawsuits.

The speaker says the team has been treated differently throughout the playoffs, but does not feel that applies to the whole team. They are looking forward to tonight’s game, describing it as very important, and say the team must skate, compete, manage the puck, and make adjustments only after identifying mistakes. They also say success has been earned, not mysterious, and praise a long-time competitor and leader as part of a strong franchise core.

HPCaaS is presented as scalable support for new HPC-based business models, allowing enterprises to offer HPC services or insights, use HPC without building their own infrastructure, and access modern technologies quickly. The passage says 81% of current HPC users plan to implement HPC-based business models, and IDC sees HPCaaS, cloud HPC, and data analytics as important for digital transformation, innovation, and competitiveness in manufacturing.

The President transmits a treaty with Nicaragua for an interoceanic canal and urges ratification. He argues the canal is necessary for U.S. political, military, and commercial interests, would respect Nicaraguan sovereignty, and would benefit world trade, U.S. commerce, and national unity.

Inflation is a broad increase in prices that reduces purchasing power. The passage says high inflation tends to hurt stocks in the short term, increase volatility, favor value stocks over growth stocks, and can lead to higher interest rates, while the long-term impact may be less negative as companies pass on higher costs.

The passage discusses the team’s success, highlighting the impact of added Stanley Cup–experienced players, especially Mike Commodore and Cory Stillman, who were described as well-liked and important contributors. It also covers pride in being a U.S.-born coach, influences from family and several coaches, and praise for a defenseman’s strong, consistent season, leadership, and speed.

In January 2017, foreign investors made net purchases of Dh406 million on ADX. The general index rose 0.03 per cent to 4,548, while traded value increased to Dh7.741 billion and average daily value rose 87 per cent to Dh352 million. Market capitalization fell 1.32 per cent to Dh438.383 billion. Eshraq Properties was the most active stock, and the real-estate sector led trading with Dh2.989 billion.

Lackawanna County Prison counselor Kimberly A. Rupp, 49, was charged with misdemeanor retail theft for allegedly skipping payment for $206.77 in merchandise at Walmart using self-checkout. She had also been charged a month earlier with felony retail theft for allegedly trying to steal $3,194 in items from Kohl’s. Rupp was released on $10,000 unsecured bail, and a preliminary hearing is scheduled for Monday.

This systematic review examined 35 studies on bibliotherapy in education and found that it may improve socio-emotional, academic, self-esteem, resilience, hope, anxiety, stress, and depression outcomes, though awareness, training, and standardization remain limited.

Sentencing arguments for Lake Louise resort, which pleaded guilty to cutting endangered trees in Banff National Park, were delayed until July 9 because no earlier courtroom was available. The case involves at least 39 whitebark pine trees, and the sentence will depend on the number cut and environmental impact.

The APC in Ekiti State nominated former Ado-Ekiti Local Government chairman Chief Adebisi Adegboyega Egbeyemi as its deputy governorship candidate to run with Dr. Kayode Fayemi in the July 14, 2018 governorship election. Egbeyemi has held several political and public offices, including legislator, commissioner, attorney general, and party leader, and is married with children.

Huawei says it aims to become the number one global PC vendor within five years, following new MateBook device releases. Analysts say its cash, large install base, and global retail presence could support a strong push, though it will still face major competition and channel challenges.

The speaker says the team responded with physical, focused play, settled down, controlled the puck better, and worked well together despite line changes. They stress working hard, staying on the game plan, and not celebrating too early because only one game has been won.

Jurors convicted Joseph Percoco on three counts, including two counts of conspiracy and solicitation of bribes, and he is scheduled to be sentenced on June 11. Steven Aiello was found not guilty on bribery charges but guilty on one count of conspiracy, with sentencing set for June 14, while Joseph Gerardi was found not guilty on all charges and the jury remained deadlocked on Peter Galbraith Kelly Jr. Percoco, his attorneys, and Governor Cuomo all commented on the verdict, with defense lawyers considering further review or a motion to set aside the verdict.

The passage introduces VN-HGCN, a heterogeneous graph neural network that adds virtual nodes to enable long-range message passing without predefined meta-paths. It uses 4 layers with transformation, node-level aggregation, and attention-based type-level aggregation, and experiments on ACM, DBLP, and IMDB show strong node classification performance and robustness.

GLUCOSE is a distributional offline reinforcement learning model developed and externally validated to personalize hourly regular insulin dosing in the first day after cardiac surgery. Using MIMIC-IV and eICU-CRD data, it showed improved estimated performance over clinician dosing, lower dosing error in human evaluations, and comparable or better safety, effectiveness, and acceptability than clinician policies.

The passage introduces SimulRAG, a simulator-based RAG framework for long-form scientific QA that uses a simulator retrieval interface and claim-level generation with uncertainty estimation and simulator boundary assessment. It also presents a benchmark for climate and epidemiology and reports that SimulRAG outperforms RAG baselines in informativeness and factuality, while UE+SBA improves claim-level verification efficiency and quality.

The passage addresses postwar readjustment, especially agriculture, transportation, rail labor disputes, prohibition enforcement, immigration registration, education, child labor, tax-exempt securities, and other domestic issues, while also affirming U.S. support for peace, international cooperation, and limited involvement abroad.

ADF&G reported an aggressively behaving fox near Wood River Road in Dillingham, with signs possibly indicating rabies. Officials advised people to stay away from foxes acting unusually and reminded dog owners to keep rabies vaccinations current.

City Hall personnel records show Cleveland engineering and construction manager Khalil Ewais tried to resign in 2015 over pay and expanded duties, then stayed after promises of staffing changes and a possible raise. Federal agents later raided City Hall and seized records tied to Ewais’s side business, projects, and Burton Scot Contractors amid an ongoing sealed investigation.
Morgan Stanley said FAANG stocks remain fundamentally strong but may see slower returns in 2018, as macro and cyclical risks could limit further gains after a year of sharp outperformance.

An email forwards an essay by Arundhati Roy arguing that the U.S. war in Afghanistan is an act of terror, criticizing the bombing, civilian suffering, humanitarian aid drops, media coverage, surveillance, and the roles of weapons and oil interests.

An analysis of campaign contributions found BigLaw firms are moving left, with 92.45% of contributions in 2023 and 2024 going to Democrats, up from a 6-1 Democratic-to-Republican ratio in 2017-2020. Among top-grossing firms, Cleary Gottlieb, Fried Frank, and Mintz Levin had the highest Democratic share, while Nelson Mullins, Lewis Brisbois, and Ogletree Deakins had the lowest.

The Missouri Court of Appeals affirmed an order requiring Max Gibson to modify an insurance trust to remove a provision allowing him to use the policies’ cash value, and upheld attorney fees and costs. The court rejected his arguments about altering the agreement, pleading, venue, adequacy of legal remedy, and fees.

USD/CAD is range-bound between 1.2968 and 1.3211 with a neutral intraday bias and mixed near-term outlook. A break above 1.3387 would suggest the decline from 1.3598 has ended and open upside toward 1.3598 and above, while a drop below 1.2968 would turn the outlook bearish. Longer term, the move from 1.4689 is viewed as a correction pattern.

The lecture explains TaintDroid, an Android taint-tracking system that tracks sensitive data from sources like GPS, contacts, and IMEI and blocks it from reaching the network. It describes taint propagation through Dalvik instructions, arrays, IPC messages, files, and native methods, notes conservative design choices and performance overhead, and discusses limitations such as side channels, app collusion, implicit flows, and taint explosion. It also briefly covers related systems for richer information-flow control and TightLip’s doppelganger-process approach for legacy programs.

Eccentric exercises, which involve slow, controlled lowering movements, can increase strength by creating tension and muscle damage, though they may leave muscles sore. The passage says they can help increase metabolism by building stronger muscles, and recommends strength-focused training such as negative push-ups rather than hypertrophy training, along with a healthy diet. It also says “long, lean muscles” and “bulking” are myths for women.

At Suzuka’s sole practice session, dry but patchy conditions followed yesterday’s wash-out. Alonso received a 25-place grid penalty after an engine change, and Bottas, Hamilton, Vettel, Ricciardo, and others featured in a session twice interrupted by red flags caused by Bottas and Raikkonen incidents. Bottas set the fastest time ahead of Hamilton, with Vettel third, while Ferrari and Mercedes focused on qualifying simulations late in the session.

The passage explains the “Box & One” defense and gives the “Chase” offense as a simple way to attack it. Key ideas include isolating the star player in the middle, using back screens, base screens, weakside two-game action, give-and-go entries, and double-screen continuity. It stresses execution, communication, scouting, and moving players to exploit weak defenders.

The passage explains that the 52-week high is the highest closing price of a stock over the past year and that the 52-week high strategy buys stocks near that level. It also describes the 52-week range, notes that intraday breaches do not count unless the stock closes beyond the level, and says academic research suggests stocks near their 52-week highs may outperform others. Backtests on the S&P 500 were not considered very tradable or especially successful.

Rose McGowan reportedly settled with Harvey Weinstein for $100,000 in 1997 after an episode at Sundance, and the agreement said it was not an admission of harassment. The same report also said Ashley Judd accused Weinstein of inappropriate behavior, and Weinstein later said he would take a leave of absence from The Weinstein Company.

The Department of Energy approved nearly $67 million for 85 nuclear research projects at universities and government laboratories to promote safety, efficiency, and US energy independence. More than $31 million will fund 32 university-led projects in 23 states, and $6 million will support 19 universities studying reactor safety and performance. Since 2009, the office has awarded about $472 million to 103 US colleges and universities.

The Patient Charter sets out NHS patients’ legal rights, NHS pledges, and responsibilities, including free care at the point of use, equal access, safe and quality care, informed consent, choice, complaint routes, and respectful use of NHS services.

The passage argues that fruit is healthy and should not be avoided despite new diet trends claiming otherwise. A dietician says fruit is nutrient-dense, and suggests choosing lower-glycemic fruits if concerned about weight or blood sugar.

The lecture reviews biomimicking examples in engineering, including wood replicas, fiber-reinforced 3-D printed honeycombs, foamed metal implants, tissue scaffolds, sandwich panels, and density-gradient structures inspired by palms and plant stems. Gibson then discusses exam logistics and answers student questions about foam energy-absorption graphs, test coverage, and the upcoming schedule.

Enron’s stock fell sharply amid doubts about its survival and the Dynegy takeover, while lenders granted a three-week extension on a $690 million note and continued talks on restructuring debt. Reports also described pressure on Enron assets and subsidiaries in Japan, India, and the UK, and noted that employees’ retirement savings and some bondholders had been heavily harmed by the company’s collapse.

Experts said California’s recreational cannabis rollout has been hampered by complex regulations, slow local licensing, limited legal storefronts, heavy taxes, and continued underground sales. BDS Analytics reported $339 million in licensed recreational dispensary sales through February 2018, below expectations, though some compared the state’s experience to earlier markets like Colorado.

HeartLands Conservancy is gathering public input for the Cahokia Creek Watershed Planning project, which will address storm water, flooding, and water quality issues in the Indian Creek and Canteen Creek watersheds around Glen Carbon and Edwardsville. The effort, led with Madison County and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, will use community feedback to help identify projects and funding for watershed problems.

A 10-year-old Government Primary School student at PGI alleged that youths in a black car tried to abduct her near a Vekra Booth around 11 am, prompting school and police action and a precautionary DDR. Police said locals near the site had not seen any kidnapping attempt, and the school again requested regular PCR patrols after a similar incident on February 9.

A flash flood watch is in effect for much of central Alabama until 7 p.m. today, with showers and thunderstorms expected to continue and produce heavy rain on saturated ground. Tomorrow will have more scattered storms, mainly in the afternoon and evening, with a marginal risk of severe weather in parts of north Alabama. Friday through the weekend should bring partly sunny, routine early June weather with scattered afternoon and evening storms and highs near 90. Next week is expected to start drier, with a greater chance of storms late in the week.

Belgium’s upset win over Spain sent Romania to the 2019 Rugby World Cup as Europe 1 and likely helped Canada’s repechage chances. Spain will face Portugal, with the winner playing Samoa for a World Cup spot, while the loser joins Canada in the four-team repechage. Belgium’s points came from penalty kicks, and World Rugby is investigating the appointment of a Romanian referee.

U.S. stocks stayed near record highs as strong retail sales and higher inflation pushed Treasury yields up and increased expectations that the Federal Reserve may raise rates sooner. The S&P 500 was little changed, while the Dow and Nasdaq rose slightly; utility and other dividend-oriented stocks fell. The dollar strengthened, and commodity prices were mixed.

The email is an “IEP News” roundup sent by Jean Munoz on May 21, 2001, listing California energy-crisis media coverage, a Dow Jones note that Controller Kathleen Connell would release power contract details, and several news stories and transcripts about blackouts, power prices, investigations, conservation, and Governor Gray Davis’ response.

The passage explains how soccer coaches should prepare players for varied field, weather, lighting, equipment, referee, and perimeter conditions, emphasizing field inspection, safety, and adapting play to conditions such as wet, uneven, icy, windy, hot, or poorly marked fields.

NVIDIA Corporation reported the results of its May 23, 2017 annual stockholders meeting: all twelve director nominees were elected, named executive officer compensation was approved on an advisory basis, stockholders favored annual advisory votes on compensation, and PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP was ratified as the independent accounting firm for fiscal year ending January 28, 2018.

The speaker discusses injuries, officiating, and lineup changes, saying the team did not play well enough to win and must generate more offense and second-chance chances. He stresses that players are hurt at this time of year, that someone else must step up if key players are out, and that the team may need to adjust lines or use seven defensemen depending on availability.

The speaker says the bruise is fine and they are ready to play tonight. They praise a young player as a great, offensive-minded talent, saying it reflects strong development back home and a bright future. They also say they do not know him well, and emphasize keeping play simple and making strong decisions with the puck.

China’s first-quarter GDP rose 6.9%, above its 6.5% target, but the passage questions the reliability and significance of China’s statistics. Industrial production increased to 7.6% in March 2017, retail sales grew 10.9%, and fixed asset investment remained below 10% overall, with state-owned enterprise investment still growing faster than private investment.

The Senate again rejected dueling Republican and Democratic stopgap funding bills, extending the government shutdown into its eighth day. Democrats want health-care protections, including an extension of Affordable Care Act subsidies, while Republicans seek funding through Nov. 21. The shutdown has led the IRS to furlough nearly half its workforce.

This study compared REM sleep microstructure in controls, iRBD, and PD+RBD patients. iRBD showed a higher phasic REM sleep ratio, PD+RBD showed lower STW density and shorter STW duration, both patient groups had STW spectral shifts toward higher frequencies, and NREM/REM transitions were progressively longer from controls to iRBD to PD+RBD.

The passage derives in-plane and out-of-plane properties of hexagonal honeycombs, including elastic moduli, compressive plateau stresses for elastic buckling, plastic yielding, and brittle crushing, plus fracture toughness for brittle honeycombs. It also covers triangulated honeycombs, which deform mainly by axial forces and have a modulus proportional to t/l. Out-of-plane behavior includes Young’s modulus, Poisson’s ratios, shear moduli, compressive strength, and brittle fracture relations. The lecture ends by noting upcoming discussion of wood and cork.

The speaker says Paul’s return and goal showed leadership and gave the team a huge lift, and that the team now has a chance to win the Stanley Cup in Game 7. He says the opportunity means a lot after difficult years and that the team feels good, is ready, and has a long flight tomorrow.

The study examined long COVID among vaccinated healthcare workers in Brazil using a case-control design at Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein from March 2020 to July 2022. Cases were RT-PCR-confirmed COVID-19 infections with symptoms lasting more than 4 weeks; controls recovered within 4 weeks.

The Delaware Supreme Court reversed the Superior Court and held that Cheryl Tickles was injured on PNC’s premises and during the course of her employment, so she was entitled to workers’ compensation benefits.

The passage describes Turing GPU architecture improvements, including a unified shared memory/L1/texture cache, larger L2 cache, GDDR6 memory, enhanced video and display support, NVLink for SLI, and new features such as RT Cores, Tensor Cores, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, and NGX AI features like DLSS. Gray Davis’s political position improved, but he still faced criticism over bailout efforts, executive orders, and potentially costly long-term power contracts.

A former competitive swimmer and long-time Apple engineer, he has gained prominence at product launches and expanded responsibilities beyond hardware.

A Berliner Testament is a joint will in which spouses appoint each other as sole heirs and usually their children as final heirs. It can provide financial security for the surviving spouse, but it has strong binding effects and cannot generally be changed unilaterally, even if circumstances change. Tax allowances should also be considered, and legal advice is recommended.

Delta executives expect premium revenue from first class and other higher-priced cabins to overtake coach cabin revenue next year, possibly for at least a quarter or two. The issue is whether his plea agreement waived his right to appeal, after the 5th Circuit dismissed his appeal based on the waiver despite the trial judge telling him he had a right to appeal.

Its strengths include solid coverage against quick passes, screens, and the run, especially with hard corners. Its main weaknesses are multiple vertical routes, trips formations, and certain run situations that can stress the box or leave a safety exposed.

The rule is part of Dodd-Frank and has already faced other rollbacks under Trump administration efforts to loosen financial regulations.
