An AHL contract or tryout could let him play for Rochester in the regular season and playoffs, while Buffalo would prefer an amateur tryout this season and an entry-level contract starting in 2018-19. Signing a contract would forfeit his remaining NCAA eligibility.

The passage describes a 500 kHz synchronous push-pull converter design using GaN devices and gives selected component values for the TPS7H500x-SP controller, including RT = 205 kΩ, 5 V output settings, ~25 ns dead time, 50 ns leading-edge blanking, 33 nF soft-start capacitor, 2.5 transformer turns ratio, 40 μH primary inductance, 170 V primary FETs, 80 V synchronous rectifier FETs, 0.47 μH output inductor, about 2.3 mF output capacitance, 7.5 Ω current-sense resistor, 3.3 nF hiccup capacitor, 40.2 kΩ/15 nF/47 pF compensation parts, and 102 kΩ slope compensation resistor. It also lists input supply, layout, and documentation update guidelines.

The passage explains the five SAE levels of self-driving capability and notes that production cars have already reached Levels 1 and 2, which still require full driver attention. BMW expects Level 3 on its iNext electric car in 2021, while Level 4 would allow longer periods before driver takeover and can stop safely if the driver does not respond. BMW does not expect Level 4 infrastructure soon, Waymo already has limited Level 4 cars and plans a taxi service in Phoenix, and Level 5, with no driver needed, is expected only by the end of the next decade.

The disclosure describes systems and methods for detecting abnormal cardiac activity using cardiac and motion data, optionally with subject contextual information. It processes data in windows, determines signal quality indices and cardiovascular features, applies tensor transforms, and uses a deep learning architecture including a convolutional neural network, bidirectional recurrent neural network, and attention network to classify cardiac activity as normal or abnormal and generate a report.

In a retrospective cohort of 2,514 women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, 13% were diagnosed with incident hypertension within 12 months postpartum. Higher 15–90 day postpartum systolic BP, older age, and eclampsia/severe preeclampsia were associated with higher hazard, while a later BP check was associated with lower hazard. About 40% lacked a postpartum BP check at 15–90 days.

The passage is largely a repeated list of headlines, with one detailed item on JPMorgan Chase accelerating AI integration across its operations to reduce costs, streamline workflows, and improve services through broad deployment of generative AI, though it faces compliance and infrastructure challenges.

Wandera said iOS 11 drained iPhone and iPad batteries more than twice as fast as iOS 10 in tests of 50,000 devices, though iOS 11.0.1 improved battery life and Apple later released more updates. Older iPhones experienced worse drain, and users were advised not to revert to iOS 10.3.3. Suggested battery-saving steps included limiting background app refresh, restricting background location access, and using low power mode.

The passage is a collection of October 29, 2001 news reports about Enron’s falling stock, Moody’s downgrade of its debt to two notches above junk, concerns over its creditworthiness and liquidity, talks with banks for additional credit, and growing reluctance among counterparties in Europe and elsewhere to trade with it. It also notes investor and analyst concern over Enron’s disclosures, partnership transactions, and related lawsuits.

The passage lists several AMD Geode CS5535 companion device issues, including incorrect AuxOutputFull behavior on Port 60h reads, ATAC hangs with word-aligned PRDs, LPC controller aborts on certain SYNC timing, SMB NEGACK bit clearing inconsistently, retry counting in GLPCI, atomic GPIO feature-bit writes failing after suspend, an SMBus hold-time shortfall, missing LOWBAT_FLAG after abnormal standby, and Sleep_X/Sleep_Y not deasserting when delays exceed PM_SED.

Connaught Public School in Hintonburg attempted a tunnel ball world record with over 250 students, surpassing the previous record of 120, and the result awaits Guinness verification. The event also raised $10,000 for school yard renewal projects, including a new playground, basketball court, funnel ball net, grass, and trees.

Jeff Bezos, Reid Hoffman, and other CEOs criticize work-life balance, arguing that success often requires nonstop work, sacrifice, and “harmony” instead of separation between work and personal life. Others, including Andrew Feldman, Lucy Guo, Eric Yuan, and Jack Ma, also say achieving greatness demands long hours or constant commitment.

The passage lists the annual incomes needed to buy homes in 25 U.S. cities, with San Francisco highest at $226,577 and Detroit lowest at $7,359. It also says Seattle’s housing market is hot and prices rose 18.6 percent year over year in King County, but experts say the market is unlikely to collapse like in 2008, though a correction may occur.

American consumer confidence rose in April to 128.7, near an 18-year high, from 127.0 in March. The increase was linked to strong labor market conditions, tax cuts, less stock market volatility, and reduced trade war worries, though some analysts said spending growth may lag confidence.

NEC Corp has established the NEC Satellite Operation Center, scheduled to be fully operational in April, to begin operating the ASNARO-2 satellite using its GroundNEXTAR system and a secure data center. The center can operate multiple satellites simultaneously, and NEC plans to market ASNARO-2 images with JEOSS starting in September.

The TPS7H500x-SP is a radiation-hardness-assured current mode PWM controller family for space-grade DC-DC converters. It supports Type 2A or 2B frequency compensation, fixed-frequency peak current mode control, thermal shutdown at 175°C typical, and a design example of a 500 kHz synchronous push-pull converter using GaN devices with specified component values and layout guidelines.

Software must place halt commands last in the queue for precise halting, and use only one queued command for precise error halting. Interrupt status bits can be cleared by writing PM_RBCtl[CLEAR_INTS]=1 when processing is finished or paused. The passage also describes SPA encoding for page migration, page migration command requirements and status handling, and notes that errors may be reported in commands, ring buffer status, or MCA, with hardware errors sometimes making pages unrecoverable.

McEachern and Harrison, both 5-0 after bye weeks, kicked off Friday night in Kennesaw, Georgia, with McEachern ranked No. 1 in The NEXT 25 bubble rankings and seeking a statement win, while Harrison aimed to raise its profile with an upset.

Astronomers discovered RAD J131346.9+500320, the most distant and most powerful odd radio circle known, about 10 billion years old and showing two intersecting rings. Found with citizen scientists using LOFAR, the study suggests ORCs may be linked to galactic superwind outflows rather than black hole mergers.

Peter Marks, the former top FDA vaccine regulator, has joined Eli Lilly to oversee molecule discovery and infectious diseases, and confirmed he started Monday. The move drew criticism over the revolving door between the FDA and industry.

Louisiana sued the “Banking Department of the Citizens’ Bank” for a license tax, but the court held that the objection for want of citation had to be decided contradictorily with the Citizens’ Bank of Louisiana, which was not sued. The judgment was reversed and the suit dismissed, with other issues left open.

The passage lists energy industry stories and reports on Enron’s bankruptcy, including its pipelines and power assets, FERC contacts with Enron officials, Enron Japan creditors, U.S. government-backed loans to Enron-related projects, BG Group’s acquisition of Enron assets in India, and broader Senate debate on energy legislation. It also notes California Gov. Gray Davis is considering delaying the MTBE ban.

The passage presents a bucketized hysteresis pacing controller for real-time advertising auctions that combines hysteresis control with proportional feedback to improve budget pacing. It contrasts this method with a legacy variable-step multiplicative controller, introduces an analytical framework for parameter selection, and reports real-world auction experiments showing improved pacing accuracy, especially for small-budget campaigns.

In Windows 10, you can change mouse pointer size and color in Settings under Ease of Access > Mouse, or search for “Mouse Pointer.” Size can be set to small, medium, or large, and color to white, black, or inverted. For more shape options, use Control Panel > Mouse > Pointers.

NASA’s Dawn spacecraft captured its closest-ever images of Ceres, showing bright salt deposits in Occator Crater and the faculae Vinalia Faculae and Cerealia Facula. The mission, now nearing its end from low-altitude orbit, aims to study Ceres’ surface, composition, and subsurface mysteries.

ISDA’s May 16, 2001 press report summarized news on hedging regulations, OTC derivatives market growth slowing in late 2000, FHLB New York’s FAS 133 compliance, single-stock futures, options accounting, credit derivatives regulation, and ISDA’s finalized restructuring supplement.

Canadian Pacific Railway is speeding up cross-border shipments from Vancouver to the U.S. by up to 48 hours compared with Canadian National Railway, aiming to cut costs for shippers and pressure its rival. The faster service routes intermodal containers through Chicago to Detroit and the Ohio valley, while CN has emphasized avoiding Chicago congestion to improve its own speed.

Euro zone stocks hit over a one-year high after factory activity data showed the fastest growth in more than five years, while the euro fell below US$1.05 as the dollar strengthened. Italian, German and French shares rose, euro zone bond yields declined, and the Istanbul attack had little market impact; the Turkish lira slipped and bitcoin rose above US$1,000.

The passage explains defensive strategies against the Horns offense, including showing and recovering, avoiding switches, and using all-out trap disruption before the first screen. It details player rotations, pass denial, help positions, and final matchups for defending dribble penetration and post actions.

Roger Poole says Britain’s coarse-fishing season has begun and anglers should use different tactics and baits than in March, as rivers now offer abundant natural food. He promotes angling for youngsters, National Fishing Month, and club efforts to grow membership. He also notes early-season catches such as tench, chub, dace, roach, perch, bream and barbel, and advises experimenting to find what works.

The passage describes the arrest of Travis Reinking, a White man suspected of killing four people at a Nashville Waffle House, who was apprehended without police firing a shot and was found with a handgun and ammunition. It contrasts this restraint with police violence against Black people, citing the arrest of Chikesia Clemons in Alabama and arguing that race affects policing in the U.S.

The Office of Climate Change opened a three-day Greenhouse Gas Inventory workshop in Guyana to support the Third National Communication to the UNFCCC, build technical and institutional capacity, and train national experts for future inventory reporting. Speakers said the training will improve climate reporting, support Guyana’s green agenda, and may end with testing and certification.

Napheesa Collier suffered a Grade 2 tear of three ankle ligaments and a shin muscle in a collision Friday, with a minimum six-week recovery period. The Mercury eliminated the short-handed Lynx in Game 4, and coach Cheryl Reeve was ejected in Game 3 and suspended for one game over her reaction to the injury play.

NEC Display said four P-series pro-grade 24/7 digital signage displays will move from three-year to five-year warranties, with no extra cost: P404, P484, and P554 from first shipment, and P703 for purchases made on or after August 1, 2017.

The Internal Bar Strength (IBS) indicator measures the closing price’s position relative to the day’s high and low using (Close-Low)/(High-Low). The passage says IBS has worked well for decades on stocks and stock indices, especially in volatile or bear-market conditions, but less well on other asset classes. It also notes a key weakness is execution at the close, and that combining IBS with filters or another indicator can improve results, though curve fitting is a risk.

The passage claims high cholesterol should be treated by addressing underlying causes rather than with lifelong statins, and promotes a “functional food therapeutic lifestyle change” program and book as a natural, side-effect-free therapy for hyperlipidemia.

The passage describes the author’s long familiarity with the Tappan Zee Bridge and fascination with the new Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge. It highlights the bridge’s scale, design, construction methods, outreach efforts, environmental planning, and the large team involved in building what is presented as an iconic, long-lasting span.

A University of Alabama student, Kelsey Hall, wore a Christmas tree costume to class after promising on Twitter to do so if her post got 1,000 retweets; it quickly got 30,000. She said the attention has been stressful and she may avoid future social media challenges.

High School Sports Talk Presented by VirginiaPreps.com airs Saturdays from 10 AM EST to Noon on ESPN Radio 94.1, hosted by Matthew Hatfield and Coach Ed Young. During a program from the Boo Williams Sportsplex in Hampton, Matt spoke with several guests, including Chris Duhon, Jalen Lecque, David Teel, Cam Bacote, Bryan Kersey, Ed Miller, and Keyontae Johnson.

Alpha Theory’s Analytics Department says client data reveals investor biases from deviations between actual and optimal position sizes. Examples include failing to cut exposure after large price moves, building positions too slowly, using undisciplined sizing without price targets, and overdiversifying; disciplined, more concentrated portfolios tend to outperform.

The lecture compared full and fractional factorial designs with adaptive one-factor-at-a-time experimentation for robust design. It argued that adaptive methods can outperform fractional factorials, especially when interactions are not small, and described applications to Taguchi-style robust design, industry practice, and several experimental studies.

Showstoppers Theatre’s summer production, Foiled Again!, is a two-week children’s musical theater program directed by Radu Azdril, with performances at La Colina Junior High School in Santa Barbara. The program gives young actors experience in acting, singing, choreography, costumes, sets, lighting, and sound; children 12 and under are free, and general admission is $7.

The passage discusses the need to win tonight, increase pressure on goalie Quick, and spend more time in the offensive zone. It notes the opponent’s defense has been strong, the team has worked hard but can improve puck movement and shot selection, and that lineup changes may help.

NVIDIA’s quarterly report for the period ended April 26, 2015 showed revenue of $1.151 billion, net income of $134 million, and cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities of $4.792 billion. GPU revenue rose 5% and Tegra revenue rose 4% year over year, while operating income increased to $176 million. The company also reported share repurchases, dividend payments, ongoing litigation, and plans to wind down Icera modem operations with expected restructuring charges of $100 million to $125 million.

The 2-1-2 zone is a compact variation of the 2-3 zone that protects the middle, uses an athletic defender at the middle position, and places bigs near the basket for rebounding. It is vulnerable to outside shooting and is mainly used against poor shooting teams or high post offenses, with detailed player shifts depending on ball position.

The passage says last week’s markets turned risk-off, with major indexes breaking down from highs amid weak jobs data, policy uncertainty, and technical deterioration. It notes strong earnings overall, but says the market still sold into good earnings news.
Google Wallet may soon add fingerprint unlock, replace its separate Payments PIN with a Google Account PIN, and possibly allow users to remove the PIN requirement entirely.

A fake WhatsApp link claims PM Narendra Modi will give everyone Rs. 500 free recharge, but it is a phishing attempt that asks for personal details and then to share the link with 15 friends. The passage warns not to click, fill in information, or share such links because they may compromise privacy and be used maliciously.

Options trading in AMZN offers several strategies, including buying call and put options, writing covered or naked calls and puts, and spread trading. It can be used to speculate on price movements or hedge positions, but it carries risks such as leverage, expiration, liquidity, and margin calls. Fees, margin requirements, execution speed, and platform features depend on the broker.

Bank of New York Mellon Corp cut its Greenlight Reinsurance holdings by 8.7% in the second quarter to 193,448 shares, while several other institutional investors increased their positions. Analysts issued mixed rating changes, and Greenlight Reinsurance reported quarterly EPS of -$0.96, beating estimates, with revenue below expectations.

The passage introduces a bilinear-biquadratic Heisenberg model on a partially anisotropic triangular lattice made of isosceles triangles, and reduces the ground-state problem to a single triangle. It derives the energy in terms of spin angles, analyzes minima on tetrahedron vertices, edges, faces, and interior points, and lists corresponding ground-state configurations and energies. Phase diagrams for the Heisenberg and XY cases are also presented.

Frickley Athletic have added several players for 2017-18, including Jason Yates, Josh Nodder, Danny Patterson, Joe Austin, Tom Dugdale and Danny Swales, while Tyler Williams is staying and Jacob Hazell is returning; manager Spencer Fearn praised the new signings and said Hazell could partner Gavin Allott.

Offensive guards line up in the interior offensive line and play a crucial, under-appreciated role in both run and pass blocking. They need strength, athleticism, intelligence, and technique to handle defensive tackles, blitzes, and pull for run plays.

KPMG says AI agent deployment in major U.S. organizations has surged, with usage rising from 11% to 42% in six months and employee resistance dropping sharply. Leaders have shifted from fear to “cognitive fatigue,” while emphasizing that AI still needs human oversight, that traditional KPIs and ROI miss much of its value, and that entry-level work and recruiting are likely to change.

SanDisk’s EULA grants a limited, non-exclusive license for personal use on one computer, prohibits modification, reverse engineering, redistribution, and embedding, disclaims all warranties, limits liability, allows termination for violations, restricts high-risk use, and requires compliance with U.S. export laws and California jurisdiction. The passage also instructs not to dispose of the device with unsorted household waste.

The passage outlines early offense phases: early push, early flow, and continuity. It details how to attack outnumbered situations, breakaways, 2-on-1, 3-on-1, 3-on-2, and 3-on-3 situations, and describes several continuity offenses including Flex, Passing Game, Mid Screen, Side Screen, and Inside Triangle.

Costco sells gold, silver, and platinum to members online and at some warehouses. Buyers need a Costco membership, and in-store purchases require a pickup slip and payment at the front office. Precious metals are not returnable or price-adjustable, and buyers are advised to avoid interest-bearing financing and plan for long-term holding.

The passage reviews STEM education, project-based learning, design, and architectural studio education, then uses ethnographic observations of first-year architecture students to derive six STEM-related conclusions: students should solve open-ended problems independently, motivation should be increased, problems should be authentic and real-life based, younger students should focus on understanding problems through hands-on experience, technical drawing skills should be taught more widely, and a criticism/jury-based studio model should inform undergraduate STEM project courses.

Nathaniel Atkins’s application for a writ of error coram nobis, claiming ineffective assistance of appellate counsel, was denied because he failed to establish that he was denied effective appellate representation.

The American Red Cross says its blood supply is still recovering from March winter storms that canceled more than 270 blood drives and left over 9,500 donations uncollected, including 1,287 in Connecticut, and is urging people to donate when safe.

Acordis Technology & Solutions, the official IT Solutions Provider for the Miami Heat, will sponsor and attend the Jewish Federation of Broward County’s annual Men’s Nite Out on May 9, 2018, at The Signature Grand in Davie, Florida. This year’s speaker is Reggie Jackson, and the event is open to professionals who want to network.

The lecture explains that Fiat-Shamir is not sound for protocols with non-negligible or negligible soundness in general, but is sound in the random oracle model for constant-round public-coin protocols with negligible soundness, and more generally for protocols with round-by-round soundness. It then notes that the Hamiltonian-cycle zero-knowledge protocol is not zero knowledge under parallel repetition, and that Fiat-Shamir soundness for this protocol implies this failure of parallel zero knowledge.

The passage argues that AI is rapidly reshaping higher education by supporting personalized learning, research, administration, and collaboration, while raising concerns about bias, privacy, academic integrity, faculty resistance, and unequal access. It highlights institutional responses such as faculty training, curriculum changes, and policy frameworks, and recommends ethical, collaborative AI adoption to improve outcomes and inclusivity.

The speaker said the team stuck to its game plan, stayed composed after falling behind, and kept shooting until they scored. The passage also mentions concern about Dr. McMullen selling the team and notes that seeing the same shooter twice as a goalie can feel unusual.

The North Dakota Supreme Court reversed suppression of evidence in Denise Hahne’s DUI case, holding that law enforcement checkpoints are not required as a matter of law to provide motorists a safe or legal way to avoid them. The case was remanded to determine whether the checkpoint was constitutionally reasonable.

New Jersey ranked 25th in the Commonwealth Fund’s 2018 state healthcare scorecard, down two places from the previous year, with room to improve preventive care, hospital readmissions among elderly patients, and medical costs. It ranked 14th for access to care, 5th for covering kids, and 7th for infant mortality, but trailed all other Northeast states.

The OECD warned that threatened trade barriers and rising oil prices could hurt global growth, reduce confidence, investment and jobs, and raise inflation while lowering household incomes. It slightly lowered its world economic growth forecast to 3.8% this year and 3.9% next year.

The Court of Federal Claims held that Brister’s 1985 and 1986 tax returns were false and filed with intent to evade tax by claiming Solar Roofing withholding credits that were never paid, so the IRS’s 1993 adjustments were timely under § 6501(c)(1). Judgment was entered for the United States.

The 13/48 trading strategy uses the crossover of the 13-period and 48-period EMAs to signal bullish or bearish trades. It works best in trending stock markets, but backtests found it is prone to whipsaws and lagging, with a 5.1% annual return versus 7.2% for buy and hold.

The study examined faculty and student opinions on how distance education affects equality and inequality of opportunity in education. Faculty members said it can support equal opportunity through self-paced learning and easier access to information, but can also create inequality through technology access problems, internet issues, unsuitable learning environments, and differences in student competencies. Students said it helps through flexibility, free access, and various sources, but inequality arises from financial limits and internet problems. Suggested improvements included identifying learner characteristics, improving access to technology and internet infrastructure, increasing digital literacy, state budgeting support, and teacher consultancy.

The passage explains entangled photons and entanglement as a resource, emphasizing that entangled states must involve physically separable subsystems. It introduces Bell states, entanglement purification, and measuring entanglement via the entropy of the reduced density matrix. It also describes probabilistic entangling of atoms using emitted photons, beam splitters, and Hong-Ou-Mandel interference.

Microsoft reported it early adopted new accounting standards for revenue recognition and leases effective July 1, 2017. The changes materially affected consolidated income statements and balance sheets, but had no impact on cash flows. Revenue recognition changes mainly affected software license revenue, while leases required recognition of right-of-use assets and lease liabilities. Restated financial information for fiscal years 2017 and 2016 was provided in Exhibit 99.1.

In 2007, Victor Reinoso had to recommend a leader for the troubled Washington, DC Public Schools as the system was about to come under mayoral control. DCPS faced poor student performance, bureaucratic inefficiency, patronage, frequent leadership turnover, and widespread facilities problems. Reinoso, a reform-minded deputy mayor for education, built a team, gathered data showing severe underperformance, helped draft the mayoral takeover legislation, and searched for a chancellor committed to major, outcome-driven reform.

The paper studies uncertainty quantification for a semi-linear parabolic reaction-diffusion tumor growth model with random diffusion and proliferation coefficients, using quasi-Monte Carlo methods to estimate expectations of quantities of interest. It establishes well-posedness, derives parametric regularity and QMC error results for uniform random fields, and presents numerical experiments, including a log-normal test case on an unstructured domain.

The message is a Commissioner.COM fantasy football e-report dated November 25, 2001, containing promotional offers, NFL player injury and matchup updates, and a schedule breakdown for a fantasy matchup between Luccis Losers and Team Chick.

Mesh is a short-to-intermediate passing concept designed to create natural picks and open voids against man and zone coverage. It is effective versus man coverage and base zone defenses, but can struggle against zone blitzes or simulated pressure. The passage also outlines route assignments, quarterback progression, and variations such as mesh rail and a sit route option.

Culp reported fourth-quarter and fiscal 2017 results in line with expectations, with annual pretax income reaching a record $29.7 million, adjusted EBITDA up 7% to $40.1 million, and cash flow strong. Mattress fabrics posted record annual sales and profits, while upholstery fabrics saw lower annual sales but comparable profitability. The board approved a special dividend of $0.21 per share, and management expects first-quarter fiscal 2018 sales and pretax income to be roughly comparable to last year, with ongoing facility consolidation and potential hospitality acquisitions.

Chris Lattner, the engineer who created Swift, announced he is joining Google to work on Google Brain, after leaving Apple for Tesla and then departing Tesla after about six months. Google sees AI as a key part of its future and cloud business.

The passage describes the SEV-ES and SEV-SNP GHCB specification, including GHCB layout, protocol versions, feature advertisement, non-automatic exits, SNP restricted injection, guest identification, SMP booting, NMI handling, debug register support, and unsupported SMM and nested virtualization. It also documents GHCB-based requests such as page state change, guest request, extended guest request, APIC ID list, SNP Run VMPL, SNP TIO guest request, Secure AVIC backing page support, termination requests, and #HV doorbell, IPI, and timer behavior.

The speaker says Scotty will have to decide how much time to devote to hockey and family, since coaching requires sacrifices, but fully expects him back next year. The speaker also praises Scotty’s passion, energy, and dedication to watching and talking about hockey.

Channel 4 chief executive Alex Mahon called the broadcaster’s 28.6% gender pay gap “unacceptable” and said she is determined to improve it, aiming for 50 men and 50 women in the top 100 jobs by 2023. She said the gap reflects the mainly female lower half of the organisation and the underrepresentation of women in top-paid roles.

The invention concerns high-pressure flow devices, especially valves and fluid ends, in which seals are mounted in recesses in the body rather than in the mating closure component. This transfers erosion from the body to the less complex closure, improving service life and reducing repair downtime and cost.

CTPNet is a multivariate long-term time series forecasting framework that learns inter-channel, intra-subsequence, and inter-subsequence dependencies using channel-wise, trend-wise, and periodic-wise representation learning. It uses temporal query-based multi-head attention, downsampling, and a Transformer with linear complexity, and reports new state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.

A 34-year-old Mission man was arrested after a black pickup truck caused multiple collisions at a Maple Ridge strip mall, injuring a woman and her son. He was charged with impaired driving, hit and run, and dangerous driving causing bodily harm, then released on a promise to appear in court.

Microsoft Corporation filed an 8-K on February 26, 2020 reporting that it issued a press release updating revenue guidance for its More Personal Computing segment for the quarter ending March 30, 2020.

The speaker said it was disappointing not to score right away, but they stayed positive, kept working, and believed they were playing well in other areas. They said scoring was nice, but winning was the most important thing, and they were confident the goals would come with time.

The passage argues that generative AI is disrupting higher education assessment, creating academic integrity concerns but also opportunities to improve feedback, assessment authenticity, and AI literacy. It presents a case study where students used ChatGPT to draft essay outlines, then evaluated and refined them, and reports that students valued the training while noting AI outputs were often generic, superficial, and sometimes inaccurate.

The Louisiana Supreme Court affirmed Ray Jones Jr.’s conviction and life sentence for first degree murder of his infant son. It held that three inculpatory statements were admissible because two were spontaneous and the third was not obtained through custodial interrogation; any error in admitting the third statement was harmless beyond a reasonable doubt. It also found no abuse of discretion in limiting cross-examination of the psychiatrist.
Adam Silver said the NBA has no plan to move the 2026 All-Star Game from Los Angeles despite its investigation into the Clippers, and the event will proceed independently at Intuit Dome on Feb. 15.

Scotland’s new Abusive Behaviour and Sexual Harm Act will make disclosing or threatening to disclose intimate photos or videos a criminal offence from April 1, with a maximum penalty of five years in prison. The law targets the sharing of private images and videos, and Justice Secretary Michael Matheson said it is intended to address abusive behaviour and the harm caused by such disclosures.

The passage describes a system for active ground terrain mapping on mobile agricultural machines using a pose detection sensor to generate position and orientation signals along a route. These signals define a virtual point cloud estimated to correspond to ground surface points, from which elevation values and weighting values are generated and aggregated into georeferenced map data. The map data can be used to generate control signals for controllable subsystems such as header height, boom height, steering, propulsion, and communication systems, and may also be used to predict ground elevation ahead of the machine.

The study found broad interest in micro-credentials among Mauritian education and industry leaders, but understanding was limited and definitions varied. Respondents preferred a hybrid, competency-based model integrated into the national qualifications framework and university credit systems, with reliable assessment and phased implementation.

Matthew Shashy, 29, of Montgomery, was sentenced to four years of probation after a federal jury found him guilty of impeding, intimidating, and interfering with Air Force personnel at Maxwell Air Force Base. He had fired a shotgun three times outside the base in January 2017 after spray-painting anti-government graffiti, and was later identified and surrendered to law enforcement.

Brookfield Infrastructure Partners has delivered strong historical returns, with adjusted AFFO rising from $352M in 2012 to $926M, and currently offers a 4% distribution yield. The passage says future growth may come from infrastructure opportunities, retained cash flows, asset rotation, and issuing units, though future returns are expected to be lower than in the past.

A Phase 2 trial found that 16 weeks of omalizumab plus oral immunotherapy improved desensitization in children with multiple food allergies: 83 percent could safely consume two grams of at least two allergenic foods after 36 weeks, versus 33 percent with placebo and OIT, and omalizumab reduced adverse events during early OIT.

Archaeologists searched debris in a narrow gap at City Hall for Willie Halpin’s Easter Rising rifle but did not find it. They uncovered other artefacts, including roof fragments with a bullet hole, glass milk bottles, a teapot lid, and pottery, and suggested the rifle may have been removed soon after the Rising.

The passage explains that credit bureaus like Equifax began as tools for businesses to assess customers’ creditworthiness and have grown into large corporations that collect extensive financial data without people opting in. It also notes that lawmakers have struggled to regulate them for fifty years.

A $5.25 million gift from former Western University professor John Knight’s estate will support LHSC’s translational ovarian cancer research, honoring his wife Mary, who died of the disease in 2008. The funds will be used for researchers, equipment, and collaborations, and Victoria Hospital’s A-block lobby was named the Mary and John Knight atrium.

ETF Channel estimates the Vanguard Mid-Cap Growth ETF (VOT) has an implied analyst target price of $145.80 per unit, 9.77% above its recent price of $132.83. Notable underlying holdings with upside include Sensata Technologies Holding, Global Payments, and Markel.

Tanzania launched the Tanzania Business Clinic to speed up business climate reforms by identifying solutions to company and sector challenges. It follows a Cabinet-approved blueprint to amend laws and regulations, with implementation starting in the 2018/19 financial year to improve the business environment and attract investment.

Former Facebook executives Chamath Palihapitiya and Sean Parker expressed regret about Facebook and social media’s societal effects, citing guilt, harm to social fabric, misinformation, and negative impacts on children and productivity. Palihapitiya said he will use the money he was paid to focus on structural changes he can control.

Voters in Julia Banks’ Chisholm electorate were largely unaware of questions over her possible dual Greek Australian citizenship, while local opinions on a potential byelection were mixed. Chisholm, a multicultural Melbourne seat won by Banks from Labor in 2016 by 2.84 per cent, could likely be competitive for Labor if a byelection were held, according to one politics lecturer and a Labor strategist.

GPT-5’s launch was widely criticized for glitches, inaccurate charts, and a model some users found unfriendly, with critics saying it failed to meet OpenAI’s high expectations. The passage also says Sam Altman says the model was misunderstood and that he has changed his view on AGI.

The passage lists many soccer hand signals and other non-verbal cues used by teammates, goalkeepers, and coaches to communicate actions such as passes, runs, set pieces, substitutions, defensive movement, and throw-in or free-kick instructions, especially when crowd noise prevents oral communication.

The passage describes SD memory card bus speed modes and initialization sequences for UHS-I and UHS-II, including 1.8V voltage switching, 4-bit bus requirements, tuning with CMD19, and function selection with CMD6. It also outlines card identification/data transfer modes, CMD8 and ACMD41 initialization rules, erase/discard operations, lock/unlock and Card Ownership Protection using CMD42, and application-specific command handling with CMD55.

An 11-year-old boy, Damian Sunderland, was attacked by a relative's dog and will need months of surgery, including recent skin grafts to his cheeks, lower jaw, nose, and recreated lips. He was hospitalized at Children's Mercy and the University of Kansas Hospital after the June 20 attack.

President Ulysses S. Grant warned against illegal military expeditions being organized in the United States against Canada, urged citizens not to aid them, and ordered U.S. officers to prevent, stop, and arrest those involved.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s Blackwell GPU architecture, highlighting the AI Management Processor for GPU context scheduling, new 4:2:2 video encode/decode and DisplayPort 2.1b support, power-efficiency improvements, DLSS 4 with multi-frame generation and transformer-based models, neural shaders and related AI rendering features, and specifications for GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs.

VentureWire’s May 22, 2001 issue reported Kodiak Venture Partners closed its second fund at $290 million, Mercury Interactive bought Freshwater Software for $147 million, Celetron raised $48 million, and TVM held a first close on a new life science fund. It also covered numerous new financings, acquisitions, staff cuts, executive changes, and fund news across technology and venture-backed companies.

A phase 2/3 study in Indian children and adolescents aged 2 to 17 years found SII-NVX-CoV2373 safe, well tolerated, and highly immunogenic, with non-inferior anti-S IgG and neutralizing antibody responses versus adults and robust responses against Delta, Omicron BA.1, and BA.5. No vaccine-related serious adverse events or adverse events of special interest were reported.

The study examined third-year distance-learning B.Ed. students and lecturers at North-West University to assess Physical Education teacher training in distance mode. It found generally positive lecturer interaction, growing student confidence, and useful video-based practical learning, but also obstacles such as limited prior knowledge, technology and internet problems, delays in assignment administration and feedback, and reduced physical contact. Recommendations included more face-to-face contact, better technological training, improved video use, stronger online interaction, and better administrative systems.

Mud Bay, a Pacific Northwest pet store chain, used employee ownership and a Good Jobs Vision to raise wages, improve benefits and training, simplify assortment, standardize some processes, and partner with animal organizations. From 2014 to 2017, sales grew 70% and turnover fell from 48% to 31%, but profit margins declined as costs rose. In 2018, leaders debated whether to close stores an hour earlier to improve employee schedules and reduce labor costs.

The passage explains that poor document management costs businesses time, money, and customers, while better document management improves workflow, productivity, and business growth. It describes Xerox tools for scanning, sharing, controlling printing, and managing supplies through cloud and mobile apps.

Passports may be issued only to U.S. citizens who satisfy legal rules proving citizenship, U.S. domicile, and intent to return; they are not required for every applicant. A person who has expatriated himself or is permanently domiciled abroad cannot receive one, and individual circumstances determine whether passport issuance is appropriate.

A city court reserved its order on Shashi Tharoor’s anticipatory bail plea until tomorrow in the Sunanda Pushkar death case. Delhi Police opposed the plea, saying he might flee, influence witnesses, or hamper the investigation, while Tharoor’s lawyers argued the chargesheet said he cooperated and no custodial interrogation was needed. He has been summoned as an accused and charged under IPC sections 498A and 306, but has not been arrested.

Matt Barbet has launched the Home Roads podcast, where he chats with cyclists and other figures while riding with them on their home roads. Launching on June 8, the first episodes feature Alex Dowsett, Sarah Storey, Nicolas Roche and David Millar, with more episodes to follow including Ben Saunders, Simon Warren, Simon Mottram and Philippa York.

The 200-day moving average is a simple long-term trend indicator used to smooth price fluctuations and identify uptrends or downtrends. The passage says it can help avoid bear markets and lower drawdowns, but it also produces many whipsaws and may underperform buy-and-hold when markets keep rising.

The lecture discusses hinged dissections, their examples, construction techniques, software and hardware possibilities, pseudopolynomial bounds, and 3D dissection theory. It also covers the Dehn invariant, conditions for 3D and 4D dissections, and open problems in higher dimensions.

The NVIDIA A100 GPU improves DRAM, L2, and NVLink bandwidth, adds a larger 40 MB L2 cache with residency controls and compute data compression, and supports MIG to partition one GPU into up to seven isolated GPU instances. It also introduces features such as third-generation Tensor Cores, PCIe Gen 4, NVJPG decode, improved atomics, NVDEC, CUDA task graphs, async copy, asynchronous barriers, and structured sparsity support.
Researchers found that New Caledonian crows and kea parrots performed better at tool-use tasks after first exploring objects, suggesting they learned object properties through play.

NAE events are non-AE exit events handled by #VC and VMGEXIT, with guests and hypervisors exchanging required state through the GHCB using VALID_BITMAP and SW_EXITCODE fields. The passage describes supported NAE types and protocols for MMIO, page state changes, guest requests, AP creation, #HV doorbell and timer events, Secure AVIC, termination, and interrupt delivery, including host and guest responsibilities.

The passage contains hockey coach and player comments about winning, injuries, physical play, goaltending, lineup uncertainty, and preparing for a Stanley Cup series against Boston. It also includes praise for specific players’ effort, speed, and physicality, and emphasizes taking things one game at a time.

Joan Jordan, an Irish engineer diagnosed with MS in 2010, says she was repeatedly rejected for jobs after becoming ill but is now working part-time again. She has written a book about living with MS and is speaking at a World MS Day event where MS Ireland is launching a report on improving MS research in Ireland.

The Saskatchewan Roughriders are considering using return specialist Christion Jones in the defensive backfield, as he has practiced extensively there as an “emergency DB” for Thursday’s game. Jones says he is ready to play multiple positions, while head coach Chris Jones says the team limits his workload to protect his return game, though he could be used on defense if needed.

The passage describes memory devices that use configurable, variable address obfuscation to map logical addresses to physical addresses in memory arrays. The mapping can differ by device, die, array, or over time, and may support wear-leveling while making wear patterns harder to reverse-engineer.

The passage is a SanDisk Sansa Fuze manual covering safety and hearing warnings, cleaning and disposal tips, player features, charging, basic operation, file transfer, playback of music, audiobooks, videos, photos, FM radio, voice recording, deletion, settings, troubleshooting, support, warranty, and software license terms.
Camel engravings at Jebel Misma, made more than 12,000 years ago by some of the first people in the region, suggest early human presence in a once-verdant Arabian Desert landscape.

The passage argues that schools overemphasize vague “skills” like critical thinking and metacognition while neglecting actual knowledge in subjects such as history, science, math, languages, and the arts. It says broad background knowledge is essential for reading, understanding, and critical thought, and that policies and curricula should prioritize knowledge-rich instruction.

Using 2021 Nigeria Malaria Indicator Survey data, the study found that 56% of households owned at least one insecticide-treated net, 41.4% of children under 5 and 49.6% of pregnant women slept under one. Usage was associated with residence, geopolitical zone, and wealth, with higher use in rural households and in North East/North West regions, but overall coverage remained below the 80% national target.

NVIDIA’s quarterly report for the period ended May 1, 2022 showed revenue of $8.29 billion and net income of $1.62 billion, with growth in Graphics and Compute & Networking revenue. The company recorded a $1.35 billion acquisition termination cost after ending the Arm purchase agreement, repurchased $2.0 billion of stock, paid $100 million in dividends, and held $20.34 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities.

Mario Batali is taking a leave of absence from his businesses after reports of inappropriate and sexual misconduct accusations by multiple women, including a chef and three former employees. He apologized, said some allegations matched his past behavior, and was removed from the cast of ABC’s “The Chew.”

HMD Global has kept Nokia phones updated, but 136 days after promising to share the Nokia 8 kernel source code and modifications, it still had not done so. The passage says this would violate the GPLv2, has drawn criticism from developer Francisco Franco, and notes that HMD also will not unlock the Nokia 8 bootloader for security reasons.

Researchers say 39 fossils from Newfoundland, dated to about 560 million years ago, may be the remains of a spongelike animal rather than decomposed material. The newly identified creature, named after punk rocker John Lydon for its spiky appearance, had pores, fingerlike tubes, and was likely a filter feeder that lived on top of other organisms.

Researchers found that Black Mamba, Western Green Mamba, and Jamesons Mamba venoms can cause limp paralysis first and then spastic paralysis after antivenom treatment, explaining why current antivenoms sometimes fail. The study also found regional venom differences, especially in Black Mamba populations from Kenya and South Africa, and suggested specialized antivenoms are needed.

This systematic review of 20 studies found that AI in higher education can improve assessment efficiency, standardization, grading consistency, and personalized feedback. It also identified challenges including bias, privacy, transparency, and limits in evaluating subjective work, and stressed the need for ethical, pedagogical, and human oversight.

The speaker says the cheering was taken as support and encouragement before going into Detroit, and emphasizes a realistic, reactive approach to the game based on players’ tendencies once the puck reaches them.

The speaker describes being physically involved in a tense game, contributing to two goals, and focusing on helping the team win. He says it feels great to have his parents and brother watching the Stanley Cup Finals. He also praises Cory as an underrated player who moves the puck well and creates plays.

The passage lists Birmingham City FC’s ten best away days from the last decade, including notable wins, late goals, promotion-clinching matches, and dramatic survival results at Bristol City, Wolves, Fulham, Reading, Derby, Club Brugge, Tottenham, Crystal Palace, Shamrock Rovers, and Bolton.

The Deepwater Horizon, leased by BP from Transocean, exploded on April 20, 2010, killing 11 workers, injuring 17, and causing the largest marine oil spill in U.S. waters. The passage describes BP’s history, restructuring, and prior safety problems, then outlines disputed decisions on the Macondo well—casing design, centralizers, mud circulation, and a cement bond log—that were linked to cost, time, and safety trade-offs.

Ray Lewis, Brian Urlacher, and Randy Moss were elected to the Pro Football Hall of Fame on their first try, while Terrell Owens was elected on his third ballot. Brian Dawkins also joined the eight-person class, along with Bobby Beathard, Jerry Kramer, and Robert Brazile.

An Acer Swift 16 AI laptop is on sale for $800, or $450 off, at Best Buy’s Techtober event. It includes 16 GB of RAM, 1 TB of storage, a 16-inch OLED 2,880 x 1,800 display with a 120-Hz refresh rate, and an Intel Core Ultra 7 256V CPU.

The lecture introduces limited attention, showing through experiments and stock-market examples that people miss important information when it is not salient. It presents Chetty et al.’s evidence that consumers underreact to sales taxes, and a seaweed-farming study showing that people may fail to learn when they do not attend to the right variables.

The Department disapproved Mr. Allen’s intervention in the Kim Ok-kiun murder case, saying the U.S. consul-general at Shanghai had no jurisdiction. Mr. Sill reported that Korean rebels had defeated government forces and captured Chon-ju, warned that Seoul and American residents were at risk, and asked Admiral Skerrett for a ship at Chemulpo. Mr. Denby reported that China had sent troops and warships to Korea at the Korean king’s request to aid against the insurgents.

FDR’s inaugural address said the nation faced fear and economic संकट, blamed failures in banking and business, and called for immediate government action to put people to work, restore confidence, regulate finance, and pursue national recovery through unity, discipline, and a good-neighbor foreign policy.

The passage covers the California power crisis, including blackouts, utility debt and defaults, emergency state and federal actions, and debates over price caps. It also notes Enron-related reports, a long-term energy management deal with Owens-Illinois, and several other energy and utility news items.
@ThingsExpo was named a top IoT and M2M media brand by Onalytica, based on Twitter analysis of IoT/M2M conversations and influencer rankings.

Trump has shown willingness to reverse major policy positions, including on China’s currency status. An analyst suggested he could also reconsider leaving the Trans-Pacific Partnership, which he withdrew from in January; the treaty text remains valid until February 2018, and Japan and the other remaining members are trying to revive the deal without the U.S.

The MACD and RSI strategy combines two momentum indicators to analyze trends and potential market moves. The passage says the combination can be useful, but it should be based on clear trading rules and backtesting, since the indicators can also be redundant and results vary by market and settings.

The flexbone is a run-heavy offense evolved from the wishbone, built on option plays, misdirection, and some play-action passing. It uses specific personnel roles, creates ball-control and assignment-confusion advantages, but can be limited by a weak pass game, heavy practice demands, and weather.

Nifty50 rose 29.65 points, but the market remained range-bound with short covering and rollover activity dominating. Key resistance is seen at 10,650 and 10,695, with support at 10,585 and 10,510. Technical indicators are bullish, but a clear breakout has not occurred, so caution is advised.

Jeff Carter and Drew Doughty discussed a playoff overtime goal, the team’s two-game lead, and the plan to reset before returning to Los Angeles. Carter called it his first playoff overtime goal and a special moment, while Doughty said the series would be treated as starting over with home-ice advantage.

Mississippi State (8-0) will play its first road game Tuesday at Cincinnati (7-2), a tough non-conference matchup at BB&T Arena. Key factors are Cincinnati’s turnover issues, the Bearcats’ strong offensive rebounding, and Mississippi State’s deeper rotation, with Eli Wright expected back from suspension.

German Protestants are using Twitter services in Magdeburg to attract churchgoers and engage people online. Pastor Ralf Peter Reimann says social media can help retain and gain followers, though the experiment has mixed reactions, especially among older worshippers.

The A100 Tensor Core GPU supports TF32, FP16/BF16 mixed precision, FP64 acceleration, structured sparsity, larger L1/shared memory and L2 caches, HBM2 memory with ECC, third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, MIG partitioning, and CUDA features such as task graphs, async copy, barriers, and L2 residency controls. It is presented as improving deep learning, HPC, multi-tenant isolation, and data-center scalability.

Larry Swedroe’s portfolio is an evidence-based, diversified 30/70 stock-bond strategy designed for long-term growth with lower risk. It emphasizes low-cost index funds, small-cap value, value investing, periodic rebalancing, and avoiding market timing. The passage says the backtested annual return was 3.71%, and that the heavy bond allocation makes it less suited to short-term gains.

The passage discusses Berkshire Hathaway’s share repurchase program, noting that purchases were made only in 2012 after the buyback threshold was raised to 120% of book value, and none occurred from 2013 to 2016. It argues that book value understates Berkshire’s intrinsic value and suggests the 120% threshold should be increased so repurchases could occur more often.

European stocks were set for their biggest weekly loss since November 2016 as rising bond yields and a stronger euro weighed on markets, with the STOXX 600 down about 1.7-1.8 percent and banks hit by weak results from Deutsche Bank, Caixabank and Sabadell. Investors were also watching U.S. payrolls data and the impact of U.S. tech earnings on European stocks.

The court reversed summary judgment for Personal Service Insurance Company and George Johnson, Jr. It held that under Florida tort law George Johnson, Jr. could be personally liable for Fred Johnson’s negligent driving with permission, and that the Ohio bond could contractually cover that liability, so the case was remanded for further proceedings.

The paper examines how an Australian university addressed limited primary pre-service teachers’ arts education competencies by creating an Arts Specialism. Using education policy sociology and critical discourse analysis, it traces the development, text production, and implementation of four arts courses, arguing that the specialisation helped improve knowledge, confidence, and teaching readiness despite time and resource constraints.

The passage describes historical and legendary accounts of children reportedly raised by animals or in the wild, including Jean de Liège, an Irish “sheep-boy,” and a Texas “Wolf Girl,” while noting that many such tales are hoaxes or doubtful.

A free five-week self-management course for adults in Angus with chronic pain will begin in Montrose in May, offering sessions on pain understanding, stress management, pacing, flare-ups, relaxation and medication. The course, delivered by Pain Association Scotland for Angus Health and Social Care Partnership, aims to improve coping and quality of life, and places can be booked by phone or email.

SEV-ES debug register virtualization is supported when “DebugVirtualization” is enabled; otherwise DR7 reads and writes are intercepted. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported. The #HV doorbell page uses PendingEvent and NoEoiRequired to signal interrupts and non-maskable events, with host and guest rules for presenting, acknowledging, and completing interrupts and EOIs.

The passage says iPhones trade some innovation for stronger security, with built-in encryption, two-factor authentication prompts, remote wipe and location tools, permission controls, and regular updates. It also says iOS is not immune to malware, but Apple’s closed hardware and software ecosystem reduces security risks compared with Android.

U.S. homebuilders’ sentiment slipped to 68 in April from 71 in March, though it remained above 50 and favorable. Measures of current sales, future sales, and buyer traffic also declined. Despite this, new home sales have been robust, supported by low mortgage rates and a solid job market.

Last shot situations require preparation, simple execution, and getting the ball to the best player. Teams should hold for the last shot with less than 30 seconds remaining when leading or trailing by fewer than eight points, save timeouts, practice long passes and rebounding, and use predefined inbound plays under pressure.

Canadians who fought in the Korean War are being remembered as tensions rise again on the Korean Peninsula, but former diplomat Marius Grinius says Canada lost influence with North Korea after adopting a “controlled engagement” policy. He and others argue Canada has humanitarian and security reasons to re-engage, while North Korea continues nuclear and missile tests and the United States warns that “the era of strategic patience is over.”

The passage describes SD card block write, erase, discard, FULE, write protection, lock/unlock, and switch-function commands, including CRC protection, error conditions, busy signaling, command sequences, timeout rules, and differences between card types and capacities.

October’s sky features a supermoon on October 6, the Draconid meteor shower around October 8, and the Orionid meteor shower peaking on October 21. The Orionids are associated with Halley’s Comet, and the Draconids come from debris from comet 21P Giacobini-Zinner.

The lecture covers permutation matrices for reordering rows or columns in systems of equations and introduces eigenvalues and eigenvectors through diffusion and Plinko examples. It explains how to find eigenvalues using det(A − λI) = 0, discusses algebraic and geometric multiplicity, and shows when a matrix can be diagonalized using a complete set of eigenvectors. It also notes applications to solving linear systems and systems of ordinary differential equations.

Taylor Swift has broken numerous records across her career, including youngest country chart and CMA winner, multiple Grammy album of the year milestones, most American Music Awards, most No. 1s on Billboard’s US Digital Song Sales chart, most weeks at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Country Albums chart, longest song to reach No. 1, and several streaming records on Spotify, Apple Music, and Amazon Music. Her Eras Tour became the highest-grossing music tour ever, and she is reported to have a net worth of $1.6 billion.

Backtests on SPY suggest EMA strategies work best with short periods for mean reversion and long periods for trend following. EMA gives more weight to recent prices than SMA, follows price more closely, and still lags, so it can produce false signals and is often used with other indicators.

The study conducted a systematic review of leading Information Systems journals (2000–2017) and reduced 292 articles to 28 final papers. It identified underlying dimensions of digital transformation, digital business strategy, and organizational capabilities, and proposed a framework showing their interrelationship, with digital business strategy and organizational capabilities supporting digital transformation.

YouTube said April the giraffe’s livestream became the second-most-watched live channel in company history, with over 232 million live views. The stream began on Feb. 10 at Animal Adventure Park in New York and peaked when April gave birth to a male calf on Saturday.

The Foreign Relations editors use State Department, presidential library, and other agency records, including declassified and still-classified materials accessed through special arrangements, and document access may be limited by declassification status or archival transfer. Documents are arranged chronologically by Washington time and are reproduced as closely as possible to the originals, with editorial conventions for corrections, omissions, headings, and notes on classified or missing material.

The paper studies multi-period resource allocation under stochastic demands. It solves a static convex formulation with a bisection method, then proposes a sequential shrinking-horizon policy that conditions future demand distributions on observed demands. Simulations with jointly log-normal demands show the sequential policy outperforms the static and roll-forward methods and approaches the oracle bound.

The passage argues that digital transformation depends not only on technology but also on culture, especially data culture. Digital leaders tend to adopt a growth mindset, encourage experimentation and learning, share data transparently, use measurement to guide decisions, and align the organization around common goals. Digital laggards more often favor short-term optimization, restricted data access, subjective judgment, and poorly grounded goals.

The article argues that anti-CRT bans in Idaho, Utah, and Arizona silence Native perspectives, perpetuate Native invisibility, and discourage culturally sustaining pedagogy in teacher education. Using TribalCrit and stories from teacher education settings, the authors contend that settler-colonial and whitewashed narratives continue to shape public education and that critical democracy requires teaching Native history, sovereignty, and content at all levels.

Five-year-old Lyla Carreyn is back home after receiving a kidney from her 4K teacher, Beth Battista, and being hospitalized since February 21. She had post-surgery complications, including a hard-to-treat infection, and will still need daily medications, frequent lab work, and possible re-admission if signs of infection or rejection appear.
Tesla reported that on September 4, 2020 it completed the sale of $5.0 billion of common stock through its at-the-market offering program, with final settlement expected by September 9, 2020.

The study used U.S. COVID-19 Trends and Impact Survey data from September 2020 to May 2021 to estimate county-month mask-wearing behavior, correcting for sampling and response bias with raking, Bayesian binomial regression, and vaccination-based debiasing. It found strong spatial heterogeneity, higher masking in urban counties, a peak in January 2021, a decline in May 2021, and that community-reported masking closely matched bias-corrected self-reports.

The passage argues that stocks and bonds are both in bubbles and highlights a technical ratio chart of 10-year yields versus the S&P 500 as a warning sign. It says the ratio has broken trend support, may be forming a head and shoulders pattern, and could signal a multi-year bear market unless yields fall or stocks rise.

The lecture introduces walking robots as a control challenge, emphasizing limit cycles and impacts as key difficulties. It explains limit cycle stability using the Van der Pol oscillator and Poincaré maps, then applies these ideas to walking models such as the rimless wheel, compass gait, and kneed walkers, highlighting passive dynamic walking and ground-impact energy loss.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K on May 9, 2017, announcing a press release and CFO commentary on its results for the quarter ended April 30, 2017, including exhibits for the first quarter fiscal 2018 financial results.

The address says there is less need for a detailed statement at the start of the second presidential term because the war and public declarations are already well known. It recalls that the Civil War arose from disagreement over slavery, describes slavery as the central cause, and says the war may be part of God’s purposes. It ends by urging charity, firmness, healing the nation’s wounds, and pursuing lasting peace.

The passage says trend following in gold works well, especially using a 12-month moving average. A simple rule of being long when gold is above the average and in cash when below outperformed buy and hold, avoided major drawdowns, and captured gold’s big moves. Gold is described as a non-cashflowing asset that can serve as an inflation hedge, though the stock market is suggested as a better hedge.

This study tested 147 imipenem-resistant gram-negative isolates from Evercare Hospital, Dhaka, using disc potentiation tests for KPC and MBL. All isolates were carbapenem-resistant; resistance was highest in patients over 60 and in ICU samples. Acinetobacter baumannii was the main organism carrying both enzymes, and tracheal aspirates had the most dual-enzyme-positive samples.

The passage is an excerpt from a Texas Instruments MSPM0G datasheet describing analog reference requirements, switching/linearity notes, and the device’s peripherals and features, including the CPU, power modes, clocking, DMA, events, memory, GPIO, ADC, VREF, comparators, DAC, security blocks, communication interfaces, timers, debugging, bootloader, factory constants, application notes, and revision history.

The passage discusses coaching decisions on power plays, ice time, line usage, and managing player confidence and fatigue in a tight series against Detroit. It also highlights the leadership and positive impact of Sean upon his return, notes effective defensive pairings and strong opposition defense, and emphasizes the need for patience, discipline, and a reset after a frustrating game without a goal.

The court reversed the rehabilitative alimony and related financial awards because they exceeded Kenneth Kaylor’s ability to pay, and remanded for a new award consistent with Sharon Kaylor’s needs and his ability to pay. All other parts of the dissolution judgment were affirmed.

The passage describes several AGESA host services: stackless routines to create and later disable a pre-memory stack region on all processor cores, a structure-creation service with multiple allocation methods, and stack-required queries for DIMM data eye results, APIC address, and available pre-memory execution cache size.

The passage reviews curriculum literacy as the ability to understand, evaluate, and apply educational programs, and argues it is important for teachers, administrators, and students. It reports a thematic content analysis of 29 English and Turkish articles from Scopus, finding rising research after 2015, most studies in social sciences, and concentrations in Australia, the United States, and Turkey. The study highlights digital technology, artificial intelligence, equity, and interdisciplinary integration as key themes and calls for more training and broader research on curriculum literacy.

Vietnamese higher education digitalization was slow before COVID-19 but has accelerated under government policy and the pandemic. Most HEIs now use digital platforms, online learning, and digitalized materials, though progress varies and challenges remain in infrastructure, skills, funding, and coordination.

S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit fresh records as AMD shares jumped after OpenAI announced a deal to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs over multiple years. AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million shares, which could give OpenAI about a 10% stake if fully exercised.

The Nasdaq 100 E-mini futures contract is an electronically traded, cash-settled futures contract based on the Nasdaq 100 index. It trades on CME Globex, expires quarterly, and has a contract size equal to the index value multiplied by $20. The all-time high is 16,676.50 and the all-time low is 797.50. Main price factors include Fed rate decisions, component price changes, economic news, and the US Dollar Index.

The speaker describes a special bond with Alex and happiness for him and the team, saying they overcame criticism and came back in every series. He says he felt personally calm and in a good place, loved working in Washington, and believed changes were needed because the team had lost quality people. He praises Kuznetsov, Holtz, and others, and reflects on lifting the Cup as especially meaningful because of family sacrifices and people who supported his coaching career.

Tube UK provided ten audio systems for five floats and five stages at Manchester’s 2017 Manchester Day celebrations, managed by a nine-person crew in one day. The setup included battery-powered float systems, compere PAs, and larger music stages, with the main finale system in Cathedral Gardens for 2,000-plus people.

The speakers credit a key play for a goal, reflect on a difficult summer and support received, say they are focused on reaching the Stanley Cup, note growing confidence through the series, and praise Manny’s advice to play a simple, north-south game.

Jonathan Rinderknecht, 29, was charged with starting the fire that destroyed much of Pacific Palisades and became Los Angeles’ most destructive blaze. Authorities said he lit a New Year’s Day fire that later reignited, fled the scene, returned to watch it burn, and gave inconsistent statements during an interview.

Pets at Home in Burton is partnering with the National Autistic Society for an autism hour on Sunday, October 8, opening an hour early with reduced lights, music and till bells to create a calmer, autism-friendly environment. The initiative is part of a UK-wide event, and the National Autistic Society says 64% of autistic people sometimes avoid shops because of their autism.

A bear trap is a bullish trading pattern where a sharp drop tricks traders into thinking a downtrend will continue, but the price quickly reverses and rises. The passage explains how to spot it using chart patterns, indicators like MACD and RSI, fundamentals, and backtesting, and says retail traders can avoid it by not acting on FOMO, considering broader conditions, and sticking to a tested strategy.

Samsung’s new Chromebook Pro and Chromebook Plus are designed to run Android apps on Chrome OS, reflecting Google’s effort to merge desktop and mobile computing. The 2-in-1 devices include built-in digital pens, 4K streaming, two USB-C ports, and improved ChromeVox assistive features, with the Pro starting at $549 and the Plus at $449.99.

Orca has submitted its T cell therapy for FDA approval, alongside other biotech news including TCGX’s $1.3 billion fund, Skye’s failed obesity drug study, and FDA approval of a second generic mifepristone.

The passage describes Turing GPU features including improved memory compression and about 50% higher effective bandwidth than Pascal, new display and video engines with 8K and HDR support, VirtualLink for VR headsets, NVLink-based SLI, real-time ray tracing with RT Cores, NGX AI features such as DLSS, mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, multi-view rendering, and updated GPU specifications for TU102, TU104, and TU106.

Rihanna and French President Emmanuel Macron headlined a conference in Senegal that raised hundreds of millions of dollars for education in developing countries. Macron pledged 200 million euros to the fund and said education is the only response to extremism and fundamentalism in West Africa.

Meizu announced the M5s, an updated version of the M5, for China on February 20. It has a 5.2-inch HD display, MediaTek MT6753 processor, 3GB RAM, 13MP rear camera, 5MP front camera, 3,000mAh battery, and runs Android 6.0 Marshmallow with Flyme OS. Prices start at 799 Yuan for 16GB and 999 Yuan for 32GB, with international availability unknown.

Global stocks traded in narrow ranges as investors awaited fresh drivers, with most Asian shares lower, European markets little changed, and U.S. futures flat amid concerns over trade tensions and North Korea.

Amazon has expanded Whole Foods discounts for Prime members to 12 more states, offering 10 percent off sale items and other weekly discounts, with plans for nationwide rollout by the end of summer. Prime members also get free two-hour delivery on $35-plus orders.

Several university leadership appointments were announced, including interim and permanent presidencies at Northwestern University, Winston-Salem State University, Lee University, SUNY Geneseo, and Texas A&M University.

The passage lists dated files and telegrams related to American plans and preparations for the Peace Conference, then includes a memorandum from Breckinridge Long proposing a secret bureau to study likely Peace Conference issues under the Secretary of State, with expert advisers on various regions and subjects.

Jonathan Toews, Kimmo Timonen, and Trevor van Riemsdyk said the series has been very tight, with both teams deserving and focused on the next game. County officials say a reduced computer tax rate and an $863,000 water-sewer credit helped attract Facebook without costing taxpayers, and they hope the deal will bring more data centers to Henrico.

The rocket carried a three-kilogram University of Tokyo satellite to test low-cost micro-satellite launches amid growing private-sector demand.

Reservations are required, hikes are limited to 30 people, and participants should wear appropriate clothing and bring water.

Lee said people have not been given a fair shot, while Smith emphasized that women of color are the most left out.

The changes aim to give clearer refund information and make the company that assembles the package responsible for the whole holiday, with support from Which? and Consumer minister Margot James.

Some hurricane-affected consumers can enroll until Dec. 31, many subsidized enrollees may pay lower premiums in 2018, and state-run marketplaces have later deadlines.

The project will examine capturing CO2 from coal-burning plants, as Wyoming’s coal industry faces long-term risks from emissions regulations and demand for cleaner energy.

Kim Jong-un attended the Pyongyang celebrations amid speculation about a possible new nuclear test, while China warned that conflict could break out at any moment.

On April 17, NASA’s Terra satellite observed its cloud band, while JTWC reported a compact westward-moving circulation and said wind shear and dry air should prevent re-intensification.

The new polymer £10 note, featuring Jane Austen, entered circulation in September 2017 and is designed to last longer and be harder to counterfeit.
