A rumor from Mac Otakara says Apple’s next iPhone may take design cues from the Apple Watch, with a rounded polished stainless steel frame between glass front and back panels, a hidden Touch ID sensor, and vertically aligned dual cameras.

The study evaluated zero-shot, scratch training, fine-tuning, and multi-head fine-tuning of a MACE foundation model for surface systems. Fine-tuning consistently improved prediction accuracy and physical realism for Au, RuO2, and BiVO4 surfaces versus training from scratch, while multi-head fine-tuning helped preserve bulk performance and improved out-of-domain predictions for other unary metals, though at higher computational cost.

The passage argues that trauma-informed human rights education in higher education should address the risk of retraumatization by combining values clarification, inclusive content design, and dialogic teaching. It recommends that educators cultivate a rights-respecting teaching persona, embed the UN’s learn about/through/for human rights framework into curricula, use reflective and co-created learning, and include survivors and practitioners to support agency, dignity, and advocacy.

The white paper says manufacturing firms face geopolitical, energy, supply chain, labor, and sustainability pressures, and argues that IT-based simulation, modeling, analysis, and HPC can improve innovation, quality, efficiency, and digital transformation. It reports growing use of these tools, but also notes challenges such as data silos, outdated or inaccurate simulations, security concerns, cost, and energy consumption.

The paper studies whether earnings press release text predicts announcement-day stock returns using LDA, BERT, MPNet, and FinBERT on over 134,000 press releases from 2006–2023. It finds soft information is about as informative as earnings surprise, with FinBERT performing best. A trading strategy based on public release signals does not earn excess returns after market open, but leaked pre-release information improves stock ranking accuracy.

A Federal Reserve rate hike will likely raise costs for credit card debt, home equity lines, and some adjustable-rate mortgages, while mortgage and auto loan rates may change little. Savers may see slight increases in some CDs and savings accounts, and higher U.S. rates can attract overseas investment and reduce capital in developing countries.

A UCLA study found that meat-based food for U.S. dogs and cats and their waste generate about 64 million tons of carbon dioxide a year, while experts noted pets have an environmental footprint but warned against plant-based diets for cats and some dogs because of health risks.

U.S. Treasury yields rose after a jobs report showed 33,000 payroll losses, a 4.2% unemployment rate, and 2.9% hourly wage growth. Traders focused on the wage gains and inflation concerns, while also watching geopolitical risks and upcoming Treasury debt auctions.

The passage contains several news articles about Enron-related oil deals, Artesia Technologies’ $26 million funding with Enron Broadband Services as an investor, and Houston’s proposed downtown basketball arena, focusing on public financing, taxpayer costs, and comparisons with other arena deals.

The Vegas Golden Knights are preparing for the NHL expansion draft, with existing teams submitting protected lists and Vegas selecting one player from each team to build its first roster. Teams may protect either 11 players in a fixed format or 9 in a more flexible format, and must expose certain forwards, defencemen, and a goalie who meet contract and games-played requirements.

The University of Notre Dame received $205 million in gifts over two weeks, including $150 million from Matthew and Joyce Walsh to rename its School of Architecture and a separate gift from Francis and Kathleen Rooney to endow an institute for the study of American democracy.

The passage argues that Siri should be able to learn new words, pronunciations, nicknames, and user-defined meanings through voice commands, which would make interactions more flexible and improve Siri over time. It says Siri’s current nickname and contact-related features are too limited and that Apple should add this learning ability.

Apple Inc. reported that at its February 13, 2018 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, all eight listed directors were elected, Ernst & Young LLP was ratified as independent auditor for 2018, executive compensation and the amended Non-Employee Director Stock Plan were approved, and the “Shareholder Proxy Access Amendments” and “Human Rights Committee” proposals were not approved.

North Park Elementary in San Bernardino reopened a week after a shooting that killed a teacher and an 8-year-old boy, with students returning amid hugs, support, tightened security, and counselors. School officials said the reopening was a step toward healing and that the school would not let the attack disrupt its commitment to students.

Amsterdam’s Buiksloterham is using an experimental, temporary docklands regeneration centred on De Ceuvel, a sustainable co-working hub on renovated houseboats that reuses waste, generates renewable energy, and helps clean polluted land. The project aims to support an inclusive, circular neighbourhood rather than luxury development.

Kilauea’s eruption on Hawaii’s Big Island has driven fast-moving lava, volcanic gas, ash, and other hazards through communities, forcing evacuations and damaging homes, while volcanic haze has been carried to Guam. Officials warned residents about poor air quality, low visibility, and hazardous volcanic particles as the eruption continues.

Peel Regional Police say they now have credible information that three men seen on video beating a 29-year-old autistic man at Square One are originally from British Columbia’s lower mainland and may have recently traveled to the GTA. Police are asking people in British Columbia to help identify them.
RSI does not appear effective as a mean reversion indicator in Bitcoin and other cryptos, but it shows better results as a momentum indicator and seems to work well in crypto trading.

The U.S. Supreme Court is considering Arkansas’s appeal to allow an execution to proceed after state and federal court rulings stalled it. Don Davis had his last meal and could be the first of eight inmates executed, while the appeals court said the state’s lethal injection method did not create undue severe pain.

The manuscript argues that quantitative research is not objective and presents quantitative criticalism as a justice-driven approach that combines quantitative methods with critical epistemologies. It describes the authors’ positionalities, outlines tensions in statistics and methodology, reviews examples using critical race theory, queer theory, and intersectionality, and urges scholars and educators to use critical reflection to advance equity and social justice.

The passage presents SpinGPT, an LLM-based poker agent for Spin & Go tournaments trained in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on 320,000 professional decisions and offline reinforcement learning with 270,000 solver-generated hands. SpinGPT improved bet-size calibration over the SFT model and outperformed it in head-to-head play, though both showed limitations and some illegal or mistaken actions.

The passage describes a global learning and skills crisis affecting children and young people, with high youth unemployment, NEET rates, and widespread skills mismatches. It says GPE supports partner countries through policy dialogue, financing, knowledge, and public-private partnerships to improve foundational and 21st century skills, with examples from Lesotho, Ghana, Kenya, and El Salvador.

The passage lists 17 mistakes that can hinder weight loss, including drinking from plastic bottles, cutting out sweets or carbs completely, being a perfectionist, emotional eating, using store-bought protein bars or energy drinks, relying on the weighing scale, not sleeping enough, eating too little, repeating the same workout routine, drinking calories, and following someone else’s weight-loss plan.

The MACD histogram trading strategy is a mean-reversion system that uses histogram zero-line crossovers to identify momentum changes and reversal points. Entry is on the close, exit is on the first day the close is higher than the previous day’s close, and long positions perform better than short positions.

The passage describes Turing GPUs’ display, video, VR, SLI, ray tracing, AI, and rendering features, including 8K/HDR support, VirtualLink, NVLink, RT Cores, Tensor Cores, NGX/DLSS, mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, multi-view rendering, and hardware specifications for TU102, TU104, and TU106.

The passage lists several feature phones and their prices, highlighting uses such as secondary or backup phones, gifting to elders, and avoiding smartphone dependence. It notes the Nokia 3310, Nokia 216, Samsung Metro 350, Nokia 230, Intex Yaari, Micromax X408, Samsung Guru E1200, and Nokia 105, with features like basic cameras, MP3 players, flashlights, dual SIM, and long battery life.

Onesmo Rupil, once a drug user and heroin addict, dropped out of the University of Dodoma due to poor performance linked to substance abuse and later turned to crime to fund his addiction. After arrests and imprisonment, he underwent rehabilitation in Dar es Salaam and is now the manager of Philimisana Foundation Sober House in Mwanza, while warning about the widespread use and harmful effects of marijuana and other drugs.

The study developed an automated intensive care guideline adherence monitoring system using FHIR-encoded recommendations and OMOP CDM patient data. Across five university hospitals and 82,015 ICU episodes, the system achieved 97.0% accuracy versus 86.6% for human reviewers and processed over 2000 patient days per second. Most mismatches were attributed to human error, often because unstructured data were unavailable to the system.

The speaker says the series against Colorado was tough and New Jersey is equally difficult, with no excuse of fatigue. He describes New Jersey as a balanced, well-chemistry line that plays strong defense and transitions quickly, and says the team must find the right matchups, spread scoring, contain that line, and battle for every inch in a likely low-scoring Stanley Cup Finals game.

NVIDIA states the specification is provided “as is,” may be changed without notice, and may not be copied or used outside its terms. It disclaims warranties and liability, restricts suitability for critical applications, and limits customer use and liability under its standard sales terms.

A Journal of Climate paper by Nic Lewis and Judith Curry estimates climate sensitivity from observed warming since 1850 and finds values lower than most CMIP5 model estimates. It reports median ECS of 1.66°C and TCR of 1.33°C using globally complete data, implying future warming may be substantially below IPCC model projections.

The SAP describes summary statistics, tables, figures, and listings for efficacy, safety, laboratory, ECG, local tolerability, and immunogenicity analyses by treatment group, with all safety analyses based on the safety set and many summaries focused on treatment-emergent adverse events, plasma glucose recovery, and glucose concentration over time.

Janet Yellen said the Fed should keep gradually raising interest rates to prevent the U.S. economy from overheating, while calibrating the pace so inflation can reach 2 percent. She said job growth of 90,000 to 120,000 a month would be sustainable, and warned against tightening too slowly or too quickly.

The Grand Canyon Institute says Arizona’s universal ESA voucher program has weak accountability and transparency, primarily serves higher-income zip codes, and is often used for homeschooling or extracurriculars rather than private school tuition. It estimates most universal participants never attended district or charter schools and that the program is a net cost to the state, reaching about $350 million in FY2025.

The passage describes NVIDIA Blackwell RTX features, including Mega Geometry for more detailed real-time ray tracing, LSS for faster and more efficient strand rendering, SER 2.0, AMP, new video/display support, power-efficiency improvements, DLSS 4, neural shaders, and neural graphics technologies. Pre-service teachers generally viewed the Physical Education and Sports Curriculum (5–8) positively in terms of outcomes, content, teaching-learning processes, and assessment, but many were undecided about scientific errors, the content’s suitability, and some evaluation practices; the study recommends more research, seminars, and curriculum review courses.

Tesla Motors filed an 8-K on August 5, 2016 correcting footnote 1B in its Second Quarter 2016 Update: the “Net increase in operating lease vehicles” amounts were misstated as $97,247 and $456,345 and should have been $241,253 and $600,351. Tesla said the error was limited to supplemental, non-GAAP information and did not affect reported cost of revenues or GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation.

The passage describes methods for forming multi-layer 3-dimensional vertical NOR-type memory string arrays. It uses damascene local vertical bit lines and two-step etching of local word lines to reduce ribboning and improve stack stability, with additional embodiments using dielectric pillars or stacked masks.

Second-quarter S&P earnings rose 11%, with more than half of companies beating forecasts, but analysts have still trimmed full-year earnings estimates for 2017 and 2018. Goldman Sachs said the results were not strong enough to justify positive revisions, and BlackRock said investors reacted with indifference even as major indexes hit records.

The passage is a January 26, 2001 Enron mention roundup featuring articles on California’s power crisis, Wall Street reactions to Enron’s profits, commentary on Enron’s role in California and India, wind energy’s comeback, and a report that Maharashtra may miss a payment to Enron’s Dabhol Power.

Coeur Mining Inc. shares fell 0.68% in the latest session. Analysts project a 12-month target of $10.25, with estimates ranging from $8.50 to $12, based on 8 opinions. The stock’s ABR is 1.67 from 6 recommendations, with 1 Buy, 6 Outperform, 2 Hold, and no Underperform or Sell ratings. Its ATR-14 is 0.31, weekly volatility is 2.93%, monthly volatility is 3.56%, and RSI is 62.01. The company has a market capitalization of $1.6 billion, 182.81 million outstanding shares, and 2.21 million shares traded versus an average of 3.42 million.

InnerDancer Performing Arts hosts monthly Vista dances for teens and adults with developmental disabilities at the Gloria McClellan Adult Activity & Resource Center, offering music, movement, socialization, and inclusion. Founded by Caroline Bossmeyer in 2009, the nonprofit teaches adaptive dance and emphasizes self-expression over perfection.

The passage argues that digital ecosystems should mimic biological ecosystems to create scalable, self-organising systems for solving complex dynamic problems. It defines digital ecosystems as distributed, adaptive systems using evolutionary computing, dynamic fitness landscapes, and reconfigurable network topologies, and reports simulations designed to test whether they exhibit biological ecosystem-like behavior.
Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on July 22, 2020 announcing a press release with its financial results for the fiscal quarter and year ended June 30, 2020.

Chance the Rapper served as grand marshal of Chicago’s Bud Billiken back-to-school parade, riding in a white convertible and waving to crowds. He has also donated $1 million to Chicago Public Schools, helped distribute free backpacks, and urged politicians to support the schools.

The lecture explained two-nucleon effective field theory with fine tuning, showing that non-relativistic scattering leads to the effective range expansion and that bubbles can be summed exactly. A naive power counting fails because the scattering length is large, so a renormalization scheme with power divergence subtraction or offshell subtraction is used to promote the C0 interaction to leading order. This reveals fixed points, enhanced operators, and a bound-state pole associated with the deuteron.
Coral Davenport explains how Russell Vought, director of the Office of Management and Budget, plans to circumvent Congress’s budgetary powers to advance the Trump administration’s agenda.

Trump said Democrats’ role in the shutdown gave him an “unprecedented opportunity” to cut federal agencies, and his administration froze or canceled billions for projects in Democratic-leaning areas. He plans to meet with OMB Director Russell Vought to discuss cuts, including whether they would be temporary or permanent, while the shutdown continued after Congress failed to pass funding bills and Republicans and Democrats remained split over extending Obamacare tax credits.

The D.C. Circuit vacated the NRC’s transfer of regulatory authority to New Jersey and remanded, holding that the NRC’s explanations concerning criterion 25 and retention of jurisdiction were arbitrary and capricious.

The passage describes AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) feature, which supports page migration in systems with IOMMU enablement, including concurrent DMA and SNP guest pages. It outlines command types, ring buffer operation, firmware reload requirements, status/error handling, address alignment rules, and initialization/shutdown behavior for the TMPM driver.

European stocks were set for their biggest weekly loss since November 2016 as rising bond yields, a stronger euro, and weak banking results weighed on markets. Deutsche Bank posted a larger-than-expected 2017 loss, while Caixabank and Sabadell also disappointed. Investors were watching U.S. payrolls data and reacting to a Bank of America Merrill Lynch “Sell” signal.

The paper studies whether large language models can autoformalize hybrid cyber-physical systems into differential game logic. It introduces 20 benchmark kinematics problems, a syntax-and-semantic checker, and an LLM repair pipeline. Using few-shot prompting, OpenAI o3 achieved 70% top-5 accuracy, while failures were mainly due to checker limitations and difficult problems involving optimization, non-polynomial dynamics, or complex dynamics.

The passage discusses snowfall recovery in Britain, criticizes ministers for undermining Theresa May’s EU deal, and previews Liberal Democrat Voice content, including House of Lords business, a youth activist award scheme, Samaritans’ work, and a planned musical interlude on the theme of “goodbye.”

The passage describes a study on using digital phenotyping and large language models to analyze psychiatric interviews for depression and anxiety. It collected over 15,000 minutes of speech from 1,160 outpatients at Shanghai Mental Health Center, extracted clinical, linguistic, and acoustic features, fine-tuned an LLM with psychiatrist annotations, and built an ensemble model to predict diagnostic groups and symptoms with moderate accuracy.
Theo Walcott scored in the 51st minute to give Everton a 1-0 win over Newcastle at Goodison Park. It was Walcott’s third goal for Everton since joining in January.

Cover 0 is an all-out blitz with man coverage that creates quick pressure but leaves defenders on islands. Offenses attack it with quick man-beaters, slants, crossing routes, and pick or rub concepts, with examples including double slants, fade-out/RB seam, trips bunch jerk route, slant-rub, and motion slant-flat plays.

Former Aberdeen manager Steve Paterson suggested Pittodrie should host Neale Cooper’s funeral, saying Aberdeen may not have a church big enough for the turnout. Paterson and others paid tribute to Cooper, who died in hospital after a fall, and Aberdeen said they would follow his family’s wishes.

FlowMotion Smartphone Stabilizer’s Kickstarter campaign was funded in one hour and raised over $600,000 against a $30,000 goal. Its FlowMotion ONE uses a 3-in-1 design as a wearable stabilizer, handheld device, or extension-pole setup to reduce shake and produce smooth, cinematic smartphone video. Founded in 2015, FlowMotion is based in Palo Alto and Trondheim and has won several awards.

This study using DHS data from Benin and Cameroon found very low awareness of cervical cancer and cervical screening among women aged 15–49 years. Awareness was associated with older age, higher education, and internet use in both countries, and with wealth in Cameroon; radio use was also associated with screening awareness.

The study examines wastewater surveillance for SARS-CoV-2, focusing on small-volume Nanotrap particle methods as alternatives to traditional concentration methods such as membrane filtration and skim milk. It evaluates factors affecting RNA detection and compares automated and manual Nanotrap processing using grab and Moore swab samples collected in Atlanta.

An Oklahoma veterinarian removed 21 pacifiers from a dog’s stomach after a local couple noticed their baby’s pacifiers were missing. The dog, Dovey, had slowed eating and vomited a pacifier, but is now doing well and going home.

Ann Schmidt circulated a digest of news about Enron and energy markets, including utility stock trends, Enron India loan rate cuts, high natural gas prices, and multiple articles on Enron-related power and trading developments.

Wisconsin Poison Center recorded 59 kratom exposure calls from 2010–2022, with increasing frequency over time, about half involving polysubstance exposure, common symptoms of agitation and tachycardia, and 7 critical care admissions; 1 death was reported.

This randomized open-label trial studied 1112 NVAF subjects treated with apixaban for 48 weeks, comparing standard of care information with an additional education program. After 24 weeks, participants in the education group were re-randomized to continue or stop the program. Adherence was measured by electronic monitoring, with defined 24-hour adherence and non-adherence units, and periods when apixaban was withheld were excluded. Treatment discontinued for more than 30 consecutive days was considered permanent discontinuation.

The article is a mailbag on Texas A&M football, saying a blowout loss to Alabama would not make the Florida game a must-win for Kevin Sumlin, though A&M needs strong play in its final six games. It also answers questions about throwback uniforms, fall weddings, music requests, North Texas promotions, Arsene Wenger, and burrito preferences.

The passage says market momentum remains intact, but charts show early warnings. It notes the S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July and 7.8% year to date, though August began weakly, with volatility and credit spreads turning seasonal and short-term technicals looking tenuous.

An alleged Swiss spy arrested in Germany is suspected of dealing in stolen banking data, but it remains unclear whether he acted for the Federal Intelligence Service. A watchdog denied the Attorney General’s Office was involved or exposed his identity, while Swiss authorities said the FIS had assisted in a related case and ended its investigation in 2014.

The passage discusses the team’s long-standing chemistry, trust, and lack of cliques as key reasons they handle adversity well and integrate new players easily. It also mentions their focus on the next game, the value of big-city matchups for hockey, and praise for teammates such as Drew Doughty and Justin, along with the team’s playoff mentality and pursuit of another banner.

2-year-old Laylah Washington died after being shot in the head while riding in a car with her mother and brothers in Memphis, Tennessee. Police said the family was followed after a parking lot dispute, no arrests have been made, and they were looking for a black Chevrolet Impala.

HMP Northward is overcrowded, with more than 220 men in a prison designed for 212, and authorities plan to move some low-risk inmates to a cordoned-off section of the Immigration Detention Centre at Fairbanks. Officials say this short-term measure could free about 22 spaces while maintaining safety and normal operations at the centre, which is already near capacity and facing a hunger strike by nine asylum-seeking detainees.

The passage describes wireless communication methods for managing duplication mode in radio bearers. It provides techniques for reporting data volume on one path to reduce signaling overhead, and for activating or deactivating duplication mode through radio access network messages with various message formats. It also covers related handling of duplicated data, cell or path configuration, and apparatus, storage medium, and chip implementations.

Microsoft reported first-quarter fiscal 2021 revenue of $37.2 billion, up 12% from the prior year, with net income of $13.9 billion and diluted EPS of $1.82. Revenue and operating income increased across all three segments, led by Intelligent Cloud, while commercial cloud revenue rose 31% to $15.2 billion. The company also changed the estimated useful lives of server and network equipment, which increased operating income by $927 million in the quarter.

Environment Canada issued a special weather statement for Edmonton and nearby areas on Wednesday afternoon due to possible funnel clouds and a small chance of weak landspout tornadoes. Officials said the risk was low, but people should stay alert and be ready to take shelter if funnel clouds develop nearby.

Britain’s FTSE 100 fell 0.2% as BT and AstraZeneca shares dropped after disappointing updates, putting the index on track for its worst week since August 2017. Miners and oil stocks rose, while Capita gained more than 5% after Morgan Stanley upgraded it to “equal-weight.”

The passage describes a data intake and query system for collecting, indexing, storing, and searching machine data as events using a late-binding schema. It explains host/client architectures, cloud and external data search via ERP processes, and indexing methods including metadata, buckets, and inverted indexes.

The court denied Jennings’ motions to strike and granted UNC’s motion for summary judgment. It held that the alleged conduct was not severe, pervasive, and objectively offensive enough to support Title IX or § 1983 sexual harassment claims, that Dorrance did not violate Jennings’ privacy rights, and that the state invasion-of-privacy claim also failed.

A Treasury minister said Britain’s fish fingers would be “safe in the hands” of the Government during Brexit talks, after Labour’s Mel Onn sought assurances about customs arrangements to protect the time-sensitive fish trade and Great Grimsby processing jobs.

The passage reviews how information technology has reshaped language education in Indonesia, noting challenges such as teacher skills, student engagement, access, and assessment, alongside benefits like ASR, task-based and game-based learning. It also highlights management strategies, student attitudes, and the need for inclusive, data-driven digital integration.

Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods, requires disputes to be heard in Santa Clara County courts, restricts export compliance, and allows waivers or amendments only in signed writing.

A federal judge in Illinois dismissed a lawsuit accusing the College Board and 40 selective colleges of conspiring to inflate tuition. Judge Sara Ellis found the plaintiffs did not plausibly allege an agreement or evidence of collusion, though she acknowledged the practice raised tuition prices for some students.

At a human trafficking training session in Oshakati, Prosecutor-General Martha Imalwa said human trafficking is a major global crime and that Namibia has signs of the problem, including missing children and foreign children working in poor conditions. She said training was needed to help officials detect, investigate, assist victims, and prosecute offenders. Police Inspector-General Sebastian Ndeitunga said police recorded 25 human trafficking cases from 2010 to 2017, with some in court, some declined, one conviction, one acquittal, and 14 under investigation.

In a randomized, single-blind, placebo-controlled trial in healthy adults exposed to SARS-CoV-2 within 72 hours, SA58 nasal spray reduced laboratory-confirmed symptomatic COVID-19 by 80.82% and SARS-CoV-2 infection by 61.83% versus placebo. No severe COVID-19, deaths, serious adverse events, or adverse events of special interest occurred, and the most common adverse events were mild nasal symptoms.

The passage describes a medical airway management system that uses airflow, physiological, and positioning sensors to guide intubation or RSI, detect procedure steps, verify endotracheal tube placement, monitor tube position after placement, and provide context-sensitive feedback and alarms through a patient monitoring device and related displays.

California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed SB 53, a law requiring major AI companies to disclose safety protocols, report serious incidents, and protect whistleblowers. The law also creates CalCompute for safe AI research and includes civil penalties, with supporters calling it a balanced transparency measure and critics warning it could burden startups.

Kevin Love, recovering from a concussion before the Finals, reflected on a turbulent Cleveland tenure marked by criticism, trade rumors, injuries, and revealed anxiety and panic attacks. He said opening up brought support from others and that his time with the Cavaliers has been “well worth it.”

Tropical Storm Nate was forecast to cross the northwestern Caribbean, hit the eastern Yucatan Friday evening, move into the southern Gulf of Mexico, and approach the northern Gulf coast Saturday evening, likely strengthening into a hurricane by Sunday. The storm prompted a tropical storm watch for parts of Northwest Florida, state emergency actions, and multiple local cancellations, closures, and preparations in Escambia and Santa Rosa counties.

The summer box office was dominated by three successful superhero films, while most other genres had only one notable hit each or underperformed. Warner Bros. argues that this left the rest of the slate filled with disappointments, bombs, and a lack of diversity in successful non-comic-book movies.

Researchers at UC Irvine and other institutions unveiled a satellite-based drought severity index using NASA GRACE data that adds groundwater storage to drought assessments. The GRACE-DSI covers 2002 to 2014, tracks hydrological drought globally, and showed significant agreement with other drought indices.

Tony Iommi appeared at Birmingham’s BIMM Music Institute on May 25 to announce the BIMM Birmingham Scholarship he is sponsoring and speak with prospective students. He said he has felt his career has been worth it since day one, despite setbacks and criticism.

The passage lists multiple news items about Enron, energy markets, and related political disputes, including California electricity price manipulation allegations, Brazil’s power rationing, India’s Dabhol dispute and renegotiation panel, European gas market shifts, and company strategy updates such as Dynegy’s planned acquisitions.

Ryan, a six-year-old star of Ryan ToysReview, earned about $11 million in 2017 and ranked in Forbes’ Top 10 highest-paid YouTube stars. The channel, started in 2015, has over 10 million subscribers and more than eight billion views, and his parents say it will continue only while he enjoys making it.

The long-short equity strategy involves taking long positions in stocks expected to rise and short positions in stocks expected to fall, aiming to reduce risk and profit from both price increases and declines. The passage explains its use in hedge funds, examples of portfolio construction and a backtest, and notes that it often requires leverage and is more common among institutional investors.

The study presents an AI-assisted inverse design workflow for Dion-Jacobson 2D perovskites using an invertible 12-digit fingerprint of organic spacers. It expands 21 reported spacers to millions of hypothetical candidates, uses DFT and machine learning to predict energy level alignment, screens synthesis feasibility, and identifies new spacers with Ib, IIa, and IIb alignments.

A New York Times survey found that most responding federal judges were dissatisfied with the Supreme Court’s emergency docket decisions in Trump-related cases. Only 12 of 65 said the Court used the docket appropriately, and only 2 of 54 said it improved the public’s view of the judiciary.

Quarter Circle Games announced The Peterson Case, a first-person horror game set in 1947 near the Roswell UFO incident. It follows Detective Franklin Reinhardt as he investigates a deserted house, a missing family, and an unearthly presence. The game is coming to PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC.

Teck Resources was upgraded by Zacks Investment Research from hold to buy with a $25 price target. Other analysts also issued mostly buy or outperform ratings, and the stock’s consensus rating is Buy with a $31.18 target. The company recently reported quarterly EPS and revenue above estimates.

The passage describes Gonzales v. Raich, a Supreme Court case over whether Congress could prohibit local, state-legal medical marijuana use and cultivation under the Commerce Clause. The Court ruled 6-3 for the government, prompting dissents from Rehnquist, O’Connor, and Thomas and leaving federalism opponents disappointed.

The passage describes MSPM0G-series peripherals and features, including the temperature sensor and VREF, comparator, DAC, security accelerators, TRNG, communication interfaces, timers, low-frequency subsystem, RTC_B, watchdogs, analog connections, debug/bootloader support, factory constants, and application/layout recommendations.

Sarah Huckabee Sanders declined to discuss whether she has experienced sexual harassment during a press briefing, saying she had empathy for survivors but was there to relay information on behalf of the president.

The passage promotes several credit cards, highlighting the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card for its unlimited 2% cash rewards, $200 bonus after $500 spent in 3 months, 12-month 0% intro APR, no annual fee, and up to $600 cell phone protection. It also lists comparable offers from Capital One Quicksilver and Citi, along with disclosure and advertising information.

The University of Minnesota Morris is on the site of a former Indian boarding school, and one original boys dormitory now serves as the multi-ethnic resource center. Native students at Morris discussed the lasting trauma of boarding schools and the campus’s significance, noting the tuition waiver for Native American students and the campus’s high Native enrollment.

The flu epidemic remains widespread, with high activity in 42 states and 53 child deaths this season. The dominant H3N2 strain is linked to more severe illness, and a Canadian report said the vaccine was 17 percent effective against it, though officials still recommend vaccination and early antiviral treatment.

It improves occlusion in mixed-reality scenes by using instance segmentation masks with representative and padded-border depth values to reduce under-occlusion and over-occlusion.

Bitcoin rose above $9,000 to about $9,300, with analysts expecting further gains if it breaks the $10,000 resistance level. The passage cites strong buy orders, easing regulatory concerns, and forecasts of a possible move to $11,500.

The Students Achievement Survey tested over 36 lakh students from 50,000 schools, and marks cards with star-based grades will be sent to parents through schools.

Auckland Airport said it located a woman involved in a security breach after a knife was detected during screening. The international terminal was temporarily held up, screening restarted, and several flights were delayed.

In southern Zambia, amplicon deep-sequencing of malaria samples from 2018–2023 found the Pfk13 candidate artemisinin-resistance marker P441L in 6% of samples, rising from 0% in 2018 to 7.2% in 2023, exceeding the WHO 5% threshold. Pfmdr1 Y184F was present in 41% of samples, with two co-occurrences with P441L, and the findings support continued molecular surveillance for drug resistance.

U.S. stocks rose sharply Monday, led by the S&P 500’s biggest one-day gain since April, after a volatile week. Other updates included expectations of another Fed rate rise this year, weaker eurozone factory output, a China slowdown, stronger-than-expected Japan GDP growth, and lower oil and gold prices.

The study found that rural special education teachers are attracted and retained by financial incentives, support, manageable job demands, and rural recruitment initiatives. Support from administrators, colleagues, and the community, along with higher salaries, reduced paperwork and caseloads, relevant professional development, and Grow Your Own programs, were commonly cited.

NASA’s Suomi NPP spacecraft captured an infrared image of the northern lights over several Canadian provinces on Dec. 22, just after the winter solstice. The passage also explains that auroras are caused by solar wind interacting with Earth’s magnetic field, and that the strongest displays occur about every 11 years.
Nintendo announced Mario Kart Tour, a smartphone app version of Mario Kart, expected to release in the fiscal year ending March 2019. No further details were given.

Tyreek Hill underwent surgery after a dislocated left knee and multiple torn ligaments, and his agent said it went well and he is expected to play in 2026. The passage also includes NFL headlines and notes that the Dolphins will need to replace Hill’s production.

The speaker says they want to play a tight game on the road, then use home-ice advantage, and notes that bad games and being outplayed are part of hockey. They believe the better team will win, say their style can counter the opponent’s, and admit they were not surprised by the opponent’s hard play in the playoffs but did not execute what they needed to do.

The court affirmed summary judgment for Hargrave, holding that the affidavits and agreement showed Merrill Lynch and its predecessors did not assume Fuller, Rodney & Co.’s liabilities, plaintiff’s account was not transferred, and plaintiff’s unsupported affidavit and claimed discovery errors did not create a factual issue.

BAE Systems agreed to sell Qatar 24 Typhoon fighter jets in a 6 billion pound deal that also includes missiles and guided bombs. Britain’s defense secretary said it is the Typhoon’s biggest export agreement in a decade and will support Qatar’s military mission in the Middle East.

USD/JPY rose after North Korea’s missile test prompted yen selling, briefly reaching 114.17 before easing. The Nikkei was mostly unaffected and up 0.5%, while traders expect consolidation and possible dollar demand on dips, with no U.S. data due and order flows likely to drive intraday moves.

Microsoft’s 2016 Form 10-K says it is a global technology company focused on productivity and business processes, the intelligent cloud, and more personal computing. It reports these segments, describes its products and services, notes major competition and operational activities, lists executive officers and employees, and outlines numerous business and risk factors, including competition, cloud execution, security, regulation, acquisitions, and supply chain risks.

A study of Tokyo metropolitan residents found that longer commutes increase insomnia and daytime sleepiness, while smaller housing size increases insomnia. For homes meeting a 95 m² standard for a four-person household, commutes over 52 minutes reached the insomnia cutoff.

The passage explains the proper soccer defensive 1-v-1 stance: one foot forward and one back, balanced on the balls of the feet with bent knees and arms out, to react quickly, slow the attacker, and prepare for a tackle. It says the lead foot changes by field position to help block inside movement and force attackers toward the sideline, and recommends practice teaching defenders how to adjust their stance as opponents move.

Iso is a downhill running scheme that uses a fullback as a lead blocker on a linebacker, with double teams at the point of attack to quickly move the ball vertically. Its strengths are fast downhill execution and simplicity; its main weakness is dependence on strong personnel. The passage also describes blocking assignments against 3-4 odd and 4-3 even fronts and mentions shotgun Iso and weakside Iso as variations.

GBPJPY is the exchange rate between the British pound and Japanese yen, formed as a cross pair of GBPUSD and USDJPY. The passage says it can be significantly correlated with USDJPY, is called “Geppy” or “The Beast,” and is considered difficult to trade, with best intraday trading during the Asian and London sessions.

The passage is a Sansa Fuze manual covering player navigation, computer connection, firmware updating, formatting, transferring music/photos/videos, playback controls, FM radio, voice recording, deleting content, system settings, troubleshooting, support, warranty, and software license terms.

Microsoft’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 31, 2018 reported revenue of $32.5 billion and net income of $8.4 billion, compared with a net loss in the prior-year quarter. Revenue and operating income increased across all segments, with Intelligent Cloud and Productivity and Business Processes showing the strongest growth. The filing also described the GitHub acquisition, the impact of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, and detailed financial statements, investments, debt, leases, contingencies, and segment results.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on January 29, 2015 reporting that it announced its fourth quarter 2014 and year-end 2014 financial results, and included exhibits with the press release and information on non-GAAP financial measures.

The passage defines mandatory, recommended, and optional terms, then gives an overview of SD Memory Card specifications, including capacities, voltages, bus speeds, card types, form factors, registers, initialization, read/write and erase operations, write protection, password locking, Card Ownership Protection, and UHS-I/UHS-II modes and command sequences.

Malacañang said President Rodrigo Duterte will investigate corruption allegations against Development Academy of the Philippines President Elba Cruz, who was accused by employees of unauthorized restructuring, CSC rule violations, threats of mass termination, and frequent foreign travel. Roque also said Duterte plans to fire top officials of the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor over similar junket allegations.

The passage reviews major leadership models in education, noting that each has strengths and limitations and that no single model is sufficient for school settings. It argues for a synthetic, flexible approach combining administrative, transformational, distributed, participative, ethical, contingent, and transactional practices to better address changing educational challenges.

The University of Windsor’s Board of Governors named Douglas Kneale interim president and vice-chancellor starting July 1, until a successor to Alan Wildeman is found. Kneale, the university’s provost and vice-president, academic since 2015, said he will provide continuity and leadership during the transition.

Ipswich mayoral candidates have received almost $60,000 in disclosed donations ahead of the by-election, with Andrew Antoniolli leading on $46,400, including a $15,000 donation from Plencove, while Paul Tully has disclosed $10,968 and a $3,300 in-kind billboard gift from Falvey Investments. The Greens’ Brett Morrissey has received $1,330 in nine donations.

Example embodiments improve binaural sound localization by processing sound to appear to originate from locations behind, near, or along a line-of-sight to a visible or known sound source, often using far-field HRTFs instead of near-field HRTFs. The passage also describes switching between binaural and mono/stereo sound in response to device actions, face or gaze detection, orientation changes, distance changes, and power or sensor states.

The passage explains orthonormal expansions in infinite-dimensional spaces, emphasizing that the residual after projection is orthogonal to all basis functions and that L2 functions can be expanded using orthonormal sets. It then shifts to communication systems, separating discrete coding from modulation, and introduces PAM, where symbols are mapped to equally spaced signal levels and then to waveforms. Finally, it presents Nyquist’s criterion for zero intersymbol interference and notes that raised cosine filters are commonly used in practice.

The study finds that exchange bias in incoherently grown RuO2/Fe heterostructures is not due to intrinsic antiferromagnetic or altermagnetic order in RuO2, but to a chemically intermixed interfacial layer containing iron oxide, including magnetite, which pins ferromagnetic moments. Polarized neutron diffraction showed no detectable sublattice moment in RuO2, while PNR, APT, HRTEM/EELS, and SQUID measurements supported an interfacial origin and showed no exchange bias in RuO2/Ni heterostructures.

The paper develops a ProbLog-based Bayesian model of relevance-theoretic implicature comprehension. Using a coffee-offer example, it distinguishes explicatures from implicatures, models comprehension as a heuristic search for the first interpretation satisfying relevance expectations, and evaluates interpretive hypotheses by KL divergence and, when equal, Herbrand base size.

Strange Brigade will launch on August 28 for PS4, Xbox One, and PC, with pre-orders available now and a free Secret Service Weapons Pack included. A Deluxe Edition with a season pass will add new campaign missions, characters, weapons, items, and more.

BioSafe Systems announced five hires: Carleton Birk as Operations Manager and Tenaya Becker, Ester Mastronardi, Patrick Clark, and Kyle Pickles as Technical Sales Representatives covering regions in the USA and Canada.

The passage is a series of playoff hockey coach remarks saying the team stayed competitive despite losses, is focused on improving puck management, neutral-zone decisions, and physical play, and believes its penalty kill has been strong. It also discusses a blindside hit that injured a player, lineup adjustments for the next game, and the importance of home ice, fan support, and staying even-keeled.

Researchers at Georgia Tech demonstrated ransomware that could control a simulated water treatment plant by shutting valves, increasing chlorine, and showing false readings, highlighting weaknesses in industrial control systems. They warned that stronger password policies, limited connections, and intrusion monitoring are needed to protect such systems.

Mary Meeker’s Internet trends survey said global internet usage is growing 7%, down from 12% the year before, while smartphone sales have stalled. She reported 3.6 billion internet users, rising e-commerce, strong growth in voice computing, and major subscriber/user counts for services including Netflix, Amazon Prime, Spotify, Uber, and Airbnb.

The passage compiles articles about Enron, California’s power crisis, Dabhol disputes in India, energy company profits, Brazil’s energy shortage, and Buenos Aires issuing a new patacon currency to pay bills.

The passage is a user manual for the SanDisk Sansa c200, covering recording, file transfer, music, photo, radio, settings, troubleshooting, support, warranty, legal notices, and disposal instructions.

A deep neural network was trained on 102 combined medical imaging datasets totaling 4.5 million images to classify CT, MRI, PET, and X-ray images. The best model, ResNet-18, achieved 96.00% accuracy and 86.17% balanced accuracy on unseen test data, suggesting hyper-scale multimodal medical image classification is feasible.

Chinese and Japanese troops were sent to Korea during the rebellion, while Korea and foreign diplomats tried to prevent conflict and preserve peace. Both sides refused to withdraw first, tensions rose in Seoul and Chemulpo, and the King appealed for the Chinese to leave while Japan remained stubborn.

The passage argues that mass formal schooling systems cause systemic harm to students through structural, objective, and symbolic forms of coercion, hierarchy, and control, and that such harm is morally wrong because it treats innocents as means to ends. It also claims Montessori education aligns with this critique by emphasizing freedom, harmony, and nonharmful education.

The DAX 40 is Germany’s main equity index, made up of 40 blue-chip stocks, and is popular for its liquidity, low trading costs, and diversification benefits versus US markets. The passage describes futures, CFDs, and ETFs as ways to trade it, with futures presented as the preferred method, and notes that DAX strategies can work well for mean reversion, breakout, gap, momentum, and overnight trading.

The lecture motivates underactuated robotics by contrasting conservative, high-gain systems like ASIMO and aircraft with passive walkers, birds, fish, and other dynamic machines. It defines underactuated systems as those whose control inputs cannot accelerate the system in every direction, reviews manipulator dynamics using a two-link arm, and outlines the course topics, including nonlinear dynamics, optimal control, motion planning, and machine learning methods for robots with uncertainty and unknown models.

The Blue Jays and Yankees, tied for the AL’s best record, will meet in a best-of-five ALDS after Toronto won the tiebreaker and season series 8-5. The series begins Saturday, Oct. 4, with Games 1, 2, and 5 in Toronto and Games 3 and 4 in New York; Games 1 and 2 air on Fox and FS1, respectively.

The lecture explains Tor as a volunteer-run anonymity network, defines anonymity, unlinkability, and unobservability, and describes Tor’s circuit-based design, directory authorities, hidden services, major attacks, censorship resistance, and future work.

Education researchers are cautiously optimistic after recent Department of Education moves to reinstate some canceled contracts, seek guidance on modernizing IES, and hire a longtime researcher to advise on reform. Experts still warn that severe staff shortages, reduced reporting, and other cuts could undermine data quality and future research.

The passage explains the rules, tactics, and training for goalkeepers facing penalty kicks. It stresses that penalty kicks heavily favor the kicker, so goalkeepers need technical, mental, and physical preparation, knowledge of Law 14, cue-reading, and calm post-kick responses.

Cement, realty and infrastructure stocks rose 2%–5% on the BSE after Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced incentives for rural and urban housing post demonetization, while the Sensex was down 0.39% at 26,523.

The passage discusses team confidence, leadership, and coaching, emphasizing key goals, the importance of playing as a group, and strong mental toughness. It also praises individual contributions from players such as Khabibulin, Saprykin, Kipper, Jarome, and others, and credits Darryl for keeping the team accountable and moving in the right direction.

The passage introduces UNCERTAINGEN, a probabilistic embedding framework for metagenomic binning that addresses limitations of deterministic k-mer and LLM-based embeddings. It models DNA fragments as distributions in embedding space to capture ambiguity from shared sequences and highly similar k-mer profiles, provides theoretical expressivity results, and reports improved performance on real metagenomic datasets.

Jeff Davis Parish is starting the school year after summer preparations, staff training, and campus improvements. Jennings Elementary expects streamlined processes and committed educators, and the parish’s graduation rate is 92.5%, up three points from last year and fourth best in the state.

This scoping review found nine studies on belonging in graduate health professions education and identified three themes affecting belonging: environment, relationships, and personal factors. It concluded that occupational therapy education should better support belonging, especially for historically minoritized students.

The Supreme Court declined to hear several cases, including Alex Jones’ appeal and a Colorado parents’ challenge over schools’ handling of children’s gender identity, and also denied review in cases involving Section 230, a death penalty juror-misconduct claim, and California cannabis-related fines. It asked the solicitor general for views in two other cases.

The study proposed a world model framework for autonomous mechanical thrombectomy navigation across 10 patient-specific vasculatures. In multi-task testing, TD-MPC2 outperformed SAC with higher mean success rate and path ratio, but longer procedure times.

Actress Allison Mack was released on $5 million bail to await trial on sex trafficking and conspiracy charges tied to recruiting women for a secret society within Nxivm. She will live under house arrest with her parents, who put up their home as collateral, and must avoid contact with Keith Raniere, Nxivm, and associates.

The bankruptcy court granted summary judgment to Wells Fargo and Dynamic Management, rejected SCS General Contractors’ equitable lien and alter ego claims, ordered escrowed funds released to Wells, and dismissed the claims against Dynamic and Spirit.

Los Angeles County will pay nearly $12 million in a settlement to the family of cyclist Milton Olin Jr., who was killed by a sheriff’s deputy patrol car. Attorneys said new evidence shows the deputy was on a straight, unobstructed road for 21 seconds before hitting Olin at about 48 mph, while texting his wife and using the patrol car computer. They are urging the district attorney to review the case again.

The report analyzes the global household sewing machines market from 2013–2023, covering market size, forecasts, regional and type segments, applications, manufacturers, costs, profits, drivers, and challenges. It includes mechanical and electronic sewing machines, home and light commercial uses, and profiles major companies such as Brother, Singer, and Janome.

Many people in Western countries dislike eating insects, but around two billion people worldwide regularly eat them, and they are nutritious and ecologically sustainable. Research on primates suggests genes for digesting insect chitin, and cooked insects have appeared on American menus, including roasted grasshoppers sold by the Seattle Mariners.

The passage argues that the U.S. Department of Education should strengthen the Institute of Education Sciences by prioritizing urgent research needs, improving coordination and data systems, and helping states and districts apply evidence in classrooms. It recommends learning agendas, faster research tracks, modernized reporting, and practitioner-facing resources to make the federal education research system more efficient, effective, and accountable.

LG has launched the G7 ThinQ in South Africa, a flagship smartphone with Gorilla Glass 5, slim bezels, AI features, a Snapdragon 845 processor, 4GB RAM, 64GB expandable storage, and dual rear cameras. It will be available in early June for about R13,999.

After a disabled veteran’s handcycle was stolen, Randy Sooter donated his own handcycle to replace it. Gerard Ah-Fook, a Navy veteran and paracycling competitor, said the gift would help him keep training while police continue searching for the stolen bike.

The passage outlines a liberal diplomatic offensive aimed at Bulgaria, Serbia, Italy, Austria-Hungary, Germany, Russia, France, and the western Allies, combining assurances, references to national claims, disarmament, democracy, and a league of nations to weaken the enemy and unify allies. It then proposes peace terms requiring the restoration of Belgium and northern France, leaving Luxemburg to negotiation, and undoing the 1871 wrong in Alsace-Lorraine.

The passage presents eight strategies for beating distraction, including acting with urgency, working in a distraction-free location, evaluating opportunities as “heck-yes” or no, focusing on one priority at a time, finding an obsession, using a personalized routine, avoiding multitasking, and building an organization-wide focus culture.

The passage describes AI-assisted activity training systems and methods that present activity categories, receive voice-based training plans in a source language, use NLP to extract selected activities and attributes, and then play multimedia guidance while cameras and AI analyze the user’s performance in real time and provide aural, visual, or haptic feedback. It also describes smart mirrors, display devices, gymnasium use, circuit creation and sharing, activity category augmentation, and editing or sharing captured activity media.

Devro’s shares have risen by almost a quarter since January, and interim results indicated further potential for capital gains and dividends. First-half sales rose 11pc to just over £125m, helped by demand in Russia, south-east Asia and China, and the company maintained strong cash conversion despite spending on a new plant in China, which is expected to reach full capacity by year-end.

VentureWire’s October 31, 2000 issue highlights Trinity Ventures’ $540 million Trinity VIII fund and Sun Microsystems’ plan to invest $100 million more in wireless firms, along with numerous financing, acquisition, management, and personnel announcements across technology and internet companies.

Strength training can build fitness, but injuries are more likely without correct technique, warm-ups, cool-downs, and gradual increases in intensity. The passage describes common injuries including rotator cuff injuries, hamstring injuries, herniated discs, tendonitis, tennis elbow, and golfer’s elbow, along with prevention tips such as good posture, proper stretching, avoiding pain, resting, staying hydrated, and seeking medical or fitness advice when needed.

The University of North Texas held fall 2017 commencement ceremonies on Dec. 15–16 in Denton, with more than 3,400 students expected to receive degrees. Bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral ceremonies were scheduled at the UNT Coliseum and Murchison Performing Arts Center, and a special commencement was also offered in New Orleans for graduates attending the New Orleans Bowl.

Amazon.com, Inc., incorporated in Delaware and headquartered in Seattle, filed its 2017 Form 10-K, reporting operations in North America, International, and AWS, with Whole Foods Market included after its August 28, 2017 acquisition. The company described its customer-, seller-, developer-, enterprise-, and content creator-focused businesses, noted intense competition and numerous operating, legal, tax, foreign exchange, security, and regulatory risks, and reported 2017 net sales of $177.866 billion, net income of $3.033 billion, and cash from operations of $18.434 billion.

The speaker said the team lost control in the third period after leading twice, made too many soft plays, and allowed Detroit to capitalize on mistakes. He said the team will bounce back at home, noted he does not address the team after games, and added that the goalie made great saves and could not be faulted on the goals.

Microsoft announced the expiration of its exchange offers for certain debt securities and revised the related press release to update the amount of 3.041% Notes due 2062 to be issued. In connection with settlement on March 17, 2021, it issued $6.25 billion of 2.921% Notes due 2052 and $1.935 billion of 3.041% Notes due 2062.

The Supreme Court appointed senior counsel Amarendra Sharan as amicus curiae to examine material seeking a fresh inquiry into the larger conspiracy behind Mahatma Gandhi’s assassination, but said the material did not prima facie appear sufficient. The petitioner, Pankaj Kumud Chandra Phadnis, argued that new evidence pointed to British Secret Service Force 136 and a wider cover-up.

The lecture introduces graph limits as a way to describe limits of sequences of graphs using graphons, symmetric measurable functions from the unit square to \([0,1]\). It defines homomorphism densities for graphs and graphons, explains convergence of graphs via convergence of all such densities, and introduces the cut norm and cut distance to compare graphons and graphs. The main results stated are that density convergence is equivalent to cut-distance Cauchy convergence, every convergent sequence has a limit graphon, and the space of graphons modulo distance zero is compact.

The passage contains forwarded news clippings about Enron mentions, including stories on oil-bid winners seeking financing, Artesia Technologies’ funding round with Enron Broadband Services, and Houston articles debating a publicly financed basketball arena and comparing it with other NBA arena deals.

A Pakistani girl named Angel, born with rare CLOVES syndrome, has suffered severe pain, swollen feet, malnutrition, and bullying, and is preparing for a free double amputation in Australia by Professor Tony Pennington’s team.

The passage describes AGESA host-environment dependencies, call-out procedures, stack setup, build tools and configuration options, UEFI/PEI/DXE execution stages, initialization entry points, memory and graphics-related settings, suspend/resume handling, and required host call-outs for buffer allocation, deallocation, and system reset.

Tesla Motors, Inc. held its 2016 Annual Meeting on May 31, 2016. Stockholders elected Brad W. Buss and Ira Ehrenpreis as Class III directors, approved ratification of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as independent auditor for fiscal year 2016, and did not approve the stockholder proposal on supermajority voting provisions.

The CBEC said only central tax officers can verify transitional GST credits, even for taxpayers under state administration, citing legal jurisdiction and access to records. The move follows concerns that taxpayers have overclaimed credits, though a preliminary enquiry found only 5-7% invalid, and it may trigger Centre-state litigation. The board also said the CGST Act will be amended to exclude earlier cesses from valid transitional credit.

Attorney General Patrick Morrisey renewed a contract with the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission to help West Virginia investigators monitor stores for recalled products and ensure recall notices are posted. Since 2015, more than 40 compliance checks have been conducted, with 25 more planned this year.

The CCAT Collaboration is constructing the six-meter FYST telescope in Chile and testing Mod-Cam and Prime-Cam instruments. The paper characterizes Mod-Cam stripline thermal conductivity and RRR, estimates thermal loading for both instruments, and finds elevated crosstalk originates in the SMP-SMA transition PCBs rather than the stripline, leading to redesigned PCBs expected to improve isolation.

The passage argues AMD may be poised for an upward move ahead of its Q1 2018 earnings and outlines options strategies to gain exposure with limited upfront capital: buying a $10 call, using a $10/$12 call spread, or selling a cash-secured $10 put. It says the strategies can lower cost or even produce a net credit, while capping gains or creating assignment risk if AMD falls below the strike prices.
Tesla Motors, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 2, 2015, stating it had published a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 and furnished under Items 2.02 and 7.01.

Police say 37-year-old Jason A. Clifford forced his way into a southeast Portland apartment armed with a slungshot, threatening people and trying to break into apartments. He was arrested on multiple charges, and two other people in the apartment were also arrested on outstanding warrants.

WIRED reviews white-noise and sound machines for sleep, explaining noise colors and recommending models such as LectroFan, Snooz, Hatch, Babelio, Yogasleep Dohm, Momcozy, and others, with notes on timers, sound options, portability, and night lights.

The Inverted Hammer is a single-candle bullish reversal pattern that forms at the bottom of a downtrend, with a small lower body, little or no lower shadow, and a long upper shadow. Traders use it to look for potential bullish reversals, but it should be confirmed with other indicators. The passage says it is frequent, can be profitable and reliable in backtests, and is best used with market context, support, trendlines, moving averages, momentum tools, stop-losses, and risk management.

Trump will direct his trade adviser to consider a Section 301 investigation into Chinese practices that force U.S. firms to hand over intellectual property, potentially leading to tariffs. Officials said the trade action is separate from U.S. pressure on China over North Korea, and any investigation could take up to a year.

Violet Brown, a former sugarcane worker in western Jamaica, is believed to have become the world’s oldest living person after Emma Morano’s death. She is considered to have credible birth documentation showing a March 10, 1900 birth, though Guinness World Records has not yet confirmed her title. Brown said hard work and her Christian faith helped her live a long life.
A UC Davis study found California gun deaths fell from 2000 to 2015, largely due to reduced gang violence and black homicides, while firearm suicides remained a major share.

Digital laggards set aspirational goals that are poorly grounded in data, leading employees to avoid measurement and rely on process adherence and qualitative effort. Digital leaders use transparent, data-driven goals to align strategy, teams, and culture, while balancing metrics with flexibility. The passage also describes four organizational patterns in data transformation: data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant.

The passage describes NVIDIA’s evolution from Volta and Turing Tensor Core GPUs to the A100 Tensor Core GPU, emphasizing major gains for AI, HPC, and data analytics. It highlights A100 features such as third-generation Tensor Cores, TF32, BF16, FP64 support, sparsity, Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitioning, larger HBM2 and L2 cache, NVLink/NVSwitch scaling, PCIe Gen 4, and CUDA 11 software improvements. It also notes DGX A100 as a 5 PFLOPS system designed for scalable AI workloads.

The passage describes a handheld ISFET Lab-on-Chip using RT-pHLAMP to detect circulating YAP1 nucleic acid, AR-FL mRNA, and AR-V7 mRNA from prostate cancer blood samples. The device showed rapid, concordant results with benchtop assays, and YAP1 detection was associated with higher PSA and more advanced cancer stage.

The passage is a forwarded summary of international power sector restructuring from June to November 2000, covering Europe, Central and Eastern Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and Africa/Middle East. Mark Schroeder notes several errors in the EU summary and says Poland was omitted.

European shares rebounded on Monday, with the STOXX 600 up 0.7 percent after geopolitical tension drove their worst weekly losses of the year. Banks led gains, RWE rose 3 percent on improved profit guidance, Danone gained on takeover speculation, and Ladbrokes Coral fell after a downgrade.

Compass Minerals International went public in December 2003 after Apollo Management acquired it from IMC Global, and CEO Michael Ducey considered how to meet investor expectations. The passage outlines the history, production methods, industry structure, environmental concerns, and Compass Minerals’ operations, financials, properties, and management.

In his final State of the Union address, the President said major social progress had been achieved, including Medicare, voting rights, education aid, Head Start, job training, and near full employment, but many commitments remained unfinished. He urged action on urban development, housing, Social Security, anti-poverty efforts, civil rights, crime control, government reorganization, and budget restraint, while calling for peace efforts in Vietnam, the Middle East, and with the Soviet Union. He ended with personal reflections on his presidency and a plea for support for President-elect Nixon.

A Rand, Harvard, and UCLA study of 3,066 workers found that American workplaces are often physically and emotionally taxing: one in five workers reported a hostile or threatening social environment, two-thirds work at high speed or under tight deadlines, and more than half face unpleasant or hazardous conditions. Women reported unwanted sexual attention and young men verbal abuse, though many workers also described their jobs as meaningful and their bosses as supportive.

The passage studies pricing an expiring item sold by a monopolist to strategic buyers with stochastic arrivals. It models the interaction as a Stackelberg game, proves equilibrium conditions for buyer behavior using Value-Based Threshold strategies, and derives near-optimal pricing schedules: constant pricing in thin markets and linear discounting in thick markets.

The passage explains the toss play in football, noting that it is a simple, widely used outside run that works best with fast tailbacks and athletic linemen. It describes its strengths, weaknesses, blocking rules against 3-4 and 4-3 defenses, and variations such as Flexbone Toss and Single Back Toss G Pull.
The speaker says the team will try a different strategy after struggling against a consistent neutral zone and a weak power play, and they hope to review video, improve, and tie the series.

Microsoft held its 2019 Annual Shareholders Meeting on December 4, 2019. Shareholders re-elected all 13 director nominees, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as auditor for fiscal 2020, and rejected shareholder proposals on employee representation on the board and the gender pay gap.

The Missouri Court of Appeals affirmed the trial court’s property division, including awarding the marital residence to Joseph and declining to equalize the division based on Diane’s teacher retirement account, but vacated and remanded because of a mathematical error in valuing Diane’s assets.

Tesla’s 2016 Form 10-K says the company designs, manufactures, and sells electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and solar energy products, and describes Model S, Model X, and planned Model 3 production, along with Gigafactory 1 and SolarCity integration. It also outlines sales, service, financing, manufacturing, regulatory incentives, competition, intellectual property, employees, and numerous business risks, including production delays, supplier dependence, growth challenges, battery safety, material shortages, product liability, and intense competition.

The passage discusses a team’s focus on discipline, reducing power plays, staying concentrated on the next game, and improving defensively by denying net-front access and creating traffic in front of the opposing goalie. It also mentions confidence gained from a comeback series and includes remarks about fans, entertainment, and “stealing” a game.

The Red Cross Society of Ghana is appealing for ambulances and says it has personnel to operate them, but its donated ambulance has broken down. It also noted World Bank-funded first aid posts on major highways. The passage says Ghana has 55 functioning ambulances for 29 million people, while government has initiated processes to provide 275 more.

The passage describes the TMS320DM8127 device and its C674x DSP core, including memory sizes, MMU use, ARM Cortex-A8 subsystem features, peripherals, memory maps, and extensive pin multiplexing and terminal function details. It also includes revision history updates to device specifications, clocking, power sequences, timing, and pin/register descriptions.

Players described the Stanley Cup Finals as a long-awaited opportunity, stressing discipline, hard work, strong defense, and improving the power play against a talented opponent. They praised teammates and the opposing goaltender, and said the best strategy is to play smart, be patient, and avoid turnovers.

VentureWire’s May 22, 2001 issue reported Kodiak Venture Partners closing its second fund at $290 million, Mercury Interactive acquiring Freshwater Software for $147 million, Celetron raising $48 million, and TVM’s first close on a new life science fund. It also covered multiple financings, acquisitions, executive changes, staff cuts, and corrections.
Mark Palmer forwarded a California class-action complaint alleging electricity generators and traders manipulated the wholesale electricity market, and said Enron’s suit would look the same.

George Washington University’s Alpha Phi sorority is terminating the memberships of three members after a racist Snapchat post circulated on social media. The chapter apologized, said it was addressing issues of privilege and diversity, and university officials said they were investigating the incident and working with Alpha Phi and affected students.

Putin’s re-election is portrayed as enabling him to strengthen power and develop a post-Soviet ideology to define Russia’s identity and offer an alternative to Western liberal democracy. The passage says the West should reject this vision and remain firm in its own ideals.

Create Sheffield, a new Sheffield partnership, aims to increase children’s access to arts and culture, improve school attainment, and support creative skills and careers for young people up to age 25. It will develop resources, opportunities, and a young makers initiative, with membership starting in September.

The speaker says their team has not played its usual playoff style, has struggled with puck management and generating shots against New Jersey’s strong defense and goaltending, and must improve at home in Anaheim by executing better, capitalizing on chances, and handling the neutral zone more effectively.

Oregon schools have one of the nation’s lowest graduation rates and among the fewest instructional days, prompting debate over whether less classroom time contributes to poor outcomes. Some advocates and parents support adding instructional days, while lawmakers say multiple factors affect graduation rates and that more days alone may not solve the problem.
