Structural differences along the ingot corresponded to changes from antiferromagnetic to ferromagnetic behavior, with larger SL spacing and lower Mn content associated with lower Curie temperatures.

The paper studies antiferromagnetic domain-wall dynamics under spin-orbit torque using a discrete spin-chain model and a continuum nonlinear sigma-model extension with damping and spin torque. It focuses on precessional, propagating, and oscillatory domain-wall motion, and discusses the magnetic moment carried by these textures.

A banker warned that fraudsters at ATM galleries trick people into receiving transfers from stolen phones or hacked accounts, which can lead to account freezes, BVN flagging, and police action. The passage cites two victims, including an 18-year-old and an adult customer, and urges people not to help strangers with ATM transfers.

California’s Department of Fish and Wildlife re-approved Newhall Ranch after certifying additional environmental review, concluding greenhouse gas and stickleback protection issues were resolved. FivePoint revised its mitigation plan, and the California Air Resources Board found the project would not add net greenhouse gas emissions.

The passage describes young Africans developing agricultural technologies to improve food security, create jobs, and help farmers adapt to climate change, including waste-to-fuel briquettes in Rwanda, support for women farmers in Malawi, and a soil-sensing device in Kenya.

The study classified RET, MEN1, and CDKN1B variants from IndiGen, ClinVar, and Mastermind using ACMG/AMP guidelines, created the MAPVar database with 3,280 MEN-linked classified variants, and found one likely carrier of pathogenic RET mutations in nearly 341 Indians. It also validated variants in GUaRDIAN patient data and developed an NGS panel for rapid MEN genetic testing.

Tesla entered into an underwriting agreement on February 13, 2020 to sell 2,650,000 shares of common stock, with an underwriters’ option for 397,500 additional shares later exercised in full. The offering closed on February 19, 2020, generating approximately $2.31 billion in net proceeds.

Enron restated third-quarter results, increased its loss, and warned that a $690 million debt may soon come due because of a credit downgrade. It also said further rating drops could trigger about $3.9 billion in additional debt, while bankers worried Dynegy might abandon the takeover.

Bar Harbor Bankshares reported 2016 net income of $14.9 million, with results including $2.7 million in acquisition and system conversion charges. Total assets rose to $1.8 billion and loans increased 14 percent to $139 million above the prior year-end. Fourth-quarter diluted EPS was 42 cents, and non-interest income increased $3.4 million, or 38 percent, from the prior year.

The Supreme Court heard arguments over whether the U.S. Postal Service and federal government can be sued for intentionally undelivered mail, in a case brought by Texas landlady Lebene Konan. The justices debated the postal exception in the Federal Tort Claims Act, with some skeptical of the government’s broad immunity claim and others worried about more lawsuits over mail problems.

At Silverbluff Audubon Center in Aiken County, staff say they will root for the Eagles in the Super Bowl because bald eagles live there and a nesting pair has been present since 1994. The segment notes the birds as a national symbol and shows one eagle flying over the center.

R. Thomas Beach’s rebuttal testimony, on behalf of indicated electric generators, supports the Comprehensive Settlement Agreement and opposes the SCGC/TURN PISA because it fails to unbundle intrastate transmission. Beach argues that PG&E and SoCalGas face similar issues, that SoCalGas backbone and local transmission can be unbundled similarly to the PG&E Gas Accord, and that city-gate market competition has benefited electric generators. He also contends the Comprehensive Settlement lowers rates and risks for electric generators and that SCGC/TURN overstate the impact of demand charges.

VOT shortwave broadcasts target Tibet on 11.510, 9.510, and 15.565 MHz at specified evening and morning times in Tibet, India, and Nepal, with frequent retuning advised. Its satellite radio service on AsiaSat 7 uses 4146 MHz horizontal C-band at 105.5°E and is listed as “MOMO,” available 24/7 with alternating Mandarin and Tibetan audio.

Radford University narrowed its search for Vice President for Student Affairs to Dr. Thomas C. Segar and Dr. Ann Marie Klotz, who presented at forums on September 11 and 12, 2017. Both candidates emphasized student success, community, and experience in student affairs.
The passage contains multiple predictions for Evan Dunham vs. Dariush, with all four writers picking Dariush to win, mostly by unanimous decision and once by second-round submission.

Jacob Allen sued Richard Knight and Hannah, executrix of Hope Allen’s estate, for withholding about sixty-four pounds due him under his father’s will. The jury found for Allen and ordered the defendants to pay his proportion of the estate plus court costs.

Nick Kyrgios beat Jan-Lennard Struff in straight sets to level Australia with Germany at 1-1 in their 2018 Davis Cup tie in Brisbane, after Alexander Zverev had earlier defeated Alex de Minaur in five sets. The tie continued with doubles on Saturday, followed by reverse singles on Sunday.

Tensions between Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un over threats of nuclear war sparked a global market sell-off and renewed volatility. Jeffrey Saut said some technical damage had been done but that the market remained a secular bull market, while warning a conflict could push oil to $150 a barrel, though he thought war was unlikely. Gina Sanchez said markets could see heightened volatility not seen since the crisis.

The article argues that education abroad participation is low despite institutional emphasis on global citizenship, and it presents a framework for designing sustainable faculty-led programs by balancing curricular, operational, and financial logistics. It outlines considerations such as learning outcomes, risk management, leadership, travel planning, budgeting, funding sources, and business model types for faculty-, student-, and external-party-led programs.

Black tea may promote health and weight loss by altering gut bacteria, increasing microbes linked to lean body mass and decreasing those linked to obesity. In a mouse study, both green and black tea acted as prebiotics, and a combination of both may be most helpful.

Microsoft announced it will redeem all outstanding 2.125% Notes due December 6, 2021, issued in the principal amount of €1.75 billion, on September 6, 2021. The redemption price will equal principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date.

Police said Parker Hogan helped plan his roommate Michael Buskey’s suicide, brought a gun, notebook and pen to the scene, showed him how to hold the gun, then returned after the shot, removed Buskey’s phone, and later called police and Buskey’s father. Hogan pleaded not guilty to charges including aiding suicide and falsifying evidence and posted bail pending a July court appearance.

The passage discusses adjustments during a tight, low-scoring hockey game, including difficulties seeing the puck, strong goaltending, and playing around a large opponent. It also notes excitement over a key goal, the importance of hard work and fundamentals after a layoff, and focusing on one win in a long best-of-seven series.

The study, based on interviews with four experienced academics at Anadolu University, examines how advanced technologies in distance education may affect management, economics, employment, and socio-cultural change. Participants said artificial intelligence, metaverse, blockchain, virtual reality, brain-computer interfaces, and brain chips could reshape educational processes, reduce hierarchy, change jobs, increase automation, create new business areas, and alter culture and communication. The study recommends developing AI assistants, blockchain-based certification, adaptive content, metaverse systems, and further research on brain-computer interfaces and brain chips.
Officials marked completion of the 179-megawatt Switch Station 1 and 2 solar projects near Las Vegas, built to power Switch data centers in Reno and Las Vegas.

Hartman argues that Andropov’s foreign policy is largely unchanged from Brezhnev’s and that the USSR remains difficult to deal with, making U.S. security the first priority. He says arms control should be given higher priority, especially INF, and that the zero-zero INF position is no longer useful because the Soviets are using negotiations and propaganda to pressure Western European opinion against U.S. deployment.

Apple Watch Series 3 is expected to include both cellular and non-cellular models in 38mm and 42mm sizes, with LTE-only modems. Kuo estimates Apple Watch sales of 17.5 to 18 million next year, at least half being Series 3, and 2.8 to 3.6 million LTE units, with sales starting soon after the fall launch alongside new iPhones.

The passage describes neuromodulation systems and methods that use electrode fractionalization and target multipoles to create linear electric fields for tissue modulation, especially in spinal cord stimulation. It emphasizes shaping fields to preferentially modulate dorsal horn or dorsal root tissue while minimizing dorsal column activation, with user-adjustable controls such as angle, focus, spread, and automated field optimization.

A Senate committee criticized the Supreme Court of Canada’s Jordan ruling for imposing unrealistic trial deadlines and warned that many criminal charges could be stayed. The committee issued 50 recommendations and called for a broader rethink of the criminal justice system.

The court granted DOCS’s motion to dismiss and dismissed the claims against DOCS and Sing Sing on Eleventh Amendment grounds, while allowing the action to potentially proceed against Officer Hernandez if service is proper.

The Government is launching a consultation on new powers to tackle irresponsible company directors after failures such as Carillion and BHS, including measures to claw back money, disqualify directors who sell struggling companies, and strengthen the Insolvency Service. Ministers and MPs said the reforms aim to protect workers, small suppliers and taxpayers from abuse during insolvencies.

The Grand River Conservation Authority is spending $1.8 million to use LiDAR to create digital floodplain maps for the Grand, Speed, and Conestogo rivers over five years. The updated maps will be linked to flood forecasting software to provide real-time flood predictions and improve emergency response, replacing many outdated paper maps from more than 40 years ago.

Engineers developed a rapid optical flow cytometry technique using femto- and picosecond lasers and time-domain thermo-transmission to screen protein sequences, including in living bacteria, without heating or killing cells. The method can separate proteins by crystalline properties and is being used to study natural and synthetic proteins, including squid ring teeth proteins.

The speaker says the kids enjoy coming to the ice, notes tomorrow night is a big game, and says the team must focus on their performance rather than the consequences. He says everyone wants to win the Cup and views it as a once-in-a-lifetime chance, while the coaching staff will review tapes, make defensive adjustments, and the team must improve along the boards and stay fresh.

The paper proposes a methodology for a trusting agent in e-commerce to assess risk by determining a probable trusted agent’s FailureLevel before and during interaction. It divides analysis into pre-interaction and post-interaction time phases, uses time slots, recommendations, past interactions, and Gaussian distribution to estimate future failure probabilities, and illustrates the approach with an example involving two logistics agents.
Iowa State’s unbeaten season ended with a 38-30 upset loss to Cincinnati, who led 31-7 at halftime. The defeat leaves the Big 12 wide open again after a chaotic 2024 season.

Special education teachers in Kazakhstan said they preferred formal education over distance education for disabled students, found distance education insufficient for meeting individual needs, and reported problems in family participation and teacher-student interaction. The study recommends improving technology-based learning, individualized content, online family seminars, and social activities.

A memorial match for Aidan Sutherland will be held at Stark’s Park on Sunday to raise diabetes awareness and support the Diabetes Research and Wellness Foundation. The event, organised by his friend Ben Graham, will include entertainment and players including Aidan’s friends, former teammates, Colin Cameron and Darren Dods.

The speaker says the team learns from difficult games, corrects mistakes, and benefits from honest conversations. They emphasize staying disciplined, controlling emotions, using all players in different situations, and relying on depth when injuries occur.

The study found that epilepsy-causing genes are dysregulated in Alzheimer’s disease, especially in a severe cognitive profile, with most shared genes across three cohorts downregulated and enrichment in synaptic, glutamatergic, GABAergic, and channel-related pathways. These changes were more pronounced in later AD stages, supporting a bidirectional link between AD and epilepsy and suggesting shared molecular mechanisms and potential therapeutic targets.

The passage says uranium analysts are generally bullish because demand is expected to rise as more nuclear reactors are planned or proposed, with some forecasting higher prices by 2019–2020. It also notes recent weakness in the URA ETF chart, but suggests uranium may still be in a correction rather than a decline, with support levels to watch.

The speaker, ending a long presidency, expresses gratitude, wishes the new president well, and calls for national cooperation, balance, and responsible leadership. He warns against the military-industrial and scientific-technological complexes, urges restraint in using resources, and advocates peace, disarmament, mutual respect, and continued work for justice and human betterment.

The Tax Court held that the decedent’s gifts by personal check were completed in 1981 when the checks were paid, not in 1980 when they were delivered. It declined to apply the relation back doctrine to these noncharitable gifts because petitioner failed to prove unconditional delivery and, under Oklahoma law, the decedent retained dominion and control until payment.

The passage describes NVIDIA Ampere GA10x GPU features, including 2:4 structured sparsity, DLSS improvements, GDDR6X memory with PAM4 signaling, RTX IO storage acceleration, advanced display support, NVDEC/NVENC video processing, and performance gains for gaming, data center, and workstation workloads.

The passage lists discounted Prime Day toy deals, including Squishmallows, Magna-Tiles, a retired Lego flower centerpiece, Play-Doh, a spooky Lego set, Melissa & Doug’s ice cream counter, Crayola’s Color Wonder Magic Light Brush Station, and a National Geographic rock tumbler kit, and suggests them as holiday gifts or treats.

In a prospective cohort of 103 cerebral cavernous malformation patients, PTPN2rs72872125 CT and VDRrs7975232 CC were associated with asymptomatic phenotype, PTPN2rs72872125 CC plus GM-CSF improved diagnostic prediction of symptomatic disease, FCGR2Ars1801274 GG predicted symptomatic events during follow-up, and VDRrs731236 AA and VDRrs11568820 CC were linked to earlier symptom onset.

The passage describes a finite-element model for methane bubble growth and fracture in consolidated aquatic muds, coupling dissolved methane diffusion with Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics. It models bubble expansion from a penny-shaped seed to an inverted tear-drop shape, validates results against analytical solutions, and notes the model applies to individual bubbles and needs upscaling for broader sediment properties.

The passage reviews literature on diagnosing student learning problems through classroom observation, collaborative inquiry, and post-lesson discussion, and describes a teacher education course that used panoramic cameras to support evidence collection. In a study with 22 TESs, observation reports and a questionnaire showed improved diagnostic ability and significantly higher perceived instructional design capability after four cycles of practice.

Amazon has patented a system for delivery drones to fragment and shed parts during malfunctions or bad weather, using terrain data to control where components fall and alter the drone’s descent. The patent mentions release methods like latches, springs, compressed gas, or small explosive charges, but it may not be used in practice.

The message reports on U.S. peace, foreign relations, neutrality, and treaty obligations; the suppression of expeditions against Cuba and concerns over the African slave trade; claims and diplomatic matters with several nations; the aftermath of the Mexican War, including California and New Mexico, finances, tariffs, post-office service, internal improvements, and recommendations for Congress, while emphasizing preservation of the Union and constitutional limits on government powers.

The passage says social media platforms use AI to moderate content, but AI can misread context, reflect bias from training data, and still requires human reviewers. It can help speed moderation, yet ethical considerations are lagging behind the technology.

Connecticut town and city lobbyists asked Gov. Malloy to ease state mandates, reduce administrative burdens, allow local cost-control reforms, change municipal retirement rules, and keep more land-transfer fees. They also said the budget stalemate is creating uncertainty, while Senate President Martin Looney disputed claims that municipal leaders were not seeking to be held harmless on state aid.

SanDisk’s warranty requires contacting support and returning the product prepaid in tamper-resistant packaging with a tracking number; SanDisk may repair, replace, or refund it, and its liability is limited. The software is licensed for personal use on one SanDisk product at a time, cannot be modified or reverse engineered, is provided “as is,” and SanDisk disclaims warranties and most liability, with California law and Santa Clara County courts governing the agreement.

The passage describes methods and systems for digitally planning orthodontic treatment and manufacturing appliances by measuring tooth positions, receiving movement constraints, diagnosing malocclusions, generating multiple treatment plans, selecting a plan, and outputting fabrication instructions. It also details branching treatment plans based on malocclusion types such as bi-protrusion, molar and canine class II/III relationships, overjet, and anterior extraction, including options for bicuspid extraction and interproximal reduction.

Tesla’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2018 reported total revenues of $6.82 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $311.5 million for the quarter. As of September 30, 2018, total assets were $29.26 billion, total liabilities were $23.41 billion, and cash and cash equivalents were $2.97 billion. The filing also describes revenue recognition changes from adopting ASC 606, debt obligations, inventory, property and equipment, and accounting updates.

In patients with hematological malignancies and COVID-19, transfusion of high-titer convalescent plasma was associated with decreased inflammatory markers, improved PCR cycle thresholds, and low rates of transfusion-related adverse events. Overall 90-day survival was 64.9%, and in B-cell neoplasm patients, CCP exposure was associated with lower mortality in propensity-weighted analyses, especially after prior anti-CD20 therapy.

The passage lists multiple AMD Geode CS5535 companion device silicon revision A3 issues, including DMA, PCI, ACPI, LPC, PIC, UART, IDE, SMB, GPIO, thermal alarm, sleep clock, and PIT behavior problems; several cause hangs, failed accesses, incorrect interrupts, or corrupted writes, and some have workarounds or no resolution.

Apple Inc. reported that on September 12, 2017 it issued and sold $1 billion each of its 1.500% Notes due 2019, 2.100% Notes due 2022, and 3.750% Notes due 2047, plus $2 billion of its 2.900% Notes due 2027, under an underwriting agreement dated September 5, 2017. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, bear semiannual interest starting March 12, 2018, and mature in 2019, 2022, 2027, and 2047, respectively.

Diana Containerships reported quarterly EPS of -$0.66, beating estimates, while revenue was $5.40 million, below expectations and down 63.8% year over year. Renaissance Technologies LLC increased its stake, and Zacks Investment Research raised the stock from sell to hold.

The passage lists multiple news items mentioning Enron, including Lay’s $7 million bonus, Enron’s Japan power plant plan, a Dubai gas project, Enron’s withdrawal from an Indian project, a wind power subsidiary proposal, and comments by Jeffrey Skilling on California deregulation and Enron’s 2001 revenue outlook.

The passage discusses Tampa Bay Lightning leadership, player development, and the importance of patience in building a successful team through home-grown talent and careful scouting. Steve Yzerman and Coach Cooper describe the growth of players like Stamkos, Hedman, Johnson, Palat, Kucherov, and Bishop, emphasizing character, development, and how the team responded to adversity during its playoff run.

Roanoke’s original Bittle tree, planted by Dr. David Bittle, stood for over 100 years before damage from lightning and wind made it hazardous and led to its removal. Wood from the tree was used by Reverend Chris Bowen and George Arthur to create the Bittle Tree of Life Cross for Antrim Chapel, a symbolic feature for Roanoke’s 175th anniversary.

May Baxter-Thornton and Emma Lewis have been appointed to the victims and survivors panel of the Independent Inquiry into Child Sexual Abuse to advise on reaching and listening to Welsh victims and survivors. Both have personal experience of child sexual abuse and said they want Welsh voices heard. The inquiry first opened in Wales in November 2016 and has met victims and experts in several Welsh locations.
The Louisiana Supreme Court granted the writ of review and ordered the Court of Appeal to send up the record in duplicate and notify counsel for both parties.

ERW (Electric Resistance Welding) is used for transporting vapor and liquid materials such as petroleum and gas, and is widely applied in transportation pipes and various industries. ERW steel pipe uses hot-rolled coil as raw material, has controlled wall thickness and burr removal, and has become widely used in urban gas network engineering.

The passage describes media playback systems and methods in which a playback device receives digital audio data, sends part of it to an identification system to identify the content, receives related information, and forwards that information to a control device while playing the audio. The control device can request identification, receive the returned information, and display metadata or related details.

The passage presents two opinion pieces: one argues health care is a right and supports Medicare for All, while the other criticizes a headline about a teen killed by police, saying she was committing a crime and that police deserve more respect.

The passage describes directional backlights using waveguides and plural light sources to form viewing windows for autostereoscopic, privacy, and multi-viewer displays. It also describes display stacks with polarisers and retarders, including switchable liquid crystal retarders, to reduce off-axis visibility in privacy mode while maintaining head-on luminance, and control systems that switch light source output and retarder voltage.

A Deloitte study found consumer confidence in driverless cars has risen, with 49% now saying self-driving cars will not be safe, down from 73% last year. Trust in the brands building the vehicles, especially traditional car manufacturers, was a major reason, while electric vehicles remained far less preferred.

The passage explains the presidential election cycle theory, which says U.S. stock market performance tends to be stronger in the first two years of a president’s term, especially the pre-election and election years, and weaker in the last two years, with midterm years often weakest until the fourth quarter. It cites Yale Hirsch and Stock Trader’s Almanac backtests, notes that election effects can be sector-specific, and says investors should stay invested and rebalance portfolios.

Intel’s Management Engine is a hidden, always-on microcontroller in many Intel CPUs that connects to storage and networking, and researchers have shown a physical-access exploit for arbitrary code execution on it. Mitigation options are limited and depend on specific vendors, while tools like me_cleaner can disable much of its functionality without shutting down the computer.

New Jersey Governor Chris Christie signed a law strengthening protections for people with developmental disabilities and giving families more say in their care, following the death of Stephen Komninos. The measure allows twice-yearly unannounced inspections of group homes, requires injury notification within two to eight hours, and mandates at least two family meetings a year.

The passage examines Mortimer J. Adler’s perennialism, arguing that education should emphasize eternal values, docility, democracy, and learning according to learners’ capacity rather than job preparation. It also discusses Christian education and global education through posthumanist reflections, and concludes that educational management should address justice, women’s empowerment, and the deeper development of learners, teachers, parents, and related parties.

The Browns reportedly are not ruling out Baker Mayfield with the No. 1 pick, and all four top quarterbacks remain in consideration. John Dorsey says Cleveland is open to all options, while Mayfield completed a 4,627-yard, 43-touchdown senior season at Oklahoma.
Jefferies raised Ferguson Plc’s price target to GBX 5,240 and kept a hold rating. Other analysts gave mixed ratings, and the stock traded up 0.68% to GBX 5,200 on Thursday.

VentureWire People for May 30, 2001 lists executive changes, executive searches, and hiring notices across technology companies. It highlights new appointments at Solsoft, Real Media, Gluon Networks, InfoImage, QED Solutions, Corechange, DigitalMoJo, Partech, BitFlash, Pelago Networks, Octopus, Riptech, Axerra, Elagent, PurpleYogi, OptiMight, World Wide Packets, ChipData, CryoCor, OutStart, Delphi Communication Systems, Isovia, Nerve Wireless, NetByTel, CommerceFlow, and Converge.

Nicola Sturgeon said the Conservatives would use a snap election to shift the UK right, force a hard Brexit, and impose cuts, calling it a major miscalculation and an attempt to exploit Labour’s disarray. She said the election would be about protecting Scotland from a Tory government and rejecting its agenda, while Scottish Conservative leader Ruth Davidson said the party would campaign on securing a strong Brexit deal and opposing a second Scottish referendum.

The MSPM0C1105/MSPM0C1106 are MSPM0 MCUs with an Arm Cortex-M0+ CPU up to 32 MHz, multiple low-power operating modes, PMU and clock management, DMA, event routing, flash and SRAM memory, GPIO, ADC, timers, serial interfaces, watchdogs, RTC, comparator, security, CRC, debug support, and factory constants.

Venezuelan TPS holders asked the Supreme Court to keep in place a federal judge’s order blocking the Trump administration from ending their protected status. They argued the Supreme Court’s earlier stay was limited, while the government said lower courts had defied that stay.

Ed Sachse, now president of property services at Kennedy Wilson, began in real estate with a teenage window-washing business in Detroit, later worked as an accountant and broker, founded his own property management company in 1993, survived stage 4 non-Hodgkin lymphoma and the Great Recession, and was eventually acquired by Kennedy Wilson.

President Rutherford B. Hayes issued a proclamation on July 18, 1877, stating that domestic violence existed in West Virginia at Martinsburg and other points along the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad, and warning those involved to disperse peacefully by noon on July 19, 1877.

The passage describes an optical waveguide display that uses first and second diffractive parts, with external waveguide surfaces coated by a material, preferably a meta-material, having a refractive index substantially equal to or less than 1.0. This lowers the TIR critical angle, widening the field of view and extending the wavelength range, and may also provide protective coverage; multicolor and multilayer waveguide embodiments are also described.

Genworth Financial shares fell 0.37%, with analysts’ 12-month target at $3 versus a latest close of $2.70. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 3, with 5 hold ratings and no buy, outperform, underperform, or sell ratings. Its ATR-14 is 0.1, weekly volatility is 2.81%, monthly volatility is 3.58%, RSI is 42.86, market capitalization is $1.39 billion, and 2.14 million shares traded versus a 3.43 million average.

Sheffield Lord Mayor Magid Magid called Donald Trump a “wasteman,” banned him from the city, and declared July 13 “Mexico Solidarity Day.” He said the stunt was to highlight Trump’s behavior and show support for Mexico, citing reasons including the Muslim ban, Paris agreement withdrawal, embassy move to Jerusalem, child imprisonment at borders, and defense of white supremacists.

The lecture reviews renewal theory, emphasizing the strong law, the elementary renewal theorem, and Blackwell’s theorem, then uses age and duration to explain why expected duration can exceed expected inter-renewal time. It then introduces countable-state Markov chains, including random walk and birth-death examples, and defines recurrence through first-passage probabilities and return times.

The passage describes a near-fatal case of sepsis after a scratch, explains that sepsis is an uncontrolled body response to infection that can cause organ failure, and lists symptoms and risk factors. It says there is no specific cure, but research on metformin and gene therapy is promising, and greater public and medical awareness is currently the most important way to save lives.

The passage presents a real-time face anonymization system for scientific experiment education that uses an improved YOLOv8 model (MSFF-YOLOv8), contour-adaptive occlusion refinement, and a custom dataset to blur faces while preserving instruments and operations. It reports 96.02% accuracy and 22.67 fps at 1080p, and introduces SOBA and OBR metrics to evaluate blurring accuracy and over-blurring.

La-Z-Boy is favored over Stanley Furniture, with stronger analyst support, higher revenue and earnings, better profitability, dividend payments, and greater institutional ownership, while Stanley Furniture is cheaper on a price-to-earnings basis and has lower volatility.

Sam Altman said intellectual property rights holders react more strongly to AI video than to still images because video feels more real and lifelike. He said OpenAI is giving rights holders more granular control in Sora, and predicted companies may eventually want more of their content in AI-generated videos.

Researchers have made progress toward understanding and potentially manipulating human memories, using methods involving face cells, CREB, and reconsolidation. Studies led by Dr. Susumu Tonegawa showed that artificial links between harmless situations and fear, and later positive associations, can be created, suggesting memories may be implanted or erased with the right tools.

The speakers say they are excited to play for the Stanley Cup, believe they earned it by beating three strong teams, and do not care about outside perceptions. They praise Mike Peca, explain their team’s physical style and strong skating forwards as key to success, and say playoff time off helped them relax and prepare. They also say their recent adversity has given them enough experience and confidence for the series.

The passage argues that trade deficits reduce U.S. demand and can raise unemployment, but this can be offset by other domestic demand. It says the dollar’s reserve-currency status does not force trade deficits, and claims China and South Korea hold excess reserves and manage currencies to gain trade advantages. It also criticizes China’s technology-transfer policies, saying U.S. companies voluntarily invest there despite the conditions.

The passage says an RSI(2) mean-reversion strategy on QQQ outperformed buy and hold, especially in several bear markets, and that adding a second indicator improved results further. The enhanced strategy is described as having a 12.7% CAGR, 14% time in market, 232 trades, 75% winners, a profit factor of 3, 19.5% max drawdown, and a Sharpe Ratio of 2.85.

SD Memory Card is a high-capacity, high-speed card with security features including mutual authentication, a new cipher algorithm, and optional non-secure access; it may also support ISO-7816-based security. SDIO cards are compatible with SD Memory cards and add I/O functionality for mobile devices, while avoiding damage in non-SDIO hosts. SD Memory Card communication uses a 9-pin interface and can operate at up to 208 MHz.

JD Wetherspoon’s is set to open a 1,600sq metre gastropub in Dublin city centre using the former Trustee Savings Bank and Baptist Chapel buildings on Lower Abbey Street, after receiving licensing approval and planning permission. The company already has several gastropubs in Dublin, Dún Laoghaire and Cork, and is known for low-priced drinks and food.

The lecture introduced auctions as a major pricing mechanism in procurement, Treasury sales, and online advertising, then analyzed independent private values models. It showed that in second-price sealed-bid auctions and button auctions, bidding true value is a weakly dominant strategy and revenue equals the expected second-highest value. It then derived first-price sealed-bid equilibrium bid shading and explained revenue equivalence: first- and second-price auctions yield the same expected revenue under standard assumptions. The lecture discussed reserve prices, risk aversion, correlated values, common value auctions, and winner’s curse, and concluded with an empirical oil-lease study showing asymmetric information helps explain bidding behavior.

High Speed (HS) mode allows codes to be read one at a time, with the ADS7828 stretching the clock after the read-addressing byte until conversion is complete. To remain in HS mode after a read, use a repeated START instead of a STOP, since STOP returns the part to F/S mode.

An Alberta Education survey on the K-12 curriculum review found respondents wanted more emphasis on practical skills and reading, writing, and math, with strong feedback especially on social studies. Most surveyed said the draft plans supported literacy, numeracy, critical thinking, and student success, while concerns focused on confusion about the drafts, political correctness, and representation of Indigenous and global perspectives.

The BGF China Flexible Equity Fund invests in both onshore A-shares and offshore Chinese equities using a long-only, fundamentals-driven, concentrated strategy. Managed by Helen Zhu with support from 10 China-focused analysts, it aims to capture opportunities across markets, sectors, and factors within a universe of over 4,300 stocks.

The study examined Turkish tour guiding students’ perceptions of emergency distance education during Covid-19. Students preferred face-to-face education and considered EDE insufficient for practical training, communication, and motivation, though they acknowledged advantages such as time management, flexibility, savings, and access to materials.

The passage describes the Foreign Relations of the United States ebook edition and the series’ purpose, legal standards, editing principles, and sources. It states that the series provides the official documentary record of major U.S. foreign policy decisions and diplomatic activity, and that most sources for this volume are declassified and available at the National Archives.

A strong data culture aligns organizations vertically and horizontally by using shared metrics, transparent data access, and common models. Digital leaders emphasize learning, transparency, measurement, and consistent beliefs, while laggards often face misalignment from entrenched habits and weak focus. Organizations typically fall into four patterns: data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, or data reliant.

Brad Vis has been selected as the Conservative candidate for Mission-Matsqui-Fraser Canyon in the next federal election after narrowly losing the riding to Liberal Jati Sidhu in 2015. Conservative leader Andrew Scheer and the riding association praised Vis, who criticized Liberal government spending and said Conservatives would do outreach across the large riding.

The speaker says he felt good despite the loss, but the other team played better, especially in the second period. He says his team must use more speed, shoot more, create traffic, and match the opponent’s intensity in the next game. He also says the loss was a learning experience, that they need to bounce back, and that the next game is very important.

The passage describes cancer diagnosis methods and assay panels that use targeted cfDNA methylation analysis. It provides oligonucleotide probe sets, probe-design methods, and classifiers for detecting cancer presence, stage, or type, including tissue-of-origin, based on differentially methylated genomic regions from specified lists.

The court held that the presiding judge lacked jurisdiction to file the “Report of Presiding Judge” in the McAdoo divorce case because the report had no connection to any issue in that case and could not be made part of its record. The peremptory writ of mandate was ordered to issue.

The passage describes a reconfigurable hardware switch pipeline for SDN that separates packet header fields into a primary packet header vector (PPHV) for fields processed by the match-action unit and a secondary packet header vector (SPHV) for fields that are not. The parser, configured by control-plane-generated parse graphs, extracts headers into these vectors, the MAU processes only the PPHV, and the deparser reassembles the packet using processed PPHV data, unprocessed SPHV data, and payload.

The passage describes PLL frequency limits, interrupt mappings, timing and electrical requirements, register descriptions, and design guidelines for multiple device subsystems, including EMAC, MDIO, GPIO, GPMC, HDMI, video processing, I2C, imaging, and DDR2/DDR3 memory interfaces.

The passage reviews Poisson process properties, including memoryless exponential interarrival times, stationary and independent increments, and the Poisson distribution of counts. It then explains combining independent Poisson processes, splitting a Poisson process with a Bernoulli switch, non-homogeneous Poisson processes, and the conditional uniform distribution of arrival epochs given a fixed number of arrivals, ending with a bus-arrival paradox about why observed waiting intervals seem longer than the mean interarrival time.

The E-mini S&P 500 futures track the S&P 500 index and are financially settled contracts traded on CME Globex. They began in 1997, have quarterly expirations, a contract value of $50 times the index, a tick size of $12.50, and a minimum fluctuation of 0.25 index points. The all-time high is 4808.25 and the low is 665.75. Trading runs Sunday to Friday with daily breaks, and settlement is cash-based using special opening quotes on the third Friday of the contract month.

Fifth Third Bank announced a $10.9 billion all-stock acquisition of Comerica, creating the ninth-largest U.S. lender with about $288 billion in assets. The deal, approved by both boards and pending regulatory clearance, is expected to close in early 2026.

The passage discusses the importance of strong goalies, playoff evaluation of reserve players, and comparisons between different championship teams and eras. It also describes a player’s scoring role changing with team expectations, notes the excitement and intensity of the Stanley Cup Finals, and praises a goalie and a versatile center for their playoff performance and all-around contribution.

Poland will invest 20 billion zlotys ($5.5 billion) to connect its fuel pipeline system with NATO’s Central Europe Pipeline System, extending infrastructure by about 300 kilometres and adding storage facilities. The project is intended to strengthen military readiness, resilience, and NATO logistics, with construction expected to take several years.

The buy-and-hold strategy is a passive, long-term approach in which investors buy stocks or ETFs and hold them for years or decades, ignoring short-term price swings. The passage says it can reduce costs and stress, defer capital gains taxes, and often outperforms active trading over long periods, especially in diversified portfolios.

This multicenter cross-sectional study of 185 children aged 6–59 months in southern Punjab, Pakistan found that wasting was associated with family monthly income and complementary feeding practices, stunting with TB contact history and exclusive breastfeeding, and undernutrition with monthly income and exclusive breastfeeding. Most children had low income, no exclusive breastfeeding, and poor complementary feeding practices.

The passage explains that design patterns for distributed systems help developers learn from others, share a common vocabulary, and build reusable components. It then introduces single-node container patterns: sidecars add functionality such as HTTPS termination, dynamic configuration, monitoring, and a simple PaaS; ambassadors broker traffic for sharding, service discovery, and request splitting; adapters normalize interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks. It also outlines multi-node patterns, especially replicated load-balanced services and sharded services, including caching, SSL termination, and the role of sharding functions.

The passage says the speaker values a calm, balanced personality, consistency, effort, and the ability for any line or player to step up in the playoffs. It also mentions learning from strong coaches and environments, and ends by mourning someone’s death while celebrating his life and legacy.

A Death Cross is when a short moving average, usually the 50-day, crosses below a long moving average, usually the 200-day. The passage says it can signal short-term weakness and help reduce drawdowns, but it also often causes premature exits and performs better as a defensive tool than as a standalone trading signal.
Northern Oil & Gas refinanced its 2028 notes with new 2033 notes, leaving annual interest costs roughly unchanged and pushing the next note maturity to its 2029 convertible notes.

Real estate expert Amir Korangy says renting can be a better choice than buying for millennials and Gen Z because home prices, mortgage rates, and ownership costs are high, while renting often offers more space and flexibility. He says not everyone should own a home, especially if they are not focused on building equity.

The court held that because the plaintiffs failed to prove they gave the defendant the contractually required five-day written notice, they did not establish a prima facie case and were not entitled to recover. The judgment was reversed and judgment was directed for the defendant, with costs.

The speaker says the team must stay focused and not let the loud, passionate crowd influence them, especially in the finals in Canada. They note the goalie played well, say the team respects the opportunity and urgency of the moment, and add that they have already handled similar high-emotion environments in Montreal and Buffalo.

The passage describes systems, devices, and methods for neuromodulation that use patient, clinician, or automatic input in a search method to evaluate candidate parameter sets and identify an optimal set for programming a neuromodulator. It also describes neuromodulation systems, implantable and external devices, and example search methods including sorting algorithms, gradient descent, and sensitivity analysis.

The passage describes SD card command timing, data transfer rules, erase and discard operations, write protection and lock/unlock behavior, APP_CMD and CMD6 switch functions, CMD8 initialization, and CRC and timeout requirements. It also details COP/FEP password protection, force erase, bus width restrictions, and read/write behavior for different card capacity types.

The rose gold 42mm Apple Watch Series 10 with GPS and cellular is at its lowest price yet. The Series 10 has a larger, brighter display, slimmer and lighter design, new water features, similar battery life to the Series 9, and faster charging.

Southwest Airlines operates frequent short flights that increase wear on planes and engines. After a deadly engine failure on Flight 1380 that killed one passenger, questions arose about maintenance and safety, though experts said the airline is not considered unsafe and noted its large fleet and strong overall safety record. Southwest has also faced FAA fines and other safety incidents, and says it has increased engine inspections.

The speaker says they are disappointed and frustrated by the league’s decision, cannot control it, and wishes the incident had been delayed until next season so they could compete. They say the injury was unintentional, that they only meant to push the other player aside, and that they want their team to win even though they cannot be part of it on Thursday.

The passage presents Americans across the country describing patriotism in different ways, including protest, military service, helping immigrants, community involvement, and support for Trump. Their views reflect deep divisions over national identity, race, protest, and what it means to be American.

Daisy-chain mode is enabled after power-up or reset by setting DAISY_CHAIN_LEN, which specifies the number of ADCs excluding ADC1. Register writes and reads in daisy-chain use N×24-bit SPI frames, with reads performed in two steps using 0xFE and then 0xFF frames. The passage also lists several register field functions and application notes for the ADS9803, including bandwidth modes, power supplies, layout guidance, and its use in ATE applications.

Пассаж описывает RFID в ритейле как технологию, обеспечивающую автоматическую идентификацию, трекинг товаров и клиентов, инвентаризацию в реальном времени и улучшение логистики, управления запасами и клиентского опыта. Представлены архитектура ETL-хранилища данных для интеграции POS- и RFID-данных, логическая модель аналитической базы и ожидаемые эффекты внедрения, включая рост точности учета, снижение потерь и повышение продаж и лояльности.

Preston beat Hull 2-1 to stay close to the playoff places, while Derby’s 3-0 win over Brentford kept them in the automatic promotion spots. Aston Villa, Cardiff and Fulham also won to remain near the top, while Sunderland lost again and stayed in the relegation zone. Birmingham and QPR earned wins, and Norwich and Millwall also recorded 1-0 and 2-0 victories respectively.

Dell Technologies held its 2025 Securities Analyst Meeting on October 7, 2025, with executives including Paul Frantz, Arthur Lewis, and David Kennedy. The company said it would discuss non-GAAP financial measures and year-over-year growth unless otherwise specified.

The passage reports a presidential address noting the death of Foreign Minister Dr. Amancio Alcorta, affirming peace with all states, progress on boundary disputes and arbitration treaties, and describing a difficult but improving financial situation with revenues slightly above estimates and expenditures below budgeted amounts.

Tesla’s June 30, 2021 Form 10-Q reported $22.347 billion in six-month revenue and $1.642 billion in net income, with total assets of $55.146 billion and cash and cash equivalents of $16.229 billion. The filing also described bitcoin holdings of $1.31 billion, adoption of ASU 2020-06, debt repayments and conversions, stock-based compensation expense, and ongoing legal and lease commitments.

Skin redness in hot weather is linked to inflammation, stress, lack of sleep, dehydration, and certain foods, and the passage recommends anti-inflammatory, hydrating, plant-based foods, whole grains, and avoiding alcohol, excess coffee, refined sugar, and flour.

The passage gives PCB layout guidelines for a switching regulator: keep feedback traces away from the inductor and noise, place input/output capacitors and compensation parts close to the IC, make power traces short and thick, use ground planes, connect grounds carefully, and arrange components to reduce EMI and noise.

Undocumented immigrants across the U.S. are fearing stepped-up ICE raids and deportation, with churches serving as possible sanctuaries. The fear grew after Guadalupe Garcia de Rayos was deported following a routine check-in, and a woman named Jessica now fears the same outcome at her upcoming ICE appointment. Pastor Emma Lozano says her Chicago church offers sanctuary, but she says more people are needed, and the church has faced hate speech and now has an armed guard.

Harvard researchers found knee osteoarthritis has doubled since the mid-20th century, even after adjusting for age and weight. They suggest the rise may be linked partly to physical inactivity rather than just wear and tear, and say changing modern lifestyle factors could help reduce risk.

The study modeled COVID-19 spread on synthetic contact networks with households, schools, workplaces, and community transmission, comparing Florida-like and Texas-like populations. It found that vulnerable individuals isolating alone was insufficient to reduce their infection risk, population structure had mixed effects, and co-worker interactions contributed more to spread than classmate interactions.

Using Mendelian randomization with UK Biobank discovery data and FinnGen replication data, the study identified 12 prostate cancer-associated genes and found enrichment in metabolic and cancer-related pathways. Drug prediction and docking highlighted several candidate drugs, and the authors concluded these genes may inform targeted therapy for prostate cancer.

British property interests in Chile and Argentina encouraged a peaceful settlement, leading to secret negotiations on mutual armament limits through British mediation; Argentina reportedly rejected an initial disarmament proposal, while later talks also addressed Pacific coast affairs and boundary settlement. The presidential message was optimistic on finances and mentioned arbitration, the army and navy, and colonization.

Amgen said Repatha prevented heart disease death, heart attack, and the most common stroke type in a 12,000-patient trial. Analysts said the results could help the cholesterol-lowering shot reach a broader market.

This study found that LVEF-1, a simple echocardiographic index, was lower in patients with more severe coronary artery stenosis, negatively correlated with Gensini score and BNP, and better than LVEF for predicting moderate or severe stenosis. After PCI, LVEF-1 increased, and its improvement was independently associated with Gensini score and stent diameter.

NXP Semiconductors shares fell 5% after China warned against US trade threats, reducing hopes that Beijing would soon approve Qualcomm’s $44 billion acquisition. Qualcomm’s deal has approval from eight of nine regulators, with China still pending, and talks were said to be on hold.

The study found immune responses to BNT162b2 and BNT162b2SA were as good as comparisons made in the same participants, and the results were not likely due to chance. Temporary lymphocyte drops, injection site reactions, and systemic events were generally mild or moderate and resolved quickly. Serious medical problems and deaths were rare, and researchers did not believe most were related to the study vaccines.

The passage says Peter Drucker’s ideas influenced the concept of an “ownership society,” later associated with George W. Bush. It argues that India in 2017 was not yet such a society, but since 2014 the Modi government has taken steps to reduce state control, including banking reforms, cutting LPG and kerosene subsidies, and UDAY, which shifts responsibility to state electricity boards.

More than 500 flu cases were reported in the Show-Me-State last week, and officials said it is too early to know whether this is a bad year or an early spike. Registered Nurse Sandy Gibbons advised people to see a doctor as soon as flu symptoms begin and to start anti-viral medicine within 72 hours, along with getting fluids, rest, and avoiding returning to work too soon to prevent spreading illness.

The passage promotes a custom term paper writing service, claiming it is convenient, ensures quality and high grades, offers online ordering, and provides tips for choosing a service by comparing prices, reading reviews, getting quotes, and contacting writers. It also says the service prioritizes quality, fast delivery, experience, and commitment.

The TPS7H500x-SP controllers support programmable dead time, leading edge blank time, duty cycle limits, current sense and hiccup protection, external fault shutdown, slope compensation, thermal shutdown, and fixed-frequency peak current mode control. The passage also gives design guidance and an example push-pull converter application, including component selection, layout recommendations, and revision and packaging information.

A backtest of the NIFTY 50 from 2008 to today found a Santa Claus Rally effect, using a strategy that went long at the close of the second Friday in December and exited at the close of the first trading day of the new year. The reported results were a 1.2% average gain per trade, 71% win ratio, profit factor of 6, and 7% max drawdown.

The Steelers unveiled 1978 throwback jerseys to replace the “bumblebee” uniforms for at least the next two seasons, honoring the 40-year anniversaries of Super Bowl XIII and XIV. They will wear them against the Browns in Week 8.

Digital leaders promote transparent, widely shared data access, measurement, and data-driven goals to align teams and support collaboration, innovation, and risk-taking. Digital laggards restrict data, rely more on judgment and silos, and often struggle to connect goals to strategy or use quantitative metrics effectively.

Amazon.com, Inc. announced that on February 25, 2019, Indra K. Nooyi was elected to its Board of Directors and appointed to the Audit Committee. She received a restricted stock unit award for 549 shares, vesting in three annual installments beginning May 15, 2020, and entered into the company’s standard indemnification agreement.

The passage explains stocks and bonds as different investments: stocks represent ownership and can offer higher long-term returns but greater risk, while bonds are loans that usually pay fixed interest and are generally less risky. It says history favors stocks, but a mix of stocks and bonds can reduce volatility and drawdowns. It also briefly describes a seasonal “Investing only in Winter” strategy and notes that its backtest did not perform as expected.

The passage describes engineered muscle-targeting AAV compositions, vector systems, particles, and methods that use n-mer motifs, including RGD and non-RGD motifs, to target muscle cells and deliver therapeutic cargo for muscle diseases. It also reports selection and characterization of muscle-tropic AAV capsid variants in mice and across species.

The passage reviews cash back credit card offers, highlighting the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card for its unlimited 2% cash rewards, $200 bonus after $500 spending in 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months, no annual fee, and cell phone protection. It also lists offers from Capital One Quicksilver and Citi, along with disclosure and advertising information.

European stocks rose Monday, led by banks, as thin holiday trading was expected and London and U.S. markets were closed. The Stoxx Europe 600 gained 0.5%, with Italian and German banks advancing and major national indexes mostly higher.

Microsoft reported second-quarter fiscal 2021 revenue of $43.1 billion and net income of $15.5 billion, compared with $36.9 billion and $11.6 billion a year earlier. Revenue increased in all three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Cash and cash equivalents were $14.4 billion, total assets were $304.1 billion, and total liabilities were $173.9 billion as of December 31, 2020.

In 124 people with borderline resectable or locally advanced PDAC, pre-treatment serum 3-IAA was not associated with chemotherapy response or overall survival, and no significant survival differences were seen across 3-IAA quartiles.

A Michigan family says their five-year-old son was repeatedly taped shut and denied lunch by two teachers at Highview Elementary School. The parents filed a police report and plan to sue, while the school district says it has removed one staff member and is investigating the claims.

Researchers at McGill University and the University of Toronto describe gaslighting as a learning process based on prediction and surprise, rather than only psychodynamic theory. The model says manipulators exploit trust and close relationships by repeatedly violating expectations and making targets feel incompetent about reality. It suggests anyone could be vulnerable if they trust the wrong person.

The passage describes Reagan transition foreign policy documents and personnel, including an interim advisory committee and a State Department transition team, and then reproduces Reagan’s November 20, 1975 presidential candidacy statement criticizing Washington leadership and calling for responsible, responsive government.

Builder Eric Woodward is turning a vacant Fort Langley lot into a pop-up park after cancelling plans for a boutique hotel project amid a dispute with the Township. The park will include gathering and play areas, and major work is expected to be complete by early July.

The study examines transfer learning with SFCNs on MRI age and sex prediction using UK Biobank pre-training and OASIS, IXI, and ABIDE as target datasets. It finds that pre-trained features are task-specific but reusable across datasets, transfer learning outperforms elastic net regression and training from scratch, and performance and convergence improve most when the source and target data are more similar.

Teuvo Teravainen said he stays calm, has family who play the sport in Finland, and was happy to score. Antoine Vermette said the opportunity was exciting, emphasized confidence, perseverance, puck possession, and praised Teravainen as a skilled, smart player.

Sea of Thieves was Rare’s biggest launch in over two decades, with the highest launch-month sales for any Rare title since NPD began tracking in 1995. It was the second best-selling game of March and the eighth best-selling game of 2018 year-to-date, though Game Pass downloads were not included.

U.S. stocks fell as 10-year Treasury yields reached 3%, raising borrowing-cost concerns, and several quarterly results disappointed. The S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq were weighed down by technology and industrial shares, including Alphabet, Facebook, 3M, Caterpillar and Apple, while consumer confidence rebounded and oil prices reversed lower after U.S.-French talks on Iran.

The study created the first large-scale, publicly available Turkish dataset for citation intent classification in Computer Science, with 2,650 labeled citation sentences from 723 articles. It used five labels from the Web of Science scheme, benchmarked GPT-4o and Gemini models, improved performance with DSPy prompt optimization to 86.5%, and achieved 91.3% accuracy with a stacked ensemble model.

Amazon.com, Inc. entered into an amended and restated credit agreement on April 27, 2018, increasing its unsecured revolving credit facility from $3.0 billion to $7.0 billion and extending the term to April 27, 2021. The company also established a $7.0 billion commercial paper program for unsecured notes with maturities of up to 397 days, to be used for general corporate purposes.

The passage discusses the pressure of closing out a hockey series, the need to stay mentally and emotionally ready, uncertainty about an injured teammate’s availability, and the importance of remaining businesslike and focused on the game rather than the possible outcome. It also contrasts the pressures of winning at home versus on the road.

Research by Ross Levine and co-authors finds that easier borrowing leads businesses to invest more in pollution-reducing projects, lower toxic emissions, and receive better environmental ratings. Using bank deposit windfalls from the fracking boom as a test case, they found benzene levels fell 26 percent in non-gas-producing counties with greater credit availability.

Ryan Malone, a 2010 Olympic silver medalist, signed a tryout deal with the Iowa Wild to stay eligible for the 2018 U.S. Olympic men’s hockey team, and Brian Gionta remains on USA Hockey’s radar for the roster.

The passage says David Ellison refused to discuss a possible bid for Warner Bros. Discovery, but many in media expect one after the Ellisons bought Paramount earlier this year. It explains that a Paramount-WBD merger could make industrial sense, face potentially easier antitrust review, and likely be financed partly by Larry Ellison, though no deal exists yet.

The passage introduces an edit distance for finitely presented \(R^d\)-persistence modules and proves that, for constructible modules, it equals the interleaving distance. It also shows that stable invariants can be characterized via either distance.

A Calgary mother’s car was stolen with her 12-year-old son’s hockey gear inside, and she says replacing the equipment will cost $1,500 to $2,000. Shauna Sinfield, who has multiple sclerosis and lives on a fixed income, said police believe the car and gear are unlikely to be recovered. A GoFundMe campaign has raised $685 toward a $3,000 goal.

The speakers say the playoffs have been tougher, the team must work through calls and penalties, and that sticking to their systems and game plan is important. They say Detroit is playing well, they like playing at home, they are getting chances and defending well, but the bounces have not been going their way.

The TPS7H500x-SP controllers use peak current mode control with CS_ILIM for current sensing and current-limit setting, enter hiccup mode when CS_ILIM exceeds 1.05 V, and support external fault shutdown via the FAULT pin and slope compensation via RSC. The passage also gives design and layout guidance, including a space-grade push-pull converter example with selected component values, operating ranges, compensation, and PCB routing recommendations.

The speaker said the team had opportunities in the third period but a mediocre second period and lapses cost them the game. They noted the game was a tough, well-played playoff contest, praised both goaltenders, and said the team must play a consistent 60 minutes, stay focused, and build on how well they have played at home.

The passage highlights top open source posts about DomTerm, the history and meaning of open source and container runtimes, and Christine Peterson’s coining of the term “open source software.” It also describes a middle school program that uses Linux to keep over 200 old computers running, while celebrating an eight-year anniversary and community members.

A fourth-grade girl in Grand Haven, Michigan, is selling handmade stretchy straw fidgeters to help pay school lunch debts after learning some classmates only got cheese sandwiches if they owed money. Her family also started a GoFundMe, which surpassed its original $188 goal and is now aiming for $2,200 to erase lunch debt across the district.

The article argues for a sociocultural, ecological perspective on foreign language education policy and practice, focusing on English teaching in state schools in Asia, especially Malaysia and Thailand. It says curriculum goals, proficiency targets, teacher proficiency, and communicative teaching methods often mismatch classroom realities, social identities, and socioeconomic conditions, contributing to inequality and poor outcomes.

The study models P. vivax relapse with an exponential clock in which each hypnozoite activates independently at a constant rate, and fits this model to daily follow-up data from 1,344 children in the SPf66 trial in Thailand. It estimated an average hypnozoite carriage duration of 171 days, a mean sporozoite batch size of 6.9, and that about 75% of observed symptomatic P. vivax infections were relapses.

Bacteria from grape leaves can degrade guaiacol, a smoke compound linked to wine’s ashy aftertaste, suggesting a possible way to reduce smoke taint. The study found two strains that nearly eliminated guaiacol in 96 hours, though more work is needed for other smoky compounds.

The Department of Education will hold its first School Safety Conference at Okkodo High School on June 26 for about 400 support staff to address bullying, harassment, suicide, sexual identity, drugs, alcohol, mental health, and crisis response. DOE says safety issues are increasing and is focusing more on treatment and group therapy for drug offenses, with 352 illegal drug use or possession cases reported in School Year 2015-2016.

Investors are watching the Czech National Bank meeting amid speculation it may scrap its crown cap, while Britain’s ONS is reviewing how to detect recessions sooner. Markets were volatile after Fed minutes, U.S. tax reform delays, and concern ahead of Trump’s summit with Xi; Wall Street fell slightly, Treasury yields eased, and European stocks were expected to open lower.

NVIDIA’s Q3 fiscal 2020 Form 10-Q reported revenue of $3.014 billion and net income of $899 million, both down year over year, with gross margin rising to 63.6%. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $9.769 billion. The filing also described the pending Mellanox acquisition, lease accounting adoption, stock-based compensation, debt, legal proceedings, and segment results for GPU and Tegra Processor businesses.

Jack Wilshere has reportedly met with West Ham manager Manuel Pellegrini to discuss a possible move after confirming he will leave Arsenal. West Ham are said to be leading the race, though Fenerbahce have also offered him a large deal. Wilshere is still deciding his next move, with family reasons and a possible England recall making Premier League football appealing.

The Education Department continued negotiations during the shutdown on new student loan repayment rules and which postbaccalaureate programs count as professional degrees. Officials proposed a one-year expanded definition after committee pushback, but no consensus was reached, and talks will resume in November.

In 451,355 UK Biobank participants, obesity and diabetes were both associated with worse cardiovascular biomarkers and higher rates of myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death. Cardiovascular risk increased with BMI in both diabetes and non-diabetes groups, but normal-weight participants with diabetes had higher cardiovascular mortality than obese participants without diabetes.

The court denied the defendant’s motion to sever 13 counts arising from six alleged extortion incidents at three Chinese restaurants, holding that all counts were properly joined under CPL 200.20(2)(b) because evidence of each incident would be material and admissible in a trial of the others. The court found common scheme, identity, and intent supported joinder.

The speaker said the team needs to be more patient, play simple hockey, get the puck in deep, reduce the opponent’s neutral-zone speed, and find ways to get shots through blocked lanes and traffic. They also said the team could have played better in front of Ward, noted frustration in their game, and hoped to rebound in the next game.

In 67,060 Chinese adults, arterial stiffness measured by baPWV was negatively associated with eGFR and related to CKD. In the cohort analysis, higher baPWV predicted incident CKD, lower eGFR predicted higher arterial stiffness, and cross-lagged analysis suggested that decline in eGFR preceded increases in baPWV.

In a case study of one woman with a transtibial amputation, long-term in-lab spinal cord stimulation restored missing-limb sensation during walking and was associated with reduced knee antagonist co-contraction, increased tensor fasciae latae activity, and increased pelvic obliquity range-of-motion and pelvic drop.

Bear Grylls said schools are not fully preparing children for adult life and should empower them more, arguing that success comes from determination rather than exam results. He also said his own success came more from persistence than school performance, praised Eton, and said he hopes Donald Trump is too busy to join him on an adventure.

North Texas saw hail from thunderstorms last weekend, but severe weather season has started slowly, with only a few tornadoes reported statewide and four in North Texas. Oklahoma has recorded no tornadoes so far in 2018, its slowest start since April 26, 1962, and Kansas has also had zero tornadoes.

The study introduced SCIseg, an open-source deep learning method for automatic 3D segmentation of the spinal cord and T2-weighted hyperintense lesions in spinal cord injury images. Trained on 191 patients and 231 scans from three sites, it performed well across heterogeneous scanners and image settings, correlated with clinical scores, and generalized reasonably to degenerative cervical myelopathy.

Medvedev said the Russian economy is entering a positive growth stage, citing industrial output growth of 1.3% and agricultural growth of 5% over the last year. He also said agricultural machinery production rose by 60% and that the sector has strong export potential.

Anyone can dine at Army & Air Force Exchange Service restaurants and buy grab-and-go items from Express locations for on-installation consumption, while full Exchange shopping privileges remain limited to Soldiers, Airmen, and their families.

The group is calm and focused on sticking with the same game plan for Sunday, relying on mental toughness, starting better, and turning the game back on their opponent at home. They say they have handled adversity well, used a collective effort against tough lines, and expect a strong effort from both sides.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on July 25, 2019 it announced its second quarter 2019 financial results and included exhibits with the press release and non-GAAP financial information.

Athletes Unlimited, founded by Jon Patricof and Jonathan Soros, launched player-led professional women’s leagues in softball, volleyball, lacrosse, and basketball using a new format with no owners or coaches, weekly team drafts, a leaderboard-based scoring system, and athlete decision-making through Player Executive Committees. The company also emphasized athlete compensation, long-term profit sharing, social impact, and broadcasting and storytelling to build awareness and fan engagement.

The disclosure describes allocating wireless resources in multiple-BSSID WLANs using TIM group AID mappings and trigger frames. An AP can assign random RUs to selected BSSIDs, the Tx BSSID, or unassociated stations by using specific AID values, and can advertise multiple-BSSID information and random access parameters in management frames.
Grupo Supervielle S.A. published a slide deck for a presentation at Latin Securities Argentina in London, alongside Seeking Alpha transcript team notes and unrelated article listings.

The speaker honors Amherst and Robert Frost, arguing that privilege brings responsibility to serve the public interest. He praises Frost as both artist and American, saying art and poetry check power, preserve truth, and strengthen national life. He calls for educated people to help solve major domestic and international problems and hopes for an America that balances strength with wisdom, beauty, and cultural opportunity.

The CAT offense uses a 2-1-2 spread with sharp passing, a skilled middle/post player, baseline back cuts when the ball goes inside, post rolls to the basket on corner passes, and opposite-corner skip passes against traps or double teams. Dribble penetration should be used sparingly to escape trouble and keep the ball moving.

Tight ends remain a major offensive position because their size, athleticism, blocking, and route-running create difficult matchups and add versatility. They line up near the line of scrimmage, catch short-to-medium routes, help in the run and pass game, and can be key red-zone targets.

Look Good … Feel Better will have beauty professionals volunteering at Dignity Health Sierra Nevada Memorial Hospital Diagnostic Imaging on May 8 to support women in active cancer treatment. The free program offers skincare and makeup techniques and guidance on coping with hair loss.

Guangdong Province is experiencing China’s largest chikungunya outbreak, with over 4,000 confirmed cases since late July, mostly in Shunde District, Foshan. Authorities are urging residents to remove standing water as no specific antiviral treatment or vaccine exists.

CTC-Pak officials marked World No Tobacco Day by urging priority for health over business, saying tobacco causes major NCD deaths in Pakistan, including heart attacks, and calling for stricter enforcement of tobacco laws, an 85 percent pictorial health warning on cigarette packs, and higher tobacco taxes.

The passage describes a new minorization-maximization algorithm for maximum likelihood and REML estimation in multivariate variance components linear mixed models, addressing limitations of existing methods. Applied to PsychENCODE isoform data, it found strong local cis effects, collectively large trans effects, greater shared genetic influences among cis-SNPs, and more genetic signals at isoform level than gene level, some linked to psychiatric disorders.

The passage reports on Texas Longhorn recruiting, noting 10 remaining top football targets and 19 early commitments, along with bowl possibilities depending on the Texas A&M game. It also summarizes Texas women’s basketball and men’s basketball results, and details signing classes in baseball, women’s basketball, volleyball, softball, and golf.

The paper introduces SoDaDE, a data-driven solvent fingerprint trained with a transformer on the Spange solvent property dataset using data augmentation and masking. SoDaDE achieved the best results on the Catechol Benchmark, outperforming prior representations in both full-data and single-solvent settings.

The lecture introduces stability and causality for discrete-time systems, showing that for linear shift-invariant systems stability means the unit sample response is absolutely summable and causality means it is zero for n less than 0. The board will also discuss recruiting tuition-paying Chinese students, elementary construction, consolidation and redistricting, and the possible closing of Regency Park Elementary School.

Average investment is expected to be about $1 million, and 4% reported spending over $10 million. The most preferred blockchain type was private blockchain (69%), followed by hybrid or consortium blockchains (20%) and public blockchain (10%).

Pump and dump schemes are described as scams in which a promoter artificially raises a stock’s price with false or misleading information, then sells to latecomers as the price falls. They are said to be mostly illegal and immoral, common in OTC and crypto markets, and likely to cause losses for investors.

It provides mechanisms for calculating a paging occasion based on parameters such as DRX cycle, paging interval, device ID, and PO offset, and for transmitting or receiving paging DCI and/or paging messages within paging resources on preset beams or ports, including by using quasi-co-location information.

Orbital ATK reported Q2 2017 sales of $1.12 billion and adjusted earnings above estimates, but GAAP profits fell and free cash flow was negative. The company raised full-year sales and earnings guidance, while Argus Research upgraded the stock to buy with a $120 target. The passage argues the stock looks expensive based on its valuation.

The study proposes “whole human pedagogy,” a decolonial education abroad framework centered on embodiment, emotions, belonging, and becoming. Interviews with 17 practitioners found these themes reflected in their work and suggested the framework can guide program development, professional development, and future research.

Sean “Diddy” Combs was sentenced to four years and two months in prison and fined $500,000 for transporting people across state lines for sexual encounters. He was convicted in July, acquitted of sex trafficking and racketeering charges, and said he was sorry before sentencing.

Mr. Stevens reported hostility to the Hawaiian succession and growing annexation sentiment, with revolutionary plans checked by a U.S. naval vessel. He described conflict between the Queen and the legislature, warned the monarchy might be overthrown, and urged annexation or a customs union with U.S. control of Pearl Harbor. By January 28, 1893, news arrived of a peaceful revolution and the Queen’s dethronement. The report says U.S. policy toward Hawaii from 1820 to 1893 was one of close friendship and protection, while foreign intervention was distrusted.

Despite severe education research cuts under the Trump administration, some contracts may be reinstated, the Education Department is seeking input to modernize IES, and several researchers describe the situation as cautiously optimistic. However, staff shortages and reduced reporting capacity continue to threaten data quality, while future support for NAEP, NCES, and regional education labs remains uncertain.

The notes will pay 5.75% interest, be convertible at US$14.85 per share, and the company plans to use proceeds for debt payments, Trogarzo™ commercialization, and general corporate purposes.

NGC 5949 is a dwarf barred spiral galaxy about 44 million light-years away and roughly one-hundredth the mass of the Milky Way. Its proximity made it discoverable by William Herschel in 1801, and dwarf galaxies like it raise questions such as the cuspy halo and missing satellites problems.

The Ultimate Oscillator is a momentum indicator that measures price momentum across the 7-, 14-, and 28-period timeframes using weighted averages of buying pressure and true range. It was developed by Larry Williams in 1976. The passage says it is consistent in backtests, can be used as a mean reversion strategy, and trading signals are based on divergences, with oversold below 30 and overbought above 70.
