Through a risky strategy that included securing Parcel J at Fan Pier, raising funds, involving the public, and selecting Diller + Scofidio as architects, the ICA opened its new building in 2006 and later drew large crowds, including for Shepard Fairey’s 2009 exhibition.

The Supreme Court dismissed Pradyuman’s father Varun Thakur’s plea to cancel the Pinto family’s interim bail in the Ryan International School murder case. The Punjab and Haryana High Court had earlier granted them anticipatory bail, barred them from leaving India without permission, and asked them to assist the investigation.

The eruption has displaced thousands, opened 24 fissures since May 3, and also covered wells at a geothermal plant, with officials monitoring the damage.

It allocates 20% to each asset and stays in cash when there is no monthly signal. The passage says backtests showed a maximum drawdown of -13.24%, and that ETFs can be used instead of picking individual securities.

The company completed acquisitions including Whole Foods Market and Souq, issued $16.0 billion of senior notes, and said it would adopt new accounting standards in 2018 and 2019.

The company reported quarterly earnings of ($0.26) per share on $47.44 million revenue, both better than estimates, and insiders sold shares in recent transactions.

President Hassan Rouhani had threatened to disrupt oil shipments from neighboring countries, and Qassem Soleimani praised the remarks and said he was ready to implement such a policy.

VC Dr Iqrar Ahmad said the university had started 48 new degree programs, student enrolment had risen above 25,000, financial assistance had reached Rs700 million, and the competitive research portfolio had crossed Rs2.5 billion. The project is meant to challenge viewers’ perceptions of refugees, highlight the role of governments, and create an ambivalent mix of surveillance, art, and distortion.

India has called on the UN secretariat to disclose data on serious misconduct by UN personnel and on cases where immunity was waived or refused. India said the UN should better address accountability for wrongdoing, noting that while peacekeeping abuse data is published, a full roster of allegations across the UN has not been made public.

The double bottom chart pattern is a bullish reversal pattern with two similar swing lows and a swing high between them. It is considered complete when price breaks above the neckline, and traders may enter long on that breakout or more aggressively at the second low. Profit targets are often measured from the pattern size, with stop losses placed either in the middle or below the pattern.

Emperor penguins are classified as near-threatened, and researchers warn their population could decline as temperatures rise. A new remote monitoring system uses time-lapse cameras and weather data to track colony behavior, and it has shown the penguins huddling more in warmer weather, suggesting possible food shortages.

A UDMA write CRC error occurs after device termination because the ATAC fails to restart the CRC for subsequent write portions, continuing from the previous CRC instead. Interferometric SHG polarimetry was used to image CVD-grown hBN and reveal widespread antiparallel domains and domain boundaries on high-symmetry substrates. SHG intensity varied by up to three orders of magnitude across samples, and correlating SHG with Raman intensity, linewidth, and orientational spread provided a structural quality framework. The study concludes that destructive interference from antiparallel domains governs the SHG suppression and that the method is scalable for assessing crystalline quality in hBN and other non-centrosymmetric 2D materials.

In a prospective study of 22 cirrhotic patients undergoing TIPS, untargeted metabolomics showed that bile acids changed most after shunt placement, especially between post-procedure peripheral samples and discharge. Greater pre- to post-TIPS hepatic-vein metabolome dissimilarity was associated with worse later hepatic encephalopathy, suggesting a role for intrahepatic shunting. Post-shunt decreases in specific bile acids were inversely associated with HE severity, and glycerophosphocholine and bilirubin-related metabolites also fluctuated with HE outcomes.

Steve Scalise and others at an Alexandria baseball practice before being killed by police, had reportedly been living in a white cargo van near the YMCA for months and kept to himself. He noted the 242nd US Independence Day anniversary, Azerbaijan’s 100th anniversary, and said the US has supported Azerbaijan since its independence and continues to support an independent, stable Azerbaijan.

Awards may be cash, stock, or performance stock, with payouts based on a pre-established formula.

Within one year, 0.258% had a documented suicide attempt and 0.242% had self-directed violence, while reported suicide deaths did not differ significantly between groups.

It says Type O blood is most critically needed, though all types are welcome, and lists several upcoming mobile blood drives in Avon Lake, Amherst, Elyria, and Grafton.

Pakistan said it proposed five working groups on counterterrorism, intelligence sharing, military, economy, trade, transit, refugee repatriation and connectivity, and reiterated support for an Afghan-led peace process. The passage also says both states support each other despite criticism over Israel’s actions in Gaza and Myanmar’s treatment of the Rohingya.

The lecture reviews collective Thomson scattering, explaining that when the scattering wavelength exceeds the Debye length, the laser scatters from plasma modes such as ion acoustic waves and electron plasma waves. It derives the scattered power spectrum in terms of a spectral density function, then uses a test-particle and Klimontovich distribution approach to express that function through plasma susceptibilities and permittivity. The passage then introduces the Vlasov equation and Landau contour to calculate susceptibility for arbitrary and Maxwellian distributions.

PATA was responsible for pre-admission work-ups for outpatients, but limited capacity, manual scheduling, uneven provider workload, and delays in the OR caused problems for patients, staff, and surgery timing. However, greater stimulant use was associated in an age-dependent way with lower thalamic resting blood flow in adults and lower medial prefrontal cortex response to methylphenidate in adolescents. The team is excited and confident, feeling healthy, rested, and energetic except for Dwayne’s injury. They hope to play well Saturday night, continue with their game plan, and earn another game. A player was praised for bringing physicality, forechecking well, and creating offense.

Data is read as 12-bit words in two bytes, with special handling for high-speed mode and for settling time when the internal reference is turned on.

Students, staff, friends, and family shared memories and goodbye messages, and the school plans to add a plaque to the tree when it is large enough.

The study used a municipality-level agent-based model with demography, mobility, mixing, hospitalization, and seroprevalence data to analyze the first COVID-19 wave in the Netherlands. It found that mobility reductions contributed most to epidemic control, school closure had little impact, and subnational interventions could have reduced societal burden with comparable epidemic control.

SWIM’s 2013 conference, “Dare to Fail,” was nearly complete when a major snowstorm threatened Boston, forcing the leadership to weigh canceling, holding a half-day event, or proceeding as planned. After months of speaker, marketing, operations, and sponsorship work, the team met with MIT Sloan staff on February 7 to decide what to do before vendors arrived and costs increased.

A study of 105 pet dogs found that 33 showed addictive-like behavior toward toys, with terriers and shepherds more commonly affected. Researchers suggest the drive may be tied to the excitement of play rather than the toy itself, and say such behavior may be rare.

Baking powder and baking soda are not interchangeable: baking soda is a base that reacts with acids, while baking powder contains baking soda plus a dry acid. They can be substituted in some cases, and both can be tested by adding water or vinegar to check for bubbling. Baking powder lasts 3–12 months, while baking soda lasts much longer if sealed and kept cool.

Federal Reserve officials were nearly unanimous in September that rates should be cut because of a weakening labor market, but they were split 10-9 on whether there should be two or three total cuts by year-end, with a slim majority favoring two more. Minutes also said most participants expected further easing this year, while concerns about tariffs, inflation, and a government shutdown affected the outlook.

The paper introduces LOT, an inductive method that builds human-readable taxonomies of reasoning features to distinguish large reasoning models from their outputs. Applied to 12 open-source LRMs, LOT outperforms few-shot prompting, VML, and a human-defined taxonomy, reveals systematic reasoning differences across scale, base family, and domain, and shows that modifying smaller Qwen models’ reasoning can improve GPQA accuracy by 3.3–5.7%.

The lecture discusses paternalism in behavioral economics, distinguishing hard paternalism from soft forms such as libertarian and asymmetric paternalism, and arguing that interventions are most justified when they help people with mistakes without hurting others. It reviews arguments for and against paternalism, gives examples like the Save More Tomorrow 401(k) plan, and notes that nudges can help but also backfire or be unwanted. It concludes that psychological factors matter in economic decisions and that market solutions do not solve all problems.

Comcast Corporation has a consensus “Buy” rating from 23 brokerages, with an average 12-month target price of $79.31. Recent analyst reports raised ratings and price targets, the company reported quarterly EPS of $0.89 on revenue of $21 billion, and it announced a 2-for-1 stock split and a higher quarterly dividend.

A new study found that window-seat passengers may have lower exposure to germs on airplanes, and researchers concluded that one person on a 150-passenger flight would likely be infected on average if a contagious passenger were in an aisle seat. The study also found that aisle-seat passengers moved around more often than middle- or window-seat passengers.

Amazon has added Outlook.com calendar support to Alexa, letting users manage events by voice through the iOS Alexa app. It also updated Tap speakers for hands-free Alexa activation and echo spatial perception, while retaining about eight hours of battery life.

The passage presents SOS pressure defense as a practical basketball program for improving defense against stronger offenses. It outlines six keys: teaching fundamentals in simple stages, using SOS action words, forcing opponents to checkpoint areas, encouraging switching on screens, initiating pressure in the backcourt, and assigning each defender a specific role.

The speaker praises players’ hard play, commitment, and grit, says the team has experience, motivation, and momentum from past elimination games, and describes the series as mentally demanding with strong goaltending and intense effort from both teams.

New research found that Protoceratops embryos incubated for nearly three months and Hypacrosaurus embryos for six months, based on growth lines in fossilized teeth. The results suggest dinosaur incubation was more like that of reptiles than birds, and that long incubation and slow maturation may have put non-avian dinosaurs at a disadvantage at the end of the Cretaceous.

Trump issued an order ending birthright citizenship, prompting federal challenges. The Supreme Court first rejected universal injunctions, then lower courts ruled against the order. The administration has now asked the Court to review decisions from the 9th Circuit and New Hampshire, with arguments likely in 2026 if the Court takes the case.

The Wisconsin Court of Appeals affirmed Andrew Sabo’s conviction, holding that the search warrant affidavit established probable cause, that he failed to make the preliminary showing required for a Franks-Mann hearing, and that the trial court properly denied disclosure of the informant’s identity.

The lecture derives the inviscid Burgers’ equation solution from a delta-function source as a fan followed by a shock, with shock position \(x=\sqrt{2t}\), and checks the shock speed and entropy condition. It then explains how viscous Burgers’ equation can be linearized into the heat equation via a change of variables, leading to an exact formula whose zero-viscosity limit recovers the inviscid solution. The lecture also briefly discusses Korteweg-de Vries, solitons, integrable nonlinear PDEs, and mentions Navier-Stokes nonexistence as an open problem.

The passage describes an Internet-based overlay network for transporting IPsec traffic and selecting an optimal ingress edge region. A customer router first resolves a service hostname via DNS, establishes an IKEv2 tunnel to the returned edge, and that edge performs a secondary DNS lookup to verify whether it is the best ingress region. If not, the edge sends an IKEv2 redirect to a better edge. If needed later, the edge can drop liveness probe responses to force the router to reconnect and obtain a new edge selection.

WORD and BYTE writes to PMC registers can corrupt future register writes because shadow register updates ignore byte lane information, causing 32-bit granularity updates and possible local or cross corruption. ACPI-defined registers may be accessed with WORD and BYTE operations, but these can still cause corruption; proprietary non-ACPI registers are restricted to DWORD access only.

A California Senate committee voted to hold Enron and Mirant in contempt for refusing to turn over subpoenaed documents in a price-manipulation probe, while state regulators exempted oil refineries and related facilities from rolling blackouts to protect gasoline supply. The passage also reports Bush’s energy plan facing slow congressional action, criticism of a UCLA energy report, and falling natural-gas prices for Southern California consumers.

AfriForum said forensic scientist Dr David Klatzow began investigating the possible cause of the Knysna and surrounding area fires, starting with gathering relevant information and meeting role-players. He also flew over the disaster area to assess the extent of the fires and whether wind could have spread them, and the public was invited to send information to AfriForum.

Mercedes chief Toto Wolff said stress, tension and disruption between drivers may be needed to maintain the team’s dominance. He noted Hamilton and Bottas had an issue-free season, unlike the bitter Hamilton-Rosberg rivalry, but believes competition can improve performance and wants Bottas to challenge Hamilton next season.

A 36-year-old man, Reinaldo De Jesus Henao of New York, was arrested at Coachella in Indio, California, on suspicion of stealing over 100 mobile phones. Police said festival-goers traced missing phones using Find My Phone, and officers allegedly found him with a backpack containing the phones. He has been charged with grand theft and receiving stolen property and was released on $10,000 bail.

Astronomers observed rogue planet Cha 1170-7626, about 600 light-years away, accreting gas and dust at 6 billion metric tons per second, the fastest growth ever recorded for a planet. The planet’s late June to August outburst, seen with the VLT and James Webb, was hotter and brighter than earlier observations and may indicate a starlike birth.

Amarin Corp Ads shares rose 1.33% in the session. Analysts project a 52-week target of $7.6 based on 5 opinions, with targets ranging from $5 to $10 versus a latest close of $3.8. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 1, with 2 Buy and 3 Outperform ratings, ATR-14 of 0.2, weekly volatility of 5.04%, monthly volatility of 4.33%, RSI of 43.29, market cap of $1.03 billion, 270.89 million outstanding shares, and 6.36 million shares traded versus a 1.89 million average.

The passage argues that Baker Mayfield is the best quarterback in the draft based on analytics and performance. Pro Football Focus and other metrics rate him highly for accuracy, performance under pressure, and deep passing, though concerns remain about his height, sacks, offense system, and off-field reputation.

Thruxton’s 50th anniversary meeting features historic races, demonstration sessions, and the opening of the new Thruxton Centre, with appearances by Nigel Mansell and Murray Walker. The event includes classic Formula 2, sportscars, Historic Formula Ford 1600s, and Historic Touring Cars, with several notable drivers and cars entered.

Texas Instruments provides technical resources “as is” for skilled developers, disclaims all warranties, and says users are responsible for selecting products, validating applications, and meeting requirements. The resources may change without notice, are limited to TI product development use, and TI rejects additional terms.

The paper proposes NeuroAdapter, an end-to-end brain decoding framework that conditions a latent diffusion model directly on parcel-wise fMRI embeddings, avoiding intermediate feature spaces. It reports competitive reconstruction results on NSD, NSD-Imagery, and Deeprecon, and introduces IBBI, a cross-attention-based interpretability framework that reveals parcel contributions and ROI attention maps during image generation.

Chelsea manager Antonio Conte has told his players to focus on their Premier League match at Huddersfield Town rather than their upcoming Champions League tie with Barcelona, after Chelsea’s 1-0 loss at West Ham. He said Chelsea must go game by game, cannot defend their title, and must fight for a Champions League place. Chelsea are third and Huddersfield are 12th.

Theresa May is reported to be seeking Cabinet support for a “softest possible Brexit” at Friday’s Chequers summit, including continued UK acceptance of some EU laws, easier immigration for EU citizens, and a customs deal where the UK collects EU tariffs. The passage also describes Conservative Party conflict over Brexit, with warnings against leadership challenges and resignations.

The speaker says they are focused on the Stanley Cup Finals and tomorrow night’s game, moving on from a recent incident and taking things one game at a time. They respect the league’s decision, have not yet received more information, and must be careful around the net to avoid bumping the goalie and putting their team short-handed. They also discuss the strengths of several players, including puck movement, rush play, net presence, and poise, and mention balancing rink work with family and managing a baseball fantasy team.

In a Colorado personal injury case, the Supreme Court held that the petitioners had waived therapist-patient privilege by claiming mental suffering and psychiatric expenses, but the trial court still had to balance their confidentiality interests against YMCA’s discovery needs. The court made the rule absolute and remanded for reconsideration under the correct protective-order standard.

AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) announced it will shut down on December 15, 2017, ending a service active since 1997. Once the leading U.S. instant messaging app, AIM declined as texting and social media grew in popularity.

Total solar eclipses on Earth are possible because the moon is about 400 times smaller than the sun but about 400 times closer, making them appear the same size. The moon is slowly moving away from Earth, so total eclipses have only a limited future and will end in about 600 million years.

The passage describes systems and methods for managing virtual desktop instance resources in a provider network. A service provider can detect connections, disconnections, and inactivity, apply shutdown policies or predictive models, shut down and later restart computing resources, and detach or reattach storage volumes to preserve user data and session continuity.

The Sansa c200 uses a rechargeable lithium-ion battery, supports music, photo, radio, and voice recording, and connects to a computer for file transfer in MTP or MSC mode. It includes navigation, playback, slideshow, equalizer, preset, and settings options, plus support, warranty, license, and disposal information.

The passage focuses on a Stanley Cup Finals game, noting that the team was outskated, did not compete well, and took undisciplined penalties, but remains focused on winning at home. It also says several players are dealing with injuries, including Erik, whose healing was deemed complete, and Doug, who will miss the game, with others expected to step up.

The passage discusses AI in higher education, outlining its definition, implementation strategies, responsible use principles, benefits, challenges, and future prospects. It emphasizes personalized learning, efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and the need for ethics, privacy, fairness, and human oversight.

Apple Inc. filed its 2022 Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 24, 2022, reported 15,908,118,000 shares outstanding, and described its business, risks, legal proceedings, and Nasdaq-listed common stock under AAPL.

Zendaya used her 2017 Teen Choice Awards acceptance speech to urge young people to stay educated, pay attention, use their voices against injustice, and help make the world better after speaking out against the Charlottesville protests.

InfoWorld provides PR guidelines for Technology of the Year winners, including approved quote, branding, logo usage, award descriptions, and corporate boilerplate. It says winners may order physical awards or reprints through the YGS Group and must follow strict rules for using the InfoWorld Technology of the Year logo and references.

The passage explains that the Put-Call ratio is a sentiment indicator based on put and call volume or open interest, where high readings generally signal fear and low readings complacency. It describes calls, puts, and how the ratio is calculated, notes that there are different types of ratios with no universal good or bad value, and says the authors’ backtests found its trading performance unimpressive and inferior to indicators like VIX.

The passage highlights United Nations efforts to address water access in South Sudan, Vietnam, Singapore, Kyrgyzstan, and elsewhere, and notes a UN working-level dialogue on water-related sustainable development goals. It ends with a warning that future conflict could be about water and a call to treat water appropriately.

The 2018 Chevrolet Equinox offers a 1.6L turbo-diesel engine with highway fuel efficiency of 6.0 L/100km and 240 lb-ft of torque, along with stop/start technology and B20 compatibility. Chevrolet says the engine was developed within General Motors and the Equinox adds cargo space, connectivity, safety features, and turbocharged engine options, with the turbo-diesel starting at $35,645.

The LakeSmart Team is providing the Dock Talk program this summer to share information on healthy lake ecosystems, and will also appear at the Matiowki Farmer’s Market and other events. The three-member team includes Krista Robertson, Reed Cupeiro, and Myles King, and the program covers shoreline care, septic systems, invasive species, safe boating, and the Clean, Drain and Dry program.

The passage describes AI-based image encoding and decoding apparatuses and methods that down-scale an original image with a first DNN, encode the lower-resolution image, transmit image data plus AI data, decode the image, and optionally up-scale it with a second DNN. The AI data is used to determine whether to perform AI up-scaling and to select DNN settings based on factors such as resolution, bitrate, codec type, or stored identifiers. If AI data is absent or the up-scaling DNN is unavailable, the decoded second image is output instead, and legacy up-scaling may be used.

The lecture explains how the large N expansion of gauge theory matches the topology expansion of string scattering, motivating a correspondence between large N gauge theory and string theory. It discusses why this is difficult for QCD, then argues that scale-invariant large N theories lead naturally to string theory in AdS space. The lecture also introduces the Nambu-Goto and Polyakov actions and rewrites string dynamics as two-dimensional gravity coupled to scalar fields.

The passage describes a near-eye display system that uses eye tracking to determine a maximum luminance location based on the user’s field of view and drives display light sources at different luminance levels depending on their distance from that location. Light sources nearer the maximum luminance location are driven brighter than those farther away, with separate display zones, eye tracking, and controller circuitry used to reduce power consumption while maintaining user experience.

Harvey Weinstein was indicted in Manhattan on rape and criminal sex act charges in the first criminal case tied to sexual misconduct allegations against him. His lawyers said he would not testify before the grand jury, while District Attorney Cyrus R. Vance Jr. said the case would proceed and rejected claims of political pressure. Weinstein, who denies the allegations, was already free on $1 million bail and faced accusations from multiple women.

Touch Football Australia and the NRL have launched the NRL Touch Premiership, a seven-round televised curtain raiser to NRL matches starting May 18, giving elite male and female touch players a pathway and greater publicity. Ali Brigginshaw said the partnership could boost touch football and allow players to move between touch and rugby league, though her Jillaroos contract likely prevents her from playing.

The passage gives instructions for replacing a computer’s HDD with a SanDisk SSD in notebook and desktop computers. It says to power off the computer, disconnect the power, remove the battery for notebooks, and then install the SSD, with desktops often requiring a 3.5-inch mounting adapter first. After installation, close the case or drive bay, reconnect power, and boot the computer, where an upgrade-complete screen may appear.

Leapfrog reported significant hospital safety improvements in its latest grades, including five first-time “A” hospitals that previously had “F” grades, 46 hospitals earning an “A” for the first time, and 49 hospitals maintaining an “A” in every update since 2012. Of about 2,500 hospitals graded, 30% earned an “A,” and Hawaii, Idaho, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Virginia had the highest percentages of “A” hospitals.

The PGA848 input voltage range extends to within 3V of either supply, with common-mode range depending on input, gain, and reference voltage. A typical application drives an ADS8860 SAR ADC using ±15V input supplies and a 5.3V output supply, with a 2.5V REF pin set by a divider and OPA192 buffer. Layout guidelines emphasize symmetry, bypassing, trace separation, minimizing leakage and parasitics, and avoiding high supply voltages above 40V.

The Boathouse at City Point will open on Hopewell’s riverfront on June 17, with 6,000 square feet of interior space, a patio, event space, and a reservable chef’s table. It is the fourth Boathouse restaurant in Central Virginia and is considered a key part of Hopewell riverfront revitalization.

Madison Realty Capital provided a $137 million construction loan to JDS Development Group for Monad Terrace in South Beach, Miami, fully capitalizing the project. Monad Terrace includes 59 waterfront residences, is designed by Jean Nouvel with Kobi Karp Architecture, and has reported strong sales ahead of an expected Fall 2019 completion.

The passage discusses GNU C Library 2.28 building and running cleanly on GNU/Hurd, GNU Guix being made to run on Android with difficulty, and the release of Node.js 10 with npm@6 featuring new security improvements.

TI says documentation updates can be tracked via Notifications on the product folder on ti.com, with change details in revision histories. It also directs users to TI E2E support forums, warns about ESD damage, and provides mechanical, packaging, and orderable information subject to change without notice.

Using lidar technology, archaeologists discovered over 60,000 previously unknown Mayan structures in the Guatemalan jungle, including houses, fortifications, and causeways. The find suggests the Mayan civilization was far larger and more complex than previously thought, with possible populations of 10 to 15 million and advanced land and water management systems.

TeraWulf is shifting from bitcoin mining to AI-focused digital infrastructure, backed by major Fluidstack and Google deals. The company expects $760 million in annual revenue, plans to reach 1,150 MW by 2030, and could grow revenue to $1.5 billion annually.

Steven Kean asked how important the Ex-Im Bank fight was to Enron and forwarded articles noting that Enron was among major U.S. exporters lobbying against proposed Ex-Im Bank budget cuts. The passage also says Enron was included among companies with financing from the bank and mentions Enron in unrelated reports on Dutch gas trading, Houston office development, and California power issues.

In 45 mild AD patients aged 50–74, APOE4 carriers with BCHE-K had a mean AD diagnosis age 6.4 years earlier than APOE4 carriers without BCHE-K, with slightly higher amyloid and tau and a more limbic-amnestic phenotype; no similar BCHE-K effect was seen in APOE4 noncarriers.

Britain’s exam regulator Ofqual said OCR should be fined a record £175,000 after a May 2017 Romeo and Juliet exam question wrongly referred to Tybalt’s hatred of the Capulets instead of the Montagues, affecting more than 14,000 students. Ofqual said the paper was “not fit for purpose,” and some 2,735 students were graded using answers from other sections.

The lecture focuses on FIR filter structures, showing direct, transposed, and cascade forms, and a special linear-phase FIR structure that uses symmetry to cut multiplications roughly in half. It also presents the frequency-sampling structure, which uses DFT coefficients as frequency samples and can be useful for filters with many zero samples and for filter banks. The lecture ends with a comparison of structures and a brief discussion of finite register-length effects, especially coefficient quantization and its impact on pole placement and sensitivity.

A bronze sculpture called “The Last Three” has been unveiled in New York City as a memorial to Africa’s last three Northern White Rhinos, prompting criticism from art critic Jerry Saltz and support from others. The 5m-high work depicts the three zoo survivors moved to Kenya in 2009 after the species became extinct in the wild.

The passage contains Smith County legal notices, including vehicle possession notices, probate land sales, notices to creditors, a juvenile court publication order, dependency and neglect notice, and trustee’s sales for specific properties and estates.

Ultralight backpacking is presented as a philosophy of carrying less to stay comfortable, safe, and happy, with a base weight of 10 pounds or less. The passage says the biggest weight savings come from bringing less, especially by removing unnecessary gear, and that experimenting with lighter shelter, sleep systems, and habits can make backpacking easier and more enjoyable.

US vital statistics showed only a modest rise in cancer mortality during the COVID-19 pandemic, with 12,000 excess cancer deaths in 2020 and a 2% increase overall when multiple-cause deaths were used. Excess mortality was greatest for hematological cancers, while pancreatic and lung cancer showed no excess; diabetes and Alzheimer’s showed much larger increases. The findings suggest cancer’s apparent COVID-19 mortality risk is largely explained by demographics, competing mortality risk, and coding changes.
The 2022 U.S. RSV surge was caused by multiple pre-existing RSV-A and RSV-B lineages, including several shared between Massachusetts and Washington, not by a single highly transmissible variant.

The passage argues that the Russian seizure of the Cape Horn Pigeon on the high seas was unlawful, since it was engaged in legitimate whaling and there was no proper basis for confiscation. It says Russia later admitted the arrest resulted from a misunderstanding, returned the vessel, and offered indemnity, while the owners claimed damages, including $45,000 for loss of the vessel’s service.

Ben Affleck, who publicly said he had completed treatment for alcohol addiction in March, was seen seven months later looking upbeat and refreshed at what was believed to be an outpatient treatment centre in Los Angeles.

The passage explains that environmental education is essential for raising awareness, knowledge, skills, attitudes, and participation to prevent and solve environmental problems. It outlines its objectives, guiding principles, and environmental knowledge, and argues that sustainable development depends on behavioral change, resource conservation, waste reduction, clean technology, and community involvement to achieve long-term environmental sustainability.

The passage argues that music education should be taught interdisciplinarily with fields such as mathematics, language, science, psychology, and art. It presents a qualitative case study of one participant from a music department and concludes that interdisciplinary music education supports cognitive, social, emotional, academic, and creative development, and should be strengthened through curriculum changes, practical courses, workshops, and teacher training.

The passage says Russia has courted Western far-right activists as part of a disinformation strategy aimed at portraying the West as chaotic and Russia as an alternative power. It summarizes Anton Shekhovtsov’s book on how this evolved from Cold War tactics to Putin-era “nudge propaganda,” “narrative laundering,” and selective sourcing, while noting the Kremlin has had mixed results and may be supporting more violent far-right groups.

Foreigners were repeatedly ordered to leave a bivouac and were eventually escorted out. The passage then includes diplomatic correspondence denying a reported Korean demand regarding a naval instructor, followed by U.S. statements on the Korea-Japan-China situation, warning of possible war and describing U.S. efforts to promote peace while maintaining neutrality.

The study examined 124 Faculty of Industrial Education students’ readiness, expertise, and needs for creating educational multimedia. Results showed high overall expertise and the highest overall need for learning materials, with greater need in areas of lower experience such as copyright and the metaverse, and lower need in areas of higher experience such as presentations and infographics.

An email titled “IEP News 5/23” was sent to a large group and listed news stories about California’s energy crisis, including articles on Davis’s push for backup diesel generators, allegations of electricity price manipulation, Bush and Davis meeting, Reliant’s price-cut offer if rules are waived, blackout warning plans, and a poll showing Californians blaming many parties for the crisis.

Nabors Industries’ sale of Quail Tools is described as beneficial because it sold for more than the purchase price and will help reduce debt by 25%. The passage also says Nabors’ key markets, the U.S. and Saudi Arabia, appear to be at cyclical troughs, and its stock is up 70% from recent lows but still below historical valuations.

The procedures initialize and later remove a pre-memory stack region for all processor cores using a stackless, register-passing interface. They set up processor and cache state before main memory is available, preserve EBX in one routine, and return status codes such as AGESA_SUCCESS, AGESA_WARNING, and AGESA_FATAL; the second routine disables CAR mode without changing MTRRs after stack relocation to memory.

Florida International University reopened Monday, four days after a pedestrian bridge collapse killed six people. The university planned a moment of silence, is mourning the victims, and is cooperating with investigators while helping victims’ families.

A Scottish teacher, Caroline Hope, died after contracting E.coli in Turkey during surgery for advanced colon cancer. Her family raised more than £31,000 for a medical evacuation, and she died at Queen Elizabeth University Hospital in Glasgow after returning to Scotland.

The passage lists RIAA diamond-certified songs in chronological order, explaining that diamond means at least 10x platinum or 10 million equivalent units. It highlights recent and record-setting certifications, including Drake’s record 10 diamond singles, while naming many songs and certification dates from 1997 to 2025.

Shaun Dion Hamilton says Christian Kirk stood out as a younger player at The Opening in 2013 and is now Texas A&M’s top offensive threat against Alabama. Kirk has hurt Alabama in each of the last two seasons with a punt return touchdown and a touchdown catch, and Alabama players say they must know where he is and tackle him to limit his explosive plays.

North Carolina’s DHHS uses 140 parts per trillion as the health goal for GenX in water, meaning no anticipated non-cancer health effects. A toxicologist said these effects may include endocrine disruption, thyroid disease, and reproductive effects, while cancer links remain uncertain due to limited studies.

Trump administration cuts and policy changes have reduced support for multilingual learners in K-12 schools, including professional development, newcomer centers, teacher hiring, and translation services. Advocates and educators warn the cuts and deportation fears are leaving students and families less able to access services, with significant budget losses proposed for 2026.

Hong Kong and Singapore have seen a surge in initial coin offerings as companies seek a more favorable fundraising environment after China and South Korea banned ICOs. The passage says both cities remain loosely regulated and have attracted many Chinese and South Korean issuers, including Bithumb and Zikto.

A Russian spacewalk outside the International Space Station lasted 8 hours and 13 minutes, setting a new Russian record, but ended with a communications antenna in the wrong position. NASA said the antenna was still working and Russian officials planned to review whether further action was needed.

Apple reported Q1 2020 net sales of $91.8 billion and net income of $22.2 billion, both up from a year earlier, driven mainly by higher iPhone, Wearables, Home and Accessories, and Services sales. The company adopted new lease and hedging accounting standards, repurchased $20.0 billion of stock, and ended the quarter with $340.6 billion in assets and $89.5 billion in shareholders’ equity.

The passage gives instructions for cloning data from an existing HDD to a SanDisk SSD, then replacing the HDD with the SSD in either a notebook or desktop computer. It notes that some SATA devices may draw more power than a computer can supply, and if the SSD is not recognized, other USB devices should be disconnected.

Josh Allen praised James Cook as an “all-time teammate,” saying his new contract may have helped him play more freely. Cook has 401 rushing yards and five touchdowns through the first month and has topped 100 rushing yards in his last three games.

New research from Yale’s Budget Lab and the Brookings Institution found no evidence of discernible AI-related disruption to U.S. jobs since ChatGPT’s launch, with labor-market shifts largely predating widespread AI adoption. The passage also says Meta will use AI chatbot conversations to personalize ads, OpenAI has launched Sora 2, and S&P 500 companies’ AI-related risk disclosures have risen sharply.

The passage describes SOS strategies for disrupting low-post offense, including post fronting, Base Go, Go Top, Go Wing, Hold, and Yo-Yo. It explains when each trap or denial option is used and details player rotations, closeouts, and pass-denial responsibilities for right and left side post situations.

The passage describes a gold overnight trading strategy that buys gold futures, GLD, or GDX at the market close and sells at the next open to capture overnight price moves. It reports mixed results, notes high risk and volatility, and says such commodity strategies are difficult to trade and may break down over time.

The passage presents FRUS ebook edition notes and two 1893 Senate documents from President Benjamin Harrison transmitting State Department reports and correspondence concerning the United States and Hawaii, including an uncompleted 1854 treaty draft and relations from 1820 to 1893.

The passage contains multiple reports on Enron’s financial transactions, regulatory scrutiny, and asset sales. A Wall Street Journal article says Enron made a $35 million purchase from an entity run by company officer Michael Kopper, raising questions about off-balance-sheet debt. Other pieces describe investor and regulator concerns, calls for corporate governance reform, possible asset sales, and Enron’s efforts to sell its India and Korea holdings.

The passage describes U.S. policy toward Hawaii, including warnings against treaty violations, support for Hawaiian treaty obligations, and a belief that the Hawaiian Islands should remain benevolently neutral. It also covers U.S. responses to British and French activity in Polynesia, renewal of the reciprocity treaty in 1884 with a Pearl River Harbor cession, continued debate over that treaty, and later cable proposals linking Hawaii with North America and Australia.

The American Stroke Association’s FAST acronym helps identify stroke symptoms: face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty, and time to call 911 immediately. A similar mnemonic, S.T.R., stands for smile, talk, and raise both arms.

The passage compares children’s phone ownership across countries and ages, noting that German children often do not own phones as early as U.S. children. It cites studies showing younger ownership in the United States, higher ownership in South Korea, and varying patterns in Europe, Turkey, Africa, and Australia. The American Academy of Pediatrics says there is no “right” age for a first phone and gives screen-use recommendations for young children.

The passage says the best-performing stock markets since 1900 are Australia, the United States, South Africa, New Zealand, and Denmark. Australia ranked first, with returns over 120 years exceeding 6.5% annually in U.S. dollars, while the U.S. had about 6.5% real annualized returns since 1900. It also states that stocks have outperformed bonds and Treasury bills over the long term, and that investing in stocks offers return potential, inflation protection, dividends, ownership, liquidity, diversification, and low entry costs.

The passage criticizes cryogenic preservation as unrealistic and exploitative, arguing that no scientist believes frozen bodies or brains can be revived. It notes growing interest in cryopreservation, including a terminally ill British teenager and several celebrities, but calls the practice a deceitful “confidence trick” that robs death of dignity.

Beignet the nutria, a mascot at the South Louisiana Wetlands Discovery Center, was brought out on World Wetlands Day to see if he would see his shadow. He did not, which Jonathan Foret said meant a mild hurricane season.

Four months after Zipcar launched, Robin Chase discovered the company’s revenue was far below expectations and that its business model was not working. With fundraising and launch commitments pending, she and her team had to consider changes, including a possible 20% price increase, despite concerns about customer backlash.

The passage argues for support of France’s claim to Alsace-Lorraine without binding the United States beyond France’s willingness to fight, recognizes Italy’s right to boundary rectifications and free Trieste, calls for a Balkan settlement based on evacuation by Central Powers and economic-national balance, and supports an independent democratic Poland with access to the sea and self-determination.
Montreal was ranked the world’s best student city, overtaking Paris, which fell to second place. London rose to third, with Seoul fourth; Canada had three cities in the top 11.

South Korean prosecutors raided Korean Air Lines’ headquarters amid an investigation into suspected tax evasion, embezzlement and breach of trust involving Chairman Cho Yang-ho and family members. The probe follows increased scrutiny of the family and Cho’s recent step down from a co-chief executive role at Jin Air.

The TPS7H500x-SP controllers use a transconductance error amplifier, resistor-divider output voltage programming, soft-start, selectable switching frequency modes, primary and synchronous outputs, programmable dead time and leading-edge blank time, pulse skipping, duty-cycle limits, current sensing with hiccup protection, external fault shutdown, slope compensation, thermal shutdown, and fixed-frequency peak current mode control. The passage also gives design guidance, example component selections, input power and layout recommendations, revision notes, and packaging information.

Penny Mordaunt became the first minister to use sign language in Parliament, signing and speaking during Commons questions to promote the Global Disability Summit and disability inclusion. MPs applauded, and Speaker John Bercow also replied using sign language.

The speaker says the team has played well despite bad bounces, believes the score has not reflected their play, and says they will not give up. David Clarkson says they need more traffic and to capitalize on chances, but the group has heart, believes it can battle back, and will continue to push shift by shift and game by game.

The speaker says the team must be more aggressive, improve penalty killing, forecheck and entries, and focus on details like blocked shots, giveaways, and takeaways. He says players should stay within their own games, avoid trying to do too much in the Stanley Cup Finals, and notes positive team stories and faceoff tactics.

Consilium Software announced UniRSM™ as a SolutionsPlus replacement for Cisco Remote Silent Monitoring, available worldwide through Cisco Commerce. It is designed for Cisco Contact Center Enterprise environments to enable remote silent monitoring and coaching, with features including whisper coaching, multi-call monitoring, HA failover, web-based reporting, and Windows/Linux support.

The passage says most retail CFD traders lose money, with informal survey results ranging from 62% to 82% losing traders. It attributes this to leverage, transaction costs, illiquidity, hidden fees, lack of trading plans, and limited knowledge, and says CFD trading is generally not profitable for most traders.

Lincolnshire County Council leader Martin Hill called on health bosses to publish more detailed future service plans after a CQC report rated ULHT as requiring improvement overall, with Boston inadequate, Lincoln requiring improvement, and Grantham and Louth good. He said recruitment remains the main problem, praised progress, and raised concerns about children’s services at Boston, issues at Lincoln, and the future of Grantham A&E, which is closed at night due to staffing shortages.

The passage describes an information management system for backing up, restoring, archiving, replicating, and managing primary and secondary data. It explains that some cloud and network environments do not natively support changed-block tracking, and that the disclosed approach enables incremental and differential backups by comparing virtual machine disk images, generating a changed-block map, and extracting changed blocks for backup.

Investor sentiment turned cautious as U.S. stock valuations hit record highs, driven by AI and tech gains, with the IMF and JPMorgan warning of correction risks. Other headlines included Bank of England AI bubble warnings, Google’s Gemini Enterprise launch, and gold rising above $4,000.

The passage says Trump’s recognition of Jerusalem as Israel’s capital was condemned internationally, and that the US has long supported Israeli Zionist interests. It argues the Arab League is weak, the peace process is a sham, Palestinians in Jerusalem lack full rights, and the two-state solution is dead or nearly dead.

Tarik Skubal tied a Tigers postseason record with 14 strikeouts in 7 2/3 innings, and Detroit beat Cleveland 2-1 in Game 1 of the AL Wild Card Series. The Tigers took a 1-0 series lead on a go-ahead run in the seventh and a tense ninth-inning finish.

An investigating officer told the Western Cape High Court there was no suicide note or other sign that Susan Rohde took her own life at Spier in July 2016, and that an autopsy later found she died from manual strangulation. The trial was postponed so the defence could prepare to cross-examine evidence about a bathroom door hook test.

The Ravens fell to 1-3 after a 37-20 loss to the Chiefs, with criticism focused on their defense and Lamar Jackson’s turnovers and hamstring injury. The passage says Baltimore’s season is in serious danger and that the team must win its next two games before the bye week to keep its hopes alive.

A goalie said an MRI showed a likely third-degree MCL injury, which will heal but not immediately, after a collision near the net that also pinched his elbow. He said Mark Andre was not to blame, that his team has rallied through adversity, and that he will still help in whatever way he can while supporting the two goalies who will replace him.

The study sequenced 12 SARS-CoV-2 samples from Esteio, Rio Grande do Sul, collected in April–June 2021; 10 were P.1 and 2 were P.1.17. Across the genomes, 68 nucleotide substitutions were found, including common mutations such as NSP12:P323L and S:D614G. Statewide GISAID data showed Gamma predominated in 2021, Delta in the second half of 2021, and Omicron from December 2021. Selection analyses found no positive selection in E, positive and negative selection in M, and multiple positively and negatively selected sites in N.

Amazon.com, Inc. entered into an amended and restated credit agreement on June 23, 2020 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and other lenders, extending the revolving credit facility to June 23, 2023 and using borrowings for general corporate purposes, including backstopping commercial paper notes.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 23, 2019 reporting that it released its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2019 by posting its Third Quarter 2019 Update on its website. The update was attached as Exhibit 99.1 and the report was signed by Chief Financial Officer Zachary J. Kirkhorn.

This protocol describes a three-arm randomized controlled trial in Singapore testing an eight-week digital mindfulness psychoeducation program, Digital-MindCAN, for adult cancer survivors after curative treatment. It compares Digital-MindCAN with Palouse Mindfulness and wait-list control, measuring objective and subjective stress as primary outcomes and well-being, relaxation, mindfulness, resilience, depression, and anxiety as secondary outcomes using questionnaires, physiological measures, and focus groups.

The study examined preschool teachers’ views on sensory education and classroom practices using interviews with 20 teachers. Teachers said sensory education is important, supports all developmental areas, is included but not clearly stated in the preschool program, and is often carried out through various daily activities and family involvement. Major difficulties were insufficient materials, unsuitable physical conditions, and a need for more training on sensory education.

Stanford researchers used blue light and genetically engineered E. coli to shape biofilms into detailed patterns at 25-micrometer resolution, a method they call biofilm lithography. They say it could help study biofilm growth, bacterial interactions, antibiotic resistance, and enable biomaterials, microfluidic devices, and biofilm-based circuits.

The speaker says the team improved its defensive quickness, composure, puck movement, and patience, which helped them play better offensively and defensively. They also note the hot Dallas weather and travel adjustments, mention a planned matchup strategy for the series, and say the team felt embarrassed after a bad performance but responded by taking personal responsibility and playing with more urgency and emotion.

The passage discusses a hockey team’s belief in its ability to win from behind, while acknowledging it did not play well enough in the first two periods and needs to skate better, avoid penalties, and move the puck more effectively. It also describes confidence gained from past comebacks, praise for goaltending, preparation for the series, the team’s depth, locker-room chemistry, and the challenge posed by a physical, talented opponent.

Wisconsin’s frack sand industry has rebounded from a 2015 slump as domestic crude production rose, and demand is expected to grow this year. New Texas mines will add competition, but experts say Wisconsin’s northern white sand should not be negatively affected, and prices may rise 10 to 12 percent.

The passage argues that Agilent Technologies should be avoided because its stock appears overvalued despite some shareholder-friendly financial traits, such as dividend growth and manageable debt. It says revenue and net income growth have been uninspiring, dividend growth has slowed, and a conservative forecast suggests only about a 6.7% annual return over four years. It also notes business demand can be variable and cites a bearish technical outlook, including a possible drop toward $53 if support at $58.50 breaks.

CMD42 requires a block length at least as large as its data structure; otherwise its result is undefined and the card may enter an unexpected locked state. Reserved parameter bits are don’t care, password length must be 1 to 128 bits, and errors set LOCK_UNLOCK_FAILED; CARD_IS_LOCKED reflects the current card state and may indicate a change between locked and unlocked after CMD42.

The passage describes players reflecting on a close playoff game, saying it gave them confidence and that they must keep playing a straightforward, focused style as a five-man unit. They emphasize the importance of effort from the forwards, strong teamwork, short shifts, and staying calm against a fast, capable opponent, while noting nerves early in the game and the need to avoid distractions.

Sushma Swaraj sought a report from the Indian High Commission in Islamabad after Sikh leader Charnjit Singh was shot dead in Peshawar. Sukhbir Singh Badal expressed shock and asked her to raise the issue with Pakistan, and police suspected the killing was a targeted attack.

Washington Prime Group Inc Cmn shares fell 0.27% in the latest session. Analysts have a 12-month consensus target of $6.77, with targets ranging from $6 to $7.50, and the latest close was $7.51. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 4, with most analysts rating it Hold. Its ATR-14 is 0.25, weekly volatility is 2.76%, monthly volatility is 3.38%, RSI is 65.19, market capitalization is $1.41 billion, and 3.62 million shares traded versus a 3.47 million average.

The passage examines relocated higher education projects created by Russian emigrants after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, describing them as emergency education initiatives that support fleeing scholars and students, preserve academic heritage, and promote future-oriented hope through exile.

A Markov model using RATIONS trial data found that a 6-month nutritional supplementation program for HIV-negative household contacts of persons with TB in India would reduce TB incidence, deaths, and DALYs, and would be cost-effective versus usual care at $229 per DALY averted from the healthcare perspective and $184 from the societal perspective. Sensitivity analyses showed the results were most affected by supplement cost and TB incidence risk reduction.

The speaker says the puck drop issue seemed inconclusive and could be called either a goal or no goal, but they trust Toronto and the refs. They also say the goalie has been the best player in the playoffs and has their full belief, and they describe Milwaukee as a valuable place that helped them mature on and off the ice.

The speakers discuss being happy to still be alive in the playoffs and wanting more success in the finals. They say they need to create more offense, build off the last win, and keep playing hard against an opponent close to its goal. Martin Brodeur also mentions enjoying time with family, including his son’s birthday, and says the travel and long days make time away from hockey important.

The lecture introduces dynamic optimality for binary search trees, defines properties such as sequential access, dynamic finger, entropy, working set, and unified bounds, and notes which are known for splay trees. It then presents a geometric view using arborally satisfied point sets and explains an offline greedy construction and an online version using split trees.

A newborn girl from a Followers of Christ Church family died in Oregon City from complications of prematurity, and the medical examiner said she could have survived with immediate medical care; her twin sister survived after receiving medical attention. Deputies are investigating because no one called 911, and no charges have been filed.

At finite temperature, a CFT on flat space has the same physics at all temperatures, but on a sphere the dimensionless product \(rT\) matters. In AdS, the spherical case allows both thermal AdS and black hole solutions, with small and big black holes for \(T>T_{\min}\). The small black hole is unstable, while a Hawking-Page phase transition occurs at \(T_c\) between thermal AdS and the big black hole, with the big black hole dominating at high temperature.

Faviola Dadis said Steven Seagal sexually assaulted her during a 2002 casting session at a Beverly Hills hotel room when she was 17. She described unwanted touching, said she later suffered emotional harm, and reported the case to police; Los Angeles prosecutors are reviewing it. Dadis spoke with attorney Lisa Bloom alongside Regina Simons, who also accused Seagal of assault, while Seagal has denied the allegations.

Bemidji’s Blue Ox won the Region 10C title, beating Crookston after entering the tournament as the top seed and securing a state tournament berth. Ben Thoma earned the pitching win, Cody Benson led at the plate, and Bemidji will receive a first-round bye in the state tournament, while Crookston enters as runner-up.

Cape Breton residents in Coxheath reported nightly visits from large giant house spiders, identified as Eratigena atrica. A biologist said the spiders are harmless, often enter homes for insects or by accident, and may leave or die when food runs out.

Meizu has cut China prices for the Pro 7 and Pro 7 Plus again, with the series now starting at 1,999 Yuan from December 12. The Pro 7 and Pro 7 Plus feature secondary displays, Helio X30 variants, dual 12-megapixel rear cameras, a 16-megapixel front camera, Flyme OS 6 based on Android Nougat, and batteries of 3,000mAh and 3,500mAh respectively.

Apple’s former Siri natural language understanding head, Rushin Shah, has left after five years to join Facebook in Menlo Park, where he will work on natural language and dialogue understanding. His departure comes as Siri faces stronger competition from rival assistants, and Apple has recently expanded Siri features, including its new smart speaker.

The episode discusses balancing cost and simplicity in investing, John Robertson’s book and tools for index investing, and whether Vanguard’s new one-fund ETFs are worth switching to. It says the ETFs can reduce fees, but suitability depends on portfolio size, automatic contributions, ETF trading experience, account complexity, and target asset mix.

HPE introduced the Edgeline Services Platform and two apps to help customers manage IoT devices and combine IT and OT data. The platform runs IoT applications at the equipment location rather than in traditional data centers or the cloud, and the apps support data aggregation and network address translation.

ESA has inaugurated a 35-meter deep space antenna at New Norcia in Western Australia, its fourth Estrack antenna and second at the site. The antenna uses cryogenically cooled technology and a 20kW transmitter to support missions including Juice, Solar Orbiter, BepiColombo, Mars Express, Hera, and future missions, and it will enter service in 2026.

Researchers showed that polymyxin B kills active Gram-negative bacteria by triggering outer armor overproduction and shedding, which lets the antibiotic enter the cell. Dormant bacteria were not killed unless sugar woke them up first, suggesting polymyxins may be less effective against sleeping cells and could be paired with treatments that activate them.

The passage describes SD memory card initialization, identification, and data transfer rules. It covers ACMD41, CMD8, CMD2, CMD3, CMD7, CMD6, CMD11, CMD19, CMD12, CMD16, CMD24/25, CMD32/33/38, CMD42, and CMD55, including card capacity types, UHS-I voltage switching, tuning, erase/discard/FULE operations, write protection, lock/unlock and COP/FEP behavior, and function switching through CMD6.

The speaker says the team played well but lost a goaltending duel, lacked a killer instinct and enough quality scoring chances, and must improve to win the next three games in the Stanley Cup series against Tampa Bay.

The West Virginia Supreme Court held that firing at-will employees for refusing a polygraph test violated state public policy, based on the state’s recognition of privacy interests. It also held that public policy is a question of law, not a jury question. Two justices dissented, arguing no preexisting public policy barred the discharge and that the decision was retroactive.

Bishop Hassan Kukah urged politicians to improve governance and warned against using religion to cover misgovernance. He praised the military for patience in allowing democracy to continue, called on Nigerians to question leaders more critically, and said democracy needs constant engagement and tolerance of opposing views.

Austin Police Chief Brian Manley urged the bomber or bombers in an 11-day package bombing campaign to contact authorities, saying the attacks killed two people, injured two others, and may be a hate crime. He said the case has drawn worldwide attention, the reward for information has risen to $100,000 plus a $15,000 state reward, and investigators have received extensive federal help while reviewing hundreds of leads and suspicious packages.

The passage is a collection of repeated financial and news headlines, with one detailed section on UK Chancellor Rachel Reeves declining to rule out tax increases ahead of the November budget, citing fiscal discipline and economic uncertainty.
Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on January 29, 2020, announcing a press release with its financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2019.

The passage is an Enron mentions email listing related news headlines and articles, including market updates, Enron’s criticism of Japan’s power market, Williams’ move into European energy markets, and multiple reports on Enron’s troubled Dabhol project in India, where families of executives were moved out, regulators and lenders discussed termination, and a judicial probe was demanded.

The device uses a straight-binary ADC transfer function with single-ended and differential bipolar or unipolar inputs. It includes active-high input and AVDD alarm features, supports SPI and source-synchronous data transfer modes, daisy-chain operation, reset and low-power modes, and nine configurable registers for device control, data output, range selection, and alarm thresholds.

The court affirmed the judgment denying the mother custody of Edward and awarding custody to the father, relying on the child’s established home life and best interests rather than treating the parents as equally situated under the “tender years” rule.

The lecture introduced ordinary differential equation initial value problems, explained converting equations into standard first-order form, and discussed numerical methods such as Forward Euler, trapezoid, midpoint, and Runge-Kutta methods. It emphasized accuracy, error growth, and numerical stability, including an example where Forward Euler gives unstable behavior for a simple decaying equation.

The passage discusses modeling extended enterprise business processes using a three-part framework: static domain models, workflow models, and value models. It explains rule-based business modeling, open-world and closed-world reasoning, modal interpretations of business rules, workflow description and validation, value modeling for profitability, and consistency relations between these models.

Digital storytelling in African higher education is presented as a tool that promotes empowerment, cultural enrichment, creativity, engagement, reflective and higher-order thinking, and communication skills. The reviewed studies, mostly qualitative, show its use in pre-service teacher training, geography education, oral performance, postgraduate research, and social activism, while noting challenges such as limited resources, time constraints, and technological barriers.

Steve Wynn’s attorneys said he settled in 2006 with a second woman who accused him of sexual misconduct and recently reported her to the FBI for alleged extortion. The woman’s attorney denied any extortion, and the FBI did not confirm an investigation.

The passage says Jeremy Corbyn was driven in a diesel Ford Galaxy to Westminster, where it was left on double yellow lines for 40 minutes, and criticizes him for hypocrisy because he often speaks about air pollution while using a car described as highly polluting.

The lecture introduces AMO physics as the study of atoms, molecules, photons, and electromagnetic fields, emphasizing its evolution from observation to control of nature. It highlights control of internal states, motion, and single quantum systems, and the field’s current focus on entanglement, many-body physics, and optical lattices. The speaker also outlines the course topics, requirements, and the use of optical lattices as a key example connecting atomic clocks, cooling, diffraction, interferometry, and many-body physics.

CPFL Energia launched Envo to target Brazil’s growing solar home market, offering equipment, installation, grid connection help, and support for selling excess energy. The company said demand is rising as consumers seek lower bills and less environmental impact, and connections to the national grid increased from 7,500 at the end of 2016 to 10,000 by April.
The passage is a list of HBO Max shows and documentaries, highlighting their plots, cast, seasons, awards, cancellations, and renewals, while recommending them as notable series to watch.

A toy manufactured by a Chinese company in Vietnam, designed by a Dutch artist in Belgium, inspired by Hong Kong indie toy culture, and popularized by a Thai K-pop star became a major Gen-Z cultural trend in 2025.

University of Utah scientists used dense portable seismometer networks and new seismic analysis to map the near-surface geology around Old Faithful, identifying a large hydrothermal reservoir and showing that eruption-related tremors occur just before eruptions.

The passage describes Secretary Stettinius urging flexible, informal positions before a general conference, discussion of the proposed name “United Nations,” and debate over principles in Chapter I. It then summarizes his diary: preparations for Yalta and Mexico City, efforts to notify Latin American associated nations about possible exclusion from the United Nations Conference, and work on memoranda and voting procedure ahead of the Big Three meeting and a future United Nations Conference.

The First Circuit affirmed denial of habeas relief, holding that Ronald L. Johnson’s confession was voluntary under the totality of the circumstances despite his injuries, lack of sleep, limited education, and failure to receive warnings.

French President Emmanuel Macron awarded climate grants to 18 researchers, including 13 based in the U.S., as part of his “Make Our Planet Great Again” initiative. Recipients Camille Parmesan and Benjamin Sanderson said the grants offer support for climate research amid funding and political difficulties in the United States, and both will work in France for the next few years.

The HDT/HYT program provided free asymptomatic COVID-19 testing in Yolo County and Davis, conducting 770,165 tests among 89,924 people. Testing participation was highest during Omicron, with women, people aged 19–44, and White participants testing most frequently, while participation declined after Omicron.

Worcester city employees, especially police, fire, and public works workers, received more than $11 million in overtime pay in 2017, with police alone taking home $4,399,365. City officials said the overtime was not due to understaffing but to special projects, training, protests, grants, and emergency work. Police detail pay also totaled $9,326,718, and some officers earned more in detail pay than in regular salary.

IU Health says flu season in Indiana may last until mid-April, with 278 flu deaths reported so far. The passage stresses that infections like flu and norovirus can spread through contaminated surfaces and phones, and that thorough handwashing is the best prevention.

The study used walking, visual diaries, photography, and art-making to help seven prospective teachers turn everyday experience into aesthetic experience and connect art, life, and place. Participants expanded their understanding of walking, developed new perspectives through aesthetic inquiry, and linked their observations to social issues, urban rhythms, and personal experience.

The passage criticizes the Supreme Court’s order barring political appeals based on religion, caste, creed, community, and language, arguing that identity-based politics has helped marginalized groups organize and gain representation. It says communalism should be addressed through law enforcement and political processes, not judicial fiat, and calls the order unimplementable because identity continues to influence elections in India.

Apple Inc.’s Q3 2023 Form 10-Q reports nine-month net sales of $293.8 billion and net income of $74.0 billion, with quarterly net sales of $81.8 billion and net income of $19.9 billion. Cash and cash equivalents were $28.4 billion, total assets were $335.0 billion, and the company repurchased $56.1 billion of common stock during the nine months ended July 1, 2023.

Abraaj, a large private equity firm focused on developing economies, drew scrutiny over its $1 billion health care fund after investors questioned how more than $200 million in cash was being used and sought forensic proof it was not funding Abraaj’s own operations. The fund bought hospitals in Nigeria, Pakistan, and India, while some investments underperformed, including CARE in India. Abraaj received backing from institutions including the World Bank’s IFC, the Gates Foundation, Proparco, and CDC Group, and Arif Naqvi continued promoting a larger $6 billion fund.

Extreme Networks shares fell 0.46%, and analysts have a 12-month consensus price target of $16.7 based on five opinions, versus a latest close of $10.87. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 1.2, with 1 Buy and 4 Outperform ratings, and its RSI is 45.3. Its market cap is $1.25 billion, with 115.06 million shares outstanding, 0.48 ATR-14, 3.70% weekly volatility, and 4.85% monthly volatility.

Amazon reported higher sales and income for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2018, with net sales rising to $56.6 billion in Q3 and $160.5 billion year to date, and net income increasing to $2.9 billion and $7.0 billion. Operating income improved across North America and AWS, while International losses narrowed. The company also reported acquisitions of Ring and PillPack, adopted new revenue and lease accounting guidance, and ended the period with $21.0 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash.

The speaker says the team reviewed video, knows what to do, and will watch more video at the hotel. They need to move the puck to the net quicker, reduce blocked shots, and focus on driving to the net, creating screens, and getting rebounds against strong goaltending.

The passage argues that #MeToo has prompted political resignations and backlash, but that parties should hold leaders to high standards and believe accusers while allegations are assessed. It says fairness does not require ignoring women’s claims, and that the movement should change the status quo rather than defend it.

Indiana is considering outcomes-based contracts with private tutoring companies to improve middle school reading, with payment tied to student results. Officials say the model is intended to create accountability, though evidence of success is limited and implementation details are still being worked out.
